ranking_policy: Source priority plus recency; curated view balances topics and caps each source. Not popularity or proof verification.

items.title: Stark units and cyclotomic Iwasawa theory over complex cubic fields
items.excerpt: For cyclotomic extensions of complex cubic fields, we prove the integral rank-$1$ and rational rank-$2$ abelian Stark conjectures. More generally, we prove a relative theorem on the higher-rank Rubin--Stark conjectures for cubic extensions of number fields. We then apply our Stark unit constructions to the Bergeron--Charollois--Garc\'{i}a conjectures on elliptic gamma values. Finally, we prove an Iwasawa main conjecture relating norm-compatible systems of Stark units to ideal class groups in cyclotomic towers over complex cubic fields.
items.title_zh: 复杂立方域上的斯塔克单位和分圆岩泽理论
items.excerpt_zh: 对于复三次域的分圆扩展，我们证明了积分秩-$1$ 和有理秩-$2$ 阿贝尔斯塔克猜想。更一般地说，我们证明了数域三次扩张的高阶鲁宾-斯塔克猜想的相对定理。然后，我们将 Stark 单元构造应用于关于椭圆伽玛值的 Bergeron--Charrollois--Garc\'{i}a 猜想。最后，我们证明了岩泽主要猜想，将斯塔克单位的范数兼容系统与​​复杂立方域上的分圆塔中的理想类群联系起来。

items.title: Effective bounds for adjoint Bloch-Kato Selmer groups of Hilbert modular forms
items.excerpt: Let $F$ be a totally real field and let $\Pi$ be a regular algebraic cuspidal automorphic representation of $\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb A_F)$. Under the usual Taylor-Wiles residual irreducibility hypothesis, we prove the vanishing of the adjoint Bloch-Kato Selmer group with characteristic-zero coefficients and give an explicit upper bound for a corresponding Selmer group with divisible coefficients. The argument revisits Wiles's use of level raising at Taylor-Wiles primes. In place of freeness or almost freeness of automorphic cohomology over a Hecke algebra, we compare congruence modules at the original and auxiliary levels and control the part of the Hecke cotangent space detected by the automorphic module. This produces Galois cohomology classes with prescribed ramification at the auxiliary primes. The resulting bounds depend explicitly on congruence data at the original automorphic level and on torsion in cotangent spaces of local deformation rings.
items.title_zh: 希尔伯特模形式的伴随 Bloch-Kato Selmer 群的有效界
items.excerpt_zh: 令$F$ 为完全实数域，并令$\Pi$ 为$\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb A_F)$ 的正则代数尖端自守表示。在通常的泰勒-怀尔斯剩余不可约性假设下，我们证明了具有特征零系数的伴随布洛赫-加藤塞尔默群的消失，并给出了具有可整除系数的相应塞尔默群的显式上限。这个论点重新审视了怀尔斯在泰勒-怀尔斯素数上使用水平提升的方法。代替赫克代数上自守上同调的自由性或几乎自由性，我们比较原始层和辅助层的同余模，并控制由自守模检测到的赫克余切空间的部分。这产生了在辅助素数处具有指定分支的伽罗瓦上同调类。所得到的边界明确取决于原始自同构水平上的同余数据以及局部变形环的余切空间中的扭转。

items.title: Constructing Large Euler Pseudoprimes through Carmichael Products
items.excerpt: Inspired by recent work on Carmichael numbers and by the construction of Sanchez, et al., we revisit the subset product construction of Alford, et al. We state a theoretical parallel variant of the pushdown algorithm and extend computational records in two ways. First, we construct a Carmichael number that is an Euler pseudoprime to every base up to $1172819$, which includes the first $90968$ prime numbers. Second, we extend the known list of Carmichael numbers with exactly $d$ prime factors from $d \leq 19565220$ to $d \leq 340210163$.
items.authors: Jon Grantham, Andrew Shallue, Jonathan Webster
items.title_zh: 通过卡迈克尔积构造大型欧拉伪素数
items.excerpt_zh: 受到最近关于卡迈克尔数的工作和桑切斯等人的构造的启发，我们重新审视了阿尔福德等人的子集积构造。我们提出了下推算法的理论并行变体，并以两种方式扩展计算记录。首先，我们构造一个卡迈克尔数，它是直到 $1172819$ 的每个基数的欧拉伪素数，其中包括前 $90968$ 素数。其次，我们将已知的卡迈克尔数列表扩展到 $d$ 质因数，从 $d \leq 19565220$ 到 $d \leq 340210163$。

items.title: Cartesian product of $\psi$-badly approximable sets
items.excerpt: In this note, we study the Cartesian products of sets in $\mathbb R^{d}$ that are $\psi$-approximable but not $c\psi$-approximable for arbitrarily small $c>0$, often denoted $\mathbf{Bad}_{d}(\psi)$. Setting $d=\sum_{i=1}^{N}d_i\in\mathbb N$ and $\psi_i(q)=q^{-\tau_i}$ with $\tau_i\geq 1/d_i$, $i=1,\ldots,N$, we calculate \[ \dim_{\mathrm H}\prod_{i=1}^{N}\mathbf{Bad}_{d_i}(\psi_i) =\min_{1\leq i\leq N}\left\{\frac{d_i+1}{\tau_i+1}+(d-d_i)\right\}=d- \max_{1\leq i\leq N}\left\{ d_i-\frac{d_i+1}{\tau_i+1} \right\}, \] for $\dim_{\mathrm H}$ denoting the Hausdorff dimension. The lower bound is obtained by combining the delayed-pruning construction of Koivusalo-Levesley-Ward-Zhang (IMRN, 2024) with the product Cantor-set method of Wang-Wu (TAMS, 2024).
items.authors: Mumtaz Hussain, Johannes Schleischitz, Benjamin Ward
items.title_zh: $\psi$-严重近似集的笛卡尔积
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们研究 $\mathbb R^{d}$ 中集合的笛卡尔积，对于任意小的 $c>0$，它们可 $\psi$ 逼近，但不可 $c\psi$ 逼近，通常表示为 $\mathbf{Bad}_{d}(\psi)$。设置 $d=\sum_{i=1}^{N}d_i\in\mathbb N$ 和 $\psi_i(q)=q^{-\tau_i}$ 与 $\tau_i\geq 1/d_i$, $i=1,\ldots,N$，我们计算 \[ \dim_{\mathrm H}\prod_{i=1}^{N}\mathbf{Bad}_{d_i}(\psi_i) =\min_{1\leq i\leq N}\left\{\frac{d_i+1}{\tau_i+1}+(d-d_i)\right\}=d- \max_{1\leq i\leq N}\left\{ d_i-\frac{d_i+1}{\tau_i+1} \right\}, \] 表示 $\dim_{\mathrm H}$ 表示豪斯多夫维度。下界是通过将 Koivusalo-Levesley-Ward-Zhang (IMRN, 2024) 的延迟剪枝构造与 Wang-Wu (TAMS, 2024) 的乘积 Cantor 集方法相结合而获得的。

items.title: Symmetric identities and determinants for matrices composed of Legendre symbols
items.excerpt: In this paper, we prove a series of identities and evaluate the determinants for a class of matrices composed of Legendre symbols given by Sun [10, Conjecture 3.2 (i)]. Together with [6] which proved Conjecture 3.2 (ii) in [10], these results provide a more general approach for a complete proof of Conjecture 3.2 in [10].
items.title_zh: 由勒让德符号组成的矩阵的对称恒等式和行列式
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们证明了一系列恒等式，并评估了由 Sun 给出的勒让德符号组成的一类矩阵的行列式[10，猜想 3.2 (i)]。与证明[10]中的猜想3.2(ii)的[6]一起，这些结果为[10]中的猜想3.2的完整证明提供了更通用的方法。

items.title: Murmurations in Short Intervals for Elliptic Curves Ordered by Height
items.excerpt: Murmurations are the phenomenon, first observed by He, Lee, Oliver, and Pozdnyakov (2025), that the average value of $\epsilon(E) a_p(E)$, the $p$-th $L$-function coefficient weighted by the root number, over elliptic curves of conductor in some range $N(E) \in [N_1, N_2]$ seem to approximate a continuous, oscillating function. While murmurations have been proven for other families of $L$-functions (notably by Zubrilina (2025) for weight $k$ modular forms), the only unconditional murmuration formula for elliptic curves is a partial result by Sawin and Sutherland (2025) ordering by naive height instead of conductor. In this setting, murmurations appear by first averaging $\epsilon(E) a_p(E)$ for a single curve over $p \in (C_1, C_2)$ and then average over elliptic curves of bounded height. However, Sawin and Sutherland's results average $\epsilon(E) a_n(E)$ over all of $\mathbb{N}$ instead of a small interval $(C_1, C_2).$ In this work, we prove how small the interval $(C_1, C_2)$ can be taken while preserving the conclusion of Sawin and Sutherland's first murmuration formula (Proposition 7).
items.title_zh: 按高度排序的椭圆曲线的短间隔杂音
items.excerpt_zh: 杂音是由 He、Lee、Oliver 和 Pozdnyakov (2025) 首先观察到的现象，即 $\epsilon(E) a_p(E)$ 的平均值（按根号加权的第 $p$-th $L$ 函数系数）在某些范围 $N(E) \in [N_1, N_2]$ 中的导体椭圆曲线上似乎近似于连续的振荡函数。虽然杂音已被证明适用于其他 $L$ 函数族（特别是 Zubrilina (2025) 的权重 $k$ 模形式），但椭圆曲线的唯一无条件杂音公式是 Sawin 和 Sutherland (2025) 按朴素高度而不是导体排序的部分结果。在此设置中，杂音的出现是通过首先对 $p \in (C_1, C_2)$ 上的单个曲线求 $\epsilon(E) a_p(E)$ 的平均值，然后对有界高度的椭圆曲线求平均值。然而，Sawin 和 Sutherland 的结果是在所有 $\mathbb{N}$ 上平均 $\epsilon(E) a_n(E)$，而不是一个小区间 $(C_1, C_2)$。在这项工作中，我们证明在保留 Sawin 和 Sutherland 第一个杂音公式的结论的同时，可以取多小的区间 $(C_1, C_2)$（命题 7）。

items.title: Counting solutions to sparse systems of congruences
items.excerpt: We obtain new bounds and asymptotic formulas for the number of solutions to sparse systems of $n$ diagonal congruences modulo an integer $q$ in $s$ variables. In a large range of parameters, our results improve and generalise those of A. A. Karatsuba (1976). In particular, our lower bound on $s$, which guarantees the solvability of such systems, depends only on $n$, rather than on specific degrees as in the work of A. A. Karatsuba (1976).
items.title_zh: 计算稀疏同余系统的解
items.excerpt_zh: 我们获得了 $n$ 对角线同余对 $s$ 变量中的整数 $q$ 取模的稀疏系统的解数的新界限和渐近公式。在大范围的参数中，我们的结果改进并推广了 A. A. Karatsuba (1976) 的结果。特别是，我们对 $s$ 的下限保证了此类系统的可解性，它仅取决于 $n$，而不是像 A. A. Karatsuba (1976) 的工作中那样取决于特定的程度。

items.title: $99.99\%$ of cubic surfaces have a rational point
items.excerpt: When cubic surfaces in $\mathbb{P}^3$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ are ordered by height, we prove that almost every such surface satisfies the Hasse principle. This extends work of Browning, Le Boudec and Sawin and completes the proof of the conjecture of Poonen and Voloch for Fano hypersurfaces. We also obtain an upper bound for the least height of a rational point on almost all everywhere locally soluble cubic surfaces and we give an upper bound for the number of cubic surfaces with a Brauer--Manin obstruction to the Hasse principle. Finally, once combined with a calculation of Beneish and Keyes about the density of everywhere locally soluble cubic surfaces, this establishes the explicit proportion of cubic surfaces that have a rational point.
items.title_zh: $99.99\%$ 的立方体表面有一个有理点
items.excerpt_zh: 当 $\mathbb{P}^3$ 和 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上的立方曲面按高度排序时，我们证明几乎每个这样的曲面都满足哈斯原理。这扩展了 Browning、Le Boudec 和 Sawin 的工作，并完成了 Poonen 和 Voloch 对 Fano 超曲面猜想的证明。我们还获得了几乎所有处处可局部可溶的立方表面上有理点的最小高度的上限，并且给出了具有对哈塞原理的布劳尔-马宁阻碍的立方表面的数量上限。最后，结合贝尼什和凯斯关于处处局部可溶立方表面密度的计算，就建立了具有有理点的立方表面的显式比例。

items.title: Multiplicativity of Vertex Energy Under the Kronecker Product
items.excerpt: We prove that vertex energy is multiplicative under the Kronecker product. Using this core property, we introduce a unified theorem to compute vertex energies for any graph operation obtained through the Kronecker product. As direct applications, we derive exact vertex energy formulas for semishadow, generalized splitting, and shadow-splitting graphs. Furthermore, we completely classify all blueprint matrices that preserve vertex energies.
items.authors: Ronak B Dudhat, Vinodray J Kaneria, Kalpesh M Popat
items.title_zh: 克罗内克积下顶点能量的乘数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了顶点能量在克罗内克乘积下是可乘的。利用这个核心属性，我们引入了一个统一定理来计算通过克罗内克积获得的任何图运算的顶点能量。作为直接应用，我们推导出半阴影图、广义分裂图和阴影分裂图的精确顶点能量公式。此外，我们对所有保留顶点能量的蓝图矩阵进行了完全分类。

items.title: Constructions and Upper Bounds for Trifferent Codes
items.excerpt: A ternary code of blocklength $n$ is trifferent if every three distinct codewords have a coordinate at which they take all three values. Let $T(n)$ be the largest size of such a code. We prove that $T(n)=\Omega(1.162579^n)$ and $T(n)=O(n^{-1/2}(3/2)^n)$. The lower bound improves the exponential base $(9/5)^{1/4}=1.15829\ldots$ of K\"orner and Marton. It comes from a random system of overlapping local constraints, in which every position is read two or three times, followed by thinning and the deletion of nearby pairs and of the remaining triples that violate trifference. The required estimates reduce to finitely many inequalities, which we verify rigorously by computer. The upper bound improves our earlier bound $O(n^{-2/5}(3/2)^n)$.
items.title_zh: 三差码的构造和上限
items.excerpt_zh: 如果每三个不同的码字都有一个坐标，在该坐标处它们取所有三个值，则块长度 $n$ 的三元码是三元码。令 $T(n)$ 为此类代码的最大大小。我们证明 $T(n)=\Omega(1.162579^n)$ 和 $T(n)=O(n^{-1/2}(3/2)^n)$。下界改进了 K\"orner 和 Marton 的指数底 $(9/5)^{1/4}=1.15829\ldots$。它来自重叠局部约束的随机系统，其中每个位置被读取两到三次，然后细化并删除附近的对以及违反 trifference 的剩余三元组。所需的估计减少到有限多个不等式，我们通过计算机严格验证。上限改进了我们之前的边界$O(n^{-2/5}(3/2)^n)$。

items.title: Graphs with the largest chainable index and their properties
items.excerpt: This paper provides a complete characterization of the set of graphs with the largest chainable index. In particular, it is shown that the number of arcs and vertex degrees of such graphs satisfy strong restrictions. Moreover, graphs with the largest chainable index form five parametric families, and exactly one of them consists of graphs that are not strongly connected. As a consequence, the number of graphs on $n$ vertices with the largest chainable index is computed, and the values of the primitive exponent for these graphs are calculated.
items.authors: Alexander Guterman, Svetlana Zhilina, Evgenii Shafeev
items.title_zh: 具有最大可链接索引的图及其属性
items.excerpt_zh: 本文提供了具有最大可链接索引的图集的完整特征。特别是，表明此类图的弧数和顶点度满足严格的限制。此外，具有最大可链接索引的图形成五个参数族，并且其中恰好一个由非强连接的图组成。因此，计算具有最大可链接索引的 $n$ 个顶点上的图的数量，并计算这些图的本原指数的值。

items.title: Nash-Williams' Orientation Theorems for Infinite Graphs
items.excerpt: Nash-Williams proved in 1960 that every finite multigraph has a \emph{well-balanced} orientation: for all vertices $x$ and $y$, the maximum number of arc-disjoint directed paths from $x$ to $y$ is at least half, rounded down, of the maximum number of edge-disjoint $x$--$y$ paths. In particular every finite $2k$-edge-connected multigraph has a $k$-arc-connected orientation. He announced an extension to infinite graphs whose details, as far as is known, never appeared, and the two statements for infinite graphs have since been known as the strong and the weak orientation conjecture of Nash-Williams. We prove both, for multigraphs of arbitrary cardinality. For multigraphs with countably many edges we obtain more: a well-balanced orientation that is smooth (in-degree and out-degree differ by at most one at every vertex of finite degree) and, if the multigraph is $2$-edge-connected, has infinitely many arcs in each direction across every infinite cut. Such an orientation is obtained by K\H{o}nig's lemma from a sequence of finite orientation problems, each solved by the theorem of Kir\'aly and Szigeti on simultaneous well-balanced orientati
items.authors: Amena Assem, Mohammad A. Mahmoud, Bobby Miraftab
items.title_zh: 无限图的纳什-威廉姆斯方向定理
items.excerpt_zh: Nash-Williams 在 1960 年证明，每个有限多重图都有一个 \emph{平衡良好} 的方向：对于所有顶点 $x$ 和 $y$，从 $x$ 到 $y$ 的弧不相交有向路径的最大数量至少是边不相交 $x$--$y$ 路径的最大数量的一半（向下舍入）。特别是每个有限的 $2k$ 边连接多重图都有一个 $k$ 弧连接方向。他宣布了无限图的扩展，但据所知，其细节从未出现过，无限图的两个陈述从此被称为纳什-威廉姆斯的强方向猜想和弱方向猜想。对于任意基数的多重图，我们证明了两者。对于具有可数条边的多重图，我们获得更多：一个平滑的均衡方向（在有限度的每个顶点上，入度和出度最多相差一个），并且如果多重图是 $2$ 边连接的，则在每个无限切割的每个方向上都有无限多个弧。这样的方向是通过 K\H{o}nig 引理从一系列有限方向问题中获得的，每个问题都通过 Kir'aly 和 Szigeti 关于同时平衡良好方向的定理来解决

items.title: Graceful Colorings for Random Graphs
items.excerpt: Given a vertex coloring $c:V(G)\to [k]$, the graceful induced edge labeling is the induced edge coloring $c'(uv):=|c(u)-c(v)|$. A vertex coloring $c$ is a \textbf{graceful coloring} if $c$ is a proper vertex coloring and $c'$ is a proper edge coloring. The graceful coloring number $\chi_g(G)$ is the least $k$ such that there exists a graceful coloring $c:V(G)\to [k]$. We study the graceful coloring number for the Erd\H{o}s-Renyi random graph, $G_{n,p}$. In the diameter $2$ regime, we find the $\chi_g(G_{n,p})=n^{1+o(1)}$ using a connection between graceful colorings and Salem-Spenser sets. In the regime where $G_{n,p}$ is connected, but not diameter 2, we find that $\chi_g(G_{n,p})=\Theta\left(\frac{n^2p^2}{\log np}\right)$, using the forbidden submatching method and a connection between graceful coloring and the chromatic number of the square of $G_{n,p}$. Finally, in the regime where $G_{n,p}$ has constant average degree, we find that $\chi_g(G_{n,p})=\Delta(G_{n,p})+1$, by exploring the cycle structure of $G_{n,p}$.
items.authors: Sean English, Edward Janosko, Erik Slivken, Sid Touzeau
items.title_zh: 随机图的优雅着色
items.excerpt_zh: 给定顶点着色 $c:V(G)\to [k]$，优雅的诱导边缘标记是诱导边缘着色 $c'(uv):=|c(u)-c(v)|$。如果 $c$ 是正确的顶点着色并且 $c'$ 是正确的边缘着色，则顶点着色 $c$ 是 \textbf{graceful coloring}。优雅着色数 $\chi_g(G)$ 是最小的 $k$，使得存在优雅着色 $c:V(G)\to [k]$。我们研究 Erd\H{o}s-Renyi 随机图 $G_{n,p}$ 的优美着色数。在直径 $2$ 体系中，我们使用优雅着色和 Salem-Spenser 集之间的连接找到 $\chi_g(G_{n,p})=n^{1+o(1)}$。在 $G_{n,p}$ 连接但不连接直径 2 的区域中，我们发现 $\chi_g(G_{n,p})=\Theta\left(\frac{n^2p^2}{\log np}\right)$，使用禁止子匹配方法以及优雅着色和 $G_{n,p}$ 平方色数之间的连接。最后，在$G_{n,p}$具有恒定平均度的情况下，通过探索$G_{n,p}$的循环结构，我们发现$\chi_g(G_{n,p})=\Delta(G_{n,p})+1$。

items.title: Inverses of split graphs via Ferrers diagrams and degree sequences
items.excerpt: A graph is a split graph if its vertex set can be partitioned into a clique and a stable set and is a partitioned split graph if the partition is also specified. The inverse of a partitioned split graph is formed by removing all edges within the clique and adding all edges between vertices in the stable set, while preserving the edges between the two parts. In this paper we compare two forms of the degree sequence of a graph: the conventional form and the block representation. We show the effect on the block representation of taking complements of graphs and inverses of split graphs, the latter of which is complicated by the fact that some split graphs have two different inverses. When there are two distinct inverses, we show how the degree sequences of these inverses are related to each other in both the conventional and block representations. We also demonstrate geometric interpretations of these results using Ferrers diagrams.
items.authors: Karen L. Collins, Tantan Dai, Ann N. Trenk
items.title_zh: 通过 Ferrers 图和度数序列实现分割图的逆
items.excerpt_zh: 如果图的顶点集可以划分为团集和稳定集，则图是分裂图；如果还指定了分区，则图是分区分裂图。分区分割图的逆是通过删除团内的所有边并添加稳定集中顶点之间的所有边，同时保留两部分之间的边来形成的。在本文中，我们比较了图的度序列的两种形式：常规形式和块表示。我们展示了取图的补集和分割图的逆对块表示的影响，后者由于某些分割图具有两个不同的逆而变得复杂。当存在两个不同的逆时，我们展示了这些逆的度数序列在传统表示和块表示中如何彼此相关。我们还使用 Ferrers 图演示了这些结果的几何解释。

items.title: Graphon hitting times: connectivity and minimum degree
items.excerpt: A classical result in random graphs states that the Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi random graph process becomes connected at exactly the moment its last isolated vertex disappears. The main goal of this paper is to establish a graphon analogue of this result. Let $G(n,W)$ be the inhomogeneous random graph sampled from a graphon $W$, and reveal its edges one by one in a uniformly random order. We prove that if $W$ is connected and the lower tail of its degree distribution satisfies $g_W(t)/t\to 0$ as $t\to 0$, which is needed for the connectivity of $G(n,W)$, then the connectivity and minimum-degree-one hitting times coincide asymptotically almost surely. We also determine when this hitting time occurs at scale $\Theta(n\log n)$, as in the binomial random graph model. Moreover, we give a simple analytic criterion for the transition to be localized in a $(1+o(1))$-multiplicative window, and construct graphons with minimum degrees arbitrarily close to zero whose transition is nevertheless sharp. Our approach uses Laplace transforms and vague convergence of rescaled graphon degree measures to provide a unified framework for analyzing low-degree verti
items.authors: Constanza Gacit\'ua Fuentes, Marcos Kiwi, Mat\'ias Pavez-Sign\'e
items.title_zh: Graphon 命中时间：连接性和最小程度
items.excerpt_zh: 随机图中的一个经典结果表明，Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi 随机图过程恰好在其最后一个孤立顶点消失的时刻变得连通。本文的主要目标是建立该结果的图形模拟。令 $G(n,W)$ 为从图 $W$ 中采样的非齐次随机图，并以均匀随机的顺序一一揭示其边。我们证明，如果 $W$ 是连通的，并且其度分布的下尾满足 $g_W(t)/t\to 0$ 作为 $t\to 0$，这是 $G(n,W)$ 的连通性所必需的，那么连通性和最小度一命中时间几乎肯定是渐近重合的。我们还确定此命中时间何时以 $\Theta(n\log n)$ 的规模发生，如二项式随机图模型中那样。此外，我们给出了一个简单的分析标准，用于将转变定位在 $(1+o(1))$ 乘法窗口中，并构造具有任意接近于零的最小度的图元，但其转变仍然是尖锐的。我们的方法使用拉普拉斯变换和重新缩放的图子度测量的模糊收敛来为分析低度垂直度提供统一的框架。

items.title: Helly complexes are minimal fillings
items.excerpt: We show that Helly complexes are universal minimal fillings. More precisely, if $X$ is a Helly complex, and $Y$ is a simplicial complex whose boundary is isomorphic to that of $X$ and such that the distances between the boundary vertices induced by $Y$ are at least as large as those induced by $X$, then $Y$ has at least as many vertices as $X$. The same type of inequalities hold for $i$-dimensional simplices of $X$ and $Y$ for all $i=0,1,\ldots$, i.e., for all coordinates of the $f$-vectors of $X$ and $Y$. When $Y$ is dismantlable, we show that the boundary isomorphism assumption can be weakened to a bijection between the vertex sets of both boundaries with an additional technical condition on boundary edges.
items.authors: Mart\'in Blufstein, J\'er\'emie Chalopin, Victor Chepoi
items.title_zh: Helly 复合物是最少的填充物
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明 Helly 复合物是通用的最小填充物。更准确地说，如果 $X$ 是 Helly 复形，并且 $Y$ 是单纯复形，其边界与 $X$ 的边界同构，并且 $Y$ 引起的边界顶点之间的距离至少与 $X$ 引起的边界顶点之间的距离一样大，则 $Y$ 至少具有与 $X$ 一样多的顶点。对于所有 $i=0,1,\ldots$，即对于 $X$ 和 $Y$ 的 $f$ 向量的所有坐标，相同类型的不等式适用于 $X$ 和 $Y$ 的 $i$ 维单纯形。当 $Y$ 可拆除时，我们表明边界同构假设可以弱化为两个边界的顶点集之间的双射，并在边界边上附加技术条件。

items.title: Kov\'acs Vanishing for Excellent Log Canonical Threefolds
items.excerpt: We prove a vanishing theorem of S. Kov\'acs for excellent log canonical threefolds whose closed points have perfect residue fields of sufficiently large characteristic. This vanishing theorem roughly says that LC threefold pairs are not far from being rational pairs (in the sense of Koll\'ar \& Kov\'acs and Schwede \& Takagi) if one includes a correction term. We apply this vanishing to prove a depth relation of Chou and resolution-invariance of cohomologies of ``essential divisors" for isolated log canonical threefolds in large characteristic, extending works of Ishii and Fujino. Using examples constructed by Bernasconi and Cascini-Tanaka, we show that these results fail in low characteristic. Finally, we show Kov\'acs and Alexeev-Hacon's result (in char 0) that ``Irrational centers are LC centers" fails in every positive characteristic.
items.title_zh: Kov\'acs 因出色的对数正则三重而消失
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了 S. Kov'acs 的消失定理，它适用于优秀的对数正则三重，其闭点具有足够大特征的完美剩余域。这个消失定理粗略地说，如果包含修正项，LC 三重对就离有理对不远了（在 Koll\'ar \& Kov\'acs 和 Schwede \& Takagi 的意义上）。我们应用这种消失来证明 Chou 的深度关系和大特征中孤立对数正则三重的“本质除数”上同调的分辨率不变性，扩展了 Ishii 和 Fujino 的工作。使用 Bernasconi 和 Cascini-Tanaka 构造的例子，我们表明这些结果在低特征中失败。最后，我们展示了 Kov\'acs 和 Alexeev-Hacon 的结果（在字符 0 中）“无理数”中心是 LC 中心”在每一个积极特征上都失败了。

items.title: Gerbe-corrected stringy E-functions
items.excerpt: We define an invariant of $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein complex varieties with at worst log-terminal singularities equipped with a rational Brauer class $\alpha$ that generalizes existing versions of the $\alpha$-corrected stringy $E$-polynomial, which are defined only for quotients of quasi-projective varieties by finite groups. Using recent results from $p$-adic integration, this new invariant can be shown to behave well for degenerate dual abelian fibrations and to agree with the intersection or BPS $E$-polynomial for certain moduli problems.
items.title_zh: Gerbe 校正的弦 E 函数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们定义了 $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein 复变簇的不变量，它具有最坏的对数终端奇点，配备有理布劳尔类 $\alpha$，它概括了 $\alpha$ 校正的弦 $E$-多项式的现有版本，该多项式仅针对有限群的准射影簇的商进行定义。使用 $p$-adic 积分的最新结果，可以证明这个新的不变量对于简并双阿贝尔纤维表现良好，并且与某些模问题的交集或 BPS $E$ 多项式一致。

items.title: Primitive Collections for Klyachko Varieties
items.excerpt: Klyachko introduced a family of $S_m\times S_n$-invariant toric Gorenstein Fano varieties, $X_{mn}$, with connections to representation theory, algebraic groups, and graph theory. He focused on the case in which $m$ and $n$ are coprime, for which $X_{mn}$ are smooth, and hence Fano. Klyachko and Voskresenskii later proved that all forms of $X_{mn}$ are stably rational when $m, n$ are coprime, and that all forms of $X_{mn}$ are rational when $n$ is congruent to 1 modulo $m$. In the same paper, they classified centrally symmetric toric Fano varieties as products of projective lines and generalized del Pezzo varieties, $X_{2,2k+1}$. For this reason, the special case of generalized del Pezzo varieties are frequently studied. For example, Ballard, Duncan, and McFadden proved that the bounded derived category of generalized del Pezzo varieties has a full exceptional collection of line bundles. An understanding of the maximal cones and primitive collections of the fan associated to $X_{2,2k+1}$ is crucial in their construction. In this paper, we focus on the Klyachko varieties $X_{mn}$ in the case in which $n$ is congruent to 1 modulo $m$. W
items.title_zh: Klyachko 品种的原始收藏
items.excerpt_zh: Klyachko 引入了一系列 $S_m\times S_n$ 不变的复曲面 Gorenstein Fano 簇 $X_{mn}$，与表示论、代数群和图论有关。他重点关注 $m$ 和 $n$ 互质的情况，其中 $X_{mn}$ 是光滑的，因此是 Fano。 Klyachko 和 Voskresenskii 后来证明，当 $m、n$ 互质时，所有形式的 $X_{mn}$ 都是稳定有理数，并且当 $n$ 与 1 模 $m$ 全等时，所有形式的 $X_{mn}$ 都是有理数。在同一篇论文中，他们将中心对称复曲面 Fano 簇分类为射影线的乘积和广义 del Pezzo 簇 $X_{2,2k+1}$。因此，人们经常研究广义 del Pezzo 变种的特殊情况。例如，Ballard、Duncan 和 McFadden 证明了广义 del Pezzo 簇的有界派生范畴具有完整的特殊线束集合。了解与 $X_{2,2k+1}$ 相关的扇形的最大锥体和原始集合对于其构造至关重要。在本文中，我们重点关注 $n$ 与 1 模 $m$ 全等的情况下的 Klyachko 簇 $X_{mn}$。瓦

items.title: Simple ordinary geometrically split abelian varieties over finite fields
items.excerpt: In this paper we provide a partial classification (necessary conditions) for all possible simple ordinary geometrically split abelian varieties over a finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$. Let $A$ be such an abelian variety, i.e. $A$ is simple over $\mathbb{F}_q$ and splits as $A \sim B^s$ over $\mathbb{F}_{q^d}$ for some simple abelian variety $B$. Assume that $d$ is a minimal extension degree over which $A$ splits and $B$ has a minimal field of definition (up to isogeny) $\mathbb{F}_{q^e}\subseteq \mathbb{F}_{q^d}$. For dimension $2$, Howe and Zhu showed that the only possible degrees $d$ are $2$, $3$, $4$, and $6$. Moreover, for each such degree $d$, they provided explicit formulae expressing the isogeny invariant, namely the characteristic polynomial of the Frobenius endomorphism $\chi_{A,q}$, in terms of the coeffients of $\chi_{B,q}$. We extend this result to ordinary abelian varieties of higher dimension. For dimensions $3$--$10$, we provide complete lists of such varieties as components of the Weil restriction $W_{\mathbb{F}_{q^d}/\mathbb{F}_q}(B)$ together with all possible triples $(d, e, s)$ and restrictions on characteristic polyno
items.title_zh: 有限域上的简单普通几何分裂阿贝尔簇
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们为有限域 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上所有可能的简单普通几何分裂阿贝尔簇提供了部分分类（必要条件）。设$A$是这样一个阿贝尔变体，即$A$是简单的$\mathbb{F}_q$，并且对于一些简单的阿贝尔变体$B$来说，分裂为$A\sim B^s$在$\mathbb{F}_{q^d}$上。假设 $d$ 是 $A$ 分裂的最小扩展度，并且 $B$ 具有最小定义域（直到同源）$\mathbb{F}_{q^e}\subseteq \mathbb{F}_{q^d}$。对于维度 $2$，Howe 和 Zhu 表明 $d$ 唯一可能的度数是 $2$、$3$、$4$ 和 $6$。此外，对于每个这样的度$d$，他们提供了表达同源不变量的明确公式，即Frobenius自同态$\chi_{A,q}$的特征多项式，以$\chi_{B,q}$的系数表示。我们将这个结果扩展到更高维度的普通阿贝尔簇。对于维度 $3$--$10$，我们提供了作为 Weil 限制 $W_{\mathbb{F}_{q^d}/\mathbb{F}_q}(B)$ 组成部分的变体的完整列表，以及所有可能的三元组 $(d, e, s)$ 以及对特征多项式的限制

items.title: A fake quadric that is not a bidisk quotient
items.excerpt: Fake quadrics are minimal complex surfaces of general type with $b_1=0$ and $e=4$. The paper gives a construction of a fake quadric $S$ that is a $32$-fold branched cover of $\mathbf{CP}^1\times\mathbf{CP}^1$ along nine curves. This configuration is given by four horizontal lines, four vertical lines and the diagonal. We show that $S$ is not aspherical. As a corollary the universal cover of $S$ is not the bidisk $\mathbf{H}\times\mathbf{H}$.
items.title_zh: 不是 bidisk 商的伪二次方程
items.excerpt_zh: 假二次曲面是一般类型的最小复曲面，其中 $b_1=0$ 和 $e=4$。该论文给出了一个伪二次曲面 $S$ 的构造，它是 $\mathbf{CP}^1\times\mathbf{CP}^1$ 沿九条曲线的 $32$ 倍分支覆盖。该配置由四根水平线、四根垂直线和对角线给出。我们证明 $S$ 不是非球面的。作为推论，$S$ 的通用覆盖不是 bidisk $\mathbf{H}\times\mathbf{H}$。

items.title: Semiorthogonal decompositions of limit categories for symmetric stacks
items.excerpt: In our earlier work with Tudor Padurariu, we introduced the notion of limit categories for derived stacks with self-dual cotangent complexes and used them to formulate the Dolbeault geometric Langlands conjecture. In this paper, we generalize the notion of limit categories to a broader class of derived stacks, which we call symmetric stacks. One of the motivations for this generalization is to formulate Dolbeault geometric Langlands-type correspondences for a broader class of moduli stacks. We establish several fundamental properties of limit categories for symmetric stacks, including compact generation, the existence of semiorthogonal decompositions, functoriality, and a Kunneth formula. In a companion paper, we apply the results of this paper to formulate a Dolbeault geometric Langlands-type conjecture for moduli stacks of sheaves on smooth surfaces with nef anticanonical divisors.
items.title_zh: 对称栈极限类别的半正交分解
items.excerpt_zh: 在我们早期与 Tudor Padurariu 的合作中，我们引入了具有自对偶余切复形的派生堆栈的极限范畴的概念，并用它们来制定 Dolbeault 几何朗兰兹猜想。在本文中，我们将极限类别的概念推广到更广泛的派生堆栈类别，我们将其称为对称堆栈。这种概括的动机之一是为更广泛的模堆栈类别制定 Dolbeault 几何朗兰兹型对应关系。我们建立了对称堆栈极限类别的几个基本属性，包括紧致生成、半正交分解的存在性、函子性和 Kunneth 公式。在另一篇论文中，我们应用本文的结果来制定 Dolbeault 几何 Langlands 型猜想，用于具有 nef 反规范因子的光滑表面上的滑轮模堆栈。

items.title: The Dolbeault geometric Langlands-type conjecture for smooth surfaces
items.excerpt: Using a general theory of limit categories for symmetric stacks, we construct their semiorthogonal decompositions for moduli stacks of pure one-dimensional coherent sheaves on smooth surfaces with nef anti-canonical divisors. The components of these semiorthogonal decompositions are quasi-BPS categories associated with the corresponding local Calabi--Yau threefolds. By comparing these semiorthogonal decompositions with those of dg-categories of coherent sheaves on moduli stacks of semistable sheaves, we propose a Dolbeault geometric Langlands-type conjecture for surfaces, generalizing the Dolbeault geometric Langlands conjecture for $\GL_r$-Higgs bundles. Our conjecture includes a correspondence for Higgs bundles twisted by sufficiently ample line bundles on curves. We discuss examples and construct Hecke actions on limit categories and, under certain conditions, on quasi-BPS categories. For symplectic surfaces, these actions are expected to provide a categorical lift of the corresponding Hecke operators on BPS cohomology constructed by Davison--Hennecart--Kinjo--Schiffmann--Vasserot.
items.title_zh: 光滑表面的 Dolbeault 几何 Langlands 型猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 使用对称堆栈极限类别的一般理论，我们构建了具有 nef 反规范除数的光滑表面上的纯一维相干滑轮模堆栈的半正交分解。这些半正交分解的分量是与相应的局部 Calabi-Yau 三重相关的准 BPS 类别。通过将这些半正交分解与半稳定滑轮模堆上相干滑轮的 dg 类别的分解进行比较，我们提出了曲面的 Dolbeault 几何朗兰兹型猜想，推广了 $\GL_r$-Higgs 丛的 Dolbeault 几何朗兰兹猜想。我们的猜想包括曲线上足够充足的线束扭曲希格斯丛的对应关系。我们讨论示例并在极限类别上以及在某些条件下在准 BPS 类别上构造 Hecke 动作。对于辛曲面，这些作用有望为由 Davison--Hennecart--Kinjo--Schiffmann--Vasserot 构建的 BPS 上同调上的相应 Hecke 算子提供分类提升。

items.title: Decomposition algorithms for rational curves on real classical groups
items.excerpt: This paper is devoted to an algorithmic investigation of the decomposition problem for rational curves on real classical groups. The main contributions are: (1) We present two Maple-implemented algorithms for decomposing rational curves on real classical groups. The first algorithm decomposes a curve with multiple poles into a unique product of curves with single poles. For rational curves on (indefinite) orthogonal groups, the second algorithm further decomposes single-pole curves into products of low-degree curves. The former only involves linear equations, whereas the latter requires solving both linear and quadratic equations. (2) We compare the decomposition of the same curve with respect to different ambient groups. Through this comparison, we provide an interpretation of the "multiplication trick" for motion polynomials within our framework. Moreover, we demonstrate that our second algorithm aligns with this trick. (3) We prove that the solvability of linear equations in the second algorithm is preserved under the extension of the ambient group. For illustration, we provide comprehensive computational examples.
items.authors: Yifan Li, Zijia Li, Ke Ye
items.title_zh: 实经典群上有理曲线的分解算法
items.excerpt_zh: 本文致力于实经典群上有理曲线分解问题的算法研究。主要贡献是：（1）我们提出了两种 Maple 实现的算法，用于分解真实经典群上的有理曲线。第一种算法将多极点曲线分解为单极点曲线的唯一乘积。对于（不定）正交群上的有理曲线，第二种算法进一步将单极点曲线分解为低次曲线的乘积。前者仅涉及线性方程，而后者需要求解线性方程和二次方程。 (2) 我们比较同一曲线对于不同环境组的分解。通过这种比较，我们在我们的框架内提供了对运动多项式的“乘法技巧”的解释。此外，我们证明了我们的第二个算法与这个技巧相一致。 (3)我们证明了第二个算法中线性方程组的可解性在环境群的扩展下得以保留。为了便于说明，我们提供了全面的计算示例。

items.title: Simultaneous coordinate-wise Wasserstein central limit theorem in high dimensions
items.excerpt: For independent centered random vectors $(X_i)_{i=1}^n$ of finite fourth moments, we obtain dimension free Wasserstein bound between its normalized sum $W_n = n^{-1/2}\sum X_i$ and a Gaussian whose covariance equals that of $W_n$. The coupling between $W_n$ and the Gaussian is strong in the sense that a single coupling controls controls every projection onto a subset of those eigen coordinates. The proof combines stochastic localization, Hermite expansion on a Gaussian prior with exchangeable pairing. This proves the Conjecture surmised in \cite{fang2026sharp} and improves the coefficient on the fourth-moment term from $2$ to $197/108$. The same Wasserstein error bound extends to real separable Hilbert space. For Hilbert-valued i.i.d. observations, the $L^2$ prediction error bound has an order of $O(n^{-1/2})$, with no dimension factor or restriction on covariance eigenvalue decay, and the same coupling retains bounds for every spectral projection. In an $\ell^2$ example, we demonstrate that the coordinate-wise error gives sharp error order of $n^{-1/2}$.
items.title_zh: 高维同时坐标方式 Wasserstein 中心极限定理
items.excerpt_zh: 对于有限四阶矩的独立中心随机向量 $(X_i)_{i=1}^n$，我们获得其归一化和 $W_n = n^{-1/2}\sum X_i$ 与协方差等于 $W_n$ 协方差的高斯之间的无维 Wasserstein 界。 $W_n$ 和高斯之间的耦合很强，因为单个耦合控制控制着这些特征坐标子集上的每个投影。该证明结合了随机定位、高斯先验上的 Hermite 扩展和可交换配对。这证明了 \cite{fang2026sharp} 中推测的猜想，并将四阶矩项的系数从 $2$ 提高到 $197/108$。同样的 Wasserstein 误差界扩展到实数可分离希尔伯特空间。对于希尔伯特值 i.i.d.观察中，$L^2$ 预测误差界限的阶数为 $O(n^{-1/2})$，没有维度因子或对协方差特征值衰减的限制，并且相同的耦合保留每个光谱投影的界限。在 $\ell^2$ 示例中，我们证明坐标方向误差给出了 $n^{-1/2}$ 的尖锐误差阶。

items.title: From random intersection to spatial graphs: a unified asymptotic framework
items.excerpt: Random intersection graphs and spatial random graphs provide different mechanisms for generating edges and clustering. We investigate their interplay through geometric random intersection graphs, where vertices are adjacent whenever they share a spatially located group. First, a Poisson decomposition by attachment sets yields exact subgraph probabilities and laws of large numbers for connected subgraph densities. It distinguishes triangles supported by a common group from those requiring three distinct groups. Second, explicit representations of global and average local clustering reveal their different dependence on model parameters and the role of shared groups in edge correlations. Finally, by varying the strength and spatial range of group memberships, we establish convergence to random connection, random geometric, random intersection, Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi, and complete graphs. We characterize the corresponding clustering limits and show that clustering need not converge to that of the limiting graph, highlighting the distinction between spatially local convergence and global graph statistics.
items.authors: Alessandra Bianchi, Alberto De Nicol\`o, Riccardo Michielan
items.title_zh: 从随机交集到空间图：统一的渐近框架
items.excerpt_zh: 随机交集图和空间随机图提供了不同的生成边和聚类的机制。我们通过几何随机交集图研究它们的相互作用，其中只要共享一个空间定位组，顶点就相邻。首先，通过附件集进行泊松分解可产生精确的子图概率和连通子图密度的大数定律。它将由公共组支持的三角形与需要三个不同组的三角形区分开来。其次，全局和平均局部聚类的显式表示揭示了它们对模型参数的不同依赖性以及共享组在边缘相关性中的作用。最后，通过改变群体成员的强度和空间范围，我们建立了随机连接、随机几何、随机交集、Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi 和完整图的收敛。我们描述了相应的聚类限制，并表明聚类不需要收敛到限制图的收敛，突出了空间局部收敛和全局图统计之间的区别。

items.title: Differentiability of the shape function in the planar corner growth model
items.excerpt: We prove that the shape function of planar directed last-passage percolation with general i.i.d.\ real-valued weights is differentiable on the open first quadrant, under a moment assumption of order $p''>4$ on the positive part of the weight and a nearly optimal order $p'>1$ on the negative part. Due to known results, only directions outside a percolation cone need be considered. The proof is a multiscale path-counting argument that uses the shape theorem, oriented percolation on a coarse-grained lattice, a simple change of measure in a finite region, and the van den Berg--Kesten inequality. Our Lean-formalized proof is an AI-assisted adaptation and improvement of the OpenAI proof of differentiability in planar first-passage percolation.
items.authors: Christopher Janjigian, Firas Rassoul-Agha, Timo Sepp\"al\"ainen
items.title_zh: 平面角增长模型中形状函数的可微性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，在权重正部分阶数 $p''>4$ 的矩假设和负部分近似最优阶 $p'>1$ 的矩假设下，具有一般 i.i.d.\ 实值权重的平面定向最后通道渗流的形状函数在开放第一象限上是可微的。由于已知结果，仅需要考虑渗滤锥之外的方向。证明是一个多尺度路径计数论证，它使用形状定理、粗粒度格上的定向渗透、有限区域中的简单测量变化以及 van den Berg-Kest​​en 不等式。我们的精益形式化证明是对平面首代渗透中可微分性 OpenAI 证明的 AI 辅助适应和改进。

items.title: Quantitative Convergence of the Nodal Length of Random Trigonometric Polynomials
items.excerpt: We establish quantitative convergence results for the distribution of the nodal length of two-dimensional random trigonometric polynomials with independent and identically distributed centered coefficients towards that of the corresponding Gaussian limiting field. More precisely, we obtain an explicit polynomial rate of convergence. The proof combines probabilistic and geometric arguments. First, we establish quantitative convergence estimates for the underlying random fields. Using a suitable functional representation, this problem is reduced to the quantitative convergence of an empirical field towards a Brownian sheet in a Wasserstein-type distance. Second, Crofton's formula allows us to express the nodal length in terms of the zeros of the restrictions of the random trigonometric polynomials to parametrized affine lines. This reduction makes it possible to adapt one-dimensional arguments based on Kac's counting formula and transfer the convergence estimates for the random fields to the associated nodal lengths.
items.title_zh: 随机三角多项式节点长度的定量收敛
items.excerpt_zh: 我们建立了二维随机三角多项式的节点长度分布的定量收敛结果，该多项式具有独立且相同分布的中心系数，朝向相应的高斯极限场。更准确地说，我们获得了显式多项式收敛率。该证明结合了概率论和几何论证。首先，我们为基础随机场建立定量收敛估计。使用合适的函数表示，这个问题被简化为经验场向 Wasserstein 型距离的布朗片的定量收敛。其次，克罗夫顿公式允许我们用随机三角多项式对参数化仿射线的限制的零点来表达节点长度。这种减少使得可以根据 Kac 计数公式调整一维参数，并将随机场的收敛估计转移到相关的节点长度。

items.title: Height function covariance and point-to-line coalescence in the directed landscape
items.excerpt: We prove an integration-by-parts formula for the KPZ fixed point with a deterministic $C_b^1$ terminal reward. For flat data, let $C(x)$ denote the spatial height covariance at time one. For almost every $x>0$, we show that $-C'(x)$ is the probability that the point-to-line geodesics started at $0$ and $x$ coalesce by time one. The proof uses Gaussian integration by parts for the O'Connell--Yor polymer, followed by the zero-temperature and directed-landscape limits.
items.authors: Yu Gu, Jeremy Quastel, Tianhao Xian
items.title_zh: 有向景观中的高度函数协方差和点到线合并
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了具有确定性 $C_b^1$ 终端奖励的 KPZ 不动点的分部积分公式。对于平面数据，让 $C(x)$ 表示第一时刻的空间高度协方差。对于几乎每个 $x>0$，我们表明 $-C'(x)$ 是点到线测地线从 $0$ 开始且 $x$ 在时间 1 合并的概率。该证明使用 O'Connell-Yor 聚合物的部分高斯积分，然后是零温度和定向景观限制。

items.title: On the Cluster Duration Distribution of the Markovian Hawkes Process
items.excerpt: The duration of a Hawkes process cluster, meaning the time from first point to last point in an entirely endogenously generated progeny stream, has been stubbornly resistant to analysis; even the mean has not been known in closed form. Recently, uniformly random parking functions have been found to be hidden spines of these history-driven clusters, offering a probabilistic combinatorial structure within self-excitement that has opened new avenues for analysis. Here, we leverage and refine this decomposition to provide a closed-form expression for the mean cluster duration in the case of an exponential excitation kernel. Specifically, we reduce from uniformly random parking functions to non-uniform preference counts. This change of probabilistic combinatorial structure in the decomposition leads us to both a Borel-based identity and an explicit integral-based expression for the mean duration.
items.title_zh: 马尔可夫霍克斯过程的簇持续时间分布
items.excerpt_zh: 霍克斯过程簇的持续时间，即完全内生生成的子代流中从第一个点到最后一个点的时间，一直顽固地难以分析；甚至连平均值也不以封闭形式得知。最近，人们发现均匀随机停车函数是这些历史驱动集群的隐藏脊柱，在自兴奋中提供了概率组合结构，为分析开辟了新途径。在这里，我们利用并细化这种分解，以在指数激励核的情况下提供平均簇持续时间的封闭形式表达式。具体来说，我们从均匀随机停车函数减少到非均匀偏好计数。分解中概率组合结构的这种变化使我们得到基于 Borel 的恒等式和平均持续时间的显式基于积分的表达式。

items.title: Improving the efficiency of the ratio-of-uniforms method
items.excerpt: In 1977, Kinderman and Monahan showed that under certain conditions, a random variable can be expressed as the ratio $V/U$, where $(U,V)$ is uniformly distributed over a bounded region $S\subset{\mathds R}^2$. Thus, by generating values of $(U,V)$ and computing the indicated ratio, samples from the random variable can be obtained. This procedure is now known as the ratio-of-uniforms method and relies heavily on our ability to produce uniform samples from $S$, for which an acceptance-rejection method is customarily used. In this paper, we propose three sampling schemes based on the polar representation of $S$. The first uses a covering consisting of triangles, the second uses a covering based on circular sectors, while the third employs rectangular coverings of an associated angular density. Numerical examples illustrate that these schemes can achieve acceptance rates close to $100\%$.
items.title_zh: 提高均匀比率方法的效率
items.excerpt_zh: 1977 年，Kinderman 和 Monahan 证明，在某些条件下，随机变量可以表示为比率 $V/U$，其中 $(U,V)$ 均匀分布在有界区域 $S\subset{\mathds R}^2$ 上。因此，通过生成 $(U,V)$ 的值并计算指示的比率，可以获得随机变量的样本。这个过程现在被称为均匀比率方法，在很大程度上依赖于我们从 $S$ 生成均匀样本的能力，通常使用接受-拒绝方法。在本文中，我们提出了三种基于$S$的极坐标表示的采样方案。第一种使用由三角形组成的覆盖物，第二种使用基于圆形扇形的覆盖物，而第三种使用具有相关角密度的矩形覆盖物。数值例子表明这些方案可以达到接近$100\%$的接受率。

items.title: Martingale averages, Fourier extension and the Schr\"odinger equation
items.excerpt: The martingale averaged Fourier extension theorem holds for the paraboloid in n dimensions on the Knapp line. Using embedding and interpolation, this gives the complete range of possible exponents (the diagonal case p=q was obtained in [Saw7] using smooth Alpert wavelets instead). OpenAI has recently announced proofs of the deterministic analogue on the diagonal p=q [Ope] and of the local smoothing conjecture [OpeLS], in all dimensions. Since a deterministic estimate at a point on the Knapp line implies the probabilistic one there, the point of the present paper is a short, elementary and self-contained proof of the probabilistic estimate, which uses no Kakeya-type input. We give an application of the probabilistic Knapp theorem to the global initial value problem for the Schr\"odinger equation, in which we obtain sharp regularity results averaged over martingale transforms of the initial data f.
items.authors: Lyudmila Korobenko, Cristian Rios, Eric T. Sawyer
items.title_zh: 马丁格尔平均值、傅里叶扩展和 Schr\"odinger 方程
items.excerpt_zh: 鞅平均傅里叶扩展定理对于纳普线上的 n 维抛物面成立。使用嵌入和插值，这给出了可能指数的完整范围（对角线情况 p=q 是在 [Saw7] 中使用平滑的 Alpert 小波获得的）。 OpenAI 最近宣布了所有维度上对角线 p=q [Ope] 上的确定性模拟和局部平滑猜想 [OpeLS] 的证明。由于纳普线上某一点的确定性估计意味着那里的概率估计，因此本文的要点是概率估计的简短、基本且独立的证明，它不使用 Kakeya 类型的输入。我们将概率 Knapp 定理应用于 Schr\"odinger 方程的全局初始值问题，其中我们获得了对初始数据 f 的鞅变换进行平均的尖锐正则性结果。

items.title: hp-Adaptive Finite Element Modeling of Static Cracks in Density-Dependent Media
items.excerpt: The elastostatic crack-tip fields within a density-dependent continuum are numerically investigated under several macroscopic loading configurations. The governing nonlinear boundary value problem is formulated using an algebraically nonlinear hyperelastic constitutive relationship in which the material moduli are intrinsically coupled to volumetric strain. Existence and uniqueness of the weak solution to the nonlinear displacement-based variational formulation are rigorously established at the continuous level via the Minty-Browder theorem. The variational formulation is then linearized at the partial differential equation level to construct a continuous damped Newton-Raphson scheme. To accurately capture the severe field gradients and internal singularities inherent to this model, the resulting sequence of linear operator equations is discretized and solved via a conforming finite element method within an $hp$-adaptive framework. A comparative analysis is conducted across five distinct boundary loading profiles (encompassing uniform, piecewise-slope, and concentrated point loads) applied to a stationary cracked geometry. Within each
items.authors: Vicente Valle Martinez, Saugata Ghosh, S. M. Mallikarjunaiah, Dambaru Bhatta
items.title_zh: 密度相关介质中静态裂纹的 HP 自适应有限元建模
items.excerpt_zh: 在几种宏观载荷配置下对密度相关连续体内的弹性静力裂纹尖端场进行了数值研究。使用代数非线性超弹性本构关系来表述控制非线性边值问题，其中材料模量本质上与体积应变耦合。基于非线性位移的变分公式的弱解的存在性和唯一性通过 Minty-Browder 定理在连续水平上严格建立。然后在偏微分方程级别对变分公式进行线性化，以构建连续阻尼牛顿-拉夫森格式。为了准确捕获该模型固有的严重场梯度和内部奇点，所得到的线性算子方程序列被离散化，并通过 $hp$ 自适应框架内的一致有限元方法进行求解。对应用于静态裂纹几何形状的五个不同的边界载荷分布（包括均匀载荷、分段倾斜载荷和集中点载荷）进行了比较分析。每个内

items.title: Error estimates for a structure-preserving finite-element scheme of quasi-incompressible Navier-Stokes-Maxwell-Stefan systems
items.excerpt: A conforming finite-element scheme for quasi-incompressible Navier-Stokes-Maxwell-Stefan systems in a bounded domain with periodic boundary conditions is presented. The system consists of the Navier-Stokes equations, together with a quasi-incompressibility constraint, coupled with the cross-diffusion Maxwell--Stefan equations. The numerical scheme preserves the partial masses and the quasi-incompressibility constraint and dissipates the discrete energy. First-order error estimates in space and time are shown for a diffusion-augmented mobility matrix by using the relative energy method and suitable projection error estimates. Numerical experiments in two space dimensions illustrate the convergence of the scheme and indicate second-order convergence in space in the $L^2$ norm.
items.authors: Aaron Brunk, Ansgar J\"ungel, Maria Luk\'a\v{c}ov\'a-Medvid'ov\'a
items.title_zh: 准不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯-麦克斯韦-斯特凡系统的结构保持有限元格式的误差估计
items.excerpt_zh: 提出了具有周期性边界条件的有界域中准不可压缩 Navier-Stokes-Maxwell-Stefan 系统的一致有限元格式。该系统由纳维-斯托克斯方程、准不可压缩约束以及交叉扩散麦克斯韦-斯特凡方程组成。数值格式保留了部分质量和准不可压缩性约束并耗散了离散能量。通过使用相对能量方法和适当的投影误差估计，显示了扩散增强移动性矩阵的空间和时间一阶误差估计。二维空间维度的数值实验说明了该方案的收敛性，并表明在 $L^2$ 范数下空间中的二阶收敛。

items.title: Adaptive Blockwise Tensor Trains for Stochastic Finite-Volume Methods with Uncertain Geometry
items.excerpt: Stochastic finite-volume (SFV) methods extend conservative, shock-capturing discretizations to hyperbolic systems with uncertain inputs by partitioning the parameter domain into finite-volume cells. However, their memory and computational cost grow exponentially with the number of uncertain parameters. Tensor-train (TT) formats can remove this exponential dependence, provided the ranks of the discrete solution remain small throughout the simulation. This requirement is frequently violated when the uncertainty is geometric. Mapping each realization onto a common reference domain introduces parameter-dependent metric factors, so that shocks and contacts propagate at different reference speeds and come to occupy different cells across realizations. The resulting rank growth is spatially localized - a structure that neither a single global TT nor a separate TT for each physical cell is able to exploit. We propose an adaptive blockwise TT representation in which the SFV solution is partitioned along its physical mode into contiguous blocks, each stored as an independent TT for every conserved variable. Blocks are split near discontinuities
items.authors: William P. Gammel, Steven T. Walton, Stephen A. Andrews, Svetlana Tokareva, William T. Taitano
items.title_zh: 具有不确定几何的随机有限体积方法的自适应分块张量训练
items.excerpt_zh: 随机有限体积 (SFV) 方法通过将参数域划分为有限体积单元，将保守的冲击捕获离散化扩展到具有不确定输入的双曲系统。然而，它们的内存和计算成本随着不确定参数的数量呈指数增长。如果离散解的等级在整个模拟过程中保持较小，则张量训练 (TT) 格式可以消除这种指数依赖性。当不确定性是几何的时，这一要求经常被违反。将每个实现映射到公共参考域引入了参数相关的度量因子，以便冲击和接触以不同的参考速度传播，并在实现中占据不同的单元。由此产生的排名增长是空间局部化的——单个全局 TT 和每个物理单元的单独 TT 都无法利用这种结构。我们提出了一种自适应分块 TT 表示，其中 SFV 解沿着其物理模式划分为连续的块，每个块存储为每个保守变量的独立 TT。块在不连续处附近被分割

items.title: FokasNets: Completing missing boundary data in Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Operators via the Global Relation
items.excerpt: We introduce FokasNets, a framework that combines Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and operators (PINOs) with the Global Relation (GR) formulation of the Fokas method (also referred to as the Unified Transform), for mixed boundary problems. The general framework considers lifted representations of the neural network models, where the Dirichlet boundary conditions are imposed by construction and the neural network learns the interior correction. The Global Relation is used as an additional solve during training that provides the missing boundary conditions to the lifted neural network, making training more efficient and accurate in the interior and on the boundary. We develop the construction of FokasNets for elliptic and evolution PDEs (Fokas-PINNs), and the corresponding PDE solution operator problems (Fokas Operator Networks - FONets), using the Global Relation formulations for these PDE classes. Furthermore, we develop the necessary theoretical framework for FokasNets, including error and stability analysis and show that FokasNets are universal approximators. We provide comprehensive numerical experiments, using examples wi
items.authors: Kyriakos C. Georgiou, Khemraj Shukla, Athanassios S. Fokas, George Em Karniadakis
items.title_zh: FokasNets：通过全局关系完成物理信息神经网络和算子中缺失的边界数据
items.excerpt_zh: 我们引入 FokasNets，这是一个将物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 和运算符 (PINO) 与 Fokas 方法（也称为统一变换）的全局关系 (GR) 公式相结合的框架，用于解决混合边界问题。总体框架考虑了神经网络模型的提升表示，其中狄利克雷边界条件是通过构造施加的，并且神经网络学习内部校正。全局关系在训练期间用作附加解决方案，为提升的神经网络提供缺失的边界条件，使内部和边界上的训练更加高效和准确。我们使用这些偏微分方程类的全局关系公式，开发椭圆和演化偏微分方程 (Fokas-PINN) 的 FokasNets 构造，以及相应的偏微分方程解算子问题（Fokas 算子网络 - FONets）。此外，我们为 FokasNets 开发了必要的理论框架，包括误差和稳定性分析，并表明 FokasNets 是通用逼近器。我们提供全面的数值实验，并使用示例

items.title: PACL: Patch-based Admissibility and Conservative Limiting framework for bound-preserving compact single-step DG methods for hyperbolic conservation laws
items.excerpt: We develop a Patch-based Admissibility and Conservative Limiting (PACL) framework for compact single-step discontinuous Galerkin (DG) discretizations of hyperbolic conservation laws. The key idea is to establish admissibility of weighted averages over overlapping cell patches after a complete high-order time step. Continuous patch weights cancel interior numerical flux contributions, yielding admissibility estimates for weighted patch averages under suitable time-step conditions. A conservative patch correction uses these averages as reference states to obtain admissible physical cell averages, and a subsequent cellwise scaling enforces whole-cell or nodal admissibility in the original DG space. The framework requires neither a strong-stability-preserving decomposition nor auxiliary first-order discretizations, and all limiting is performed at the end of each time step. For scalar conservation laws, we prove a patchwise weak maximum principle for compact Runge--Kutta DG (cRKDG), ADER-DG with converged or fixed-Picard predictors, and Lax--Wendroff DG. items.title_zh: PACL：基于补丁的可接受性和保守限制框架，用于双曲守恒定律的保界紧凑单步 DG 方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了基于补丁的可接受性和保守限制（PACL）框架，用于双曲守恒定律的紧凑单步不连续伽辽金（DG）离散化。关键思想是在完整的高阶时间步长之后建立重叠细胞斑块上加权平均值的可接受性。连续斑块权重消除了内部数值通量贡献，从而在适当的时间步条件下产生加权斑块平均值的可接受性估计。保守的补丁校正使用这些平均值作为参考状态来获得可接受的物理单元平均值，并且随后的单元缩放强制原始 DG 空间中的全单元或节点可接受性。该框架既不需要强保稳定性分解，也不需要辅助一阶离散化，并且所有限制都在每个时间步结束时执行。对于标量守恒定律，我们证明了紧凑 Runge--Kutta DG (cRKDG)、具有收敛或固定 Picard 预测器的 ADER-DG 以及 Lax--Wendroff DG 的补丁弱极大值原理。我们还证明，在规定的局部网格和缩放假设下，单个应用程序

items.title: Anderson-Accelerated Landweber Iteration with Regularization Guarantees for Nonlinear Ill-Posed Problems
items.excerpt: Anderson acceleration (AA) can markedly reduce iteration counts for fixed-point solvers, but its unrestricted signed history extrapolation need not preserve the stability required for iterative regularization of ill-posed problems. We introduce a regularization-guaranteed Anderson-accelerated Landweber method (\RG) in which finite-memory AA generates a proposal while the committed iterate is a controlled perturbation of a certified Landweber anchor. Under a local tangential cone condition and a scale-normalized localization condition, we prove strong convergence of the exact-data trajectory to a solution, stability at every fixed iteration, finite discrepancy stopping, and strong convergence of the discrepancy-stopped noisy reconstructions to the same exact-data limit; local uniqueness is needed only if that selected limit is to be identified with a prescribed solution $x^\dagger$. Under the additional benchmark source condition $x^\dagger-x_0=F'(x^\dagger)^*\lambda^\dagger$ and a standard range-invariance condition, we obtain the discrepancy-principle rate $\norm{x_{k_\delta}^\delta-x^\dagger}=O(\delta^{1/2})$. items.authors: Jianming Gao, Xiliang Lu, Lin Tian
items.title_zh: 非线性不适定问题的具有正则化保证的安德森加速 Landweber 迭代
items.excerpt_zh: 安德森加速（AA）可以显着减少定点求解器的迭代次数，但其无限制的带符号历史外推不需要保持不适定问题的迭代正则化所需的稳定性。我们引入了一种正则化保证的安德森加速 Landweber 方法 (\RG)，其中有限内存 AA 生成提案，而提交的迭代是经过认证的 Landweber 锚点的受控扰动。在局部切向锥条件和尺度归一化定位条件下，我们证明了精确数据轨迹对解的强收敛性、每次固定迭代的稳定性、有限差异停止以及差异停止噪声重建对相同精确数据极限的强收敛性；仅当要使用规定的解决方案 $x^\dagger$ 来识别所选限制时，才需要局部唯一性。在额外的基准源条件$x^\dagger-x_0=F'(x^\dagger)^*\lambda^\dagger$和标准范围不变条件下，我们得到差异原理率$\norm{x_{k_\delta}^\delta-x^\dagger}=O(\delta^{1/2})$。速率证明控制

items.title: A fast tangential rational Krylov subspace method with randomized sketching for large Lyapunov matrix equations
items.excerpt: We propose a tangential rational Krylov subspace method augmented with randomized sketching for solving continuous-time Lyapunov equations $AX + XA^T + BB^T = 0$, where $A$ is large and sparse and $B$ has a rank much higher than one. Numerical solutions require high-dimensional rational Krylov subspaces (e.g., of dimensions up to $\sim 1000$), leading to substantial computational cost and long runtime. Building on the adaptive strategies of [SIAM\,J.\,Matrix\,Anal.\,Appl., 35\,(2014), pp.\,476--498], which expand the subspace using the most relevant directions, we introduce several enhancements: selective orthogonalization of basis vectors and fast residual-norm estimation enabled by randomized sketching, and the option to use either adaptive distinct poles or a small set of repeated poles. We derive a new computable error bound for the approximate solutions and show that sketching does not degrade the convergence rate relative to the standard (non-sketched) algorithm. Numerical experiments demonstrate improved robustness and efficiency, with reduced runtimes and often higher accuracy than the standard tangential method.
items.title_zh: 大型 Lyapunov 矩阵方程的随机草图快速切向有理 Krylov 子空间方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一种通过随机草图增强的切向有理 Krylov 子空间方法，用于求解连续时间 Lyapunov 方程 $AX + XA^T + BB^T = 0$，其中 $A$ 大且稀疏，$B$ 的秩远高于 1。数值解需要高维有理 Krylov 子空间（例如，维度高达 $\sim 1000$），从而导致大量的计算成本和较长的运行时间。基于 [SIAM\,J.\,Matrix\,Anal.\,Appl., 35\,(2014), pp.\,476--498] 的自适应策略（使用最相关的方向扩展子空间），我们引入了一些增强功能：基础向量的选择性正交化和通过随机草图实现的快速残差范数估计，以及使用自适应不同极点或一​​小组重复极点的选项。我们为近似解推导了一个新的可计算误差界，并表明相对于标准（非草图）算法，草图绘制不会降低收敛速度。数值实验表明，与标准切向方法相比，鲁棒性和效率得到了提高，运行时间更短，而且精度通常更高。

items.title: Two 3-Dimensional Coefficient Inverse Problems for Wave-like Equations With a Single Location of the Point Source
items.excerpt: In this paper two long standing open questions are addressed for the first time. Those questions are about Lipschitz stability estimates and uniqueness theorems for two Coefficient Inverse Problems (CIPs) for 3-Dimensional wave-like Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) with formally determined input data. We assume that a certain associated PDE is written in finite differences with respect to time t. The unknown coefficients depend on all three spatial variables. The key novelty here is that the input data for these CIPs are generated by only a single location of the point source at the moment of time {t = 0}. In the first CIP (CIP1) the unknown coefficient is the potential of a wave-like PDE. The second CIP (CIP2) is concerned with a far more challenging case when the unknown coefficient is involved in the principal part of the hyperbolic operator. In addition to Lipschitz stability and uniqueness results, numerical methods are developed for both CIPs. Their convergence analysis establishes the global convergence property of both numerical techniques. The latter is unlike the local convergence of conventional numerical procedures fo
items.authors: Michael V. Klibanov, Jingzhi Li, Tian Niu
items.title_zh: 具有单一点源位置的波动方程的两个三维系数反问题
items.excerpt_zh: 本文首次解决了两个长期悬而未决的问题。这些问题是关于具有形式确定的输入数据的 3 维波状偏微分方程 (PDE) 的两个系数反问题 (CIP) 的 Lipschitz 稳定性估计和唯一性定理。我们假设某个相关的 PDE 被写成相对于时间 t 的有限差分。未知系数取决于所有三个空间变量。这里的关键新颖之处在于，这些 CIP 的输入数据仅由点源在时间 {t = 0} 的单个位置生成。在第一个 CIP (CIP1) 中，未知系数是波状偏微分方程的势。当双曲算子的主要部分涉及未知系数时，第二个 CIP (CIP2) 涉及更具挑战性的情况。除了 Lipschitz 稳定性和唯一性结果之外，还为这两个 CIP 开发了数值方法。他们的收敛分析建立了两种数值技术的全局收敛特性。后者不同于传统数值过程的局部收敛

items.title: Separable models of an NIP Banach space theory
items.excerpt: Let $Y$ be the renorming of $\ell_2(\mathbb N)\oplus_2\ell_2(\mathbb N)$ with norm $(h^2+q^2)^{1/2}$, where $h$ is the Hilbert norm and $q(u,v)=\sup_{i<)$ and the dimension of a separable Hilbert summand. Every such pair occurs. We describe all elementary embeddings between these models. The bounded norm types over a separable model are separable in the uniform metric exactly when its index order contains no copy of $(\mathbb Q,<)$.
items.title_zh: NIP Banach 空间理论的可分离模型
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $Y$ 为 $\ell_2(\mathbb N)\oplus_2\ell_2(\mathbb N)$ 与范数 $(h^2+q^2)^{1/2}$ 的重整，其中 $h$ 是希尔伯特范数，$q(u,v)=\sup_{i<)$ 以及可分离希尔伯特被加数的维数。每一个这样的配对都会发生。我们描述了这些模型之间的所有基本嵌入。当可分离模型的索引顺序不包含 $(\mathbb Q,<)$ 的副本时，可分离模型上的有界范数类型在统一度量中是可分离的。

items.title: A Sequent Calculus for the Quantified Reflection Calculus $\mathrm{QRC}_1$: Cut-Elimination, Interpolation, and NP-Completeness
items.excerpt: We introduce $\mathrm{G3QRC}_1$, the first Gentzen-style sequent calculus for Borges and Joosten's Quantified Reflection Calculus ($\mathrm{QRC}_1$). As a strictly positive, first-order modal logic, $\mathrm{QRC}_1$ crucially escapes Vardanyan's $\Pi^0_2$-completeness theorem for quantified provability logic, while remaining arithmetically complete with respect to Peano and Heyting Arithmetic. The central innovation of $\mathrm{G3QRC}_1$ is a pair of context-erasing modal rules that simultaneously account for the monotonicity and transitivity axioms by deliberately discarding parametric context across modal boundaries. This structural bottleneck allows for a clean proof of cut-admissibility via a standard lexicographic induction, circumventing the complex loop-checking typically required for provability logics. Cut admissibility yields an instantiated subformula property and supports a direct canonical proof of the finite model property. We streamline the adequate Kripke semantics by interpreting constants globally. We also establish a split-context Craig interpolation theorem and a contextual form of left uniform interpolation, unifo
items.title_zh: 量化反射微积分 $\mathrm{QRC}_1$ 的序列微积分：割消除、插值和 NP 完备性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们引入 $\mathrm{G3QRC}_1$，这是博尔赫斯和 Joosten 的量化反射微积分 ($\mathrm{QRC}_1$) 的第一个 Gentzen 式序列微积分。作为严格正的一阶模态逻辑，$\mathrm{QRC}_1$ 至关重要地避开了 Vardanyan 的用于量化可证明性逻辑的 $\Pi^0_2$ 完备性定理，同时相对于 Peano 和 Heyting 算术保持了算术完备性。 $\mathrm{G3QRC}_1$ 的核心创新是一对上下文擦除模态规则，它们通过故意丢弃跨模态边界的参数上下文来同时解释单调性和传递性公理。这种结构瓶颈允许通过标准词典归纳法清晰地证明可切性，从而规避了可证明性逻辑通常所需的复杂循环检查。削减可接纳性产生实例化的子公式属性，并支持有限模型属性的直接规范证明。我们通过全局解释常量来简化足够的 Kripke 语义。我们还建立了分裂上下文克雷格插值定理和左均匀插值的上下文形式，unifo

items.title: Stability in abstract classes via set theoretic techniques
items.excerpt: We prove that all abstract classes equipped with an independence relation satisfying a mild local character condition are stable. We obtain the result by using methods from model theory and set theory. We have several applications in the context of abstract classes of modules. In particular, we prove that if $K$ is a class of $R$-modules closed under isomorphisms and pure submodules and $\lambda^{\operatorname{card}(R) + \aleph_0} = \lambda$, then $K$ equipped with pure embeddings is stable in $\lambda$.
items.title_zh: 通过集合论技术实现抽象类的稳定性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了所有具有满足温和局部特征条件的独立关系的抽象类都是稳定的。我们利用模型论和集合论的方法得到了结果。我们在模块抽象类的上下文中有几个应用程序。特别地，我们证明，如果 $K$ 是在同构和纯子模块下封闭的 $R$ 模块类，并且 $\lambda^{\operatorname{card}(R) + \aleph_0} = \lambda$，那么配备纯嵌入的 $K$ 在 $\lambda$ 中是稳定的。

items.title: A family of forcings with hyperfinite equivalence of generics
items.excerpt: We identify a class of forcings that includes several classical forcings and prove that for all forcings $\mathbb{P}$ in this class the associated equivalence of generics relation $\equiv^{\mathbb{P}}_M$, as defined by Smythe, is a hyperfinite CBER.
items.title_zh: 具有泛型超有限等价性的强迫族
items.excerpt_zh: 我们确定了一类包含多个经典强迫的强迫，并证明对于此类中的所有强迫 $\mathbb{P}$，由 Smythe 定义的泛型关系 $\equiv^{\mathbb{P}}_M$ 的相关等价性是超有限 CBER。

items.title: Well-foundedness of the strict Lipschitz order on countably complete filters
items.excerpt: In $\mathsf{ZF}+\mathsf{DC}$, the strict Lipschitz order on proper countably complete filters on any fixed ordinal is well-founded. The proof uses transfinite recursion and closure under countable intersections to derive a contradiction from a descending chain. Restricting each filter to the least ordinal it contains yields a set-like well-founded order that compares filters on different ordinals. In $\mathsf{ZF}$, two ultrafilters on the same ordinal are equal if each is nonexpansively reducible to the other. These results answer both parts of Question 9.2.11 in The Ultrapower Axiom.
items.title_zh: 可数完备滤波器上的严格 Lipschitz 阶有充分根据
items.excerpt_zh: 在 $\mathsf{ZF}+\mathsf{DC}$ 中，任何固定序数上的适当可数完全过滤器的严格 Lipschitz 顺序是有充分根据的。该证明使用可数交集下的超限递归和闭包来从降序链中导出矛盾。将每个过滤器限制为其包含的最小序数会产生一个类似集合的有根据的顺序，该顺序可以比较不同序数上的过滤器。在 $\mathsf{ZF}$ 中，如果每个超滤器都不可扩张地还原到另一个，则同一序数上的两个超滤器相等。这些结果回答了《The Ultrapower Axiom》中问题 9.2.11 的两个部分。

items.title: Higher-Dimensional Automata in Geometric Logic
items.excerpt: What does the topos of a higher-dimensional automaton know about its infinite behaviour that its language does not? We write partial HDAs with an infinite run as models of a geometric theory over an intuitionistic metatheory with no choice. The topos of a machine is that of sheaves on its prefixes. The label word of a prefix records the shape and acceptance bit of each cell with the ipomset of each step. Under unique choice these words give a geometric morphism to the label topos of sheaves on label words, which thus records the shapes and acceptance bits that the B\"uchi language forgets. Machines sharing their B\"uchi language and their frames can differ over the label topos. The bouquet of two squares shares its frame and its B\"uchi language with the interleaved square; each accepted run of either reads the two events in parallel forever. Only the interleaved square has runs through cells of shape a, and the geometric sequent excluding such runs separates the two over the label topos.
