items.title_zh: 几何逻辑中的高维自动机
items.excerpt_zh: 高维自动机的拓扑对它的无限行为有什么了解，而它的语言却不知道？我们将无限运行的部分 HDA 编写为几何理论模型，而不是直观元理论，没有任何选择。机器的拓扑是其前缀上的滑轮的拓扑。前缀的标签字记录了每个单元的形状和接受位以及每个步骤的ipomset。在独特的选择下，这些单词为标签单词上的滑轮的标签拓扑赋予几何态射，从而记录 B\"uchi 语言忘记的形状和接受位。共享 B\"uchi 语言的机器及其框架可以在标签拓扑上有所不同。两个正方形的花束与交错的正方形共享其框架和 B\"uchi 语言；任一接受的运行永远并行读取两个事件。只有交错的正方形穿过形状 a 的单元，并且排除此类运行的几何序列在标签拓扑上将两者分开。在具有可判定相等的字母表上，有限刚性机器在其标签映射包含语言环境时是明确的，并且它们的 e

items.title: From Numbers to Container Strings
items.excerpt: We examine two ways of coding sequences in arithmetical theories. We investigate under what conditions they work. To be more precise, we study the creation of objects of a data-type that we call container strings, roughly sequences where the components are ordered but where we do not have an explicitly given projection function and length function. The first coding idea is Smullyan coding and the second one is Markov coding. This second idea is based on the representation of binary strings in the special linear monoid of the non-negative part of discretely ordered commutative rings. We employ Markov coding to obtain an alternative proof that the weak theory ${\sf PA}^-$ is sequential. We prove a correspondence result for a principle for container strings to Euclidean Division under the Markov translation.
items.title_zh: 从数字到容器字符串
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究算术理论中编码序列的两种方法。我们调查它们在什么条件下工作。更准确地说，我们研究了称为容器字符串的数据类型对象的创建，粗略地按顺序排列组件，但我们没有明确给出的投影函数和长度函数。第一个编码思想是Smullyan编码，第二个编码思想是马尔可夫编码。第二个想法基于离散有序交换环非负部分的特殊线性幺半群中二进制串的表示。我们采用马尔可夫编码来获得弱理论 ${\sf PA}^-$ 是顺序的替代证明。我们证明了马尔可夫翻译下容器串原理与欧几里得除法的对应结果。

items.title: The Uniform Functional Interpretation with Informative Types
items.excerpt: We discuss a new approach to functional interpretations based on uniform quantification and relativization. The uniform quantification in the background permits a more penetrating analysis of principles related to collection and contra-collection. Relativization comes from a computationally informative notion of being an element of a given type. The approach is flexible. When the information takes the shape of bounds, we can recapture a form of the combination of G\"odel's functional {\em dialectica} interpretation with majorizability. When the information is "canonical" in function types, we obtain new functional interpretations and new models of G\"odel's theory T.
items.title_zh: 信息类型的统一功能解释
items.excerpt_zh: 我们讨论一种基于统一量化和相对化的功能解释的新方法。背景的统一量化使得对征收和反征收相关原理的分析更加深入。相对化来自于作为给定类型的元素的计算信息概念。方法是灵活的。当信息呈现有界的形式时，我们可以重新捕获G\"odel的泛函{\em辩证}解释与可大化性的组合形式。当信息在函数类型中是“规范的”时，我们获得G\"odel理论T的新泛函解释和新模型。

items.title: AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics
items.excerpt: AI systems are increasingly capable of producing machine-checked Lean proofs of advanced mathematical results. Real mathematical formalization, however, is not isolated theorem proving: it requires building the definitions and intermediate lemmas that connect a result to a formal library. Existing evaluations often provide isolated theorem statements in settings where much of this supporting theory is already available in Mathlib. We introduce AutoformBench, a benchmark of 341 Lean 4 formalization tasks drawn from 24 advanced mathematical sources. Lean-experienced mathematicians formalized and audited each target statement, leaving the corresponding Lean proof to the evaluated agent. Each problem is embedded in a broader mathematical development: agents receive the informal proof but must translate it into Lean while constructing the missing definitions, intermediate lemmas, and supporting infrastructure. We compare the performance of frontier models on these problems. We find a largely shared difficulty frontier: success depends less on mathematical domain than on models' ability to construct missing formal infrastructure. Data and c
items.authors: Charles Arnal, Ahmad Rammal, Niket Patel, Fabian Gloeckle, Bartosz Piotrowski, Amaury Hayat, Julia Kempe, R\'emi Munos, Vivien Cabannes
items.title_zh: AutoformBench：高级数学的精益形式化基准
items.excerpt_zh: 人工智能系统越来越有能力生成先进数学结果的机器检查精益证明。然而，真正的数学形式化并不是孤立的定理证明：它需要构建将结果连接到形式库的定义和中间引理。现有的评估通常在 Mathlib 中已经提供了大部分支持理论的情况下提供孤立的定理陈述。我们引入了 AutoformBench，它是来自 24 个高级数学来源的 341 个 Lean 4 形式化任务的基准。经验丰富的精益数学家对每个目标陈述进行形式化和审核，将相应的精益证明留给评估代理。每个问题都嵌入在更广泛的数学发展中：代理收到非正式证明，但必须将其转化为精益，同时构建缺失的定义、中间引理和支持基础设施。我们比较了前沿模型在这些问题上的表现。我们发现了一个很大程度上共同的困难边界：成功更多地取决于模型构建缺失的正式基础设施的能力，而不是数学领域。数据与c

items.title: Certify What You Plant: Shortcut-Free Proof Depth in Logical Reasoning Data
items.excerpt: Procedurally generated logic problems are used to both evaluate and train reasoning in language models. Their difficulty is usually set by planting a proof, that is, by sampling a proof of the desired depth and stating its premises as the problem. However, a planted proof is only one possible proof. A problem can also have shorter proofs, or several unrelated ones, and its stated depth then overstates what solving it requires. We measure what a problem actually requires, relative to a stated set of inference rules. For each problem, we compute the steps every proof must make, the shortest proof, the number of minimal proofs and the indispensable premises, and export certificates that an independent checker verifies. Audits of eight datasets find depth that is forced (ProofWriter, Blocksworld), problems labelled depth 5 that require about two specific rule applications (FLDx2), and answers that need no particular step (ZebraLogic). We then construct problems whose every proof has a requested structure, using a catalog of shortcuts proved once per rule set. Every constructed problem is checked in full and comes with its own certificat
items.authors: Baptiste Juran, Dimitri Kachler, Damien Sileo
items.title_zh: 证明你所种植的东西：逻辑推理数据中的无捷径证明深度

items.title: Interactive Proofs as a Unified Framework for Evaluating and Leveraging Verifiable Proof Generation by LLM Agents
items.excerpt: Recent advances in LLM-assisted theorem proving and program verification have attracted widespread attention. Beyond determining whether a proposition is true, LLM agents must produce evidence that can be independently checked by humans or formal verification tools. To evaluate the underlying, protocol-agnostic ability of LLM agents to construct verifiable proofs-rather than their proficiency with any particular proof language or verification tool, we introduce Merlin-Bench. Drawing on interactive proof systems from computational complexity theory, we cast an LLM agent as the prover: under a designated protocol, the agent interacts with a formal verifier to substantiate its claimed answer to a problem instance. We develop an automated framework for constructing test cases and use it to create 100 cases across 15 problem families, each formulated within this prover-verifier framework. Experiments with 10 frontier LLMs across multiple agent harnesses show that reliably producing verifiable proofs in accordance with specified protocols remains a substantial challenge. Our case studies further provide actionable insights into improving ag
items.authors: Yankai Shu, Xingyu Zhao, Chuan Mao, Congchi Yin
items.title_zh: 交互式证明作为评估和利用 LLM 代理生成可验证证明的统一框架
items.excerpt_zh: LLM辅助定理证明和程序验证的最新进展引起了广泛关注。除了确定一个命题是否正确之外，法学硕士代理人还必须提供可以由人类或正式验证工具独立检查的证据。为了评估 LLM 代理构建可验证证明的与协议无关的底层能力，而不是评估他们对任何特定证明语言或验证工具的熟练程度，我们引入了 Merlin-Bench。借鉴计算复杂性理论中的交互式证明系统，我们将 LLM 代理作为证明者：在指定协议下，代理与形式验证者交互，以证实其对问题实例声称的答案。我们开发了一个用于构建测试用例的自动化框架，并使用它创建了 15 个问题系列的 100 个案例，每个案例都在这个证明者-验证者框架中制定。对跨多个代理工具的 10 个前沿法学硕士进行的实验表明，根据指定协议可靠地生成可验证的证明仍然是一项重大挑战。我们的案例研究进一步提供了改善农业的可行见解

items.title: PatternMiner: Automated Mathematical Discovery Through LLM-Guided Training and Interpretation of Small Models
items.excerpt: There are several approaches to AI-driven mathematical discovery. One of these involves the use of large language models (LLMs) to resolve well-specified conjectures via text-based reasoning, while another uses narrow models and interpretability for more open-ended, human-in-the-loop exploration using object-based mathematical data. The latter is limited in its ability to move beyond simple empirical pattern detection while the former is not well-designed for direct, open-ended exploration of large mathematical datasets. In this paper we introduce PatternMiner, a system that combines these two paradigms. In PatternMiner, an LLM agent generates mathematical datasets based on an initial broad question, trains narrow machine learning models on them, uses interpretability techniques to extract patterns from these trained models, and uses these patterns to formulate conjectures. Once an initial conjecture has been formulated, PatternMiner instructs the agent to search for counterexamples using calls to mathematical software. If a set of counterexamples can be found, these are used as feedback for conjecture refinement or another round of t
items.authors: Michael Ruofan Zeng, Junaid Hasan, Xuanyu Yang, Emily Xia Meng, Henry Kvinge
items.title_zh: PatternMiner：通过法学硕士指导的小模型训练和解释自动发现数学
items.excerpt_zh: 人工智能驱动的数学发现有多种方法。其中之一涉及使用大型语言模型（LLM）通过基于文本的推理来解决明确的猜想，而另一种则使用狭义模型和可解释性，使用基于对象的数学数据进行更开放的、人机交互的探索。后者超越简单的经验模式检测的能力受到限制，而前者的设计不适合对大型数学数据集进行直接、开放式的探索。在本文中，我们介绍了 PatternMiner，一个结合了这两种范式的系统。在 PatternMiner 中，LLM 代理根据最初的广泛问题生成数学数据集，在其上训练狭义机器学习模型，使用可解释性技术从这些训练模型中提取模式，并使用这些模式来制定猜想。一旦制定了初始猜想，PatternMiner 就会指示代理使用数学软件调用来搜索反例。如果可以找到一组反例，则将它们用作猜想细化或另一轮t的反馈

items.title: Honest but Wrong: Formalizing Retraction in the Ethics of Speech Acts
items.excerpt: A speaker who asserts honestly may later discover that its assertion was false. Such erroneous truths are not lies, yet they raise the question of whether, and on which moral grounds, the speaker must retract them. Using the FIPA-ACL performative disconfirm, we extend a belief-based framework that evaluates speech acts under deontologism and consequentialism to the case of retraction. We prove that the honesty duty of deontologism, which bears on utterances when they are made, never requires retracting an erroneous truth, and add a persistent one, which forbids letting the addressee believe what the speaker no longer believes. On a legal-advice case implemented in Answer Set Programming, we show that deontologism and consequentialism both require the retraction, but that consequentialism no longer does once it comes too late to prevent harm.
items.authors: Benjamin Icard, Gauvain Bourgne, Jeanne Bonnaventure, Jean-Gabriel Ganascia
items.title_zh: 诚实但错误：将言论道德中的撤回正式化
items.excerpt_zh: 诚实地断言的发言者后来可能会发现其断言是错误的。这些错误的事实并不是谎言，但它们提出了一个问题：说话者是否必须撤回它们，以及基于什么道德依据。使用 FIPA-ACL 执行否定，我们扩展了一个基于信念的框架，该框架评估义务论和后果论下的言语行为到撤回的情况。我们证明，道义论的诚实义务对言论产生影响，从不要求撤回错误的事实，并添加一个持久的事实，即禁止让收件人相信说话者不再相信的事情。在答案集编程中实现的法律建议案例中，我们表明道义论和结果论都需要撤回，但一旦为时已晚，无法防止伤害，结果论就不再需要撤回。

items.title: Budget, Readout or Reasoning? Where Small Reasoning Models Lose Value in Auction Bidding
items.excerpt: Ad platforms and marketplaces show bidders a bid landscape, the estimated chance of winning at each candidate bid, and increasingly let agents built on reasoning language models choose the bid. We give six open reasoning models of 4B to 14B parameters such landscapes, with win curves from eBay closing prices and from a simulated advertising market (AuctionNet), and score their bids on held-out auctions against an exact calculator. Because the agent is handed the estimates, the lost value can be split by cause. Two failures belong to the models. They pass over the best option even when the values written in their own trace already rank it first, and their wrong answers lean toward the highest bid on the menu. The lean is about the bid's size, not its place in the list, and it survives sampling. At 768 forced tokens on eBay, under pay-your-bid pricing, the wrong answers cost bidders 7-17% of the surplus the calculator's bids earn. Arithmetic errors are rare. Two further losses come from operator choices. A token cap cuts traces short: allowed to stop on their own within 4,096 tokens, five models recover 91-100% of the calculator's lea
items.authors: Mahbod Khaleti, Seyed Reza Tavakoli, Baran Hoseini, Alireza Noori, Amir Amini, Koorosh Aslansefat, Marjan Alirezaie, Ali Habibnia
items.title_zh: 预算、读数还是推理？小型推理模型在拍卖中失去价值的地方

items.title: Agentic Waterfall: An Intent-Driven Information Discovery Framework for Reclaiming User Control in the Attention Economy
items.excerpt: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior. We address this problem with the Agentic Waterfall framework, whose language-model controller maintains persistent user state and coordinates content retrieval, ranking, and state updates. To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol. The dataset combines real content metadata with simulated interaction histories. The protocol compares systems under shared histories using relevance scores and blind judgments of how well recommendations satisfy current user goals and constraints. Agentic Waterfall remains competitive with strong baselines on conventional recommendation tasks across five public benchmarks. On the Agentic Waterfall Dataset, it outperforms the strongest baseline in both evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 16.1%.
items.authors: Yige Luo, Shining Zhang, Jikun Liu, Hongjiao Qiang, Ran Guan
items.title_zh: 代理瀑布：在注意力经济中回收用户控制的意图驱动的信息发现框架
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将 Agentic Waterfall Feed 形式化，这是个性化信息发现的一个新问题，其中用户主动指导推荐，系统适应从显式请求和浏览行为推断出的不断变化的需求。我们使用 Agentic Waterfall 框架解决这个问题，该框架的语言模型控制器维护持久的用户状态并协调内容检索、排名和状态更新。为了评估此任务的系统，我们提供了 Agentic Waterfall 数据集和基于重播的评估协议。该数据集将真实内容元数据与模拟交互历史相结合。该协议使用相关性分数和对推荐满足当前用户目标和约束的程度的盲目判断来比较共享历史下的系统。 Agentic Waterfall 在五个公共基准的传统推荐任务上保持着强大的竞争力。在 Agentic Waterfall 数据集上，它的表现优于两项评估中最强的基线，相对改进高达 16.1%。

items.title: Do We Really Need an LLM for Weight-Space Programming? A Deterministic Forward-Only Paradigm and Its Capability Boundaries
items.excerpt: Recent work on Weight-Space Programming uses LLMs to edit neural weights with forward passes only, conflating LLM scripting with the underlying algebra of forward-only editing. We show that for core structured editing regimes, an LLM optimizer is unnecessary, and introduce Forward Weight-Space Programming (FWSP): a deterministic pipeline combining probing, localization, stratified operators (O1-O4), automatic blind routing (83.3% vs. 33.3% for a 27B LLM with the same tool library), and paired verification with zero additional per-token computation. For reasoning LLMs, we propose Protected FisherGate, a closed-form covariance-whitened readout edit orthogonal to normal-reasoning states: on DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B, a single frozen math-calibrated patch achieves 84.2% HumanEval pass@1 (1K budget; 75.4 +/- 9.4% across 3/5 Stage-4-passing subsets), beating 512-token-reserved budget forcing by +14.6 pp (-23.4% tokens) while transferring across HF-to-vLLM backends on full GSM8K and MATH-500. Across five modalities and thirteen models (50K to 27B dense and FP8 MoE), we further prove and verify two operator boundaries, subspace entanglement and fro
items.title_zh: 我们真的需要法学硕士来进行权重空间编程吗？确定性仅前向范式及其能力边界
items.excerpt_zh: 最近关于权重空间编程的工作使用 LLM 来编辑仅前向传递的神经权重，将 LLM 脚本与仅前向编辑的基础代数混为一谈。我们证明，对于核心结构化编辑机制，LLM 优化器是不必要的，并引入前向权重空间编程 (FWSP)：结合探测、本地化、分层运算符 (O1-O4)、自动盲路由（使用相同工具库的 27B LLM 为 83.3% 与 33.3%）的确定性管道，以及零额外每个令牌计算的配对验证。对于推理 LLM，我们提出了 Protected FisherGate，这是一种与正常推理状态正交的封闭形式协方差白化读数编辑：在 DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B 上，单个冻结数学校准补丁实现了 84.2% HumanEval pass@1（1K 预算；在 3/5 Stage-4-passing 子集中为 75.4 +/- 9.4%），击败了在完整的 GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上跨 HF 到 vLLM 后端传输时，512 个代币预留预算强制增加 +14.6 个百分点（-23.4% 代币）。在五种模式和十三种模型（50K 到 27B 密集和 FP8 MoE）中，我们进一步证明和验证了两个算子边界、子空间纠缠等

items.title: Temporal Exposure to Byzantine Vulnerability Under Intermittent Participation in Federated Learning
items.excerpt: In this paper, we study the effect of participation variability on per-round Byzantine vulnerability. We formalise Dynamic Participation Exposure (DPE), a phenomenon in which the global Byzantine fraction remains below an aggregation rule's tolerance threshold, while a participating client set violates, or approaches violation of, the assumptions required for robust aggregation. Under stochastic participation, we derive the probability of per round exposure and analyse how active-set size affects the variability of the observed Byzantine fraction. We further examine the accumulation of exposure over multiple rounds and consider adversaries that selectively participate during favourable rounds. Our analysis shows that intermittent participation does not automatically imply aggregation failure. Rather, it transforms Byzantine robustness from a static population-level property into a stochastic and temporal property. To mitigate this risk, we outline actionable design recommendations based on minimum active-set constraints, temporal monitoring, participation history, and adaptive aggregation.
items.title_zh: 间歇性参与联邦学习时暂时暴露的拜占庭漏洞
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了参与可变性对每轮拜占庭漏洞的影响。我们形式化了动态参与暴露（DPE），这是一种全局拜占庭分数保持低于聚合规则的容忍阈值的现象，而参与的客户端集违反或接近违反稳健聚合所需的假设。在随机参与下，我们得出每轮暴露的概率，并分析活动集大小如何影响观察到的拜占庭分数的变异性。我们进一步检查多轮暴露的积累，并考虑在有利轮次中选择性参与的对手。我们的分析表明，间歇性参与并不自动意味着聚合失败。相反，它将拜占庭稳健性从静态的人口级别属性转变为随机和时间属性。为了减轻这种风险，我们根据最小活动集约束、时间监控、参与历史和自适应聚合概述了可行的设计建议。

items.title: Understanding Failure Patterns in LLM-Based Mathematical Optimization Modeling
items.excerpt: Industrial optimization involves complex constraints, making optimization modeling difficult to automate. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored for generating optimization models from natural language, but their reliability in end-to-end settings remains limited, often producing non-executable, infeasible, or feasible but incorrect solutions. In this work, we study failure modes in LLM-based optimization modeling by decomposing the process into three components: mathematical reasoning, solver usage, and domain knowledge, and constructing datasets that target each aspect. Using these datasets, we analyze how different components relate to errors and find that they are associated with different types of failure, although these relationships are not always strong or consistent. Furthermore, while combining these components improves execution reliability, feasible but incorrect solutions remain the dominant failure mode, suggesting a remaining gap between executability and correctness. These findings highlight limitations of current dataset designs and suggest the importance of data that better capture constraint completeness an
items.authors: Ryoichi Takase, Xian Yeow Lee, Hikaru Tomonari, Masaya Tsunokake
items.title_zh: 了解基于 LLM 的数学优化建模中的故障模式
items.excerpt_zh: 工业优化涉及复杂的约束，使得优化建模难以自动化。人们已经探索了大型语言模型（LLM）用于从自然语言生成优化模型，但它们在端到端设置中的可靠性仍然有限，通常会产生不可执行、不可行或可行但不正确的解决方案。在这项工作中，我们通过将过程分解为三个部分来研究基于 LLM 的优化建模中的故障模式：数学​​推理、求解器使用和领域知识，并构建针对每个方面的数据集。使用这些数据集，我们分析不同组件与错误的关系，并发现它们与不同类型的故障相关，尽管这些关系并不总是牢固或一致。此外，虽然组合这些组件可以提高执行可靠性，但可行但不正确的解决方案仍然是主要的故障模式，这表明可执行性和正确性之间仍然存在差距。这些发现凸显了当前数据集设计的局限性，并表明了更好地捕获约束完整性和数据完整性的数据的重要性。

items.title: Scalpel and Brush: Pruning and Targeted Weight Editing of a Small Language Model by a Single LLM Agent
items.excerpt: It has recently been shown that an LLM can itself edit the weights of a language model, yet it remains unclear which part of such a result is due to the agent and which part is reproduced by a random edit of the same shape, by an instruction in the prompt, or by a standard procedure without an LLM. We unify repair and pruning as sparse weight edits to optimize a metric we specify, using BLEU as an example: three tasks -- targeted weight repair ("brush"), structured MLP neuron pruning ("scalpel", zeroing pruned weights), and layer removal with repair - are assigned to a DeepSeek Harness agent powered by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with up to 50 dev evaluations. We study Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct in three independent runs per task, with final evaluation on two hidden splits. On ordinary differential equations, changing at most 0.0084% of weights raised test BLEU by 24-32% on second-order equations and by a factor of 1.8-2.5 on equations with polynomial right-hand sides. items.authors: Sergei Koltcov, Vera Ignatenko, Anton Surkov, Rabie Abdultawab Ramadan
items.title_zh: 手术刀和刷子：单个 LLM 代理对小语言模型的修剪和目标权重编辑
items.excerpt_zh: 最近的研究表明，LLM 本身可以编辑语言模型的权重，但目前尚不清楚这样的结果的哪一部分是由代理造成的，哪一部分是通过相同形状的随机编辑、提示中的指令或没有 LLM 的标准程序来再现的。我们将修复和剪枝统一为稀疏权重编辑，以优化我们指定的指标，以 BLEU 为例：三个任务——目标权重修复（“刷子”）、结构化 MLP 神经元剪枝（“手术刀”、将剪枝权重归零）和修复层移除——被分配给由 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 提供支持的 DeepSeek Harness 代理，最多可进行 50 次开发评估。我们在每个任务的三个独立运行中研究 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct，并对两个隐藏的分割进行最终评估。对于常微分方程，最多改变 0.0084% 的权重可使二阶方程的测试 BLEU 提高 24-32%，对于多项式右侧的方程提高 1.8-2.5 倍。独立的替换检查表明，较高的 BLEU 反映了符号对齐，而不是提高了正确性。去除 12.5-15% MLP 神经元的面罩会缩小模型

items.title: FEAST: Fair and Efficient Adaptive Sampling for Task-Free On-Policy Learning
items.excerpt: Language agents trained from self-generated experience must allocate a limited rollout budget across heterogeneous capabilities. A common strategy is to prioritize capabilities with strong current learning signals, but in on-policy learning these signals are endogenous: past allocation changes the policy and therefore the evidence available for future allocation. This can create a feedback loop in which under-trained capabilities receive increasingly fewer opportunities to improve. We formalize this effect through the Quota-Efficiency Law (QEL), which shows that allocation history can change learning efficiency even under matched capability-specific exposure. Motivated by this, we introduce FEAST, a task-free adaptive sampling framework that separates opportunity allocation from compute allocation. FEAST dynamically discovers capability clusters while preserving their learning histories, maintains continued sampling opportunities across clusters, and reserves a rollout budget for each selected cluster. items.authors: Yongxi Zhu, Ziyi Wang, Yichen Wu, Ruite Lu, Liao Chang, Haipeng Li, Ying Wei
items.title_zh: FEAST：公平高效的自适应采样，用于无任务的策略学习
items.excerpt_zh: 根据自我生成的经验训练的语言代理必须在异构功能之间分配有限的部署预算。一个常见的策略是优先考虑具有强当前学习信号的能力，但在策略学习中，这些信号是内生的：过去的分配改变了策略，因此改变了可用于未来分配的证据。这可能会形成一个反馈循环，其中训练不足的能力获得改进的机会越来越少。我们通过配额效率法（QEL）形式化了这种效应，它表明即使在匹配的特定能力暴露下，分配历史也可以改变学习效率。受此启发，我们引入了 FEAST，这是一种无任务自适应采样框架，它将机会分配与计算分配分开。 FEAST 动态发现能力集群，同时保留其学习历史，保持跨集群的持续采样机会，并为每个选定的集群保留部署预算。在每个预算中，它逐渐将计算集中在具有信息丰富的奖励变化的提示上。跨越 GURU-18K 和 SMC，F

items.title: DLaR: Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.excerpt: Latent reasoning enables LLMs to operate in continuous embedding space, yet existing methods suffer from deterministic inference that precludes exploration of diverse reasoning paths. While recent approaches inject stochasticity to restore exploration, we identify two fundamental limitations: \textit{uniform stochasticity} across all steps is suboptimal, and unconstrained perturbations disrupt reasoning coherence. We propose Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning (DLaR), a framework with two complementary mechanisms that operate at different temporal granularities within the GRPO reinforcement learning framework. At the token level, Adaptive Stochasticity Modulation (ASM) dynamically adjusts perturbation intensity at each latent step based on a confidence-entropy fusion signal, increasing exploration when the model is uncertain and preserving stability when confident. At the training level, Training-Aware Stochasticity Tuning (TAST) progressively decays the base stochasticity level following a curriculum schedule. items.title: RAP: Radial-Angular Random Projection for Hyperbolic Representations
items.excerpt: Random projection is a basic compression primitive for Euclidean representation learning, with the Johnson--Lindenstrauss lemma giving a target dimension $k=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log n)$ independent of the ambient dimension. As hyperbolic representations gain increasing attention in modern Transformers, vision-language models, and large language models, the same need for oblivious dimensionality reduction arises, but no analogous primitive yet exists for hyperbolic representations. We study this gap. Two natural attempts fail in dual ways: a tangent-space scheme gives a clean local guarantee but is chart-bound and pays a curvature penalty, while a fully hyperbolic projection in the hyperboloid model is geometrically native but mixes radial and angular error before feeding them into the conditioning of $\operatorname{arcosh}$. We propose radial-angular random projection (RAP), which preserves the radial coordinate exactly and applies a Euclidean random projection only to the angular direction, lifting the result back to the target hyperboloid. items.title_zh: RAP：双曲表示的径向角随机投影

items.title: When the Proxy Is Wrong: Mismatch-Corrected Bandits for Adaptive Data Sampling
items.excerpt: Data allocation methods often use a small proxy model to select training data for a larger target model. However, this proxy can rank data differently from the target, leading to suboptimal training performance. To address this problem, we model the mismatch between the proxy and target models and incorporate it into the allocation decision. To do so, the problem is cast as a multi-fidelity bandit, where each arm is a data intervention. The proxy reward is observed every round, whereas the target reward is revealed only on rare audits of the same update. These paired observations identify arm-wise mismatches without assuming a shared offset or preservation of rankings. Mismatch-corrected bandits correct the proxy with paired residuals, audit only uncertain decisions, and pace the audit budget over training. From a theoretical viewpoint, we prove a regret decomposition and lower bounds under stationarity. These bounds show that proxy-only allocation can incur linear regret and that a minimum number of paired audits is necessary. items.authors: Amine Saadi, Elissa Mhanna, Rapha\"el F\'eraud, Gw\'enol\'e Lecorv\'e
items.title_zh: 当代理错误时：自适应数据采样的失配校正老虎机
items.excerpt_zh: 数据分配方法通常使用小型代理模型来为较大的目标模型选择训练数据。然而，该代理可能会对数据进行与目标不同的排序，从而导致训练性能不佳。为了解决这个问题，我们对代理模型和目标模型之间的不匹配进行建模，并将其纳入分配决策中。为此，问题被视为多保真强盗，其中每个臂都是数据干预。每轮都会观察到代理奖励，而目标奖励仅在同一更新的罕见审核中才会显示。这些配对观察结果可以识别逐臂不匹配，而无需假设共享偏移或保留排名。不匹配校正老虎机使用配对残差校正代理，仅审计不确定的决策，并根据培训调整审计预算。从理论角度来看，我们证明了遗憾分解和平稳性下界。这些界限表明，仅代理分配可能会导致线性遗憾，并且需要最少数量的配对审计。在突变的情况下，过早使用审计预算也会带来线性遗憾。滑动窗口政策

items.title: Spec2Weights: Certifying Networks that a Language Model Writes from a Specification
items.excerpt: A language model can write the weights of a small MLP, CNN, RNN or GNN from a plain-language specification, with no data and no gradient step. We ask when such a network can be proved exact in the float32 arithmetic it actually runs in. A float-safety lemma makes exhaustive float32 enumeration a proof for any summation order, and a layered error bound covers networks whose weights are not short binary fractions. With dynamic programming, template checks, an SMT proof, breadth-first search and induction for weight-tied recurrences, this certifies 12 of 15 written networks (one after a single constant fix) on every input of a stated domain (up to $10^{16}$ inputs, or every graph or grid up to a size bound), in a minute of CPU or less each. The certificates also say where a network stops being exact: the shortest-path network is exact iff the distance is at most 4,096 and fails at the predicted hops. Thirty new specifications were each written by a fresh session of one model family (Claude Opus 5.5). items.authors: Soumik Bhattacharjee, Musa Tur Farazi, Md Nasir Uddin, Tishna Sabrina, Chowdhury Mohammad Rakin Haider
items.title_zh: Spec2Weights：验证语言模型根据规范编写的网络
items.excerpt_zh: 语言模型可以根据简单语言规范编写小型 MLP、CNN、RNN 或 GNN 的权重，无需数据，也无需梯度步骤。我们询问何时可以在实际运行的 float32 算术中证明这样的网络是精确的。浮点安全引理使详尽的 float32 枚举成为任何求和顺序的证明，并且分层误差界限涵盖了权重不是短二进制分数的网络。通过动态编程、模板检查、SMT 证明、广度优先搜索和权重关联递归归纳，可以在指定域的每个输入（最多 10^{16}$ 输入，或每个图形或网格达到大小限制）上验证 15 个写入网络中的 12 个（在单个常量修复之后），每个网络的 CPU 占用时间为一分钟或更少。证书还说明网络在哪里不再精确：当且仅当距离最多为 4,096 并且在预测的跳数处失败时，最短路径网络是精确的。三十个新规格均由一个模型系列（Claude Opus 5.5）的新会议编写。二十五个首次提交的内容被证明对于任何求和顺序都是准确的；五个税表与前一天的真实税额相差 0.11 美元以内

items.title: Learning from Recurrence: Internalizing Depth-Induced Preferences in Looped Language Models
items.excerpt: A looped language model repeatedly applies the same block to its hidden state before predicting each token. The number of passes is its recurrent depth. Increasing this depth gives the model more computation per token with the same parameters. Can the shared block learn from the predictions it makes at greater depth? Following prior work, we retrofit pretrained OLMo-2-1B with a shared recurrent block and continue mid-training over varying recurrent depths. In the four-pass model, additional passes mainly redistribute probability among tokens that already rank highly after one pass. We use the continuations generated at greater depth to train only the shared block through a single pass, without reference answers or correctness filtering. We call this transfer preference write-back. Write-back further improves one-pass and multi-pass accuracy on most tasks. At their target depths, the updated models outperform a non-recurrent control matched for mid-training data and token budget on all six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with a mean relative gain in accuracy of up to 46.2% across tasks. items.title_zh: 从循环中学习：在循环语言模型中内化深度诱发的偏好
items.excerpt_zh: 循环语言模型在预测每个标记之前重复将相同的块应用到其隐藏状态。通过的次数就是其循环深度。增加此深度可以使模型在相同参数下对每个标记进行更多计算。共享块可以从更深入的预测中学习吗？在之前的工作之后，我们用共享的循环块改造了预训练的 OLMo-2-1B，并在不同的循环深度上继续进行中期训练。在四遍模型中，额外的遍主要是在一次遍之后已经排名较高的标记之间重新分配概率。我们使用更深度生成的延续来通过单遍仅训练共享块，无需参考答案或正确性过滤。我们将此称为传输首选项回写。回写进一步提高了大多数任务的单遍和多遍准确性。在目标深度，更新后的模型在所有六个数学推理基准上优于与中期训练数据和令牌预算匹配的非循环控制，跨任务的平均相对准确度提高高达 46.2%。在四遍推理中，单遍训练输出

items.title: Lightweight Reasoning Transfer via Chain-of-Thought Vector Projection
items.excerpt: Transferring reasoning capabilities from large language models to smaller ones often requires extensive teacher supervision or costly student adaptation. We study projected cross-model Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Vector transfer, a two-stage approach that keeps both models frozen. First, we learn a task-level CoT Vector in the teacher using dataset-provided solution traces and final-answer supervision. We then train a lightweight linear projector to map the fixed vector into a smaller student's residual space. Student-side training uses only final-answer cross-entropy on a small subset of task training examples; it requires neither teacher outputs nor intermediate solution traces. We select the student injection layer and intervention scale on a labeled support set and report results on the disjoint remainder of each evaluation split. On GSM8K and MATH, the projected vector improves base students by 10.37-21.98 accuracy points across the evaluated teacher-student settings. items.title_zh: 通过思想链向量投影进行轻量级推理迁移
items.excerpt_zh: 将推理能力从大型语言模型转移到较小的语言模型通常需要大量的教师监督或昂贵的学生适应。我们研究了预计的跨模型思想链 (CoT) 矢量传输，这是一种使两个模型保持冻结状态的两阶段方法。首先，我们使用数据集提供的解决方案跟踪和最终答案监督在教师中学习任务级 CoT 向量。然后，我们训练一个轻量级线性投影仪将固定向量映射到较小的学生残差空间中。学生端训练仅在一小部分任务训练示例上使用最终答案交叉熵；它既不需要教师的输出，也不需要中间解决方案的痕迹。我们在标记的支持集上选择学生注入层和干预规模，并报告每个评估分割的不相交剩余部分的结果。在 GSM8K 和 MATH 上，投影向量在评估的师生设置中将基础学生的准确度提高了 10.37-21.98 点。在四个代码生成基准测试中，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 学生获得 3.23-4.67 pass@1 分，而基础 Qwen2.5-7B 学生获得高达 9.65 分。这些结果

items.title: Puzzling-Bench: Evaluating Language Models on 23,777 Human-Written Puzzles with Community-Verified Answers
items.excerpt: We introduce Puzzling-Bench, a benchmark of 23,777 puzzles with community-verified answers drawn from the Puzzling Stack Exchange archive (2014-2026): riddles, ciphers, logic grids, lateral-thinking problems, wordplay and recreational mathematics, a third of them with images. Every puzzle carries the answer accepted by its author, a short reference answer taken from it (LLM-extracted for the evaluation sets and checked on a 50-puzzle human review), the author's own hints, community tags and a creation date, so that the benchmark supports hint ablations, category analysis and a rolling post-cutoff slice (254 puzzles posted after the training cutoff of six of the nine models we evaluate, including the best one) as a contamination check. We evaluate nine frontier and open models with a two-tier scorer (normalized exact match, then an LLM judge) and validate the judge with three judges from two model families: they agree on 95-97% of verdicts (kappa 0.82-0.96), move no model by more than 1.6 points, and show no own-family preference. items.title: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base
items.excerpt: We present AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base, a mixture-of-experts language model with 80 billion total parameters and approximately 3 billion active parameters per token, trained from scratch at Yandex and released under the Apache 2.0 license. The model combines Kimi Delta Attention with full attention, uses Attention Residuals, and is trained with Muon. Training comprises general pretraining on 17.5 trillion tokens, two context-extension stages, and a dedicated stage for reasoning and agentic interaction. We describe the data collection and augmentation pipelines, evaluation protocols, architectural ablations, and scaling-law experiments. We identify the limitations of held-out training loss as a proxy for downstream performance and introduce an auxiliary loss on mixture-of-experts outputs to stabilize training at the predicted learning rate. Domain-specific data selection and augmentation improve factual knowledge, mathematics, and programming skills, while agent trajectories introduced during pretraining improve performance on agentic benchmarks after supervised fine-tuning. items.title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
items.excerpt: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. Its estimated generation cost per recovered problem is nearly identical, while its cost per accepted trace is 30% lower. items.title_zh: 困难数学问题的多种替代推理轨迹
items.excerpt_zh: 用于数学推理的大型语言模型 (LLM) 的后训练通常依赖于已接受的痕迹，其最终答案可以通过验证者。然而，对于困难的数学问题，在独立蒙特卡罗 (MC) 采样下，此类痕迹可能很少见。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了多样化替代推理轨迹（DART），这是一种轨迹挖掘方法，从被拒绝的轨迹开始，将其分解为推理步骤，并按位置加权不确定性对它们进行排名。然后，在完成生成的跟踪之前，它会使用参考答案指导和元思想为排名较高的步骤故意生成不同的候选候选。对于贪婪未解决的 DeepMath-103K 问题，DART 在匹配数量的生成迹线下比 MC 采样多恢复 37% 的问题。每个已恢复问题的估计生成成本几乎相同，而每个已接受跟踪的成本要低 30%。训练后的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 对 DART 挖掘的痕迹在 MATH-500 和 AIME 基准的六项评估中的五项中实现了最高点估计。这些结果表明，使用 DART 重新访问被拒绝的跟踪可以扩大问题覆盖范围并证明

items.title: Two literary allegories
items.excerpt: I believe strongly in trying to engage with literature. I would like to take two allegories from two books which I have read recently and which resonated with me in the context above. I hope that, even if you are more optimistic than me, you will get something out of these allegories, even if it is just the enjoyment of some writing and perhaps the desire to read more from these authors. I also hope that it can be a respite from reading directly about the philosophy and politics of mathematics.

items.excerpt_zh: 我坚信尝试与文学接触。我想从我最近读过的两本书中摘取两个寓言，它们在上述背景下引起了我的共鸣。我希望，即使你比我更乐观，你也会从这些寓言中得到一些东西，即使这只是一些写作的乐趣，也许只是想读更多这些作者的作品。我也希望这可以让我在直接阅读数学哲学和政治学之后得到喘息的机会。

items.title: On the AHM’s awkward position on the Riemann Hypothesis being solved
items.excerpt: A response to AHM's reaction to the claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis, a couple of posts ago.
items.title_zh: 论 AHM 在黎曼猜想解决中的尴尬处境
items.excerpt_zh: 对 AHM 对黎曼假设证明的反应的回应，几篇文章之前。

items.title: G.R.H. Polymath
items.excerpt: [This is a guest post by Anurag Sahay, Will Sawin, and Lior Silberman – T.] Last Friday Levent Alpöge announced a Lean certicate containing a proof of the Generalized Riemann hypothesis. Since then there has been a flurry of activity in validating the certificate, and toward extracting a human-understnable proof and simplifying the Lean certificate […]
items.title_zh: G.R.H.博学者
items.excerpt_zh: [这是 Anurag Sahay、Will Sawin 和 Lior Silberman – T. 的客座帖子] 上周五，Levent Alpöge 宣布了一份精益证书，其中包含广义黎曼假设的证明。从那时起，验证证书、提取人类可理解的证明和简化精益证书等方面开展了一系列活动 […]

items.title: Counting elliptic curves by discriminant
items.excerpt: We prove an asymptotic formula with a power saving for the number of $\mathbb{Q}$-isomorphism classes of elliptic curves $E/\mathbb{Q}$ ordered by minimal discriminant, assuming the $abc$ conjecture. Unconditionally, we obtain the same asymptotic for the curves with $|\Delta_{\min}(E)| \le X$ and $c_4(E) \le X^{8/3 - \delta}$ for any fixed $\delta > 0$, by obtaining new bounds for the number of integral points $(c_4, c_6)$ near the cusp $c_4^3 = c_6^2$.
items.title_zh: 通过判别式计算椭圆曲线
items.excerpt_zh: 假设 $abc$ 猜想，我们证明了一个渐近公式，可以节省按最小判别式排序的椭圆曲线 $E/\mathbb{Q}$ 的 $\mathbb{Q}$ 同构类的数量。无条件地，我们得到与 $|\Delta_{\min}(E)| 相同的渐近曲线\le X$ 和 $c_4(E) \le X^{8/3 - \delta}$ 对于任何固定的 $\delta > 0$，通过获取尖点 $c_4^3 = c_6^2$ 附近积分点 $(c_4, c_6)$ 数量的新界限。

items.title: Matrix Criteria for Mordell--Weil Ranks of Quartic Twists of $y^2=x^3+x$ with Root Number $-1$
items.excerpt: We study the Mordell--Weil ranks of quartic twists $E_a:y^2=x^3+ax$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ with global root number $-1$. For $D$ a product of $n\ge2$ distinct odd primes, a $2$-isogeny descent yields unconditional rank bounds for $E_D$, $E_{-D}$, and $E_{-2D}$ in terms of matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$ defined by additive Legendre symbols. Under suitable congruence and matrix-rank conditions, these curves have rank at most one, and rank one assuming the Mordell--Weil parity conjecture. For $E_{-2D}$, an additional explicit square condition establishes rank one unconditionally. Our results extend earlier two-prime criteria to arbitrary numbers of prime factors and further to fourth-power-free coefficients $H=\prod_{i=1}^n\ell_i^{e_i}$, where $e_i\in\{1,3\}$.
items.title_zh: Mordell 的矩阵准则 - $y^2=x^3+x$ 的四次扭曲 Weil 等级，根号为 $-1$
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上四次扭曲 $E_a:y^2=x^3+ax$ 的 Mordell--Weil 等级，全局根数 $-1$。对于 $D$ 是 $n\ge2$ 不同奇素数的乘积，$2$-同源下降产生 $E_D$、$E_{-D}$ 和 $E_{-2D}$ 的无条件等级界限，以加性勒让德符号定义的 $\mathbb{F}_2$ 上的矩阵表示。在适当的同余和矩阵秩条件下，这些曲线的秩最多为一，并且假设莫德尔-韦尔奇偶校验猜想为秩一。对于 $E_{-2D}$，附加的显式平方条件无条件地建立排名第一。我们的结果将早期的二素数标准扩展到任意数量的素数因子，并进一步扩展到四次方系数 $H=\prod_{i=1}^n\ell_i^{e_i}$，其中 $e_i\in\{1,3\}$。

items.title: Irrationality and differential equations: the work of Calegari, Dimitrov, and Tang
items.excerpt: Beautiful recent work of Calegari, Dimitrov, and Tang has given new methods for proving irrationality of certain arithmetically interesting constants, notably $L(2, \chi_{-3})$, building on ideas of Siegel, Andr\'e, Bost-Charles, and others. This note is meant to explain some of this work for the 2027 JMM Current Events Bulletin, and to situate it in context of some results and conjectures in arithmetic and algebraic geometry.
items.title_zh: 无理数和微分方程：Calegari、Dimitrov 和 Tang 的著作
items.excerpt_zh: Calegari、Dimitrov 和 Tang 最近的出色工作给出了证明某些算术上有趣的常数的无理性的新方法，特别是 $L(2, \chi_{-3})$，它建立在 Siegel、Andr\'e、Bost-Charles 等人的思想的基础上。本说明旨在解释 2027 年 JMM 时事公报的部分工作，并将其置于算术和代数几何中的一些结果和猜想的背景下。

items.title: Smale's Mean Values And Geometric Mean Values
items.excerpt: We prove that, for every integer $d>2$ and every $L>0$, there exists a polynomial of degree $d$ whose geometric mean value exceeds $L$. This result demonstrates that the geometric mean value alone is insufficient to establish the smallest upper bound for the minimum of Smale's mean values. Under certain additional assumptions, we derive upper bounds for the geometric mean value, thereby verifying Smale's mean value conjecture for several subclasses of polynomials. Furthermore, we connect Smale's mean values to Fekete points. Motivated by this connection, we formulate a new problem concerning Fekete points in the spirit of Smale's mean values.
items.title_zh: Smale 平均值和几何平均值
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，对于每个整数 $d>2$ 和每个 $L>0$，都存在一个几何平均值超过 $L$ 的 $d$ 次多项式。该结果表明，仅几何平均值不足以建立 Smale 平均值最小值的最小上限。在某些附加假设下，我们推导出几何平均值的上限，从而验证了 Smale 对多项式的几个子类的平均值猜想。此外，我们将 Smale 的平均值与 Fekete 点连接起来。受这种联系的启发，我们本着 Smale 均值的精神提出了一个关于 Fekete 点的新问题。

items.title: On the leading constant in Manin's conjecture
items.excerpt: We disprove a conjecture of Batyrev and Tschinkel concerning counting rational points of bounded height. Our results strongly suggest that the transcendental Brauer group plays a role in the leading constant in problems of the same nature such as the Manin--Peyre conjecture.
items.authors: Stephanie Chan, Peter Koymans, Nick Rome, Tim Santens
items.title_zh: 论马宁猜想中的领先常数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们反驳了巴特列夫和钦克尔关于计算有界高度的有理点的猜想。我们的结果强烈表明，超越布劳尔群在类似性质的问题（例如马宁-佩尔猜想）中的主导常数中发挥着作用。

items.title: The Residual Unitary Case for Almost Elusive Groups
items.excerpt: In this short note, we remove the residual unitary family in Hall's classification of almost elusive classical groups and the corresponding conditional family in the quasiprimitive classification. Using theorems of Zsigmondy and Schinzel together with some elementary number theory arguments, we prove that if n > 4 is odd, f > 1 is even, and r is the unique primitive prime divisor of (2^f)^{2n} - 1, then 4nf divides r - 1. For n > 4 prime and any positive integer f, we deduce that a unique primitive prime divisor r of (2^f)^{2n} - 1 satisfies r > 4nf, except when (n, f, r) = (5, 1, 11). We then obtain two conjugacy classes of derangements of the same prime order in a broader family of unitary subspace actions, and a quadratic lower bound for the number of such classes in the corresponding product actions.
items.title_zh: 几乎难以捉摸的群的剩余单一情况
items.excerpt_zh: 在这篇简短的笔记中，我们删除了几乎难以捉摸的经典群的霍尔分类中剩余的酉族和准原始分类中相应的条件族。使用 Zsigmondy 和 Schinzel 定理以及一些初等数论论证，我们证明如果 n > 4 是奇数，f > 1 是偶数，并且 r 是 (2^f)^{2n} - 1 的唯一本原因数，则 4nf 整除 r - 1。对于 n > 4 素数和任何正整数 f，我们推导出 (2^f)^{2n} - 1 的唯一本原因数 r满足 r > 4nf，除非 (n, f, r) = (5, 1, 11)。然后，我们在更广泛的酉子空间作用族中获得相同素数阶排列的两个共轭类，以及相应乘积作用中此类类数量的二次下界。

items.title: Generalized Tate--Nakayama duality for complexes of tori over local function fields
items.excerpt: We define the cohomology set $H^{1}(\mathcal{E}, Z \to T \to U)$ for a complex $Z \to T \to U$ with $T$, $U$ tori over a local function field $F$ and $Z$ a finite subgroup of $T$, where $\mathcal{E}$ is the gerbe from [Dil23]. We follow the method of [Kal26] and prove that the Tate--Nakayama isomorphism [Dil23, Theorem 4.10] for $H^{1}(\mathcal{E}, Z \to T)$ extends to $H^{1}(\mathcal{E}, Z \to T \to U)$, which lets one generalize Kaletha's parametrization [Kal21] of supercuspidal $L$-packets to local function fields.
items.title_zh: 局部函数域上环面复形的广义 Tate-Nakayama 对偶性
items.excerpt_zh: We define the cohomology set $H^{1}(\mathcal{E}, Z \to T \to U)$ for a complex $Z \to T \to U$ with $T$, $U$ tori over a local function field $F$ and $Z$ a finite subgroup of $T$, where $\mathcal{E}$ is the gerbe from [Dil23]. We follow the method of [Kal26] and prove that the Tate--Nakayama isomorphism [Dil23, Theorem 4.10] for $H^{1}(\mathcal{E}, Z \to T)$ extends to $H^{1}(\mathcal{E}, Z \to T \to U)$, which lets one generalize Kaletha's parametrization [Kal21] of supercuspidal $L$-本地功能字段的数据包。

items.title: Counting solutions to Euclidean Fermat equations
items.excerpt: A solution $(x,y,z) \in \mathbb{Z}^3-\{(0,0,0)\}$ to a Fermat equation \begin{equation} \label{eq:abstract-gfe} Ax^a + By^b + Cz^c = 0 \end{equation} is called \emph{primitive} if $\gcd(x,y,z) = 1$. In the \emph{Euclidean} regime (that is, when the Euler characteristic $\chi = \tfrac{1}{a} + \tfrac{1}{b} + \tfrac{1}{c} - 1$ is zero), the equation above defines a smooth genus one curve in a weighted projective plane. We study these models and provide an asymptotic formula for the number of primitive integral solutions with bounded height.
items.authors: Niven T. Achenjang, Santiago Arango-Pi{\~n}eros, Sameera Vemulapalli
items.title_zh: 计算欧几里得费马方程的解
items.excerpt_zh: 如果 $\gcd(x,y,z) = 1$，费马方程 \begin{equation} \label{eq:abstract-gfe} Ax^a + By^b + Cz^c = 0 \end{equation} 的解 $(x,y,z) \in \mathbb{Z}^3-\{(0,0,0)\}$ 称为 \emph{primitive}。在 \emph{Euclidean} 体系中（即，当欧拉特征 $\chi = \tfrac{1}{a} + \tfrac{1}{b} + \tfrac{1}{c} - 1$ 为零时），上面的方程定义了加权射影平面中的平滑亏格一曲线。我们研究这些模型并提供了具有有界高度的原始积分解的数量的渐近公式。

items.title: Minor--Skein Spatial Negami Splitting Vectors and a Gluing Formula for Marked State Sums
items.excerpt: We organize the edge states of a decorated spatial graph by the minors of their underlying abstract graphs. For pieces with disjoint edge sets, Negami's component formula and functorial ribbon evaluation express each marked sector as a boundary pairing, provided the local data determine its marker. We give two explicit rules for this last step. A two-terminal rule for $3$-connected targets tests each piece with and without a virtual edge. At arbitrary finite vertex boundaries, records of partial branch sets determine the occurrence of each fixed simple target. The rules assign a weight once per edge state, even when the state contains several minor models.
items.title_zh: 次要--Skein 空间 Negami 分裂向量和标记状态和的粘合公式
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过底层抽象图的次要状态来组织装饰空间图的边缘状态。对于具有不相交边缘集的片段，Negami 的分量公式和函数带评估将每个标记的扇区表示为边界对，前提是本地数据确定其标记。我们为最后一步给出了两条明确的规则。 $3$ 连接目标的两端规则测试每个部分是否有虚拟边缘。在任意有限顶点边界处，部分分支集的记录确定每个固定简单目标的出现。这些规则为每个边缘状态分配一次权重，即使该状态包含多个次要模型也是如此。

items.title: Ramsey numbers of fixed-length cycles, paths and stars in set-colored triple systems
items.excerpt: Let $R_3(H;r,s,t)$ be the least order of a complete triple system in which every assignment of $s$ of $r$ colors to each triple forces a copy of $H$ whose edges share at least $t$ colors. Fix $r\ge s\ge t\ge1$ and let $n$ count edges. We prove that the Ramsey numbers of the linear path and the linear cycle of fixed length $n$ are both $\gamma n+o(n)$ as $n\to\infty$, with $\gamma=2$ if and only if $r=s$. For tight paths the corresponding formula is $\tau n+o(n)$, with the same coefficient for tight cycles when $3\mid n$. To obtain exactly $n$ edges in a linear cycle, we choose the parity of the connections and vary the lengths of the paths they join. For a linear star $S_n$, whose edges meet only at the center, $R_3(S_n;r,s,t)=cn+O(n^{2/3})$ for fixed colors. For fixed $n\ge2$ and $s,t$ as $r\to\infty$, it is asymptotic to $\sqrt{6a_n\binom{r}{t}/\binom{s}{t}}$, where $a_n=n(n-1)$ for odd $n$ and $a_n=n(2n-3)/2$ for even $n$. For a tight star, whose edges share a pair, the leading term is $(n-1)\binom{r}{t}/\binom{s}{t}$ in both regimes. For a fixed linear path of $n\ge3$ edges and fixed $s\ge t\ge2$, the upper bound is $(2000h/1307+o
items.title_zh: 固定颜色三重系统中固定长度循环、路径和星的 Ramsey 数
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $R_3(H;r,s,t)$ 为完整三元组系统的最小阶，其中每次将 $r$ 颜色的 $s$ 分配给每个三元组都会强制生成一个 $H$ 的副本，其边缘至少共享 $t$ 颜色。修复 $r\ge s\ge t\ge1$ 并让 $n$ 计算边数。我们证明，线性路径和固定长度$n$的线性循环的拉姆齐数都是$\gamma n+o(n)$，即$n\to\infty$，其中$\gamma=2$当且仅当$r=s$。对于紧路径，相应的公式为 $\tau n+o(n)$，当 $3\mid n$ 时，紧循环的系数相同。为了在线性循环中精确获得$n$条边，我们选择连接的奇偶校验并改变它们连接的路径的长度。对于线性星形 $S_n$，其边缘仅在中心相交，$R_3(S_n;r,s,t)=cn+O(n^{2/3})$ 对于固定颜色。对于固定的 $n\ge2$ 和 $s,t$ 为 $r\to\infty$，它渐近到 $\sqrt{6a_n\binom{r}{t}/\binom{s}{t}}$，其中 $a_n=n(n-1)$ 对于奇数 $n$，$a_n=n(2n-3)/2$ 对于偶数 $n$。对于紧星，其边共享一对，在两种情况下首项均为 $(n-1)\binom{r}{t}/\binom{s}{t}$ 。对于 $n\ge3$ 边和固定 $s\ge t\ge2$ 的固定线性路径，上限为 $(2000h/1307+o

items.title: Power-Law Lower Bounds for Edges in Odd Induced Subgraphs
items.excerpt: For a finite simple graph $G$, let $g(G)$ denote the maximum number of edges in an induced subgraph of $G$ in which every vertex has odd degree. Motivated by Scott's question of whether $g(G) \geq cm$ for every graph with $m$ edges, we prove that $g(G) \geq cm^{4/7}$ for every finite simple graph with $m \geq 1$ edges, where $c > 0$ is an absolute constant. For bipartite graphs, we obtain the stronger bound $g(B) \geq cm^{2/3}$.
items.title_zh: 奇数导出子图中边的幂律下界
items.excerpt_zh: 对于有限简单图 $G$，令 $g(G)$ 表示 $G$ 的导出子图中的最大边数，其中每个顶点都有奇数度。受 Scott 关于是否对于每个具有 $m$ 边的图 $g(G) \geq cm$ 的问题的启发，我们证明 $g(G) \geq cm^{4/7}$ 对于每个具有 $m \geq 1$ 边的有限简单图，其中 $c > 0$ 是绝对常数。对于二部图，我们获得更强的界限 $g(B) \geq cm^{2/3}$。

items.title: Bounds for the small Davenport constant of extraspecial groups of exponent three
items.excerpt: Let $E_s$ be the extraspecial group of order $3^{2s+1}$ and exponent three. We prove $4s+2r+2\le d(E_s\times C_3^r)\le 4s+2r+3$ for $s\ge1$ and $r\ge0$. For $s\ge2$, the degree in the polynomial proof is optimal among weights depending only on group-element multiplicities modulo three. For $s=2$, we reduce the question in all ranks to an abelian subset-sum problem with a fixed set of forbidden values in a $77$-dimensional space. We show that this set, together with zero, contains no $76$-dimensional subspace. The equality $d(E_2\times C_3^r)=2r+10$ in all ranks is not established here.
items.title_zh: 指数三的超特殊群的小达文波特常数的界限
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $E_s$ 为阶 $3^{2s+1}$ 且指数为 3 的超特殊群。我们证明 $4s+2r+2\le d(E_s\times C_3^r)\le 4s+2r+3$ 对于 $s\ge1$ 和 $r\ge0$。对于 $s\ge2$，多项式证明中的次数在权重中是最佳的，仅取决于群元素重数模三。对于 $s=2$，我们将所有等级中的问题简化为阿贝尔子集和问题，在 $77$ 维空间中具有一组固定的禁止值。我们证明这个集合与零一起不包含 $76$ 维子空间。所有等级中的等式$d(E_2\times C_3^r)=2r+10$在这里不成立。

items.title: Quadratic periods after adjoining one move to a fixed subtraction game
items.excerpt: Zhang conjectured that adjoining one move $c$ to a fixed subtraction set $S$ gives a Grundy sequence whose least preperiod and period are both $O_S(c)$. For every $q=20+9s$ with $s\ge0$, take $S=\{3,6,q-3\}$. Along $c=qk+1$ with $k\ge2$, the Grundy and win/loss sequences are periodic from heap zero with common least period $(k+2)(c+6)-11$, asymptotic to $c^2/q$. For $\{3,6,17\}$ we determine both least periods and preperiods for every positive $c$ and verify the complete table in Lean. Fixed bases with the same entire Grundy sequence realize infinitely many distinct positive quadratic coefficients for the augmented period. A second fixed triple gives a quadratic Grundy preperiod while the win/loss sequence repeats from heap zero. A third has a quadratic Grundy period but only a linear win/loss period. For an arbitrary fixed $S$, a linear bound on both Grundy invariants implies eventual affine formulas with integer coefficients on residue classes. The same finite-state method extends four numerical tables of Zhang. We also give the entire augmented sequence for $c>\max S$ when the losing heaps of $S$ are exactly the multiples of a fixe
items.title_zh: 与固定减法游戏相邻一步后的二次周期
items.excerpt_zh: 张推测，将一个移动 $c$ 与固定减法集 $S$ 相邻会给出一个 Grundy 序列，其最小预周期和周期均为 $O_S(c)$。对于每个 $q=20+9s$ 和 $s\ge0$，取 $S=\{3,6,q-3\}$。沿着 $c=qk+1$ 和 $k\ge2$，Grundy 和赢/输序列从堆零开始具有周期性，公共最小周期为 $(k+2)(c+6)-11$，渐近到 $c^2/q$。对于 $\{3,6,17\}$，我们确定每个正 $c$ 的最小周期和前期，并验证精益中的完整表格。具有相同的整个格伦迪序列的固定基实现了增广周期的无限多个不同的正二次系数。第二个固定三元组给出了二次 Grundy 前期，而赢/输序列从堆零开始重复。第三种具有二次格伦迪周期，但只有线性赢/输周期。对于任意固定的 $S$，两个 Grundy 不变量的线性界限意味着最终的仿射公式在残差类上具有整数系数。同样的有限状态方法扩展了张的四个数值表。当 $S$ 的丢失堆恰好是固定值的倍数时，我们还给出了 $c>\max S$ 的整个增广序列

items.title: RSK with a twist, mirabolic Steinberg variety, and Pak--Postnikov representations
items.excerpt: There is a beautiful interplay between the classical Robinson--Schensted correspondence and the Steinberg variety, which is the union of conormal components of $Fl(V) \times Fl(V)$. The irreducible components of the Steinberg variety gives the geometric interpretation of RS, and Pak--Postnikov description of RS as U,D operators is the combinatorics shadow of the $S_n\times S_n$-representation inside the top homology of the Steinberg variety. We study the conormal components of $Fl(V) \times Fl(V) \times L(\lambda)$, where $L(\lambda)$ is an irreducible representation of $GL(V)$. We show that there are only three families of $L(\lambda)$ such that $Fl(V)\times Fl(V) \times L(\lambda)$ has finitely many orbits. These families are determinant twists of classical RS, Travkin's mirabolic RSK and its Fourier dual. We extend the combinatorial interpretation of RS in terms of U,D operators to mirabolic RSK. Finally, we give a filtration of the top homology of the mirabolic Steinberg variety in which each graded piece is a Pak--Postnikov $S_n \times S_n$-representations.
items.title_zh: 带有扭曲的 RSK、奇迹斯坦伯格簇和 Pak-Postnikov 表示
items.excerpt_zh: 经典的 Robinson-Schensted 对应关系和 Steinberg 变体之间存在着美妙的相互作用，斯坦伯格变体是 $Fl(V) \times Fl(V)$ 共正规分量的并集。斯坦伯格簇的不可约分量给出了 RS 的几何解释，Pak-Postnikov 将 RS 描述为 U,D 算子是斯坦伯格簇顶部同调内 $S_n\times S_n$ 表示的组合学影子。我们研究 $Fl(V) \times Fl(V) \times L(\lambda)$ 的共法分量，其中 $L(\lambda)$ 是 $GL(V)$ 的不可约表示。我们证明 $L(\lambda)$ 只存在三个族，使得 $Fl(V)\times Fl(V) \times L(\lambda)$ 具有有限多个轨道。这些族是经典 RS、特拉夫金的奇迹 RSK 及其傅立叶对偶的行列式扭曲。我们将 U、D 算子方面的 RS 组合解释扩展到 Mirabolic RSK。最后，我们给出了 mirabolic Steinberg 簇的顶级同源性过滤，其中每个分级片段都是 Pak--Postnikov $S_n \times S_n$ 表示。

items.title: Cycle popping and positivity in linear Laurent phenomenon algebras
items.excerpt: We prove that every monomial in the cluster variables of a linear Laurent phenomenon algebra is a nonnegative combination of cluster monomials, as conjectured by Lam and the second author. The proof uses Wilson's cycle popping. We also give a new proof of Laurent positivity in linear Laurent phenomenon algebras, previously established by the first author.
items.title_zh: 线性洛朗现象代数中的循环弹出和正性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了线性洛朗现象代数的簇变量中的每个单项式都是簇单项式的非负组合，正如 Lam 和第二作者的猜想。证明使用威尔逊循环弹出。我们还给出了第一作者先前建立的线性洛朗现象代数中洛朗正性的新证明。

items.title: Major progress on hamiltonian saturation in hypergraphs
items.excerpt: For $1\leq \ell< k$, an \emph{$\ell$-overlapping $k$-cycle} is a $k$-uniform hypergraph in which, for some cyclic vertex ordering, every edge consists of $k$ consecutive vertices and every two consecutive edges share exactly $\ell$ vertices. A $k$-uniform hypergraph $H$ is $\ell$-\emph{hamiltonian saturated} if $H$ does not contain an $\ell$-overlapping Hamilton $k$-cycle but every hypergraph obtained from $H$ by adding a new edge does contain such a cycle. For $n$ divisible by $k-\ell$, let sat$(n,k,\ell)$ be the smallest number of edges in an $\ell$-hamiltonian saturated $k$-uniform hypergraph on $n$ vertices. In the case of graphs Clark and Entringer showed in 1983 that, for sufficiently large $n$, sat$(n,2,1)=\lceil \frac{3n}2\rceil$. By ad hoc methods, the present authors proved previously that sat$(n,k,\ell)=\Theta(n^{\ell})$ for some rather narrow and scattered ranges of $\ell$. In this paper we present a unified proof of this equality for all $k$ and $\ell>k/2$.
items.title_zh: 超图哈密顿饱和的重大进展
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 $1\leq \ell< k$，\emph{$\ell$-重叠 $k$-cycle} 是 $k$-均匀超图，其中对于某些循环顶点排序，每条边由 $k$ 个连续顶点组成，并且每两条连续边完全共享 $\ell$ 顶点。如果 $H$ 不包含 $\ell$ 重叠的汉密尔顿 $k$ 循环，但通过添加新边从 $H$ 获得的每个超图确实包含这样的循环，则 $k$ 一致超图 $H$ 是 $\ell$-\emph{哈密尔顿饱和}。对于可被 $k-\ell$整除的 $n$，令 sat$(n,k,\ell)$ 为 $n$ 顶点上的 $\ell$-哈密尔顿饱和 $k$-均匀超图的最小边数。对于图，Clark 和 Entringer 在 1983 年表明，对于足够大的 $n$，sat$(n,2,1)=\lceil \frac{3n}2\rceil$。通过临时方法，本作者之前证明了对于一些相当狭窄和分散的 $\ell$ 范围，sat$(n,k,\ell)=\Theta(n^{\ell})$。在本文中，我们提出了所有 $k$ 和 $\ell>k/2$ 等式的统一证明。

items.title: Stacks of Parabolic Vector Bundles in the Geometric Langlands Program
items.excerpt: I define a locus inside stacks of parabolic vector bundles on smooth projective curves which is important for the construction of twisted Hecke eigensheaves in the ramified geometric Langlands program for $\mathrm{GL}_n$. I give an explicit description of this locus in the case of rank $3$ parabolic vector bundles on $\mathbb{P}^1$ with parabolic structure at four points. This example involves partial flags in the level structure as well as a non-trivial twisted equivariance condition.
items.title_zh: 几何朗兰兹纲领中的抛物线向量束堆栈
items.excerpt_zh: 我在平滑射影曲线上的抛物线向量束堆栈内定义了一个轨迹，这对于在 $\mathrm{GL}_n$ 的分支几何朗兰兹程序中构建扭曲的赫克特征轮非常重要。在 $\mathbb{P}^1$ 上的秩 $3$ 抛物线向量束在四个点处具有抛物线结构的情况下，我给出了该轨迹的明确描述。此示例涉及级别结构中的部分标志以及非平凡的扭曲等方差条件。

items.title: An Introduction to Semialgebraic Geometry
items.excerpt: The first chapter of these lecture notes explains algorithms for counting real roots and the Tarski-Seidenberg theorem. In the next two chapters we study semialgebraic subsets of $\mathbb R^n$ , which are defined by boolean combinations of polynomial equations and inequalities. The main tool for this study is the cylindrical algebraic decomposition, which is introduced in Chapter 2. The principal result of Chapter 3 is the triangulation theorem. This theorem shows that semialgebraic sets have a simple topology, which can be effectively computed from their definitions. Chapter 4 contains examples of finiteness results and uniform bounds for semialgebraic families. In particular, we give an explicit bound for the number of connected components of a real algebraic set as a function of the degree of the equations and the dimension of the ambient space.
items.title_zh: 半代数几何导论
items.excerpt_zh: 这些讲义的第一章解释了计算实根的算法和 Tarski-Seidenberg 定理。在接下来的两章中，我们研究 $\mathbb R^n$ 的半代数子集，它们由多项式方程和不等式的布尔组合定义。这项研究的主要工具是圆柱代数分解，它在第二章中介绍。第三章的主要结果是三角剖分定理。该定理表明，半代数集具有简单的拓扑，可以根据其定义有效地进行计算。第 4 章包含半代数族的有限性结果和统一界限的示例。特别是，我们给出了实代数集的连通分量数量的显式界限，作为方程的次数和周围空间的维数的函数。

items.title: On the unirationality of anticanonical weighted complete intersection surfaces: the infinite families
items.excerpt: Anticanonical weighted complete intersection surfaces fall into finitely many sporadic families and four infinite families. We prove that the anticanonical surfaces lying in the infinite families are unirational over their field of definition. Over a Hilbertian field, we further prove that a Hilbert subset of members consists of nonrational surfaces.
items.title_zh: 关于反规范加权完全交集曲面的非理性：无限族
items.excerpt_zh: 反规范加权完全相交曲面分为有限多个零星族和四个无限族。我们证明无限族中的反正则曲面在其定义域上是非理性的。在希尔伯特域上，我们进一步证明希尔伯特成员子集由非有理曲面组成。

items.title: Heights and energies of polarized fibrations of varieties II. Fibrations over a polarized base
items.excerpt: We extend the height and energy inequalities for fibrations over curves to a fibration $f:X\to Y$ over a polarized variety $(Y,B)$. For an integrable relatively nef adelic line bundle $\bar L$, we prove a height inequality under the assumption that $L$ is nef on the inverse image of a geometric generic complete-intersection curve in $Y$. We deduce a lower bound for the local energy at almost every complex or nonarchimedean realization of a fixed polarized model when $L$ is $f$-ample. For a slope semistable bundle on a fixed polarized complex variety, we show that the infimum of the energy on its projective bundle equals the infimum of Donaldson's functional on Hermitian quotient metrics, with the normalization given below.
items.title_zh: 品种 II 的极化纤维的高度和能量。极化基底上的纤维振动
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将曲线上纤维振动的高度和能量不等式扩展到极化变量 $(Y,B)$ 上的纤维振动 $f:X\to Y$。对于可积的相对nef adelic线束$\bar L$，我们在假设$L$是nef在$Y$中几何通用完全相交曲线的逆像上的情况下证明了高度不等式。当 $L$ 为 $f$-充足时，我们推导出固定极化模型的几乎每个复杂或非阿基米德实现的局部能量下界。对于固定极化复数簇上的斜率半稳定丛，我们证明其射影丛上的能量的下确界等于厄米商度量上唐纳森泛函的下下界，归一化如下。

items.title: Schubert positivity for filtered bundles
items.excerpt: We characterize formal filtered nefness of a formal quotient flag on a polarized Hodge--Lefschetz module by the formal nefness of its positive-rank total quotients. Using this criterion, we prove that quotient Schubert functors preserve formal nefness and that Schubert incidence modules inherit every commuting formally filtered nef flag. As geometric and numerical consequences, we recover the positivity criteria of Fulton--Lazarsfeld and Fulton and extend the Lorentzian polynomial theorem of Lu and Zheng to derived Schubert classes of filtered bundles. In combinatorics, our framework applies to tautological flags of flag matroids on ordinary and augmented matroid Chow rings as well as on the intersection cohomology of rational projective fans equipped with a common weight map. We deduce concordance-sensitive intersection inequalities, establish the Schubert positivity of the leading Riemann--Roch Chow class of a flag matroid, and show that the nonvanishing supports of derived Schubert numbers on an augmented Chow ring form the Higgs lifts of an intrinsically determined matroid quotient.
items.title_zh: 舒伯特对过滤束的积极性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过正秩总商的形式无效性来表征极化 Hodge--Lefschetz 模块上形式商标志的形式过滤无效性。使用这个标准，我们证明商舒伯特函子保留了形式 nefness，并且舒伯特关联模块继承了每个通勤形式过滤的 nef 标志。作为几何和数值结果，我们恢复了 Fulton 的正性准则——Lazarsfeld 和 Fulton，并将 Lu 和 Cheng 的洛伦兹多项式定理扩展到导出的滤波丛的 Schubert 类。在组合学中，我们的框架适用于普通和增强拟阵 Chow 环上的旗形拟阵的同义反复旗形，以及配备公共权重图的有理射影扇形交集上同调。我们推导了一致性敏感的交不等式，建立了旗形拟阵的领先黎曼-罗克·周 (Riemann--Roch Chow) 类的舒伯特正性，并表明增广周环上导出的舒伯特数的非零支持形成了本质确定的拟阵商的希格斯升力。

items.title: Full Support For the Degree-Zero Hitchin Morphism
items.excerpt: We present a draft argument for the full-support conjecture for the canonical GLn Hitchin morphism in degree zero over a smooth complex projective curve of genus at least two. The whole-base Ng\^o support equality yields a finite necessary classification in terms of weighted products of maximal equigeneric spectral-factor families. We study their generic nodality, develop moving-cycle arguments for arbitrary multiplicities, and give an intersection calculation using generalized parabolic presentations and intrinsic Nash transforms. We relate the full-base Ng\^o string to the BPS formula for intersection Hodge numbers in every rank and give the genus-two rank-three Hodge table. The arguments developed here are presented for mathematical checking and revision by the authors. And the article is generated by ChatGPT, the author is trying his best to comprehense the article and the human's version is coming soon.
items.title_zh: 完全支持零度希钦态射
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个完全支持猜想的论证草案，该猜想是在至少 2 的平滑复射影曲线上零度的典型 GLn 希钦态射。整体基 Ng\^o 支持等式根据最大等属谱因子族的加权乘积产生有限的必要分类。我们研究它们的通用结点，开发任意重数的移动周期论证，并使用广义抛物线表示和内在纳什变换给出交集计算。我们将全基 Ng\^o 字符串与每个秩中交集 Hodge 数的 BPS 公式联系起来，并给出属二秩三 Hodge 表。本文提出的论点供作者进行数学检查和修改。这篇文章是由ChatGPT生成的，作者正在尽力理解这篇文章，人类版本即将推出。

items.title: Chern classes of vanishing cycles for maps having no blowups
items.excerpt: We study the nearby and vanishing cycles for maps with no blowups. For holomorphic maps between complex manifolds admitting at most ICIS, we show that the Riemann-Hurwitz defect in Chern classes is compensated for by the Chern class transformation of the Milnor number constructible function.
items.title_zh: 没有爆炸的地图的消失循环陈省级
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究没有爆炸的地图的附近周期和消失周期。对于最多允许 ICIS 的复流形之间的全纯映射，我们表明 Chern 类中的 Riemann-Hurwitz 缺陷可以通过 Milnor 数可构造函数的 Chern 类变换来补偿。

items.title: Simultaneous Waring problems for binary forms and the geometry of rational curves
items.excerpt: We investigate the simultaneous Waring problem for binary forms and its geometric applications to rational curves. By analyzing the minimal free resolution of the simultaneous annihilator, we establish formulas for both simultaneous Waring ranks and border Waring ranks including explicit computations for binary monomials. As a geometric application, we explicitly describe parametrizations of rational curves up to projective equivalence. We determine the minimum dimension of a rational normal scroll containing the curve as a section of its ruling in terms of the minimal generators of the corresponding simultaneous annihilator. For rational curves lying as divisors on rational normal surface scrolls, we characterize their smoothness and describe the generators of their defining ideals.
items.authors: Maciej Ga{\l}\k{a}zka, Jaewoo Jung, Hyunsuk Moon
items.title_zh: 二元形式和有理曲线几何的联立韦林问题
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究二元形式的联立韦林问题及其在有理曲线上的几何应用。通过分析同时湮没子的最小自由分辨率，我们建立了同时 Waring 等级和边界 Waring 等级的公式，包括二元单项式的显式计算。作为几何应用，我们明确地描述了有理曲线的参数化直至投影等价。我们根据相应的同时消灭子的最小生成元确定包含曲线作为其统治部分的有理法向卷轴的最小尺寸。对于作为有理法表面卷轴上的约数的有理曲线，我们描述了它们的平滑度并描述了它们定义理想的生成器。

items.title: Dynamical phase transition in Brownian motion via sharp large deviations
items.excerpt: We prove a dynamical phase transition in Brownian motion with drift, a phenomenon recently predicted in the physics literature. Specifically, when a Brownian motion with drift on a long time interval is conditioned on an upper large deviation event for the (normalized) occupation measure of the interval [-1,1], in the spirit of the Gibbs conditioning principle, a phase transition occurs. If one conditions on a large deviation event in the far upper tail, the conditioned process follows the Langevin diffusion suggested by the Donsker-Varadhan variational formula for additive functionals. In contrast, if one conditions on a large deviation event in the near upper tail, the conditioned process follows a different Langevin diffusion on a fraction of the time interval and subsequently behaves like the unconditioned process. We establish this phase transition via a new sharp large deviation result for the occupation measure, which is of independent interest. We also provide further corollaries of this result and discuss generalizations to other Markov processes and additive functionals.
items.authors: Benjamin Budway, Makiko Sasada, Mykhaylo Shkolnikov
items.title_zh: 布朗运动中通过急剧大偏差的动态相变
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了带有漂移的布朗运动的动态相变，这是物理学文献中最近预测的一种现象。具体来说，当长时间间隔上有漂移的布朗运动以间隔 [-1,1] 的（归一化）占据测量的上限大偏差事件为条件时，本着吉布斯条件原理的精神，会发生相变。如果以远上尾部的大偏差事件为条件，则条件过程遵循加性泛函的 Donsker-Varadhan 变分公式所建议的 Langevin 扩散。相反，如果以近上尾部的大偏差事件为条件，则条件过程在一小部分时间间隔上遵循不同的朗之万扩散，并且随后表现得与无条件过程类似。我们通过占用度量的新的急剧大偏差结果来建立此相变，这是独立的兴趣。我们还提供了该结果的进一步推论，并讨论了对其他马尔可夫过程和加性泛函的推广。

items.title: An easy proof of transience of one-dimensional Rademacher walk with power weights
items.excerpt: Using a version of a local limit theorem, we provide an easy proof that the Rademacher random walk with step sizes $n^\alpha$, $\alpha>1/2$, is transient.
items.title_zh: 具有功率权重的一维 Rademacher 行走的瞬态性的简单证明
items.excerpt_zh: 使用局部极限定理的一个版本，我们提供了一个简单的证明，证明步长为 $n^\alpha$、$\alpha>1/2$ 的 Rademacher 随机游走是瞬态的。

items.title: An $O(n^{-1/2})$ remainder for the Chow--Robbins stopping boundary
items.excerpt: We sharpen the asymptotic approximation to the optimal stopping boundary in the Chow--Robbins game, proving the inverse-square-root remainder conjectured by Elton. The proof combines an exactly harmonic integral for simple random walk with a Catalan first-passage renewal identity. Averaging the stopping defect over one spatial period removes its leading lattice dependence, and a coupling of states at equal depth transfers this cancellation to the renewal sum. Consequently, the explicit integer stopping rule can fail at no more than a constant times the square root of the number of observation times.
items.title_zh: Chow--Robbins 停止边界的 $O(n^{-1/2})$ 余数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们锐化了 Chow--Robbins 博弈中最优停止边界的渐近逼近，证明了 Elton 猜想的反平方根余数。该证明将简单随机游走的精确调和积分与加泰罗尼亚第一代更新恒等式结合起来。对一个空间周期内的停止缺陷进行平均可以消除其主要的晶格依赖性，并且相等深度的状态耦合将这种抵消转移到更新总和。因此，显式整数停止规则可能会在不超过观察次数的平方根的常数倍时失败。

items.title: Frieze's $\zeta(3)$ and the Avram--Bertsimas constant under Haar conjugation
items.excerpt: Let $H_d=U_d^*\Lambda_dU_d$, where $U_d$ is Haar unitary and $\Lambda_d$ is a deterministic real diagonal matrix, and put $\sigma_d^2=\mathbb E|H_{12}|^2$. For minimum spanning trees with edge weights $\exp(-s|H_{ij}|^2/\sigma_d^2)$, we prove that the normalized expected weights differ from those of the independent Gaussian model by a polynomially small error, uniformly for $0 0$. The limit is the classical Avram--Bertsimas constant and includes Frieze's $\zeta(3)$ at $s=1$. For edge weights $|H_{ij}|^{-1}$, we approximate the normalized expected weight by an explicit one-dimensional integral with polynomial error, and obtain a divergent expansion in inverse powers of $\log d$. The assumptions require the spectrum, after centering and division by its standard deviation, to remain uniformly bounded. From Penrose's high-dimensional edge-length limit we derive $2-\gamma-\zeta(2)$ as the first correction to the high-dimensional Euclidean minimum spanning tree constant after normalization by the unit-ball volume. This correction is a logarithmic moment of the limiting distribution of MST edge weights; half of it is the first logarithmic co
items.title_zh: Frieze 的 $\zeta(3)$ 和 Haar 共轭下的 Avram--Bertsimas 常数
items.excerpt_zh: 设$H_d=U_d^*\Lambda_dU_d$，其中$U_d$是哈尔酉矩阵，$\Lambda_d$是确定性实对角矩阵，并输入$\sigma_d^2=\mathbb E|H_{12}|^2$。对于边缘权重为 $\exp(-s|H_{ij}|^2/\sigma_d^2)$ 的最小生成树，我们证明归一化期望权重与独立高斯模型的期望权重之间存在多项式小误差，对于 $0 0$ 是一致的。该极限是经典的 Avram-Bertsimas 常数，并包括 Frieze 在 $s=1$ 处的 $\zeta(3)$。对于边权重$|H_{ij}|^{-1}$，我们通过具有多项式误差的显式一维积分来近似归一化期望权重，并获得$\log d$的逆幂的发散展开。这些假设要求谱在居中并除以其标准差之后，保持均匀有界。从彭罗斯的高维边长限制，我们推导出 $2-\gamma-\zeta(2)$ 作为单位球体积归一化后对高维欧几里得最小生成树常数的第一次修正。该修正是MST边权重极限分布的对数矩；其中一半是第一个对数 co

items.title: From invasion to replacement: excursions of the Moran model
items.excerpt: An excursion-theoretic description of the continuous-time Moran model with recurrent mutation is developed. Exploiting its birth--death structure, the killed Moran process is characterized through its Green function, resolvent, Laplace transforms of hitting times, and spectral decomposition. A duality between the Moran model and a pure-death process is also established, yielding a spectral representation of its transition probabilities. The characterization of the killed process leads to a boundary-switching excursion representation in which returning excursions correspond to unsuccessful invasions of an allelic type, whilst switching excursions describe population-wide allelic replacement. The resulting regenerative structure provides the exact joint distribution and Laplace transforms for several path statistics, including the number, height and duration of unsuccessful invasions preceding replacement. Using Doob h-transforms, convergence of the rescaled Moran excursion measures and associated point processes, restricted to excursions exceeding a fixed positive height, to their Wright--Fisher counterparts is established. items.title_zh: 从入侵到替代：莫兰模型的游览
items.excerpt_zh: 开发了具有循环突变的连续时间 Moran 模型的偏移理论描述。利用其出生-死亡结构，杀死的莫兰过程通过其格林函数、解析、命中时间的拉普拉斯变换和谱分解来表征。莫兰模型和纯死亡过程之间的对偶性也被建立，产生其转移概率的谱表示。被杀死过程的表征导致边界切换偏移表示，其中返回偏移对应于等位基因类型的不成功入侵，而切换偏移描述群体范围的等位基因替换。由此产生的再生结构为多个路径统计数据提供了精确的关节分布和拉普拉斯变换，包括替换之前不成功入侵的数量、高度和持续时间。使用 Doob h 变换，重新调整的莫兰偏移量度和相关点过程（仅限于超过固定正高度的偏移）与其 Wright-Fisher 对应物的收敛得以建立。这些反式

items.title: Spectral characterizations of sub-Gaussian heat kernel bounds
items.excerpt: Grigor'yan, Hu and Lau, in Conjecture 3.9 of [Springer Proc. Math. Stat. 88 (2014): 147--207], asked whether a Faber--Krahn inequality and matching bounds for the bottom of the Dirichlet spectrum on balls characterize sub-Gaussian heat kernel upper bounds. We give a counterexample on the Euclidean plane. Our counterexample uses a planar diffusion associated with a Dirichlet form from the work of Li and Sun in [Ann. Appl. Probab. 34 (2024), 4193--4236]. The bottom of the Dirichlet spectrum on every ball of radius $r$ is comparable to $r^{-2}$ meanwhile for balls centered on the $x_1$-axis, the mean exit time starting at the center is comparable to $r^3$ as $r\downarrow0$. This also shows that the exit-time hypotheses used to characterize heat kernel upper bounds in [Stochastic Process. Appl. 189 (2025): 104707] and [Math. Nachr. 299 (2026): 2566--2589] cannot be omitted. We then give a novel spectral characterization of heat kernel upper bounds in terms of the first Dirichlet eigenpair of balls. In particular, on an unbounded proper geodesic Dirichlet space with volume doubling, reverse volume doubling and a scale-$r^\beta$ Poincar\'e
items.title_zh: 亚高斯热核边界的光谱表征

items.title: Concentration of the half-space Airy line ensembles
items.excerpt: The half-space Airy line ensembles $\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{hs};\varpi}$ ($\varpi\in\mathbb R\cup\{\infty\}$), introduced in arXiv:2505.01798, arXiv:2601.04546, are natural analogues of the Airy line ensemble and are expected to arise as universal scaling limits of models in the half-space Kardar--Parisi--Zhang (KPZ) class. We prove that, at each fixed time $t\geq 0$, the height of the $k$th curve concentrates about $-(3\pi k/2)^{2/3}$ on the scale $k^{-1/3}\sqrt{\log(2+k)}$, with exponential tails.
items.title_zh: 半空间艾里线系综的集中
items.excerpt_zh: 半空间艾里线系综 $\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{hs};\varpi}$ ($\varpi\in\mathbb R\cup\{\infty\}$) 在 arXiv:2505.01798、arXiv:2601.04546 中引入，是艾里线系综的自然类似物，预计将作为通用缩放限制出现半空间卡达尔-帕里西-张（KPZ）级模型。我们证明，在每个固定时间$t\geq 0$，第$k$条曲线的高度集中在$k^{-1/3}\sqrt{\log(2+k)}$尺度上的$-(3\pi k/2)^{2/3}$，具有指数尾部。

items.title: Analysis and Optimal Approximation of Operator-Valued Riccati Equations with Unbounded Control Operators
items.excerpt: In this work, we present new results on the well-posedness and approximation of the operator-valued Riccati equations that arise in the context of control systems with unbounded control operators, e.g. interior point and boundary control systems. We first prove that the Bochner integral form of the operator-valued Riccati equation is well-posed even if the control operator is unbounded. We then leverage the favorable structure of the Bochner integral form to prove that the error of approximate solutions are bounded by the approximation error of the process $C_0$-semigroup. This general result then leads to the correct prediction of optimal error estimates for the finite element approximation of the Riccati equation. The analysis is carried out on both the time-dependent and stationary Riccati equations and our numerical convergence study on the weakly damped wave process and the thermal process with delta function actuation operators corroborate the results of our analysis.
items.title_zh: 具有无界控制算子的算子值Riccati方程的分析与最优逼近
items.excerpt_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了关于算子值 Riccati 方程的适定性和逼近性的新结果，这些方程出现在具有无界控制算子的控制系统的背景下，例如内点和边界控制系统。我们首先证明即使控制算子无界，算子值 Riccati 方程的 Bochner 积分形式也是适定的。然后，我们利用 Bochner 积分形式的有利结构来证明近似解的误差受过程 $C_0$-半群的近似误差的限制。然后，这个一般结果导致对 Riccati 方程的有限元近似的最佳误差估计的正确预测。分析是对瞬态和平稳 Riccati 方程进行的，并且我们对弱阻尼波过程和热过程的 Delta 函数驱动算子的数值收敛研究证实了我们的分析结果。

items.title: A decoupled BDF2-type integrator for the spin-diffusion Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert system in ferromagnetic multilayers
items.excerpt: We propose and analyze a fully discrete, linear, decoupled BDF2-type finite element integrator for the spin-diffusion Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (SDLLG) system arising in spintronics. The SDLLG equations couple the magnetization dynamics with a diffusion equation for spin accumulation. The proposed numerical method combines a projection-free BDF2-type tangent-plane discretization of the magnetization dynamics with BDF2 time-stepping for the spin accumulation. By treating the coupling terms explicitly through extrapolation, each time step requires only two independent linear solves that can be performed in parallel. The analysis accommodates the usual exchange field and a general, possibly nonlinear, lower-order effective field. Unconditional weak convergence towards a global weak solution is shown. We also establish bounds on the deviation from the unit-length constraint. Under additional assumptions on the associated energy functional, an energy inequality for the limiting solution is obtained. Numerical experiments support the theoretical findings.
items.authors: Michele Ald\'e, Dirk Praetorius, Agus L. Soenjaya
items.title_zh: 铁磁多层中自旋扩散Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert系统的解耦BDF2型积分器
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出并分析了一种完全离散、线性、解耦的 BDF2 型有限元积分器，用于自旋电子学中出现的自旋扩散 Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (SDLLG) 系统。 SDLLG 方程将磁化动力学与自旋累积的扩散方程耦合起来。所提出的数值方法将磁化动力学的无投影 BDF2 型切面离散化与自旋累积的 BDF2 时间步进相结合。通过外推明确地处理耦合项，每个时间步长仅需要两个可以并行执行的独立线性求解。该分析涵盖了通常的交换场和一般的、可能非线性的、低阶有效场。显示了朝向全局弱解的无条件弱收敛。我们还建立了单位长度约束偏差的界限。在相关能量泛函的附加假设下，获得极限解的能量不等式。数值实验支持了理论发现。

items.title: A Kernel Framework for Linear Operator Equations
items.excerpt: Solving linear operator equations with nonlocal terms or heterogeneous constraints often requires specific numerical schemes. We develop a unified approach based on embedding such equations into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). Differential, boundary, and integral operators are represented by their Riesz representers in the RKHS. The equations are solved in the regularized least-squares sense at finitely many collocation points. The solution is a finite linear combination of operator-induced representers and is obtained from a single linear system. Its sensitivities, such as financial Greeks, follow by direct differentiation. To reduce the computational cost for large collocation sets, we introduce a Nystr\"om approximation based on subsampling the operator-induced representers. It yields the best approximation of this solution within the reduced trial space, in a regularized empirical norm. Numerical examples cover ordinary, partial, and partial integro-differential equations, including multi-asset and jump-diffusion option pricing.
items.title_zh: 线性算子方程的核框架
items.excerpt_zh: 求解具有非局部项或异构约束的线性算子方程通常需要特定的数值方案。我们开发了一种基于将此类方程嵌入到再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中的统一方法。微分、边界和积分算子由 RKHS 中的 Riesz 表示来表示。这些方程在有限多个配置点处以正则化最小二乘意义求解。该解是算子引起的表示的有限线性组合，并且是从单个线性系统获得的。它的敏感性，例如金融希腊人，随之而来的是直接分化。为了减少大型搭配集的计算成本，我们引入了基于对算子引起的表示进行子采样的 Nystr\"om 近似。它在正则化的经验范数中在减少的试验空间内产生该解决方案的最佳近似。数值示例涵盖普通、偏微分和偏积分微分方程，包括多资产和跳跃扩散期权定价。

items.title: Sharp History-Length Dependence of Mesh-Uniform Exponential Decay Rates for a Boundary-Memory Euler-Bernoulli Beam
items.excerpt: For a boundary-memory Euler--Bernoulli beam with polynomial relaxation, we quantify the loss of exponential stability as the retained history length $S$ grows. The continuous and conforming Hermite--$\mathbb P_1$ generators have zero-frequency resolvent norms bounded above and below by constant multiples of $S$. The bounds are uniform in the beam mesh and in every history mesh of step at most a fixed $h_0$. Their semigroup norms retain a plateau of duration proportional to $S$. Under positive distributed and boundary damping, matching exponential estimates hold with the optimal time scale $1+S$, uniformly in the meshes. Optimality refers to the semigroup norm on the augmented state space, which includes the history. Without distributed damping, the same time scale holds for the continuous truncated generator under a boundary condition on $\delta^{(3)}$. We also prove strong convergence of the finite-history semigroups to the full-history semigroup, uniformly on compact time intervals, under restriction and zero extension of histories.
