items.title_zh: 边界记忆欧拉-伯努利梁网格均匀指数衰减率的尖锐历史长度依赖性
items.excerpt_zh: 对于具有多项式松弛的边界记忆欧拉-伯努利梁，我们量化了随着保留历史长度 $S$ 的增长指数稳定性的损失。连续且一致的 Hermite--$\mathbb P_1$ 生成器具有零频率解析范数，上下边界为 $S$ 的常量倍数。梁网格中的边界是统一的，并且步骤的每个历史网格中最多有一个固定的 $h_0$。他们的半群范数保持了与 $S$ 成正比的持续时间平台。在正分布和边界阻尼下，匹配指数估计在网格中均匀地保持最佳时间尺度 $1+S$。最优性是指增广状态空间上的半群范数，其中包括历史。在没有分布式阻尼的情况下，在 $\delta^{(3)}$ 上的边界条件下，连续截断发电机也适用相同的时间尺度。我们还证明了有限历史半群与全历史半群的强收敛性，一致地在紧凑时间间隔上，在历史的限制和零扩张下。远程历史数据包给出截断生成器的阶数为 $S^{-1}$ 的残差，阶数为 $S^{

items.title: A mixed-primal FEM for Poisson-Fermi interfacial problems
items.excerpt: This paper presents a mixed-primal FEM for a linearised Poisson--Fermi interface problem arising from the Bazant--Storey--Kornyshev theory, which describes electrostatic interactions in ionic solutions. It leads to a transmission problem coupling a fourth-order equation in the solvent region with a second-order equation in the solute region. To precisely compute the electrostatic stress and the interactive force in the electrolyte, we reformulate the fourth-order problem as a mixed system by introducing the gradient of the electrostatic potential, the divergence of its gradient, and the gradient of its divergence as additional independent variables. The second-order problem is studied in its primal form as this approach eliminates the requirement for Lagrange multipliers to enforce the transmission conditions. The resulting formulation is discretised using Raviart--Thomas finite elements for the vector variables and piecewise polynomial finite elements for the scalar variables. Well-posedness of the mixed-primal formulation and optimal a priori error estimates for the field variables as well as for the postprocessed Maxwell tensor are
items.authors: Siyad Rahman Mandottil, Neela Nataraj, Ricardo Ruiz-Baier
items.title_zh: 泊松-费米界面问题的混合原始有限元
items.excerpt_zh: 本文提出了一种混合原始有限元，用于解决由 Bazant-Storey-Kornyshev 理论产生的线性化泊松-费米界面问题，该理论描述了离子溶液中的静电相互作用。它导致将溶剂区域中的四阶方程与溶质区域中的二阶方程耦合的传输问题。为了精确计算电解质中的静电应力和相互作用力，我们通过引入静电势梯度、梯度散度及其散度梯度作为附加自变量，将四阶问题重新表述为混合系统。二阶问题以其原始形式进行研究，因为这种方法消除了拉格朗日乘子来强制传输条件的要求。使用 Raviart-Thomas 有限元作为向量变量，使用分段多项式有限元作为标量变量，对所得公式进行离散化。混合原始公式的适定性以及场变量以及后处理麦克斯韦张量的最佳先验误差估计为

items.title: Verified two-sided bounds for the inf-sup constant of the divergence on planar polygons
items.excerpt: The inf-sup constant $\beta(\Omega)$ of the divergence governs the stability of the Stokes problem. For polygons, analytic lower bounds are far from the true value, and numerical methods either bound $\beta$ from above or require spectral-gap and mesh-fineness hypotheses that cannot presently be checked. We propose a method that produces verified lower bounds without any such hypothesis. It rests on the Friedrichs formulation of $\beta$ in the Bergman space and on a multiplier identity that controls the non-compact corner contribution pointwise, with the sharp corner constant; the remaining compact part is bounded by a finite matrix inequality that is checked in exact and ball arithmetic. We prove that the bounds converge to $\beta$. Together with enclosed Rayleigh quotients of explicit trial functions (and, for the square, the bottom $\frac12-\frac1\pi$ of the essential spectrum) this yields two-sided enclosures, e.g.\ $0.426245\le\beta\le0.426252$ for the square and $0.303973\le\beta\le0.304078$ for the L-shaped domain. items.title_zh: 验证平面多边形上散度的 inf-sup 常数的两侧边界
items.excerpt_zh: 散度的 inf-sup 常数 $\beta(\Omega)$ 决定了斯托克斯问题的稳定性。对于多边形，解析下限与真实值相距甚远，数值方法要么从上面限制$\beta$，要么需要目前无法检查的谱间隙和网格细度假设。我们提出了一种无需任何此类假设即可产生经过验证的下限的方法。它基于 Bergman 空间中的 Friedrichs 公式 $\beta$ 以及乘数恒等式，该乘数恒等式以尖角常数控制非紧角贡献；剩余的紧凑部分受有限矩阵不等式的限制，该矩阵不等式通过精确算术和球算术进行检查。我们证明边界收敛于 $\beta$。与显式试验函数的封闭瑞利商（对于正方形，基本谱的底部 $\frac12-\frac1\pi$）一起，这会产生两侧包围，例如正方形的 \ $0.426245\le\beta\le0.426252$ 和 L 形域的 $0.303973\le\beta\le0.304078$。对于带有方孔的正方形，既不是单连通的也不是星形的，我们得到 $0.154596\le\beta\le

items.title: Gradient-free MCMC exploiting low-dimensional Gaussian and nonGaussian posterior structure
items.excerpt: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) for Bayesian inverse problems is expensive: the unknown is high-dimensional, every likelihood evaluation requires a forward solve, and gradients are often unavailable. The posterior typically differs from the prior in a few directions and is often approximately Gaussian in most of them but strongly non-Gaussian in a few. We propose the NQU sampler, a gradient-free MCMC method that splits the parameter space into non-Gaussian (N), approximately quadratic (Q) and uninformative (U) directions. The split is learned once, before sampling, from likelihood values, and each block is updated by a kernel suited to it; a collapsed update handles a global prior scale. Because the learned structure only shapes the proposals, every update leaves the exact posterior invariant, at the cost of one likelihood evaluation. We give a condition under which the blocks can be learned and show that, for likelihoods with exactly the learned structure, the spectral gap of the sampler does not depend on the dimension, whereas updating the scale given all coordinates can have a gap of order $1/d$. On the posterior axes, the NQU sam
items.authors: Hongqiao Wang, Jiahua Jiang, Jing Liu, Jinglai Li
items.title_zh: 利用低维高斯和非高斯后验结构的无梯度 MCMC
items.excerpt_zh: 用于贝叶斯反问题的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗 (MCMC) 成本高昂：未知数是高维的，每个似然评估都需要前向求解，并且梯度通常不可用。后验通常在几个方向上与先验不同，并且在大多数方向上通常近似高斯分布，但在少数方向上强烈非高斯分布。我们提出了 NQU 采样器，这是​​一种无梯度 MCMC 方法，它将参数空间划分为非高斯 (N)、近似二次 (Q) 和无信息 (U) 方向。在采样之前，根据似然值学习一次分割，并且每个块由适合它的内核更新；折叠更新处理全局先验规模。由于学习的结构仅塑造提案，因此每次更新都会留下精确的后验不变量，但代价是一次似然评估。我们给出了可以学习块的条件，并表明，对于具有精确学习结构的似然性，采样器的谱间隙不依赖于维度，而更新给定所有坐标的比例可以具有 $1/d$ 量级的间隙。在后轴上，NQU sam

items.title: Upwind finite element approximation of the gradient blow-up time for a viscous Hamilton--Jacobi equation
items.excerpt: We analyze an upwind finite element method with piecewise linear elements for a viscous Hamilton--Jacobi equation with a superquadratic gradient source term, subject to homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions. On polytopal inner approximations of smooth bounded domains in dimensions $N=1,2,3$, we prove maximum-norm convergence of the numerical solution to the exact solution before gradient blow-up and convergence of gradient-threshold times to the blow-up time under explicit mesh and regularity assumptions. We also verify the regularity assumption and finite-time gradient blow-up for an example on the disk, to which the main theorem therefore applies. Numerical experiments illustrate this gradient blow-up.
items.title_zh: 粘性Hamilton--Jacobi方程梯度爆破时间的迎风有限元近似
items.excerpt_zh: 我们分析了具有超二次梯度源项的粘性 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程的分段线性单元的迎风有限元方法，并受齐次狄利克雷边界条件的影响。在维度 $N=1,2,3$ 的平滑有界域的多拓扑内近似上，我们证明了在显式网格和正则性假设下，数值解对梯度爆炸之前的精确解的最大范数收敛性以及梯度阈值时间对爆炸时间的收敛性。我们还以磁盘上的示例验证了正则性假设和有限时间梯度爆炸，因此主要定理适用于该示例。数值实验说明了这种梯度爆炸。

items.title: Idempotent generically stable measures in NSOP$_1$ groups
items.excerpt: We prove the Idempotent Measure Conjecture for type-definable groups in theories whose Keisler randomization is NSOP$_1$. More precisely, every global idempotent frequency interpretation measure on such a group is the unique left-invariant and the unique right-invariant measure concentrating on its type-definable stabilizer. In particular, its support is a left-simple convolution semigroup and has a unique minimal left ideal. The announced theorem of Ben Yaacov, Chernikov and Ramsey that randomization preserves NSOP$_1$ (proof in the appendix) yields the corresponding conclusion for all type-definable groups in NSOP$_1$ theories.
items.title_zh: NSOP$_1$ 组中的幂等一般稳定措施
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在凯斯勒随机化为 NSOP$_1$ 的理论中证明了类型可定义群的幂等测度猜想。更准确地说，这样一个群上的每个全局幂等频率解释测度都是唯一的左不变量和唯一的右不变量测度，集中于其类型可定义的稳定器。特别是，它的支持是左简单卷积半群，并且具有独特的最小左理想。 Ben Yaacov、Chernikov 和 Ramsey 宣布的随机化保留 NSOP$_1$ 的定理（附录中的证明）为 NSOP$_1$ 理论中的所有类型可定义群得出相应的结论。

items.title: Progress on the Stable Fields Conjecture
items.excerpt: We prove that every infinite stable field of positive characteristic is separably closed. We also show that the field $\mathbb{C}(t)$ has the strict order property (hence is unstable).
items.authors: G Conant, J Freitag, C Terry
items.title_zh: 稳定场猜想的进展
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了每一个具有正特性的无限稳定场都是可分离闭的。我们还表明域 $\mathbb{C}(t)$ 具有严格的顺序属性（因此不稳定）。

items.title: Provability of Consistency: A New Foundational Landscape
items.excerpt: This paper surveys recent developments on the provability of consistency. For nearly a century, the Unprovability of Consistency Thesis (UCT) has held that sufficiently rich systems, such as Peano Arithmetic (PA), cannot formalize a proof of their own consistency. Recent studies show that the standard G\"odelian consistency formula, Con_PA, on which the UCT argument rests, represents a non-equivalent redefinition of the original Hilbertian notion of consistency. We construct a rigorous mathematical proof of the Hilbertian consistency of PA that is formalizable within PA itself, thereby refuting UCT. While G\"odelian consistency formulas remain indispensable for comparing the relative strengths of theories, Hilbertian consistency enables internal self-verification. Beyond vindicating Hilbert's consistency program, these findings dismantle the Lucas-Penrose argument and remove perceived logical barriers to self-verifying Automated Theorem Proving and Artificial Intelligence.
items.title_zh: 一致性证明：新的基础景观
items.excerpt_zh: 本文调查了一致性证明的最新进展。近一个世纪以来，一致性不可证明性命题（UCT）一直认为，足够丰富的系统，例如皮亚诺算术（PA），无法形式化证明其自身的一致性。最近的研究表明，UCT论证所依赖的标准G\'odelian一致性公式Con_PA代表了对原始希尔伯特一致性概念的非等价重新定义。我们构建了PA的希尔伯特一致性的严格数学证明，该证明可在PA本身内形式化，从而反驳UCT。虽然G\'odelian一致性公式对于比较理论的相对强度仍然是不可或缺的，但希尔伯特一致性使得内部自我验证成为可能。除了证明希尔伯特的一致性计划是正确的之外，这些发现还推翻了卢卡斯-彭罗斯的论证，并消除了自我验证自动定理证明和人工智能的逻辑障碍。

items.title: Cardinal Transfer Events for Infinitary Logic with Infinitary Quantification
items.excerpt: Assuming the existence of a certain theory $\Phi$, we solve the Gap-$n$ problem for more than one predicate. This will be done for infinitary logic with infinitary quantification.
items.title_zh: 具有无限量化的无限逻辑的基数转移事件
items.excerpt_zh: 假设存在某种理论$\Phi$，我们解决多个谓词的Gap-$n$问题。这将针对具有无限量化的无限逻辑来完成。

items.title: Density elimination for weakly commutative pseudo-uninorm logic:a correction and an explicit theory-level completeness proof
items.excerpt: We correct the density-elimination argument for weakly commutative pseudo-uninorm logic in Wang, \emph{Symmetry} 11 (2019), 368, retaining its basic ideas and overall strategy. The published definition of a labelled copy permits independent renamings of antecedent and succedent labels. Under the syntactic splicing interpretation used in that argument, a contraction-free derivable hypersequent and a four-element residuated chain refute the claimed compatibility of the resulting contraction with ordered density elimination. We require a single renaming on both sides of each closed block and prove that the linear rules and coherent closed-block contraction preserve provability of every member of the associated Cartesian families. An occurrence-based separation argument, together with normalization to cuts on the monoidal unit, establishes strong density elimination. We then derive standard completeness from density, retaining the original conclusion for formula theorems. For an explicit Hilbert presentation with independent conjugation parameters, we give a direct relative chain-countermodel proof for arbitrary theories in a countable la
items.title_zh: 弱交换伪非正则逻辑的密度消除：修正和显式理论级完备性证明
items.excerpt_zh: 我们纠正了 Wang, \emph{Symmetry} 11 (2019), 368 中弱交换伪非正则逻辑的密度消除论证，保留了其基本思想和总体策略。已发布的带标签副本的定义允许对先前标签和后​​续标签进行独立重命名。根据该论证中使用的句法剪接解释，无收缩的可导出超序列和四元素残差链反驳了所声称的所得收缩与有序密度消除的兼容性。我们需要在每个封闭块的两侧进行一次重命名，并证明线性规则和连贯的封闭块收缩保留了相关笛卡尔家族每个成员的可证明性。基于事件的分离论证与幺半群单位切割的归一化一起建立了强密度消除。然后，我们从密度推导出标准完整性，保留公式定理的原始结论。对于具有独立共轭参数的显式希尔伯特表示，我们给出了可数 la 中任意理论的直接相对链反模型证明

items.title: The Borel Topos
items.excerpt: We construct a topos for Borel mathematics: statements which are true in Borel mathemaics correspond in a precise way to statements which are true in the internal logic of this topos. We investigate several other properties of this topos, including proving that it satisfies a Borel analogue of the Church-Turing thesis: the statement that every function on a standard Borel space is Borel. We also show that an earlier construction of a similar "Borel topos" by van Osdol does not suit these purposes because of an error in that paper.
items.authors: Joseph Helfer, Patrick Lutz, Forte Shinko
items.title_zh: 博雷尔拓扑斯
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为 Borel 数学构建了一个拓扑：Borel 数学中正确的陈述以精确的方式对应于该拓扑的内部逻辑中正确的陈述。我们研究了这个拓扑的其他几个属性，包括证明它满足 Church-Turing 论文的 Borel 类似物：标准 Borel 空间上的每个函数都是 Borel 的陈述。我们还表明，由于该论文中的错误，范奥斯多尔早期构建的类似“Borel topos”并不适合这些目的。

items.title: Some conservativity results for weak arithmetic theories in a language with exponentiation
items.excerpt: Recall that $\mathsf{IOpen}$ denotes the theory of quantifier-free induction in the pure arithmetic language. In this paper, we consider an extension of $\mathsf{IOpen}$ in the arithmetical language expanded by the unary function $\exp: x \mapsto 2^x$, obtained by adding certain simple universal axioms for $\exp$, namely, $$\exp(1) = 2, \quad \exp(x + y) = \exp(x) \exp(y), \quad \exp(x) > x.$$ We prove that this theory is $\Pi_1$-conservative over $\mathsf{IOpen}$ and $\forall$-conservative over the theory of discretely ordered $\mathbb Z$-semirings. This result extends a result of A. Wilkie and provides a partial answer to a question of E. Je\v{r}\'abek concerning the strength of the theory of exponential integer parts.
items.title_zh: 求幂语言中弱算术理论的一些保守性结果
items.excerpt_zh: 回想一下，$\mathsf{IOpen}$ 表示纯算术语言中的无量词归纳理论。在本文中，我们考虑 $\mathsf{IOpen}$ 在算术语言中的扩展，由一元函数 $\exp: x \mapsto 2^x$，通过添加 $\exp$ 的某些简单通用公理而获得，即 $$\exp(1) = 2, \quad \exp(x + y) = \exp(x) \exp(y), \quad \exp(x) > x.$$ 我们证明这个理论是$\Pi_1$-对 $\mathsf{IOpen}$ 保守，$\forall$-对离散有序 $\mathbb Z$-半环理论保守。这个结果扩展了 A. Wilkie 的结果，并为 E. Je\v{r}\'abek 关于指数整数部分理论强度的问题提供了部分答案。

items.title: Alpha-Beta Pruning via Monadic Continuations
items.excerpt: Alpha-beta pruning is a fundamental technique in game-playing AI, enabling efficient minimax search by avoiding the exploration of branches that cannot affect the optimal decision. We present a monadic formulation of alpha-beta pruning based on the combination of the continuation monad and the reader monad. Unlike previous approaches that encode alpha-beta bounds into the types of available moves, our construction records these bounds within monadic outcomes, leaving the move types unchanged. We further show that the ordinary continuation monad suffices to compute not only optimal outcomes but also optimal plays, by extending the outcome type to include the corresponding sequences of moves. This provides an alternative to generalisations of the continuation monad proposed to address the inefficiencies associated with the selection monad in alpha-beta search. We illustrate our approach with an implementation of Tic-Tac-Toe, observing a 39-fold reduction in the number of plays evaluated, compared with exhaustive search, in computing an optimal play. Finally, we formally establish the correctness of our construction by proving that the
items.title_zh: 通过 Monadic 延续进行 Alpha-Beta 剪枝
items.excerpt_zh: Alpha-beta 剪枝是游戏 AI 中的一项基本技术，通过避免探索无法影响最佳决策的分支来实现高效的极小极大搜索。我们提出了基于延续单子和读者单子组合的 α-β 剪枝的单子公式。与之前将 alpha-beta 边界编码为可用移动类型的方法不同，我们的构造将这些边界记录在单子结果中，使移动类型保持不变。我们进一步表明，通过扩展结果类型以包括相应的移动序列，普通的延续单子不仅足以计算最佳结果，还足以计算最佳游戏。这为延续单子的泛化提供了一种替代方案，旨在解决与 alpha-beta 搜索中的选择单子相关的低效率问题。我们通过 Tic-Tac-Toe 的实现来说明我们的方法，在计算最佳游戏时，观察到与穷举搜索相比，评估的游戏数量减少了 39 倍。最后，我们通过证明

items.title: Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation, Strategy-Proofness, and Multi-Scale Composition
items.excerpt: Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act. In this paper, we show that allocation is not an auxiliary concern but a structural component of governance. When multiple agents compete for execution under constrained resources, any allocation mechanism introduces unavoidable trade-offs between fairness, efficiency, and resistance to strategic manipulation. We formalize this through a set of impossibility results, including Sybil amplification and the incompatibility of desirable allocation properties. We then show that these allocation constraints cannot be resolved within a single layer of control. Instead, they propagate across the system, interacting with execution atomicity, state enforcement, and behavioral drift. This leads to a multi-scale governance structure composed of four orthogonal dimensions: temporal (atomicity), state (enforcement), behavioral (drift monitoring), and population (allocation). Our main result is an irreducibility theorem: under finite observabi
items.title_zh: 自治代理系统的不可约治理结构：公平分配、策略验证和多尺度组合
items.excerpt_zh: 自治代理治理通常被视为强制正确执行的问题。然而，在多代理系统中，执行之前还有一个同样基本的问题：允许哪些代理执行操作。在本文中，我们表明分配不是一个辅助问题，而是治理的结构组成部分。当多个智能体在有限的资源下竞争执行时，任何分配机制都会不可避免地在公平、效率和抗战略操纵之间进行权衡。我们通过一组不可能的结果来形式化这一点，包括 Sybil 放大和理想分配属性的不兼容性。然后我们表明这些分配约束无法在单层控制中得到解决。相反，它们在整个系统中传播，与执行原子性、状态执行和行为漂移交互。这导致了由四个正交维度组成的多尺度治理结构：时间（原子性）、状态（执行）、行为（漂移监控）和人口（分配）。我们的主要结果是一个不可约性定理：在有限观测下

items.title: Agent Evaluation Without Ground Truth: A Null Proportion Perspective
items.excerpt: The correctness of actions taken by agents is typically evaluated against known, externally verified ground truth labels, such as whether a proof is correct or whether code compiles and passes unit tests. However, as coding and science agents are entrusted with more end-to-end autonomy -- proposing interventions, running experiments, and deciding what to deploy and investigate next -- whether an agent's actions genuinely improve an outcome must be inferred from noisy, often inconclusive experiments. To evaluate agents in this setting, we define agent quality as a weighted sum of correct decisions along its trajectory, using sequences of $e$-values as statistical evidence regarding correctness in place of ground-truth labels. Our framework accommodates arbitrarily dependent decisions, data-dependent trajectory termination, dynamically generated hypotheses, and quality measures defined after the trajectory concludes. We construct upper and lower bound estimators and confidence sets for agent quality with statistical guarantees that hold uniformly over agent trajectory distributions and establish instance-wise sharpness of our estimator
items.authors: Brian M. Cho, Michael Lindon, Nathan Kallus
items.title_zh: 没有基本事实的代理评估：零比例视角
items.excerpt_zh: 代理采取的操作的正确性通常根据已知的、外部验证的真实标签进行评估，例如证明是否正确或代码是否编译并通过单元测试。然而，由于编码和科学代理被赋予了更多的端到端自主权——提出干预措施、运行实验以及决定下一步部署和调查什么——代理的行为是否真正改善了结果，必须从嘈杂的、通常是不确定的实验中推断出来。为了评估这种情况下的智能体，我们将智能体质量定义为沿着其轨迹的正确决策的加权总和，使用 $e$ 值序列作为有关正确性的统计证据来代替真实标签。我们的框架适应任意相关的决策、数据相关的轨迹终止、动态生成的假设以及轨迹结束后定义的质量度量。我们构建了代理质量的上限和下限估计器和置信集，并具有统计保证，这些保证在代理轨迹分布上保持一致，并建立了估计器的实例级锐度

items.title: Safe Autoformalization: Sufficiency and Necessity with Entailment Graphs
items.excerpt: Autoformalization translates a natural-language statement into a formula that captures its intent, which depends on the statement's context: the background that disambiguates it. LLMs make autoformalization practical, but their probabilistic output carries no formal guarantees. We propose techniques for safe autoformalization that certify one-sided logical adequacy: a formula sufficient for the intent is safe to enforce, and a formula necessary for it is safe to rely on. We use LLMs to generate candidate formulas and order them by logical strength in an Entailment Graph (EG), an ordering a solver decides. Each edge carries a residual and a co-residual, the two adjoints of the entailment order, all fixed by the candidate pool alone. In a context, two searches return the sufficient frontier, the weakest candidates that entail the statement, and the necessary frontier, the strongest candidates the statement entails; each step is one local check against an edge's residual or co-residual. The frontiers bracket the statement and yield the ambiguity residue, which holds exactly of the situations the candidates certify neither as satisfying n
items.title_zh: 安全自动形式化：蕴涵图的充分性和必然性
items.excerpt_zh: 自动形式化将自然语言语句转换为捕获其意图的公式，这取决于语句的上下文：消除歧义的背景。法学硕士使自动形式化变得实用，但它们的概率输出没有正式的保证。我们提出了安全自动形式化的技术，以证明单方面的逻辑充分性：足以满足意图的公式可以安全地执行，而必要的公式可以安全地依赖。我们使用 LLM 生成候选公式，并根据蕴涵图 (EG) 中的逻辑强度对它们进行排序，排序由求解器决定。每条边都带有一个残差和一个共残差，即蕴涵顺序的两个伴随物，全部由候选池单独固定。在一个上下文中，两次搜索返回足够的边界，即该语句所包含的最弱的候选者，以及必要的边界，即该语句所包含的最强的候选者；每一步都是针对边缘残差或共同残差的本地检查。边界将陈述括起来并产生歧义残差，该残差恰好包含候选人证明都不满足 n 的情况

items.title: Provably Near-Optimal PQ in the Extended Zador Model
items.excerpt: This paper investigates Product Quantization (PQ) Optimization with Gaussian data. It offers three key contributions (i) a proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation for PQ; (ii) a new Extended Zador (EZ) estimator of the $k$-means quantization cost that is accurate in low bit rates and low dimensions; and (iii) a novel segmentation algorithm based on 1-d bin packing of global bit allocations. The result is a simple algorithm (EZPQ) with strong approximation guarantees. It matches OPQ's empirical accuracy while providing a per-instance distortion lower bound certificate under the Gaussian EZ cost model. On typical real embedding spectra, EZPQ with 2 bits per coordinate is often certifiably within 1% of the optimum in this model. It also consistently achieves a lower reconstruction error than all random-rotation-based algorithms such as EDEN, E-RaBitQ, and TurboQuant.
items.authors: Edo Liberty, Ashwin Padaki, Amir Ingber
items.title_zh: 扩展 Zador 模型中可证明接近最优的 PQ
items.excerpt_zh: 本文研究了高斯数据的乘积量化 (PQ) 优化。它提供了三个关键贡献 (i) 证明 SVD 是 PQ 的最佳预处理旋转； (ii) 新的 $k$ 量化成本的扩展 Zador (EZ) 估计器，在低比特率和低维度下是准确的； (iii)基于全局比特分配的一维装箱的新颖分段算法。结果是一个具有强大近似保证的简单算法（EZPQ）。它与 OPQ 的经验准确性相匹配，同时在高斯 EZ 成本模型下提供每个实例的失真下限证书。在典型的真实嵌入谱上，每个坐标 2 位的 EZPQ 通常可以证明与该模型中的最佳值相差 1% 以内。与所有基于随机旋转的算法（例如 EDEN、E-RaBitQ 和 TurboQuant）相比，它始终能够实现较低的重建误差。

items.title: Self-Improving Long-Horizon Reasoning by Learning Summaries from Local Continuations
items.excerpt: Reasoning models degrade as their context grows, so longer reasoning traces do not by themselves give longer effective horizons. One way to extend the horizon is to compress the reasoning history into a compact state from time to time and continue from the state. Existing methods train the state with the final-answer reward or distill it from a stronger model. Neither signal is tailored to measure the contribution of the state alone. We observe that a reasoning model that degrades over long trajectories still behaves reliably in short contexts. We aim to preserve this short-context behavior when compressing the reasoning history. Motivated by this, we train a separate summarizer with Delta-KL, a reward computed from the frozen reasoning model's token-level predictions on sampled continuations, and run inference by truncating the trace, summarizing it, and continuing from the summary (TruSuCo). Training uses a few thousand questions with 4k-token reasoning prefixes and does not need answers or external teachers. Under a fixed 32k-token budget, the trained summarizer improves on vanilla reasoning and on an untrained summarizer in all ni
items.title_zh: 通过学习局部延续的总结来自我改进长视野推理
items.excerpt_zh: 推理模型会随着上下文的增长而退化，因此较长的推理轨迹本身并不能提供更长的有效范围。扩展视野的一种方法是不时将推理历史压缩成紧凑状态，并从该状态继续。现有的方法使用最终答案奖励来训练状态，或者从更强大的模型中提取它。这两个信号都不是专门用来衡量国家的贡献的。我们观察到，在长轨迹上退化的推理模型在短上下文中仍然表现可靠。我们的目标是在压缩推理历史时保留这种短上下文行为。受此启发，我们使用 Delta-KL 训练一个单独的摘要器，这是根据冻结推理模型对采样延续的标记级预测计算出的奖励，并通过截断跟踪、对其进行总结并从摘要继续进行推理 (TruSuCo)。训练使用数千个问题和 4k-token 推理前缀，不需要答案或外部教师。在固定的 32k 令牌预算下，经过训练的摘要器在所有方面都改进了普通推理和未经训练的摘要器

items.title: Wavefront: Low-Rank Drafting with Parallel Causal Refinement for Speculative Decoding
items.excerpt: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Parallel block drafters such as DFlash and P-EAGLE propose a whole block in one forward pass, but they lose the dependence between tokens in the block; DSpark restores part of it with a lightweight correction head that runs sequentially. Measuring DSpark, we find that this head overrides the base prediction on most slots, so the expensive base readout through the target's full lm_head mostly provides a seed. We therefore propose Wavefront, which follows a simple principle: shrink the base and strengthen the correction head. Wavefront replaces the full lm_head with a learned low-rank base, conditions the correction head on the whole drafted prefix within the same block, and resolves it with a few parallel Jacobi passes. A fixed pass budget makes the draft step free of data-dependent control flow, so we capture it as a single CUDA graph in vLLM with fused kernels. On Qwen3-8B, Wavefront improves throughput over xPress, DSpark and DFlash by 2.6%, 10.7% and 23.6% on average across math, code, chat and agenti
items.title_zh: Wavefront：具有并行因果细化的低阶起草，用于推测解码
items.excerpt_zh: 推测性解码通过让廉价的起草者提出目标模型并行验证的标记来加速 LLM 推理。 DFlash 和 P-EAGLE 等并行区块起草者在一次前向传递中提出了整个区块，但它们失去了区块中代币之间的依赖关系； DSpark 通过按顺序运行的轻型校正头来恢复其中的一部分。通过测量 DSpark，我们发现该头会覆盖大多数插槽上的基本预测，因此通过目标的完整 lm_head 进行的昂贵的基本读出主要提供种子。因此，我们提出了Wavefront，它遵循一个简单的原则：缩小底座并加强校正头。 Wavefront 用学习的低阶基替换完整的 lm_head，在同一块内的整个起草的前缀上调节校正头，并通过一些并行雅可比传递来解析它。固定的传递预算使草稿步骤不受数据相关的控制流的影响，因此我们将其捕获为带有融合内核的 vLLM 中的单个 CUDA 图。在 Qwen3-8B 上，Wavefront 在数学、代码、聊天和代理方面的吞吐量比 xPress、DSpark 和 DFlash 平均提高了 2.6%、10.7% 和 23.6%

items.title: Verified Proof Refactoring with Codex and Qwen
items.excerpt: We refactor existing Lean 4 proofs to reduce source length and checking cost while preserving theorem statements and compatibility across Lean versions. A locally served Qwen model uses the open-source Codex CLI to inspect source, retrieve declarations, and test proof replacements. The host keeps a replacement only if it improves the objective and Lean accepts it on every required version. A deterministic CPU pass then refines the verified proofs. On the 60 problems in Lean Refactor Arena, model search achieves a local mean combined score of 82.07, and cleanup raises it to 82.18. The final proofs pass all 127 required proof--version checks. Our system placed first in the open-source LLM track of Lean Refactor Arena at VeriCodeGen.
items.title_zh: 使用 Codex 和 Qwen 进行验证证明重构
items.excerpt_zh: 我们重构现有的 Lean 4 证明，以减少源代码长度和检查成本，同时保留定理陈述和跨 Lean 版本的兼容性。本地服务的 Qwen 模型使用开源 Codex CLI 来检查源代码、检索声明和测试证明替换。仅当替代品改进了目标并且精益在每个所需版本上接受它时，主机才会保留替代品。然后，确定性的 CPU 通行证会完善经过验证的证明。在 Lean Refactor Arena 的 60 个问题上，模型搜索的局部平均综合得分为 82.07，清理将其提高到 82.18。最终的证明通过了所有 127 项必需的证明版本检查。我们的系统在 VeriCodeGen 的 Lean Refactor Arena 的开源 LLM 赛道中排名第一。

items.title: GaokaoMathGen: Chinese Gaokao Mathematics Finale Problem Generation Controlled by Latent Reasoning Structures
items.excerpt: Generating Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problems requires controlling not only the included skills, but also the underlying mathematical kernel and solution path. Existing LLM-based methods mainly rely on surface-level specifications, while the realized difficulty of generated problems cannot be determined directly from prompted targets. Therefore, we propose GaokaoMathGen, a framework for Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problem generation controlled by latent reasoning structures. It extracts standardized latent reasoning structures from seed problems and performs constrained synthesis using skills, methods, a core identity, and a pivot step as structural controls. We further estimate realized difficulty through logical-quality filtering, fixed-solver decoding effort, structural features, and solver-output search signals. Experiments show that semantic normalization improves cross-annotator comparability and that 78.0% of 609 scored candidates pass the logical-quality filter. In a teacher audit of the 60 highest-effort candidates, all were judged to reach finale or penultimate problem difficulty, and only one exhibited a sever

items.title_zh: GaukaoMathGen：潜在推理结构控制的中国高考数学大结局问题生成

In this paper, we study conformalized OOD gating coupled with actionability-constrained counterfactual search across two tabular benchmarks: Adult and Give Me Some Credit (GMSC). Calibrating finite-sample anomaly gates (gate_IF, gate_LOF, and the conjunctive gate_ALL) at significance level delta = 0.05 over isolation forest, local outlier factor, and k-nearest-neighbor signals, we audit generated counterfactuals against held-out GMM and OCSVM detectors alongside ablation studies (gen10, gen100, and relax). items.title: Beyond the Last Loop: Reinforcement Learning with a Teacher Extrapolated from the Model Itself
items.excerpt: Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop can be read out through the shared language-model head. Post-training them with verifiable rewards is hard: the outcome reward carries one bit per response, spreading it over loops trains intermediate loops on tokens sampled from the last loop, and distillation needs either a teacher that ignores the reward or an external, larger model. We observe that a looped model already contains a teacher stronger than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELGO (Extrapolated-Loop Group-relative Optimization) adds to GRPO a dense per-token distillation term towards this distribution. The teacher is computed from an anchor copy of the model, which stays frozen and is replaced by the current model once the student's KL to the teacher falls below a threshold, so the teacher improves with the student without chasing its own extrapolation. items.title_zh: 超越最后一个循环：由模型本身推断的教师强化学习

items.title: On the Information Loss of Multi-Token Prediction: Origin and Solution
items.excerpt: Multi-token prediction (MTP) accelerates autoregressive decoding through block-wise prediction, but remains vulnerable to error accumulation across sequentially generated blocks. To investigate this limitation, we analyze the distinction between block-wise and sequence-level cumulative information loss (CIL). Specifically, when the model generates using its own previous outputs without access to reference answers, the input-conditional gap equals the cross-block dependence of the reference targets. To improve prediction when these generated prefixes are imperfect, we propose Dual-MTP, which supervises shared prediction heads under full and randomly masked contexts. Together, complete-prefix supervision and context perturbations provide complementary training signals while retaining the MTP architecture. To characterize this training objective, we use the normalized dual loss to bound the divergence between the model's predictive distributions under full and masked contexts. items.title: To Critic Or Not To Critic
items.excerpt: As large language models tackle longer and more complex tasks, understanding when a critic improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes increasingly important. Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) trains a critic to reduce variance and provide fine-grained credit assignment, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) drops the critic and avoids the bias of bootstrapping from the critic's value estimates. Although recent critic-based methods have reported strong performance relative to GRPO, it remains unclear when each approach is preferable. We argue that there is no universal answer; instead, the choice depends on several interacting factors, including batch size, critic reliance, and task complexity. We study the bias-variance tradeoff in terms of gradient direction, measuring how closely each method's gradient estimates align with the true policy gradient as batch size grows. Under a shared actor objective, we compare GRPO with PPO in control tasks, short-horizon math, and long-horizon terminal agents. items.excerpt_zh: 随着大型语言模型处理更长、更复杂的任务，理解批评家何时提高强化学习 (RL) 的效率变得越来越重要。近端策略优化 (PPO) 训练批评者减少方差并提供细粒度的信用分配，而组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 则丢弃批评者并避免从批评者的价值估计中引导的偏差。尽管最近基于批评家的方法相对于 GRPO 表现强劲，但仍不清楚每种方法何时更可取。我们认为没有普遍的答案；相反，选择取决于几个相互作用的因素，包括批量大小、评论家依赖和任务复杂性。我们研究梯度方向方面的偏差-方差权衡，测量随着批量大小的增长，每种方法的梯度估计与真实策略梯度的吻合程度。在共享参与者目标下，我们在控制任务、短视野数学和长视野终端代理方面比较 GRPO 和 PPO。在超过 1,200 次训练运行中，其中包括 96 次 LLM 训练，我们发现 PPO 通常在小批量方面处于领先地位

items.excerpt: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving, all-weather physical scene understanding across darkness, smoke, and walls. items.title: The Teacher Is Already Inside: Self-Distilling Looped Language Models Beyond Their Last Loop
items.excerpt: Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop is readable through the shared language-model head. Post-training them is hard. Reward-only reinforcement learning needs a verifier and learns from one sparse signal per response; spreading the reward over loops collapses the entropy of every loop; and cross-loop self-distillation, as in LoopOPD, can only teach intermediate loops, because the last loop cannot learn from its own frozen copy: the loss is zero at initialisation. We observe that a looped model already contains a policy that decodes better than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELPSD (Extrapolated-Loop Policy Self-Distillation) turns this distribution into a self-distillation target: a frozen copy of the model computes it, and the model's own last loop is distilled towards it on its own rollouts, using the exact reverse KL at every visited prefix. items.title: EPRO: Robust Policy Optimization Through an Imperfect Execution-Policy Predictor
items.excerpt: RL for LLMs often separates rollout generation from policy training. Although the two numerical engines share model parameters, they can induce different policies. This creates a challenge beyond correcting a known training-inference mismatch: during learner updates, the execution policy corresponding to the current parameters cannot be directly observed. We view this as optimizing an unobserved execution policy through an imperfect predictor of its evolution. This perspective raises two fundamental questions: how can we estimate the execution policy's response to learner updates, and how much should we trust that estimate when optimizing the actual execution policy? We introduce Execution-Policy Robust Optimization (EPRO) to address these challenges. Starting from the observed rollout-time execution policy, we use training-policy changes to construct a differentiable predictor of the current execution policy, whose score yields Transported Score Centering (TSC). items.excerpt: Text-to-image (T2I) models are increasingly embedded in everyday visual culture, yet little is known about how they translate abstract human values into visual scenes. We then map these prototypes onto a taxonomy of social configurations spanning setting, sociality, mode of engagement, and social register, revealing what is systematically foregrounded or omitted. items.title: RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction
items.excerpt: Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries. However, learning effective compaction jointly with the agent policy remains challenging, as summaries affect task success over many subsequent interactions. We introduce RECAP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework based on the principle that a summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history. We formalize this principle with a behavior distortion objective that measures the divergence between the agent's subsequent behavior under compressed and original contexts. We show that the gradient of the distortion objective decomposes into two complementary learning signals: distortion-based reward for summary generation and self-distillation for subsequent actions. Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that RECAP consistently outperforms the task-reward-only RL baselines on both environments, leading to an absolute improvement of 4.6% and 4.3% on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified, respectively. items.title_zh: 回顾：通过上下文压缩训练长期 LLM 代理
items.excerpt_zh: 上下文压缩使大型语言模型代理能够通过用压缩摘要替换交互历史来在有限的上下文预算内处理长期任务。然而，与代理策略一起学习有效的压缩仍然具有挑战性，因为摘要会影响许多后续交互的任务成功。我们引入了 RECAP，这是一种强化学习 (RL) 框架，其原则是摘要应保留原始交互历史引发的行为。我们用行为扭曲目标来形式化这一原则，该目标衡量智能体在压缩环境和原始环境下的后续行为之间的差异。我们表明，失真目标的梯度分解为两个互补的学习信号：用于摘要生成的基于失真的奖励和用于后续动作的自我蒸馏。 Qwen3.5-4B 上的实验表明，RECAP 在两种环境下始终优于仅任务奖励 RL 基线，在 BrowseComp-plus 和 SWE-bench Verified 上分别实现了 4.6% 和 4.3% 的绝对改进。消融进一步凸显了价值

items.title: LUCID: Statistically Grounded Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning Evaluation
items.excerpt: Cheap language-model raters grade chain-of-thought reasoning at scale, yet systematic step-rating errors can skew reasoning audits and solution rankings. We introduce LUCID (Loop for Unbiased Calibration via Inference-time Diagnosis), which pairs prompt self-correction with Design-based Supervised Learning (DSL). Without retraining or weight access, LUCID calibrates binary step ratings by aligning predicted and expert soundness rates. From a small expert-labeled set, LUCID summarizes rater bias in plain text and prompts the rater to re-grade unseen steps. For example, on PRM800K, GPT-5-mini grades too strictly, under-rating computation, verification, and late-trace steps most acutely. In one pass, LUCID shrinks GPT-5-mini's calibration gap from 7.8 to 0.9 percentage points in absolute predicted-expert rate difference. LUCID also halves false alarms (sound steps rated unsound) and lifts error-detection F1 on unsound steps by 32%. LUCID retains these gains with 1,000 diagnostic steps or overall-gap feedback alone. The loop also transfers across models and domains: it applies GPT-5-mini's bias profile to lift GLM-5.2's PRM800K accuracy,

items.title_zh: LUCID：基于统计的 LLM 推理评估自我修正
items.excerpt_zh: 廉价的语言模型评估者对思维链推理进行大规模评分，但系统性的分级错误可能会扭曲推理审核和解决方案排名。我们引入了 LUCID（通过推理时间诊断进行无偏校准的循环），它将快速自我校正与基于设计的监督学习 (DSL) 结合起来。无需重新训练或权重访问，LUCID 通过调整预测健全率和专家健全率来校准二元步评级。 LUCID 从一小部分专家标记的集合中以纯文本形式总结评估者偏差，并提示评估者重新对未见过的步骤进行评分。例如，在 PRM800K 上，GPT-5-mini 评分过于严格，严重低估了计算、验证和后期跟踪步骤。在一次通过中，LUCID 将 GPT-5-mini 的绝对预测专家速率差异的校准差距从 7.8 个百分点缩小到 0.9 个百分点。 LUCID 还将误报（声音步骤评级为不健全）减少了一半，并将不健全步骤的错误检测 F1 提高了 32%。 LUCID 仅通过 1,000 个诊断步骤或整体差距反馈就保留了这些成果。该循环还可以跨模型和域传输：它应用 GPT-5-mini 的偏差配置文件来提升 GLM-5.2 的 PRM800K 精度，

items.title: Localizing Cross-Lingual Generalization in Parameter Space
items.excerpt: Cross-lingual transfer is uneven across tasks, succeeding for natural language understanding but often failing for mathematical reasoning. We argue that this asymmetry is governed by the geometry of parameter space. Specifically, cross-lingual generalization is determined by whether English and target-language LoRA adapters share a low-error basin. To test this, we use linear mode connectivity (LMC) between English and target-language adapters, evaluating on three tasks. We find that NLI and QA model-language pairs are mostly linearly connected, whereas mathematical reasoning (Math) pairs are not, indicating that basin geometry is task-dependent. Such disconnection in Math is ``local'' rather than global. A small target-language task sample, applied only to the English adapter's language encoding or semantic composition layers, is enough to repair it. Cross-lingual generalization is also factorizable into language-specific encoding and language-agnostic composition, each supplied separately from a cheaper signal. English task data routed to the composition layers and an unlabeled target-language corpus routed to the language encoding
items.authors: Yeoreum Lee, Jaeseong Lee, Seung-won Hwang
items.title_zh: 在参数空间中本地化跨语言泛化
items.excerpt_zh: 跨语言迁移在不同任务上的表现并不均衡，在自然语言理解方面取得了成功，但在数学推理方面却常常失败。我们认为这种不对称性是由参数空间的几何形状决定的。具体来说，跨语言泛化取决于英语和目标语言 LoRA 适配器是否共享低错误盆地。为了测试这一点，我们在英语和目标语言适配器之间使用线性模式连接（LMC），对三项任务进行评估。我们发现 NLI 和 QA 模型语言对大多是线性连接的，而数学推理（数学）对则不然，这表明盆地几何形状是任务相关的。数学中的这种脱节是“局部的”而不是全局的。一个小的目标语言任务样本，仅应用于英语适配器的语言编码或语义构成层，就足以修复它。跨语言泛化还可以分解为特定于语言的编码和与语言无关的组合，每个编码都由更便宜的信号单独提供。英语任务数据路由到组合层，未标记的目标语言语料库路由到语言编码

items.title: FOL-Proof: Verifying LLM Text-to-Logic Translations via Deterministic Semantics
items.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language statements into first-order logic (FOL) to improve reasoning. However, LLMs are prone to errors, and so a semantically unfaithful FOL formula could corrupt downstream reasoning. We present FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations against independently derived linguistic interpretations. FOL-Proof operates by deterministically obtaining a pool of candidate translations via semantic analysis tools, such as the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics; then applying an SMT solver to check each derived reading for logical equivalence to the LLM-generated formula. If the translation is faithful it is accepted; otherwise, it is rejected, or optionally repaired via repeated invocations to the LLM. The procedure is conservative: incomplete search, unsupported constructions, or inconclusive checks yield abstention rather than false rejection. items.title_zh: FOL-Proof：通过确定性语义验证 LLM 文本到逻辑的翻译
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地用于将自然语言语句转换为一阶逻辑 (FOL) 以改进推理。然而，LLM 很容易出错，因此语义上不忠实的 FOL 公式可能会破坏下游推理。我们提出了 FOL-Proof，一种语义防火墙管道，可根据独立派生的语言解释来验证 LLM 生成的 FOL 翻译。 FOL-Proof 的运行方式是通过语义分析工具（例如英语资源语法和最小递归语义）确定性地获取候选翻译池；然后应用 SMT 求解器检查每个导出的读数与 LLM 生成的公式的逻辑等价性。如果翻译忠实，则被接受；否则，它会被拒绝，或者可以选择通过重复调用 LLM 来修复。该程序是保守的：不完整的搜索、不受支持的结构或不确定的检查会产生弃权而不是错误拒绝。我们根据既定基准（ProofWriter、RuleTaker 和 PrOntoQA）以及新的对抗性基准（LongFaithCheck）评估了 FOL-Proof。我们的实验

items.title: Verifiable On-Policy Distillation
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful approach for improving language-model reasoning, but its supervision is inherently sparse: a sequence-level verifier reward is propagated only through sampled trajectories and provides no direct signal for alternative actions. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a complementary form of supervision by providing dense teacher feedback over the full next-token distribution, but this signal is not grounded in verified task outcomes. Simply co-optimizing the two objectives does not couple these signals: verifier feedback remains sparse and does not inform the dense teacher supervision. We introduce Verifiable On-Policy Distillation (VOPD), which transfers sparse verifier feedback into dense, verifier-grounded supervision. Our key observation is that the implicit-reward view of OPD places teacher supervision and verifier feedback in a common reward space while retaining a reward signal available for every next-token action. items.authors: Juntong Shi, Stefano Ermon, Jure Leskovec, Minkai Xu
items.title_zh: 可验证的政策蒸馏
items.excerpt_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为改进语言模型推理的强大方法，但其监督本质上是稀疏的：序列级验证者奖励仅通过采样轨迹传播，并且不为替代动作提供直接信号。在策略蒸馏（OPD）通过对完整的下一个令牌分布提供密集的教师反馈，提供了一种补充形式的监督，但该信号并不基于经过验证的任务结果。简单地共同优化两个目标并不会耦合这些信号：验证者的反馈仍然稀疏，并且不会通知密集的教师监督。我们引入了可验证的策略蒸馏（VOPD），它将稀疏的验证者反馈转化为密集的、基于验证者的监督。我们的主要观察结果是，OPD 的隐式奖励观点将教师监督和验证者反馈置于共同的奖励空间中，同时保留每个下一个令牌操作可用的奖励信号。根据这种观点，VOPD 将验证者的偏好投射到教师的隐式奖励方向上，Rao-Blackwell 将所得信号 ov

items.title: Privacy Disclosure Control Benchmark (PDC-Bench): How Faithfully Do LLMs Keep Privacy Constraints on In-Context Disclosure Granularity?
items.excerpt: In LLM task execution, a constraint on the permitted disclosure granularity of personal attributes is sometimes imposed on the output. For example, if a person's private attribute is their location (San Francisco) and disclosure is permitted only at the country level, an output at the state level (California) violates the constraint. Detecting such violations requires capturing not only direct privacy leakage (San Francisco) but also semantic leakage (California). However, existing benchmarks cannot measure the degree of leakage with respect to a given semantic constraint such as the country-level limit. We therefore formalize disclosure control as a constraint on the permitted ceiling over the hierarchy of a knowledge graph. Building on this formulation, we construct PDC-Bench, a benchmark of 16,105 samples covering geography, age, race and ethnicity, and occupation. In our experiments applying PDC-Bench to eleven LLMs, 62% of the constraint violations were semantic leakage. items.title_zh: 隐私披露控制基准 (PDC-Bench)：法学硕士如何忠实地保持对上下文披露粒度的隐私约束？
items.excerpt_zh: 在LLM任务执行中，有时会对输出施加对允许的个人属性披露粒度的限制。例如，如果一个人的私有属性是其位置（旧金山），并且仅允许在国家/地区级别进行披露，则州/地区级别（加利福尼亚州）的输出就会违反该约束。检测此类违规行为不仅需要捕获直接的隐私泄漏（旧金山），还需要捕获语义泄漏（加利福尼亚）。然而，现有的基准无法衡量给定语义约束（例如国家级限制）的泄漏程度。因此，我们将披露控制形式化为知识图谱层次结构允许上限的约束。在此基础上，我们构建了 PDC-Bench，这是一个包含 16,105 个样本的基准，涵盖地理、年龄、种族和民族以及职业。在我们将 PDC-Bench 应用于 11 个法学硕士的实验中，62% 的约束违规是语义泄漏。我们进一步发现，语义泄漏更少依赖于模型，而更多地依赖于允许的披露粒度和任务对私有属性的需求；关于
