items.excerpt: “For far too many people—myself included—it has become an identity. That is a terrible thing. If we place such importance on the emotional dimensions of mathematics, then it should not be pursued as a profession. What direction should the future mathematics community take? […]”
items.title_zh: 我想要 MSE，而不是 MO。
items.excerpt_zh: “对于太多人来说——包括我自己——它已经成为一种身份。这是一件可怕的事情。如果我们如此重视数学的情感维度，那么它就不应该作为一种职业来追求。未来的数学界应该朝什么方向发展？[……]”

items.title: Explicit Error Term in the Chebotarev Density Theorem for Function Fields
items.excerpt: We prove an explicit error term in the Chebotarev Density Theorem for finite generically Galois \'etale morphisms of affine varieties over finite fields, under a mild condition on their size. The error term generalises the known results for curves, and depends only on invariants of the varieties. We present several applications to the explicit error term. We apply it to existence problems, and to the Bateman-Horn conjecture over finite fields.
items.title_zh: 函数域切波塔列夫密度定理中的显式误差项
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在切波塔列夫密度定理中证明了有限域上仿射簇的有限一般伽罗瓦埃塔莱态射的显式误差项，并且在其大小的温和条件下。误差项概括了曲线的已知结果，并且仅取决于品种的不变量。我们提出了显式误差项的几种应用。我们将其应用于存在问题以及有限域上的贝特曼-霍恩猜想。

items.title: The Tate Conjecture in Positive Characteristic
items.excerpt: Let $\mathcal{Z}(n)$ be Bloch's cycle complex and $\mathbb{Z}(n)^c$ be the complex that compute continuous \'etale cohomology. Kahn observed that the Tate conjecture for a finite field is equivalent to the map $\mathcal{Z}(n)\otimes\mathbb{Z}(0)^c\to\mathbb{Z}(n)^c$ being isomorphism. Later, Kahn found that the Tate conjecture for a finite field is equivalent to $\Omega_\ell(\mathbb{Z}_\ell)\in DM^{\text{eff}}_{\text{\'et}}(k)$, where $\Omega_\ell$ is the right adjoint of the $\ell$-adic realisation functor. In this note, using the Dwyer-Greenlees equivalence between $\ell$-completed objects and $\ell$-torsion objects, we prove that $\Omega_\ell(\mathbb{Z}_\ell)\in DM^{\text{eff}}_{\text{\'et}}(k)$, and consequently, based on Kahn's early work, the Tate conjecture at positive characteristics.
items.title_zh: 泰特猜想的积极特征
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\mathcal{Z}(n)$ 为布洛赫循环复数，$\mathbb{Z}(n)^c$ 为计算连续 etale 上同调的复数。卡恩观察到，有限域的泰特猜想等价于映射 $\mathcal{Z}(n)\otimes\mathbb{Z}(0)^c\to\mathbb{Z}(n)^c$ 同构。后来，卡恩发现有限域的泰特猜想等价于DM^{\text{eff}}_{\text{\'et}}(k)$中的$\Omega_\ell(\mathbb{Z}_\ell)\，其中$\Omega_\ell$是$\ell$-adic实现函子的右伴随。在这篇文章中，我们利用$\ell$-完成物体和$\ell$-扭转物体之间的Dwyer-Greenlees等价性，证明了$\Omega_\ell(\mathbb{Z}_\ell)\in DM^{\text{eff}}_{\text{\'et}}(k)$，因此，基于卡恩的早期工作，泰特猜想具有正特性。

items.title: Reduction types of curves in tame extensions
items.excerpt: Let $C/K$ be a curve of genus $g\geq 1$ over a discretely valued field $K$ with algebraically closed residue field. In this paper, we study the behaviour of the reduction type of $C$ under finite tame extensions. If $L/K$ is a tame extension of degree $n$, we give sufficient conditions on the reduction type $R$ of $C$ so that the reduction type of the base change $C_L$ is uniquely determined by $R$ and $n$. In particular, if $C$ has abelian and toric ranks zero, then $R$ satisfies these conditions. We also give an algorithm to compute the possibilities for the reduction type of $C_L$ given only $R$ and $n$. The main method involves studying harmonic covers of graphs with a cyclic action. As a result, we obtain a characterisation of tame curves with potentially good reduction in terms of their reduction type, and a new proof of a result by Liu-Lorenzini-Raynaud regarding the non-realisability of certain reduction types.
items.title_zh: 驯服延伸中曲线的简化类型
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $C/K$ 为具有代数闭留数域的离散值域 $K$ 上的亏格 $g\geq 1$ 曲线。在本文中，我们研究了有限驯服扩展下 $C$ 的约简类型的行为。如果$L/K$是度$n$的温和扩展，我们对$C$的约简类型$R$给出充分条件，使得基数变化$C_L$的约简类型由$R$和$n$唯一确定。特别是，如果 $C$ 的阿贝尔和环面秩为零，则 $R$ 满足这些条件。我们还给出了一个算法来计算仅给定 $R$ 和 $n$ 的 $C_L$ 约简类型的可能性。主要方法涉及研究具有循环作用的图的调和覆盖。结果，我们获得了驯服曲线的表征，在其归约类型方面具有潜在的良好归约，以及刘-洛伦齐尼-雷诺关于某些归约类型的不现实性的结果的新证明。

items.title: Recurrence formulas for Taylor expansions at CM points on genus-one and genus-two Shimura curves
items.excerpt: We establish a general differential equation relating the expansion of a weight-two eigenform $f$ on a Shimura curve to the Schwarzian derivative $\mathcal{R}$ associated with $f$. When the quotient $X/W$ has genus zero, we introduce a Hauptmodul $u$ and obtain a coupled system of differential equations involving $f$, $\mathcal{R}$, and $u$. Geometric information, including local constraints on the poles of $\mathcal{R}$, together with the initial coefficients of the expansion of $f$, determine all the parameters in the system. We apply this method to all twelve weight-two eigenforms on Shimura curves $X_0^N(1)$ of genus one or two, obtaining explicit recurrence formulas for their Taylor expansions at selected CM points, conditional on the numerically recognized initial coefficients. As an application, we use the coefficients obtained from the recurrence to compute the Shimura uniformization $\Phi: \operatorname{Jac}(X)\to E$ to high precision and identify a large family of CM points on the associated elliptic curves $E$.
items.title_zh: 一格和二格 Shimura 曲线上 CM 点泰勒展开式的递推公式
items.excerpt_zh: 我们建立了一个一般微分方程，将 Shimura 曲线上的权重二本征形 $f$ 的展开与与 $f$ 相关的 Schwarzian 导数 $\mathcal{R}$ 联系起来。当商 $X/W$ 亏格为零时，我们引入 Hauptmodul $u$ 并获得涉及 $f$、$\mathcal{R}$ 和 $u$ 的微分方程耦合系统。几何信息，包括 $\mathcal{R}$ 极点的局部约束，以及 $f$ 展开的初始系数，决定了系统中的所有参数。我们将此方法应用于一或二属的 Shimura 曲线 $X_0^N(1)$ 上的所有十二个权重二本征型，获得其在选定 CM 点处的泰勒展开式的显式递推公式，以数值识别的初始系数为条件。作为应用，我们使用从递归获得的系数来计算 Shimura 均匀化 $\Phi: \operatorname{Jac}(X)\to E$ 的高精度，并识别相关椭圆曲线 $E$ 上的一大群 CM 点。

items.title: Improved bounds for the binary Chowla conjecture
items.excerpt: For the M\"obius function $\mu$ and every fixed $0 < \epsilon < 1$, we prove \[ \sum_{n \le x} \mu(n) \mu(n + 1) \ll_{\epsilon} \frac{x}{(\log x)^{1 - \epsilon}}. \] This improves on OpenAI's recent bound of $x/(\log x)^c$, where $c > 0$ is a tiny absolute constant. The proof echoes the graph expansion framework of Helfgott, Radziwill, and Pilatte on the logarithmic Chowla conjecture, earlier Fourier analytic methods of Matom\"aki, Radziwill, and Tao on the Chowla conjecture on average, as well as work of Ter\"av\"ainen and the author for M\"obius on shifted primes. This also yields an improved result, \[ \sum_{p \le x} \mu(p + 2) \ll_{\epsilon} \frac{\pi(x)}{(\log x)^{1/2 - \epsilon}}. \] Specifically, we refine the determinant approach from the Poisson-Dirichlet law for prime predecessors. We replace the averaged prime weights of L\"u-Wang-Wu with an exact partition of prime intervals. Once sieving out exceptional integers, this enables uniform cancellation with arbitrary log power savings.
items.title_zh: 二元 Chowla 猜想的改进界限
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 M\"obius 函数 $\mu$ 和每个固定的 $0 < \epsilon < 1$，我们证明 \[ \sum_{n \le x} \mu(n) \mu(n + 1) \ll_{\epsilon} \frac{x}{(\log x)^{1 - \epsilon}}。 \] 这改进了 OpenAI 最近的 $x/(\log x)^c$ 边界，其中 $c > 0$ 是一个很小的边界证明与 Helfgott、Radziwill 和 Pilatte 在对数 Chowla 猜想上的图展开框架、Matom\"aki、Radziwill 和 Tai 在 Chowla 猜想上的早期傅立叶分析方法相呼应，以及 Ter\"av\"ainen 和 M\"obius 在移位素数上的工作，这也产生了改进的结果，\[ \sum_{p \le。 x} \mu(p + 2) \ll_{\epsilon} \frac{\pi(x)}{(\log x)^{1/2 - \epsilon}} 具体来说，我们改进了素数前身的泊松-狄利克雷定律的行列式方法，我们用素数区间的精确划分替换了 L\"u-Wang-Wu 的平均素数权重。一旦筛选出异常整数，就可以实现统一取消并节省任意对数功率。

items.title: Uniform counting of quadratic fields with local conditions
items.excerpt: We sharpen the uniform counting estimates of Bhargava, Thorne, and the author for quadratic fields with prescribed local conditions. Combining the Burgess and P\'olya--Vinogradov bounds, we improve the dependence of the error term on the primes supporting the local conditions and make explicit the factors previously absorbed into an arbitrary $\epsilon$-power of their product. The resulting estimate has an absolute implied constant.
items.title_zh: 因地制宜的二次域统一计数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们锐化了 Bhargava、Thorne 和作者对具有规定局部条件的二次域的统一计数估计。结合 Burgess 和 P\'olya-Vinogradov 界限，我们改善了误差项对支持局部条件的素数的依赖性，并明确了先前吸收到其乘积的任意 $\epsilon$ 幂中的因素。所得估计值具有绝对隐含常数。

items.title: Stepanov's method and uniform sumset estimates in arbitrary finite fields
items.excerpt: Let $A<\mathbb F_q^\times$ be a proper multiplicative subgroup that generates $\mathbb F_q$ over its prime field. We prove that \[ |A+A|\ge \tfrac18|A|^{3/2} \] whenever $|A|<q^{2/3}$, uniformly in the characteristic and extension degree, without quantitative restrictions on intersections with proper subfields. Moreover, in contrast with what is expected in prime fields, we show that no uniform bound with exponent larger than $5/3$ holds in $\mathbb F_q$ even for $|A| \approx q^{1/2}$. The proof's key idea is to run the prime-field Stepanov method in reverse, constructing an auxiliary polynomial whose specialization vanishes identically instead of requiring it to be nonzero.
items.authors: Albert Cochrane, Todd Cochrane, Craig Spencer
items.title_zh: Stepanov 方法和任意有限域中的均匀总和估计
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $A<\mathbb F_q^\times$ 为真乘法子群，在其素数域上生成 $\mathbb F_q$。我们证明\[ |A+A|\ge \tfrac18|A|^{3/2} \] 每当$|A|<q^{2/3}$时，在特征和扩展程度上是一致的，并且与适当子域的交集没有数量限制。此外，与素数域中的预期相反，我们表明，即使对于 $|A| ，在 $\mathbb F_q$ 中也不存在指数大于 $5/3$ 的统一界限。 \大约q^{1/2}$。该证明的关键思想是反向运行素域 Stepanov 方法，构造一个辅助多项式，其特化同样消失，而不是要求它非零。

items.title: A two-sided continued-fraction criterion for the Erd\H{o}s-Moser equation and Erd\H{o}s's 1949 problem
items.excerpt: We give a two-sided continued-fraction criterion for the Erd\H{o}s--Moser equation $1^k+2^k+\dots+(m-1)^k=m^k$. Writing $m=k/\log 2+3/2+\gamma_m/m$, Gallot, Moree and Zudilin showed that a solution yields a convergent of $\log 2/(2N)$, for a known divisor $N$ of $k$, followed by a large partial quotient. We show that an explicit two-sided estimate for $\gamma_m$, from our earlier centre-of-mass work, restricts this partial quotient, for each value of $\gcd(k/N,2m-3)$, to two consecutive values, or to three in the exceptional case that an integer lies in an explicit interval of relative length $O(1/m)$. This excludes the first index left open by their computation and, without extending their continued-fraction computation, raises the lower bound for a nontrivial solution from $m>2.71\cdot 10^{1667658416}$ to $m>6.26\cdot 10^{1667658425}$. The same criterion gives an effective form of the asymptotic results of Best and te Riele on Erd\H{o}s's 1949 problem on the largest term of $1^n+\dots+(m-1)^n$. We determine all 50 pairs $(m,n)$ with $m<10^{399}$ for which $(m-2)^n<(m-1)^n/2$ and $1^n+\dots+(m-1)^n>m^n$; in particular, the smallest e
items.title_zh: Erd\H{o}s-Moser 方程和 Erd\H{o}s 1949 问题的双边连分数准则
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出 Erd\H{o}s--Moser 方程 $1^k+2^k+\dots+(m-1)^k=m^k$ 的两侧连分数准则。 Gallot、Moree 和 Zudilin 的写作 $m=k/\log 2+3/2+\gamma_m/m$ 表明，对于 $k$ 的已知除数 $N$，后跟一个大的偏商，解会产生 $\log 2/(2N)$ 的收敛。我们证明，根据我们之前的质心工作，对 $\gamma_m$ 的显式两侧估计将 $\gcd(k/N,2m-3)$ 的每个值限制为两个连续值，或者在整数位于相对长度 $O(1/m)$ 的显式区间内的特殊情况下限制为三个。这排除了计算中留下的第一个索引，并且在不扩展连分数计算的情况下，将非平凡解的下限从 $m>2.71\cdot 10^{1667658416}$ 提高到 $m>6.26\cdot 10^{1667658425}$。同样的准则给出了 Best 和 te Riele 在 Erd\H{o}s 的 1949 年问题上关于 $1^n+\dots+(m-1)^n$ 最大项的渐近结果的有效形式。我们确定所有 50 对 $(m,n)$，其中 $m<10^{399}$，其中 $(m-2)^n<(m-1)^n/2$ 和 $1^n+\dots+(m-1)^n>m^n$；特别是，最小的 e

items.title: Foata and Spot Commutation for Parking Functions
items.excerpt: For a parking function $\alpha$, let $\mathrm{spot}(\alpha)$ be the permutation whose $i$th entry is the space occupied by car $i$ and let $\mathrm{foata}(w)$ be Foata's second fundamental transformation on words. Conjecture 6.3 of Celano et al. asserts that $\mathrm{foata}(\mathrm{spot}(\alpha)) = \mathrm{spot}(\mathrm{foata}(\alpha))$ for every unit interval parking function $\alpha$. This paper proves the identity for a larger class: parking functions where each prime component (borrowing Gessel's definition) of $\alpha$ is nondecreasing. Since every unit interval parking function is composed of nondecreasing prime parking functions, the conjecture follows. A key step is showing that $\mathrm{foata}$ preserves the set of parking functions $\alpha$ with $\mathrm{spot}(\alpha) = \mathrm{std}(\alpha)$, where $\mathrm{std}$ denotes standardization. In particular, this proves that inversion count and major index are equidistributed over this larger class.
items.title_zh: Foata 和 Spot 换向停车功能
items.excerpt_zh: 对于停车函数 $\alpha$，令 $\mathrm{spot}(\alpha)$ 为排列，其中第 $i$ 个条目是汽车 $i$ 占用的空间，并令 $\mathrm{foata}(w)$ 为 Foata 对单词的第二个基本变换。 Celano 等人的猜想 6.3断言对于每个单位间隔停车函数$\alpha$，$\mathrm{foata}(\mathrm{spot}(\alpha)) = \mathrm{spot}(\mathrm{foata}(\alpha))$。本文证明了更大类别的恒等式：停车函数，其中 $\alpha$ 的每个素数分量（借用 Gessel 的定义）都是非递减的。由于每个单位间隔停车函数都是由非减素停车函数组成，因此猜想如下。关键一步是表明 $\mathrm{foata}$ 保留了停车函数 $\alpha$ 的集合，其中 $\mathrm{spot}(\alpha) = \mathrm{std}(\alpha)$，其中 $\mathrm{std}$ 表示标准化。特别是，这证明了反转计数和主要索引在这个更大的类别中是均匀分布的。

items.title: Forsyth--Glaisher-Type Series for $1/\pi$ Involving Catalan Numbers and Harmonic Numbers
items.excerpt: We develop an elementary method for constructing and evaluating families of Forsyth--Glaisher-type series for $1/\pi$. The approach is based on Newton's generalized binomial theorem, identities for generalized binomial coefficients, and Euler's beta integral, together with properties of the gamma and digamma functions. We establish several parameterized identities involving squares of central binomial coefficients and products of odd integers, from which we derive explicit evaluations in terms of $1/\pi$. By means of transformations connecting generalized binomial coefficients with Catalan numbers, we obtain further families of series involving squares of Catalan numbers. We also derive identities for series involving harmonic and odd harmonic numbers by differentiating suitable parameter-dependent formulas. These results yield evaluations containing both $1/\pi$ and logarithmic terms, particularly $\ln 2$. Our results provide a unified framework for generating and evaluating related binomial and Catalan-type series and reveal connections among central binomial coefficients, Catalan numbers, and harmonic numbers.
items.authors: Kunle Adegoke, Robert Frontczak, Taras Goy
items.title_zh: Forsyth--Glaisher 型系列，价格为 1/\pi$，涉及加泰罗尼亚数和调和数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了一种基本方法，用于构建和评估 Forsyth--Glaisher 型系列的族，价格为 $1/\pi$。该方法基于牛顿广义二项式定理、广义二项式系数恒等式和欧拉 beta 积分，以及 gamma 和 digamma 函数的属性。我们建立了几个参数化恒等式，涉及中心二项式系数的平方和奇数整数的乘积，从中我们得出以 $1/\pi$ 为单位的显式评估。通过将广义二项式系数与加泰罗尼亚数连接起来的变换，我们获得了涉及加泰罗尼亚数平方的更多级数族。我们还通过微分合适的参数相关公式来导出涉及谐波和奇次谐波数的级数的恒等式。这些结果产生包含 $1/\pi$ 和对数项的评估，特别是 $\ln 2$。我们的结果为生成和评估相关二项式和加泰罗尼亚型级数提供了统一的框架，并揭示了中心二项式系数、加泰罗尼亚数和调和数之间的联系。

items.title: Short Paper No. 2: Relations between integer sequences A003622 $\&$ A035336 and two criteria in respect of maximum degrees within the family of finite linear Jaco graphs
items.excerpt: This paper establishes two relationships between integer sequences and the maximum degrees of finite linear Jaco graphs $J_n(x)$. First, it characterizes the positive maximum degrees that occur exactly once within the family, showing that they are generated by the integer sequence A003622. Second, it determines the orders of the corresponding graphs and establishes their relationship with the integer sequence A035336. These results resolve conjectures previously stated in [5]. The proofs were developed with the assistance of AI-based mathematical reasoning technology and subsequently reviewed by the authors.
items.title_zh: 短文第 2 号：整数序列 A003622 $\&$ A035336 与有限线性 Jaco 图族内最大度数的两个准则之间的关系
items.excerpt_zh: 本文建立了整数序列与有限线性 Jaco 图 $J_n(x)$ 最大度之间的两种关系。首先，它描述了族中恰好出现一次的正最大度数，表明它们是由整数序列 A003622 生成的。其次，确定相应图的阶并建立它们与整数序列A035336的关系。这些结果解决了先前在[5]中所述的猜想。这些证明是在基于人工智能的数学推理技术的帮助下开发的，随后由作者进行审查。

items.title: The Rotation Strategy Wins Penney's game for Permutations
items.excerpt: In Penney's game for permutations, two players choose distinct patterns of the same length $k$, and independent random variables with a common continuous distribution are observed until the relative order of $k$ consecutive observations matches one of the patterns; the player who chose that pattern wins. Elizalde and Lin conjectured that the second player wins with probability greater than one half by answering the pattern $a_1a_2\cdots a_k$ with its rotation $a_ka_1\cdots a_{k-1}$. We prove that this conjecture holds for every $k\ge3$. We also show that for $k\ge8$ the rotation wins with probability at least $1/2+0.0053/(k+1)$. The proof writes the advantage of the second player in terms of clusters, which are chains of overlapping marked occurrences of the two patterns weighted by $\pm1$. We show that, for each ordering of the observations, the weights of its clusters sum to $-1$, $0$, or $1$. This gives an explicit bound on the contribution of arbitrarily long clusters, which proves the result analytically for $k\ge8$, and exact rational computations prove it for $3\le k\le7$.
items.title_zh: 轮换策略赢得了 Penney 的排列游戏
items.excerpt_zh: 在 Penney 的排列游戏中，两个玩家选择相同长度 $k$ 的不同模式，并观察具有共同连续分布的独立随机变量，直到 $k$ 连续观察值的相对顺序与其中一个模式匹配；选择该模式的玩家获胜。 Elizalde 和 Lin 推测第二个玩家通过回答模式 $a_1a_2\cdots a_k$ 及其旋转 $a_ka_1\cdots a_{k-1}$ 获胜的概率大于二分之一。我们证明这个猜想对于每个 $k\ge3$ 都成立。我们还表明，对于 $k\ge8$，轮换获胜的概率至少为 $1/2+0.0053/(k+1)$。该证明以簇的形式描述了第二个玩家的优势，簇是由 $\pm1$ 加权的两个模式的重叠标记出现的链。我们表明，对于观察的每个排序，其簇的权重总和为 $-1$、$0$ 或 $1$。这给出了任意长簇的贡献的显式界限，从而分析证明了 $k\ge8$ 的结果，并且精确有理计算证明了 $3\le k\le7$ 的结果。

items.title: Combinatorial Zeta Functions of Type $\widetilde A_2$
items.excerpt: We develop a combinatorial zeta theory for finite colored triangular complexes $X$ whose vertex links satisfy a local hexagon condition. Their edge and chamber zeta functions $Z_1(X,u)$ and $Z_2(X,u)$ are Euler products over primitive closed geodesics. The M\"obius functions of the augmented local incidence posets define a vertex polynomial $M(X,u)$. We prove the identity $\frac{Z_1(X,u)}{Z_2(X,-u)} = (1-u^3)^{\chi(X)}M(X,u)^{-1}$, where $\chi(X)$ is the Euler characteristic of $X$. The proof reconstructs the cohomological operator framework for finite $\mathrm{PGL}_3$ quotients from the local link data: the degree operators recover the three determinant factors and together form a cochain map homotopic to multiplication by $1-u^3$. Sylvester's identity gives the resulting alternating determinant relation directly. All constructions use only the finite incidence structure of $X$; no ambient group, field, or building is required.
items.title_zh: $\widetilde A_2$ 类型的组合 Zeta 函数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为有限彩色三角形复合体 $X$ 开发了一种组合 zeta 理论，其顶点链接满足局部六边形条件。它们的边缘和腔 zeta 函数 $Z_1(X,u)$ 和 $Z_2(X,u)$ 是原始闭合测地线上的欧拉积。增广局部关联偏序集的 M\"obius 函数定义了一个顶点多项式 $M(X,u)$。我们证明了恒等式 $\frac{Z_1(X,u)}{Z_2(X,-u)} = (1-u^3)^{\chi(X)}M(X,u)^{-1}$，其中 $\chi(X)$ 是 $X$ 的欧拉特征。证明重构了上同调算子框架来自本地链接数据的有限 $\mathrm{PGL}_3$ 商：度运算符恢复三个行列式因子，并一起形成与 $1-u^3$ 相乘的 cochain 映射同伦，直接给出所得的交替行列式关系。所有构造仅使用 $X$ 的有限关联结构，不需要环境组、场或建筑物。

items.title: Quadratic periods and preperiods in subtraction games with one varying move
items.excerpt: We give two infinite families of counterexamples to Zhang's conjectures on the period and preperiod of the Sprague-Grundy sequence when a single move c is adjoined to a fixed subtraction set S. For S = {4,5,10} and c = 15t+13 with t >= 2, the least period is c+19 and the least preperiod is (c^2+21c+8)/15. For S = {3,7,10} and c = 90t+9 with t >= 1, the least period is (c^2+26c+615)/30 and the least preperiod is 19 less than the period. The latter quadratic period also occurs in the outcome sequence, which is periodic from its first term. The proofs construct the sequences from fixed words and reduce the mex recurrence to a finite table of local identities.
items.authors: Ruiqi Zhao, Qi Zhang, Zhihao Shi
items.title_zh: 一步变化的减法游戏中的二次周期和预周期
items.excerpt_zh: 当单个移动 c 与固定减法集 S 邻接时，我们给出了张关于 Sprague-Grundy 序列的周期和前期的猜想的两个无限系列反例。对于 S = {4,5,10} 和 c = 15t+13 且 t >= 2，最小周期为 c+19，最小前期为 (c^2+21c+8)/15。对于 S = {3,7,10} 和 c = 90t+9（t >= 1），最小周期为 (c^2+26c+615)/30，最小前期比周期小 19。后一个二次周期也出现在结果序列中，该序列从第一项开始就是周期性的。证明从固定单词构建序列，并将 mex 递归减少到局部恒等式的有限表。

items.title: Face-neighbourly polyhedra with eight or nine faces and genus at most three
items.excerpt: A polyhedral surface is face-neighbourly if every pair of faces shares an edge. We classify the combinatorial types of closed orientable face-neighbourly polyhedral surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$ with eight or nine faces and genus at most three, assuming trivalent vertices, simple planar polygonal faces and distinct supporting planes for adjacent faces. Several common edges between a pair of faces are allowed. The enumeration gives 42,124 candidate maps with eight faces and 203 with nine. SAT certificates exclude all but two maps, both of genus three with eight nonagonal faces. They are realised by Mizhaev's V2 and by the R\"ost--V\'igh polyhedron. With the face-neighbourliness condition removed, the class of genus-three surfaces with eight nonagonal faces has one additional realisable type, Mizhaev's V1.
items.title_zh: 面邻多面体，有八个或九个面，属最多三个
items.excerpt_zh: 如果每对面共享一条边，则多面体曲面是面相邻的。我们对 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中具有八个或九个面且最多三个的闭合可定向面邻多面体曲面的组合类型进行分类，假设三价顶点、简单的平面多边形面和相邻面的不同支撑平面。一对面之间允许存在多个公共边。枚举给出了 42,124 个有 8 个面孔的候选地图和 203 个有 9 个面孔的候选地图。 SAT 证书不包括除两张地图之外的所有地图，这两张地图都是三属的，有八个九角形面。它们由 Mizhaev 的 V2 和 R\"ost--V\'igh 多面体实现。去掉面邻接条件后，具有八个九角面的属三曲面类又多了一种可实现的类型，即 Mizhaev 的 V1。

items.title: Externally supported independence in split and proper interval graphs
items.excerpt: An independent set $B$ in a graph $G=(V,E)$ satisfying the additional condition that the vertices in $N(B)$ are dominated by vertices in $V(G) \setminus N[B]$ is called an externally supported independent set (ESI-set for short). The maximum cardinality of such a set in $G$ is called externally supported independence number of $G$. We study the externally supported independence number in split graphs and proper interval graphs, two graph classes with unbounded clique-width. For split graphs we investigate the structure and computational complexity of the ESI Set problem. We prove that the ESI Set problem remains NP-complete when restricted to split graphs, while also establishing simple upper and lower bounds for the externally supported independence number. These bounds are sharp for a wide range of split graphs. For split graphs, we further investigate the relationship between the externally supported independence number and the isolation number. In particular, we characterize when an optimal ESI-set yields an optimal isolating set, and conversely, when an optimal isolating set yields an optimal ESI-set. Finally, we consider proper
items.authors: Dragana Bo\v{z}ovi\'c, Tanja Dravec, Aleksander Kelenc
items.title_zh: 外部支持分割图和适当区间图中的独立性
items.excerpt_zh: 图$G=(V,E)$中的独立集$B$，满足$N(B)$中的顶点受$V(G)\setminus N[B]$中的顶点支配的附加条件，称为外部支持独立集（简称ESI集）。 $G$中这样一个集合的最大基数称为$G$的外部支持独立数。我们研究分裂图和适当区间图（两个具有无限团宽度的图类）中的外部支持的独立数。对于分割图，我们研究 ESI 集问题的结构和计算复杂性。我们证明，当限制于分割图时，ESI 集问题仍然是 NP 完全问题，同时还为外部支持的独立数建立了简单的上限和下限。这些界限对于各种分割图来说都是尖锐的。对于分割图，我们进一步研究外部支持的独立数和隔离数之间的关系。特别是，我们表征最佳 ESI 集何时产生最佳隔离集，以及相反，最佳隔离集何时产生最佳 ESI 集。最后，我们考虑适当的

items.title: Raynaud and Gruson's flattening techniques in Berkovich geometry
items.excerpt: Raynaud and Gruson introduced a flattening procedure for coherent sheaf in the schemes context that rely on sophisticated techniques of algebra and geometry. These methods were later used by Raynaud, Bosch and L\"utkebohmert in formal geometry, and more recently Ducros has developed analogous tools for Berkovich spaces. However, it should be noted that the expression "flattening by blowing up" is, in this context, a little abusive because the flattening process actually requires a succession of blow up and quasi-\'etale morphisms. The aim of this article is to develop a local flattening technique in Berkovich geometry, in the boundaryless case, which only involves blow up.
items.title_zh: 伯科维奇几何中雷诺和格鲁森的展平技术
items.excerpt_zh: 雷诺和格鲁森在依赖于复杂的代数和几何技术的方案上下文中引入了相干束的展平过程。这些方法后来被 Raynaud、Bosch 和 L\"utkebohmert 在形式几何中使用，最近 Ducros 为 Berkovich 空间开发了类似的工具。然而，应该注意的是，在这种情况下，“通过爆炸展平”这个表达有点滥用，因为展平过程实际上需要一系列的爆炸和准 etale 态射。本文的目的是在 Berkovich 空间中开发一种局部展平技术几何，在无边界情况下，只涉及爆炸。

items.title: Spaces of ratios of schemes and \'etale cohomology
items.excerpt: We introduce the arithmetic topologies on the spaces of ratios for log schemes and prove the basic properties of their cohomologies.
items.authors: Kazuya Kato, Chikara Nakayama, Sampei Usui
items.title_zh: 格式比空间和 etale 上同调
items.excerpt_zh: 我们介绍了对数格式的比率空间上的算术拓扑，并证明了它们的上同调的基本性质。

items.title: On the tensor product of semistable Hermitian adelic vector bundles over an adelic curve
items.excerpt: We prove tensor semistability for Hermitian adelic vector bundles on proper adelic curves whose underlying fields are countable and of characteristic zero. The central estimate concerns the canonical integral Specht lattice of a rectangular partition with fixed height: its logarithmic covolume, divided by its rank and tensor degree, tends to zero. We prove this estimate from monic seminormal norms and an exact hypergeometric law weighted by the square of a Vandermonde product for tableau prefixes. Constant adelic Specht bundles and equivariant contractions then yield the slope inequality for every geometrically semistable subspace of a finite tensor product. The correction is the measure of the Archimedean places times a sublinear Specht term and vanishes in the limit as the auxiliary degree tends to infinity. An instability-filtration argument completes the reduction to arbitrary factors and identifies the tensor product Harder--Narasimhan filtration. The number field specialization gives the Bost tensor semistability conjecture in all ranks.
items.title_zh: 关于 adelic 曲线上半稳定 Hermitian adelic 向量束的张量积
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了 Hermitian adelic 向量束在真 adelic 曲线上的张量半稳定性，该曲线的基础场是可数的且特征为零。中心估计涉及具有固定高度的矩形分区的规范积分 Specht 格子：其对数余体积除以其秩和张量度，趋向于零。我们根据 monic 半正规范数和由 Tableau 前缀的 Vandermonde 乘积平方加权的精确超几何定律证明了这一估计。然后，恒定的adelic Specht丛和等变收缩产生有限张量积的每个几何半稳定子空间的斜率不等式。校正是阿基米德位置的度量乘以次线性 Specht 项，并且随着辅助度趋于无穷大而在极限中消失。不稳定性过滤论证完成了对任意因子的简化，并确定了张量积 Harder-Narasimhan 过滤。数域专门化给出了所有等级的 Bost 张量半稳定性猜想。

items.title: Stably irrational algebraically elliptic Fano threefolds
items.excerpt: We establish algebraic ellipticity in the sense of Gromov of a general hypersurface of bidegree $(2,2)$ in $\mathbb P^2\times\mathbb P^2$. According to a theorem of B\"ohning and Graf von Bothmer, a very general such hypersurface is a stably irrational Fano threefold.
items.title_zh: 稳定无理代数椭圆 Fano 三重
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在 $\mathbb P^2\times\mathbb P^2$ 中建立二度 $(2,2)$ 一般超曲面的格罗莫夫意义上的代数椭圆性。根据 B\"ohning 和 Graf von Bothmer 的定理，一个非常普遍的超曲面是一个稳定的无理法诺三重曲面。

items.title: Arithmetic jet stacks
items.excerpt: We construct a stack, which generalizes the notion of the arithmetic jet space functor constructed by Borger using the generalized Witt vector constructions. A priori we con- struct the jet space functor for prestacks, consequently showing that this functor preserves stacks. We then proceed to show the representability of the jet space functor applied to a representable morphism of stacks thereby showing that the jet space functor preserves algebraic and Deligne-Mumford Stacks. We also discuss the properties of morphisms preserved under the jet functor
items.title_zh: 算术喷射堆栈
items.excerpt_zh: 我们构造了一个堆栈，它概括了 Borger 使用广义维特向量构造构造的算术射流空间函子的概念。我们先验地为叠前构造了射流空间函子，从而表明该函子保留了叠层。然后，我们继续展示射流空间函子应用于可表示的堆栈态射的可表示性，从而表明射流空间函子保留了代数堆栈和德利涅-芒福德堆栈。我们还讨论了在射流函子下保留的态射的性质

items.title: Tannakian Brill-Noether theory of nodal curves
items.excerpt: Using the Tannakian categories arising from convolutions of perverse sheaves on semi-abelian varieties, we can associate to any subvariety of a semi-abelian variety a reductive group together with a representation. We compute these groups and representations for Brill-Noether varieties of all curves whose generalized Jacobian is semi-abelian, in particular for nodal curves. We also obtain new results on the dimension and non-degeneracy of these Brill-Noether varieties.
items.title_zh: 节点曲线的坦纳克布里尔-诺特理论
items.excerpt_zh: 使用由半阿贝尔簇上反常滑轮的卷积产生的坦纳克类别，我们可以将半阿贝尔簇的任何子簇关联到一个还原群和一个表示。我们计算所有广义雅可比行列式为半阿贝尔曲线的 Brill-Noether 变体的这些群和表示，特别是对于节点曲线。我们还获得了有关这些 Brill-Noether 变体的尺寸和非简并性的新结果。

items.title: Torrelli's Question for Isolated Hypersurface Singularities
items.excerpt: Torrelli asked whether the class $[1/f]$ belongs to the intersection homology $\mathcal{D}$-module of a hypersurface if and only if $-1$ is a simple root of its local Bernstein-Sato polynomial. We prove this equivalence for isolated hypersurface germs with $2\le n\le 4$ variables, and we construct isolated counterexamples with $n$ variables for every $n\ge 5$. In fact a counterexample with $[1/f]\in\mathrm{IC}_D$ and $\mathrm{mult}_{s=-1}b_f(s)=r\ge 2$ always needs at least $r+3$ variables. The counterexamples modify a three-variable example of Saito and adjoin suitable pure powers in the new variables. We also show that a counterexample polynomial in $n$ variables needs at least $n+1$ monomials, and we record further cases in which the equivalence holds.
items.title_zh: 托雷利关于孤立超曲面奇点的问题
items.excerpt_zh: Torrelli 询问类 $[1/f]$ 是否属于超曲面的交集同调 $\mathcal{D}$ 模，当且仅当 $-1$ 是其局部 Bernstein-Sato 多项式的简单根。我们证明了具有 $2\le n\le 4$ 个变量的孤立超表面细菌的等价性，并且我们为每个 $n\ge 5$ 构造了具有 $n$ 变量的孤立反例。事实上，$[1/f]\in\mathrm{IC}_D$ 和 $\mathrm{mult}_{s=-1}b_f(s)=r\ge 2$ 的反例总是需要至少 $r+3$ 变量。反例修改了 Saito 的三变量示例，并在新变量中加入适当的纯幂。我们还表明，$n$ 变量中的反例多项式至少需要 $n+1$ 个单项式，并且我们记录了等式成立的更多情况。

items.title: Finite abelian groups acting on rationally connected threefolds III: Classification
items.excerpt: We complete the classification of finite abelian groups that admit a faithful action on a rationally connected threefold. For a finite abelian group $G$ with invariant factors $1<d_1\mid\cdots\mid d_s$, put $c(G)=\sum_i(1-1/d_i)$. We prove that for $1\le n\le3$ such a group admits a faithful action on a rationally connected variety of dimension $n$ if and only if $c(G)\le n$. We also show that finite abelian subgroups of the Cremona group of rank three are, up to isomorphism, precisely the products of finite abelian subgroups of the Cremona groups of ranks one and two. Four further groups can act faithfully on rationally connected threefolds. For each of these groups, the faithful action is unique up to birational conjugacy and automorphism of the acting group.
items.title_zh: 作用于有理相连三元的有限阿贝尔群 III：分类
items.excerpt_zh: 我们完成了有限阿贝尔群的分类，该群承认有理连接的三元组上的忠实行为。对于具有不变因子 $1<d_1\mid\cdots\mid d_s$ 的有限交换群 $G$，输入 $c(G)=\sum_i(1-1/d_i)$。我们证明，对于 $1\le n\le3$，当且仅当 $c(G)\le n$ 时，这样的群承认在有理连接的维度 $n$ 上有忠实的行动。我们还证明，三阶克雷莫纳群的有限阿贝尔子群在同构之前，正是一阶和二阶克雷莫纳群的有限阿贝尔子群的乘积。另外四个群体可以忠实地在理性连接的三重上行动。对于这些群体中的每一个，忠实的行动都是独特的，直到行动群体的双有理共轭和自同构。

items.title: Geometric foundations of mesoscopic nucleation theory: commutativity of kinetic and probabilistic reduction for the Dean-Kawasaki equation
items.excerpt: The reduction of a stochastic field equation to a few degrees of freedom is a central problem in many areas of physics, applied mathematics and engineering. In this work we present two routes for the dimensional reduction of conservative stochastic partial differential equations of Dean-Kawasaki type. To our knowledge, such reductions have always been carried out at the level of the trajectories, i.e. on Dean's equation, and never at the level of the probability distribution, i.e. on Kawasaki's equation. The first route starts from the parametrisation of the density introduced by Lutsko [J. F. Lutsko, J. Chem. Phys. 136, 034509 (2012)], who imposed it on the field equation and obtained stochastic equations for the order parameters by integrating against a suitable weight. The second route, which reduces Kawasaki's equation, is new. This route averages the functional forward Kolmogorov equation over the fast transverse degrees of freedom, using Fermi tubular coordinates around the manifold. Since the equations of Dean and Kawasaki are formally equivalent, one would expect both reductions to be equivalent as well. We show that this is n
items.title_zh: 介观成核理论的几何基础：Dean-Kawasaki 方程的动力学和概率约简交换律
items.excerpt_zh: 将随机场方程简化为几个自由度是物理学、应用数学和工程学许多领域的中心问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了 Dean-Kawasaki 型保守随机偏微分方程降维的两种途径。据我们所知，这种减少始终是在轨迹层面（即迪安方程）进行的，而不是在概率分布层面（即川崎方程）进行的。第一条路线从 Lutsko 引入的密度参数化开始 [J. F.卢茨科，J.化学。物理。 136, 034509 (2012)]，他将其施加到场方程上，并通过针对合适的权重进行积分，获得了阶次参数的随机方程。第二条路线是新的，它减少了川崎方程。该路线使用流形周围的费米管坐标对快速横向自由度上的函数正演柯尔莫哥洛夫方程进行平均。由于 Dean 和 Kawasaki 的方程在形式上是等价的，因此人们会期望这两种简化也都是等价的。我们证明这是 n

items.title: Epidemic random model under vaccination regime and non-permanent immunity driven by time-changed Levy noise
items.excerpt: A random version of the Susceptible-Infected-Recovered-Vaccinated (SIRV) epidemic model with non-permanent immunity and a population of non-constant size is studied. The compartments satisfy a system of differential equations in which the contact rate is a random coefficient, and the contact rate itself is driven by a stochastic differential equation with time-changed Levy noise. This noise is constructed from a conditional Brownian motion and a doubly stochastic Poisson random field, both governed by a stochastic clock. When the clock is independent of the Brownian and Poisson components, the two parts of the noise are a time-changed Brownian motion and a time-changed Poisson random measure. The equation for the contact rate decouples from the compartment equations and enters them as a random parameter, which allows the compartments to be treated pathwise. The existence, uniqueness, and positivity of the global solution are proven, and the basic reproduction number of the model is shown to be random. Furthermore, sufficient conditions for extinction and persistence in mean of the disease are derived. The conditions are expressed in t
items.authors: Giulia Di Nunno, Jasmina Djordjevic, Nenad Suvak
items.title_zh: 疫苗接种制度下的流行病随机模型和时变Levy噪声驱动的非永久免疫
items.excerpt_zh: 研究了具有非永久免疫力和非恒定规模群体的易感感染者恢复疫苗（SIRV）流行病模型的随机版本。隔室满足微分方程组，其中接触率是随机系数，并且接触率本身由具有时变 Levy 噪声的随机微分方程驱动。该噪声由条件布朗运动和双随机泊松随机场构成，两者均受随机时钟控制。当时钟独立于布朗和泊松分量时，噪声的两部分是时变布朗运动和时变泊松随机测量。接触率方程与隔室方程解耦，并将它们作为随机参数输入，这允许按路径处理隔室。证明了全局解的存在性、唯一性和正性，并证明了模型的基本再生数是随机的。此外，还得出了该疾病灭绝和持续存在的充分条件。条件表示为 t

items.title: Fermat costs and path-dependent first-passage percolation
items.excerpt: We introduce a path-dependent and space-inhomogeneous first-passage percolation (FPP) model in the continuum. Inspired by Euclidean FPP, it is defined through a sample of points drawn from a common density function on a Riemannian manifold. In Euclidean FPP, the cost of each step in a discrete path is given by its length raised to the power $\alpha>1$. In our model, the power $\alpha$ increases as the path progresses, governed by a control mechanism. Consequently, the resulting percolation cost is not a distance. However, we prove a shape theorem showing that, as the number of points goes to infinity, the percolation costs converge to deterministic space-time integrals along curves in the manifold. This limit defines a quasi-distance with the property that traversing a curve from a high-density region towards a low-density one is generally cheaper than in the reverse direction; thus highlighting its potential use in machine learning applications.
items.authors: Sandro Gallo, Matthieu Jonckheere, Alejandro H. Wences
items.title_zh: 费马成本和路径相关的首代渗透
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在连续体中引入了路径相关且空间不均匀的首通道渗流（FPP）模型。受欧几里得 FPP 的启发，它是通过从黎曼流形上的公共密度函数抽取的点样本来定义的。在欧几里得 FPP 中，离散路径中每个步骤的成本由其长度的 $\alpha>1$ 次方给出。在我们的模型中，功率 $\alpha$ 随着路径的进展而增加，由控制机制控制。因此，产生的渗透成本不是距离。然而，我们证明了一个形状定理，表明随着点的数量趋向无穷大，渗透成本沿着流形中的曲线收敛到确定性时空积分。该极限定义了一种准距离，其具有以下特性：从高密度区域向低密度区域穿过曲线通常比相反方向更便宜；从而强调了它在机器学习应用中的潜在用途。

items.title: Tight Lipschitz Hardness for Solving Random Polynomial Equations
items.excerpt: We consider the problem of solving $n$ polynomial equations in $d$ real variables: $F_1({\boldsymbol x})=0, \ldots, F_n({\boldsymbol x})=0$, with unknowns ${\boldsymbol x}=(x_1, \ldots, x_d)$ satisfying the normalization constraint $\|{\boldsymbol x}\|=1$, when the polynomials are i.i.d. realization of a rotationally invariant Gaussian process. In previous work (Montanari, Subag, 2023), we developed an iterative algorithm that attempts to minimize the energy function $H({\boldsymbol x})=\|{\boldsymbol F}({\boldsymbol x})\|^2/2$ (with ${\boldsymbol F}({\boldsymbol x})=(F_i({\boldsymbol x}):i\le n)$), using first and second order information (gradient and Hessian of $H$) at a sequence of query points ${\boldsymbol x}_1, \ldots, {\boldsymbol x}_k$. Here, we prove a lower bound on the minimum energy achieved by any algorithm that is Lipschitz continuous in the coefficients of the polynomials $F_i$. We prove that the lower bound matches the the energy achieved by the algorithm in (Montanari, Subag, 2023), hence characterizing the degree of accuracy to which the system of equations ${\boldsymbol F}({\boldsymbol x})={\boldsymbol 0}$ can be s
items.title_zh: 用于求解随机多项式方程的紧 Lipschitz 硬度
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑在$d$实数变量中求解$n$多项式方程的问题：$F_1({\boldsymbol x})=0, \ldots, F_n({\boldsymbol x})=0$，未知数${\boldsymbol x}=(x_1, \ldots, x_d)$满足归一化约束$\|{\boldsymbol x}\|=1$，当多项式为i.i.d.旋转不变高斯过程的实现。在之前的工作中（Montanari, Subag, 2023），我们开发了一种迭代算法，尝试最小化能量函数 $H({\boldsymbol x})=\|{\boldsymbol F}({\boldsymbol x})\|^2/2$ （其中 ${\boldsymbol F}({\boldsymbol x})=(F_i({\boldsymbol x}):i\le n)$)，在一系列查询点 ${\boldsymbol x}_1, \ldots, {\boldsymbol x}_k$ 处使用一阶和二阶信息（$H$ 的梯度和 Hessian）。在这里，我们证明了多项式 $F_i$ 的系数中 Lipschitz 连续的任何算法所实现的最小能量的下界。我们证明下界与 (Montanari, Subag, 2023) 中算法实现的能量相匹配，因此表征了方程组 ${\boldsymbol F}({\boldsymbol x})={\boldsymbol 0}$ 可以达到的准确程度

items.title: Limit distributions and bootstrap for smooth adapted Wasserstein distances
items.excerpt: In this paper, we provide limit theorems for the Gaussian-smoothed adapted Wasserstein distances. Let $\widehat{\mu}_n$ be the empirical measure of independent paths with law $\mu$ on $(\mathbb{R}^d)^T$. Let $P = \mu * \gamma_\sigma$ and $P_n = \widehat{\mu}_n * \gamma_\sigma$, where $\gamma_\sigma = N(0,\sigma^2 I_{dT})$ is a Gaussian measure with mean zero and covariance matrix $\sigma^2 I_{dT}$. We first assume that $\mu$ is compactly supported. For every $1 < p < \infty$ and fixed $d, T$, and $\sigma > 0$, we show that $\sqrt{n}\,\mathrm{AW}_p(P_n,P) \Rightarrow Q_{P,p}(G)^{1/p}$, where $G$ is the Gaussian limit of the density fluctuation and $Q_{P,p}$ is the minimum adapted $p$-energy for the linearized continuity equation. We prove full-path bootstrap consistency and the convergence of the first and $p$-th moments. The limit and the bootstrap hold for noncompact laws as well, for all $1 < p < \infty$ under appropriate tail and structural conditions. For two-sided bounded density perturbations of strongly log-concave laws, the bandwidth is not restricted for $1 < p \le 2$. For $p > 2$, we give sufficient tail conditions and provi
items.title_zh: 平滑适应 Wasserstein 距离的极限分布和引导程序
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们提供了高斯平滑自适应 Wasserstein 距离的极限定理。令 $\widehat{\mu}_n$ 为在 $(\mathbb{R}^d)^T$ 上具有定律 $\mu$ 的独立路径的经验测度。设 $P = \mu * \gamma_\sigma$ 和 $P_n = \widehat{\mu}_n * \gamma_\sigma$，其中 $\gamma_\sigma = N(0,\sigma^2 I_{dT})$ 是均值为零和协方差矩阵 $\sigma^2 I_{dT}$ 的高斯测度。我们首先假设 $\mu$ 是紧支持的。对于每个 $1 < p < \infty$ 和固定 $d、T$ 和 $\sigma > 0$，我们表明 $\sqrt{n}\,\mathrm{AW}_p(P_n,P) \Rightarrow Q_{P,p}(G)^{1/p}$，其中 $G$ 是密度涨落的高斯极限，$Q_{P,p}$ 是最小适应 $p$-能量为线性化连续性方程。我们证明了全路径引导一致性以及第一个时刻和第 $p$ 个时刻的收敛性。对于所有 $1 < p < \infty$ 在适当的尾部和结构条件下，极限和引导程序也适用于非紧定律。对于强对数凹定律的两侧有界密度扰动，带宽不受 $1 < p \le 2$ 的限制。对于 $p > 2$，我们给出足够的尾部条件并提供

items.title: The shortest figure-eight geodesics on random hyperbolic surfaces
items.excerpt: We consider primitive unoriented figure-eight geodesics on a closed hyperbolic surface of genus $g$ sampled from Weil--Petersson measure. The shortest of these geodesics realizes the non-simple systole. He, Shen, Wu and Xue proved that its length is tight after centering at $a_g=\log g-\log\log g$. We prove that, as $g\to\infty$, the point process of centered lengths converges to a Poisson process on $\mathbb R$ with intensity $e^s\,ds/(8\pi^2)$. Its first arrival gives a reflected Gumbel limit for the centered systole $M_g$. We also prove convergence of the marked process in which each figure-eight carries the three cuff lengths of its supporting pair of pants, normalized by their sum. In the limiting process, the third cuff accounts for half the perimeter. The two winding cuffs, ordered at random, divide the other half uniformly. These splits are independent across points and independent of the limiting lengths. Uniform exponential bounds on both tails of $M_g$ give convergence of all fixed polynomial moments. At the critical exponent $-1$, we obtain $\mathbb E_g e^{-M_g}\sim(\log g)/(16\pi^2)$.
items.title_zh: 随机双曲曲面上最短的 8 字形测地线
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑从 Weil-Petersson 测度采样的属 $g$ 的闭合双曲曲面上的原始无向八字形测地线。这些测地线中最短的一条实现了非简单收缩。 He、Shen、Wu、Xue证明了以$a_g=\log g-\log\log g$为中心后它的长度是紧的。我们证明，随着$g\to\infty$，中心长度的点过程收敛到$\mathbb R$上的泊松过程，强度为$e^s\,ds/(8\pi^2)$。它的第一次到达给出了中心收缩 $M_g$ 的反映 Gumbel 极限。我们还证明了标记过程的收敛性，其中每个 8 字形都带有其支撑裤子的三个袖口长度，并通过它们的总和进行归一化。在限制过程中，第三个袖口占周长的一半。两个缠绕袖口，随机排列，均匀地划分另一半。这些分割在点之间是独立的，并且与限制长度无关。 $M_g$ 两个尾部的均匀指数界给出了所有固定多项式矩的收敛。在临界指数$-1$处，我们得到$\mathbb E_g e^{-M_g}\sim(\log g)/(16\pi^2)$。

items.title: Exact almost sure scale for non-negative stochastic recursions
items.excerpt: We study exact almost sure scale for non-negative stochastic recursions whose conditional mean consists of a linear term and a signed adapted perturbation. The linear term determines a product normalization, but convergence after normalization does not ensure a strictly positive limit. Multiplying the state by the inverse of each deterministic contraction factor gives a contraction-adjusted state. On paths where this state tends to infinity, we prove that the logarithm of the normalized state differs from the cumulative relative perturbation by an almost surely convergent quantity. The assumptions control the effective step sizes, the quadratic positive relative perturbation, and the conditional quadratic variation of the relative martingale noise. If the positive perturbation is summable at the normalized scale, the normalized process converges to a finite non-negative limit; strict positivity is then equivalent to absolute summability of the relative perturbation. We also give criteria for divergence of the contraction-adjusted state, first-order comparisons, and counterexamples illustrating the role of the hypotheses. Harmonic step
items.authors: Giacomo Aletti, Irene Crimaldi, Andrea Ghiglietti
items.title_zh: 非负随机递归的精确几乎确定的尺度
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究非负随机递归的精确几乎确定的尺度，其条件均值由线性项和带符号的适应扰动组成。线性项决定乘积归一化，但归一化后的收敛并不能确保严格的正极限。将状态乘以每个确定性收缩因子的倒数即可得出收缩调整状态。在该状态趋于无穷大的路径上，我们证明归一化状态的对数与累积相对扰动的差异几乎肯定是收敛的。这些假设控制有效步长、二次正相对扰动以及相对鞅噪声的条件二次变化。如果正扰动在归一化尺度上可求和，则归一化过程收敛到有限非负极限；那么严格正性就等价于相对扰动的绝对可求性。我们还给出了收缩调整状态的发散标准、一阶比较以及说明假设作用的反例。谐波阶跃

items.title: Differentiability of the solution to an SPDE with respect to the model for the associated regularity structure
items.excerpt: Given a stochastic partial differential equation that falls within the scope of the theory of regularity structures, we show that its solution is, in a suitable sense, a smooth function of the underlying model. This allows one to infer the regularity of the solution with respect to any perturbation of the noise from that of the model. As an application of our results, we provide an elementary proof of the Malliavin differentiability of solutions to a wide class of equations driven by Gaussian noises.
items.title_zh: SPDE 解相对于相关正则结构模型的可微性
items.excerpt_zh: 给定一个属于正则结构理论范围内的随机偏微分方程，我们证明它的解在适当的意义上是基础模型的平滑函数。这使得人们能够根据模型的噪声扰动来推断解决方案的规律性。作为我们结果的应用，我们提供了由高斯噪声驱动的一类广泛方程的解的 Malliavin 可微性的基本证明。

items.title: Adaptive Precision Incomplete Matrix Factorization
items.excerpt: Incomplete factorizations are widely used to precondition Krylov subspace methods for solving large sparse linear systems. Recent work has explored computing approximate factorizations in low precision, but using only one uniformly low precision limits the achievable accuracy and can degrade the quality of the preconditioner. We propose adaptive precision incomplete factorization algorithms in which we store each entry of the factors in a precision chosen according to its magnitude and a target accuracy. We present a rounding error analysis showing that the adaptive precision threshold-based incomplete LU and incomplete Cholesky factorizations achieve a backward error of the order of the target accuracy. We also discuss how to incorporate pivoting and scaling and how to perform the triangular solves with the adaptive precision factors. Finally, we explain how the approach applies to memory-limited incomplete Cholesky factorizations by using the magnitude of the largest dropped entry as the target accuracy. Numerical experiments on a wide range of matrices from the SuiteSparse collection show that adaptive precision can substantially r
items.authors: Andrew Lister, Theo Mary, Jennifer Scott
items.title_zh: 自适应精度不完全矩阵分解
items.excerpt_zh: 不完全因式分解广泛用于预处理 Krylov 子空间方法，以求解大型稀疏线性系统。最近的工作探索了低精度计算近似因式分解，但仅使用一种统一的低精度会限制可实现的精度，并可能降低预处理器的质量。我们提出了自适应精度不完全分解算法，其中我们将因子的每个条目存储在根据其大小和目标精度选择的精度中。我们提出的舍入误差分析表明，基于自适应精度阈值的不完全 LU 和不完全 Cholesky 分解实现了目标精度数量级的后向误差。我们还讨论了如何结合旋转和缩放以及如何使用自适应精度因子执行三角求解。最后，我们通过使用最大丢弃条目的大小作为目标精度来解释该方法如何应用于内存限制的不完全 Cholesky 分解。对 SuiteSparse 集合中的各种矩阵进行的数值实验表明，自适应精度可以显着提高

items.title: Sub-Riemannian flow matching
items.excerpt: We study sub-Riemannian conditional flow matching (SRCFM) for generative transport with prescribed velocity constraints. Training uses paths between sampled source and target points whose velocities lie in the allowed horizontal directions at each state. A neural network takes time and the full state as input and predicts the coefficients of these directions, and the horizontal frame then determines the full velocity used for generation. We describe constructions based on Heisenberg geodesics and joint endpoint equations in free step-two Carnot groups. We propose a scalable piecewise algorithm that computes horizontal paths directly from their endpoints. A straight segment sets the horizontal coordinates, and a loop in those coordinates corrects the remaining vertical displacement. We verify the algorithm's endpoint accuracy to numerical precision in high-dimensional tests. Synthetic experiments illustrate approximate distribution transport along horizontal trajectories. On resized MNIST, we use the same construction to generate images from Gaussian inputs with fewer controls than pixels.
items.title_zh: 亚黎曼流匹配
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究亚黎曼条件流匹配（SRCFM），用于具有规定速度约束的生成传输。训练使用采样源点和目标点之间的路径，其速度位于每个状态允许的水平方向。神经网络以时间和完整状态作为输入并预测这些方向的系数，然后水平框架确定用于生成的完整速度。我们描述了基于海森堡测地线和自由步二卡诺群中的联合端点方程的构造。我们提出了一种可扩展的分段算法，可以直接从端点计算水平路径。直线段设置水平坐标，这些坐标中的循环校正剩余的垂直位移。我们在高维测试中验证了该算法的端点精度到数值精度。综合实验说明了沿水平轨迹的近似分布传输。在调整大小的 MNIST 上，我们使用相同的结构从高斯输入生成图像，控制数量少于像素。

items.title: Data-driven discovery of sparse governing equations with parameterized operators
items.excerpt: We study parameterized SINDy (pSINDy), an extension of the Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) framework for the discovery of parsimonious governing equations involving operators with unknown parameters such as fractional-order Caputo derivatives, fractional Laplacians, and parameterized kernel operators. The framework jointly identifies the unknown operator parameters and sparse library coefficients through a sparsity-promoting optimization problem. To solve this problem, we develop and analyze the parameterized sequentially thresholded least-squares (pSTLSQ) algorithm. In each iteration, it removes terms with small coefficients, updates the operator parameters by a fixed number of optimization steps that improve the fit of the remaining library terms, and refits their coefficients by least squares. Under suitable assumptions, we prove that pSTLSQ converges locally to a local minimizer and give sufficient conditions for identifying the terms present in the governing equation. Numerical experiments demonstrate recovery of governing equations from noisy synthetic data for fractional ODEs, fractional PDEs, and nonlocal d
items.title_zh: 使用参数化算子的数据驱动的稀疏控制方程发现
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究参数化 SINDy (pSINDy)，它是非线性动力学稀疏辨识 (SINDy) 框架的扩展，用于发现涉及具有未知参数的算子（例如分数阶 Caputo 导数、分数拉普拉斯算子和参数化核算子）的简约控制方程。该框架通过稀疏性促进优化问题联合识别未知算子参数和稀疏库系数。为了解决这个问题，我们开发并分析了参数化顺序阈值最小二乘（pSTLSQ）算法。在每次迭代中，它删除系数较小的项，通过固定数量的优化步骤更新算子参数，以提高剩余库项的拟合度，并通过最小二乘法重新拟合其系数。在适当的假设下，我们证明 pSTLSQ 局部收敛于局部极小值，并给出了识别控制方程中存在的项的充分条件。数值实验证明了从分数式 ODE、分数式 PDE 和非局部 d 的噪声合成数据中恢复控制方程

items.title: A hybrid high-order discretization of a volume integral formulation for eddy currents on unstructured polyhedral meshes
items.excerpt: Volume integral formulations are attractive for eddy-current simulation because they require a mesh only of the conducting region. However, their dense interaction matrices make it important to control the number of unknowns needed for a prescribed accuracy. We propose an arbitrary-order Hybrid High-Order discretization of a current-based volume integral formulation on general unstructured polyhedral meshes. The method combines high-order polynomial approximation with local mesh refinement around defects and material interfaces. For bounded positive spatially varying resistivity and magnetic permeability uniform throughout space, we establish well-posedness and a priori error estimates using a constructive right inverse of the discrete divergence. Numerical experiments demonstrate convergence for smooth solutions and compare mesh refinement with increasing the polynomial degree. Selected comparisons show that higher degree on coarser meshes can reduce the number of current unknowns coupled by the Green operator and the associated storage for a prescribed accuracy. items.authors: Raman Kumar, Aurelio Spadotto, Silvano Pitassi
items.title_zh: 非结构化多面体网格涡流体积积分公式的混合高阶离散化
items.excerpt_zh: 体积积分公式对于涡流模拟很有吸引力，因为它们只需要导电区域的网格。然而，它们密集的交互矩阵使得控制规定精度所需的未知数变得非常重要。我们提出了一般非结构化多面体网格上基于电流的体积积分公式的任意阶混合高阶离散化。该方法将高阶多项式近似与缺陷和材料界面周围的局部网格细化相结合。对于整个空间均匀的有界正空间变化电阻率和磁导率，我们使用离散散度的建设性右逆来建立适定性和先验误差估计。数值实验证明了平滑解的收敛性，并比较了网格细化与增加多项式次数的情况。选定的比较表明，较粗网格上的较高程度可以减少由 Green 算子和相关存储耦合的当前未知数的数量，以达到规定的精度。最后，三维涡流测试基准评估了

items.title: Deterministic regularisation of the nonsymmetric eigenproblem
items.excerpt: We give a deterministic algorithm for pseudospectral shattering in exact arithmetic. This resolves an important open problem in the complexity of the nonsymmetric eigenproblem. Given a complex contraction $A$ of order $n\ge2$ and $0<\delta<1/2$, we compute a perturbation $E$ with $\|E\|<\delta$ such that $A+E$ has simple spectrum. The ratio of its eigenbasis condition number to its minimum eigenvalue gap is at most $C(n/\delta)^{20/3}$. The algorithm also computes an exact eigensystem of $A+E$. It uses $O(n^3\log^d(n/\delta))$ real-field operations and comparisons, where $C$ and $d$ are absolute constants. We choose the rank-one perturbations using a lower bound on the circle mean of the logarithm of the discriminant modulus. A quadratic penalty controls how far the accumulated updates move the matrix. By using the same reference eigenbasis for several updates, we can estimate all the current projector norms while recovering only the directions needed for the next perturbation.
items.title_zh: 非对称特征值问题的确定性正则化
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了精确算术中伪谱破碎的确定性算法。这解决了非对称本征问题的复杂性中的一个重要的开放性问题。给定 $n\ge2$ 阶的复杂收缩 $A$ 和 $0<\delta<1/2$，我们用 $\|E\|<\delta$ 计算扰动 $E$，使得 $A+E$ 具有简单的频谱。其特征基条件数与其最小特征值间隙之比至多为$C(n/\delta)^{20/3}$。该算法还计算 $A+E$ 的精确特征系统。它使用 $O(n^3\log^d(n/\delta))$ 实场运算和比较，其中 $C$ 和 $d$ 是绝对常数。我们使用判别模对数的圆平均值的下界来选择一级扰动。二次罚分控制累积更新移动矩阵的距离。通过使用相同的参考本征基进行多次更新，我们可以估计所有当前的投影范数，同时仅恢复下一个扰动所需的方向。

items.title: Finite-difference neural policy iteration for high-dimensional degenerate Hamilton--Jacobi equations
items.excerpt: We develop a finite-difference neural policy iteration method for high-dimensional degenerate Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman and Isaacs equations. Artificial viscosity yields a monotone finite-difference operator, and neural networks approximate the linear equations of semi-discrete policy iteration using local stencil values. This avoids global tensor-grid storage. For measurable feedbacks, we bound the propagation of evaluation, terminal, gradient, and control optimization errors by a geometrically weighted sum. Discrete comparison, consistency, and vanishing viscosity relate the approximation to the original degenerate equation. On coupled manufactured problems with rank-deficient diffusion, the method achieves lower mean errors than direct physics-informed neural networks at every tested dimension from five to fifty under equal training time. At fifty dimensions and $900$ seconds, the mean relative $L^2$ error over three paired seeds is about $40\%$ lower. items.title_zh: 高维简并Hamilton--Jacobi方程的有限差分神经策略迭代
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为高维简并 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman 和 Isaacs 方程开发了一种有限差分神经策略迭代方法。人工粘度产生单调有限差分算子，神经网络使用局部模板值近似半离散策略迭代的线性方程。这避免了全局张量网格存储。对于可测量的反馈，我们通过几何加权和来限制评估、终端、梯度和控制优化误差的传播。离散比较、一致性和消失粘度将近似值与原始简并方程联系起来。在具有秩亏扩散的耦合制造问题上，在相同的训练时间下，该方法在从 5 到 50 的每个测试维度上实现了比直接物理信息神经网络更低的平均误差。在 50 个维度和 $900$ 秒的情况下，三对种子的平均相对 $L^2$ 误差大约低 $40\%$。相对于原始简并解，二维细化实现了 $0.297%$ 误差，独立的网格参考将近似误差与粘度偏差分开。在一个

items.title: Numerical approximation of the Hilfer fractional derivative using orthogonal Quasi-Polynomials
items.excerpt: A numerical approach based on a composite Gaussian quadrature for the Hilfer fractional derivative is presented. This approach employs quasi-polynomials that are orthogonal with respect to the weight function on the interval $(0,1)$. As special cases, the Riemann--Liouville and Caputo fractional derivatives are obtained. Error bounds for the approximation are derived. To confirm the convergence rates as well as the high efficiency of the new approach, numerical examples are provided.
items.title_zh: 使用正交拟多项式对 Hilfer 分数导数进行数值逼近
items.excerpt_zh: 提出了一种基于 Hilfer 分数阶导数的复合高斯求积的数值方法。该方法采用与区间 $(0,1)$ 上的权重函数正交的拟多项式。作为特例，得到了黎曼-刘维尔和卡普托分数阶导数。推导出近似值的误差范围。为了确认新方法的收敛速度和高效率，提供了数值示例。

items.title: Quantitative Convergence of the Spherical Brownian Motion collisional particle system for the Maxwellian Landau Equation
items.excerpt: In this paper, we establish the quantitative convergence of the spherical Brownian motion (SBM) collisional particle system for the Maxwellian Landau equation via Wasserstein distances. When used as numerical method, it enjoys linear complexity $O(N)$ in particle number $N$, and conserves the momentum and energy almost surely. Moreover, only random grouping and sampling are needed for simulations without further numerical discretization. In the first part, we identify the large particle mean field limit of the system, and the Wasserstein convergence to the limit is justified through a coupling similar to the recent work for the Nanbu type Monte Carlo method \cite{BorghiPareschi2025}. The key difference is that the particles in our coupled shadow system are not i.i.d. due to the perfect matching. In the second part, the convergence of the mean field dynamics to the Landau solution is justified by the relative entropy with a bound $O(\tau^2)$, being $\tau$ the stepsize. This results in an $O(\tau)$ bound for the Wasserstein distance error. A crucial technical tool in the convergence in relative entropy is to provide suitable bounds on t
items.authors: Jos\'e Antonio Carrillo, Ruizhi Huang, Lei Li
items.title_zh: 麦克斯韦朗道方程球面布朗运动碰撞粒子系统的定量收敛
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们通过 Wasserstein 距离建立了麦克斯韦朗道方程的球形布朗运动（SBM）碰撞粒子系统的定量收敛。当用作数值方法时，它在粒子数$N$上具有线性复杂度$O(N)$，并且动量和能量几乎肯定守恒。而且，模拟时只需要随机分组和采样，无需进一步进行数值离散。在第一部分中，我们确定了系统的大粒子平均场极限，并且通过类似于 Nanb​​u 型蒙特卡罗方法最近的工作 \cite{BorghiPareschi2025} 的耦合来证明 Wasserstein 收敛到极限。主要区别在于我们的耦合阴影系统中的粒子不是独立同分布的。因为完美的搭配。在第二部分中，平均场动力学收敛到朗道解的合理性是通过具有边界 $O(\tau^2)$ 的相对熵来证明的，即 $\tau$ 为步长。这会导致 Wasserstein 距离误差的 $O(\tau)$ 界限。相对熵收敛的一个关键技术工具是为 t 提供合适的界限

items.title: Dense ideals in forcing extensions of Nairian models
items.excerpt: Complementing the work of Blue, Larson, and Sargsyan~\cite{NM,NM2}, we obtain forcing extensions of minimal Nairian models in which the Axiom of Choice and the Generalized Continuum Hypothesis hold. In these extensions, every uncountable regular cardinal $\kappa$ carries a precipitous, uniform, $\kappa$-dense ideal $\mathcal{I}_\kappa$. In fact, $\mathcal P(\kappa)/\mathcal{I}_\kappa$ is isomorphic to the regular open algebra of $\textrm{Col}(\omega,\kappa)$. This extends Woodin's theorem on the existence of $\omega_1$-dense ideals on $\omega_1$ in forcing extensions of models of $\Theta_{\rm reg}$ \cite[Section~2.3]{ASTWZ24}, where $\Theta_{\rm reg}$ denotes the theory $\textrm{ZF}+\textrm{AD}_{\mathbb R}+\text{``$\Theta$ is regular''}$. Moreover, our work places the consistency strength of the aforementioned theory on generic embeddings below a Woodin cardinal that is a limit of Woodin cardinals, and also complements the seminal work of Eskew and Hayut~\cite{EH24}.
items.title_zh: 强制扩展 Nairian 模型的密集理想
items.excerpt_zh: 补充 Blue、Larson 和 Sargsyan~\cite{NM,NM2} 的工作，我们获得了最小 Nairian 模型的强制扩展，其中选择公理和广义连续统假设成立。在这些扩展中，每个不可数正则基数$\kappa$都带有一个陡峭的、均匀的、$\kappa$密集的理想$\mathcal{I}_\kappa$。事实上，$\mathcal P(\kappa)/\mathcal{I}_\kappa$ 与 $\textrm{Col}(\omega,\kappa)$ 的正则开代数同构。这扩展了伍丁关于$\omega_1$上存在$\omega_1$稠密理想的定理，强制扩展$\Theta_{\rm reg}$ \cite[Section~2.3]{ASTWZ24}，其中$\Theta_{\rm reg}$表示理论$\textrm{ZF}+\textrm{AD}_{\mathbb R}+\text{``$\Theta$ 是常规的''}$.此外，我们的工作将上述通用嵌入理论的一致性强度置于伍丁基数之下，这是伍丁基数的极限，并且也补充了 Eskew 和 Hayut~\cite{EH24} 的开创性工作。

items.title: A Note on the Topos-Inadmissibility of Free Heyting Algebras
items.excerpt: Yiqi Xu and Linguan Ye have recently settled the long-standing open question about which Heyting algebras are topos-admissible, that is, occur as the truth values of some topos. They prove that free Heyting algebras with two or more generators are not topos admissible. Their proof has been simplified by Zoltan Kocsis and by Sam van Gool. Here I make some further simplifications, emphasising algebraic methods over Kripke semantics and in particular the use of Sierpi\'nski cones of Heyting algebras.
items.title_zh: 关于自由海廷代数的拓扑不可接受性的注记
items.excerpt_zh: Yiqi Xu 和 Linguan Ye 最近解决了长期悬而未决的问题，即哪些 Heyting 代数是拓扑可接受的，即作为某些拓扑的真值出现。他们证明具有两个或更多生成元的自由 Heyting 代数不是拓扑可接受的。 Zoltan Kocsis 和 Sam van Gool 简化了他们的证明。在这里，我做了一些进一步的简化，强调代数方法优于 Kripke 语义，特别是 Heyting 代数的 Sierpi\'nski 锥的使用。

items.title: CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data
items.excerpt: This paper shows that transformer networks trained with next-token prediction (NTP) and gradient descent do not learn to make predictions using only causally-relevant tokens in the left context, irrespective of the causal ordering of tokens during training, and identifies the learning deficiencies responsible. We introduce a causal world-model setup, for which, we characterize the Bayes-optimal predictor under the causal view of the data. We then prove that, a function that distills its predictions to non-causal views of data, when realized under Occam's Razor, recovers the true causal predictor. Based on this analysis we propose CausalNTP, a practical training algorithm that approximates this theoretical recipe and trains transformers to depend only the causally relevant tokens in left-context. Empirically in the world-model setup, CausalNTP achieves out-of-distribution generalization that vanilla NTP cannot due to its theoretical limits, regardless of data and model scale. We show similar gains and behavior in the natural language question-answering setting as a proof-of-concept.
items.title_zh: CausalNTP：噪声训练数据下因果下一个标记预测的世界模型配方
items.excerpt_zh: 本文表明，使用下一个令牌预测 (NTP) 和梯度下降训练的 Transformer 网络不会学会仅使用左侧上下文中的因果相关令牌进行预测，而不管训练期间令牌的因果顺序如何，并确定了造成的学习缺陷。我们引入了因果世界模型设置，为此，我们在数据的因果视图下描述了贝叶斯最优预测器。然后我们证明，当在奥卡姆剃刀下实现时，将其预测提炼为数据非因果视图的函数可以恢复真正的因果预测器。基于此分析，我们提出了 CausalNTP，一种实用的训练算法，它近似于这个理论配方，并训练 Transformer 仅依赖于左上下文中的因果相关标记。根据经验，在世界模型设置中，CausalNTP 实现了普通 NTP 由于其理论限制而无法实现的分布外泛化，无论数据和模型规模如何。我们在自然语言问答环境中展示了类似的收益和行为作为概念验证。

items.title: Persuasion from Within: Model-Based Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Debate and Consensus
items.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems for collective decision-making, such as multi-agent debate and consensus games, in which agents exchange messages and update their answers over multiple rounds and a resolution mechanism aggregates them into a final outcome. Most multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that every participant shares the system objective. In practice, however, a malicious agent can join as a legitimate member of the group and persuade the other agents toward a hidden adversarial goal. We formalize such attacks as a sequential decision-making problem in which the insider seeks to degrade the utility of the collective outcome. We propose a model-based insider attack that learns to persuade a group of agents: the insider first learns a world model of the benign agents from offline trajectories and then uses it both to train a persuasion policy and to plan its messages. In two case studies involving a numerical consensus game and a multi-agent debate, the learned insider is the most effective and the stealthiest attack we evaluate, outperforming both prompt-based and trained LLM persuad
items.authors: Bangyan Ju, Xiaolin Sun, Yibin Hu, Zizhan Zheng
items.title_zh: 来自内部的说服：多代理 LLM 辩论和共识中基于模型的内部攻击
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在用于集体决策的多智能体系统中，例如多智能体辩论和共识游戏，其中智能体在多轮中交换消息并更新其答案，并且解决机制将它们聚合成最终结果。大多数多代理 LLM 框架假设每个参与者都有共同的系统目标。然而，在实践中，恶意代理可以作为该组的合法成员加入，并说服其他代理实现隐藏的敌对目标。我们将此类攻击形式化为一个连续决策问题，其中内部人员试图降低集体结果的效用。我们提出了一种基于模型的内部攻击，它学习说服一组代理：内部人员首先从离线轨迹中学习良性代理的世界模型，然后使用它来训练说服策略并规划其消息。在涉及数字共识游戏和多代理辩论的两个案例研究中，学习的内部人员是我们评估的最有效和最隐秘的攻击，优于基于提示和训练有素的 LLM 说服

items.title: Improving semantic equivalence in research-level math formalization
items.excerpt: Formalizing mathematics in Lean is never a word-for-word translation of a paper: a Lean formalization changes definitions, strengthens hypotheses, splits arguments, and adds lemmas the paper never mentions. It stands to reason that a model that is good at autoformalization must be a good predictor of how a natural language source must differ from its faithful Lean formalization. With that in mind, we collect 4{,}076 audited examples of such changes from 832 Lean projects that formalize research-level mathematics, and use them to ask a practical question: how well can a model \emph{write} Lean inside a real research-level project that may contain tens of thousands of lines of code, and does training on discrepancies between natural language sources and their faithful Lean formalizations help? Our training set consists of 3{,}431 tasks from 141 repositories, and the test set consists of 645 tasks from the remaining 27 repositories. Training on in-project Lean nearly doubles complete proofs ($11\% \to 20\%$) and raises the share of statements in gold agreement with the project's own formalization by nearly a third ($30\%$ to $39\%$). items.title_zh: 提高研究级数学形式化中的语义等价性

items.title: Does a Frontier Large Language Model Know What It Can Solve? A 100-Conjecture Calibration Study
items.excerpt: How does confidence correlate with actual performance in large language models, when attacking open research-level math problems? We address this question by studying the performance of ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra on a set of 100 open conjectures in geometric analysis. By construction, the model first selected open problems in geometric analysis that it assessed that it had at least a 50\% chance of proving or disproving, and then assigned a probability of success to each question. 13 questions were then excluded after an audit, and the model was asked to resolve the remaining 87 problems. Its mean stated resolution probability was $0.617$, versus an observed rate of $0.103$ (Brier score $0.351$, ECE $0.513$), thereby demonstrating that the model was systematically over-confident in its self-assessment. However, the scores retained ranking signal (AUROC $0.714$). The model was highly overconfident in probability magnitude but did more often than not assign a high probability of success to the problems that it did resolve, than the problems that it did not. Hence, its probabilities were numerically mis-calibrated but directionally correct. A

items.title_zh: 前沿大型语言模型知道它能解决什么问题吗？ 100 项猜想校准研究

items.title: FormaFin: Verifiable Financial Analysis with Solver-Guided Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: Formally verifying financial analyses generated by large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as financial rules are largely expressed in natural language and rarely have corresponding formal specifications. Training language models to formalize these rules is hindered by the scarcity of labeled data and reliable training signals, while confidential financial data favor small models that run locally. We introduce FormaFin, a framework that trains small open language models to translate financial rules into reusable SMT formulas. FormaFin integrates teacher distillation with reinforcement learning using an SMT solver to compute rewards from numerical thresholds stated in financial rules. We evaluate FormaFin on corporate loan monitoring, in which lenders check borrowers' financial figures against loan agreements. To evaluate our framework, we curate \bench{}, a benchmark containing 143 loan agreements and 2,527 questions covering compliance, earnings cushion, and debt capacity. items.title_zh: FormaFin：通过求解器引导的强化学习进行可验证的财务分析
items.excerpt_zh: 正式验证大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成的财务分析仍然具有挑战性，因为财务规则主要以自然语言表达，很少有相应的正式规范。由于缺乏标记数据和可靠的训练信号，训练语言模型以形式化这些规则受到阻碍，而机密的财务数据则倾向于在本地运行的小型模型。我们引入了 FormaFin，这是一个训练小型开放语言模型以将财务规则转换为可重复使用的 SMT 公式的框架。 FormaFin 将教师蒸馏与强化学习相结合，使用 SMT 求解器根据财务规则中规定的数值阈值计算奖励。我们评估 FormaFin 在企业贷款监控方面的表现，贷方根据贷款协议检查借款人的财务数据。为了评估我们的框架，我们策划了 \bench{}，这是一个包含 143 份贷款协议和 2,527 个涵盖合规性、收益缓冲和债务能力的问题的基准。我们的结果表明，7B 形式化器的准确率达到 94.8%，比开放式法学硕士的性能高出十倍。在三个模型系列中，准确度范围

items.title: Scalar Tuned Lens Summaries Offer Limited Incremental Value for Mid-Generation Abstention
items.excerpt: Mid-generation abstention aims to stop an unpromising response before spending its remaining computation budget. Intermediate transformer states may help predict eventual correctness, but whether scalar summaries of their vocabulary predictions add useful evidence is less clear. We compare Tuned Lens entropy and divergence features with final-state and raw intermediate-state probes under matched, causal evaluation. Across eight instruction-tuned models on MATH-500, raw intermediate states improve ranking, whereas scalar-only probes usually trail the final-state baseline. Scalar hybrids have positive exceptions, but their advantage over position-matched permutation controls is small. Cross-fitted residual comparisons further show that gains over a final-state probe need not require aligned scalar features. Actual stopping runs on two model sizes and two benchmarks reveal a separate accuracy--computation trade-off, with token savings overstating wall-time savings for scalar policies. The evidence supports a restricted empirical conclusion about these scalar features, not a general negative claim about intermediate representations.
items.title_zh: 标量调谐镜头摘要为中代弃权者提供有限的增量价值
items.excerpt_zh: 中代弃权的目的是在花费剩余的计算预算之前阻止毫无希望的反应。中间变换器状态可能有助于预测最终的正确性，但其词汇预测的标量摘要是否增加了有用的证据尚不清楚。我们将调谐透镜熵和发散特征与匹配的因果评估下的最终状态和原始中间状态探针进行比较。在 MATH-500 上的八个指令调整模型中，原始中间状态提高了排名，而纯标量探针通常落后于最终状态基线。标量混合有积极的例外，但它们相对于位置匹配排列控制的优势很小。交叉拟合残差比较进一步表明，最终状态探针的增益不需要对齐的标量特征。在两种模型大小和两个基准上的实际停止运行揭示了单独的准确性-计算权衡，令牌节省夸大了标量策略的挂墙时间节省。证据支持关于这些标量特征的有限经验结论，而不是关于中间表示的一般否定主张。

items.title: Dimension Is Free, Horizon Is Not: When Evolution Strategies Rival Policy Gradients for LLM Fine-Tuning
items.excerpt: Policy gradient (PG) methods such as GRPO dominate LLM fine-tuning, yet recent work showed that Evolution Strategies (ES) also scale to fine-tuning models with billions of parameters. Which method needs fewer samples, and on which tasks, remains unclear. We view the two methods as estimators of the same gradient that differ in where they explore. Because ES perturbs parameters, its noise grows with the number of parameters, and because PG samples actions, its noise grows with the number of generated tokens. Only noise along the directions that change the reward slows learning. The cost of ES then depends on the effective dimension, the number of independent skills a task requires rather than its parameter count, while the cost of PG depends on the effective horizon, which counts only the tokens that share both credit and weights with the reward-carrying ones. We train both methods on a synthetic task where the number of skills and the effective horizon can be varied separately. PG is cheaper when the horizon is short, ES becomes cheaper once it is long enough, and this crossover moves to longer horizons as the number of skills grows.
items.authors: Qiyao Liang, Kajetan Schweighofer, Xin Qiu, Risto Miikkulainen
items.title_zh: 维度是自由的，地平线不是：当进化策略与法学硕士微调的政策梯度竞争时
items.excerpt_zh: GRPO 等策略梯度 (PG) 方法在 LLM 微调中占主导地位，但最近的研究表明，进化策略 (ES) 也可以扩展到具有数十亿个参数的微调模型。哪种方法需要更少的样本，以及针对哪些任务，目前尚不清楚。我们将这两种方法视为相同梯度的估计器，但它们探索的地方不同。因为 ES 扰动参数，所以它的噪声随着参数数量的增加而增加，并且因为 PG 对动作进行采样，所以它的噪声随着生成的 token 的数量而增加。只有沿着改变奖励方向的噪音才会减慢学习速度。 ES 的成本取决于有效维度，即任务所需的独立技能的数量，而不是其参数数量，而 PG 的成本取决于有效范围，它只计算与带有奖励的代币共享信用和权重的代币。我们在综合任务上训练这两种方法，其中技能数量和有效范围可以单独变化。当范围很短时，PG 会更便宜，一旦范围足够长，ES 就会变得更便宜，并且随着技能数量的增加，这种交叉会转向更长的范围。

items.title: Reward Blindness: A Theoretical Framework for Diagnosing Reinforcement Learning Reward Limitations in Text-to-SQL
items.excerpt: Text-to-SQL systems let users without programming expertise query relational databases in natural language. Reinforcement learning has become the dominant way to train such systems, yet progress is still judged by a single number, execution accuracy, which counts correct queries but says nothing about which kinds of semantic error survive training. This paper develops a theoretical framework that examines text-to-SQL from the perspective of reward design. We introduce Reward Error Sensitivity, a measure of how strongly a reward function separates queries that contain a given error type from queries that do not, and prove a Reward Blindness theorem: when this sensitivity is zero, policy-gradient training carries no systematic signal for removing that error. Using fourteen published finegrained error signals for four text-to-SQL systems on the BIRD benchmark, we build error profiles and estimate sensitivities for common reward designs. Predicate and result-level errors are the most frequent, firing on up to 27 percent of queries, while structurally deep errors such as suboptimal joins persist at 5 to 12 percent. items.authors: Lakshmi Muraleedharan Nair, Shiqi Huang, Fangyu Lo, Yihua Xu, Dingyan Shang
items.title_zh: 奖励盲目性：诊断文本转 SQL 中强化学习奖励限制的理论框架
items.excerpt_zh: 文本到 SQL 系统允许没有编程专业知识的用户以自然语言查询关系数据库。强化学习已经成为训练此类系统的主要方式，但进度仍然是通过一个数字来判断的，即执行准确性，它计算正确的查询，但没有说明哪些类型的语义错误在训练中幸存下来。本文开发了一个理论框架，从奖励设计的角度研究文本到 SQL。我们引入奖励错误敏感性，衡量奖励函数将包含给定错误类型的查询与不包含给定错误类型的查询区分开来的程度，并证明奖励盲定理：当这种敏感性为零时，策略梯度训练不携带用于消除该错误的系统信号。使用 BIRD 基准上四个文本到 SQL 系统的 14 个已发布的细粒度错误信号，我们构建错误配置文件并估计常见奖励设计的敏感性。谓词和结果级错误是最常见的，引发高达 27% 的查询，而结构性深度错误（例如次优连接）持续保持在 5% 到 12%。每个奖励系列都有一个

items.title: Coupling-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Co-Evolving Graph Games
items.excerpt: Building hydrogen station networks, electric vehicle charging grids, or vaccine distribution systems requires coordinating two separately operated graphs, demand-side facilities and the supply-side networks they depend on, where each operator's payoff depends on the other's choices. We formalize this as the Co-Evolving Graph Game (CEGG), a setting that sits between facility location, interdependent-network analysis, and graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) but is not jointly addressed by any of them. We propose Cross-Graph Attention with Policy Mirror Descent (CGA-PMD), pairing cross-graph attention, which lets each agent read only the partner-graph nodes structurally coupled to its own, with a policy mirror descent update for stable training. Across three reward domains and a range of practical network scales, we find that the structure of the coupling selects which method wins: at small scale most methods are competitive, but as scale grows or coupling becomes irregular, CGA-PMD is the one method that stays reliable: it attains the highest success count on each of five real city networks, while own-only, unmasked-at
items.authors: Mina Kim, Guanghui Lan, Benoit Montreuil
items.title_zh: 协同进化图游戏的耦合感知强化学习
items.excerpt_zh: 建设加氢站网络、电动汽车充电网或疫苗分配系统需要协调两个独立运营的图表、需求方设施和它们所依赖的供应方网络，其中每个运营商的收益取决于另一个运营商的选择。我们将其形式化为协同进化图游戏（CEGG），这是一种位于设施位置、相互依赖网络分析和基于图的多智能体强化学习（MARL）之间的设置，但不由它们中的任何一个共同解决。我们提出了带有策略镜像下降的交叉图注意力（CGA-PMD），将交叉图注意力配对，让每个智能体只读取与其自身结构耦合的合作伙伴图节点，并通过策略镜像下降更新进行稳定训练。在三个奖励领域和一系列实际网络规模中，我们发现耦合的结构选择了哪种方法获胜：在小规模下，大多数方法都是有竞争力的，但随着规模的增长或耦合变得不规则，CGA-PMD 是一种保持可靠的方法：它在五个真实城市网络中的每一个上都获得了最高的成功计数，同时只拥有自己的、公开的

items.title: Lean Census: A Distributional Analysis of AI-Generated Lean Code
items.excerpt: We compare two human-written and four AI-generated Lean libraries with Mathlib through the distributions of simple statistics of their code. For each library we measure inline claims in proofs, proof length, how often each declaration is used, and design choices such as instances and private declarations, and we read each against the variation among Mathlib's own areas. The AI-generated libraries have more inline claims per theorem, longer proofs, fewer instances, and more private declarations than the human-written ones. We release the code for the analysis as a package, lean-census, at https://github.com/project-numina/lean-census.
items.title_zh: 精益普查：人工智能生成的精益代码的分布分析
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过简单统计代码的分布，将两个人工编写的精益库和四个人工智能生成的精益库与 Mathlib 进行比较。对于每个库，我们测量证明中的内联声明、证明长度、每个声明的使用频率以及设计选择（例如实例和私有声明），并且我们根据 Mathlib 自己的区域之间的差异来阅读每个库。与人工编写的库相比，人工智能生成的库具有更多的每个定理内联声明、更长的证明、更少的实例和更多的私有声明。我们将分析代码作为一个包（lean-census）发布在 https://github.com/project-numina/lean-census。

items.title: SAFE-DRIFT: Data Selection for Supervised Fine-tuning with Controllable Off-Target Drifts
items.excerpt: We propose SAFE-DRIFT, a data-selection framework for supervised fine-tuning that improves a target capability while controlling unwanted drift in the model's other behaviors. We formalize this as a constrained optimization problem that maximizes alignment with the target gradient, subject to a budget on off-target drift which we quantify using the Fisher information of a reference distribution. Under this objective, the optimal, closed-form update is a damped natural-gradient step that downweights reference-sensitive directions. To estimate these high-dimensional gradients and work within the right geometry, we further derive a scalable algorithm that approximates the Fisher information and the target gradient in a shared low-dimensional subspace and analyze how entanglement of the target and reference task can affect the update. We evaluate SAFE-DRIFT against state-of-the-art data selection methods across diverse domains including coding and medical question answering, yielding competitive target performance while reducing degradation on specified off-target behaviors.
items.authors: Yeo Jin Jung, Yating Liu, Lalchand Pandia, Claire Donnat
items.title_zh: SAFE-DRIFT：通过可控偏离目标漂移进行监督微调的数据选择
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了 SAFE-DRIFT，这是一种用于监督微调的数据选择框架，可以提高目标能力，同时控制模型其他行为中不必要的漂移。我们将其形式化为一个约束优化问题，最大化与目标梯度的对齐，并受到偏离目标漂移的预算的影响，我们使用参考分布的 Fisher 信息对其进行量化。在此目标下，最佳的封闭形式更新是阻尼自然梯度步骤，可降低参考敏感方向的权重。为了估计这些高维梯度并在正确的几何结构内工作，我们进一步推导了一种可扩展算法，该算法在共享低维子空间中近似费舍尔信息和目标梯度，并分析目标和参考任务的纠缠如何影响更新。我们根据编码和医学问答等不同领域的最先进的数据选择方法来评估 SAFE-DRIFT，从而产生有竞争力的目标性能，同时减少特定脱靶行为的退化。

items.title: Bridging Teacher-Student Capability Gaps with Recurrent Computation
items.excerpt: Knowledge distillation transfers capabilities from large language models to smaller students, yet stronger teachers do not always yield better students. Recent studies report diminishing or even negative returns from teacher scaling. We hypothesize that these limitations arise in part from insufficient student capacity to absorb the teacher's knowledge. We therefore investigate loop and recurrent computation as a way to expand the student's effective capacity by modifying its computation graph while keeping the backbone parameter count fixed. Under teacher-forced KD during pretraining, weight-shared looping improves performance but retains teacher-size saturation, whereas cross-token recurrence avoids the observed reversal with larger teachers. In mathematical post-training under both teacher-forced KD and on-policy distillation (OPD), recurrent students scale better with increasing teacher size than looped and vanilla LLMs do. Crucially, we show that a pretrained LLM can be readily fine-tuned into a looped or recurrent architecture jointly with OPD, without repeating pretraining. items.authors: Zeyi Huang, Jiuxiang Gu, Eli Shechtman, Yong Jae Lee, Zongze Wu
items.title_zh: 通过循环计算弥合师生能力差距
items.excerpt_zh: 知识蒸馏将能力从大型语言模型转移到较小的学生，但更强大的教师并不总是能培养出更好的学生。最近的研究报告称，教师规模化的回报正在减少甚至为负。我们假设这些限制部分源于学生吸收教师知识的能力不足。因此，我们研究循环和循环计算作为通过修改其计算图同时保持骨干参数计数固定来扩展学生有效能力的一种方法。在预训练期间教师强制的 KD 下，权重共享循环提高了性能，但保留了教师规模的饱和度，而跨令牌递归则避免了观察到的较大教师的逆转。在教师强制 KD 和政策蒸馏 (OPD) 下的数学后期培训中，随着教师规模的增加，复读生的规模比循环法学硕士和普通法学硕士更好。至关重要的是，我们表明预训练的 LLM 可以很容易地与 OPD 一起微调为循环或循环架构，而无需重复预训练。我们的循环 Qwen 模型随着更大的教师而得到改进

items.title: How many mistakes does it take to learn an interval? Exact Littlestone dimensions of intervals and their unions
items.excerpt: The Littlestone dimension of a hypothesis class equals the smallest number of mistakes an online learner can guarantee against an adaptive adversary. For discrete intervals and unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points, only its order of growth was known. We determine it exactly. For every switch budget $k$ (with both end labels fixed when $k$ is odd), the smallest size on which $d$ mistakes can be forced follows a three-regime law: $d+1$ while $d\le k$, then $2d-k+1$, and beyond $d=\lceil 3k/2\rceil+k-1$ doubling the size adds exactly $k$ mistakes. Unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points correspond to $k=2j$ and size $m+1$, and a single interval gives the thresholds $1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,\dots$. The natural learner that waits for a positive example and binary-searches both endpoints is not optimal: it can be forced into one extra mistake for 50,847 of the domain sizes below $10^5$. Upper bounds come from a gap potential and a block-pairing learner, and lower bounds from adversary strategies and a refinement step.
