items.title_zh: 需要犯多少次错误才能学会一个音程？区间及其并集的精确 Littlestone 维数
items.excerpt_zh: 假设类的 Littlestone 维度等于在线学习者可以保证对抗自适应对手的最小错误数。对于 $m$ 点上的离散区间和 $j$ 区间的并集，仅知道其增长顺序。我们准确地确定它。对于每个开关预算 $k$（当 $k$ 为奇数时，两端标签固定），可以强制执行 $d$ 错误的最小大小遵循三态法则：$d+1$，而 $d\le k$，然后是 $2d-k+1$，超出 $d=\lceil 3k/2\rceil+k-1$，大小加倍会恰好增加 $k$ 错误。 $m$ 点上的 $j$ 间隔的并集对应于 $k=2j$ 和大小 $m+1$，单个间隔给出阈值 $1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,\dots$。等待正例并对两个端点进行二分搜索的自然学习器并不是最优的：对于 50,847 个低于 $10^5$ 的域大小，它可能会被迫犯一个额外的错误。上限来自差距潜力和块配对学习器，下限来自对手策略和细化步骤。这些工具为每轮提供 $O(\log m)$ 时间的明确最优学习器，这在随机流上平均会犯更多错误

items.title: AgriManager: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-RL Generalization in Agricultural Management
items.excerpt: Agricultural management is heterogeneous along two axes. The first is distributional shift within a fixed task interface: weather, crops, and prices vary across years and locations while sensors, actions, and objective stay fixed. The second is structural shift across interfaces: different farms expose different observed variables, available actions, and management objectives. We formalize the second axis as schema shift: variation in the policy-facing schema $\Sigma = (\Sigma_O, \Sigma_A, \Sigma_R)$ between training and deployment. We test whether LLM-RL generalizes across both axes with AgriManager, to our knowledge the first framework that trains LLM policies with RL across multiple process-based crop simulators, unifying DSSAT, WOFOST, and Cycles. We design a three-tier generalization ladder: Tier 1 within-schema distributional shift, Tier 2 single-axis schema shift along $\Sigma_O / \Sigma_A / \Sigma_R$, Tier 3 compositional schema shift across simulators, all scored on a frozen held-out test suite with three training seeds per method. Within fixed schemas, Qwen3-4B trained by RL with explicit reasoning exceeds neural-network PPO
items.authors: Chi Gui, Junwen Zheng, Ritwik Nigam, Qianlan Yang, Meagan Lang, Vardhan Dongre, Jeremiah Barr, Yu-Xiong Wang, Vikram S. Adve
items.title_zh: AgriManager：农业管理 LLM-RL 泛化的框架和基准
items.excerpt_zh: 农业管理在两个方面是异质的。第一个是固定任务界面内的分配变化：天气、农作物和价格随年份和地点的不同而变化，而传感器、操作和目标保持固定。第二个是跨界面的结构转变：不同的农场暴露出不同的观察变量、可用行动和管理目标。我们将第二个轴形式化为模式转变：训练和部署之间面向政策的模式 $\Sigma = (\Sigma_O, \Sigma_A, \Sigma_R)$ 的变化。我们使用 AgriManager 测试 LLM-RL 是否可以在两个轴上泛化，据我们所知，这是第一个跨多个基于流程的作物模拟器使用 RL 训练 LLM 策略的框架，统一了 DSSAT、WOFOST 和 Cycles。我们设计了一个三层泛化阶梯：第 1 层模式内分布转移、第 2 层沿着 $\Sigma_O / \Sigma_A / \Sigma_R$ 的单轴模式转移、第 3 层跨模拟器的组成模式转移，所有这些都在冻结的保留测试套件上进行评分，每种方法有 3 个训练种子。在固定模式内，通过 RL 训练并进行显式推理的 Qwen3-4B 超过了神经网络 PPO

items.title: Global Stability and Loss Convergence in Matrix Factorization
items.excerpt: We study the matrix factorization objective $\mathcal L(X,Y)=f(XY)$ for convex, twice continuously differentiable output losses with bounded and Lipschitz gradient and a minimizing set that is compact modulo specified input and output invariances. This includes the well-known cross entropy loss. We prove that a positive learning-rate threshold guarantees bounded parameters, summability of squared gradients, and convergence of the loss from every finite initialization. The proof constructs a quantity from the imbalance between parameter matrices that decreases over every step of the gradient descent trajectory.
items.title_zh: 矩阵分解中的全局稳定性和损失收敛
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究矩阵分解目标 $\mathcal L(X,Y)=f(XY)$ 的凸、两次连续可微的输出损失，具有有界和 Lipschitz 梯度，以及一个紧模指定输入和输出不变性的最小化集。这包括众所周知的交叉熵损失。我们证明正的学习率阈值保证了有界参数、平方梯度的可求和性以及每个有限初始化的损失的收敛性。该证明根据参数矩阵之间的不平衡构造了一个量，该量随着梯度下降轨迹的每一步而减少。

items.title: VeriLogic: Reinforcement Learning over Verifiable Logical Reasoning Traces
items.excerpt: Logical reasoning derives conclusions from premises through explicit intermediate inference steps, providing a natural basis for process-level verification and supervision. However, existing learning methods often rely on response-level outcome signals, which overlook heterogeneous correctness within the reasoning trace: a correct answer may contain invalid reasoning, while valid intermediate steps may also appear in an incorrect response. To address this issue, we introduce Reinforcement Learning on Verifiable Logical Reasoning (VeriLogic), which turns internal reasoning traces into explicit and verifiable learning objects. Rather than treating a response as an indivisible learning unit, VeriLogic decomposes logical reasoning into explicit intermediate judgments, proofs, and final decisions, and organizes them into a unified "Grounding - Optimization - Refinement" pipeline: (1) Verification-Grounded Reasoning Environment Construction grounds logical reasoning into explicit intermediate states and formally checkable proof obligations, making the internal reasoning process accessible to verification and learning; (2) Logical Structured
items.authors: ZeLiang Chen, Yunyao Zhang, Xinglang Zhang, Wenbing Li, Junqing Yu, Zikai Song
items.title_zh: VeriLogic：基于可验证逻辑推理轨迹的强化学习
items.excerpt_zh: 逻辑推理通过明确的中间推理步骤从前提得出结论，为过程级验证和监督提供了自然的基础。然而，现有的学习方法通​​常依赖于响应级别的结果信号，而忽略了推理轨迹中的异构正确性：正确的答案可能包含无效的推理，而有效的中间步骤也可能出现在错误的响应中。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了可验证逻辑推理的强化学习（VeriLogic），它将内部推理痕迹转化为明确且可验证的学习对象。 VeriLogic没有将响应视为不可分割的学习单元，而是将逻辑推理分解为明确的中间判断、证明和最终决策，并将它们组织成统一的“接地-优化-细化”流程：（1）验证接地推理环境构建将逻辑推理接地为明确的中间状态和形式可检查的证明义务，使内部推理过程易于验证和学习； (2)逻辑结构

items.title: Contrastive On-Policy Distillation via Dual-Branch Supervision
items.excerpt: For on-policy distillation (OPD), more capable models are a natural choice as teachers. However, higher task performance does not necessarily imply greater teachability. A controlled token intervention study suggests that even a model weaker than the student can serve as an informative contrastive reference. Building on this observation, we propose Contrastive On-Policy Distillation (cOPD), which provides dual branch supervision by contrasting strong teacher, weak teacher, and student predictions at student generated prefixes. Our analysis explains how this three way comparison helps select token candidates associated with better or worse reasoning outcomes under an idealized model. We evaluate cOPD across diverse teacher student configurations spanning different training stages, parameter scales, and model families, on tasks including mathematical reasoning, instruction following, and question answering with abstention. cOPD achieves the best or top-tier performance among the evaluated baselines across all three tasks, improving overall Pass@16 on mathematical reasoning by up to 7.51\% over the strongest baseline. items.title_zh: 通过双分支监督进行对比在政策蒸馏
items.excerpt_zh: 对于在策略蒸馏（OPD）来说，作为教师，能力更强的模型是自然的选择。然而，更高的任务绩效并不一定意味着更高的可教性。一项受控令牌干预研究表明，即使模型比学生弱，也可以作为信息丰富的对比参考。基于这一观察，我们提出了对比在策略蒸馏（cOPD），它通过对比强教师、弱教师和学生生成的前缀的预测来提供双分支监督。我们的分析解释了这种三向比较如何帮助选择与理想化模型下更好或更差的推理结果相关的令牌候选者。我们评估跨不同训练阶段、参数尺度和模型系列的不同师生配置的 cOPD，任务包括数学推理、遵循指令和弃权问答。 cOPD 在所有三项任务的评估基线中实现了最佳或顶级性能，与最强基线相比，数学推理的整体 Pass@16 提高了高达 7.51\%。进一步分析

items.title: Group-Balanced Supervised Fine-Tuning for Knowledge-Intensive Domains
items.excerpt: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) weights every supervised token equally, so on knowledge-dense corpora the loss budget follows token count rather than importance: on a legal QA benchmark, citation strings absorb 81% of the supervised loss weight budget while the answers being taught absorb 5%. We present Group-Balanced SFT (GB-SFT), which equalizes the loss budget across the semantic roles of tokens within a target sequence. With one tunable dial and one structural switch, GB-SFT contains standard SFT, class- and span-level balancing as corners whose geometry we characterize exactly. On benchmarks in law, medicine, code, and mathematics, we show across model families that: (i) GB- SFT injects new knowledge better than uniform SFT, pointwise token weighting, memory editing, and matched-budget data mixing; (ii) it matches the injection of masking out everything but the knowledge payload while retaining the citation recall that masking destroys (0.98 vs. 0.38); and (iii) role-aware grouping carries the gain: label-free partitions recover at most a third of it, an LLM tagger nearly all where the groups are lexically distinctive; and and (iv)
items.title_zh: 知识密集型领域的群体平衡监督微调
items.excerpt_zh: 监督微调（SFT）对每个监督令牌的权重相等，因此在知识密集的语料库上，损失预算遵循令牌数量而不是重要性：在法律 QA 基准上，引文字符串吸收了监督损失权重预算的 81％，而教授的答案吸收了 5％。我们提出了组平衡 SFT (GB-SFT)，它均衡目标序列中标记的语义角色之间的损失预算。 GB-SFT 具有一个可调拨盘和一个结构开关，包含标准 SFT、类级和跨度级平衡，作为我们精确描述其几何形状的角点。在法律、医学、代码和数学的基准上，我们在模型系列中表明：（i）GB-SFT 比统一 SFT、逐点令牌加权、内存编辑和匹配预算数据混合更好地注入新知识； (ii) 它与屏蔽除知识有效负载之外的所有内容的注入相匹配，同时保留屏蔽破坏的引文回忆（0.98 与 0.38）； (iii) 角色感知分组带来收益：无标签分区最多恢复三分之一，LLM 标记器几乎所有组在词汇上都是独特的；和 (iv)

items.title: From Vanishing Gradients to Recursive Self-Improvement: Evaluating the Most Influential Papers in Large Language Model Evolution (1997-2026)
items.excerpt: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Model (LLM) research makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish incremental refinements from true paradigm shifts. This review evaluates 22 of the most influential publications spanning nearly three decades (1997-2026), organized through a causal, chronologically anchored taxonomy centered on the author's birth year (1999). Beginning "before 1999" with how recurrent neural networks (RNNs) forgot earlier context (much like forgetting Chapter 1 by the time a reader reaches Chapter 9), we trace how Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks introduced a "bouncer" mechanism of forget, input, and output gates to selectively preserve long-term memory. We then examine how Word2Vec turned language into vector mathematics (king - male + female ~ queen), why sequential RNNs hit a parallelization wall, and how the Transformer's all-to-all attention weights launched the modern LLM era alongside a quadratic bottleneck. items.title_zh: 从梯度消失到递归自我完善：评估大型语言模型演化中最有影响力的论文（1997-2026）
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）研究的快速扩散使得区分增量改进和真正的范式转变变得越来越困难。这篇评论评估了近三十年（1997-2026）中最有影响力的 22 种出版物，通过以作者出生年份（1999 年）为中心的因果、按时间顺序分类的分类法进行组织。从“1999 年之前”开始，循环神经网络 (RNN) 如何忘记早期的上下文（就像读者读到第 9 章时忘记第 1 章一样），我们追踪长短期记忆 (LSTM) 网络如何引入遗忘、输入和输出门的“弹跳器”机制来选择性地保留长期记忆。然后，我们研究 Word2Vec 如何将语言转化为向量数学（王 - 男 + 女 - 王），为什么顺序 RNN 会遇到并行化墙，以及 Transformer 的全注意力权重如何在二次瓶颈的同时开启现代 LLM 时代。接下来，我们分析为什么单独缩放参数会导致容量训练不足，除非数据同等缩放（Chinchilla），人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）如何左对齐

items.title: Detectable Epistemic Attack Layers: A Coverage Theorem and Standardized Harness for Conversation-History Integrity
items.excerpt: Conversation history is infrastructure: deployed language models rely on application layers to store and reinject prior turns, and that stored state is writable. We formalize session-level contamination by attack layer, state a coverage theorem, and measure its scope: each deployment-layer verification tier covers exactly its layer and is sound with respect to the others; instruction overrides are not detectable without false positives; and composite vectors evade per-fragment verification. A standardized harness applied to eight mechanism families across 3,249 sessions and three model families makes these claims checkable. First, pattern-based detection pays a measured false-positive price: the classic defenses flag 35 to 50 percent of benign sessions, and the naive refusal floor reaches only 2.4 percent attack-cell adoption while destroying 33 to 100 percent of benign turns, whereas provenance-gated channel separation achieves adoption at or below 1.2 percent with zero false positives and zero utility loss. items.title_zh: 可检测的认知攻击层：覆盖定理和对话历史完整性的标准化工具
items.excerpt_zh: 对话历史是基础设施：部署的语言模型依赖于应用程序层来存储和重新注入先前的回合，并且存储的状态是可写的。我们将攻击层的会话级污染形式化，陈述覆盖定理，并测量其范围：每个部署层验证层完全覆盖其层，并且相对于其他层来说是健全的；在没有误报的情况下无法检测指令覆盖；和复合向量逃避每个片段的验证。标准化安全带应用于 3,249 个会话中的 8 个机制系列以及 3 个模型系列，使这些声明变得可验证。首先，基于模式的检测付出了可衡量的误报代价：经典防御标记了 35％ 至 50％ 的良性会话，天真的拒绝下限仅达到 2.4％ 的攻击单元采用率，同时破坏了 33％ 至 100％ 的良性转弯，而来源门控通道分离实现了 1.2％ 或以下的采用率，且零误报和零效用损失。其次，在探索性指令覆盖扩展中，门的边界是悬崖：指令被重新表述，没有形状 m

items.title: Does the Mixer Matter ? Paired-Seed Ablations of Tiny Bilingual Language Models
items.excerpt: We report paired-seed architecture ablations from the development of Sophea Artemis, our in-house Greek-English model family. Every arm trains on the same 3B targets with a shared tokenizer and recipe; models range from 54M to 759M total parameters and roughly 54M to 124M active parameters. The main finding is that, at this tiny scale, stored capacity matters far more than mixer design. On a fixed held-out test, replacing the dense feed-forward blocks of a recurrent/attention hybrid with sixteen routed experts, at nearly the same approximate active parameters, lowers loss by 0.079 (Greek) and 0.112 (English) nats per target, and doubling to 32 experts lowers it by a further 0.022 and 0.031, at every paired seed. Reusing a four-layer block three times recovers about 40-44% of the gap between a shallow and an independently deep model, consistent with looped-Transformer results. In contrast, the choice among grouped-query attention (GQA), Gated DeltaNet (GDN) hybrids and a Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) hybrid moves loss by only about 0.01-0.02 nats; a 1:1 GDN/GQA hybrid is the one dense variant that improves on GQA in both languages at ever
items.title_zh: 搅拌机重要吗？小型双语语言模型的配对种子消融
items.excerpt_zh: 我们报告了 Sophea Artemis（我们内部的希腊-英语模型系列）的开发中的配对种子架构消融。每只手臂都使用共享的标记器和配方在相同的 3B 目标上进行训练；模型的总参数范围为 54M 到 759M，活动参数大约为 54M 到 124M。主要发现是，在如此小的规模下，存储容量比混合器设计更重要。在固定保留测试中，用 16 个路由专家替换循环/注意力混合的密集前馈块，在几乎相同的近似活动参数下，每个目标的损失降低了 0.079（希腊语）和 0.112（英语）nats，并且加倍到 32 个专家，在每个配对种子处，损失进一步降低了 0.022 和 0.031。重复使用四层块三次可以恢复浅层模型和独立深层模型之间约 40-44% 的差距，这与循环 Transformer 结果一致。相比之下，在分组查询注意力 (GQA)、门控 DeltaNet (GDN) 混合模型和 Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) 混合模型之间进行选择，损失仅减少约 0.01-0.02 nat； 1:1 GDN/GQA 混合体是一种密集变体，它在两种语言中都改进了 GQA

items.title: Taming Fitch's and Humberstone's Paradoxes
items.excerpt: Fitch's Paradox says that if every true proposition is knowable, then every true proposition is known. Humberstone's Paradox states that if every true proposition is known by at least one of a set of finitely many agents, then some agent in that set knows every true proposition. Both paradoxes give rise to surprising and unacceptable consequences. In this paper, we diagnose a crucial tacit presupposition underlying these paradoxes, namely that the domain of propositions is closed under Boolean operations such as intersection and union, and offer a uniform resolution. We argue that the paradoxical inferences rely implicitly on this closure assumption. By adopting weak propositionally quantified modal logics that drop these closure conditions, we provide a semantically motivated account that blocks both paradoxes. The restriction on universal instantiation is not an ad hoc technical device, but reflects a conception of propositions as graspable objects of epistemic attitudes, on which the domain of propositions need not be closed under Boolean operations, since some Boolean combinations of graspable propositions may not themselves be gr
items.title_zh: 克服菲奇和亨伯斯通的悖论
items.excerpt_zh: 菲奇悖论说，如果每个真命题都是可知的，那么每个真命题都是已知的。亨伯斯通悖论指出，如果每个真命题都被一组有限多个智能体中的至少一个已知，那么该组中的某个智能体就知道每个真命题。这两个悖论都会产生令人惊讶且不可接受的后果。在本文中，我们诊断了这些悖论背后的一个关键的默认前提，即命题域在交集和并集等布尔运算下是封闭的，并提供了一个统一的解决方案。我们认为，矛盾的推论隐含地依赖于这种封闭假设。通过采用弱命题量化模态逻辑来放弃这些封闭条件，我们提供了一个语义动机的解释来阻止这两个悖论。对普遍实例化的限制不是一种特设的技术手段，而是反映了命题概念作为认知态度的可掌握对象，在该概念上，命题的域不需要在布尔运算下封闭，因为可掌握命题的某些布尔组合本身可能并不重要。

items.title: A logic of strong contingency
items.excerpt: In this paper, inspired by the notions of contingency and strong possibility, we propose a notion which may be called 'strong contingency'. This notion can be seen as a mixture of contingency and strong possibility. We investigate the logic with strong contingency as a sole primitive modality, including its bisimulation notion, expressivity, frame definability, and axiomatizations. It turns out that this logic is expressively incomparable with the standard modal logic and the logic of contingency even over the class of S5-models, and less expressive than the logic of strong possibility and weak necessity over the class of S5-models. Besides, as the introduction of the inequality into the semantics makes the completeness proof much harder, instead of showing the completeness via a canonical model construction, we reduce the soundness and strong completeness of the involved proof systems to those of the existing proof systems in the literature.
items.title_zh: 强偶然性逻辑
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，受偶然性和强可能性概念的启发，我们提出了一个可以称为“强偶然性”的概念。这个概念可以被视为偶然性和强烈可能性的混合体。我们研究具有强偶然性的逻辑作为唯一的原始模态，包括其互模拟概念、表达性、框架可定义性和公理化。事实证明，即使在S5模型类上，该逻辑在表现力上也无法与标准模态逻辑和偶然性逻辑相比，并且在S5模型类上也比强可能性弱必然性逻辑表现力差。此外，由于在语义中引入不等式使得完整性证明变得更加困难，因此我们没有通过规范模型构造来显示完整性，而是将所涉及的证明系统的健全性和强完整性降低到文献中现有证明系统的健全性和强完整性。

items.title: $Σ^1_3$ Gandy-Harrington Forcing
items.excerpt: Gandy-Harrington forcing is an important tool in descriptive set theory, first developed by Gandy and later used by Harrington to give a simple proof of Silver's dichotomy theorem. In this paper, we develop a new version of Gandy-Harrington forcing higher up in the projective hierarchy, under an appropriate local determinacy hypothesis. Using this new forcing, we prove a reverse mathematics result at the level of $\Delta^1_2$-Determinacy as well as new inner-model-theoretic basis theorem for $\Sigma^1_3$ sets.
items.authors: William Chan , Sandra Müller , Farmer Schlutzenberg , Benjamin Siskind
items.excerpt_zh: Gandy-Harrington 强迫是描述性集合论中的一个重要工具，首先由 Gandy 开发，后来被 Harrington 用于给出 Silver 二分定理的简单证明。在本文中，我们在适当的局部确定性假设下开发了甘迪-哈灵顿的新版本，在射影层次结构中强制向上。使用这种新的强迫，我们证明了 $\Delta^1_2$ 确定性水平上的逆向数学结果以及 $\Sigma^1_3$ 集合的新内模型理论基础定理。

items.title: The cardinal invariants of the $s$-dimensional Hausdorff null ideal are independent of $s$
items.excerpt: For $0 < s < 1$, let $\mathcal{N}^s$ denote the ideal of sets of $s$-dimensional Hausdorff measure zero. We prove that $\operatorname{cov}(\mathcal{N}^s) = \operatorname{cov}(\mathcal{N}^t)$ and $\operatorname{non}(\mathcal{N}^s) = \operatorname{non}(\mathcal{N}^t)$ for all $0 < s, t < 1$. The proof uses Ren and Wang's solution of the Furstenberg set conjecture. This answers open questions of Shelah--Stepr\=ans and Elekes--Stepr\=ans.
items.title_zh: $s$ 维 Hausdorff 零理想的基数不变量与 $s$ 无关
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 $0 < s < 1$，令 $\mathcal{N}^s$ 表示 $s$ 维 Hausdorff 测度为零的集合的理想值。我们证明 $\operatorname{cov}(\mathcal{N}^s) = \operatorname{cov}(\mathcal{N}^t)$ 和 $\operatorname{non}(\mathcal{N}^s) = \operatorname{non}(\mathcal{N}^t)$ 对于所有 $0 < s, t < 1$。证明使用Ren 和Wang 对Furstenberg 集合猜想的解。这回答了 Shelah--Stepr\=ans 和 Elekes--Stepr\=ans 的开放问题。

items.title: On the uniformity of definably amenable radicals and dfg-fsg decompositions in $p$-adically closed fields
items.excerpt: For definable families of groups over $p$-adically closed fields, we show that the definably amenable radicals and their dfg-fsg decompositions can be defined uniformly as the prime $p$ and the family parameters vary.
items.title_zh: 关于 $p$-adically 闭域中可定义的顺从根式和 dfg-fsg 分解的均匀性
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 $p$-adically 闭域上的可定义群族，我们证明当质数 $p$ 和族参数变化时，可定义的根式及其 dfg-fsg 分解可以统一定义。

items.title: $\mathbb{C}(t)$ has the strict order property
items.excerpt: Let $(E, P)$, $(E', P')$ be elliptic curves over $\mathbb{C}$ with marked $p$-torsion points; a marked isogeny is an isogeny sending $P$ to $P'$. We show the marked isogeny relation is interpretable in $\mathbb{C}(t)$ and has strict infinite chains. It follows that $\mathbb{C}(t)$ has the strict order property, which confirms a special case of the stable fields conjecture.
items.title_zh: $\mathbb{C}(t)$ 具有严格的顺序属性
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $(E, P)$、$(E', P')$ 为 $\mathbb{C}$ 上带有标记 $p$ 扭转点的椭圆曲线；标记的同源是将 $P$ 发送到 $P'$ 的同源。我们证明标记的同源关系可以在 $\mathbb{C}(t)$ 中解释，并且具有严格的无限链。由此可见 $\mathbb{C}(t)$ 具有严格的顺序性质，这证实了稳定场猜想的特殊情况。

items.title: LeanReviewBench: Semantic Alignment Review in Mathematical Lean Projects
items.excerpt: Lean verifies that a proof establishes its formal proposition, but whether that proposition preserves the mathematical content of an informal source requires separate review. In project-scale formalizations, this correspondence can depend on definitions and constraints distributed across many declarations. We introduce LeanReviewBench, a benchmark for project-level semantic alignment review containing 197 versioned inputs collected from 18 real Lean projects, with 87 aligned and 110 misaligned reference judgments. Each input binds an informal mathematical target to selected formal declarations and an extracted dependency context. Construction combines development-history discovery, independent target binding, reconstruction under a common Lean environment, and Astra annotation with human review of uncertain cases. The collection spans diverse mathematical domains and includes 69 historical pairs. We evaluate six language models with Direct and ReForm prompts on all 197 inputs against final human-reviewed reference labels. GPT-6.1 Sol with Direct prompting achieves the highest reported accuracy of 0.827 and misalignment-detection F1 of
items.authors: Ruichen Qiu , Hao Shen , Lihong Zhi , Xiao-Shan Gao
items.title_zh: LeanReviewBench：数学精益项目中的语义对齐审查
items.excerpt_zh: 精益验证证明是否建立了其正式命题，但该命题是否保留了非正式来源的数学内容需要单独审查。在项目规模的形式化中，这种对应关系可能取决于分布在许多声明中的定义和约束。我们引入了 LeanReviewBench，这是一个项目级语义对齐审查的基准，包含从 18 个真实精益项目收集的 197 个版本化输入，其中有 87 个对齐和 110 个未对齐的参考判断。每个输入将一个非正式的数学目标绑定到选定的正式声明和提取的依赖上下文。构建结合了开发历史发现、独立目标绑定、共同精益环境下的重建以及 Astra 注释和不确定案例的人工审查。该集合跨越不同的数学领域，包括 69 个历史对。我们根据最终人工审核的参考标签，对所有 197 个输入使用 Direct 和 ReForm 提示评估了六种语言模型。具有直接提示的 GPT-6.1 Sol 实现了 0.827 的最高报告准确度和 0.827 的错位检测 F1

items.title: Square-root cancellation in three hyperbolic counting problems via maximal estimates
items.excerpt: We study three counting problems for lattice orbits in hyperbolic space: counting orbit points within a prescribed distance of a fixed closed geodesic or a totally geodesic hyperplane, and counting orbit points above a prescribed height at a cusp. For almost every base point, we obtain error bounds of square-root size up to logarithmic factors. For the geodesic and hyperplane counts, these bounds match the conjectured exponents and improve earlier results due to Good and Laaksonen. For these two problems, we adapt the method of maximal estimates developed by Chatzakos and Dimakis for hyperbolic lattice counting, formulating it in both a discrete and a continuous framework. For the hyperplane problem, we also obtain an asymptotic formula for the spatial second moment of the error term, involving an almost periodic function. For the cusp problem, the square-root bound can be deduced from work of Yu, which incorporates Schmidt's dyadic maximal argument. We present a proof, together with an $\Omega$-result supporting the optimality of the exponent $1/2$ for at least one cusp of any group that is not essentially cuspidal. In contrast, for
items.title_zh: 通过最大估计消除三个双曲计数问题的平方根

items.title: On generation of the coefficient field of a primitive HMF by a single Fourier coefficient: An application of Nekov\'a\v{r}'s Theorem
items.excerpt: Let $f$ be a non-CM primitive Hilbert modular form (HMF) over a totally real number field, of parallel even weight $k\geq 2$, with coefficient field $E_f$, and let $F_f \subseteq E_f$ denote the field fixed by the inner twists of $f$. In this article, we establish an analogue of Ribet's large image theorem for the residual Galois representations associated with $f$, by applying Nekov\'a\v{r}'s large image theorem (cf.~\cite[Theorem B.5.2]{Nek12}) to the automorphic representation $\pi(f)$ associated with $f$. As a result, we prove that if $f$ has no nontrivial inner twists, then $E_f$ is generated by a single prime Fourier coefficient, for a set of prime ideals of Dirichlet density one. We derive this result as a consequence of a more general theorem established for $F_f$.
items.title_zh: 关于用单个傅里叶系数生成本原 HMF 的系数域：Nekov\'a\v{r} 定理的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $f$ 为全实数域上的非 CM 本原希尔伯特模形式 (HMF)，并行偶权重 $k\geq 2$，系数域为 $E_f$，并令 $F_f \subseteq E_f$ 表示由 $f$ 的内部扭曲固定的域。在本文中，我们通过将 Nekov\'a\v{r} 的大图像定理（参见~\cite[定理 B.5.2]{Nek12}）应用于与 $f$ 相关的自同构表示 $\pi(f)$，为与 $f$ 相关的剩余伽罗瓦表示建立了 Ribet 大图像定理的模拟。因此，我们证明，如果 $f$ 没有非平凡的内部扭曲，那么对于狄利克雷密度为 1 的一组素数理想，$E_f$ 是由单个素数傅里叶系数生成的。我们得出这个结果是为 $F_f$ 建立的更一般定理的结果。

items.title: An explicit Cassels--Tate pairing in characteristic $2$ and the parity of $2$-Selmer ranks
items.excerpt: Let $K$ be a global field of characteristic $2$ and $\varphi\colon E\to E'$ the Verschiebung of an ordinary elliptic curve $E/K$ with a rational point of order $2$. We prove an explicit formula for the homogeneous-space Cassels--Tate pairing on $\Sha(E/K)[\varphi]$ as a sum of local Artin--Schreier symbols, show that it coincides with Kramer's descent pairing and, on $\Sha(E/K)[\varphi]$, with the pairing induced by Milne's flat duality, and deduce that it is non-degenerate on $\Sha(E/K)[\varphi]/\hat\varphi(\Sha(E'/K)[2])$. For every ordinary elliptic curve $A/K$ we express the parity of $\mathrm{rk}\,A(K)+\dim\Sha(A/K)[2]$ by local terms (after Kramer), and identify these with local root numbers at places of semistable or potentially multiplicative reduction, and in further cases using curves with finite $\Sha$. We determine $\Sha$ in examples, and extend the formula to rational points of any prime order $\ell$, the new case being $\ell=\operatorname{char}K$.
items.title_zh: 特征 $2$ 中的显式 Cassels--Tate 配对和 $2$-Selmer 等级的奇偶性
items.excerpt_zh: 令$K$ 为特征$2$ 的全局域，$\varphi\colon E\to E'$ 为具有有理阶点$2$ 的普通椭圆曲线$E/K$ 的Verschiebung。我们证明了 $\Sha(E/K)[\varphi]$ 上齐次空间 Cassels--Tate 配对作为局部 Artin--Schreier 符号之和的显式公式，表明它与 Kramer 下降配对一致，并且在 $\Sha(E/K)[\varphi]$ 上与 Milne 平坦对偶性引起的配对一致，并推断它在$\Sha(E/K)[\varphi]/\hat\varphi(\Sha(E'/K)[2])$.对于每条普通椭圆曲线 $A/K$，我们用局部项（Kramer 之后）表示 $\mathrm{rk}\,A(K)+\dim\Sha(A/K)[2]$ 的奇偶性，并用半稳定或潜在乘性约简处的局部根数来识别这些曲线，并在进一步的情况下使用具有有限 $\Sha$ 的曲线。我们在例子中确定$\Sha$，并将公式扩展到任何素数阶$\ell$的有理点，新的情况是$\ell=\operatorname{char}K$。

items.title: The maximum area of a snake polyomino in a $12 \times n$ rectangle

items.title: Extremal Ky Fan $p$-$k$ norms of graphs
items.excerpt: We study a two-parameter extension of Nikiforov's extremal problems for graph norms, focusing on the quantity $$ S_{p,k}(G) = \left(\sum_{i=1}^{k}\sigma_i(G)^p\right)^{1/p}, $$ where $p\ge1$, and $\sigma_1(G) \ge \cdots \ge \sigma_n(G)$ are the singular values of the adjacency matrix of an $n$-vertex graph $G$. This quantity provides a common generalization of the Ky Fan $k$-norm and the Schatten $p$-norm, which correspond to the cases $p=1$ and $k=n$, respectively. We establish upper and lower bounds and characterize extremal and near-extremal graphs within specified parameter ranges. For each fixed $k \ge 4$, we determine an explicit exponent $\vartheta_k \in [1,2)$ such that the balanced complete $k$-partite graph is the unique maximizer for all sufficiently large orders, and we characterize the unique graph attaining the second-largest value. In particular, this determines the maximum Ky Fan $4$-norm for all sufficiently large orders. items.title_zh: 极值 Ky Fan $p$-$k$ 图表范数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究图范数的 Nikiforov 极值问题的二参数扩展，重点关注数量 $$ S_{p,k}(G) = \left(\sum_{i=1}^{k}\sigma_i(G)^p\right)^{1/p}、$$ where $p\ge1$ 和 $\sigma_1(G) \ge \cdots \ge \sigma_n(G)$是 $n$ 顶点图 $G$ 的邻接矩阵的奇异值。该量提供了 Ky Fan $k$-norm 和 Schatten $p$-norm 的通用概括，分别对应于 $p=1$ 和 $k=n$ 的情况。我们建立上限和下限，并表征指定参数范围内的极值和近极值图。对于每个固定的$k \ge 4$，我们确定一个显式指数$\vartheta_k \in [1,2)$，使得平衡的完整$k$分图是所有足够大的阶的唯一最大化，并且我们描述获得第二大值的唯一图。特别是，这决定了所有足够大的订单的最大 Ky Fan 4 美元标准。在这些指数下，任何具有来自 Tur\'{a}n 图的边计数的固定边赤字的最大化器都属于完全 $k$ 分图的显式有限族（只要存在这样的实现）

items.title: The Manhattan cospectrality of the cocktail party graph
items.excerpt: For a graph $G$ of order $N$ with adjacency eigenvalues $\lambda_{1}(G)\geq \cdots\geq\lambda_{N}(G),$ the cospectrality of $G$ is the smallest value of $\sum_{i}\left\vert \lambda_{i}(G)-\lambda_{i}(H)\right\vert $ over all graphs $H$ of order $N$ not isomorphic to $G.$ Abdollahi and Zakeri (Ars Math. Contemp. 22(1) (2022) P1.06) conjectured that the cospectrality of the cocktail party graph $CP_{n}$ is attained exactly at the graph $H_{n}.$ This graph is obtained from $K_{1,2,\ldots,2}$ by attaching a pendant vertex to the vertex of the part of size one. We prove this conjecture for every $n\geq2$ by showing that only three explicit graphs (two for $n=2$) are at distance less than $2$ from $CP_{n}.$ We work with the complement of a competing graph. First we remove its components $K_{2}.$ Then we treat the case in which its main component has a dominating vertex. The remaining cases are reduced to finitely many small graphs. The proof is computer-assisted, and all computations concern explicit finite lists of graphs.

items.title: Detour different-distance sets in graphs
items.excerpt: The detour distance $D(u,v)$ between two vertices of a connected graph is the length of a longest $u,v$-path. A set $S$ of vertices is a detour different-distance set if no vertex outside $S$ has the same detour distance to two vertices of $S$. We study the lower and upper detour different-distance numbers $\mathrm{dd}_D(G)$ and $\mathrm{DD}_D(G)$, the smallest and largest orders of maximal such sets; this is the detour analogue of the different-distance sets of Hedetniemi, Hedetniemi, Laskar and Mulder. The two notions coincide on trees, cycles, complete bipartite graphs and the Petersen graph, but differ in general: for instance, detour different-distance sets may contain triangles or induce $4$-cycles. We determine both numbers for many families, among them wheels, fans, windmills, hypercubes, helms, flowers, books, ladders, prisms, M\"obius ladders, crowns, gears, Dutch windmills and complete multipartite graphs, and for joins, coronas and lexicographic products. We prove that $\mathrm{DD}_D(G)$ is at most the detour diameter; that $\mathrm{DD}_D(G)=n-1$ if and only if $G$ is a path; that $\mathrm{dd}_D(G)=\mathrm{DD}_D(G)=1$ when
items.title_zh: 绕行图中的不同距离集
items.excerpt_zh: 连接图两个顶点之间的绕行距离 $D(u,v)$ 是最长 $u,v$ 路径的长度。如果 $S$ 之外的任何顶点到 $S$ 的两个顶点的绕行距离都相同，则顶点集 $S$ 是绕行不同距离集。我们研究下绕道和上绕道不同距离数 $\mathrm{dd}_D(G)$ 和 $\mathrm{DD}_D(G)$，即最大此类集合的最小和最大阶；这是 Hedetniemi、Hedetniemi、Laskar 和 Mulder 的不同距离集的绕行模拟。这两个概念在树、循环、完全二分图和 Petersen 图上一致，但总体上有所不同：例如，绕行不同距离集可能包含三角形或引发 $4$ 循环。我们确定了许多家庭的两个数字，其中包括轮子、风扇、风车、超立方体、舵、花、书籍、梯子、棱镜、M\"obius 梯子、王冠、齿轮、荷兰风车和完整的多部分图，以及连接、电晕和字典乘积。我们证明 $\mathrm{DD}_D(G)$ 至多是绕道直径； $\mathrm{DD}_D(G)=n-1$ 当且仅当 $G$ 是路径；$\mathrm{dd}_D(G)=\mathrm{DD}_D(G)=1$ 时

items.title: M\"obius expansion and pointwise energy transfer over arbitrary fields
items.excerpt: Let $F$ be a field of positive characteristic $p$, and let $A\subset F^\times$ have $N$ elements. We prove that, for every $\lambda\in F^\times$, \[ \card{A+\lambda A^{-1}}\gg\min\{N^{10/9},(pN^2)^{1/3}\}. \] This improves the exponent $31/30$ to $10/9$ in the common small-set range. Over prime fields the bound strengthens to $\min\{N^{10/9},(pN)^{1/2}\}$. Analogous bounds hold for $Af(A)$ when $f$ is a M\"obius transformation satisfying the stated nondegeneracy conditions. In characteristic zero, the bound $N^{10/9}$ remains valid. No subfield-avoidance condition is required.
items.title_zh: M\"obius 展开和任意场上的逐点能量转移
items.excerpt_zh: 令$F$为正特征$p$的字段，并令$A\子集F^\times$有$N$个元素。我们证明，对于每个 $\lambda\in F^\times$，\[ \card{A+\lambda A^{-1}}\gg\min\{N^{10/9},(pN^2)^{1/3}\}。 \] 这将常见小集范围内的指数 $31/30$ 提高到 $10/9$。在素数域上，界限增强到 $\min\{N^{10/9},(pN)^{1/2}\}$。当 $f$ 是满足规定的非简并条件的 M\"obius 变换时，类似的界限也适用于 $Af(A)$。在特征零中，界限 $N^{10/9}$ 仍然有效。不需要子字段避免条件。

items.title: On the number of edge-disjoint $K_r$ in $K_{r+1}$-free graphs
items.excerpt: Gy\H ori and Keszegh [\emph{Combinatorica} \textbf{37} (2017), 1113--1124] proved that every $K_4$-free graph on $n$ vertices with $\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor+k$ edges contains at least $k$ pairwise edge-disjoint triangles. We extend this result to cliques of arbitrary fixed order. Specifically, we prove that for every fixed integer $r\ge 3$ and all sufficiently large $n$, every $K_{r+1}$-free graph on $n$ vertices with $t_{r-1}(n)+k$ edges contains at least $k$ pairwise edge-disjoint copies of $K_r$, where $t_{r-1}(n)$ denotes the number of edges in the Tur\'an graph $T_{r-1}(n)$. Moreover, equality holds if and only if $G$ is obtained from $T_{r-1}(n)$ by adding edges within one of its parts, with the added edges forming a triangle-free graph.
items.title_zh: 关于$K_{r+1}$无图中边不相交$K_r$的数量
items.excerpt_zh: Gy\H ori 和 Keszegh [\emph{Combinatorica} \textbf{37} (2017), 1113--1124] 证明，$n$ 个顶点上具有 $\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor+k$ 边的每个 $K_4$ 无图包含至少 $k$ 个成对的边不相交三角形。我们将此结果扩展到任意固定顺序的派系。具体来说，我们证明，对于每个固定整数 $r\ge 3$ 和所有足够大的 $n$，具有 $t_{r-1}(n)+k$ 边的 $n$ 顶点上的每个 $K_{r+1}$ 无图包含 $K_r$ 的至少 $k$ 成对边不相交副本，其中 $t_{r-1}(n)$ 表示 Tur\'an 图中的边数$T_{r-1}(n)$。此外，当且仅当 $G$ 是通过在 $T_{r-1}(n)$ 的一部分内添加边而获得的，且添加的边形成无三角形图时，等式才成立。

items.title: Partial sums of Rogers-Ramanujan functions
items.excerpt: Explicit positive multisums on base q^5 for the Rogers-Ramanujan sum function and its partial sum are given. 32 combinatorial interpretations for these identities are given. The classical mod 5 Rogers-Ramanujan identities are recovered as a limiting case. These results are equivalent to a quintic basic hypergeometric identity.
items.title_zh: Rogers-Ramanujan 函数的部分和
items.excerpt_zh: 给出了 Rogers-Ramanujan 和函数及其部分和的基于 q^5 的显式正多重和。给出了这些恒等式的 32 种组合解释。经典 mod 5 Rogers-Ramanujan 恒等式被恢复为极限情况。这些结果相当于五次基本超几何恒等式。

items.title: Connected Cayley Approximation of Power Graphs of Finite Groups
items.excerpt: For a nontrivial finite group \(G\), we define its connected intersection density as the maximum, over all connected Cayley graphs on \(G\), of the proportion of edges that also belong to the undirected power graph of \(G\). We show that this density is \(1\) if and only if \(G\) is cyclic, and that it is \(1/4\), \(1/6\), and \(1/12\) for \(A_4\), \(S_4\), and \(A_5\), respectively. For the dihedral group of order \(2n\), with \(n\geq 3\), we give a general formula and show that the connected intersection density equals \((\binom{n}{2}+1)/n^2\) if and only if \(n\) is a prime power. We also give a formula for the connected intersection density of dicyclic groups. For generalized quaternion groups of order \(2N\), where \(N=2^{m-1}\geq 4\), the density is \(\frac{N^2+8}{2N(N+1)}\). For the elementary abelian group \(C_p^r\), where \(p\) is prime and \(r\geq 1\), the density is \(p^{1-r}\).
items.title_zh: 有限群幂图的连通凯莱近似
items.excerpt_zh: 对于非平凡有限群 \(G\)，我们将其连通交集密度定义为 \(G\) 上所有连通凯莱图上也属于 \(G\) 无向幂图的边比例的最大值。我们证明，当且仅当 \(G\) 是循环时，该密度为 \(1\)，并且对于 \(A_4\)、\(S_4\) 和 \(A_5\) 分别为 \(1/4\)、\(1/6\) 和 \(1/12\)。对于阶数为 \(2n\) 且 \(n\geq 3\) 的二面体群，我们给出一个通用公式并表明，当且仅当 \(n\) 是素数幂时，连通交集密度等于 \((\binom{n}{2}+1)/n^2\)。我们还给出了双环基团的连通交叉密度的公式。对于 \(2N\) 阶广义四元数群，其中 \(N=2^{m-1}\geq 4\)，密度为 \(\frac{N^2+8}{2N(N+1)}\)。对于初等阿贝尔群 \(C_p^r\)，其中 \(p\) 是素数且 \(r\geq 1\)，密度为 \(p^{1-r}\)。

items.title: Arinkin's sheaf and Hilbert schemes
items.excerpt: Arinkin's sheaf gives a relative Fourier-Mukai autoequivalence of a general Beauville-Mukai system, extending the usual Poincar\'e bundle over the smooth locus. We provide an alternative construction of it as a deformation of the Fourier-Mukai autoequivalence on the Hilbert scheme of an elliptic K3 surface obtained by lifting the classical Poincar\'e kernel for an elliptic surface. As applications, we show that the $P=C$ property for a general Beauville-Mukai system is equivalent to that for the Hilbert scheme fibration, thus providing new proofs for both. We also construct an explicit deformation that connects Markman's construction of a projectively hyperholomorphic bundle on products of hyper-K\"ahler manifolds of K3${}^{[g]}$-type to that of Hartlieb and Shah. This answers a question of Hartlieb and Shah.
items.title_zh: 阿林金的束和希尔伯特方案
items.excerpt_zh: 阿林金的束给出了一般 Beauville-Mukai 系统的相对 Fourier-Mukai 自等价性，将通常的 Poincar'e 丛延伸到光滑轨迹上。我们提供了它的另一种构造，作为通过提升椭圆曲面的经典庞加莱核而获得的椭圆 K3 曲面的希尔伯特方案上的 Fourier-Mukai 自等价性的变形。作为应用，我们证明了一般 Beauville-Mukai 系统的 $P=C$ 性质与 Hilbert 方案纤维化的性质等效，从而为两者提供了新的证明。我们还构造了一个显式变形，将马克曼对 K3${}^{[g]}$ 型超 K\"ahler 流形乘积的射影超全纯丛的构造与 Hartlieb 和 Shah 的构造联系起来。这回答了 Hartlieb 和 Shah 的问题。

items.title: Opposite filtrations on the parabolic compactified Jacobian
items.excerpt: We show that the Hikita filtration on the cohomology of the parabolic compactified Jacobian of the plane curve singularity $x^m=y^n$, $(m,n)=1$, is opposite to the perverse filtration in a precise sense. This implies the parabolic Hilb-vs-Quot conjecture from https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.19633, and consequently the main conjecture from https://arxiv.org/abs/1201.2115 for these singularities. The new ingredient is an analysis of how the Bott-Mitchell filtration on the homology of the affine Grassmannian of $SL_n$ relates to both of the above filtrations.
items.title_zh: 抛物线紧缩雅可比行列式的相反过滤
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了平面曲线奇异点$x^m=y^n$、$(m,n)=1$的抛物线紧致雅可比行列式上同调的Hikita过滤与精确意义上的反常过滤相反。这意味着来自 https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.19633 的抛物线 Hilb-vs-Quot 猜想，以及来自 https://arxiv.org/abs/1201.2115 对这些奇点的主要猜想。新成分是对 $SL_n$ 仿射格拉斯曼同源性的 Bott-Mitchell 过滤如何与上述两种过滤相关的分析。

items.title: Tensor products of additive groups as reciprocity sheaves
items.excerpt: We compute the Nisnevich reciprocity sheaves associated with tensor products of the cube-invariant objects for the additive and multiplicative groups, with at least one additive factor. Over a perfect field of characteristic different from two, these sheaves decompose into direct sums of absolute K$\"a$hler differential sheaves with binomial multiplicities. As an application, we compute the associated reciprocity sheaves of the Hochschild homology of the additive object.
items.title_zh: 作为互易滑轮的加法群的张量积
items.excerpt_zh: 我们计算与加法群和乘法群的立方不变对象的张量积相关的尼斯涅维奇互易滑轮，至少有一个加法因子。在不同于两个的完美特征场上，这些滑轮分解为具有二项式重数的绝对 K$\"a$hler 微分滑轮的直和。作为一个应用，我们计算加性对象的 Hochschild 同调性的相关互易滑轮。

items.title: Calabi-Yau at 50: mathematical discovery in the age of AI
items.excerpt: Using the golden jubilee of Yau's proof of the Calabi conjecture as a spring-board, we discuss how the dataset of Calabi-Yau manifolds brought together mathematicians and physicists since the 1980s, and then further brought in the world of machine-learning and AI since 2017. We give a historical account on the growth of the field of ``AI-assisted mathematics'' in the last decade, and comment on what culminated in 2026 as perhaps the most dramatic year in the history of mathematics since Euclid.
items.title_zh: 卡拉比-丘 50 岁：人工智能时代的数学发现
items.excerpt_zh: 以丘证明卡拉比猜想的金禧年为跳板，我们讨论了卡拉比-丘流形数据集如何将 20 世纪 80 年代以来的数学家和物理学家聚集在一起，然后自 2017 年以来进一步引入机器学习和人工智能的世界。我们对过去十年“人工智能辅助数学”领域的发展进行了历史叙述，并对 2026 年达到顶峰的情况进行了评论这也许是自欧几里得以来数学史上最戏剧性的一年。

items.title: Period maps and the $C_{\rm st}$ conjecture
items.excerpt: We construct a family of elliptic curves over an open disc whose total space violates the $C_{\mathrm{st}}$ conjecture in degree $1$. Hence the conjecture, known for proper and for Stein varieties, as well as for products of such, does not extend to proper families over Stein bases. This is an instance of a general criterion: the $C_{\mathrm{st}}$ conjecture holds for the total space of a smooth proper family over a sufficiently small open disc if and only if its period map is constant, i.e., all Gauss--Manin Higgs fields vanish or, equivalently, the $p$-adic local systems $R^if_*\mathbf{Q}_p$ are geometrically constant. This criterion is special to curves: over a $2$-dimensional polydisc, we give a family of $p$-adic analogues of non-K\"ahler elliptic surfaces whose period maps and local systems are constant, but whose total space violates the conjecture.
items.authors: Pierre Colmez, Wies{\l}awa Nizio{\l}, Xinyu Shao
items.title_zh: 周期图和 $C_{\rm st}$ 猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在一个开圆盘上构建了一系列椭圆曲线，其总空间违反了 $1$ 度的 $C_{\mathrm{st}}$ 猜想。因此，以真系和斯坦因变种及其产物而闻名的猜想，并没有扩展到斯坦因基础上的真系。这是一般准则的一个实例：$C_{\mathrm{st}}$ 猜想适用于足够小的开放圆盘上的光滑固有族的总空间，当且仅当其周期图是恒定的，即所有高斯-马宁希格斯场消失，或者等效地，$p$-adic 局部系统 $R^if_*\mathbf{Q}_p$ 是几何常数。这个标准对于曲线来说是特殊的：在 $2$ 维多圆盘上，我们给出了一系列非 K\"ahler 椭圆面的 $p$-adic 类似物，其周期图和局部系统是恒定的，但其总空间违反了猜想。

items.title: Demazure-Lusztig type operators and correspondences on Kato Catalan varieties
items.excerpt: We study the integral equivariant cohomology rings of Kato Catalan varieties $\mathscr{X}_\Psi$ associated with arbitrary root ideals $\Psi$ in type $A$. These varieties are smooth projective compactifications of the vector subbundles $T^*_\Psi\mathcal{B}$ of the cotangent bundle of the complete flag variety $\mathcal{B}$. Let $K$ denote the product of the general linear group (or its maximal torus) with the loop rotation torus $\mathbb{C}^\times$. We give an explicit presentation of $H^*_K(\mathscr{X}_\Psi;\mathbb{Z})$ with relations expressed in terms of divided difference and Demazure-Lusztig type operators. Furthermore, for every simple reflection preserving $\Psi\cup(-\Psi)$, we construct a geometric realization of the associated Demazure-Lusztig type operator on $H^*_K(\mathscr{X}_\Psi;\mathbb{Z})$ via correspondences. These correspondences yield a faithful graded action of the subalgebra of the degenerate affine Hecke algebra generated by these reflections and the polynomial subalgebra. For the maximal root ideal $\Psi=\Delta^+$, our construction recovers the cohomological counterpart of the $K$-theoretic Steinberg corresponden
items.title_zh: Demazure-Lusztig 型算子和 Kato Catalan 品种的对应关系
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了 Kato Catalan 变种 $\mathscr{X}_\Psi$ 的积分等变上同调环与 $A$ 类型中的任意根理想 $\Psi$ 相关。这些簇是完全旗簇 $\mathcal{B}$ 的余切丛的向量子丛 $T^*_\Psi\mathcal{B}$ 的平滑射影紧化。令 $K$ 表示一般线性群（或其最大环面）与循环旋转环面 $\mathbb{C}^\times$ 的乘积。我们给出了 $H^*_K(\mathscr{X}_\Psi;\mathbb{Z})$ 的显式表示，其关系以除差和 Demazure-Lusztig 类型运算符表示。此外，对于保留 $\Psi\cup(-\Psi)$ 的每个简单反射，我们通过对应关系在 $H^*_K(\mathscr{X}_\Psi;\mathbb{Z})$ 上构造关联的 Demazure-Lusztig 类型运算符的几何实现。这些对应关系产生由这些反射生成的简并仿射赫克代数的子代数和多项式子代数的忠实分级作用。对于最大根理想 $\Psi=\Delta^+$，我们的构造恢复了 $K$ 理论 Steinberg 对应的上同调对应项

items.title: Combinatorial relative orientability for toric and tropical geometry
items.excerpt: Many problems in enumerative geometry are solved by computing the degree of the top Chern class of a suitable vector bundle. Results from $\mathbb{A}^1$-homotopy theory allow to answer enumerative questions over arbitrary fields, replacing the top Chern class by the Euler class in Chow-Witt groups. For its degree to be well-defined, one needs the vector bundle to be relatively oriented. Another way to solve enumerative problems is to translate them to tropical geometry, where they become combinatorial problems. In this paper, we give a combinatorial description of relative orientability for vector bundles over smooth proper toric varieties. We show that it behaves well under tropicalization, establishing a tropical version of relative orientability, which will allow to the use of tropical geometry to answer enumerative questions over arbitrary fields. As a demonstration, we prove a quadratically enriched version of the Bernstein-Khovanskii-Kushnirenko theorem via tropical geometry. Lastly, we define the notion of $k$-phase structures on tropical hypersurfaces, generalizing the real case.
items.title_zh: 环面和热带几何的组合相对定向性
items.excerpt_zh: 枚举几何中的许多问题都是通过计算合适向量丛的顶陈类的度来解决的。 $\mathbb{A}^1$-同伦理论的结果允许回答任意域上的枚举问题，用 Chow-Witt 群中的 Euler 类替换顶级 Chern 类。为了明确定义其度数，需要向量丛具有相对定向。解决枚举问题的另一种方法是将它们转化为热带几何，在那里它们成为组合问题。在本文中，我们给出了光滑固有复曲面簇上矢量丛的相对定向性的组合描述。我们证明它在热带化下表现良好，建立了热带版本的相对定向性，这将允许使用热带几何来回答任意字段上的枚举问题。作为演示，我们通过热带几何证明了伯恩斯坦-霍万斯基-库什尼连科定理的二次丰富版本。最后，我们定义了热带超曲面上 $k$ 相结构的概念，概括了实际情况。

items.title: Chern classes, Poincar\'e polynomials, and Bernstein-Sato polynomials of plane curves
items.excerpt: We show that the Poincar\'e polynomial of a reduced plane curve $C$ is the Chern polynomial of the dual of the bundle of Jacobian syzygies of $C$. Using the Zeuthen-Segre formula, we prove that its value at $t=-1$ equals the Euler number of the complement of $C$ up to the correction term $\mu(C)-\tau(C)$, so the two numbers coincide if and only if all singularities of $C$ are quasi-homogeneous. As applications, we show that the defect in a combinatorial inequality for free $d$-arrangements is the square of the difference of the exponents, extend the addition technique to arbitrary reduced plane curves, and locate the roots of local Bernstein-Sato polynomials at ordinary singular points.
items.title_zh: 平面曲线的陈氏类、庞加莱多项式和 Bernstein-Sato 多项式
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，简化平面曲线 $C$ 的庞加莱多项式是 $C$ 的雅可比对称丛的对偶陈多项式。使用 Zeuthen-Segre 公式，我们证明它在 $t=-1$ 处的值等于 $C$ 的补集到校正项 $\mu(C)-\tau(C)$ 的欧拉数，因此当且仅当 $C$ 的所有奇点都是拟齐次时，这两个数才重合。作为应用，我们证明了自由 $d$ 排列的组合不等式的缺陷是指数差的平方，将加法技术扩展到任意简化平面曲线，并在普通奇异点处定位局部 Bernstein-Sato 多项式的根。

items.title: Uniformising random greedy maximal independent sets on graphs with at most five vertices
items.excerpt: A random greedy algorithm scans the vertices of a finite graph in increasing order of independent exponential arrival times and accepts each vertex unless an accepted neighbour blocks it. We ask an inverse question: can strictly positive finite arrival rates be chosen so that the terminal inclusion-maximal independent sets are all equally likely? We call this exact property exponential greedy uniformisability (EGU). We establish the complete small-order classification: every finite simple graph on at most five vertices is EGU, with the unique exception of the five-vertex path $P_5$ up to graph isomorphism. A strict $2\times2$ probability minor provides an explicit obstruction for the exceptional graph; the positive cases are certified by graph-isomorphism reduction and exact constructive witnesses. We explain the independent-exponential-clock probability law and the formal Lean 4 verification, registered as Palomar PALOMAR-2026-11-19-000021 (version 1). The registration is a formal proof record, not a claim of novelty certification or journal peer review.
items.title_zh: 均匀化最多五个顶点的图上的随机贪婪最大独立集
items.excerpt_zh: 随机贪婪算法以独立指数到达时间的递增顺序扫描有限图的顶点，并接受每个顶点，除非接受的邻居阻止它。我们提出一个反问题：是否可以选择严格正的有限到达率，以便终端包含最大独立集都具有相同的可能性？我们将这种精确属性称为指数贪婪均匀性（EGU）。我们建立完整的小阶分类：最多五个顶点上的每个有限简单图都是 EGU，唯一的例外是五顶点路径 $P_5$ 直到图同构。严格的 $2\times2$ 概率小数为异常图提供了明确的障碍；正例通过图同构约简和精确的建设性见证来证明。我们解释了独立指数时钟概率定律和正式的 Lean 4 验证，注册号为 Palomar PALOMAR-2026-11-19-000021（版本 1）。注册是正式的证明记录，而不是新颖性认证或期刊同行评审的声明。

items.title: Semigroup Hessian Estimates for Underdamped Langevin Dynamics
items.excerpt:
For the semigroup $e^{t\mathcal L}$ of the underdamped Langevin dynamics, we bound the Hessian $
abla^2(e^{t\mathcal L}f)$ when $
abla f$ is uniformly bounded. When the potential is strongly convex outside a ball and has bounded second and third derivatives, and the damping rate is above an explicit threshold, the bounds on $
abla^2(e^{t\mathcal L}f)$ decay exponentially in time with constants free of the dimension. The proof combines the Wasserstein contraction of the dynamics with a Bismut--Elworthy--Li formula for the degenerate noise. As an application, we prove the uniform-in-time error of the stochastic gradient UBU integrator, with an explicit coefficient of the numerical bias in the step size, proportional to the covariance of the stochastic gradient noise.
items.title_zh: 欠阻尼 Langevin 动力学的半群 Hessian 估计
items.excerpt_zh:
对于欠阻尼 Langevin 动力学的半群 $e^{t\mathcal L}$，当 $
abla f$ 一致有界时，我们限制 Hessian $
abla^2(e^{t\mathcal L}f)$。当势在球外强烈凸且具有有界二阶和三阶导数，并且阻尼率高于显式阈值时，$
abla^2(e^{t\mathcal L}f)$ 上的边界随时间呈指数衰减，常数不受维度影响。该证明将动力学的 Wasserstein 收缩与简并噪声的 Bismut--Elworthy--Li 公式结合起来。作为一个应用，我们证明了随机梯度 UBU 积分器的均匀时间误差，其中步长中的数值偏差的显式系数与随机梯度噪声的协方差成正比。

items.title: Sparse Analytic Representation of Stationary Processes with Bounded Spectral Density
items.excerpt: We consider centered second-order stationary processes Y={Y_t}{t\in R} with bounded spectral density S_Y and develop a sparse analytic representation framework. A nontrivial stationary process on the real line generally does not belong to L^2(\Omega,L^2(R)), since stationarity implies E||Y||{L^2(R)}^2=\infty. To overcome this infinite-energy obstruction, we replace the sample-path viewpoint by the bounded linear operator \widetilde Y: L^2(R) \to L^2(\Omega), with \widetilde Y(f) = \int_{R} \hat{f}(\xi) Z_Y(d\xi), where Z_Y is the orthogonal random measure in the spectral representation of Y. Applying \widetilde Y to Cauchy kernels in the upper and lower half-planes yields random analytic functions U_+ and U_-. For \alpha>1, we prove U_+ \in L^2(\Omega, B_\alpha^2(C^+)) and U_- \in L^2(\Omega, B_\alpha^2(C^-)), where B_\alpha^2(C^\pm) are weighted Bergman spaces. We combine U_+ and U_- into U(\omega,z) = U_+ for z \in C^+, and U_- for z \in C^-, and with B_\alpha = B_\alpha^2(C^+) \oplus B_\alpha^2(C^-), prove U \in L^2(\Omega, B_\alpha). We establish boundary vanishing, energy identity, and convergence, and derive covariance identitie
items.authors: Yiqiao Zhang, Fang Yang, Tao Qian
items.title_zh: 有界谱密度平稳过程的稀疏解析表示
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑具有有界谱密度 S_Y 的中心二阶平稳过程 Y={Y_t}{t\in R} 并开发稀疏分析表示框架。实线上的非平凡平稳过程通常不属于 L^2(\Omega,L^2(R))，因为平稳性意味着 E||Y||{L^2(R)}^2=\infty。为了克服这种无限能量障碍，我们用有界线性算子 \widetilde Y 替换样本路径视点：L^2(R) \to L^2(\Omega)，其中 \widetilde Y(f) = \int_{R} \hat{f}(\xi) Z_Y(d\xi)，其中 Z_Y 是 Y 的谱表示中的正交随机测度。将 \widetilde Y 应用于上、下柯西核半平面产生随机解析函数 U_+ 和 U_-。对于 \alpha>1，我们证明 U_+ \in L^2(\Omega, B_\alpha^2(C^+)​​) 和 U_- \in L^2(\Omega, B_\alpha^2(C^-))，其中 B_\alpha^2(C^\pm) 是加权伯格曼空间。我们将 U_+ 和 U_- 组合成 U(\omega,z) = U_+（对于 z \in C^+）和 U_-（对于 z \in C^-），并用 B_\alpha = B_\alpha^2(C^+)​​ \oplus B_\alpha^2(C^-)，证明 U \in L^2(\Omega, B_\alpha)。我们建立边界消失、能量恒等式和收敛性，并推导出协方差恒等式

items.title: The Number of Real Eigenvalues of a Random Sign Matrix
items.excerpt: Let $R_n$ count the real eigenvalues of an $n\times n$ matrix with independent uniform $\pm1$ entries. We prove that $R_n/\sqrt n$ converges in $L^1$ to $\sqrt{2/\pi}$. In particular, $R_n=\Theta(\sqrt n)$ with probability tending to one, as conjectured by Vu.
items.title_zh: 随机符号矩阵的实特征值数
items.excerpt_zh: 让 $R_n$ 计算具有独立均匀 $\pm1$ 条目的 $n\times n$ 矩阵的实特征值。我们证明$R_n/\sqrt n$ 在$L^1$ 中收敛到$\sqrt{2/\pi}$。特别是，正如 Vu 所推测的，$R_n=\Theta(\sqrt n)$ 的概率趋于 1。

items.title: Stochastic Differential Equations on the Simplex
items.excerpt: We propose a framework for simplex-valued diffusion processes, formulated as solutions to stochastic differential equations driven by antisymmetric Brownian motion. Our edge-wise representation includes the multivariate Jacobi processes and the general class of continuous simplex-valued polynomial diffusions. Also, it allows bounded, locally Lipschitz state-dependent drift rates and edge weights. We establish weak solutions, as well as global strong existence and pathwise uniqueness for strictly positive initial states under a sufficient boundary non-attainment condition.
items.title_zh: 单纯形上的随机微分方程
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个单纯形值扩散过程的框架，将其表述为由反对称布朗运动驱动的随机微分方程的解。我们的沿边表示包括多元雅可比过程和连续单纯形值多项式扩散的一般类。此外，它还允许有界的、局部 Lipschitz 状态相关的漂移率和边缘权重。我们在充分的边界未达到条件下建立弱解，以及严格正初始状态的全局强存在性和路径唯一性。

items.title: Vanishing bond-percolation threshold implies vanishing contact-process threshold
items.excerpt: We show that for any infinite, locally finite and connected graph $G$ and $p\in(0,1/2]$ the survival probability of the contact process with infection rate $\lambda\ge20p$ is at least $3/4$ times the bond percolation probability with retention probability $p$. In particular, $\lambda_c(G)\le20\,p_c(G)$ whenever $p_c(G)<1/2$, and $p_c(G)=0$ implies $\lambda_c(G)=0$. The proof uses a submartingale built from percolation clusters on finite balls. We contrast this with the SIR epidemic, in which every vertex is infected at most once, and for which there are graphs with $p_c(G)=0$ on which the SIR epidemic dies out almost surely for every infection rate.
items.authors: Benedikt Jahnel, Lukas L\"uchtrath, Christian M\"onch
items.title_zh: 消失的键渗阈值意味着消失的接触过程阈值
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，对于任何无限、局部有限且连通的图 $G$ 和 $p\in(0,1/2]$，感染率 $\lambda\ge20p$ 的接触过程的生存概率至少是保留概率 $p$ 的键渗透概率 $3/4$ 倍。特别是，每当 $p_c(G)<1/2$ 时，$\lambda_c(G)\le20\,p_c(G)$ ，并且$p_c(G)=0$ 意味着 $\lambda_c(G)=0$。我们将其与 SIR 流行病进行对比，其中每个顶点最多被感染一次，并且存在 $p_c(G)=0$ 的图表，其中 SIR 流行病几乎肯定会在每种感染率下消失。

items.title: Energy-constrained Brownian motion
items.excerpt: For reflected Brownian motion in an interval of length $N$, we consider the first time at which the length of time since the most recent visit to the boundary reaches $M$; this random `lifetime' comes from the interpretation in which the Brownian motion has a finite energy capacity $M$, uses energy at unit rate in the interior, and gets its energy replenished up to $M$ on every visit to the boundary. We prove distributional asymptotics for the lifetime in three different regimes depending on the relative growth of $N$ and $M$; these one-dimensional results parallel results in the random walk case by Wade and Grinfeld. We also present some initial results on the multidimensional version of the problem, for one scaling regime in the case of a ball, and conjectures on the behaviour in general domains.
items.title_zh: 能量约束布朗运动
items.excerpt_zh: 对于长度为$N$的区间内的反射布朗运动，我们考虑自最近访问边界以来的时间长度第一次达到$M$；这个随机的“生命周期”来自这样的解释：布朗运动具有有限的能量容量 $M$，在内部以单位速率使用能量，并且在每次访问边界时将其能量补充到 $M$。我们根据 $N$ 和 $M$ 的相对增长证明了三种不同状态下生命周期的分布渐近；这些一维结果与 Wade 和 Grinfeld 的随机游走案例中的结果平行。我们还针对球的情况下的一种缩放机制，提出了该问题的多维版本的一些初步结果，以及对一般领域行为的猜想。

items.title: A Class of Coupled Forward-Backward Systems Under General Filtrations
items.excerpt: We consider a class of coupled-forward backward systems defined on a general probability space assumed only to satisfy the usual conditions. We obtain existence and uniqueness results for arbitrary finite time horizons.
items.title_zh: 一般过滤下的一类正向-反向耦合系统
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑一类在假设仅满足通常条件的一般概率空间上定义的耦合前向后向系统。我们获得任意有限时间范围内的存在性和唯一性结果。

items.title: A posteriori estimates for inverse evolutionary problems
items.excerpt: The paper is focused on a posteriori error analysis of evolutionary problems, which are ill-posed in the sense of Hadamard. They may have no solutions and respective approximations may be highly unstable. For these problems, the a posteriori error estimation concept applicable to well-posed problems is not valid and requires a significant reformulation. A posteriori estimates of the functional type provide the basis for addressing this issue. They generate computable quantities that estimate the distance between a function (approximate solution to the inverse problem) and exact solution of a "close" well-posed initial boundary value problem associated with the same differential equation. The solution of this close problem exactly satisfies one part of the imposed conditions and the others are satisfied approximately with the accuracy $\eps$. This idea is elaborated for several evolutionary problems generated by the reaction-convection-diffusion equation: backward parabolic problem, problem with non-local time conditions, Cauchy parabolic problem, and parameter(s) identification problem. The estimates derived not only control the accur
items.title_zh: 逆演化问题的后验估计
items.excerpt_zh: 本文重点关注进化问题的后验误差分析，这些问题在哈达玛意义上是不适定的。它们可能没有解，并且各自的近似值可能非常不稳定。对于这些问题，适用于适定问题的后验误差估计概念是无效的，需要进行重大的重新表述。功能类型的后验估计为解决这个问题提供了基础。它们生成可计算量，用于估计函数（反问题的近似解）与与同一微分方程相关的“接近”适定初始边值问题的精确解之间的距离。这个封闭问题的解完全满足一部分所施加的条件，而其他条件则大致满足精度$\eps$。这一思想针对反应-对流-扩散方程产生的几个演化问题进行了阐述：后向抛物线问题、非局部时间条件问题、柯西抛物线问题和参数识别问题。得出的估计不仅控制准确度

items.title: Pathwise Factorization and Uncertainty Quantification for Impedance Obstacles with Random Boundaries
items.excerpt: We develop a factorization method with finite-sample statistical guarantees for two-dimensional acoustic scattering by impedance obstacles whose boundary is random and whose data are finitely many noisy multistatic measurements. In the two-dimensional far-field normalization, the symmetrization must act on a phase-rotated far-field operator; we prove the optical and range identities for every realization of a compact family of uniformly bi-Lipschitz domains, with jointly measurable regularized indicators. A quadrature-weighted finite-sample analysis separates angular approximation, measurement noise, test-vector error, and regularization, and yields a consistency theorem for empirical means and variances, joint in all data parameters. Bounded indicators admit simultaneous confidence bands, a diagonal threshold recovers the probability that a sampling point lies in the random obstacle, and a nested design yields unbiased variance components. Computations use a combined-field integral equation proved invertible at all frequencies, and the finite-grid guarantees are examined in a coverage study against a high-accuracy Monte Carlo referen
items.title_zh: 具有随机边界的阻抗障碍的路径分解和不确定性量化
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了一种具有有限样本统计保证的分解方法，用于阻抗障碍物的二维声学散射，其边界是随机的，其数据是有限多个噪声多静态测量。在二维远场归一化中，对称化必须作用于相位旋转远场算子；我们证明了均匀双利普希茨域的紧凑族的每一个实现的光学和距离恒等式，并具有联合可测量的正则化指标。正交加权有限样本分析将角度近似、测量噪声、测试向量误差和正则化分开，并针对所有数据参数联合得出经验均值和方差的一致性定理。有界指标允许同时置信带，对角线阈值恢复采样点位于随机障碍物中的概率，嵌套设计产生无偏方差分量。计算使用经证明在所有频率下均可逆的组合场积分方程，并在针对高精度蒙特卡洛参考的覆盖研究中检查有限网格保证

items.title: Source Conditions and Sharp Transition Asymptotics for the Factorization Method with Far-Field Data
items.excerpt: The factorization method characterizes an obstacle through a range test, but practical implementations replace the associated Picard series by a regularized approximation. This paper studies the resulting regularization bias for inverse acoustic scattering by impedance obstacles. For a disc, we show that every positive-order H\"older source condition fails at each noncentral interior sampling point, whereas logarithmic source conditions hold uniformly on compact interior subsets for every exponent, with explicit constants. At the center, the bias decays linearly with the regularization parameter. We then derive sharp spectral transition asymptotics through the Lambert W function. These asymptotics determine the stabilization rate inside the obstacle, the iterated-logarithmic growth at the boundary, and the divergence outside. They also yield a threshold rule for which the reconstructed disc converges in measure, together with quantitative boundary-location estimates. For general impedance obstacles, we reduce the spectral decay of the symmetrized far-field operator to that of the data-to-pattern operator and obtain two-sided transitio
items.title_zh: 远场数据因式分解方法的源条件和急剧过渡渐近
items.excerpt_zh: 因式分解方法通过范围测试来表征障碍物，但实际实现用正则化近似代替相关的皮卡德级数。本文研究了阻抗障碍物导致的逆声散射的正则化偏差。对于圆盘，我们证明每个正阶 H\"旧源条件在每个非中心内部采样点都失败，而对数源条件在每个指数的紧凑内部子集上一致成立，具有显式常数。在中心，偏差随正则化参数线性衰减。然后，我们通过 Lambert W 函数推导出尖锐的光谱过渡渐近线。这些渐近线决定了障碍物内部的稳定率、边界处的迭代对数增长以及它们还产生了重建圆盘在测量中收敛的阈值规则，以及对于一般阻抗障碍的定量边界位置估计，我们将对称远场算子的频谱衰减减少到数据到模式算子的频谱衰减，并获得两侧过渡。

items.title: Recovering from Averages: An Inverse Problem Perspective on Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
items.excerpt: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate the potential energy surface of atomistic systems from quantum-mechanical reference data and enable molecular simulation at near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Since they are fitted to total energies and forces, it is not obvious what is estimated: the total energy or the many-body potentials from which it is assembled. Mathematically, this can be formulated as a question whether a function can be recovered from averages of its values over random clusters. We study it for a linear model of fixed correlation order in simplified statistical setting. We show that, in the population limit, the potential is identifiable in a natural weighted Sobolev space, and derive finite-sample recovery guarantees. Numerical experiments for pair, three-body, and four-body models support the theory.
items.authors: Tina Torabi, Cheuk Hin Ho, Christoph Ortner, Ruo Ning Qiu
items.title_zh: 从平均值中恢复：机器学习原子间势的反问题视角
items.excerpt_zh: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 根据量子力学参考数据近似计算原子系统的势能表面，并以接近从头算的精度实现分子模拟，且成本仅为一小部分。由于它们是根据总能量和力拟合的，因此估计的内容并不明显：总能量或多体势。从数学上讲，这可以表述为一个问题：函数是否可以从随机簇上的平均值中恢复。我们研究了简化统计设置中固定相关阶数的线性模型。我们证明，在人口限制下，潜力在自然加权索博列夫空间中是可识别的，并得出有限样本恢复保证。成对、三体和四体模型的数值实验支持了该理论。

items.title: A Stochastic Tamed-Regularized Random Batch Method for Uncertain Particle Systems with Singularities
items.excerpt: The coefficients of particle systems often exhibit uncertainties due to incomplete knowledge. For particle systems with uncertainties and singularities in the drift and diffusion terms, existing methods may encounter numerical blow-up. In this paper, we propose a novel stochastic tamed-regularized Random Batch (str-RB) method for such uncertain particle systems with singularities. Specifically, since singularities in the diffusion term are more challenging than those in the drift term, building on a tamed scheme, we design an exponential regularization strategy that more effectively mitigates singularities in the diffusion term. This strategy ensures that the stochastic Galerkin (sG) projection coefficients remain finite even when the corresponding integrals for the original singular diffusion coefficient diverge. The sG method is applied to handle the random coefficients, and a random batch approach is then employed to reduce the computational complexity of large-scale simulations. Several theoretical properties of the proposed algorithm are established. Numerical tests demonstrate that the str-RB algorithm exhibits weak convergence,
items.authors: Wenyi Wang, Lei Li, Yiwen Lin
items.title_zh: 具有奇点的不确定粒子系统的随机驯化正则化随机批处理方法
items.excerpt_zh: 由于知识不完整，粒子系统的系数常常表现出不确定性。对于漂移和扩散项具有不确定性和奇异性的粒子系统，现有方法可能会遇到数值爆炸。在本文中，我们针对这种具有奇点的不确定粒子系统提出了一种新颖的随机驯服正则化随机批处理（str-RB）方法。具体来说，由于扩散项中的奇点比漂移项中的奇点更具挑战性，因此在驯服方案的基础上，我们设计了一种指数正则化策略，可以更有效地减轻扩散项中的奇点。该策略确保即使原始奇异扩散系数的相应积分发散，随机伽辽金 (sG) 投影系数仍保持有限。应用sG方法来处理随机系数，然后采用随机批量方法来降低大规模模拟的计算复杂度。建立了所提出算法的几个理论特性。数值测试表明str-RB算法收敛性较弱，

items.title: A linearly decoupled structure-preserving BCFD method for the two-species Keller--Segel chemotaxis system
items.excerpt: In this paper, we develop a fully discrete, linearly decoupled block-centered finite difference scheme for the two-species Keller--Segel chemotaxis system. Based on the Slotboom transformation, the cell-density equations are reformulated into a symmetric form, providing a natural framework for the construction of a structure-preserving discretization. The resulting scheme is shown to unconditionally preserve the positivity of both the cell densities and the chemoattractant concentration, while ensuring exact mass conservation of each cell density and the original energy dissipation. Furthermore, optimal-order error estimates for the proposed scheme are rigorously established through a higher-order consistency analysis. In particular, the cell densities exhibit first-order temporal and second-order spatial convergence in the discrete $L^2$-norm, whereas the chemoattractant concentration achieves the same convergence orders in the discrete $H^1$-norm. Finally, a series of numerical experiments is conducted to verify the theoretical results and demonstrate the reliability of the proposed scheme in simulating the finite-time blow-up pheno
items.authors: Ao Zhang, Bingyin Zhang, Hongfei Fu
items.title_zh: 一种用于两物种 Keller--Segel 趋化系统的线性解耦保结构 BCFD 方法
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们为两物种 Keller-Segel 趋化系统开发了一种完全离散、线性解耦的块中心有限差分格式。基于 Slotboom 变换，单元密度方程被重新表述为对称形式，为构造保留结构的离散化提供了自然的框架。由此产生的方案显示出无条件地保留细胞密度和化学引诱剂浓度的正性，同时确保每个细胞密度和原始能量耗散的精确质量守恒。此外，通过高阶一致性分析严格建立了所提出方案的最优阶误差估计。特别是，细胞密度在离散 $L^2$-范数中表现出一阶时间和二阶空间收敛，而趋化剂浓度在离散 $H^1$-范数中实现相同的收敛阶。最后，通过一系列数值实验验证了理论结果，证明了该方案在模拟有限时间爆炸现象方面的可靠性。

items.title: Inverse scattering for the one-dimensional discrete Schr\"odinger operator: a computational perspective
items.excerpt: We revisit inverse scattering for the one-dimensional discrete Schr\"odinger operator with compactly supported perturbation. We consider a computational perspective, adapted to the case of a digitally sampled reflection coefficient, to determine the perturbation in the form of a Jacobi matrix, including a computation of the length of the smallest interval supporting the perturbation. A new representation of scattering data in terms of orthogonal polynomials underpins the computational results. A key technical role is played by polynomials on the circle constructed from pairs of successive orthogonal polynomials on the line. The inverse algorithm is demonstrated on numerical examples.
items.authors: Peter C. Gibson, Basant Lal Sharma
items.title_zh: 一维离散 Schr\"odinger 算子的逆散射：计算视角
items.excerpt_zh: 我们重新审视具有紧凑支持扰动的一维离散 Schr\"odinger 算子的逆散射。我们考虑一种计算视角，适应数字采样反射系数的情况，以确定雅可比矩阵形式的扰动，包括计算支持扰动的最小间隔的长度。以正交多项式表示的散射数据的新表示支撑了计算结果。多项式发挥了关键的技术作用在由直线上的连续正交多项式对构造的圆上，通过数值示例演示了逆算法。

items.title: Degree-stratified randomized projection for spectral clustering
items.excerpt: Many real-world networks have heavy-tailed degree distributions, in which a few high-degree nodes coexist with many low-degree nodes. Randomized range finders reduce the cost of computing the eigenspace used in spectral clustering, but their random test matrices are constructed independently of the node degrees. We propose degree-stratified randomized projection (DS-RP), which partitions the nodes into dyadic degree strata, distributes a fixed sketch dimension across the strata, and draws an independent local sketch for each stratum. We bound the angle between the sampled range and the target eigenspace and show that the gain comes from the allocation of the sketch dimension rather than from the stratification itself. The bound improves when more sketch dimensions are assigned to the strata on which the target eigenspace is concentrated. For the degree-corrected stochastic block model, we prove that the leverage scores of this eigenspace are proportional to the node degrees, so that the allocation can be determined from the degrees alone. A Rayleigh--Ritz bound that requires no smallness assumption carries the estimate over to the com
items.authors: Junghyun Eom, Youngjin Hwang, Euihyun Kim, Yongseok Jang
items.title_zh: 谱聚类的度分层随机投影
items.excerpt_zh: 许多现实世界的网络具有重尾度分布，其中少数高度节点与许多低度节点共存。随机测距仪降低了计算谱聚类中使用的特征空间的成本，但其随机测试矩阵的构造与节点度无关。我们提出了度分层随机投影（DS-RP），它将节点划分为二元度层，在层中分布固定的草图维度，并为每个层绘制独立的局部草图。我们限制了采样范围和目标特征空间之间的角度，并表明增益来自草图尺寸的分配，而不是来自分层本身。当将更多草图尺寸分配给目标特征空间集中的层时，界限会改善。对于度校正随机块模型，我们证明该特征空间的杠杆分数与节点度成正比，因此可以仅根据度来确定分配。不需要微小假设的瑞利-里兹界将估计值传递给计算机

items.title: Lofty Models of Peano Arithmetic
items.excerpt: If M is a nonstandard model of Peano Arithmetic, then M is lofty iff M has a simple elementary extension that is recursively saturated. This had previously been known for countable M.
items.title_zh: 皮亚诺算术的崇高模型
items.excerpt_zh: 如果 M 是皮亚诺算术的非标准模型，则 M 是崇高的，当且仅当 M 具有递归饱和的简单初等扩展。这以前因可数M而闻名。

items.title: Compactness phenomena in HOD and the Optimality of Magidor's Covering theorem
items.excerpt: We investigate compactness phenomena around the power-set functions of $V$ and HOD. We prove: (1) A singular strong limit cardinal with uncountable cofinality cannot be the first place where $\mathcal{P}(\cdot )$ and $ \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{HOD}}(\cdot)$ disagree. (2) Assuming the existence of a measurable cardinal, $\aleph_\omega$ can be the first place where $\mathcal{P}(\aleph_\omega)\neq \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{HOD}}(\aleph_\omega)$, answering a question of Hayut. (3) If $\kappa$ is strong limit singular of uncountable cofinality, $\kappa$ cannot be the first place where $(\mathrm{HOD}, V)$ fails to have the cover property; (4)Magidor's Covering Theorem is optimal.
items.authors: Tom Benhamou, James Cummings, Yair Hayut, Gabriel Goldberg, Alejandro Poveda
items.title_zh: HOD中的紧致现象和Magidor覆盖定理的最优性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究围绕 $V$ 和 HOD 幂集函数的紧致性现象。我们证明： (1) 具有不可数共尾性的奇异强极限基数不可能是 $\mathcal{P}(\cdot )$ 和 $ \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{HOD}}(\cdot)$ 不一致的第一个地方。 (2) 假设存在可测基数，$\aleph_\omega$ 可以是 $\mathcal{P}(\aleph_\omega)\neq \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{HOD}}(\aleph_\omega)$ 的第一个位置，回答 Hayut 的问题。 (3) 如果$\kappa$是不可数共尾性的强极限单数，则$\kappa$不可能是第一个$(\mathrm{HOD}, V)$不具备覆盖性质的地方； (4)马吉多覆盖定理是最优的。

items.title: Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation
items.excerpt: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepresentable. We prove referential closure, causal grounding, and identifier stability, an ablation localizes each to the referee and world model rather than the policy, and two independent LLM judges repr
items.authors: Tanzimul Alam Fahim, Mohammad Arif Hossain
items.title_zh: 构建一致性：综合 CTI 知识图和一致性验证的形式限制
items.excerpt_zh: 将关系训练数据（例如知识图谱）与大型语言模型进行综合通常会一次发出一个结构化对象，这使每个对象保持有效，但使它们之间的关系失去了基础。我们研究另一种范式，通过模拟生成：我们不是描述一个关系工件，而是模拟一个生成它的过程，并将该工件作为其因果记录。语言模型代理提出意图，确定性裁判根据明确的世界模型解决结果，因此只有当它所代表的事件发生时才会发出关系，从而使一致性成为构造的属性。我们用三个引擎实例化了 STIX 2.1 标准中网络威胁情报知识图的范式，其中一个进化引擎将语言模型遗传算子应用于结构化图基因组，共享一个确定性编译器，使畸形和悬空的输出无法表示。我们证明了参照闭合、因果基础和标识符稳定性，消融将每个都定位于裁判和世界模型而不是政策，并且两位独立的法学硕士法官代表

items.title: Beyond Demographic Discrimination: Benchmarking Normative-Descriptive Calibration in LLMs
items.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, where they must distinguish between normative reasoning (what should happen) and descriptive reasoning (what is likely to happen). Most fairness benchmarks evaluate demographic discrimination under a single reasoning objective, and none we know of tests whether a model treats the same item differently when asked to describe an outcome versus decide one. We introduce normative--descriptive calibration, the extent to which a model's differentiation between matched candidates depends on whether it is asked to predict or to decide, and measure it with the Normative--Descriptive Calibration Benchmark (NDCB): 697 matched-pair scenarios across six domains, each posed under both framings, and three metrics, Normative Engagement Rate (NER), Normative Leakage Rate (NLR), and Normative--Descriptive Separation (NDS). Across six LLMs, NDS separates 13 of 15 model pairs, against 7 for BBQ accuracy and none for BOLD, although these counts also reflect each benchmark's sample size. items.authors: Radhika Bhargava, Shinibali Bhattacharyya, George Mihaila, Jay Prajapati, Anwesan Pal, Yue Zhang
items.title_zh: 超越人口歧视：法学硕士的规范描述性校准基准
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在具有社会影响的环境中，它们必须区分规范性推理（应该发生什么）和描述性推理（可能发生什么）。大多数公平基准都是在单一推理目标下评估人口歧视，而我们所知的测试模型在被要求描述结果与决定结果时是否会以不同方式对待同一项目。我们引入了规范性描述性校准，模型在匹配候选者之间的差异程度取决于它是被要求预测还是决定，并使用规范性描述性校准基准（NDCB）来衡量它：跨越六个领域的 697 个匹配对场景，每个场景都在两个框架下提出，以及三个指标：规范性参与率（NER）、规范性泄漏率（NLR）和规范性描述性分离（NDS）。在 6 个 LLM 中，NDS 将 15 个模型对中的 13 个分开，而 BBQ 准确性为 7 个，而 BOLD 则没有，尽管这些计数也反映了每个基准的样本大小。 Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.6 的框架分离最为强烈（平均

items.title: Budget-Aware Predict-and-Verify Theorem Proving with Heterogeneous LLM Solvers
items.excerpt: Large language model (LLM) theorem solvers differ in both proving capability and inference cost. Applying an expensive solver to every subgoal wastes computation when cheaper models are sufficient, while always starting from the cheapest solver wastes attempts on subgoals that require stronger models. We present BudgetPV, an agentic budget-aware predict-and-verify system that allocates computation across unresolved subgoals and heterogeneous LLM solvers. BudgetPV uses a cross-solver predictor to guide solver selection for each subgoal and revises the allocation as verification feedback becomes available. The allocation problem changes as proving progresses. Early decisions mainly determine which solver should handle an untried subgoal, while later decisions determine which previously attempted subgoals should receive additional computation. We train the predictor with two objectives for these two stages. Class-weighted cross-entropy improves assignment to less frequent stronger solvers during the initial stage, while plain cross-entropy provides better calibrated probabilities for later allocation among previously attempted subgoals.
items.authors: Wei Jiang, Ziran Liu, Wei Wang
items.title_zh: 使用异构 LLM 求解器证明预算感知预测和验证定理
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 定理求解器在证明能力和推理成本方面有所不同。当更便宜的模型足够时，将昂贵的求解器应用于每个子目标会浪费计算，而总是从最便宜的求解器开始会浪费对需要更强模型的子目标的尝试。我们提出了 BudgetPV，一种代理预算感知预测和验证系统，可在未解决的子目标和异构 LLM 求解器之间分配计算。 BudgetPV 使用跨求解器预测器来指导每个子目标的求解器选择，并在验证反馈可用时修改分配。分配问题随着证明的进展而变化。早期决策主要确定哪个求解器应该处理未尝试的子目标，而后期决策则确定哪些先前尝试的子目标应该接受额外的计算。我们为这两个阶段训练有两个目标的预测器。类加权交叉熵改进了初始阶段对频率较低的较强求解器的分配，而普通交叉熵为以后在先前尝试的子目标之间进行分配提供了更好的校准概率。

items.title: Reasoning in Two Dimensions: Quantifying Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness and Efficiency
items.excerpt: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning exposes intermediate steps, but a correct answer does not establish that an LLM relies on the dependence expressed by those steps or reasons efficiently. We operationalize CoT faithfulness and efficiency within a common framework. Specifically, we represent a CoT as a semantic reasoning graph and decompose the model's predictive dependence along two complementary axes: dependence explained by semantic support versus additional reasoning history, and dependence allocated to answer-reaching versus off-path reasoning. This decomposition yields global and step-level measures of unfaithfulness and inefficiency. Controlled interventions show that the proposed metrics respond to hidden dependence and induced off-path reasoning as intended. Across mathematical and multi-hop reasoning tasks, answer-level unfaithfulness is consistently associated with greater predictive uncertainty, whereas both unfaithfulness and inefficiency exhibit weak or inconsistent associations with answer correctness. We further derive theoretically grounded, graph-aware fine-tuning objectives that improve the targeted reasoning proper
items.authors: Chenruo Liu, Quan Zhang, Qi Lei
items.title_zh: 二维推理：量化思想链的可信度和效率
items.excerpt_zh: 思想链（CoT）推理公开了中间步骤，但正确的答案并不能证明法学硕士有效地依赖于这些步骤或原因所表达的依赖性。我们在一个共同的框架内实现 CoT 的忠诚度和效率。具体来说，我们将 CoT 表示为语义推理图，并沿着两个互补轴分解模型的预测依赖性：由语义支持解释的依赖性与附加推理历史的依赖性，以及分配给答案达成与偏离路径推理的依赖性。这种分解产生了不忠实和低效率的全局和步骤级度量。受控干预表明，所提出的指标对隐藏的依赖性做出了反应，并按预期诱发了偏离路径的推理。在数学和多跳推理任务中，答案级别的不忠实始终与更大的预测不确定性相关，而不忠实和低效率与答案正确性的关联较弱或不一致。我们进一步推导出基于理论的、图形感知的微调目标，以适当提高目标推理能力

items.title: WePM: Hierarchical Conflict Reconciliation for Unified MLLMs
items.excerpt: Bringing multimodal intelligence from the cloud to users' devices keeps sensitive data local and reduces inference cost, but deploying a specialized model per capability duplicates vision-language capacity under tight memory and compute budgets. We formalize heterogeneous capability density (HCD), measuring how broadly and effectively a model serves heterogeneous task families per unit of resident inference memory. High HCD across representation, generation, and decision raises two challenges: these capabilities need visual evidence at different spatial granularities under a fixed token budget, and separately collected task corpora yield conflicting updates to shared parameters, while cross-task paired supervision is costly and ambiguous for open-ended inputs. We present WePM, a family of pocket models unifying representation, generation, and decision within one vision-language backbone. items.authors: Zhiqiang Yuan, Qiwei Yan, Liwei Yang, Jinzhe Liu, Yang Liu, Zhongyan Hou, Liyan Xu, Peixiang Luo, Jiapei Zhang, Ying Deng, Jie Zhou, Jinchao Zhang
items.title_zh: WePM：统一 MLLM 的分层冲突协调
items.excerpt_zh: 将多模态智能从云端引入用户设备可将敏感数据保留在本地并降低推理成本，但在内存和计算预算紧张的情况下为每个功能部署专用模型会复制视觉语言能力。我们形式化了异构能力密度（HCD），衡量模型为每单位常驻推理内存提供异构任务族的广泛性和有效性。跨表示、生成和决策的高 HCD 提出了两个挑战：这些功能需要在固定令牌预算下不同空间粒度的视觉证据，并且单独收集的任务语料库会对共享参数产生冲突的更新，而跨任务配对监督对于开放式输入来说成本高昂且不明确。我们推出了 WePM，这是一系列袖珍模型，将表示、生成和决策统一在一个视觉语言主干中。多粒度视觉预算（MGVB）在全球、区域和细粒度银行之间分配固定的视觉令牌预算；统一列表知识蒸馏（ULKD）通过教师的软指导丰富了单独收集的数据，避免了错误

items.title: Learning Inside Types: Epistemic Typestates for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: Type disciplines make programs safe by construction: components checked against each other's types compose into programs that cannot go wrong in the ways the types exclude. Types suit reinforcement learning: a type constrains what an agent may choose, not how it chooses, so the guarantee holds for every policy a learner produces. We introduce epistemic typestates, a type discipline for safe multi-agent reinforcement learning. An agent's type is a protocol whose states record its beliefs, the worlds it cannot rule out from its own observations and actions, and permits only actions that are safe in every world of the belief, whatever the others do within their public types. Agents learn inside their types, which are built and checked one agent at a time and run without communication. We prove type soundness and team safety, give a synthesis that is sound and complete, build types from guards when worlds are infinite, and show that shields are a special case. All proofs are mechanised in Rocq. On nine benchmarks, no typed learner causes a safety violation, and task performance does not differ significantly from that of two recent multi-a
items.authors: Lorenzo Bacchiani, Mario Bravetti, Giovanni Pau, Roberto Girau
items.title_zh: 学习内部类型：安全多智能体强化学习的认知类型状态
items.excerpt_zh: 类型规则通过构造使程序变得安全：根据彼此的类型进行检查的组件组成的程序不会以类型排除的方式出错。类型适合强化学习：类型限制代理可以选择什么，而不是如何选择，因此保证适用于学习者产生的每个策略。我们引入了认知类型状态，这是一种用于安全多智能体强化学习的类型规则。代理的类型是一种协议，其状态记录其信念、它无法从其自己的观察和行动中排除的世界，并且只允许在每个信念世界中安全的行动，无论其他人在其公共类型内做什么。代理在其类型内进行学习，这些类型一次构建并检查一个代理，并且无需通信即可运行。我们证明类型的健全性和团队安全性，给出健全且完整的综合，在世界无限时从守卫构建类型，并表明盾牌是一个特例。所有证明均在 Rocq 中机械化。在九个基准测试中，没有类型化学习器会导致安全违规，并且任务性能与最近的两个多任务性能没有显着差异

items.title: MetaRigor: From Agentic Automation to Verifiable End-to-End Meta-Analysis Through Scientific Decision Boundaries
items.excerpt: Automated meta-analysis requires not only accurate numerical extraction but also the consistent preservation of result identity across stages, including the associated study, comparison, population, outcome, time point, and analysis conditions. We present MetaRigor, an LLM workflow framework for verifiable end-to-end evidence synthesis. MetaRigor organizes study results as Study x Target units and operationalizes scientific decision boundaries at the task level through Task Contracts, programmatic rules, and source binding. The model performs semantic interpretation that depends on study context, whereas programs execute formalizable rules, computations, validation, and source verification. We conducted controlled evaluations across five stages: evidence acquisition, data extraction, risk of bias assessment, certainty of evidence assessment, and manuscript generation. MetaRigor achieved an F1 score of 86.29% for complete result delivery and 80.20% agreement for domain-level certainty of evidence judgments.
