items.title_zh: MetaRigor：通过科学决策边界从代理自动化到可验证的端到端元分析
items.excerpt_zh: 自动化荟萃分析不仅需要准确的数值提取，还需要跨阶段一致地保留结果同一性，包括相关的研究、比较、人群、结果、时间点和分析条件。我们推出 MetaRigor，一个用于可验证的端到端证据合成的法学硕士工作流程框架。 MetaRigor 将研究结果组织为研究 x 目标单元，并通过任务契约、程序规则和源绑定在任务级别实施科学决策边界。该模型执行取决于研究上下文的语义解释，而程序则执行形式化的规则、计算、验证和源验证。我们在五个阶段进行了受控评估：证据获取、数据提取、偏倚风险评估、证据确定性评估和手稿生成。 MetaRigor 在完整结果交付方面取得了 86.29% 的 F1 分数，在证据判断的领域级确定性方面取得了 80.20% 的一致性。生成的手稿在人工评估下得分为 86.00，超过了所有三个基线。下游端的七种情况

items.title: On the loss landscape of the linear neural network: beyond critical points
items.excerpt: While the critical points of the loss landscape in linear neural networks have been extensively studied since the seminal work of Baldi \& Hornik in the late 1980s, a description of this landscape at an intermediate or global scale is still lacking. Such a characterization is crucial, particularly as a substantial body of literature indicates that gradient descent circumvents critical points. The present article introduces an intermediate structure, termed the critical thalweg, which encompasses all critical points and exhibits key geometric properties. Beyond providing a geometric proof of Baldi \& Hornik's results using simpler assumptions than the existing literature, this framework offers a global view of the loss landscape that can be easily visualized in a two-dimensional plane. Empirical observations suggest that gradient descent is attracted toward the critical thalweg, along which the loss continues to decrease to its global minimum.
items.authors: Antoine Lejay (PASTA, IECL), Lionel Lenotre (Universit{\'e} de Haute-Alsace), Sa{\"i}d Toubra (IECL)
items.title_zh: 关于线性神经网络的损失情况：超越临界点
items.excerpt_zh: 尽管自 20 世纪 80 年代末 Baldi 和 Hornik 的开创性工作以来，线性神经网络中损失景观的关键点已经得到了广泛的研究，但仍然缺乏在中间或全球范围内对这种景观的描述。这种表征至关重要，特别是因为大量文献表明梯度下降绕过了临界点。本文介绍了一种称为临界 thalweg 的中间结构，它包含所有临界点并表现出关键的几何特性。除了使用比现有文献更简单的假设来提供 Baldi & Hornik 结果的几何证明之外，该框架还提供了损失景观的全局视图，可以在二维平面中轻松可视化。经验观察表明，梯度下降被吸引到临界thalweg，沿着该临界点，损失继续减少到其全局最小值。

items.title: Don't Discard Your Rollouts: Reusing Teacher RL Traces for Student Distillation
items.excerpt: RL post-training methods such as PPO and GRPO are computationally expensive, with substantial resources devoted to sampling rollouts, which contain multiple completions per prompt along with their respective rewards. Canonical distillation, however, discards these traces and uses more compute to regenerate data from the final teacher. We ask if and how we can reuse the saved teacher RL rollouts to distil student models. Reusing rollouts is non-trivial: naive SFT on the rollouts underperforms canonical distillation, and naive DPO, while performant, is unstable, collapsing on weaker students. We show that treating rollout reuse as a data selection problem using metadata already recorded during GRPO substantially reduces this gap. We use prompt pass rates to order the data, using the easiest prompts for an SFT warm start prior to using mixed-success prompts for DPO. For each prompt, we use saved teacher log-likelihoods as a proxy for selecting student-compatible completions. Across mathematical reasoning and Python coding tasks, with students from multiple model families, our two-stage recipe achieves comparable average performance to
items.authors: Vashisth Tiwari, Emma Strubell, J. Zico Kolter
items.title_zh: 不要放弃你的部署：重用教师 RL 跟踪进行学生蒸馏
items.excerpt_zh: PPO 和 GRPO 等 RL 训练后方法的计算成本很高，需要大量资源专门用于采样部署，每个提示包含多个完成以及各自的奖励。然而，规范蒸馏会丢弃这些痕迹，并使用更多的计算来重新生成来自最终教师的数据。我们询问是否以及如何重用保存的教师 RL 部署来提炼学生模型。重用 rollout 并非易事：rollouts 上的幼稚 SFT 表现不佳，而幼稚的 DPO 虽然性能良好，但不稳定，对较弱的学生来说会崩溃。我们表明，使用 GRPO 期间已记录的元数据将推出重用视为数据选择问题可以显着缩小这一差距。我们使用提示通过率来排序数据，在对 DPO 使用混合成功提示之前，使用最简单的提示进行 SFT 热启动。对于每个提示，我们使用保存的教师对数似然作为选择与学生兼容的完成的代理。在数学推理和 Python 编码任务中，对于来自多个模型系列的学生，我们的两阶段配方实现了与

items.title: LEAN: Library-Based Adaptation for Asynchronous, Federated Fine-Tuning
items.excerpt: Federated fine-tuning of foundation models with low-rank adapters (LoRA) is typically reconciled by averaging locally trained adapters. In cross-device settings, where participants hold heterogeneous data and join or leave asynchronously, averaging is poorly suited: locally trained adapters are not identifiable up to permutation, and averages of adapters trained on dissimilar data can be uninformative or unstable. We propose a simple idea called federated library-based adaptation (LEAN), which replaces averaging altogether. The server maintains a library of rank-1 basis pairs; participants check out random subsets, fine-tune them locally as a LoRA adapter, and check them back in, so that each pair is shuffled across sites and trained on many participants' data. Because no aggregation step is required, LEAN operates fully asynchronously and communicates only low-rank parameters. We prove that, in a synchronous setting, LEAN converges to a neighborhood of a stationary point, with the shuffle canceling data heterogeneity at first order. items.authors: Erdong Hu, Zhimin Ding, Yuxin Tang, Chris Jermaine
items.title_zh: 精益：基于库的异步、联合微调适应
items.excerpt_zh: 具有低秩适配器 (LoRA) 的基础模型的联合微调通常通过平均本地训练的适配器来协调。在跨设备设置中，参与者持有异构数据并异步加入或离开，平均值不太适合：本地训练的适配器无法识别排列，并且在不同数据上训练的适配器的平均值可能缺乏信息或不稳定。我们提出了一个简单的想法，称为基于联合库的适应（LEAN），它完全取代了平均。服务器维护一个 1 级基对库；参与者检查随机子集，将它们作为 LoRA 适配器在本地进行微调，然后将它们重新签入，以便每一对都在站点之间进行洗牌，并根据许多参与者的数据进行训练。由于不需要聚合步骤，因此 LEAN 完全异步运行，并且仅传输低阶参数。我们证明，在同步设置中，精益收敛到驻点的邻域，并且洗牌消除了一阶数据异质性。在图像和文本微调基准中，精益在大多数情况下都优于基于平均的基线

items.title: Reliable Behavior Discovery via False Discovery Rate Control
items.excerpt: Reliable methods for discovering behavior patterns in large generative models are increasingly essential as models become both more complex and capable. We formalize behavior discovery as a problem class of interest and highlight the task of controlling false discovery rate (FDR) as crucial for guaranteeing reliability in behavior discovery. Building upon the multiple hypothesis testing literature, we propose DISCO (Discovery through Iterative Search with COarsened $e$-processes), a method which provably controls FDR in behavior discovery under mild conditions. DISCO improves power over previous related eBH-based approaches by allowing for adaptivity to a data-dependent number of hypotheses to be tested. We demonstrate empirically that DISCO controls FDR with higher power than comparable approaches on both synthetic data and a novel empirical evaluation of FDR-controlling methods in settings where large generative models act as both discovery engines and targets. Code is available at https://github.com/google-deepmind/disco .
items.authors: David Madras, Zi Wang, Marco Andreetto, Ken Burke, Caroline Pantofaru, Utsav Prabhu
items.title_zh: 通过错误发现率控制进行可靠的行为发现
items.excerpt_zh: 随着模型变得更加复杂和强大，在大型生成模型中发现行为模式的可靠方法变得越来越重要。我们将行为发现形式化为感兴趣的问题类别，并强调控制错误发现率（FDR）的任务对于保证行为发现的可靠性至关重要。基于多重假设检验文献，我们提出了 DISCO（通过使用 COarsened $e$-processes 进行迭代搜索进行发现），这是一种在温和条件下可证明控制行为发现中的 FDR 的方法。 DISCO 通过允许对数据相关的待测试假设数量的适应性，提高了之前相关的基于 eBH 的方法的能力。我们凭经验证明，在大型生成模型同时充当发现引擎和目标的情况下，DISCO 在合成数据上比同类方法更能控制 FDR，并对 FDR 控制方法进行了新颖的实证评估。代码可在 https://github.com/google-deepmind/disco 获取。

items.title: Improved Accuracy Scaling with Problem Complexity in LLM Arithmetic Reasoning Using Executable Symbolic Representations
items.excerpt: High accuracy on mathematical benchmarks does not establish whether reasoning remains reliable as problem complexity increases. We examine how executable symbolic representations change accuracy scaling in large language models compared with natural-language reasoning. To address this limitation, we introduce the GSM Arithmetic Benchmark (GSM-AB), a controlled benchmark that independently varies operand digit length and operation count to probe numerical scale and compositional complexity. We find that executable representations can improve accuracy and slow its decline as complexity increases. Lean reduces average sensitivity to operand digit length at every tested model size. By contrast, slower degradation with increasing operation count emerges at the larger model sizes. A Python program-of-thought (Python-PoT) control shows a similar operation-axis pattern, suggesting that this finding is not specific to Lean. These findings show that reasoning representation shapes arithmetic accuracy scaling and support executable symbolic representations for more reliable reasoning on complex arithmetic tasks.
items.title_zh: 使用可执行符号表示提高法学硕士算术推理中问题复杂性的准确度
items.excerpt_zh: 数学基准的高精度并不能确定随着问题复杂性的增加推理是否仍然可靠。与自然语言推理相比，我们研究了可执行符号表示如何改变大型语言模型中的准确性缩放。为了解决这一限制，我们引入了 GSM 算术基准 (GSM-AB)，这是一种受控基准，可独立改变操作数数字长度和运算计数，以探测数值范围和组成复杂性。我们发现，随着复杂性的增加，可执行表示可以提高准确性并减缓准确性的下降。精益降低了每个测试模型大小对操作数数字长度的平均敏感度。相比之下，模型尺寸越大，随着操作次数的增加，退化速度就越慢。 Python 思维程序 (Python-PoT) 控件显示出类似的操作轴模式，表明这一发现并非精益所特有。这些发现表明，推理表示塑造算术精度缩放并支持可执行的符号表示，以便在复杂算术任务上进行更可靠的推理。

items.title: CreditFilter: Calibrated Token Weights over the Within-Response Entropy Rank for RLVR
items.excerpt: Critic-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically assigns a uniform advantage to every token. Token-reweighting heuristics like the 80/20 mask favor high-entropy tokens, but fail to measure a token's actual impact on the outcome. We formalize this impact as the forking value: the variance of the success probability over the policy's next-token choices. The expected forking values along a response sum exactly to the reward variance. Token credit is thus, in expectation over a prompt's responses, a fixed budget spent at the forks. This motivates weights that redistribute credit within a response. The forking value factorizes into a fork consequence, which requires costly continuations to estimate, and a fork probability, which the softmax provides. On Qwen3-8B-Base, this fork probability decays exponentially with a token's within-response entropy rank at class-specific rates, revealing that most tokens carry negligible forking value. items.authors: Hanqing Zhao, Liuyue Xie, Rong-Cheng Tu, Xu Zhang, Davide Modolo, Dacheng Tao
items.title_zh: CreditFilter：RLVR 响应内熵等级的校准令牌权重
items.excerpt_zh: 具有可验证奖励的无批评强化学习（RLVR）通常为每个代币分配统一的优势。像 80/20 掩码这样的令牌重新加权启发法有利于高熵令牌，但无法衡量令牌对结果的实际影响。我们将这种影响形式化为分叉值：策略下一个代币选择的成功概率的方差。沿着响应的预期分叉值之和恰好等于奖励方差。因此，根据对提示响应的预期，代币信用是在分叉处花费的固定预算。这会激发在响应中重新分配信用的权重。分叉值分解为分叉结果（需要昂贵的延续来估计）和分叉概率（由 softmax 提供）。在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，这种分叉概率随着代币在特定类别速率下的响应内熵排名呈指数衰减，这表明大多数代币的分叉价值可以忽略不计。 CreditFilter 通过同一等级上的指数窗口对每个令牌进行加权。在近似平坦的分叉结果下，将窗口校准到该分叉概率包络线

items.title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
items.excerpt: RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process. Weight merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) must re-consolidate the whole model whenever an expert is added, and can erode capabilities outside the target domains. We propose Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation (CSPD), which keeps the pre-RL model frozen, distills each RL expert independently into a soft prompt, and composes experts by concatenating their prompts without joint training. A single soft prompt suffices to distill an RL expert, recovering at least 90% of the teacher's gain in 22 of 23 math, code, and agent settings. Independently trained prompts compose well. In a multi-expert setting, the average rises with every expert added, and the full composition matches MOPD (67.83 vs. 67.79). The composition generalizes best across six held-out benchmarks. items.title_zh: RL 专家的可组合软提示蒸馏：走向持续的培训后
items.excerpt_zh: 强化学习后训练通常会产生领域专家，然后必须将这些专家整合到一个模型中，并且随着新专家的不断到来，这种整合将成为一个持续的过程。每当添加专家时，权重合并和多教师策略蒸馏（MOPD）都必须重新整合整个模型，并且可能会削弱目标域之外的能力。我们提出了可组合软提示蒸馏（CSPD），它将预强化学习模型保持冻结，将每个强化学习专家独立地提炼为软提示，并通过连接他们的提示来组合专家，而无需联合训练。一次软提示就足以提炼出一名 RL 专家，在 23 种数学、代码和代理设置中的 22 种中恢复了教师至少 90% 的收获。独立训练的提示组合得很好。在多专家环境中，平均数随着每一位专家的加入而上升，并且完整的组合与 MOPD 相匹配（67.83 vs. 67.79）。该组合最好地概括了六个坚持的基准。输入空间自适应几乎不增加服务开销，将吞吐量保持在未自适应主干网的 1.5% 以内，达到 4 级 LoRA 的 2.40 倍。这些结果表明

items.title: THRIFTY: Cost-Constrained Reasoning-Data Synthesis for Small Language Models
items.excerpt: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly attractive for efficient, specialized deployment, and are typically trained on reasoning trajectories distilled from a larger teacher LLM. Generating this synthetic data is a major cost of the pipeline, especially when the teacher is a frontier model. Existing collection methods, however, are largely cost-unaware, or at best spread a fixed sampling budget uniformly across queries. Such allocation ignores the wide variation in problem difficulty and the strategic over- or under-sampling it invites. Thus, we propose THRIFTY, a Thompson-sampling bandit controller that spends a fixed generation-token budget to collect diverse correct reasoning trajectories, casting the task as a bandits-with-knapsacks problem with a novel diversity-aware objective. It tracks each problem's success probability with an online Beta posterior and spends each token where it expects the most new distinct correct solutions. Because repeated solutions add progressively less value, THRIFTY adaptively stops resampling saturated problems, concentrates budget on under-covered ones, and retires the unsolvable at the budget
items.title_zh: THRIFTY：小语言模型的成本约束推理数据合成
items.excerpt_zh: 小语言模型 (SLM) 对于高效、专业的部署越来越有吸引力，并且通常根据从大型法学硕士中提取的推理轨迹进行训练。生成这些合成数据是管道的主要成本，尤其是当教师是前沿模型时。然而，现有的收集方法很大程度上不了解成本，或者最多在查询之间均匀分布固定的采样预算。这种分配忽略了问题难度的巨大差异以及由此引起的战略性过采样或欠采样。因此，我们提出了 THRIFTY，一种汤普森采样强盗控制器，它花费固定的代币预算来收集不同的正确推理轨迹，将任务转化为具有新颖的多样性意识目标的背包强盗问题。它通过在线 Beta 后验跟踪每个问题的成功概率，并将每个令牌花费在它期望最新的不同正确解决方案的地方。由于重复的解决方案增加的价值逐渐减少，THRIFTY 自适应地停止对饱和问题进行重新采样，将预算集中在未涵盖的问题上，并在预算范围内淘汰无法解决的问题

items.title: Reinforcement Learning Unlearns Corrupted SFT Reasoning
items.excerpt: We show that reinforcement learning (RL) in reasoning tasks can succeed even when the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data is severely corrupted. In a mathematical reasoning dataset (GSM8K), we systematically corrupt training trajectories across 361 configurations by injecting realistic error types, varying error locations, trace-answer consistency, and corruption ratios up to 100%. While aggregated SFT-only performance steadily deteriorates under corruption (dropping from 43.61% to 13.80%), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training consistently restores model accuracy back to gold-baseline levels (approximately 60%). Crucially, initializing RL with as few as N = 8 minimal, incorrect, three-line "form-only" traces boosts post-RL performance to 69.30%, outperforming standard gold SFT initialization (60.71%) and GRPO without SFT (35.00%). Further, we show that SFT accuracy is largely uncorrelated with post-RL accuracy (r approximately 0), demonstrating a fundamental asymmetry in post-training: SFT primarily establishes structural layout (form), while RL independently discovers functional reasoning (function).
items.authors: Anika Misra, Shreyas Vinod, Huteng Dai
items.title_zh: 强化学习忘却损坏的 SFT 推理
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，即使监督微调（SFT）数据严重损坏，推理任务中的强化学习（RL）也能成功。在数学推理数据集 (GSM8K) 中，我们通过注入真实的错误类型、不同的错误位置、跟踪答案一致性和高达 100% 的损坏率，系统地损坏了 361 个配置中的训练轨迹。虽然仅 SFT 的总体性能在腐败情况下稳步恶化（从 43.61% 下降到 13.80%），但组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 训练后始终将模型精度恢复到黄金基线水平（约 60%）。至关重要的是，使用少至 N = 8 的最小、不正确、三行“仅形式”跟踪来初始化 RL，可将 RL 后性能提升至 69.30%，优于标准黄金 SFT 初始化 (60.71%) 和没有 SFT 的 GRPO (35.00%)。此外，我们还表明，SFT 精度在很大程度上与 RL 后精度不相关（r 约为 0），这证明了训练后的基本不对称性：SFT 主要建立结构布局（形式），而 RL 独立发现功能推理（功能）。

items.title: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
items.excerpt: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find that models' recall of hallucinations reinforced during training increases by 4.83% on average, compared to just 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. items.title_zh: 法学硕士在培训后记住自己的幻觉
items.excerpt_zh: 推理领域已经塑造了前沿模型的训练后配方，尽管它们是在数学和代码之外的领域进行训练和部署的。在本文中，我们研究了直接采用以推理为中心的训练方法的后果，例如，在知识任务中使用基于结果的强化学习（RL）奖励、注入“认知”行为（例如在推理链中提出和回溯假设等）。我们假设这些决策虽然对推理有用，但无意中鼓励模型记住在接受知识任务训练时它们自己在长推理链中产生的幻觉。为了研究这一点，我们使用标准的训练后模型来训练模型，在强化学习期间提取模型自我生成的幻觉，并在其余训练过程中跟踪记忆情况。我们对两个模型系列和两种架构的六个开放模型进行的实验证实了我们的假设。我们发现，在训练期间强化的模型对幻觉的回忆平均增加了 4.83%，而没有接收到训练信号的自我幻觉仅增加了 0.17%。事实上，模型甚至mem

items.title: Isolating the Language Shell: A Content-Controlled Study of Multilingual Reasoning
items.excerpt: Multilingual reasoning distillation requires choosing the language in which teacher reasoning is presented, yet existing recipes often entangle linguistic form with differences in generation, translation, and filtering. We construct content-controlled supervision by rendering the same verified English trajectories into English, translated target-language, and language-mixed shells, and fine-tune two pretrained students in three target languages, evaluating them on multilingual mathematical reasoning at two difficulty levels. Even with the underlying reasoning content held fixed, we find that shell choice can change downstream accuracy, with effects varying across students, languages, and difficulty levels. Pre-training compatibility does not consistently track these outcomes, and even when our tests find no clear accuracy difference between shells, their output-language behavior can still differ substantially. These results suggest that the supervision shell is a distinct design choice in multilingual reasoning distillation.
items.authors: Hoejoon Kwon, Jinhee Jang, Byeonggeuk Lim, YoungBin Kim
items.title_zh: 隔离语言外壳：多语言推理的内容控制研究
items.excerpt_zh: 多语言推理精炼需要选择教师推理所用的语言，但现有的方法常常将语言形式与生成、翻译和过滤的差异纠缠在一起。我们通过将相同的经过验证的英语轨迹渲染为英语、翻译的目标语言和语言混合外壳来构建内容控制的监督，并用三种目标语言对两名经过预训练的学生进行微调，在两个难度级别上评估他们的多语言数学推理。即使底层推理内容保持不变，我们发现 shell 选择可以改变下游的准确性，其效果因学生、语言和难度级别而异。预训练兼容性并不能始终如一地跟踪这些结果，即使我们的测试发现 shell 之间没有明显的准确性差异，它们的输出语言行为仍然可能存在很大差异。这些结果表明，监督外壳是多语言推理蒸馏中的独特设计选择。

items.title: Do Language Models Know Which Words Steer Their Reasoning?
items.excerpt: While chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits intermediate reasoning steps from language models, it is unclear which words in the context actually steer the CoT. We identify Phantom Context Influence (PCI): language models are disproportionately steered by semantically irrelevant context words, even as the same models deny those words' relevance when asked. To localize PCI, we introduce Leave-One-Out Word JSD analysis, which removes one context word at a time from the otherwise intact context to isolate its marginal effect on the next-token distribution; words whose removal flips the prediction (pivot words) are passed to the same LLM to self-judge whether it recognizes this predictive dependence. Across four models and three benchmarks, language models largely do not know which words steer their reasoning, a mismatch we call the Generation-Judgment Contradiction. Inspired by this phenomenon, we propose Online KV Suppression: it scores every prompt word's influence over the whole chain of thought in a single pass, then zeroes the KV-cache entries of the highest-influence word the model itself judges inert and redecodes. items.authors: Yanbei Jiang, Chao Lei, Jey Han Lau, Krista A. Ehinger, Rena Gao Wei
items.title_zh: 语言模型知道哪些单词引导它们的推理吗？
items.excerpt_zh: 虽然思想链 (CoT) 提示会从语言模型中引出中间推理步骤，但尚不清楚上下文中的哪些单词实际上引导着 CoT。我们确定了幻影上下文影响（PCI）：语言模型不成比例地受到语义上不相关的上下文单词的引导，即使相同的模型在被问及时否认这些单词的相关性。为了本地化 PCI，我们引入了留一词 JSD 分析，该分析一次从完整的上下文中删除一个上下文单词，以隔离其对下一个令牌分布的边际影响；删除会翻转预测的单词（枢轴词）将被传递给同一个 LLM，以自我判断它是否识别这种预测依赖性。在四个模型和三个基准中，语言模型很大程度上不知道哪些词引导它们的推理，我们将这种不匹配称为“生成-判断矛盾”。受这一现象的启发，我们提出了在线KV抑制：它一次性对每个提示词对整个思维链的影响力进行评分，然后将模型本身判断为惰性的影响力最高的词的KV缓存条目归零并重新解码。这款单瓦

items.title: Silent Arbitration: How Large Language Models Resolve Co-Authoritative Conflicting Instructions
items.excerpt: Large language models increasingly receive high-level instructions about roles, values, interests, and communication style. Such instructions can conflict even when a prompt assigns them equal authority and provides no priority rule. We study co-authoritative persona conflict, in which a single prompt jointly assigns two opposing personas. Across eight conflict types grounded in published source material and five LLMs, we measure conflict acknowledgment, resolution strategy, and directional stance. Models acknowledge incompatibility in 72% of direct checks but explicitly surface it in only 22% of task responses, revealing silent arbitration. Dominance accounts for 45% of dual-persona responses, and 35% of compromise-labeled responses retain directional lean. Prompt framing further changes the visible form of arbitration substantially more than ordinary paraphrase variation. These findings show that evaluating instruction following should assess whether models disclose conflicts, how they resolve them, and which persona their responses favor.
items.authors: Sihyeon Lee, Jiwoo Kum, Jihun Song, Chanwoo Kim, Chanjun Park
items.title_zh: 无声仲裁：大型语言模型如何解决共同权威冲突指令
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地接受有关角色、价值观、兴趣和沟通方式的高级指令。即使提示为它们分配了相同的权限并且没有提供优先级规则，此类指令也可能会发生冲突。我们研究共同权威角色冲突，其中单个提示共同分配两个对立的角色。在基于已发表的源材料和五名法学硕士的八种冲突类型中，我们衡量了冲突的承认、解决策略和方向立场。模型在 72% 的直接检查中承认不兼容，但仅在 22% 的任务响应中明确指出不兼容，这揭示了静默仲裁。 45% 的双重角色反应是主导性的，35% 的妥协标签反应保留了方向性倾向。与普通的释义变化相比，即时框架进一步改变了仲裁的可见形式。这些发现表明，评估指令遵循情况应该评估模型是否揭示了冲突、它们如何解决冲突以及它们的反应喜欢哪种角色。

items.title: Idempotent generically stable measures in NIP groups
items.excerpt: Let $\mu$ be a global generically stable Keisler measure on a type-definable group in an NIP theory. Then $\mu$ is idempotent if and only if it is the unique translation-invariant measure on its type-definable stabilizer subgroup. This resolves the NIP case of the Idempotent Measure problem studied by Chernikov, Gannon, and Krupi\'nski.
items.title_zh: NIP 组中的幂等通用稳定措施
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\mu$ 为 NIP 理论中类型可定义群上的全局一般稳定凯斯勒测度。那么 $\mu$ 是幂等的当且仅当它是其类型可定义的稳定器子群上的唯一平移不变测度。这解决了 Chernikov、Gannon 和 Krupi\'nski 研究的幂等测度问题的 NIP 情况。

items.title: The Power Of Enumerations
items.excerpt: We study the computational strength of enumerations of generic and random sets, particularly its interplay with computing these `typical' sets. We show that, while enumerations of $2$-generics can compute $2$-generics, this fails at higher levels---every $3$-generic has an enumeration which computes no weak $3$-generic. The analogous statement holds for randoms---every weak $2$-random has an enumeration which computes no $1$-random. We then analyze the total degrees above a quasiminimal enumeration degree, showing certain restrictions as well as certain positive results on the possible Turing degrees in such a cone. This answers a question of Slaman and Sorbi, by showing that there are quasiminimals with no minimal Turing degrees above them. We also show that while every total degree above some quasiminimals compute dimension $1$ sets, the total degrees above any quasiminimal fail to be a subset of the PA degrees.
items.title_zh: 枚举的力量
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究通用和随机集合的枚举的计算强度，特别是它与计算这些“典型”集合的相互作用。我们表明，虽然 $2$-generics 的枚举可以计算 $2$-generics，但在更高级别上会失败 - 每个 $3$-generics 都有一个枚举，它不会计算弱 $3$-generics。类似的陈述适用于随机数——每个弱 $2$-随机数都有一个不计算 $1$-随机数的枚举。然后，我们分析准最小枚举度以上的总度，显示出对此类锥体中可能的图灵度的某些限制以及某些积极结果。这通过证明存在不存在高于它们的最小图灵度来回答 Slaman 和 Sorbi 的问题。我们还表明，虽然高于某些拟极小数的每个总度都计算维度 $1$ 集，但高于任何拟极小数的总度都不能成为 PA 度的子集。

items.title: Littlestone Dimension and Its Dual
items.excerpt: The dual Littlestone dimension of a concept class $\mathcal{H}\subseteq\{0,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$, $\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}):=\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}^*)$, is the Littlestone dimension of the dual class $\mathcal{H}^*$, obtained by exchanging the roles of domain points and hypotheses. A classical result of Shelah implies that $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})$ and $\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})$ are finite simultaneously, and quantitative results of Hodges [Mathematika, 1981] imply the doubly exponential bound $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}))}}$. Malliaris and Moran [Trans. Amer. Math. Soc., 2024] asked whether this bound is optimal. We answer this by proving the improved bound \[ \operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})^2)}. \] An exponential dependence is necessary, as witnessed by the class of all binary hypotheses on a finite domain.
items.title_zh: Littlestone 维度及其对偶
items.excerpt_zh: 概念类 $\mathcal{H}\subseteq\{0,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$ 的对偶 Littlestone 维度，$\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}):=\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}^*)$ 是对偶类 $\mathcal{H}^*$ 的 Littlestone 维度，通过交换域点和假设。 Shelah 的经典结果意味着 $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})$ 和 $\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})$ 同时有限，Hodges [Mathematika, 1981] 的定量结果意味着双指数界 $\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H}))}}$。马利亚里斯和莫兰 [Trans。阿米尔。数学。 Soc.，2024]询问这个界限是否是最优的。我们通过证明改进的界限 \[ \operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal{H})\le 2^{O(\operatorname{Ldim}^*(\mathcal{H})^2)} 来回答这个问题。 \] 指数依赖性是必要的，正如有限域上所有二元假设的类所证明的那样。

items.title: The Ritt problem is decidable
items.excerpt: We give an affirmative solution to the Ritt problem.
items.authors: Jason Fang , James Freitag , Matthew Harrison-Trainor
items.title_zh: Ritt 问题是可判定的
items.excerpt_zh: 我们对Ritt问题给出肯定的解决方案。

items.title: Bridging Badiou's Gaps: Topos Theory and the Bodies of Mathematical Expression
items.excerpt: This article develops a second stage of an argument begun in 2013, revisiting Alain Badiou's use of topos theory in Being and Event and Logics of Worlds. The previous article diagnosed Badiou's reduction of topos theory to its atomistic, localic form as the scientific scapegoat in his attack on 'democratic materialism'. Now I ask what follows when this logicist illusion is dispelled and the categorical alternative is taken seriously, particularly with respect to forcing, semantic expression, and mathematical subjectification that constitute the key elements of Badiou's earlier work. I thus reconstruct Badiou's own arguments in a corrected form, while transferring them to a categorical framework. The aim is not to introduce new mathematical results, but to identify what is conceptually lost through their reduction to set-theoretic formalism. In particular, I describe Cohen's forcing argument in the context of Grothendieck topoi and Kripke-Joyal semantics, thereby explicating the geometric structures implicit in Badiou's thinking. This reconstruction further brings into view a different way of understanding Badiou's concepts of subjec
items.title_zh: 弥合巴迪欧的差距：拓扑斯理论和数学表达式的主体
items.excerpt_zh: 本文展开了 2013 年开始的争论的第二阶段，重新审视了阿兰·巴迪欧 (Alain Badiou) 在《存在与事件》和《世界逻辑》中对拓扑斯理论的使用。上一篇文章将巴迪欧将拓扑斯理论简化为其原子论的局部形式，诊断为他攻击“民主唯物主义”的科学替罪羊。现在我要问的是，当这种逻辑主义幻觉被消除并认真对待绝对选择时，特别是在构成巴迪欧早期作品关键要素的强迫、语义表达和数学主体化方面，会发生什么。因此，我以更正的形式重构了巴迪欧自己的论点，同时将它们转移到一个分类框架中。目的不是引入新的数学结果，而是确定由于将其简化为集合论形式主义而在概念上丢失了什么。特别是，我在格洛腾迪克拓扑学和克里普克-乔亚尔语义学的背景下描述了科恩的强制论证，从而解释了巴迪欧思想中隐含的几何结构。这种重构进一步带来了理解巴迪欧主体概念的不同方式。

items.title: Rates of metastability for a generalization of the Halpern iteration
items.excerpt: We apply proof mining methods developed by Kohlenbach and the second author to compute uniform rates of metastability for a generalization of the Halpern iteration studied by Kanzow and Shehu. As special cases, we obtain rates of metastability for the Halpern and modified Halpern iterations, as well as for the Tikhonov-Mann iteration. Furthermore, convergence results are obtained as immediate consequences of our quantitative results.
items.title_zh: Halpern 迭代推广的亚稳态率
items.excerpt_zh: 我们应用 Kohlenbach 和第二作者开发的证明挖掘方法来计算统一的亚稳态率，以推广 Kanzow 和 Shehu 研究的 Halpern 迭代。作为特殊情况，我们获得了 Halpern 和修改后的 Halpern 迭代以及 Tikhonov-Mann 迭代的亚稳态率。此外，收敛结果是我们定量结果的直接结果。

items.title: Half-integrality and an upper bound for slopes of Drinfeld cuspforms of level $Γ_1(t^r)$
items.excerpt: Let $p$ be a rational prime, let $q>1$ be a power of $p$ and let $\mathbb{F}_q$ be the field of $q$ elements. Let $k\geq 2$ and $r\geq 1$ be integers. Let $S_k(\Gamma_1(t^r))$ be the $\mathbb{C}_\infty$-vector space of Drinfeld cuspforms of rank two, level $\Gamma_1(t^r)$ and weight $k$ over $\mathbb{F}_q(t)$. In this paper, we prove that every finite $t$-adic slope of the Hecke operator $U_t$ on $S_k(\Gamma_1(t^r))$ belongs to $\frac{1}{2}\mathbb{Z}$ and is at most $k-2$. If $q$ is odd, then every such slope is an integer.
items.excerpt_zh: 设$p$为有理素数，设$q>1$为$p$的幂，设$\mathbb{F}_q$为$q$元素的域。令 $k\geq 2$ 和 $r\geq 1$ 为整数。令 $S_k(\Gamma_1(t^r))$ 为二阶 Drinfeld 尖峰的 $\mathbb{C}_\infty$ 向量空间，级别 $\Gamma_1(t^r)$ 和 $\mathbb{F}_q(t)$ 上的权重 $k$。在本文中，我们证明了 Hecke 算子 $U_t$ 在 $S_k(\Gamma_1(t^r))$ 上的每个有限 $t$-adic 斜率都属于 $\frac{1}{2}\mathbb{Z}$ 并且至多为 $k-2$。如果 $q$ 是奇数，则每个这样的斜率都是整数。
items.title_zh: $Г_1(t^r)$ 级 Drinfeld 尖端形状的半积分和斜率上限

items.title: The geometric expansion of the coarse trace formula of GL(4)
items.excerpt: We study the non-semisimple terms in the geometric side of Arthur's trace formula of $\rm{GL}(4)$ for the further study of the invariant trace formula. After modifying the zeta function and Arthur's definition of the weighted orbital integrals, we compare the two ways to calculate the distributions $J^T(f)$ of the geometric side, we can obtain that the distributions can be written as the linear combanition of the weighted orbital integrals. In particular, we get the coefficients $a^M(S,\gamma)$, for all $\gamma\in \rm{GL}(4,F)$, expressed by the measure and zeta functions.
items.authors: Haoyang Wang , Xinghua Cui , Weilong Zhang , Zhifeng Peng
items.title_zh: GL(4)粗迹公式的几何展开
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了Arthur迹公式$\rm{GL}(4)$几何方面的非半简单项，以进一步研究不变迹公式。修改zeta函数和Arthur对加权轨道积分的定义后，比较两种计算几何边分布$J^T(f)$的方法，可以得到分布可以写成加权轨道积分的线性组合。特别是，我们得到所有 $\gamma\in \rm{GL}(4,F)$ 的系数 $a^M(S,\gamma)$，由测度函数和 zeta 函数表示。

items.title: Lower bounds for mixed moments of modular and Dirichlet $L$-functions
items.excerpt: Let $f$ be a fixed holomorphic Hecke cusp form of level one. For every fixed positive integer $k$, we prove a lower bound of order $q(\log q)^{2k^2}$ for the $2k$-th moment of $L(1/2,f\otimes\chi)L(1/2,\chi)$ over primitive characters modulo a sufficiently large prime $q$.
items.title_zh: 模块化和狄利克雷 $L$ 函数的混合矩的下界
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $f$ 为第一级的固定全纯 Hecke 尖点形式。对于每个固定正整数 $k$，我们证明 $L(1/2,f\otimes\chi)L(1/2,\chi)$ 的第 $2k$ 个时刻的 $q(\log q)^{2k^2}$ 阶下界在原始字符上以足够大的素数 $q$ 为模。

items.title: Regular quadratic lattices are rare over real quadratic fields
items.excerpt: We show that a positive definite regular quadratic lattice of rank at least 4 over a totally real number field contains a regular sublattice that represents precisely the totally positive integers lying in an ideal. Under the generalized Riemann hypothesis and a conjecture on class numbers, it follows that, for each $m$, real quadratic fields admitting a positive definite regular lattice of some rank between 4 and $m$ have density 0. Unconditionally, only finitely many real quadratic fields of narrow class number 1 admit a positive definite regular lattice of some rank between 4 and 7.
items.title_zh: 正则二次晶格在真实二次域中很少见
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，在全实数域上，秩至少为 4 的正定正二次格子包含一个正则子格子，该子格子精确地表示理想中的全正整数。根据广义黎曼假设和类数猜想，对于每个 $m$，允许 4 到 $m$ 之间某个阶的正定正格格的实二次域的密度为 0。无条件地，只有有限多个窄类号 1 的实二次域允许 4 到 7 之间某个阶的正定正格格。

items.title: Generalized Markov numbers and plane lattices
items.excerpt: We give new explicit constructions of lattice rules in the two-dimensional square and torus. It is well-known that uniformly distributed lattices (in the sense of low-discrepancy) arise from continued fractions with bounded partial denominators. We demonstrate how integers solutions of the generalized Markov equation $x^2+y^2+z^2 = kxyz-k+3$ give rise to such lattices.
items.title_zh: 广义马尔可夫数和平面格
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了二维正方形和环面晶格规则的新显式构造。众所周知，均匀分布的格子（在低差异的意义上）是由具有有界部分分母的连分数产生的。我们演示了广义马尔可夫方程 $x^2+y^2+z^2 = kxyz-k+3$ 的整数解如何产生这样的格。

items.title: A Model of Diverse Sampling from Language Models
items.excerpt: Language models often produce high-quality individual samples but poor sets, with repeated samples clustering around the same semantic modes. We formalize diverse generation as sampling a size-$K$ subset of complete strings from a determinantal point process (DPP), where the likelihood encodes item quality, and the embedding geometry encodes repulsion between similar outputs. Exact inference over all strings is intractable, so we propose PoolDPP: draw a finite candidate pool from a tractable proposal, importance-weight the candidates toward the target quality, and run a $K$-DPP sampler on the induced pool kernel; a greedy MAP variant provides deterministic selection. We prove a finite-sample bound with an explicit constant: the KL divergence between the sampler's output and the target $K$-DPP decays as O(1/N) in the pool size. Empirically, PoolDPP extends the quality--diversity frontier on open-ended generation and the precision--recall frontier on ambiguous text-to-SQL (Ambrosia), and on mathematical reasoning (GSM8K), it raises diversity at about the same pass@$K$.
items.authors: Manuel Prada-Corral, Yahya Emara, Timothy J. O'Donnell, Ryan Cotterell, Tim Vieira
items.excerpt_zh: 语言模型通常会产生高质量的单个样本，但会产生较差的集合，重复样本聚集在相同的语义模式周围。我们将多样化生成形式化为从行列式点过程 (DPP) 中采样完整字符串的大小 $K$ 子集，其中可能性编码项目质量，嵌入几何编码相似输出之间的排斥。对所有字符串进行精确推断是很困难的，因此我们提出了 PoolDPP：从易于处理的提案中提取有限候选池，根据目标质量对候选进行重要性加权，并在诱导池内核上运行 $K$-DPP 采样器；贪婪的 MAP 变体提供了确定性选择。我们证明了具有显式常量的有限样本界限：采样器输出与目标 $K$-DPP 之间的 KL 散度在池大小中衰减为 O(1/N)。根据经验，PoolDPP 扩展了开放式生成的质量多样性边界和模糊文本到 SQL (Ambrosia) 的精确回忆边界，以及数学推理 (GSM8K)，它以大约相同的 pass@$K$ 提高了多样性。

items.title: Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes
items.excerpt: The sample compression conjecture is a longstanding open problem in learning theory, originating in the work of Littlestone and Warmuth in the 1980s. At its heart is a connection between simplification and generalization: if a predictor consistent with a training sample is defined using only a small part of that sample, then it is likely to generalize. Sample compression schemes formalize this idea, and many natural learning algorithms can be analyzed this way. The sample compression conjecture of Floyd and Warmuth (1995) asserts that every binary concept class of VC dimension $d$ admits a sample compression scheme of size $O(d)$; a weaker conjecture asks only for size polynomial in $d$. Both have remained open: the first bound depending only on $d$, due to Moran and Yehudayoff (2016), is exponential in $d$. We prove the weaker conjecture by constructing a sample compression scheme of size $O(d^2 \log^2 d)$.
items.authors: Yang Cai, Vineet Gupta, Yanchen Jiang, Christopher Liaw, Aranyak Mehta, Shay Moran, Grigoris Velegkas, Di Wang, Manfred K. Warmuth
items.title_zh: 所有 VC 类的近二次样本压缩
items.excerpt_zh: 样本压缩猜想是学习理论中长期存在的开放性问题，起源于 Littlestone 和 Warmuth 在 20 世纪 80 年代的工作。其核心是简化和泛化之间的联系：如果仅使用该样本的一小部分来定义与训练样本一致的预测变量，那么它很可能会泛化。样本压缩方案形式化了这个想法，并且许多自然学习算法都可以通过这种方式进行分析。 Floyd 和 Warmuth (1995) 的样本压缩猜想断言 VC 维度 $d$ 的每个二元概念类都承认大小为 $O(d)$ 的样本压缩方案；较弱的猜想仅要求 $d$ 中的大小多项式。两者都保持开放状态：根据 Moran 和 Yehudayoff (2016) 的说法，第一个边界仅取决于 $d$，并且与 $d$ 呈指数关系。我们通过构建大小为 $O(d^2 \log^2 d)$ 的样本压缩方案来证明较弱的猜想。

items.title: Rate-distortion Assessment for Hierarchical Content Summarization
items.excerpt: Powerful generative models including large language and vision models have demonstrated success across a wide range of content generation, editing and manipulation tasks via end-to-end prompt-based generation. However, current assessment of the quality of generative content manipulation remains subjective, limiting scientific understanding of model capabilities. Inspired by rate-distortion theory from Shannon information compression theory, in this work we formalize hierarchical content summarization as an information encoding problem. We design a principled framework to extract the semantic hierarchy of the source content to support quantitative characterization of the rate-distortion trade-off between compression efficiency (rate) against information loss (distortion) during generative content manipulation, which allows us to benchmark various models with respect to performance conditional on rate budget of interest. We demonstrate the use of the framework with empirical experiments on content summarization for long-context question-answering with state-of-the-art large language models, offering new insights into their efficiency an
items.authors: Yunye Gong, Indranil Sur, Jared Claypoole, Pritish Sahu, Ajay Divakaran
items.excerpt_zh: 包括大型语言和视觉模型在内的强大生成模型已经通过端到端基于提示的生成在广泛的内容生成、编辑和操作任务中取得了成功。然而，目前对生成内容操作质量的评估仍然是主观的，限制了对模型能力的科学理解。受香农信息压缩理论中的率失真理论的启发，在这项工作中，我们将分层内容摘要形式化为信息编码问题。我们设计了一个原则框架来提取源内容的语义层次结构，以支持生成内容操作过程中压缩效率（速率）与信息丢失（失真）之间的速率失真权衡的定量表征，这使我们能够根据感兴趣的速率预算对各种模型的性能进行基准测试。我们通过对内容摘要的实证实验来演示该框架的使用，以使用最先进的大型语言模型进行长上下文问答，为其效率和效率提供新的见解。

items.title: Cross-Question Reliable Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: AI systems operating near the limits of their capabilities can maximize utility while minimizing the risk of error by abstaining or deferring questions they are not confident about to a human or a stronger model. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been post-trained to estimate confidence in their own answers. To achieve this, methods reinforce confidence scores based on the correctness signal to each question-answer pair individually, with rewards that encourage assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect answers. However, estimating confidence scores is useful in that it enables selecting only the most confident answers, to maximize the share of solved questions while accommodating the user's risk tolerance. Assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect ones is theoretically optimal, but unattainable in practice and detrimental for selective prediction with a non-zero risk tolerance: confidences pushed to 0 and 1 carry no information about how answers compare to one another. We therefore introduce CARE (Cross-question Abstention Reward Estimation), which computes rewards over a set of question

items.title: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
items.excerpt: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. items.title: Interference Bounds and Merge-Aware Training Dynamics for Composable Fine-Tuned Models
items.excerpt: Combining fine-tuned models by composing their parameter updates has become a standard alternative to multi-task training. We formalize composability as a property of a collection of task vectors and prove that the excess loss of the merged model is controlled by an interference functional of the cross-task curvature overlap and the signed alignment of the updates. In the quadratic regime this functional equals the excess loss, giving a criterion that is necessary as well as sufficient and that measures the angle between task vectors in the curvature metric rather than the Euclidean one. Fine-tuning under a curvature-guided regularizer -- constructed from curvature statistics of the kind memory-efficient optimizers maintain -- keeps displacement in the base curvature metric below a ceiling set by the penalty coefficient at every iterate, at the standard $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ non-convex rate. items.title: Inverse ECG Reconstruction via a Preconditioned Variational Quantum Linear Solver
items.excerpt: Inverse electrocardiography (ECG) reconstructs heart-surface potentials from body-surface measurements, enabling noninvasive mapping of cardiac electrical activity. However, the reconstruction requires solving dense and ill-conditioned linear systems, whose computational cost grows rapidly with the refined heart mesh. Quantum computing offers new opportunities for solving such systems. This paper presents a hybrid quantum-classical framework for inverse ECG reconstruction, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to apply a quantum linear solver to this problem. We first propose a Laplacian-regularized pre-encoding procedure to reduce the dimension of the system while improving its conditioning. Second, the resulting reduced system is encoded and solved using a coherent variational quantum linear solver (VQLS). Finally, we provide a rigorous theoretical proof establishing that the proposed framework preserves the exact solution of the original reconstruction problem throughout all stages of the computational process. items.title: Extending Rademacher Complexity-Based Generalization Theory to Domain Generalization
items.excerpt: Domain generalization (DG) aims to train models on multiple source domains with distinct distributions to ensure robust performance on unseen target domains. In doing so, it elevates the concept of generalization from the traditional sample level to the distribution level. Existing theoretical frameworks introduce a domain space endowed with a meta-distribution to extend classical generalization analysis to this new setting. However, these approaches typically treat the domain space as devoid of geometry. In reality, the domain space is an inherently infinite-dimensional, nonlinear abstract space composed of probability distributions, and its complex geometric properties fundamentally determine generalization behavior. Consequently, existing geometry-free theories of domain generalization have a fundamental limitation. They lack a formal characterization of what distinguishes distribution-level generalization from sample-level generalization, leaving the inherent difficulty of generalizing across domains largely unexplained. items.title: Artificial mathematics
items.excerpt: As a current Director of Graduate Studies in a math department, I wanted to write something to encourage our students and potential students, to reassure them of the abiding importance of human mathematics. The result is not practical advice, but maybe an update of Roosevelt’s line about fear for the AI age.
items.title_zh: 人工数学
items.excerpt_zh: 作为现任数学系研究生主任，我想写一些东西来鼓励我们的学生和潜在的学生，让他们相信人类数学的持久重要性。结果并不是实用的建议，但可能是罗斯福关于人工智能时代恐惧的言论的更新。

items.title: Letter to young mathematicians
items.excerpt: What we are living through is a creative destruction, in which an old way of creating value is dismantled while a new one emerges. But this is also a major opportunity. Mathematicians are better positioned, and more needed, than at any point in history, I believe.
items.title_zh: 致青年数学家的信
items.excerpt_zh: 我们正在经历的是一种创造性的破坏，一种旧的创造价值的方式被拆除，同时一种新的价值创造方式出现。但这也是一个重大机遇。我相信，数学家比历史上任何时候都处于更好的地位，也更需要数学家。

items.title: The Right to Think
items.excerpt: “In the first day of philosophy, my professor walked up to the blackboard and wrote a single word in capital letters: MAN. Then he turned around and asked us what it meant. Silence. We were fifteen, and afraid of saying something banal. In the end we arrived at an answer: man is a rational animal. […]”

items.title: VeriMath: Human-in-the-Loop Generation and Verification of Curriculum-Aligned Mathematics Assessment Items
items.excerpt: Automatic generation of mathematics assessment items is a growing area in educational artificial intelligence, yet classroom deployment remains challenging. Generated questions must satisfy multiple constraints: mathematical correctness, curriculum alignment, appropriate cognitive difficulty, and educator reviewability. While prior work has advanced text generation, reliable assessment authoring requires granular control over localized examination formats and expert educational judgment. To address this challenge, we present VeriMath, a generalized, human-in-the-loop framework for generating rigorous, curriculum-constrained mathematics assessment drafts. Using annotated reference items, the framework anchors generation to the requested examination section and cognitive reasoning level, then applies sequential automated verification and guided repair before submitting drafts for expert review. We evaluate VeriMath through a national curriculum case study using 4,555 mathematics items from the Vietnamese Grade 12 curriculum and 50 distinct generation requirements covering multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer formats. items.title: LProp: Propagating Latent Uncertainty through Evidence-Conditioned Belief Revision in LLM Agents
items.excerpt: When LLM agents pass intermediate judgments downstream without uncertainty, later decisions may treat tentative assumptions as facts. Effective uncertainty propagation must preserve information for correction and update inherited beliefs as new evidence arrives. Yet scalar scores omit information needed for revision, while detailed descriptions and reflection incur additional costs. We introduce Latent Uncertainty, a latent-space estimator that preserves uncertainty-relevant information without lengthy descriptions. Building on this, we propose LProp (Latent Uncertainty Propagation), which revises inherited answer distributions using latent representations and new evidence without additional trajectory sampling. We evaluate both methods across multiple-choice, yes/no, open-ended question answering, and mathematical reasoning tasks. Our approach outperforms baselines on most metrics, while LProp achieves the lowest mean inference-token usage in all eight propagation settings. Matched feature ablations further demonstrate that inherited latent content improves error recovery beyond answer probabilities or model capacity alone.
items.authors: Kaiwen Shi, Zheyuan Zhang, Weixiang Sun, Han Bao, Colby Nelson, Yanfang Ye
items.title_zh: LProp：通过 LLM 代理人的证据条件信念修正传播潜在的不确定性
items.excerpt_zh: 当LLM代理在没有不确定性的情况下向下游传递中间判断时，后续决策可能会将暂定假设视为事实。有效的不确定性传播必须保留信息以供纠正，并在新证据出现时更新继承的信念。然而，标量分数忽略了复习所需的信息，而详细的描述和反思会产生额外的成本。我们引入潜在不确定性，这是一种潜在空间估计器，可以保留与不确定性相关的信息，而无需冗长的描述。在此基础上，我们提出了 LProp（潜在不确定性传播），它使用潜在表示和新证据来修改继承的答案分布，而无需额外的轨迹采样。我们在多项选择、是/否、开放式问答和数学推理任务中评估这两种方法。我们的方法在大多数指标上都优于基线，而 LProp 在所有八种传播设置中实现了最低的平均推理令牌使用率。匹配的特征消融进一步证明，继承的潜在内容可以改善错误恢复，而不仅仅是答案概率或模型容量。

items.title: EVA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Evaluators for Judging Temporal Quality
items.excerpt: Video evaluators play an important role in video generation, yet they miss motion defects, limiting the quality of generated videos. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) has made strong progress in mathematics and coding, where explicit verifiers provide reliable feedback on a single goal. Video evaluation poses two difficulties for RSI: it has no verifier, and it must judge many dimensions at once, such as physics, smoothness and dynamics, where a gain on one can cost another. We introduce EVA-RSI, a multi-agent framework for exploring RSI under these two constraints. We build a fixed proxy exam with construction-defined targets by applying controlled changes to videos, such as temporal reversal and frame dropping. These edits supply supervision without human annotation. A small set of human-labeled real videos anchors the exam to human judgment. Each dimension has an LLM agent that proposes improvements. A leader agent coordinates the proposals, and a Nash bargaining rule selects updates that balance progress across dimensions. Humans design the exam, review candidate changes and revise the curriculum between stages. Starting from Qwen3
items.authors: Yu Yuan, Ruizhou Ding, Shaoheng Fang, Stanley H. Chan, Zhuo Chen
items.title_zh: EVA-RSI：用于判断时间质量的视频评估器的递归自我改进
items.excerpt_zh: 视频评估器在视频生成中发挥着重要作用，但他们会忽略运动缺陷，从而限制了生成视频的质量。递归自我改进（RSI）在数学和编码方面取得了长足的进步，其中显式验证器为单个目标提供了可靠的反馈。视频评估给 RSI 带来了两个困难：它没有验证器，并且必须同时判断多个维度，例如物理、平滑度和动态，其中一个维度的收益可能会导致另一个维度的损失。我们引入了 EVA-RSI，一个用于在这两个约束下探索 RSI 的多智能体框架。我们通过对视频应用受控更改（例如时间反转和丢帧）来构建具有构造定义目标的固定代理考试。这些编辑无需人工注释即可提供监督。一小部分带有人类标签的真实视频将考试锚定为人类判断。每个维度都有一个 LLM 代理提出改进建议。领导者代理协调提案，纳什讨价还价规则选择平衡跨维度进展的更新。人类设计考试、审查考生的变化并在各个阶段之间修改课程。从Qwen3开始

items.title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents
items.excerpt: Vision-language agents that browse websites, operate phones and act in homes reason before every action, so every step waits for a large model, a latency and cost that stand in the way of deployment. Step-level speculation lets a small model draft each step and calls the large model only on rejected drafts, but its outcome rests on the judge, and a judge that reads only a step's text cannot tell whether the step fits the screen it acts on. We find that a few samples of a small model can contain a correct step about as often as the large model gets the step right, and not always on the same steps: checked against the screen, small drafts can be not only cheaper but better. We present Vanguard, a training-free judge that leaves the draft and target models unchanged: a general decision model, with the screenshot in view, gives each candidate step a probability of being right in one forward pass; the best candidate is kept if it clears a threshold, and otherwise the large model writes the step. On web, mobile and embodied agents, a 2B draft judged by Vanguard is at least as accurate as its 8B target and significantly more accurate on Mind
items.authors: Hanqi Mao, Jiajun Fan, Ruihan Guo, Shuaike Shen, Ziwen Wang, Hui Ren, Xianrui Zhong, Ge Liu
items.title_zh: Vanguard：知道何时信任投机性视觉语言代理的草案
items.excerpt_zh: 浏览网站、操作电话和在家中行动的视觉语言代理在执行每个操作之前都会进行推理，因此每一步都需要等待一个大型模型，延迟和成本阻碍了部署。步骤级推测让小模型起草每个步骤，并仅在被拒绝的草稿上调用大模型，但其结果取决于法官，而仅读取步骤文本的法官无法判断该步骤是否适合其所作用的屏幕。我们发现，小模型的一些样本可以包含与大模型正确步骤一样多的正确步骤，但并不总是在相同的步骤上：根据屏幕检查，小草稿不仅更便宜，而且更好。我们提出了 Vanguard，一种无需训练的判断，保持草稿和目标模型不变：一个通用决策模型，可以看到屏幕截图，为每个候选步骤提供在一次前向传递中正确的概率；如果清除了阈值，则保留最佳候选者，否则大型模型将写入该步骤。在网络、移动和实体代理上，Vanguard 判断的 2B 草案至少与其 8B 目标一样准确，并且在 Mind 上准确得多

items.title: SCAFFOLD: Toward Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport for Reusable LLM-Agent Skills
items.excerpt: An agent skill that succeeded yesterday may be executable today without being justified for reuse today. Tests may cover only observable contract clauses, outcome oracles may be absent, evaluations may inherit the same erroneous specification, and permissions or dependencies may change between validation and invocation. We argue that the appropriate unit of prospective trust is a Warranted Reuse Claim (WRC): a defeasible, claim-specific authorization tied to a versioned skill, target context, evidence, assumptions, and identified defeaters. The paper sharpens this position through Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport (WPET), a proposed discipline for deciding which historical evidence remains admissible after context change. It distinguishes evidence admissibility from truth of the supported safety or effectiveness claim; states a conditional preservation result and its limits; specifies three-valued applicability and asymmetric context-transfer judgments; and illustrates how provenance dependence and policy-invalidating changes alter authorization. We explicitly relate the proposal to assurance cases, contracts, and skill-library ma
items.title_zh: SCAFFOLD：为可重复使用的法学硕士代理人技能提供保全证据的运输
items.excerpt_zh: 昨天成功的代理技能今天可能可以执行，但今天没有理由重复使用。测试可能仅涵盖可观察的合同条款，结果预言可能不存在，评估可能继承相同的错误规范，并且权限或依赖关系可能在验证和调用之间发生变化。我们认为，预期信任的适当单位是有保证的重用声明（WRC）：与版本化技能、目标上下文、证据、假设和已识别的失败者相关联的可撤销的、特定于声明的授权。该论文通过保证保留证据传输（WPET）强化了这一立场，这是一项拟议的学科，用于决定在背景变化后哪些历史证据仍然可接受。它将证据的可接受性与所支持的安全性或有效性主张的真实性区分开来；说明有条件保存的结果及其限制；指定三值适用性和不对称上下文转移判断；并说明出处依赖性和政策无效变更如何改变授权。我们明确地将提案与保证案例、合同和技能库管理联系起来

items.title: KnowledgeClaw: Towards Agentic Knowledge Engineering via Omnimodal Hypergraphs
items.excerpt: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, agentic KE and multimodal KE. However, a live knowledge base needs omnimodality, a closed-loop lifecycle and multi-granular application at once, yet existing systems meet at most two and no benchmark measures all three. We formalize Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering (OmniKE) and release OmniKE-Bench, six tasks with 1,829 model-free items over 3,960 real files in five modalities. We further propose KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds an omnimodal typed hypergraph, keeps it current with a closed-loop lifecycle agent and routes each query to the granularity it needs. Against 30 baselines, it ranks first on all six tasks with an overall OKE of 55.9, +14.6 over the strongest baseline. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/KnowledgeClaw.
items.authors: Haoran Luo, Jiapu Wang, Linhao Luo, Luu Anh Tuan
items.title_zh: KnowledgeClaw：通过全模态超图迈向代理知识工程
items.excerpt_zh: 知识工程 (KE) 将原始文件转变为推理就绪的知识库，这是 LLM 代理现在可以完成的任务。 KE 已经从块和图检索增强生成（RAG）发展到记忆代理、代理 KE 和多模态 KE。然而，实时知识库同时需要全模态、闭环生命周期和多粒度应用程序，但现有系统最多满足两个，并且没有基准衡量所有三个。我们正式确定了 Omnimodal 知识工程 (OmniKE) 并发布了 OmniKE-Bench，这是六项任务，涉及五种模式的 3,960 个真实文件中的 1,829 个无模型项目。我们进一步提出 KnowledgeClaw，这是一个构建全模态类型超图的代理系统，使其与闭环生命周期代理保持同步，并将每个查询路由到其所需的粒度。在 30 条基线中，它在所有六项任务中排名第一，总体 OKE 为 55.9，比最强基线高出 14.6。我们的软件和数据可在 https://github.com/LHRLAB/KnowledgeClaw 上公开获取。

items.title: automodel: A Skill for Agentic Model Discovery
items.excerpt: The search for better models, whether expressed as analytical equations or neural architectures, has increasingly shifted from manual design toward data-driven automation. While a multitude of algorithms exist, ranging from exhaustive search to AlphaEvolve, recent advances in general-purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex raise the question: could providing such systems with a "model discovery recipe" be enough to discover or improve models? We present automodel, an agent skill for general model discovery. With case studies in astrophysics, cardiovascular dynamics, precision agriculture, traffic flow, and vehicle tire dynamics, we show how commercial agents equipped with automodel can successfully identify novel and scientifically-relevant models. Our findings suggest that encoding model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill can provide a simple, interactive, powerful and broadly applicable alternative to domain-specific automated discovery pipelines. The skill is available at: https://github.com/unlayer-ai/automodel.
items.authors: Marco Virgolin, Harry Desmond, Ester Bergantin, Giorgio Morales, John W. Sheppard, Luigi Romano, Alessandro Lucantonio
items.title_zh: automodel：代理模型发现的技能
items.excerpt_zh: 对更好模型的搜索，无论是表达为分析方程还是神经架构，已经逐渐从手动设计转向数据驱动的自动化。虽然存在多种算法，从穷举搜索到 AlphaEvolve，但 Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex 等通用编码代理的最新进展提出了一个问题：为此类系统提供“模型发现配方”是否足以发现或改进模型？我们提出了自动模型，一种用于一般模型发现的代理技能。通过天体物理学、心血管动力学、精准农业、交通流和车辆轮胎动力学的案例研究，我们展示了配备汽车模型的商业代理如何成功识别新颖且与科学相关的模型。我们的研究结果表明，将模型发现方法编码为便携式代理技能可以为特定领域的自动发现管道提供简单、交互式、强大且广泛适用的替代方案。该技能位于：https://github.com/unlayer-ai/automodel。

items.title: CaDO: Formal Verification-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Causal Dataset Repair and Generation
items.excerpt: High-quality causal reasoning datasets are essential for developing models with reliable causal understanding, particularly in specialized domains. However, existing datasets frequently suffer from incorrect annotations and structural imbalances, which can lead to biased predictions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose CaDO (Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization), a multi-agent framework for automated diagnosis and repair of causal reasoning datasets. Our framework consists of three key stages: formal causal reasoning, multi-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation. First, a Formalizer Agent translates natural language questions into formal causal queries to minimize semantic deviations and make retrieval and verification more explicit and tractable. Second, a dual-level diagnosis mechanism employs independent Critic Agents to identify sample-level errors while analyzing query-type coverage and label distributions to detect dataset-level structural imbalances. Finally, the framework employs reusable repair operators grounded in formal causal semantics to correct erroneous samples,
items.title_zh: CaDO：用于因果数据集修复和生成的形式化验证引导多代理框架
items.excerpt_zh: 高质量的因果推理数据集对于开发具有可靠因果理解的模型至关重要，特别是在专业领域。然而，现有数据集经常遭受不正确的注释和结构不平衡的影响，这可能导致预测有偏差和泛化能力有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了CaDO（因果引擎引导多智能体数据优化），这是一种用于自动诊断和修复因果推理数据集的多智能体框架。我们的框架由三个关键阶段组成：形式因果推理、多级诊断以及自动数据修复和生成。首先，形式化代理将自然语言问题转换为形式因果查询，以最大限度地减少语义偏差并使检索和验证更加明确和易于处理。其次，双层诊断机制采用独立的批评家代理来识别样本级错误，同时分析查询类型覆盖率和标签分布以检测数据集级结构不平衡。最后，该框架采用基于形式因果语义的可重用修复运算符来纠正错误样本，

items.title: Budgeted Proper Loss Design for Uncertain Decision Thresholds
items.excerpt: A binary probability estimate may be used by several decision makers with different error costs. Proper scoring rules can emphasize selected probability thresholds, but a single average threshold distribution need not give a good worst-case regret guarantee. We study the choice of a proper loss when the threshold distribution belongs to a finite specified family. Among integrable loss weights with a positive pointwise floor and a fixed total mass, we derive the weight that minimizes the sharp, distribution-free multiplier from surrogate regret to threshold-averaged decision regret. The solution clips a rescaled upper envelope of the threshold densities at the prescribed floor; its normalization is found by a one-dimensional root search. We give proofs of sharpness, optimality, and stability under density misspecification, as well as a limitation for atomic threshold laws. An exact histogram implementation and two synthetic experiments across 20 seeds verify the construction. The optimized multiplier improves over uniform and average-density weights, while fitted-model performance does not improve uniformly. The result is a loss-design
items.authors: Ankit Sharma (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore)
items.title_zh: 针对不确定的决策阈值进行适当的预算损失设计
items.excerpt_zh: 二元概率估计可由具有不同错误成本的多个决策者使用。适当的评分规则可以强调选定的概率阈值，但单个平均阈值分布不需要给出良好的最坏情况遗憾保证。我们研究当阈值分布属于有限指定族时适当损失的选择。在具有正的逐点下限和固定总质量的可积损失权重中，我们推导出最小化从替代遗憾到阈值平均决策遗憾的尖锐、无分布乘数的权重。该解决方案将阈值密度的重新调整的上包络线剪裁在规定的楼层；它的标准化是通过一维根搜索找到的。我们给出了密度错误指定下的清晰度、最优性和稳定性的证明，以及原子阈值定律的限制。精确的直方图实现和针对 20 个种子的两次综合实验验证了该结构。优化的乘数相对于均匀和平均密度权重有所改善，而拟合模型性能并未均匀改善。结果是损失设计

items.title: Stability of Parallel Transport Convolution under Riemannian Metric Perturbations
items.excerpt: Geometric convolutions on Riemannian manifolds depend on the geometry of the underlying domain, making stability under metric perturbations a fundamental question in geometric deep learning. This paper studies this question for parallel transport convolution through methods from differential geometry and analysis. On a fixed compact manifold, we establish that, for a continuous input signal and a continuous reference kernel supported in a sufficiently small normal neighborhood, the convolution output depends continuously in $L^2$ on the Riemannian metric in the $C^2$-topology, under the specified localization and transport-path conventions. The analysis develops perturbation estimates for geodesics, parallel transport, Jacobi fields, and exponential maps, and uses these estimates to compare the transported kernels. A central difficulty is the cut locus, which obstructs uniform comparison of the transport construction over the entire manifold. We address this difficulty by combining uniform estimates away from the cut locus with integral bounds on neighborhoods of arbitrarily small volume, while also controlling the change in the Riema
items.title_zh: 黎曼度量摄动下并行传输卷积的稳定性
items.excerpt_zh: 黎曼流形上的几何卷积取决于基础域的几何形状，使得度量扰动下的稳定性成为几何深度学习中的基本问题。本文通过微分几何和分析的方法研究了并行传输卷积的问题。在固定的紧凑流形上，我们确定，对于连续输入信号和在足够小的正态邻域中支持的连续参考内核，在指定的定位和传输路径约定下，卷积输出在 $L^2$ 中连续依赖于 $C^2$ 拓扑中的黎曼度量。该分析开发了测地线、并行传输、雅可比场和指数图的扰动估计，并使用这些估计来比较传输的内核。一个主要困难是切割轨迹，它阻碍了整个流形上传输结构的统一比较。我们通过将远离切割轨迹的统一估计与任意小体积邻域的积分边界相结合来解决这个困难，同时还控制 Riema 的变化

items.title: Same Rank, Different Needs: Rethinking LoRA Redistribution in Federated Learning
items.excerpt: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables clients with different resource budgets to collaboratively fine-tune foundation models. To distribute an aggregated update within each client's rank budget, existing methods commonly retain its leading singular directions. However, directions that best reconstruct the update matrix need not best preserve its responses on a particular client's inputs: a lower-energy direction may matter more to that recipient. We formalize this mismatch and show that matrix-optimal truncation can incur arbitrarily larger response error than another readout of the same rank. Motivated by this result, we propose Receiver-Aware Subspace Adaptation (RASA), a plug-in framework for receiver-aware knowledge transfer. RASA uses compact diagonal input second moments to perform uncentered PCA of receiver-weighted update responses. The resulting readout is globally optimal for the rank-constrained receiver objective and preserves at least as much response energy as spectral truncation under the diagonal metric. RASA also introduces spectral-reference aggregation, which removes the personalized initialization offset whi
items.authors: Jinqian Chen, Jihua Zhu, Chang Liu
items.title_zh: 相同的等级，不同的需求：重新思考联邦学习中的 LoRA 重新分配
items.excerpt_zh: 联合低秩适应（LoRA）使具有不同资源预算的客户能够协作微调基础模型。为了在每个客户的排名预算内分配聚合更新，现有方法通常保留其领先的单一方向。然而，最好地重建更新矩阵的方向不需要最好地保留其对特定客户端输入的响应：较低能量的方向可能对该接收者更重要。我们形式化了这种不匹配，并表明矩阵最优截断可能会比相同等级的另一个读数产生任意更大的响应误差。受此结果的启发，我们提出了接收者感知子空间适应（RASA），这是一个用于接收者感知知识转移的插件框架。 RASA 使用紧凑对角输入二阶矩来执行接收器加权更新响应的非中心 PCA。所得到的读数对于秩受限的接收器目标是全局最优的，并且至少保留与对角线度量下的频谱截断一样多的响应能量。 RASA 还引入了光谱参考聚合，消除了个性化初始化偏移

items.title: VESPA: Verifiable Symbolic Policy Adaptation for Safe Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) aims to prevent agents from taking actions that are dangerous or destructive to their environment. This is especially important for safety-critical domains, such as robotics or autonomous driving. Formal verification can be used to prove agent safety through safety constraints. However, in practice, many policies do violate safety constraints, and thus are verified to be unsafe. Since the goal is to obtain a safe policy, we would need to retrain a new policy from scratch and then verify it again until a candidate happens to pass. Both training and verification are usually not cheap, which makes this process inefficient. We introduce VESPA ($\textbf{VE}$rifiable $\textbf{S}$ymbolic $\textbf{P}$olicy $\textbf{A}$daptation), a framework for targeted fine-tuning of decision tree policies. We show that using counterexamples for policy adaptation can make existing unsafe policies safe, or at least make considerable progress towards safety. Targeted fine-tuning of the existing policy on those counterexamples enables it to learn how to avoid violating safety constraints. We thus use the result of a formal veri
items.authors: Paul K\"onig, Sascha Marton, Stefan L\"udtke, Christian Bartelt
items.title_zh: VESPA：可验证的符号策略适应安全强化学习
items.excerpt_zh: 安全强化学习（RL）旨在防止智能体采取对其环境有害或破坏的行为。这对于机器人或自动驾驶等安全关键领域尤其重要。形式化验证可用于通过安全约束来证明代理安全。然而，在实践中，许多策略确实违反了安全约束，因此被证实是不安全的。由于目标是获得安全的策略，因此我们需要从头开始重新训练新策略，然后再次验证它，直到候选人恰好通过。训练和验证通常都不便宜，这使得这个过程效率低下。我们引入了 VESPA ($\textbf{VE}$rABLE $\textbf{S}$ymbolic $\textbf{P}$olicy $\textbf{A}$daptation)，这是一个用于有针对性地微调决策树策略的框架。我们表明，使用反例进行政策调整可以使现有的不安全政策变得安全，或者至少在安全方面取得重大进展。针对这些反例对现有政策进行有针对性的微调，使其能够学习如何避免违反安全约束。因此，我们使用正式验证的结果

items.title: The geometry of neural network decision boundaries
items.excerpt: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) are built using well-understood mathematical operations, yet their complex nature poses significant challenges to intuitively understanding their decision-making processes. This work introduces a method for visualizing and measuring ANN decision boundary geometry directly in the high-dimensional input space, avoiding distortions found with traditional projection-based techniques. We analyze boundary curvatures and distances in diverse inputs, architectures, and training methods. Boundary distances grow smoothly and slowly with consistent curvature as the size of the subspace increases, suggesting that decision boundaries are close to input samples within large, continuous subspaces. We also quantify how much boundary distances and curvatures reduce near dataset samples after adversarial training. Training methodology has a significantly stronger impact on boundary distance and curvature than architecture or test-set accuracy. These findings are contextualized within prior work, supporting or refuting several previously proposed theories of boundary behavior. Our analytically and empirically supported
items.authors: Dylan M Paiton, David L Schultheiss, Matthias K\"ummerer, Zac Cranko, Matthias Bethge
items.title_zh: 神经网络决策边界的几何形状
items.excerpt_zh: 人工神经网络 (ANN) 是使用易于理解的数学运算构建的，但其复杂性对直观理解其决策过程提出了重大挑战。这项工作介绍了一种直接在高维输入空间中可视化和测量 ANN 决策边界几何形状的方法，避免了传统基于投影的技术发现的失真。我们分析不同输入、架构和训练方法中的边界曲率和距离。随着子空间大小的增加，边界距离以一致的曲率平滑且缓慢地增长，这表明决策边界接近于大型连续子空间内的输入样本。我们还量化了对抗性训练后，数据集样本附近的边界距离和曲率减少了多少。与架构或测试集精度相比，训练方法对边界距离和曲率的影响要大得多。这些发现与之前的工作背景相结合，支持或反驳了先前提出的几种边界行为理论。我们的分析和实证支持

items.title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
items.excerpt: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.
items.authors: Donghyeok Lee, Sangwon Yu, Sangkwon Park, Hye Youn Park, Munyoung Chang, Sungroh Yoon
items.title_zh: 将人脑组织分析转移到语言模型
items.excerpt_zh: 在人类皮质发育过程中，功能系统变得越来越分化。我们询问语言模型推理的改进是否涉及类似的区域重组。应用用于表征皮质组织的扩散图嵌入来匹配来自三个家族的基础模型和推理训练模型，我们发现在连续层跨度内广泛保留了具有局部变化的梯度分布。将这些跨度的权重移植到经过指令调整的主机中，平均而言可以改善数学推理，随着区域重叠，收益会增加，同时比其他地方的移植保留更多先前解决的问题。在整个训练过程中，跨度是在早期表现上升过程中逐渐形成的，中间阶段的移植也有所帮助。移植物在一定程度上改变了大多数宿主的捐赠者的行为，有时还改善了捐赠者未能解决的问题。相同的分析发现了医学模型中的可转移跨度。总之，这些发现确定了一个与推理相关的区域，其权重可以改善推理，同时对宿主现有的数学能力干扰较小。

items.title: Equal Steps, Unequal Curvature: Where Muon's Update Goes Wrong
items.excerpt: Muon updates each hidden weight matrix along the polar factor of its momentum, the steepest-descent direction under the spectral norm. That choice fixes two allocations without consulting the loss: every singular direction of the momentum receives the same step, and in a non-square matrix each neuron's step is set by its leverage score. Whether they are good is a question about curvature, which steepest-descent arguments do not answer; we measure it. Using held-out gradients and Hessian-vector products, we decompose Muon's step by singular-value band and by neuron group and compute each group's second-order optimal multiplier. In a 124M-parameter decoder trained on FineWeb-Edu, the multipliers rise monotonically from the top singular directions to the tail: Muon over-steps the high-curvature top of its spectrum. We prove in Lean when such a diagnostic licenses an intervention at Muon's own update norm. On the measured curvature, the criterion predicts, and held-out losses confirm, that moving step length off the top helps mid-training and early in the cooldown, but not at its end. We then test interventions under per-step norm matchin
items.authors: Biswa Sengupta, Jinhua Wang, L\'eo Maxime Brunswic
items.title_zh: 等步长，不等曲率：Muon 的更新出错的地方
items.excerpt_zh: Muon 沿着其动量的极坐标因子（谱范数下的最速下降方向）更新每个隐藏权重矩阵。该选择在不考虑损失的情况下修复了两个分配：动量的每个单一方向都接收相同的步长，并且在非方阵中，每个神经元的步长由其杠杆分数设置。它们是否良好是一个关于曲率的问题，而最速下降论证并不能回答这个问题。我们测量它。使用保持梯度和 Hessian 向量积，我们通过奇异值带和神经元组分解 Muon 的步长，并计算每个组的二阶最优乘数。在 FineWeb-Edu 上训练的 124M 参数解码器中，乘数从顶部奇异方向到尾部单调上升：Muon 超越了其频谱的高曲率顶部。当这样的诊断允许对 Muon 自己的更新规范进行干预时，我们在精益中证明了这一点。根据测量的曲率，该标准预测，并且保留的损失证实，将步长移离顶部有助于训练中期和冷却早期，但在训练结束时无济于事。然后，我们在每步规范匹配下测试干预措施

items.title: How Generative Models Generate: A Concise Guide to the Generative AI Landscape
items.excerpt: The rapidly expanding generative AI landscape brings together methods that differ in architecture, learning objective, mathematical representation and sampling procedure. A concise, selectively organised technical guide can provide an accessible starting point for developing a coherent understanding of this increasingly complex landscape. This article takes a generation-centred approach, connecting how models produce new observations with the modelling and learning principles that make generation possible. We develop a two-level perspective: first, distinguishing three recurring generation routes-direct transformation or decoding, sequential conditional construction, and iterative updating or transport; and second, examining the modelling and learning principles underlying these routes. Representative approaches are introduced through their key components, learning objectives and sampling procedures. We then examine their broader connections, including how different architectures and generation mechanisms can overlap or be combined. items.title_zh: 生成模型如何生成：生成人工智能景观简明指南

items.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
items.excerpt: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. items.title: From a finite subgroup of $SO(3)$:$C_2$ leads to a Holant dichotomy
items.excerpt: Counting complexity within the Holant framework has been extensively studied through complexity dichotomy theorems. While substantial progress has been achieved for various restricted settings, the general complex-valued even-arity case without auxiliary unary signatures remains largely open. This paper studies a fundamental case in this program where the binary signatures induce a group structure satisfying \(M(B(\mathcal{F}))\cong C_2\). It is observed that projective equivalence classes of binary signature matrices naturally embed into finite subgroups of \(SO(3)\), providing an algebraic viewpoint for structural classification. This paper further identifies two fundamentally different regimes for the \(C_2\) case, namely the normal and isotropic cases, and analyzes their complexity behavior separately. items.title_zh: 从 $SO(3)$:$C_2$ 的有限子群得出 Holant 二分法
items.excerpt_zh: 通过复杂性二分定理，对 Holant 框架内的复杂性计数进行了广泛的研究。虽然各种限制设置已经取得了实质性进展，但没有辅助一元签名的一般复值偶数情况在很大程度上仍然是开放的。本文研究了该程序中的一个基本情况，其中二进制签名产生满足 \(M(B(\mathcal{F}))\cong C_2\) 的群结构。据观察，二元签名矩阵的投影等价类自然地嵌入到 \(SO(3)\) 的有限子群中，为结构分类提供了代数观点。本文进一步识别了\(C_2\)情况的两种根本不同的情况，即正常情况和各向同性情况，并分别分析了它们的复杂性行为。结合小工具构造、分解技术、插值参数和将复值设置转换为等效实数结构框架的实数化方法，本文建立了一个完整的二分定理：对于每个偶数签名集 \(\mathcal{F}\) 满足 \(M(\B(\math

items.title: Reinforcement Learning with Reference-Based Rewards for Language Model Reasoning and Alignment
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning (RL) powers two major lines of large language model (LLM) post-training: reasoning, which elicits deliberate, verifiable problem solving, and alignment, which steers models toward helpful, harmless, and honest behavior. Both hinge on reward design. Reasoning relies on rule-based verification of final answers, whose binary feedback is blind to intermediate derivations, whereas process reward models (PRMs) require step-level annotations too costly to scale. Alignment depends on reward models (RMs) trained on binary preference pairs, making both data collection and model training resource-intensive. We propose RL2R, reinforcement learning with reference-based rewards, as a unified and inexpensive alternative. Using pre-existing or distilled references, RL2R measures semantic similarity with lightweight metrics such as BERTScore between a sampled generation and a reference answer or solution. Similarity preserves ordinal quality signals that binary feedback discards: responses closer to the reference earn higher rewards, and sound derivations receive credit even when the final conclusion is wrong. items.title_zh: 使用基于参考的奖励进行语言模型推理和对齐的强化学习
items.excerpt_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 为大型语言模型 (LLM) 训练后的两条主要路线提供支持：推理，引发深思熟虑的、可验证的问题解决；对齐，引导模型走向有益、无害和诚实的行为。两者都取决于奖励设计。推理依赖于对最终答案的基于规则的验证，其二进制反馈对中间推导是盲目的，而过程奖励模型（PRM）需要步骤级注释，成本太高而无法扩展。对齐取决于在二元偏好对上训练的奖励模型 (RM)，这使得数据收集和模型训练都需要大量资源。我们提出 RL2R（基于参考奖励的强化学习）作为一种统一且廉价的替代方案。使用预先存在的或经过提炼的参考，RL2R 通过轻量级指标（例如采样生成与参考答案或解决方案之间的 BERTScore）来测量语义相似性。相似性保留了二元反馈丢弃的序数质量信号：更接近参考的响应会获得更高的奖励，即使最终结论是错误的，合理的推导也会获得信用。对于数学

items.title: MedExAgent: Training LLM Agents to Ask, Examine, and Diagnose in Noisy Clinical Environments
items.excerpt: Real-world clinical diagnosis is a complex process in which the doctor is required to obtain information from both interaction with the patient and conducting medical exams. Additionally, the doctor needs to adapt to different patient personas, as well as noisy and incomplete information that can happen at any time during the process. However, existing benchmarks for medical LLMs and methods for automatic diagnosis largely simplify this process by reducing it to single-turn question answering, noise-free conversations, or sequential exam making, etc., ignoring the interactive and uncertain nature of clinical diagnosis. In this paper, we aim to address this gap by formalizing clinical diagnosis as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) with three action types: questioning the patient, ordering medical exams as tool calls, and issuing a diagnosis. We also introduce a systematic noise model comprising seven patient noise types and three exam noise types. items.title_zh: MedExAgent：培训法学硕士代理人在嘈杂的临床环境中进行询问、检查和诊断
items.excerpt_zh: 现实世界的临床诊断是一个复杂的过程，医生需要从与患者的互动和进行医学检查中获取信息。此外，医生需要适应不同的患者角色，以及过程中随时可能发生的嘈杂和不完整的信息。然而，现有的医学法学硕士基准和自动诊断方法在很大程度上简化了这一过程，将其简化为单轮问答、无噪音对话或顺序考试等，忽略了临床诊断的交互性和不确定性。在本文中，我们的目标是通过将临床诊断形式化为部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）来解决这一差距，该决策过程具有三种操作类型：询问患者、作为工具调用命令进行医疗检查以及发布诊断。我们还引入了一个系统噪声模型，包括七种患者噪声类型和三种检查噪声类型。使用我们提出的环境，我们通过两阶段管道训练有效的诊断代理 \textbf{MedExAgent}，该管道首先对

items.title: Polar: A Benchmark for Evaluating Political Bias in LLMs
items.excerpt: Political bias in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly significant, but difficult to measure reproducibly across political and linguistic contexts. We introduce Polar, a 4,026-instance multiple-choice benchmark that measures political bias through option-level likelihoods rather than prompt-based generation. Polar covers two ideological axes and eight issue categories derived from the Manifesto Project, and evaluates models in parallel across U.S. and South Korean political contexts. Across 38 LLMs, measured bias varies systematically with political context, issue category, model group, and presentation language. All models lean left-progressive on U.S. political content, but show more centered and mixed patterns on South Korean content. Translation experiments further show that presentation language alone can shift measured bias. These findings highlight the need for multilingual and cross-contextual evaluation of political bias in LLMs. The code and dataset are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/mcrl/Polar) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/thunder-research-group/Polar).
items.authors: Sangho Kim, Heejin Kim, Hyunggeun Jeon, Yoonhee Park, Jaejin Lee
items.title_zh: Polar：评估法学硕士政治偏见的基准
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）中的政治偏见日益显着，但很难在政治和语言背景下进行可重复的衡量。我们引入了 Polar，这是一个包含 4,026 个实例的多项选择基准，它通过选项级别的可能性而不是基于提示的生成来衡量政治偏见。 Polar 涵盖源自宣言项目的两个意识形态轴心和八个问题类别，并在美国和韩国的政治背景下并行评估模型。在 38 个法学硕士中，测量到的偏差随政治背景、问题类别、模型组和演示语言的不同而系统性地变化。所有模型在美国政治内容上都倾向于左翼进步，但在韩国内容上则表现出更加集中和混合的模式。翻译实验进一步表明，仅表达语言就可以改变测量到的偏见。这些发现凸显了对法学硕士政治偏见进行多语言和跨情境评估的必要性。代码和数据集可在 GitHub (https://github.com/mcrl/Polar) 和 Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/thunder-research-group/Polar) 上公开获取。

items.title: Swiss-Knife: A Framework for Reconfigurable Externalised Multi-Objective Alignment at Decode Time
items.excerpt: Decode-time alignment methods steer a frozen language model by scoring candidate continuations with an external reward and selecting the maximiser. We argue that this shared design is a single degenerate point in a much larger space. We introduce Swiss-Knife, a framework for externalised multi-objective alignment in which the alignment specification is a first-class runtime object: hot-swappable scoring blades, a batch normaliser, a pairwise aggregation operator, and a selection rule. Six axioms characterise the admissible aggregation operators, and we prove a representation theorem: every operator satisfying them has the form $R_i = \sum_{j \neq i} g((\mu_i - \mu_j)/s(\sigma_i,\sigma_j))$, a two-parameter family containing probit and logistic comparison rules and pointwise argmax as named coordinates. Within it, pairwise aggregation is Lipschitz-stable under adversarial reward contamination while argmax is not, and Candidate-Batch Normalization (CBN) makes the weight simplex invariant to the rescalings under which reward models are only ever identified.
