items.authors: Agnibh Karmakar, Mayur Parvatikar, Shreyash Dhoot, Amit Dhanda, Aman Chadha, Kapil Wanaskar, Vinija Jain, Amitava Das
items.title_zh: Swiss-Knife：解码时可重构外部化多目标对齐的框架
items.excerpt_zh: 解码时对齐方法通过使用外部奖励对候选延续进行评分并选择最大化来引导冻结的语言模型。我们认为，这种共享设计是更大空间中的一个退化点。我们引入了 Swiss-Knife，这是一个用于外部化多目标对齐的框架，其中对齐规范是一流的运行时对象：可热插拔的刻划刀片、批量归一化器、成对聚合运算符和选择规则。六个公理描述了可接受的聚合算子，并且我们证明了一个表示定理：满足它们的每个算子都具有形式 $R_i = \sum_{j \neq i} g((\mu_i - \mu_j)/s(\sigma_i,\sigma_j))$，一个包含概率和逻辑比较规则以及作为命名坐标的逐点 argmax 的二参数族。其中，成对聚合在对抗性奖励污染下是 Lipschitz 稳定的，而 argmax 则不然，候选批量归一化 (CBN) 使权重单纯形对于重新缩放保持不变，而奖励模型只能在重新缩放时被识别。我们的参考实例将 DPO-LoRA 刀片与不确定性感知 p 配对

items.title: Distill What You Trust: Reliability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.excerpt: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation allows a student to learn from complementary specialists on its own trajectories. Domain-routed approaches, however, select one teacher per example and keep it fixed throughout the response. This design both depends on domain labels that mixed training corpora often lack and cannot adapt teacher selection when the expertise required changes within a trajectory. We observe that each specialist deviates more from a shared reference on in-domain prompts than on out-of-domain prompts, on average. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{TrustMOPD}, which replaces example-level teacher selection with label-free, token-level supervision allocation. At each student-generated prefix, TrustMOPD measures this displacement in next-token preferences, calibrates its magnitude across teachers, and uses the resulting scores as proxies for local reliability to weight teacher-specific distillation losses. Evaluated across mathematics, code, and instruction following, TrustMOPD closes 91.5\% and 98.0\% of the overall-score gap between the initial student and oracle-routed teachers when trained on \textsc{Si
items.authors: Jie Sun, Mao Zheng, Mingyang Song, Zeyuan Liu, Gengsheng Li, Houcheng Jiang, Yilin Cheng, Bichuan Feng, Yuchen Cai, Junfeng Fang, Xiang Wang
items.title_zh: 提取您信任的内容：具有可靠性意识的多教师按策略提取
items.excerpt_zh: 多位教师的政策蒸馏允许学生按照自己的轨迹向互补的专家学习。然而，域路由方法为每个示例选择一名教师，并在整个响应过程中保持固定。这种设计既取决于混合培训语料库通常缺乏的领域标签，也无法在轨迹内所需的专业知识发生变化时调整教师选择。我们观察到，平均而言，每位专家在域内提示上比在域外提示上偏离共享参考更多。基于这一观察，我们提出 \textbf{TrustMOPD}，它将示例级教师选择替换为无标签、令牌级监督分配。在每个学生生成的前缀中，TrustMOPD 都会测量下一个标记偏好中的这种位移，在教师中校准其大小，并使用所得分数作为局部可靠性的代理来衡量特定于教师的蒸馏损失。经过对数学、代码和指令遵循的评估，TrustMOPD 在接受 \textsc{Si 培训时，缩小了初始学生和 Oracle 教师之间总分差距的 91.5\% 和 98.0\%

items.title: On the $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear relations among multiple zeta values in positive characteristic
items.excerpt: This paper gives a new path to determine all $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear relations among multiple zeta values in positive characteristic, which had been done by Huang, Lai, Li and the author. The path used in this paper is based on the idea of operator generation, which originated from the work of Todd, developed by the author, and independently by Im-Kim-Ngo Dac.
items.title_zh: 关于正特征中多个zeta值之间的$\mathbb{F}_q$-线性关系
items.excerpt_zh: 本文给出了一条新的路径来确定正特征中多个 zeta 值之间的所有 $\mathbb{F}_q$-线性关系，该路径是由 Huang、Lai、Li 和作者完成的。本文使用的路径基于算子生成的思想，该思想源于Todd的工作，由作者开发，并由Im-Kim-Ngo Dac独立完成。

items.title: On counting integer symmetric matrices of fixed determinant in families of slant boxes
items.excerpt: In this article, we develop an upper bound for the number of integral symmetric matrices of fixed determinant in a slant box with coefficients bounded by some given power of the volume of the slant box. We develop a counting method that expands on Shankar-Siad-Swaminathan's work on rank-3 integer symmetric matrices of fixed determinant to higher-rank matrices using geometry-of-numbers methods and invariant theory on the splitting of quadratic forms associated with the determinant formula into corresponding linear forms. We expect this generalization will allow us to apply the counting results to arithmetic statistics frameworks. In forthcoming work, we will apply the counting results to study the distribution of 2-torsion subgroups of class groups of unit-monogenised number fields.
items.title_zh: 斜箱族中固定行列式整数对称矩阵的计数
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们为倾斜盒中固定行列式的积分对称矩阵的数量制定了上限，其系数受倾斜盒体积的某个给定幂的限制。我们开发了一种计数方法，该方法使用数几何方法和关于将与行列式公式相关的二次形式分裂为相应线性形式的不变理论，将固定行列式的三阶整数对称矩阵扩展到更高阶矩阵的工作。我们期望这种概括将使我们能够将计数结果应用到算术统计框架中。在接下来的工作中，我们将应用计数结果来研究单位单调数域的类群的2-扭转子群的分布。

items.title: Narrower arithmetic progressions in the primes
items.excerpt: For each fixed $k\geq 3$ and $\delta > 0$, we prove that every subset of the primes up to $X$ of relative density at least $\delta$ contains a non-trivial $k$-term arithmetic progression with common difference $O_{k,\delta,\varepsilon}((\log X)^{k\cdot 2^{k-3}+\varepsilon})$, for any $\varepsilon>0$. This improves the previous exponent $(k-1)2^{k-2}$. The main ingredient is a relative Szemer\'{e}di theorem for narrow progressions under weaker linear forms conditions.
items.title_zh: 素数中较窄的算术级数
items.excerpt_zh: 对于每个固定的 $k\geq 3$ 和 $\delta > 0$，我们证明相对密度至少为 $\delta$ 的素数的每个子集都包含一个非平凡的 $k$ 项算术级数，其公差为 $O_{k,\delta,\varepsilon}((\log X)^{k\cdot 2^{k-3}+\varepsilon})$，对于任何 $\varepsilon>0$。这改进了之前的指数 $(k-1)2^{k-2}$。主要成分是弱线性形式条件下窄级数的相对 Szemer'{e}di 定理。

items.title: Irreducible components of affine Deligne-Lusztig variety in the affine flag variety
items.excerpt: We establish a bijection between elements of stable Demazure crystals and labeled longest increasing paths in the double Bruhat graph. As an application, we show that the orbits of irreducible components of certain special affine Deligne-Lusztig varieties (ADLVs) in the affine flag variety of a split reductive group are counted by weight multiplicities of the associated Demazure modules for the dual group. By decomposing an arbitrary ADLV into strata that are iterated fibrations over these special ADLVs, we then obtain a formula for the number of orbits of irreducible components for ADLVs in the affine flag variety, generalizing the numerical form of the Chen-Zhu conjecture.
items.title_zh: 仿射旗变种中仿射 Deligne-Lusztig 变种的不可约成分
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在稳定 Demazure 晶体的元素之间建立了双射，并在双 Bruhat 图中标记了最长的增加路径。作为一个应用，我们证明了分裂还原群的仿射旗簇中某些特殊仿射 Deligne-Lusztig 簇 (ADLV) 的不可约成分的轨道是通过对偶群的相关 Demazure 模块的重量倍数来计算的。通过将任意 ADLV 分解为这些特殊 ADLV 上的迭代纤维的层，然后我们获得了仿射旗簇中 ADLV 不可约分量轨道数的公式，推广了 Chen-Zhu 猜想的数值形式。

items.title: Superspecial curves of genus two over prime fields: Frobenius types and rational (2,2)-kernels
items.excerpt: Superspecial curves of genus two over a prime field $\mathbb{F}_p$, and the rational $(2,2)$-isogenies between their Jacobians, are the vertices and edges of the graph on which genus-two isogeny-based cryptography is built. Let $C$ be such a curve, with Jacobian $J$ and Frobenius endomorphism $\pi$. We show that $\pi^2 = p\,\alpha_*$ for a unique automorphism $\alpha$ of $C$ over $\mathbb{F}_p$ whose action on the Weierstrass points is the square of that of Frobenius. For $p \ge 7$ this gives the list of Frobenius types of the Weierstrass points: eight types, each with its Weil polynomial, a congruence condition on $p$, and its number 15, 3, 3, 7, 1, 1, 3 or 1 of $\mathbb{F}_p$-rational $(2,2)$-kernels; when all Weierstrass points are rational, the 2-Tate pairing on $J[2]$ is determined by $p \bmod 8$. We then prove closed formulas, in terms of class numbers of imaginary quadratic orders and of $\zeta_{\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt p)}(-1)$, for the mass of the curves of each type and for the mass of the rational kernels whose quotient is a product of elliptic curves. For $\pi^2 = \pm p$ the total masses are due to Ibukiyama and to Xue and Yu; our
items.title_zh: 素数域上的属二超特殊曲线：Frobenius 类型和有理 (2,2)-核
items.excerpt_zh: 素数域$\mathbb{F}_p$上的属二超特殊曲线，以及它们的雅克比行列式之间的有理$(2,2)$同构，是建立基于属二同构密码学的图的顶点和边。设$C$是这样一条曲线，具有雅可比行列式$J$和弗罗贝尼乌斯自同态$\pi$。我们证明$\pi^2 = p\,\alpha_*$对于$C$在$\mathbb{F}_p$上的唯一自同构$\alpha$，其对Weierstrass点的作用是Frobenius作用的平方。对于 $p \ge 7$，给出了 Weierstrass 点的 Frobenius 类型列表：八种类型，每种类型都有其 Weil 多项式、$p$ 上的同余条件，以及 $\mathbb{F}_p$-有理 $(2,2)$-核的数量 15、3、3、7、1、1、3 或 1；当所有 Weierstrass 点都是有理数时，$J[2]$ 上的 2-Tate 配对由 $p \bmod 8$ 确定。然后，我们根据虚数二次阶的类数和 $\zeta_{\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt p)}(-1)$ 来证明每种类型曲线的质量以及商为椭圆曲线乘积的有理核的质量的封闭公式。对于$\pi^2 = \pm p$，总质量归因于Ibukiyama、Xue 和Yu；我们的

items.title: Optimal homological stability: bounding secondary terms of Cohen-Lenstra moments and $S_d$-fields over $\mathbb{F}_q[t]$
items.excerpt: We prove an explicit stability line for the homology $H_i(\mathrm{Hur}_n^c,\mathbb{Q})$ of any Hurwitz space associated to a finite rack $c$ depending only on its homology up to some finite $n$. Moreover, as the range of $n$ increases, the slope of the resulting stability line converges to the optimal slope. Thus, for any Hurwitz space, a finite computation will yield near-optimal bounds on secondary terms for the corresponding arithmetic statistics problem. Our theorem also applies more generally to higher order stability, Frobenius weights, and braided vector spaces. As a special case of our theorem, we can deduce stability lines depending only on when $H_0(\mathrm{Hur}^c_n,\mathbb{Q})$ stabilizes, which are sharp in some cases. We apply this to two families of Hurwitz spaces to obtain bounds on the secondary term for (1) the number of $S_d$-degree $d$ function fields with squarefree discriminant, and (2) Cohen-Lenstra moments.
items.title_zh: 最佳同调稳定性：Cohen-Lenstra 矩和 $S_d$ 场的二次项在 $\mathbb{F}_q[t]$ 上的边界
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了与有限架 $c$ 相关的任何 Hurwitz 空间的同源性 $H_i(\mathrm{Hur}_n^c,\mathbb{Q})$ 的显式稳定线，仅取决于其同源性达到某个有限 $n$。此外，随着 $n$ 范围的增加，所得稳定线的斜率收敛到最佳斜率。因此，对于任何 Hurwitz 空间，有限计算将在相应的算术统计问题的二次项上产生接近最优的界限。我们的定理也更普遍地适用于高阶稳定性、Frobenius 权重和编织向量空间。作为我们定理的一个特例，我们可以仅根据 $H_0(\mathrm{Hur}^c_n,\mathbb{Q})$ 何时稳定来推导出稳定线，在某些情况下稳定线是尖锐的。我们将其应用于两个 Hurwitz 空间族，以获得 (1) 具有无平方判别式的 $S_d$ 度 $d$ 函数域的数量和 (2) Cohen-Lenstra 矩的二次项的界限。

items.title: Bernstein-Zelevinsky duality for equivariant vector bundles on Drinfeld spaces
items.excerpt: We study duality and finiteness of locally analytic representations arising from compactly supported coherent cohomology of Drinfeld spaces. We prove that Grothendieck--Serre duality for equivariant vector bundles realizes Bernstein--Zelevinsky duality of locally analytic representations. We follow the strategy of Fargues for $\ell$-adic sheaves and obtain resolutions of locally analytic representations by compactly induced representations. The resolutions motivate us to introduce the notion of locally analytic representations of compact presentation, which generalizes the notion of finitely presented representations. These representations are related to prim objects on the classifying stack in the sense of $6$-functor formalism and their extension groups to admissible locally analytic representations are finite-dimensional. As an application, we establish Serre duality for extension groups of locally analytic representations of $\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{Q}_p)$ attached to non-trianguline de Rham Galois representations under the $p$-adic local Langlands correspondence.
items.authors: Zhenghui Li, Benchao Su, Zhixiang Wu
items.title_zh: Drinfeld 空间上等变向量丛的 Bernstein-Zelevinsky 对偶性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究由 Drinfeld 空间的紧支持相干上同调产生的局部解析表示的对偶性和有限性。我们证明等变向量束的 Grothendieck--Serre 对偶性实现了局部解析表示的 Bernstein--Zelevinsky 对偶性。我们遵循 Fargues 的 $\ell$-adic 滑轮策略，并通过紧凑归纳表示获得局部解析表示的分辨率。这些决议促使我们引入紧凑表示的局部分析表示的概念，它概括了有限表示表示的概念。这些表示与$6$函子形式主义意义上的分类堆栈上的原始对象相关，并且它们到可接受的局部分析表示的扩展群是有限维的。作为一个应用，我们为 $\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{Q}_p)$ 的局部解析表示的扩展群建立了 Serre 对偶性，该表示附加到 $p$-adic 局部 Langlands 对应下的非三角线 de Rham Galois 表示。

items.title: Zero-sum subsequences of cross number $1$ over cyclic groups
items.excerpt: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, and let $\mathsf{T}(G)$ be the smallest integer $t$ such that every sequence of length $t$ over $G$ contains a nonempty zero-sum subsequence of cross number $1$. We determine the exact value of $\mathsf{T}(C_n)$ for every positive integer $n$, showing that $\mathsf{T}(C_n)=2n-1$ when $n$ is odd and $\mathsf{T}(C_n)=3n/2-1$ when $n$ is even. In particular, $\mathsf{T}(C_n)=\mathsf{s}(C_n)$ for odd $n$.
items.title_zh: 循环群上交叉数 $1$ 的零和子序列
items.excerpt_zh: 设$G$为有限阿贝尔群，并令$\mathsf{T}(G)$为最小整数$t$，使得$G$上的每个长度为$t$的序列都包含交叉数$1$的非空零和子序列。我们确定每个正整数$n$的$\mathsf{T}(C_n)$的精确值，表明当$n$为奇数时$\mathsf{T}(C_n)=2n-1$，当$n$为偶数时$\mathsf{T}(C_n)=3n/2-1$。特别是，$\mathsf{T}(C_n)=\mathsf{s}(C_n)$ 对于奇数 $n$。

items.title: Affine extensions and central compression for product-one-free sequences
items.excerpt: Let $H_s=H_{27}\times C_3^s$, where $H_{27}$ is the nonabelian group of order $27$ and exponent three. We study the elements which can be adjoined to a product-one-free sequence $L$ of length $2s+5$. Let $Q$ be its central subsequence and let $h$ be the dimension of the subgroup generated by $Q$. If $2h-|Q|\le1$, all admissible individual extensions lie in one affine hyperplane of the full additive group coordinates, avoiding the identity. The proof combines coefficient identities with finite, explicitly verified configurations and a transfer valid in every dimension. We also prove an exact central compression theorem: a central zero-sum-free block of length $2h-1$ can be replaced by one term after quotienting by an $(h-1)$-dimensional central subgroup, with a forward implication for product-one-freeness and admissible extensions. For the extraspecial group $E_2$ of order $3^5$ and exponent three, a finite stress obstruction and central compression yield a further uniform restriction: in any product-one-free sequence of length $2r+11$ over $E_2\times C_3^r$, the central subsequence is nonempty and has length at most $2h-2$, where $h$
items.title_zh: 无乘积序列的仿射扩展和中心压缩
items.excerpt_zh: 设 $H_s=H_{27}\times C_3^s$，其中 $H_{27}$ 是阶数为 $27$、指数为 3 的非阿贝尔群。我们研究可以与长度为 $2s+5$ 的无积一序列 $L$ 相连的元素。令 $Q$ 为其中心子序列，并令 $h$ 为 $Q$ 生成的子群的维数。如果$2h-|Q|\le1$，所有允许的个体扩展都位于完整加性群坐标的一个仿射超平面中，避免了恒等式。该证明将系数恒等式与有限的、明确验证的配置以及在每个维度上有效的传递结合起来。我们还证明了一个精确的中心压缩定理：长度为 $2h-1$ 的中心零和自由块可以在由 $(h-1)$ 维中心子群引用后被一项替换，并具有积一自由性和可允许扩展的前向含义。对于阶 $3^5$ 和指数三的超特殊群 $E_2$，有限应力阻碍和中心压缩产生进一步的统一限制：在 $E_2\times C_3^r$ 上长度为 $2r+11$ 的任何无积一序列中，中心子序列是非空的并且长度至多为 $2h-2$，其中 $h$

items.title: Log-concavity for alternating Eulerian polynomials
items.excerpt: Alternating Eulerian polynomials enumerate permutations by the alternating descent statistic introduced by Chebikin. We prove that their coefficient sequences are log-concave, verifying a conjecture of Lin, Ma, Wang and Wang. Our proof combines a factorization involving reciprocal quadratic factors, estimates for ordinary Eulerian zeros, and a log-concavity criterion for products of such factors. The required finite verifications use exact integer arithmetic. As applications, we obtain log-concavity for the distribution of $3$-descents, a local limit theorem for alternating descents, and bounds for the largest coefficient. We also give a Lorentzian reformulation of the main theorem.
items.title_zh: 交替欧拉多项式的对数凹性
items.excerpt_zh: 交替欧拉多项式通过 Chebikin 引入的交替下降统计来枚举排列。我们证明了它们的系数序列是对数凹的，验证了Lin、Ma、Wang和Wang的猜想。我们的证明结合了涉及倒数二次因子的因式分解、普通欧拉零点的估计以及此类因子乘积的对数凹性准则。所需的有限验证使用精确的整数算术。作为应用，我们获得了 3$ 下降分布的对数凹性、交替下降的局部极限定理以及最大系数的界限。我们还给出了主要定理的洛伦兹重构。

items.title: Local connectivity of friends-and-strangers graphs with a star
items.excerpt: Given two finite simple graphs $X$ and $Y$ with the same number of vertices, the vertex set of the friends-and-strangers graph $\FS(X,Y)$ consists of all bijections from the vertices of $X$ to the vertices of $Y$. Two bijections are adjacent exactly when one is obtained from the other by swapping the images of two adjacent vertices of $X$, while leaving all other images unchanged, and the two swapped images are adjacent in $Y$. For $n\ge2$, let $\Star_n$ be the star on $n$ vertices. Krishnan and Li [Electron. J. Combin. 33 (2026), no. 3, Paper P3.41] conjectured that, for $n\ge3$, whenever $\FS(X,\Star_n)$ is connected, the maximum number of pairwise internally vertex-disjoint paths between any two distinct vertices is equal to the smaller of their degrees. We prove this conjecture. More precisely, if $\FS(X,\Star_n)$ is connected, then $X$ must be $2$-connected, and the conjectured equality holds for every pair of distinct vertices. We further prove the stronger result that, whenever $X$ is $2$-connected, the same equality holds in every connected component of $\FS(X,\Star_n)$.
items.title_zh: 带星号的朋友和陌生人图的本地连接
items.excerpt_zh: 给定两个具有相同顶点数的有限简单图$X$和$Y$，朋友和陌生人图$\FS(X,Y)$的顶点集由从$X$的顶点到$Y$的顶点的所有双射组成。当通过交换 $X$ 的两个相邻顶点的图像而从另一个获得一个双射时，两个双射恰好相邻，同时保持所有其他图像不变，并且两个交换的图像在 $Y$ 中相邻。对于 $n\ge2$，令 $\Star_n$ 为 $n$ 个顶点上的星形。克里希南和李 [电子。 J.康宾. 33（2026），没有。 3，论文P3.41]推测，对于$n\ge3$，每当$\FS(X,\Star_n)$连接时，任意两个不同顶点之间的成对内部顶点不相交路径的最大数量等于它们的度数中较小的一个。我们证明这个猜想。更准确地说，如果 $\FS(X,\Star_n)$ 是连通的，那么 $X$ 一定是 $2$ 连通的，并且猜想的等式对于每对不同的顶点都成立。我们进一步证明了更强的结果，只要$X$是$2$连通的，$\FS(X,\Star_n)$的每个连通分量都具有相同的等式。

items.title: Longitudinal Subdivision Invariance of Periodic Directed Strips and Its Application to Elongated Octagonal Strips
items.excerpt: We prove that longitudinal refinements of finite-width periodic directed strips preserve subdivision containment. The refinement lengths may be arbitrary positive integers, without a uniform upper bound, and no matching condition is imposed on the horizontal arcs. We construct subdivision models in both directions that preserve each designated rail as a whole. The equivalence also holds when the designated rail images are required to lie in a prescribed end. A nonperiodic example shows that reverse containment may fail without periodicity. As an application, we obtain an elongated octagonal strip $O_n$ by subdividing selected longitudinal arcs of the directed hexagonal strip $H_n$. We show that every bounded face of $O_n$ is an octagon for $n\geq 2$ and that $O_n$ and $H_n$ are subdivision-equivalent. Consequently, the known exact end in-degree thresholds and forced-width formula for $H_n$ also hold for $O_n$.
items.title_zh: 周期性定向带的纵向细分不变性及其在长八边形带中的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明有限宽度周期性定向条的​​纵向细化可以保持细分遏制。细化长度可以是任意正整数，没有统一的上限，并且对水平弧不施加匹配条件。我们在两个方向上构建细分模型，将每个指定的轨道保留为一个整体。当指定的轨道图像需要位于规定的端部时，该等价性也成立。一个非周期性的例子表明，如果没有周期性，反向遏制可能会失败。作为一个应用，我们通过细分有向六边形条$H_n$的选定纵向弧来获得细长的八边形条$O_n$。我们证明 $O_n$ 的每个有界面都是 $n\geq 2$ 的八边形，并且 $O_n$ 和 $H_n$ 是细分等效的。因此，$H_n$ 的已知精确结束度阈值和强制宽度公式也适用于 $O_n$。

items.title: Classification of Forbidden 0-1 Patterns by Their Extremal Function
items.excerpt: This paper concerns the maximum weight of $n\times n$ 0-1 matrices that avoid some pattern $P$, denoted $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)$. Furedi and Hajnal initiated a research program of classifying all patterns according to their extremal function, but to date, only the weight-4 patterns are completely understood. In this paper we make progress on several fronts of the classification problem. A pattern is light if its columns have weight 1 and linear if $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)=O(n)$. We characterize the set of weight-5 linear light patterns, and the set of weight-5 linear patterns more generally. Along the way we identify several new infinite classes of linear patterns, which support the Pettie-Tardos conjecture on characterizing all linear light patterns. It was known that there exist infinitely many minimally nonlinear patterns. We identify a specific infinite set of minimally nonlinear patterns. We also prove that there are $2^{\Omega(r)}$ weight-$r$ minimally nonlinear patterns, and that every minimally nonlinear pattern has extremal function $O(n\log n)$, with the exception of the 4-cycle. We classify many of the outstanding weight-5 p
items.title_zh: 按极值函数对禁止的 0-1 模式进行分类
items.excerpt_zh: 本文关注的是避免某些模式 $P$ 的 $n\times n$ 0-1 矩阵的最大权重，表示为 $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)$。 Furedi 和 Hajnal 发起了一项根据极值函数对所有模式进行分类的研究计划，但迄今为止，只有权重 4 的模式被完全理解。在本文中，我们在分类问题的几个方面取得了进展。如果一个模式的列权重为 1，则该模式是轻量级的；如果 $\operatorname{ex}(n,P)=O(n)$，则该模式是线性的。我们更一般地表征权重为 5 的线性光图案组以及权重为 5 的线性光图案组。在此过程中，我们确定了几种新的无限类线性图案，它们支持表征所有线性光图案的佩蒂-塔多斯猜想。众所周知，存在无限多个最小非线性模式。我们确定了一组特定的无限最小非线性模式。我们还证明存在 $2^{\Omega(r)}$ 权重-$r$ 最小非线性模式，并且每个最小非线性模式都具有极值函数 $O(n\log n)$，除了 4 周期之外。我们对许多优秀的重量-5 p进行分类

items.title: An Explicit Construction of Large Families of MSTD Sets
items.excerpt: A finite set $S\subset\mathbb Z$ is more sums than differences (MSTD) if $|S+S|>|S-S|$. Yufei Zhao's bidirectional-ballot construction gives $\Theta(2^N/N)$ MSTD subsets of $[0,N-1]$, the best previously known size bound for an explicit family, to the author's knowledge. We improve this bound: for every fixed integer $T\geq1$, we construct a family of $\Theta_T(2^N/(\log_2^{\circ T} N)^{2^T})$ MSTD subsets, where $\log_2^{\circ T}$ denotes the $T$-fold iterated logarithm. This family is asymptotically larger than Zhao's for every fixed $T\geq1$. A subfamily of the same order of magnitude can be numbered so that any chosen member can be generated deterministically in time polynomial in $N$, without listing preceding members. As a supplementary comparison, replacing the terminal ballot rule by exhaustive fringe search gives a positive-proportion family with the same polynomial-time generation property.
items.title_zh: MSTD集大族的显式构造
items.excerpt_zh: 如果 $|S+S|>|S-S|$，则有限集 $S\subset\mathbb Z$ 的和多于差 (MSTD)。 Yufei Zhao 的双向投票构造给出了 $[0,N-1]$ 的 $\Theta(2^N/N)$ MSTD 子集，据作者所知，这是先前已知的显式族的最佳大小界限。我们改进了这个界限：对于每个固定整数$T\geq1$，我们构建一系列$\Theta_T(2^N/(\log_2^{\circ T} N)^{2^T})$ MSTD子集，其中$\log_2^{\circ T}$表示$T$倍迭代对数。对于每个固定的$T\geq1$，这个族都渐近地大于赵的族。可以对相同数量级的子族进行编号，以便可以在 $N$ 中的时间多项式中确定性地生成任何选定的成员，而无需列出前面的成员。作为补充比较，用穷举边缘搜索替换最终投票规则给出了具有相同多项式时间生成属性的正比例族。

items.title: Non-principality of forbidden subposet problems
items.excerpt: We show pairs of posets such that the largest families not containing any of them is substantially smaller than the largest families avoiding only one of them.
items.title_zh: 禁止子集问题的非主性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们展示了一对偏序集，使得不包含其中任何一个的最大族比仅避免其中一个的最大族小得多。

items.title: Antidirected paths on five vertices in 5-chromatic digraphs
items.excerpt: We prove that every 5-chromatic digraph containing no copy of the regular tournament on five vertices contains both antidirected paths on five vertices. This answers a question posed by El Sahili in 2004. The proof uses an edge bound for 5-critical graphs to constrain the out-degrees in a counterexample and obtain a contradiction by constructing a proper 4-colouring.
items.title_zh: 五色有向图中五个顶点上的反向路径
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，每个 5 色有向图在五个顶点上不包含常规锦标赛的副本，并且在五个顶点上包含两条反向路径。这回答了 El Sahili 在 2004 年提出的问题。证明使用 5 临界图的边界来约束反例中的出度，并通过构造适当的 4 着色来获得矛盾。

items.title: Cohomology Rings of Fiber Products of Lefschetz Fibrations
items.excerpt: We prove a Lefschetz-type theorem for the cohomology rings of fiber products of two Lefschetz fibrations with disjoint critical loci. As an application, we compute the Hodge numbers of several examples of higher-dimensional Schoen's Calabi-Yau manifolds.
items.title_zh: Lefschetz 纤维纤维积的上同调环
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了具有不相交关键轨迹的两个 Lefschetz 纤维的纤维乘积的上同调环的 Lefschetz 型定理。作为一个应用，我们计算了几个高维 Schoen 卡拉比-丘流形示例的霍奇数。

items.title: Convergence of the big J-function of a GKM manifold
items.excerpt: The genus-$0$ equivariant Gromov--Witten (GW) invariants of a GKM manifold can be computed recursively by a recursion discovered by Brown and studied further by Coates--Corti--Iritani--Tseng. In this paper, we prove a slightly modified version of this result by realizing the J-function as a solution to a fixed-point problem. As an application, we prove that both the equivariant and the non-equivariant quantum cohomologies of a GKM manifold are convergent. We also show that the equivariant central charges have no poles in the spectral parameter, compute their monodromy and their asymptotics at $z=0$, and formulate an equivariant mirror symmetry conjecture for GKM manifolds.
items.title_zh: GKM流形大J函数的收敛性
items.excerpt_zh: GKM 流形的 genus-$0$ 等变 Gromov--Witten (GW) 不变量可以通过 Brown 发现的递归来递归计算，并由 Coates--Corti--Iritani--Tseng 进一步研究。在本文中，我们通过实现 J 函数作为定点问题的解决方案，证明了该结果的稍微修改版本。作为一个应用，我们证明了 GKM 流形的等变和非等变量子上同调都是收敛的。我们还证明等变中心电荷在谱参数中没有极点，计算它们在 $z=0$ 处的单向性和渐近性，并为 GKM 流形制定等变镜像对称猜想。

items.title: Functorial height and Orlov's rationality conjecture
items.excerpt: An exceptional collection in the derived category of a smooth projective variety may fail to generate the whole category, and this failure cannot be detected by K-theory or by Hochschild homology. Kuznetsov's height detects it through Hochschild cohomology, that is, through natural transformations from the identity functor to its shifts. We replace the identity functor by an arbitrary endofunctor $F$ and define the height of a collection with coefficient $F$. It controls, in a range of degrees, the restriction of natural transformations $\mathrm{id}\to F$ to the orthogonal complement of the collection, and it is computed from the collection by a finite complex. For collections of line bundles on surfaces whose Hom divisors have nonnegative canonical degree, the tensor product with a skyscraper sheaf has height exactly two, and the projections of skyscraper sheaves form a two-dimensional family of point-like objects in the orthogonal complement. We apply these tools to Orlov's rationality conjecture. A smooth projective complex surface is rational if its derived category has a full exceptional collection in which all members except pos
items.title_zh: 函子高度与奥尔洛夫理性猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 平滑射影簇的派生范畴中的特殊集合可能无法生成整个范畴，并且这种失败无法通过 K 理论或 Hochschild 同调来检测。库兹涅佐夫的高度通过霍赫希尔德上同调来检测它，即通过从恒等函子到其平移的自然变换。我们用任意的结束函子 $F$ 替换恒等函子，并用系数 $F$ 定义集合的高度。它在一定程度上控制自然变换 $\mathrm{id}\to F$ 对集合的正交补集的限制，并且它是通过有限复数从集合中计算出来的。对于其坎约数具有非负正则度的曲面上的线束集合，与摩天大楼束的张量积的高度恰好为二，并且摩天大楼束的投影形成正交补中的二维点状物体族。我们将这些工具应用于奥尔洛夫的理性猜想。如果一个光滑的射影复曲面有一个完整的例外集合，其中除了 pos 之外的所有成员，它的派生类别就是有理的

items.title: Gopakumar-Vafa invariants and Mordell-Weil lattices
items.excerpt: Let $X\to B$ be a Weierstrass fibration with integral fibers from a smooth Calabi--Yau threefold to a del Pezzo surface. For a smooth curve $D\subset B$ with smooth inverse image $Y$, we decompose the moduli fiber of stable sheaves with Euler characteristic one and projected cycle $D$. In fiber degree $k$, its components are indexed by all sections $C$ of $Y\to D$ with $\tfrac12\langle C,C\rangle\leq k$, where $\langle\, ,\,\rangle$ is the Mordell--Weil height pairing. For infinitesimally rigid sections we compute the GV contributions, recovering the $E_8$ theta product over a $(-1)$-curve. We formulate the corresponding conjecture for families of sections.
items.title_zh: Gopakumar-Vafa 不变量和 Mordell-Weil 格子
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $X\to B$ 为 Weierstrass 纤维，具有从光滑的 Calabi-Yau 三重表面到 del Pezzo 表面的完整纤维。对于具有平滑逆像$Y$的平滑曲线$D\子集B$，我们用欧拉特征一和投影周期$D$分解稳定滑轮的模量纤维。在纤维度 $k$ 中，其分量由 $Y\to D$ 的所有部分 $C$ 和 $\tfrac12\langle C,C\rangle\leq k$ 索引，其中 $\langle\, ,\,\rangle$ 是 Mordell--Weil 高度配对。对于无限小的刚性部分，我们计算 GV 贡献，恢复 $(-1)$ 曲线上的 $E_8$ theta 产品。我们对截面族提出了相应的猜想。

items.title: Heights and energies of polarized fibrations of varieties
items.excerpt: We study nef line bundles on polarized fibrations $(X/C,\bar{H})$, with a fixed nef metrized ample polarization satisfying $H^d=1$, where $d=\dim X$. We prove a quantitative arithmetic height inequality under relative metric positivity, allowing singular arithmetic models and relatively nef adelic bundles. The height deficit defines a local energy. For nef, relatively ample line bundles over finitely generated fields, this energy is bounded below for almost every complex or nonarchimedean local-field realization of fixed polarized global model data, outside one null set common to the entire relative metric class. The results include big non-semiample examples. For ample $L$ and smooth positively curved $\bar{H}$, the complex critical equation is the Calabi--Yau equation; at zero volume, projective bundles recover Donaldson's functional. We also study critical metrics and conjectural canonical heights defined by energy envelopes.
items.title_zh: 各种极化纤维的高度和能量
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究偏振纤维 $(X/C,\bar{H})$ 上的 nef 线束，固定的 nef 测量的充足偏振满足 $H^d=1$，其中 $d=\dim X$。我们证明了相对度量正性下的定量算术高度不等式，允许奇异算术模型和相对nef的adelic束。高度差定义了局部能量。对于 nef，有限生成场上相对充足的线束，对于固定极化全局模型数据的几乎每个复杂或非阿基米德局部场实现，该能量都被限制在下面，在整个相对度量类共有的一个空集之外。结果包括大型非半示例。对于充足的$L$和光滑的正曲线$\bar{H}$，复杂的临界方程是Calabi--Yau方程；在零体积时，投影束恢复唐纳森的功能。我们还研究由能量包络线定义的关键指标和推测的规范高度。

items.title: Defining equations for two-block shallow ReLU pattern varieties
items.excerpt: We give a complete algebraic characterization of two-block shallow ReLU pattern varieties. We show that the determinantal equations arising from rank constraints imposed by the activation patterns generate the defining ideals, thereby proving a conjecture of Alexandr-Mont\'ufar. The set-theoretic proof uses a characterization of orbit closures of matrix pencils in terms of the Kronecker canonical form.
items.authors: Yulia Alexandr, Moritz Grillo, Thiago Holleben, Guido Mont\'ufar, Teresa Yu
items.title_zh: 定义两块浅 ReLU 模式变体的方程
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了两块浅 ReLU 模式变种的完整代数表征。我们证明了由激活模式施加的等级约束产生的行列式方程产生了定义的理想，从而证明了 Alexandr-Mont'ufar 的猜想。集合论证明使用克罗内克规范形式来描述矩阵铅笔的轨道闭包。

items.title: Categorified Koszul duality and deformation theory of higher categories
items.excerpt: This paper develops a deformation theory for stable $(\infty,n)$-categories for $n > 1$. We introduce the framework of complete $t$-structured stable presentable $(\infty,n)$-categories. Within this setting, we establish a higher categorified Koszul duality among complete $t$-structured presentable $(\infty,n)$-categories. Using this duality, we develop the deformation theory. We prove that the deformation problem for such categories is a well-behaved formal moduli problem determined by Hochschild cohomology, and we deduce the corresponding obstruction theory. Finally, we apply our results to sheaves of categories on perfect stacks.
items.title_zh: 科祖尔分类对偶性和高范畴变形理论
items.excerpt_zh: 本文提出了稳定 $(\infty,n)$ 类别（$n > 1$）的变形理论。我们引入了完整的$t$结构的稳定的可呈现$(\infty,n)$类别的框架。在此设置中，我们在完整的 $t$ 结构的可呈现 $(\infty,n)$ 类别中建立了更高分类的 Koszul 对偶性。利用这种对偶性，我们发展了变形理论。我们证明了此类类别的变形问题是一个由 Hochschild 上同调确定的良好的形式模问题，并推导了相应的阻碍理论。最后，我们将结果应用于完美堆栈上的成捆类别。

items.title: Unboundedness of regular del Pezzo surfaces over imperfect fields
items.excerpt: Over an F-finite field, regular del Pezzo surfaces are bounded. Over a non-F-finite field of characteristic two or three, regular del Pezzo surfaces are unbounded.
items.title_zh: 不完美域上规则 del Pezzo 曲面的无界性
items.excerpt_zh: 在 F 有限域上，规则的 del Pezzo 曲面是有界的。在具有两个或三个特征的非 F 有限域上，规则的 del Pezzo 曲面是无界的。

items.title: Joint extreme-value asymptotics for the radius and centre of smallest enclosing balls
items.excerpt: We study the joint extreme-value behaviour of the radius and centre of the smallest ball containing an i.i.d.\ spherically symmetric sample. In the Gumbel and Weibull regimes, we obtain joint limit theorems and show that the enclosing ball is asymptotically supported by exactly $d+1$ sample points, thereby resolving an open support problem in the Gumbel case. In the Fr\'echet regime, the limit is given by the smallest enclosing ball of an extremal Poisson cloud. For planar Gaussian samples, we derive an explicit joint limit law from Daniels' finite-sample formula and show that this law is universal throughout the planar Gumbel domain. In the bounded-support Weibull regime, we additionally obtain uniform tail bounds, moment convergence and an explicit limiting density, while the uniform-ball case admits an interpretation in terms of a Poisson zero cell.
items.title_zh: 最小包围球半径和中心的联合极值渐近
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究包含独立同分布球对称样本的最小球的半径和中心的联合极值行为。在 Gumbel 和 Weibull 体系中，我们获得了联合极限定理，并表明封闭球由 $d+1$ 个样本点渐近支撑，从而解决了 Gumbel 情况下的开支撑问题。在 Fr\'echet 体系中，极限由极值泊松云的最小包围球给出。对于平面高斯样本，我们从 Daniels 有限样本公式推导出一个明确的联合极限定律，并表明该定律在整个平面 Gumbel 域中是通用的。在有界支持威布尔体系中，我们还获得了均匀尾界、矩收敛和显式极限密度，而均匀球情况则允许根据泊松零单元进行解释。

items.title: Evergreen leaves and universal lifetime laws in preferential-attachment trees
items.excerpt: We study leaf lifetimes in general preferential-attachment trees. First we characterize the existence of evergreen leaves, that is, vertices that remain leaves forever. When no evergreen leaves exist, we establish, for a broad class of attachment functions, a remarkable one-parameter universality: the normalizations and limiting laws for various characteristics of leaf lifetimes depend on the attachment function only through a single numerical parameter. In particular, we obtain a shifted Pareto limit law for individual lifetimes and a joint functional limit theorem for the lifetime and label of the longest-lasting leaf. The limiting two-dimensional process, which we call the beta-decorated Fr\'echet extremal process, admits an elegant representation in terms of the Stoev--Taqqu extremal integral and the sets of optimal choices considered by Molchanov and Strokorb. We also establish a Poisson point-process limit for rescaled leaf lifetimes and corresponding labels, a finiteness criterion for long-lasting leaves, and a functional central limit theorem for their number at the critical threshold.
items.title_zh: 优先附着树中的常绿叶子和普遍寿命定律
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究一般优先附着树的叶子寿命。首先，我们描述常绿叶子的存在，即永远保持叶子的顶点。当不存在常绿叶子时，我们为一大类附着函数建立了显着的单参数普适性：叶子寿命的各种特征的归一化和限制定律仅通过单个数值参数依赖于附着函数。特别是，我们获得了个体寿命的转移帕累托极限定律以及最长叶子的寿命和标签的联合功能极限定理。极限二维过程，我们称之为 beta 修饰的 Fr'echet 极值过程，允许用 Stoev--Taqqu 极值积分以及 Molchanov 和 Strokob 考虑的最优选择集进行优雅的表示。我们还建立了重新调整的叶子寿命和相应标签的泊松点过程极限、持久叶子的有限性标准以及临界阈值下叶子数量的功能中心极限定理。

items.title: The Spectral Distribution of Matrix Least Squares Solutions, and the Ellipsoid Fitting Problem
items.excerpt: We study the spectral distribution of the least squares solution to a random linear system whose unknown is a symmetric matrix. In the normalized and isotropic setting, we derive a closed-form description of the support of the spectral distribution. As an application, we consider the ellipsoid fitting problem: given $n$ standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb{R}^d$, does there exist a centered ellipsoid passing through all of them? It was recently shown that this problem has a sharp phase transition at $n \approx d^2/4$. On the satisfiability side, unlike earlier results, these sharp results do not rely on least squares candidates. We show that the least squares candidates considered in earlier works have a threshold of positive semi-definiteness at $n \approx d^2/10$, which was previously observed numerically and predicted non-rigorously using statistical physics methods. Moreover, we show that the corresponding least squares dual certificates have a threshold of positive definiteness at $n \approx 2d^2/5$. Our approach combines several matrix concentration tools. A key technical ingredient, which may be of independent interest, is sho
items.authors: Afonso S. Bandeira, Yue M. Lu, Petar Nizi\'{c}-Nikolac
items.title_zh: 矩阵最小二乘解的谱分布和椭球拟合问题
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究未知数为对称矩阵的随机线性系统的最小二乘解的谱分布。在归一化和各向同性设置中，我们得出了光谱分布支持的封闭形式描述。作为一个应用，我们考虑椭球拟合问题：给定 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中的 $n$ 个标准高斯向量，是否存在一个穿过所有这些向量的中心椭球？最近表明，这个问题在 $n \approx d^2/4$ 处有一个急剧的相变。在可满足性方面，与之前的结果不同，这些尖锐的结果不依赖于最小二乘候选。我们表明，早期作品中考虑的最小二乘候选具有 $n \approx d^2/10$ 的正半正定阈值，这是之前使用统计物理方法进行数值观察和非严格预测的。此外，我们表明相应的最小二乘对偶证书的正定性阈值为 $n \approx 2d^2/5$。我们的方法结合了几种基质浓缩工具。一个可能具有独立利益的关键技术成分是

items.title: Multiple transition points for an epidemic model
items.excerpt: This paper is concerned with a spatial epidemic model on the $d$-dimensional square lattice that extends the contact process in two ways by assuming that each site is occupied by a social cluster of $N$ individuals rather than a single individual, and that infected individuals can be either asymptomatic or symptomatic. Newly infected individuals begin as asymptomatic and develop the symptoms at a spontaneous mutation rate $\gamma$, and all infected individuals recover at rate one. The model also distinguishes between external (between adjacent clusters) and internal (within clusters) infection rates for each state. Our analysis shows that, when either asymptomatic or symptomatic individuals only spread the disease externally and at a subcritical rate, while the other class only transmits the disease internally and at a large rate, the system exhibits at least two phase transitions with respect to the mutation rate $\gamma$ when social clusters are large. Specifically, the epidemic dies out for extreme values but survives for intermediate values of the mutation rate.
items.title_zh: 流行病模型的多个转变点
items.excerpt_zh: 本文涉及 $d$ 维方格上的空间流行病模型，该模型通过假设每个站点由 $N$ 个个体的社会集群而不是单个个体占据，以两种方式扩展接触过程，并且受感染的个体可以是无症状的或有症状的。新感染的个体一开始是无症状的，并以自发突变率 $\gamma$ 出现症状，所有感染者以 1 的速率恢复。该模型还区分每个州的外部（相邻集群之间）和内部（集群内）感染率。我们的分析表明，当无症状或有症状的个体仅以亚临界速率向外传播疾病，而另一类仅以较高的速率在内部传播疾病时，当社会集群较大时，系统相对于突变率 $\gamma$ 表现出至少两个相变。具体来说，流行病在突变率的极端值处消失，但在突变率的中间值处存活。

items.title: Extreme value statistics for majorisation partial orders
items.excerpt: We study extreme-value phenomena for random samples in partially ordered sets through their meets and joins, the order-theoretic analogues of minima and maxima. In this paper we consider the probability simplex equipped with either UT-majorisation or majorisation, with samples drawn uniformly from the corresponding simplex. We analyse these extrema both at fixed dimension and as the dimension grows, identifying almost-sure collapse to the bottom or top elements and critical scalings with nondegenerate limiting laws.
items.authors: Elia Bisi, Fabio Deelan Cunden, Giovanni Gramegna, Marilena Ligab\`o
items.title_zh: 多数化偏序的极值统计
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过它们的相遇和连接（最小值和最大值的顺序理论类似物）来研究部分有序集合中随机样本的极值现象。在本文中，我们考虑配备 UT 多数化或主要化的概率单纯形，并从相应的单纯形中均匀抽取样本。我们在固定维度和维度增长时分析这些极值，识别几乎肯定崩溃到底部或顶部元素以及具有非简并限制定律的临界缩放。

items.title: Gumbel Fluctuations of the Maximum of the Airy$_1$ Process
items.excerpt: We establish the Gumbel limit for the maximum of the Airy$_1$ process over $[0,N]$ as $N\to\infty$, with explicit centering of order $(\log N)^{2/3}$ and scale $(\log N)^{-1/3}$. The proof starts with a two-term expansion for the tail of the maximum over a fixed interval. Its leading term determines the centering, while the second term gives the joint-exceedance asymptotic for touching intervals. We then bound joint exceedances in separated unit intervals, uniformly over gaps up to a fixed multiple of the square root of the threshold. Covariance and mixing estimates control the larger gaps and complete the blocking argument.
items.title_zh: Airy$_1$ 过程最大值的 Gumbel 波动
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将 $[0,N]$ 上的 Airy$_1$ 过程的最大值建立为 $N\to\infty$ 的甘贝尔极限，其中阶数 $(\log N)^{2/3}$ 和尺度 $(\log N)^{-1/3}$ 显式居中。证明从固定间隔内最大值尾部的两项展开开始。它的首项确定中心，而第二项给出接触间隔的渐近联合超越。然后，我们将联合超出限制在单独的单位间隔内，均匀地超过阈值平方根的固定倍数。协方差和混合估计控制较大的间隙并完成阻塞论证。

items.title: Geiss-Besov Regularity of Exit Times of Diffusion Processes
items.excerpt: We prove that the truncated exit times of possibly degenerate diffusion processes from open domains satisfying the exterior sphere condition belong to the Geiss-Besov space $\mathbb{B}_p^{\frac{1}{2p}}$. In the one-dimensional case, the same result is proven using Zvonkin transformation for untruncated exit times if the diffusion is uniformly elliptic.
items.authors: Yao Chen, Jiagang Ren, Hua Zhang
items.title_zh: 扩散过程退出时间的盖斯-贝索夫规律
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明满足外球条件的开放域中可能简并扩散过程的截断退出时间属于 Geiss-Besov 空间 $\mathbb{B}_p^{\frac{1}{2p}}$。在一维情况下，如果扩散是均匀椭圆形，则使用 Zvonkin 变换对于未截断的退出时间证明了相同的结果。

items.title: Cumulant Generating Function of the Hill-Lane-Sudderth urn model
items.excerpt: We consider the Hill, Lane and Sudderth urn, in which a black or white ball is added at each step with probabilities depending on the current proportion of black balls. We solve the equation for the limiting normalized cumulant generating function when the urn function is invertible on the outer branches beyond the fixed points and the corresponding inverses are Lipschitz. The solution has a parametric representation through three quadratures of the urn function and a limit of compositions of radicals, with no derivatives or inverses of the urn function in the final formula. We prove an error bound that does not accumulate along the partition and remains valid when starting from the initial singularity. Four examples with exact solutions illustrate the two orientations of the construction, the non-affine case and the presence of zeros.
items.title_zh: Hill-Lane-Sudderth 瓮模型的累积生成函数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑 Hill、Lane 和 Sudderth 瓮，其中每一步都会添加一个黑球或白球，其概率取决于当前黑球的比例。当 urn 函数在不动点之外的外分支上可逆且相应的逆为 Lipschitz 时，我们求解极限归一化累积量生成函数的方程。该解通过 urn 函数的三个求积和自由基组成的限制进行参数表示，最终公式中没有 urn 函数的导数或逆函数。我们证明了一个误差界限，该误差界限不会沿着分区累积，并且从初始奇点开始时仍然有效。具有精确解的四个示例说明了构造的两个方向：非仿射情况和零的存在。

items.title: Error Analysis of Deep Learning
items.excerpt: This review examines deep learning theory through the lens of error decomposition, systematically addressing approximation, statistical, and optimization errors. We trace the development of error analyses from bounds on individual error components to frameworks that account for all three. Using nonparametric regression and the Deep Ritz Method as dual running examples, we demonstrate how these analyses apply across fundamentally different loss structures. We then review representative analyses in scientific machine learning, generative learning, reinforcement learning, representation learning, and large language models, showing how learning errors affect solutions, distributions, and predictions through problem-specific arguments. Throughout, we clarify which error components are controlled, how they are combined, and what assumptions are needed to obtain guarantees for trained networks.
items.authors: Yuling Jiao, Peiying Wu, Jerry Zhijian Yang, Pingwen Zhang
items.title_zh: 深度学习的误差分析
items.excerpt_zh: 这篇综述通过误差分解的视角审视了深度学习理论，系统地解决了近似误差、统计误差和优化误差。我们追踪错误分析的发展，从单个错误成分的界限到解释所有三个错误的框架。使用非参数回归和 Deep Ritz 方法作为双运行示例，我们演示了这些分析如何应用于根本不同的损失结构。然后，我们回顾了科学机器学习、生成学习、强化学习、表示学习和大型语言模型中的代表性分析，通过针对特定问题的论证展示学习错误如何影响解决方案、分布和预测。在整个过程中，我们阐明了哪些误差分量是受控制的，它们是如何组合的，以及需要哪些假设才能获得经过训练的网络的保证。

items.title: Sharp error estimates for Lagrange interpolation and Kantorovich-type operators in weighted $L_p$-spaces
items.excerpt: In this paper, we establish sharp direct and inverse approximation estimates for algebraic Lagrange interpolation polynomials and Kantorovich-type operators in weighted $L_p$ spaces on $[-1,1]$. A well-known limitation in the theory of approximation by interpolation polynomials states that for small rates of convergence $\alpha \le 1/p$, classical moduli of smoothness fail to provide matching direct and inverse estimates due to the insufficiency of integral metrics to determine pointwise values at the interpolation nodes. To overcome this difficulty, we introduce new special semi-discrete measures of smoothness based on Steklov averaging operators, which combine global $L_p$-smoothness with discrete deviations from Steklov averages at the interpolation nodes. By using these measures, we establish fully matching direct and inverse approximation theorems for Lagrange interpolation polynomials, thereby providing complete two-sided characterizations of the rate of convergence for an arbitrary rate $\alpha > 0$. As a natural application of the developed approach, we also obtain corresponding direct and inverse estimates, as well as strong
items.authors: L. Angeloni, D. Costarelli, Yu. Kolomoitsev
items.title_zh: 加权 $L_p$ 空间中拉格朗日插值和 Kantorovich 型算子的急剧误差估计
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们在 $[-1,1]$ 上的加权 $L_p$ 空间中为代数拉格朗日插值多项式和 Kantorovich 型算子建立了尖锐的直接和逆近似估计。插值多项式逼近理论中的一个众所周知的局限性表明，对于较小的收敛速度 $\alpha \le 1/p$，由于积分度量不足以确定插值节点处的逐点值，经典平滑模无法提供匹配的直接和逆估计。为了克服这个困难，我们引入了基于 Steklov 平均算子的新的特殊半离散平滑度度量，它将全局 $L_p$ 平滑度与插值节点处 Steklov 平均值的离散偏差结合起来。通过使用这些措施，我们为拉格朗日插值多项式建立了完全匹配的直接和逆近似定理，从而提供了任意速率 $\alpha > 0$ 的收敛速率的完整两侧表征。作为所开发方法的自然应用，我们还获得了相应的直接和逆估计，以及强大的

items.title: Numerical approximation of Benjamin-Ono type models for two-dimensional internal waves
items.excerpt: In this paper we analyze the numerical approximation with spectral methods of two asymptotic models for the two-dimensional propagation of internal waves in a two-layer system of fluids with rigid-lid condition. The semidiscretization in space of the periodic initial-value problem with the spectral Fourier-Galerkin method is introduced and some error estimates are derived. Then the semidiscrete system is integrated in time with the Implicit Midpoint Rule and several numerical experiments illustrate the performance of the corresponding full discretization.
items.title_zh: 二维内波Benjamin-Ono型模型的数值逼近
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们使用谱方法分析了两层刚盖流体系统中内波二维传播的渐近模型的数值近似。介绍了谱傅里叶-伽辽金方法对周期性初值问题的空间半离散化，并推导了一些误差估计。然后将半离散系统与隐式中点规则进行时间积分，并通过几个数值实验说明了相应的全离散化的性能。

items.title: Computing with Orientation-Dependent Vector Fields in Crystallographic Texture Analysis
items.excerpt: We present a computational framework for representing orientation-dependent vector fields. Building on (arXiv:2608.21235), we translate the differential-geometric formulation into crystallographic notation and focus on its computational use in crystallographic texture analysis. In crystallographic applications, small orientation changes are commonly described by rotation vectors, spin tensors, or infinitesimal misorientations. By contrast, vector fields in harmonic computations are usually represented by components with respect to Euler-angle derivatives, following the classical formulation of generalized spherical harmonics. This representation is convenient but numerically unfavorable. We instead use rotation-vector components, extending a familiar description of individual orientation changes to orientation-dependent vector fields. In this representation, vector fields are described by three scalar component functions, which can be expanded into generalized spherical harmonics. We derive frequency-domain formulas for gradient, divergence, and curl, enabling their evaluation directly on harmonic coefficients. In particular, the grad
items.title_zh: 晶体结构分析中与方向相关的矢量场的计算
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个用于表示方向相关矢量场的计算框架。在（arXiv：2608.21235）的基础上，我们将微分几何公式转化为晶体学符号，并重点关注其在晶体织构分析中的计算应用。在晶体学应用中，小的取向变化通常用旋转矢量、自旋张量或无穷小的取向误差来描述。相比之下，调和计算中的矢量场通常由欧拉角导数的分量表示，遵循广义球调和的经典公式。这种表示很方便，但在数值上不利。相反，我们使用旋转矢量分量，将单个方向变化的熟悉描述扩展到与方向相关的矢量场。在这种表示中，矢量场由三个标量分量函数描述，可以扩展到广义球谐函数。我们推导了梯度、散度和旋度的频域公式，从而可以直接根据谐波系数进行评估。特别是，毕业生

items.title: A Study of Fixed versus Adaptive Step Sizes for Phasor Dynamics Simulations
items.excerpt: Transient phasor dynamics simulations model the response of power systems to disturbances using differential-algebraic equations (DAEs). Fixed-step integration is widely used to solve these DAEs numerically, but a step size suitable for resolving a fault transient may be unnecessarily small during the rest of a simulation. In this work, we provide a quantitative comparison of fixed and adaptive backward differentiation formulas on a suite of seven grid test cases ranging from 200 to 70,000 buses. Adaptive step sizes automatically shrink near faults, perturbations, and controller limits, and grow during less active portions of the simulation. At the global error achieved by a fixed quarter-cycle step size, adaptive results give 1.8 to 2.6 times speedups. Local error distributions, step size profiles, and work-precision plots show how accuracy, nonlinear solver, and step selection contribute to these differences. The results establish adaptive integration as the preferred approach for these simulations.
items.authors: Steven B. Roberts, Luke Lowery, Slaven Peles, Adam Birchfield, Carol S. Woodward
items.title_zh: 相量动力学仿真的固定步长与自适应步长的研究
items.excerpt_zh: 瞬态相量动力学仿真使用微分代数方程 (DAE) 模拟电力系统对扰动的响应。固定步长积分广泛用于数值求解这些 DAE，但在仿真的其余部分中，适合解决瞬态故障的步长可能会过小。在这项工作中，我们在 200 到 70,000 辆公交车的七个网格测试用例上提供了固定和自适应后向微分公式的定量比较。自适应步长会在故障、扰动和控制器限制附近自动缩小，并在仿真的不活跃部分期间增大。在通过固定四分之一周期步长实现的全局误差下，自适应结果可提供 1.8 至 2.6 倍的加速。局部误差分布、步长曲线和工作精度图显示了精度、非线性求解器和步长选择如何影响这些差异。结果表明自适应集成是这些模拟的首选方法。

items.title: Optimal Control of RKHS Diffeomorphic Flows for Classification and Generative Modeling
items.excerpt: We develop a unified optimal-control framework that solves supervised classification and likelihood-based density estimation with a single diffeomorphic flow whose velocity lives in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS); the two tasks share all structure except the objective. Variable projection eliminates the terminal model (a classifier, or a Gaussian-mixture (GMM) reference), leaving a reduced control problem whose gradient comes from an analytic discrete adjoint. The RKHS parameterization makes the flow's divergence exact and deterministic at the cost of one kernel matrix-vector product, avoiding the stochastic trace estimators and potential-flow restrictions of existing continuous normalizing flows. Because the objective and gradient are deterministic, matrix-free reduced Gauss-Newton (GN) and related second-order solvers are practical for both tasks, which we benchmark against a range of first- and second-order optimizers; the learned map is a diffeomorphism with explicitly controlled regularity. In experiments from dimension 2 to 256, the reduced GN solvers use the fewest iterations of any optimizer tested and, together wit
items.title_zh: 用于分类和生成建模的 RKHS 微分同胚流的优化控制
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了一个统一的最优控制框架，该框架使用单个微分同胚流来解决监督分类和基于似然性的密度估计，该微分同胚流的速度位于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中；除了目标之外，这两个任务共享所有结构。变量投影消除了终端模型（分类器或高斯混合 (GMM) 参考），留下了梯度来自解析离散伴随的简化控制问题。 RKHS 参数化以一个核矩阵向量乘积为代价，使流的散度变得精确且确定，从而避免了现有连续归一化流的随机迹估计器和势流限制。由于目标和梯度是确定性的，无矩阵简化高斯牛顿 (GN) 和相关二阶求解器对于这两项任务都是实用的，我们针对一系列一阶和二阶优化器进行了基准测试；学习到的映射是具有明确控制规律的微分同胚。在维度 2 到 256 的实验中，简化的 GN 求解器使用所有测试的优化器中最少的迭代次数，并且与

items.title: An explicit domain-preserving projection scheme for scalar stochastic differential equations
items.excerpt: We develop an explicit domain-preserving projection scheme for scalar stochastic differential equations whose solutions evolve in a prescribed interval. A Lamperti-type transformation converts the original equation into one with additive noise, whose drift may be singular near finite boundaries or grow polynomially at infinity. The proposed domain-preserving projected Euler-Maruyama (DPPEM) scheme combines an explicit Euler-Maruyama step with projection onto a step-size-dependent interior interval. Under one-sided Lipschitz, boundary, and weighted growth assumptions, with projection parameters chosen according to the coefficient growth and available moment orders, we establish strong order one convergence for admissible moment orders. The analysis combines local consistency and stability estimates with moment and boundary negative moment bounds for the exact solution. Numerical moment bounds follow from the convergence estimate, while numerical negative moment bounds are obtained under additional conditions. Estimates for the inverse Lamperti map yield strong order one convergence for the original equations in the CIR, Heston 3/2, CEV
items.authors: Xingwei Hu, Yaozhong Hu, Aiguo Xiao
items.title_zh: 标量随机微分方程的显式保域投影方案
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为标量随机微分方程开发了一种显式保域投影方案，其解在规定的区间内演化。 Lamperti 型变换将原始方程转换为带有加性噪声的方程，其漂移在有限边界附近可能是奇异的，也可能在无穷大处呈多项式增长。所提出的域保留投影 Euler-Maruyama (DPPEM) 方案将显式 Euler-Maruyama 步骤与投影到步长相关的内部区间相结合。在单侧 Lipschitz、边界和加权增长假设下，根据系数增长和可用矩阶选择投影参数，我们为可接受的矩阶建立了强一阶收敛。该分析将局部一致性和稳定性估计与精确解的力矩和边界负力矩边界相结合。数值矩界限来自收敛估计，而数值负矩界限是在附加条件下获得的。逆 Lamperti 图的估计对 CIR、Heston 3/2、CEV 中的原始方程产生强一阶收敛

items.title: Modeling fluid--solid interaction in three-dimensional granular systems: Two-way coupling of SPH and LS-DEM
items.excerpt: This paper presents a two-way coupled fluid--solid interaction framework for granular systems based on the level-set discrete element method (LS-DEM) and smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH). The proposed method is mesh-free, fully Lagrangian, and equipped with a seamless description of arbitrary solid shapes. In particular, a level-set representation of grain geometry is used for both contact detection and fluid--solid coupling, allowing for realistic, highly irregular grains to be handled within a unified computational framework. Moreover, the method incorporates a convenient treatment of moving boundaries and admits a simple computational implementation. The capabilities of the proposed SPH--LS-DEM framework are demonstrated through several numerical benchmarks involving dam-break flow, flow through porous media, granular collapse, and cyclic loading of a saturated granular specimen. The study sets the stage for several extensions to multiphysics problems across disciplines.
items.authors: Sebasti\'an Pazmi\~no, Nitin P. Daphalapurkar, Jacinto Ulloa
items.title_zh: 三维颗粒系统中的流固相互作用建模：SPH 和 LS-DEM 的双向耦合
items.excerpt_zh: 本文提出了一种基于水平集离散元法（LS-DEM）和平滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）的颗粒系统双向耦合流固相互作用框架。所提出的方法是无网格的、完全拉格朗日的，并且配备了任意实体形状的无缝描述。特别是，颗粒几何形状的水平集表示用于接触检测和流固耦合，允许在统一的计算框架内处理真实的、高度不规则的颗粒。此外，该方法结合了对移动边界的方便处理并允许简单的计算实现。所提出的 SPH--LS-DEM 框架的功能通过几个数值基准得到了证明，包括溃坝流、多孔介质流、颗粒塌陷和饱和颗粒样本的循环加载。该研究为跨学科的多物理问题的多次扩展奠定了基础。

items.title: Preserving Ramsey ultrafilters with tree forcings
items.excerpt: We define a wide class of tree forcings that we call $\textit{normed-tree forcings}$ and prove that they can preserve Ramsey ultrafilters. These include $\textit{fat-tree forcings}$ as particular cases. As an application, we prove the consistency with $\mathsf{ZFC}$ of $\mathfrak{d}=\mathfrak{u}=\aleph_1 < \mathsf{minLc}=\mathfrak{c}=\aleph_2$, where $\mathfrak{d}$ denotes the dominating number, $\mathfrak{u}$ the ultrafilter number, and $\mathsf{minLc}$ the minimum localization cardinal. This solves some open questions about pairs of classical cardinal characteristics, such as the consistency of both $\mathfrak{e}_{\mathsf{ubd}}$ and its dual strictly larger than $\mathfrak{u}$.
items.authors: Diego A. Mej\'ia, Ulises Ariet Ramos-Garc\'ia
items.title_zh: 通过树木强制保护拉姆齐超滤器
items.excerpt_zh: 我们定义了一类广泛的树力，称为 $\textit{normed-tree forcings}$ 并证明它们可以保留 Ramsey 超滤器。其中包括 $\textit{fat-tree forcings}$ 作为特殊情况。作为一个应用，我们证明了$\mathfrak{d}=\mathfrak{u}=\aleph_1 < \mathsf{minLc}=\mathfrak{c}=\aleph_2$与$\mathsf{ZFC}$的一致性，其中$\mathfrak{d}$表示主导数，$\mathfrak{u}$表示超滤数， $\mathsf{minLc}$ 最小本地化基数。这解决了一些关于经典基本特征对的开放性问题，例如 $\mathfrak{e}_{\mathsf{ubd}}$ 及其对偶严格大于 $\mathfrak{u}$ 的一致性。

items.title: Pseudocompact MAD families under $\mathfrak b=\mathfrak c$
items.excerpt: We prove that if the bounding number $\mathfrak b$ equals the cardinality of the continuum $\mathfrak c$, then every infinite almost disjoint family of size less than $\mathfrak c$ can be extended to a maximal almost disjoint family whose Isbell--Mr\'owka space has a pseudocompact Vietoris hyperspace.
items.authors: Vinicius de Oliveira Rodrigues, Fabr\'icio Yohei Ynone
items.title_zh: $\mathfrak b=\mathfrak c$ 下的伪紧 MAD 系列
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，如果边界数 $\mathfrak b$ 等于连续统 $\mathfrak c$ 的基数，则每个小于 $\mathfrak c$ 的无限几乎不相交族都可以扩展到一个最大几乎不相交族，其 Isbell--Mr\'owka 空间具有伪紧 Vietoris 超空间。

items.title: The Borel Ruziewicz problem
items.excerpt: We prove that for $n\ge2$ the normalized surface measure is the only rotation-invariant finitely additive probability measure on the Borel subsets of $\mathbb S^n$, and that for $d\ge3$ Lebesgue measure is the only finitely additive measure on the bounded Borel subsets of $\mathbb{R}^d$ which is invariant under orientation-preserving isometries and normalized on the unit cube. This answers the Borel version of the Ruziewicz problem. On $\mathbb S^n$ it suffices to assume invariance under a finite set of rotations with a spectral gap, and on $\mathbb{R}^d$ under two such sets of rotations about two distinct centres. The main step is a criterion for invariant finitely additive probability measures to vanish on null sets. items.title_zh: Borel Ruziewicz 问题
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，对于 $n\ge2$，归一化表面测度是 $\mathbb S^n$ 的 Borel 子集上唯一的旋转不变的有限加性概率测度，而对于 $d\ge3$ 来说，Lebesgue 测度是 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 的有界 Borel 子集上唯一的有限加性测度，它在保持方向的等距下不变，并在单位立方体上归一化。这回答了 Ruziewicz 问题的 Borel 版本。在 $\mathbb S^n$ 上，足以假设具有谱间隙的有限旋转集下的不变性，并且在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上，在围绕两个不同中心的两组这样的旋转下假设不变性。主要步骤是不变有限加性概率测量在零集上消失的标准。对于 $\sigma$-紧可度量空间的有限非空对称同胚集，其拟不变 Borel 测度 $m$ 在紧集上是有限的，例如 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上的勒贝格测度，Borel 集上的每个不变有限加性概率测度在 $m$-null 集上消失当且仅当 $\delta>0$ 使得每个可数加性 Borel 概率测度都受支持在 $m$-

items.title: On Hilbert's tenth problem for number fields
items.excerpt: Given a quadratic number field $K$ we show that the $abc$ conjecture over $K$ implies that $\mathbb{Z}$ is Diophantine in $K$ and, hence, a negative answer to Hilbert's tenth problem over $K$. More generally, the same conclusions hold for an arbitrary number field $K$ provided that the $abc$ conjecture holds over $K$ and that there is an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$ whose rank is positive and does not increase over $K$.
items.title_zh: 关于希尔伯特数域第十问题
items.excerpt_zh: 给定一个二次数域 $K$，我们证明 $K$ 上的 $abc$ 猜想意味着 $\mathbb{Z}$ 是 $K$ 中的丢番图，因此，对于 $K$ 上的希尔伯特第十个问题的否定答案。更一般地，相同的结论适用于任意数域 $K$，只要 $abc$ 猜想在 $K$ 上成立，并且 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上存在一条椭圆曲线，其秩为正且不会在 $K$ 上增加。

items.title: Finite model theory for pseudovarieties and universal algebra: preservation, definability and complexity
items.excerpt: We explore new interactions between finite model theory and classical streams of universal algebra and semigroup theory. A key result is an example of finite algebras whose variety is not finitely axiomatisable in first order logic, but where the class of finite members are finitely axiomatisable amongst finite algebras. These algebras present a negative solution to a first order formulation of the Eilenberg-Sch\"utzenberger problem, and witness the simultaneous failure of the {\L}os-Tarski Theorem, the SP-Preservation Theorem and Birkhoff's HSP-Preservation Theorem at the finite level. The examples also show that a pseudovariety without any finite pseudoequational basis may be finitely axiomatisable in first order logic amongst finite algebras. Other results include the undecidability of deciding first order definability of the pseudovariety of a finite algebra, and a mapping from any fixed finite template constraint satisfaction problem to a first order equivalent variety membership problem.
items.title_zh: 伪簇和通用代数的有限模型理论：保存性、可定义性和复杂性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们探索有限模型理论与通用代数和半群理论的经典流之间的新相互作用。一个关键结果是有限代数的示例，其变化在一阶逻辑中不是有限公理化的，但有限成员类在有限代数中是有限公理化的。这些代数为 Eilenberg-Sch\"utzenberger 问题的一阶公式提供了负解，并见证了 {\L}os-Tarski 定理、SP 保全定理和 Birkhoff 的 HSP 保全定理在有限水平上的同时失效。这些例子还表明，没有任何有限伪方程基础的伪簇在有限代数中在一阶逻辑中可以是有限公理化的。其他结果包括决定有限代数伪簇的一阶可定义性的不可判定性，以及从任何固定有限模板约束满足问题到一阶等效簇隶属度问题的映射。

items.title: Base-extension Semantics for Intuitionistic Predicate Logic
items.excerpt: Sandqvist's base-extension semantics explains the logical constants of intuitionistic propositional logic by inference in bases: collections of rules over atomic sentences that record the inferential content of a state of affairs. We extend it to intuitionistic predicate logic, first- and second-order, reading the quantifiers substitutionally, and prove natural deduction sound and complete. Two ideas carry the extension. First, a rule of a base may require a premiss to be established for a fresh name, one about which neither the assumptions nor the base say anything. With such rules, Sandqvist's completeness proof extends to first-order logic, whether validity is taken over all bases or over finite ones. Second, the second-order quantifier ranges over the atomic predicates, and validity is support in comprehensive bases, where every expressible condition has a definitional proxy. This yields intuitionistic Henkin second-order logic with full comprehension, not full second-order semantics.
items.authors: Alexander V. Gheorghiu, David J. Pym
items.title_zh: 直觉谓词逻辑的基扩展语义
items.excerpt_zh: 桑德奎斯特的基扩展语义学通过基推理解释了直觉命题逻辑的逻辑常数：记录事态推理内容的原子句子的规则集合。我们将其扩展到直觉谓词逻辑，一阶和二阶，替换地读取量词，并证明自然演绎是合理且完整的。有两个想法可以扩展。首先，基础规则可能需要为新名称建立前提，而假设和基础都没有提及该前提。有了这样的规则，Sandqvist 的完整性证明就可以扩展到一阶逻辑，无论有效性是针对所有基础还是有限基础。其次，二阶量词的范围涵盖原子谓词，有效性是综合基础上的支持，其中每个可表达的条件都有一个定义代理。这产生了具有完全理解性的直观亨金二阶逻辑，而不是完全二阶语义。

items.title: On models of affine arithmetic
items.excerpt: By affine arithmetic is meant the set of affine consequences of Peano arithmetic. This is a continuous theory which is studied in the framework of affine logic, a sublogic of continuous logic. Affine arithmetic is undecidable. Also, its models are generally lattice ordered and carry a nontrivial metric. Classical models are then characterized as those which are linearly ordered. In this paper, the affine variants of several classical results in Peano arithmetic are proved. In particular, an affine form of Gaifman's splitting theorem is proved.
items.title_zh: 仿射算术模型
items.excerpt_zh: 仿射算术是指皮亚诺算术的仿射结果集。这是在仿射逻辑框架下研究的连续理论，仿射逻辑是连续逻辑的子逻辑。仿射算术是不可判定的。此外，它的模型通常是晶格有序的并且带有重要的度量。经典模型的特征是线性有序的模型。本文证明了皮亚诺算术中几个经典结果的仿射变体。特别是，证明了盖夫曼分裂定理的仿射形式。

items.title: From Multirelations to Meet-Relations: A Relational Duality for Semilattices with Adjunctions
items.excerpt: We develop a relational duality for semilattices with adjunctions (SLatas) based on binary meet-relations. First, we introduce the category of MoS-spaces and establish a dual equivalence with modal semilattices. Then, by means of A-relations, we define the category RelSP and prove a dual equivalence between SLata and RelSP. To compare this framework with the multirelational semantics previously developed for SLatas, we introduce the notion of normal mS-space and show that, under this condition, the multirelational structure can be canonically recovered from a meet-relation, and conversely. As a consequence, we prove that the categories RelSP and SLataSp are isomorphic.
items.title_zh: 从多重关系到相遇关系：带有附加物的半格的关系对偶性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了基于二元相遇关系的带有附加物的半格（SLAtas）的关系对偶性。首先，我们引入MoS-空间的范畴并建立与模态半格的对偶等价。然后，通过A关系，我们定义了RelSP范畴，并证明了SLAta和RelSP之间的对偶等价性。为了将该框架与之前为 SLAtas 开发的多关系语义进行比较，我们引入了正常 mS 空间的概念，并表明，在这种情况下，多关系结构可以从满足关系中规范地恢复，反之亦然。因此，我们证明类别 RelSP 和 SLAtaSp 是同构的。

items.title: How M.C. Escher’s Art Creates Bizarre Mathematical Worlds
items.excerpt: The artist had no formal math education, yet as a new exhibition shows, the insights revealed in his artwork became an enduring inspiration to mathematicians. The post How M.C. Escher’s Art Creates Bizarre Mathematical Worlds first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.title_zh: 如何M.C.埃舍尔的艺术创造了奇异的数学世界
items.excerpt_zh: 这位艺术家没有接受过正规的数学教育，但正如一个新的展览所显示的那样，他的艺术作品中揭示的见解成为了数学家们持久的灵感。帖子 How M.C.埃舍尔的艺术创造奇异的数学世界首次出现在《Quanta》杂志上

items.title: Why the Future of Mathematics Belongs to Human Judgment
items.excerpt: Artificial intelligence is rapidly crossing boundaries once thought exclusive to human mathematicians. It can search enormous spaces, discover patterns, formalize arguments, and increasingly prove difficult theorems. This raises an unsettling question: if machines can out-search, out-deduce, and out-prove us, what remains uniquely valuable about the human mathematician?
items.excerpt_zh: 人工智能正在迅速跨越曾经被认为是人类数学家独有的界限。它可以搜索巨大的空间，发现模式，形式化论证，并逐渐证明困难的定理。这就提出了一个令人不安的问题：如果机器能够胜过我们的搜索、推理和证明，那么人类数学家还有什么独特的价值呢？
items.title_zh: 为什么数学的未来属于人类判断
