items.title: Mathematics: From Deductive Science to Actually an Experimental Science
items.excerpt: “I was someone who thought mathematics was purely a deductive science, even identified with the formalist philosophical point of view, and I have to say that until very recently this was what mathematicians used to do; after all we would prove theorems and give these theorems to the community. […]”
items.title_zh: 数学：从演绎科学到实际上的实验科学
items.excerpt_zh: “我认为数学纯粹是一门演绎科学，甚至认同形式主义哲学观点，我不得不说，直到最近，这都是数学家过去所做的；毕竟我们会证明定理并将这些定理提供给社区。[...]”

items.title: The injectivity of the Kudla--Millson lift on unitary Shimura varieties
items.excerpt: We prove the injectivity of the Kudla--Millson lift on unitary Shimura varieties over imaginary quadratic fields under some lattice hypotheses. We express integrals of the lift over special cycles as special values of Dirichlet series and deduce injectivity by separating the Fourier coefficients of the cusp forms. We also establish a converse theorem for Borcherds products on $\mathrm{U}(n,1)$.
items.title_zh: Kudla--Millson 升力对酉 Shimura 簇的内射性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在一些格子假设下证明了虚二次域上酉 Shimura 簇上 Kudla--Millson 升力的内射性。我们将特殊循环上的升力积分表示为狄利克雷级数的特殊值，并通过分离尖点形式的傅里叶系数来推导出单射性。我们还在 $\mathrm{U}(n,1)$ 上建立了 Borcherds 乘积的逆定理。

items.title: Bounded functions on the character variety for quadratic extensions of $\mathbb{Q}_p$
items.excerpt: For any finite extension $L$ of $\mathbb{Q}_p$, Schneider--Teitelbaum defined and studied the character variety in $p$-adic Fourier theory. It is a rigid analytic curve over $L$ that parameterizes the set of locally $L$-analytic characters of $o_L$. It is conjectured that all bounded functions on the character variety of Schneider--Teitelbaum come from $p$-adic measures. We prove this conjecture for all quadratic extensions $L/\mathbb{Q}_p$.
items.authors: Laurent Berger, Johannes Sprang, Rustam Steingart
items.title_zh: $\mathbb{Q}_p$ 二次扩展的字符簇上的有界函数
items.excerpt_zh: 对于$\mathbb{Q}_p$的任意有限扩张$L$，Schneider--Teitelbaum定义并研究了$p$-adic Fourier理论中的特征变换。它是 $L$ 上的刚性解析曲线，参数化 $o_L$ 的局部 $L$ 解析字符集。据推测，Schneider-Teitelbaum 字符集上的所有有界函数都来自 $p$-adic 测度。我们对所有二次扩展 $L/\mathbb{Q}_p$ 证明了这个猜想。

items.title: A local-local principle for quadratic forms over semiglobal fields
items.excerpt: Given a quadratic form over a semiglobal field, the set of discrete valuations on the field for which the form is anisotropic over the completion is either empty, or it contains a valuation extending that of the base field with a transcendental residue field extension. In dimension at least $3$, this gives a refinement of the local-global principle for isotropy. In dimension $2$, the result yields a description of the set of elements that are locally squares everywhere.
items.authors: Karim Johannes Becher, David Grimm, Parul Gupta
items.title_zh: 半全局域上二次形式的局部-局部原理
items.excerpt_zh: 给定半全局域上的二次形式，该域上的离散评估集（其形式在完成上是各向异性的）要么是空的，要么它包含通过超越剩余域扩展扩展基域的评估。在至少 $3$ 的维度上，这给出了各向同性的局部全局原理的细化。在维度 $2$ 中，结果产生对到处都是局部正方形的元素集的描述。

items.title: Klarner's sequences have density $0$
items.excerpt: We prove that the set of non-negative integers $n$ which can be obtained from $0$ by repeated application of affine maps $x\mapsto 2x$, $x\mapsto 3x+2$ and $x\mapsto 6x+3$ has density $0$. Moreover, we reach the same conclusion for five other sequences of similar type introduced by D. Klarner. More generally, we establish a criterion excluding stationary measures with bounded density on the profinite group $\mathbb Z_P\cong\prod_{p\mid P}\mathbb Z_p$. A density-to-measure construction using invariant Banach limits and a combinatorial argument involving rational orbits and affine words yield our density-zero results. The criterion also applies to an infinite family of mixed-slope affine semigroups.
items.title_zh: Klarner 的序列密度为 $0$
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，可以通过重复应用仿射映射 $x\mapsto 2x$、$x\mapsto 3x+2$ 和 $x\mapsto 6x+3$ 从 $0$ 获得的非负整数集合 $n$ 的密度为 $0$。此外，我们对 D. Klarner 引入的其他五个类似类型的序列也得出了相同的结论。更一般地，我们建立一个标准，排除有限群 $\mathbb Z_P\cong\prod_{p\mid P}\mathbb Z_p$ 上具有有界密度的平稳测量。使用不变巴纳赫极限和涉及有理轨道和仿射词的组合论证的密度测量构造产生了密度为零的结果。该准则也适用于混合斜率仿射半群的无限族。

items.title: $L^p$-norms of holomorphic cusp forms
items.excerpt: We determine the optimal orders of local and global $L^p$-norms of $L^2$-normalized holomorphic cusp forms of large weight on the modular surface, for fixed $2 <(4\pi)^{-1}$. We also give sup norm bounds in a wider range of indices.
items.excerpt_zh: 对于固定的 $2 <(4\pi)^{-1}$，我们确定模表面上大权重的 $L^2$ 归一化全纯尖点形式的局部和全局 $L^p$-范数的最优阶。 We also give sup norm bounds in a wider range of indices.
items.title_zh: $L^p$-全纯尖点形式的范数

items.title: A Little Advice Suffices: Diffie-Hellman Is as Hard as Discrete Logarithm
items.excerpt: Is computing a Diffie-Hellman key as hard as computing a discrete logarithm? Maurer showed that it is, given a few bits of advice, provided that short intervals contain enough integers with only small prime factors; that proviso has stood for thirty years. We remove it. For every prime $p$ there is an advice string of $O(\log p)$ bits, depending only on $p$, with which discrete logarithms in every group of order $p$ are computed in polynomial time from a Diffie-Hellman oracle. The reduction is the classical one; what was missing was a proof that short intervals contain polylogarithmically smooth integers. We show that a zero-free half-plane for the Riemann zeta function, which is now known, gives the expected number of $(\log x)^K$-smooth integers in every interval $[x,x+x^\theta]$ with $\theta>17/30$. With smoothness this small the saddle point of the counting integral lies just to the left of the line $\mathrm{Re}\,s=1$, and a zero-free strip of any fixed width absorbs the shift once $K$ is large. Genus-2 Jacobians, whose orders fill such intervals, then turn one of these integers into the order of an auxiliary group. The same input
items.title_zh: 一点建议就足够了：Diffie-Hellman 和离散对数一样难
items.excerpt_zh: 计算 Diffie-Hellman 密钥与计算离散对数一样困难吗？毛雷尔证明，在给出一些建议的情况下，只要短间隔包含足够的整数，而质因数很小；这一限制性规定已经存在了三十年。我们将其删除。对于每个素数 $p$ ，都有一个 $O(\log p)$ 位的建议字符串，仅取决于 $p$，其中每组 $p$ 阶中的离散对数都是从 Diffie-Hellman 预言中以多项式时间计算的。还原是经典的还原；缺少的是短间隔包含多对数平滑整数的证明。我们证明，现在已知的黎曼 zeta 函数的无零半平面给出了每个区间 $[x,x+x^\theta]$ 中 $(\log x)^K$ 光滑整数的预期数量，其中 $\theta>17/30$。由于平滑度如此之小，计数积分的鞍点就位于线 $\mathrm{Re}\,s=1$ 的左侧，并且一旦 $K$ 很大，任何固定宽度的无零条带都会吸收偏移。 Genus-2 雅可比行列式（其阶数填充了这些间隔）然后将这些整数之一转换为辅助群的阶数。相同的输入

items.title: Abelian varieties with homotheties
items.excerpt: In 1980, Bogomolov proved that the $\ell$-adic Galois image of an Abelian variety over a number field contains an open subgroup of the homotheties. In 1986, Serre refined that result, showing that the homotheties coming from the Galois side were uniformly bounded in $\ell$ inside the homotheties of the codomain of the representation. In a 2007 paper, Zarhin shows that Bogomolov's conclusion can fail in non-trivial cases for global function fields. We prove a suitable analogue of Serre's results over finitely generated fields of positive characteristic. As a consequence, we prove a new case of the 1978 conjecture by Geyer and Jarden.
items.title_zh: 具有同调的阿贝尔簇
items.excerpt_zh: 1980 年，博戈莫洛夫证明了数域上阿贝尔簇的 $\ell$-adic 伽罗瓦图像包含同位性的开子群。 1986 年，Serre 改进了该结果，表明来自 Galois 一侧的同位性均匀地限制在表示的余域同位性内的 $\ell$ 中。在 2007 年的一篇论文中，Zarhin 表明，在全局函数域的非平凡情况下，Bogomolov 的结论可能会失败。我们在有限生成的正特征场上证明了塞尔结果的合适模拟。因此，我们证明了盖尔和贾登 1978 年猜想的一个新案例。

items.title: The totient bound and extremal gaps in cyclotomic polynomials
items.excerpt: Let $m>1$ be odd and squarefree, and let $p\nmid m$ be prime. If $p m$, the maximum gap has length $\varphi(m)$ and occurs exactly $2\lfloor p/m\rfloor$ times. We determine its positions and endpoint coefficients. These results prove the equality criterion of Ambrosino, Hong and Lee and the multiplicity formula of Zhang. We also treat repeated prime factors, even cofactors and extremal zero runs in periodic coefficient blocks.
items.title_zh: 分圆多项式中的总边界和极值间隙
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $m>1$ 为奇数且无平方，并令 $p\nmid m$ 为素数。如果$p m$，则最大间隙的长度为$\varphi(m)$，并且恰好出现$2\lfloor p/m\rfloor$ 次。我们确定它的位置和端点系数。这些结果证明了Ambrosino、Hong、Lee的平等准则和Zhang的重数公式。我们还处理周期性系数块中的重复素因子，甚至辅因子和极值零游程。

items.title: Counting formulas and refined generating functions for inversion-sequence Classes 152 and 207
items.excerpt: For the two Class 152 pattern sets, we prove that the common number of inversion sequences of length \(n\geq 1\) is \(a_n=1+\sum_{j=1}^{n-1}\binom{2j}{j}\). The Class 152 proof uses first-descent and last-zero decompositions, with weighted Dyck paths evaluating the resulting generating functions. For Class 207, we prove equality of the three total-count series and give their common generating function as an explicit Lambert-series expression after the substitution \(z=q/(1+q)^2\). Complete legal-site and catalytic recurrences lead to a Lambert series for one class and \(q\)-product orbit sums for another. A cubic limit of the balanced nonterminating \({}_3\phi_2\) \(q\)-Saalschutz summation identifies these expressions. Fixed-maximum expansions, finite verification data, refined analytic obstructions, and signed specializations are recorded in the supplementary material.
items.authors: Haobo Ma, Toufik Mansour, Wenlin Zhang
items.title_zh: 倒数序列第 152 类和第 207 类的计数公式和细化生成函数
items.excerpt_zh: 对于两个152类模式集，我们证明长度为\(n\geq 1\)的反转序列的公共数量为\(a_n=1+\sum_{j=1}^{n-1}\binom{2j}{j}\)。 152 类证明使用首次下降和最后零分解，并使用加权 Dyck 路径评估生成的生成函数。对于 207 类，我们证明了三个总计数级数的相等性，并在替换 \(z=q/(1+q)^2\) 后将它们的公共生成函数作为显式朗伯级数表达式给出。完整的合法位点和催化递归导致一类的兰伯特级数和另一类的 \(q\) 乘积轨道和。平衡非终止 \({}_3\phi_2\) \(q\)-Saalschutz 求和的立方极限标识了这些表达式。固定最大扩展、有限验证数据、精炼分析障碍和签名专业化都记录在补充材料中。

items.title: Co-edge-regular graphs with two $\lambda$-values and four distinct eigenvalues
items.excerpt: A connected $k$-regular graph $G$ on $n$ vertices is co-edge-regular if any two distinct non-adjacent vertices have the same number of common neighbors. For adjacent vertices $u$ and $v$, let $\lambda(u,v)=|N(u)\cap N(v)|$. Ge and Koolen asked whether the theorem of Neumaier on strongly regular graphs with fixed smallest eigenvalue extends to co-edge-regular graphs with exactly four distinct eigenvalues in which $\lambda(u,v)$ takes exactly two values over the edges $uv$. In this paper, we answer this question. For every integer $t\ge2$ there is $n_t$ such that if $G$ is such a graph with smallest eigenvalue at least $-t$, $n\ge n_t$, and $k<n-2-(t-1)^2/4$, then either $G$ is a clique extension of a strongly regular graph, or $G$ is obtained from a strongly regular graph with a Hoffman coloring by adding all edges inside the color classes. Consequently, $G$ is a clique extension of a strongly regular graph, a $p\times q$ grid with $p\ne q$, or the block graph of a resolvable Steiner $2$-design in which every parallel class is made into a clique.
items.title_zh: 具有两个 $\lambda$ 值和四个不同特征值的共边正则图
items.excerpt_zh: 如果任何两个不同的非相邻顶点具有相同数量的公共邻居，则 $n$ 个顶点上的连通 $k$ 正则图 $G$ 是共边正则图。对于相邻顶点 $u$ 和 $v$，令 $\lambda(u,v)=|N(u)\cap N(v)|$。 Ge 和 Koolen 询问关于具有固定最小特征值的强正则图的 Neumaier 定理是否可以扩展到具有四个不同特征值的共边正则图，其中 $\lambda(u,v)$ 在边 $uv$ 上恰好取两个值。在本文中，我们回答这个问题。对于每个整数 $t\ge2$ 都有 $n_t$，这样如果 $G$ 是具有最小特征值至少 $-t$、$n\gen_t$ 和 $k<n-2-(t-1)^2/4$ 的图，则 $G$ 是强正则图的团扩展，或者 $G$ 是通过将颜色类内的所有边相加，从具有霍夫曼着色的强正则图获得的。因此，$G$ 是一个强正则图的派扩展，一个带有 $p\ne q$ 的 $p\times q$ 网格，或者是可解析的 Steiner $2$ 设计的框图，其中每个并行类都被制成一个派。

items.title: Resistance-regular graphs need not be regular
items.excerpt: A connected graph is resistance-regular if the sum of the effective resistances from a vertex to all other vertices does not depend on the vertex, or equivalently if the Moore-Penrose inverse of its Laplacian has constant diagonal. Walk-regular graphs have this property, and Zhou, Wang and Bu asked in 2016 whether every resistance-regular graph is regular, a question that also arises in the study of graphs with constant resistance curvature. We answer this question in the negative and examine both what resistance-regularity forces and how far from regular such graphs can be. On the spectral side, we prove that a connected graph is walk-regular if and only if the first $m-1$ powers of its Laplacian pseudoinverse have constant diagonal, where $m$ is the number of distinct nonzero Laplacian eigenvalues. Because resistance-regularity constrains only the first power, it forces regularity when $m\le2$ and allows at most two vertex degrees when $m=3$. Any non-regular resistance-regular graph has minimum degree at least $3$ and a connected complement, and an exhaustive computer search shows that it must have at least $13$ vertices. For every
items.authors: Murad ul Islam Khan, Ghulam Haidar
items.title_zh: 电阻正则图不必是正则的
items.excerpt_zh: 如果从一个顶点到所有其他顶点的有效电阻之和不依赖于该顶点，或者等效地如果其拉普拉斯算子的摩尔-彭罗斯逆具有恒定的对角线，则连通图是电阻正则图。行走正则图具有这种性质，Zhou、Wang 和 Bu 在 2016 年提出了是否每个电阻正则图都是正则的问题，这个问题在研究具有恒定电阻曲率的图时也会出现。我们对这个问题给出否定的回答，并研究阻力规律性的力量以及此类图表与规律的距离有多远。在谱方面，我们证明连通图是行走正则的当且仅当其拉普拉斯伪逆的前 $m-1$ 幂具有恒定对角线，其中 $m$ 是不同的非零拉普拉斯特征值的数量。因为阻力规则性仅约束第一个幂，所以当 $m\le2$ 时它会强制规则性，并且当 $m=3$ 时最多允许两个顶点度数。任何非正则阻力正则图的最小度数至少为 3 美元，并且有一个连通补集，并且详尽的计算机搜索表明它必须至少具有 13 美元的顶点。对于每一个

items.title: Gallai's path decomposition conjecture for $K_5$-minor-free graphs
items.excerpt: Gallai conjectured that the edges of every connected graph on $n$ vertices can be partitioned into at most $\ceil{n/2}$ paths. We prove that every connected $K_5$-minor-free graph other than $K_3$ and $K_5-e$ admits such a partition into at most $\floor{n/2}$ paths. The two exceptions require $\ceil{n/2}$ paths. In a smallest counterexample we find a $4$-connected planar part containing four vertices of degree five. Their neighborhoods meet the boundary in at most one vertex. This allows us to apply the planar configurations of Blanch\'e, Bonamy, and Bonichon and to realize the reduced graph as a minor of the original graph.
items.authors: Junhao Zhang, Qinghai Liu, Yanmei Hong
items.title_zh: $K_5$-无次要图的 Gallai 路径分解猜想
items.excerpt_zh: Gallai 推测 $n$ 个顶点上的每个连通图的边最多可以划分为 $\ceil{n/2}$ 条路径。我们证明除了 $K_3$ 和 $K_5-e$ 之外的每个连接的 $K_5$-minor-free 图都允许这样的划分到最多 $\floor{n/2}$ 路径。这两个例外需要 $\ceil{n/2}$ 路径。在最小的反例中，我们发现一个 $4$ 连接的平面部分包含四个五度顶点。它们的邻域最多在一个顶点处与边界相交。这使我们能够应用 Blanch\'e、Bonamy 和 Bonichon 的平面配置，并将简化图实现为原始图的次要图。

items.title: The Conic Tverberg plus minus
items.excerpt: We prove a Tverberg type theorems: Given a set $A\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ and an affine subspaces $L_1,...,L_m\subset \mathbb{R}^d$. In some conditions there is a partition $A_1, ..., A_m, B_1, ..., B_m$ of $A$ such that the sets $L_i\cup A_i\cup B_i$ for $i=1,...,m$ have common barycentre with negative masses in $B_i$ and positive masses in $A_i$. The case $B_1=...=B_m=L_1=...=L_m=\varnothing$ is Tverberg's classical theorem. The case $L_1=...=L_m=\varnothing$ gives a partial answer to the question of Barany-Soberon about the possible number of negative masses.
items.title_zh: 圆锥形特维尔伯格加减
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明一个 Tverberg 型定理：给定一个集合 $A\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ 和一个仿射子空间 $L_1,...,L_m\subset \mathbb{R}^d$。在某些情况下，$A$ 存在分区 $A_1​​, ..., A_m, B_1, ..., B_m$，使得 $i=1,...,m$ 的集合 $L_i\cup A_i\cup B_i$ 具有公共重心，其中 $B_i$ 为负质量，$A_i$ 为正质量。 $B_1=...=B_m=L_1=...=L_m=\varnothing$ 的情况是特维尔伯格经典定理。案例 $L_1=...=L_m=\varnothing$ 部分回答了 Barany-Soberon 关于负质量的可能数量的问题。

items.title: Forbidden Substructures Preserved by the Blob Graph Operation
items.excerpt: The blob graph $G^\circ$ of a graph $G$ has a vertex for each non-empty connected vertex subset of $G$, with two distinct subsets adjacent whenever they intersect or are joined by an edge of $G$. This construction has been used in reductions from induced subgraph optimisation problems to maximum-weight independent set, where the preservation of forbidden substructures is essential. We completely characterise the graphs $H$ for which excluding $H$ from $G$ guarantees that $G^\circ$ also excludes $H$, under six containment relations. For subgraphs, minors, and topological minors, preservation holds exactly when $H$ has at most two vertices. For induced subgraphs, it holds exactly when $H$ is a linear forest. For induced topological minors, it holds exactly when $H$ is triangle-free and has maximum degree at most two. For induced minors, it holds exactly when $H$ is triangle-free and every neighbour of a vertex of degree at least three has degree exactly two. These classifications unify and extend preservation results previously established for particular forbidden graphs in algorithmic applications.
items.authors: Jakub P\k{a}czka, Agnieszka Prze\'zdziecka, Piotr Tyrakowski
items.title_zh: Blob 图操作保留的禁止子结构
items.excerpt_zh: 图 $G$ 的斑点图 $G^\circ$ 对于 $G$ 的每个非空连通顶点子集都有一个顶点，只要两个不同的子集相交或通过 $G$ 的边连接，它们就相邻。这种结构已用于将诱导子图优化问题简化为最大权重独立集，其中禁止子结构的保留至关重要。我们完全描述了图 $H$ 的特征，其中从 $G$ 中排除 $H$ 保证了 $G^\circ$ 也排除了 $H$，在六种包含关系下。对于子图、次图和拓扑次图，当 $H$ 最多有两个顶点时，守恒成立。对于诱导子图，当 $H$ 是线性森林时它恰好成立。对于诱导拓扑未成年人，当 $H$ 是无三角形且最大度数最多为 2 时，它恰好成立。对于诱导未成年人，当 $H$ 是无三角形且度数至少为 3 的顶点的每个邻居的度数恰好为 2 时，它恰好成立。这些分类统一并扩展了先前为算法应用中的特定禁止图建立的保存结果。

items.title: Supersaturation and reconfiguration diameter of independent transversals
items.excerpt: Consider the collection of independent transversals of a vertex-partitioned graph of maximum degree $\Delta$. It is a classic result that when all parts have size at least $2\Delta$, the collection is nonempty. Recently, it was found that if the parts have size at least $2\Delta+1$, then every pair of independent transversals is connected, within the collection, by a sequence of one-vertex reconfigurations. We prove, among other results, that there are exponentially many independent transversals when the parts have size at least $2\Delta$, and that the reconfiguration diameter is at most linear in the number of parts when the parts have size at least $4\Delta$.
items.authors: Wouter Cames van Batenburg, Penny Haxell, Ross J. Kang, Ronen Wdowinski
items.title_zh: 独立横截面的过饱和度和重构直径
items.excerpt_zh: 考虑最大度 $\Delta$ 的顶点划分图的独立横截面的集合。这是一个经典的结果，当所有部分的大小至少为 $2\Delta$ 时，集合是非空的。最近，人们发现，如果零件的大小至少为 $2\Delta+1$，则集合内的每对独立横截面都通过一系列单顶点重新配置进行连接。除其他结果外，我们证明，当零件的尺寸至少为 $2\Delta$ 时，存在指数级多的独立横截面，并且当零件的尺寸至少为 $4\Delta$ 时，重构直径最多与零件的数量呈线性关系。

items.title: Shifted Hankel determinants via Hankel continued fractions
items.excerpt: The Hankel determinants $H_n(F)$ of a power series $F(x)$, as well as the shifted ones $H_n^{(1)}(F)$ and $H_n^{(2)}(F)$, can be read off from its Jacobi continued fraction, provided that all $H_n(F)$ are nonzero. Without any condition on $F$, the Hankel continued fraction ($H$-fraction) still yields all $H_n(F)$. We show that the $H$-fraction of $F$ also determines the shifted Hankel determinants $H_n^{(1)}(F)$, $H_n^{(2)}(F)$ and the backward shifted ones $H_n^{(-1)}(F)$, and we give explicit formulas for them. As applications, we provide simple proofs of Hankel determinant evaluations that were previously established by means of complicated explicit $H$-fractions.
items.title_zh: 通过 Hankel 连分数转移 Hankel 行列式
items.excerpt_zh: 幂级数 $F(x)$ 的汉克尔行列式 $H_n(F)$ 以及移位行列式 $H_n^{(1)}(F)$ 和 $H_n^{(2)}(F)$ 可以从其雅可比连分数中读出，前提是所有 $H_n(F)$ 均非零。在 $F$ 上没有任何条件的情况下，汉克尔连分数（$H$-分数）仍然会产生所有 $H_n(F)$。我们证明，$F$ 的 $H$ 分数也决定了移位的汉克尔行列式 $H_n^{(1)}(F)$、$H_n^{(2)}(F)$ 和向后移位的行列式 $H_n^{(-1)}(F)$，并且我们给出了它们的显式公式。作为应用程序，我们提供了先前通过复杂的显式 $H$ 分数建立的 Hankel 行列式评估的简单证明。

items.title: Quantum $K$-theoretic Whitney relation for Lagrangian Grassmannian
items.excerpt: We give a quantum $K$-theoretic analogue of the Whitney relation for the torus-equivariant $K$-ring of the Lagrangian Grassmannian. As a consequence, we give a presentation of the torus-equivariant quantum $K$-ring of the Lagrangian Grassmannian. The strategy for obtaining such relations is to use the quantum $K$-theoretic Whitney relation for the full-flag manifold in type $C$ established by the author and Kato's pushforward map from the quantum $K$-ring of the full-flag manifold to that of the partial flag manifold. Then the Nakayama-type argument established by Gu et al., together with the classical Whitney presentation for the torus-equivariant $K$-ring of the Lagrangian Grassmannian, gives a proof of such a presentation.
items.title_zh: 拉格朗日格拉斯曼的量子 $K$ 理论惠特尼关系
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了拉格朗日格拉斯曼环的环面等变 $K$ 环的惠特尼关系的量子 $K$ 理论模拟。因此，我们给出了拉格朗日格拉斯曼环的环面等变量子 $K$ 环。获得这种关系的策略是利用作者建立的$C$型全旗流形的量子$K$理论Whitney关系和Kato从全旗流形的量子$K$环到部分旗流形的前推映射。然后，Gu等人建立的中山型论证，以及拉格朗日格拉斯曼环的环面等变$K$环的经典Whitney演示，给出了这种演示的证明。

items.title: Remarks on Fourier--Mukai invariances
items.excerpt: This note proves that smoothness and Gorensteinness are Fourier--Mukai invariants for proper flat families of Noetherian algebraic spaces. Moreover, a kernel realizing such a partnership is perfect if, and only if, the families are smooth.
items.title_zh: 关于傅里叶--向井不变量的评论
items.excerpt_zh: 该注释证明平滑度和 Gorensteinness 是诺特代数空间的真平坦族的傅立叶-Mukai 不变量。此外，当且仅当家庭和睦时，实现这种伙伴关系的内核才是完美的。

items.title: Topology of some smooth real Fano threefolds arising from blow-ups along rational curves
items.excerpt: We describe the topological blow-up of a fibre of a Seifert fibration. We then apply this result to determine the diffeomorphism types of the real loci of smooth real Fano threefolds obtained by blowing up either $\mathbb{P}^3_{\mathbb{R}}$ or a smooth real quadric threefold along a smooth real rational curve. As an application, we also determine the topology of the real loci of the two real forms of the quintic del Pezzo threefold $V_5$, completing the topological classification of smooth real rational del Pezzo threefolds.
items.title_zh: 由沿有理曲线的爆炸产生的一些平滑实法诺三重的拓扑
items.excerpt_zh: 我们描述了 Seifert 纤维的拓扑膨胀。然后，我们应用这个结果来确定通过沿平滑实有理曲线放大 $\mathbb{P}^3_{\mathbb{R}}$ 或平滑实二次三重获得的平滑实法诺三重的实轨迹的微分同胚类型。作为应用，我们还确定了五次del Pezzo三重$V_5$的两个实形式的实轨迹的拓扑，完成了光滑实有理del Pezzo三重的拓扑分类。

items.title: The Nygaard graded piece, the Frobenius--Witt cotangent complex and regularity criteria
items.excerpt: For a $p$-torsionfree $p$-quasisyntomic ring, we construct a fiber sequence relating the $p$-th Nygaard graded piece of absolute prismatic cohomology to the Frobenius--Witt cotangent complex. The latter is an arithmetic analogue of the cotangent complex in which the differential of $p$ need not vanish. We also clarify the relationship between the regularity criterion proved by Mao using the Frobenius--Witt cotangent complex and the regularity criterion established by Bhatt and Mathew using the Nygaard graded piece. This relationship was anticipated by Bhatt and Mathew.
items.title_zh: Nygaard 分级片、Frobenius--Witt 余切复形和正则性准则
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 $p$-无扭 $p$-准同步环，我们构造了一个纤维序列，将绝对棱柱上同调的第 $p$-th Nygaard 分级片与 Frobenius-Witt 余切复形相关联。后者是余切复形的算术模拟，其中 $p$ 的微分不需要消失。我们还阐明了Mao使用Frobenius-Witt余切复形证明的正则性准则与Bhatt和Mathew使用Nygaard分级件建立的正则性准则之间的关系。这种关系是巴特和马修预料到的。

items.title: Maximum number of cells in a matroid subdivision of hypersimplex
items.excerpt: David Speyer proved that the maximum number of cells in a regular matroid subdivision of the hypersimplex $\Delta(m,t)$ is $\binom{t-2}{m-1}$ , using the language of tropical geometry and properties of the Tutte polynomial of a matroid \cite[Theorem 6.1]{Speyer}. In this paper, we prove this result in general, i.e. for arbitrary matroid subdivisions including the non-regular ones. We perform a different combinatorial way using our results in \cite{HHH} and independent of tropical language.
items.title_zh: 超单纯形拟阵细分中的最大单元数
items.excerpt_zh: David Speyer 使用热带几何语言和拟阵 Tutte 多项式的性质证明了超单纯形 $\Delta(m,t)$ 的正则拟阵细分中的最大单元数为 $\binom{t-2}{m-1}$ ，\cite[定理 6.1]{Speyer}。在本文中，我们一般证明了这个结果，即对于任意拟阵细分，包括非常规细分。我们使用 \cite{HHH} 中的结果执行不同的组合方式，并且独立于热带语言。

items.title: Tannaka groups of holonomic D-modules on semi-abelian varieties are almost connected
items.excerpt: In this short note we prove that Tannaka groups arising from convolutions of D-modules on complex semi-abelian varieties are almost connected. This generalizes results known for tori on the one hand and abelian varieties on the other.
items.title_zh: 半阿贝尔簇上完整 D 模的 Tannaka 群几乎是连通的
items.excerpt_zh: 在这篇简短的文章中，我们证明由复杂半阿贝尔簇上的 D 模卷积产生的 Tannaka 群几乎是连通的。这概括了一方面已知的托里变体和另一方面的阿贝尔变体的结果。

items.title: Hypersurfaces that are far from ruled
items.excerpt: We show that a very general complex hypersurface of degree $d$ in $\mathbb P^{n+1}$ is not ruled whenever $n\geq3$ and $d\geq2\lceil(n+2)/3\rceil$. This improves Koll\'ar's original degree bound to the bound subsequently obtained by Totaro for stable irrationality and, in particular, includes very general quartic fourfolds. More precisely, we find new bounds for the minimal degree of a dominant rational map from a very general hypersurface to a ruled variety or a conic bundle, improving on previous bounds of Chen--Stapleton. The proofs combine Koll\'ar's reduction to positive characteristic with the Jacobson correspondence for inseparable extensions.
items.title_zh: 远离规则的超曲面
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，每当 $n\geq3$ 和 $d\geq2\lceil(n+2)/3\rceil$ 时，$\mathbb P^{n+1}$ 中的 $d$ 度的非常一般的复杂超曲面不被规则。这将 Koll'ar 的原始度界提高到了 Totaro 随后获得的稳定无理数界，特别是包括非常一般的四次四重。更准确地说，我们找到了从非常一般的超曲面到直纹簇或圆锥丛的主导理性映射的最小度的新界限，改进了 Chen-Stapleton 的先前界限。这些证明将Koll'ar 的正特征还原与Jacobson 对应关系结合起来，以实现不可分离的扩展。

items.title: Generators of derived category and toric Frobenius morphism
items.excerpt: We investigate the action of the toric Frobenius pushforward functor on the derived category of a toric variety. Our main goal is to characterize objects of the derived category which become generators after applying a sufficiently high Frobenius pushforward. In particular, we extend a conjecture of A.Hanlon, J.Hicks, and O.Lazarev, which describes line bundles with this property, to arbitrary equivariant objects, and prove the extended conjecture for all smooth toric varieties.
items.title_zh: 派生范畴和复曲面 Frobenius 态射的生成器
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了环面 Frobenius 前推函子对环面簇的派生范畴的作用。我们的主要目标是表征派生类别的对象，这些对象在应用足够高的弗罗贝尼乌斯前推后成为生成器。特别是，我们将 A.Hanlon、J.Hicks 和 O.Lazarev 的猜想（描述具有此属性的线丛）扩展到任意等变对象，并证明了所有光滑环面簇的扩展猜想。

items.title: A Proof of the Achlioptas-Friedgut Convergence Conjecture
items.excerpt: For every fixed integer $q\ge3$, we show that the $q$-colourability transition in a sparse random graph takes place at a limiting edge density, thus proving the Achlioptas-Friedgut convergence conjecture. The proof adapts the argument we recently introduced to settle the satisfiability conjecture.
items.title_zh: Achlioptas-Friedgut 收敛猜想的证明
items.excerpt_zh: 对于每个固定整数 $q\ge3$，我们表明稀疏随机图中的 $q$-可色性转变发生在极限边缘密度处，从而证明了 Achlioptas-Friedgut 收敛猜想。该证明采用了我们最近引入的论证来解决可满足性猜想。

items.title: Adapted transport inequalities in continuous time
items.excerpt: Given a strong solution $X$ to a stochastic differential equation (SDE), we establish sufficient conditions under which $\text{Law}(X)$ satisfies an adapted quadratic transport cost inequality (AQTCI) with respect to the semimartingale adapted Wasserstein distance. When the drift and diffusion coefficients are Markovian, we further show that the AQTCI tensorizes in a dimension-free manner. As a corollary, we show that various stochastic control problems, e.g. optimal stopping and mean-variance portfolio selection, are stable under bounded, measurable drift perturbations. Additionally, we derive concentration inequalities (with respect to certain dynamic risk measures) for stochastic integrals $\int H_s dX_s$ and deduce appropriate bounds on their tail behavior. Furthermore, using the functional It\^o formula, we show that the AQTCI for $\text{Law}(X)$ allows one to deduce classical transport inequalities for $\text{Law}(F(X))$ even when $F$ is not Lipschitz on path space. Finally, we give sufficient conditions for $\text{Law}(X)$ to satisfy AQTCIs when $X$ is a solution to a scalar fractional SDE or stochastic Volterra equation.
items.title_zh: 连续时间内适应的运输不平等
items.excerpt_zh: 给定随机微分方程 (SDE) 的强解 $X$，我们建立充分的条件，在该条件下 $\text{Law}(X)$ 满足关于半鞅适应 Wasserstein 距离的适应二次运输成本不等式 (AQTCI)。当漂移和扩散系数为马尔可夫时，我们进一步表明 AQTCI 以无量纲方式张量化。作为推论，我们证明了各种随机控制问题，例如最优停止和均值方差投资组合选择在有界、可测量的漂移扰动下是稳定的。此外，我们推导出随机积分 $\int H_s dX_s$ 的集中不等式（相对于某些动态风险度量），并推导出其尾部行为的适当界限。此外，使用泛函 It\^o 公式，我们表明 $\text{Law}(X)$ 的 AQTCI 允许推导出 $\text{Law}(F(X))$ 的经典传输不等式，即使 $F$ 在路径空间上不是 Lipschitz 时也是如此。最后，当 $X$ 是标量分数 SDE 或随机 Volterra 方程的解时，我们给出 $\text{Law}(X)$ 满足 AQTCI 的充分条件。

items.title: Avalanche Sharpness and the Stationary State of the Bak--Sneppen Model on $\mathbb Z^d$
items.excerpt: We establish the stationary picture for the nearest-neighbour Bak--Sneppen model on $\mathbb Z^d$, for every $d\ge1$. There exists a critical level $t_c$ such that, as $N\to\infty$, every fixed family of stationary fitnesses on the torus $(\mathbb Z/N\mathbb Z)^d$ converges, in exponential coordinates, to independent random variables with law $t_c+\operatorname{Exp}(1)$. The proof relies on three estimates for avalanches. For $d\ge2$, these replace the interval structure available in dimension one. We show that the threshold at which the mean avalanche range diverges coincides with the threshold for the appearance of an infinite avalanche, using the hierarchical structure of avalanches and an estimate on the creation of new sites under translation. We then prove that an avalanche reaching a macroscopic distance on the torus can, after any fixed positive increase of the level, be amplified into one covering the whole torus. Finally, below criticality, we obtain exponential integrability of the avalanche range and give a finite--infinite volume comparison. These three ingredients allow us to implement the Meester and Znamenski program t
items.title_zh: 雪崩锐度和 Bak 的静止状态--$\mathbb Z^d$ 上的 Sneppen 模型
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为每个 $d\ge1$ 在 $\mathbb Z^d$ 上建立最近邻 Bak--Sneppen 模型的平稳图。存在一个临界水平 $t_c$，使得，作为 $N\to\infty$，环面 $(\mathbb Z/N\mathbb Z)^d$ 上的每个固定适应度族在指数坐标中收敛到具有规律 $t_c+\operatorname{Exp}(1)$ 的独立随机变量。该证明依赖于对雪崩的三个估计。对于 $d\ge2$，这些替换了第一维中可用的区间结构。我们使用雪崩的层次结构和对平移下新站点创建的估计，表明平均雪崩范围发散的阈值与无限雪崩出现的阈值一致。然后我们证明，在环面上达到宏观距离的雪崩，在水平的任何固定正增加之后，可以被放大为覆盖整个环面的雪崩。最后，在临界点以下，我们获得了雪崩范围的指数可积性，并给出了有限与无限体积的比较。这三个要素使我们能够实施 Meester 和 Znamenski 计划

items.title: Stochastic differential delay equations with random delay driven by fractional Brownian motion
items.excerpt: We prove an existence and uniqueness result for stochastic differential delay equations driven by a fractional Brownian motion with Hurst parameter $H > \tfrac{1}{2}$, where the delay is a random process. Extending the pathwise Riemann--Stieltjes approach of Ferrante and Rovira \cite{FR2010}, we show that if the random delay $\tau(\cdot,\omega)$ has almost surely $\gamma$-H\"older continuous trajectories with $\gamma\delta > (1-H)/H$, where $\delta\in(0,1]$ is the H\"older exponent of the gradient of the diffusion coefficient, then the equation has a unique solution with paths in $C^{1-\alpha}(-r_0,T;R^d)\subset W_0^{\alpha,\infty}(-r_0,T;R^d)$ for appropriate $\alpha\in(1-H,\tfrac12)$. We also prove that the solution has moments of all orders when $\gamma>1/(2H)$ and the H\"older constant of the delay is bounded.
items.title_zh: 分数布朗运动驱动的具有随机延迟的随机微分延迟方程
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了由具有 Hurst 参数 $H > \tfrac{1}{2}$ 的分数布朗运动驱动的随机微分延迟方程的存在性和唯一性结果，其中延迟是随机过程。扩展 Ferrante 和 Rovira 的路径 Riemann-Stieltjes 方法 \cite{FR2010}，我们表明，如果随机延迟 $\tau(\cdot,\omega)$ 几乎肯定具有 $\gamma$-H\" 旧的连续轨迹，且 $\gamma\delta > (1-H)/H$，其中 $\delta\in(0,1]$ 是 H\" 梯度的旧指数扩散系数，则方程在 $C^{1-\alpha}(-r_0,T;R^d)\subset W_0^{\alpha,\infty}(-r_0,T;R^d)$ 中具有唯一解，对于适当的 $\alpha\in(1-H,\tfrac12)$，我们还证明当 $\gamma>1/(2H)$ 和 H\"older 常数时，该解具有所有阶矩。是有界的。

items.title: Fixed-Point Results and Disequilibrium for Negators of Hyperbolic-Valued Probability Distributions
items.excerpt: Hyperbolic-valued probability distributions provide a probabilistic setting in which mass, order, and uncertainty take values in the positive cone of the hyperbolic algebra. We study the fixed-point structure of hyperbolic probability negators and the behavior of hyperbolic-valued disequilibrium along their iterates. Starting from a hyperbolic-valued metric on each mass stratum, we define the associated disequilibrium as the separation between a distribution and the uniform distribution determined by its hyperbolic mass. We consider the disequilibria induced by the hyperbolic Euclidean, \(\ell_1\), and Jensen--Shannon metrics. Their hyperbolic Schur-convexity is established and sharp lower and upper bounds are obtained. We also characterize the possible fixed-point sets of hyperbolic negators through an order-theoretic condition and derive criteria ensuring uniqueness of the associated uniform distribution. The behavior of disequilibrium along the iterates of hyperbolic negators is then analyzed through two complementary mechanisms. Domination by Yager's negator yields exact decay factors for the Euclidean and \(\ell_1\) disequilibria
items.authors: Edil D. Molina, Juan Bory-Reyes, Jos\'e M. Sigarreta
items.title_zh: 双曲值概率分布负数的定点结果和不平衡
items.excerpt_zh: 双曲值概率分布提供了一种概率设置，其中质量、阶数和不确定性取双曲代数正锥体中的值。我们研究双曲概率负器的定点结构以及沿其迭代的双曲值不平衡行为。从每个质量层的双曲值度量开始，我们将相关的不平衡定义为分布与由其双曲质量确定的均匀分布之间的分离。我们考虑由双曲欧几里得、\(\ell_1\) 和 Jensen--Shannon 度量引起的不平衡。建立了它们的双曲 Schur 凸性并获得了尖锐的下限和上限。我们还通过阶次理论条件来表征双曲负子的可能定点集，并导出确保相关均匀分布唯一性的标准。然后通过两种互补机制分析沿着双曲否定子迭代的不平衡行为。 Yager 否定的支配产生了欧几里得和 \(\ell_1\) 不平衡的精确衰减因子

items.title: A Brownian web invariance principle: Localized disturbance flows and Hastings-Levitov(0)
items.excerpt: We establish a Brownian web invariance principle for localized disturbance flows, providing a criterion that strengthens the weak-flow convergence of [Norris--Turner 2015, Ann. Probab. 43, 935--970] to path-Hausdorff convergence of their full trajectory collections. We apply this approach to the radial, stationary, and cylindrical versions of the Hastings--Levitov$(0)$ aggregation model, proving path-Hausdorff convergence of the full harmonic measure path collections to the (Cylindrical) Brownian web, together with joint convergence of the full gap--finger collections to geometric embeddings of the corresponding double Brownian webs. This extends the radial HL$(0)$ small-particle limits of [Norris--Turner 2012, Commun. Math. Phys. 316, 809--841] for the harmonic measure flow and finite gap--finger collections. In the radial and cylindrical HL$(0)$, we also show that the rescaled one-arm domination time converges to a multiple of the global coalescence time of coalescing Brownian motion on $\mathbb T$, with convergence of expectations. The main new ingredient is a three-point survival estimate, proved via a multiscale stopping-time dec
items.authors: Guanyi Chen, Xinyi Li, Eviatar B. Procaccia, Yuxuan Zong
items.title_zh: 布朗网不变原理：局部扰动流和 Hastings-Levitov(0)
items.excerpt_zh: 我们建立了局域扰动流的布朗网不变原理，提供了加强弱流收敛的标准 [Norris--Turner 2015, Ann.很可能。 43, 935--970] 到其完整轨迹集合的路径豪斯多夫收敛。我们将此方法应用于 Hastings-Levitov$(0)$ 聚合模型的径向、静止和圆柱版本，证明全谐波测量路径集合到（圆柱）布朗网的路径豪斯多夫收敛性，以及全间隙指集合到相应双布朗网的几何嵌入的联合收敛性。这扩展了 [Norris--Turner 2012, Commun.] 的径向 HL$(0)$ 小颗粒极限。数学。物理。 316, 809--841] 用于谐波测量流程和有限间隙手指集合。在径向和圆柱 HL$(0)$ 中，我们还表明，重新调整后的单臂支配时间收敛到 $\mathbb T$ 上合并布朗运动的全局合并时间的倍数，并且与预期一致。主要的新成分是三点生存估计，通过多尺度停止时间dec证明

items.title: Approximating It\^o Processes in Adapted Wasserstein Distance with Finite Support Laws
items.excerpt: Motivated by finite-scenario surrogates in stopping and control problems, we study the approximation of It\^o diffusion laws by laws supported on $M$ paths in an adapted Wasserstein distance, which we term adapted functional quantization. Under the strict adapted Wasserstein distance, no finite-support approximation can achieve vanishing error, while even under its relaxed counterpart, naive empirical measures still fail to converge. To resolve this, we develop a recursive conditional sampling algorithm and derive constructive upper bounds on the adapted quantization error. In one dimension, this yields the Brownian rate $(\log M)^{-1/2}$ for every diffusion with continuous coefficients of linear growth and pathwise uniqueness. In several dimensions, a quantitative Osgood stability condition with exponent $\beta$ yields the rate $(\log M)^{-\eta_p}$, where $\eta_p=\min\{1/2,\beta/(\beta+4p-2)\}$. Without the Osgood condition, we construct a two-dimensional diffusion with smooth bounded coefficients whose adapted quantization error decays more slowly than $(\log M)^{-\gamma}$ for any $\gamma>0$.
items.title_zh: 用有限支持律逼近自适应 Wasserstein 距离中的过程
items.excerpt_zh: 受停止和控制问题中有限场景代理的启发，我们研究了适应 Wasserstein 距离中 $M$ 路径上支持的定律对 It\^o 扩散定律的近似，我们将其称为适应函数量化。在严格适应的 Wasserstein 距离下，任何有限支撑近似都无法实现误差消失，而即使在宽松的对应条件下，朴素的经验测量仍然无法收敛。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种递归条件采样算法，并推导出适应量化误差的建设性上限。在一维中，对于具有线性增长和路径唯一性连续系数的每个扩散，这会产生布朗率 $(\log M)^{-1/2}$。在多个维度上，指数 $\beta$ 的定量奥斯古德稳定性条件产生速率 $(\log M)^{-\eta_p}$，其中 $\eta_p=\min\{1/2,\beta/(\beta+4p-2)\}$。如果没有奥斯古德条件，我们构造一个具有平滑有界系数的二维扩散，对于任何 $\gamma>0$，其适应的量化误差衰减得比 $(\log M)^{-\gamma}$ 更慢。

items.title: Uniform spatial Schauder estimates for backward stochastic partial differential equations with random coefficients
items.excerpt: We prove spatial Schauder estimates for super-parabolic backward stochastic partial differential equations. All coefficients can be random and depend on time and space, and the estimates are uniform in probability and time. The key ingredient is a weighted conditional energy norm adapted to the parabolic scale of each frequency block. Together with heat-kernel bounds and coefficient freezing, it controls the gradient-martingale coupling without assuming a bounded martingale integrand. As an application, we establish Schauder solvability for semilinear stochastic Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equations.
items.authors: Yunzhang Li, Shanjian Tang, Yuyang Ye
items.title_zh: 具有随机系数的后向随机偏微分方程的均匀空间 Schauder 估计
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了超抛物型向后随机偏微分方程的空间 Schauder 估计。所有系数都可以是随机的并且取决于时间和空间，并且估计在概率和时间上是一致的。关键要素是适应每个频率块的抛物线尺度的加权条件能量范数。与热核界限和系数冻结一起，它可以控制梯度鞅耦合，而无需假设有界鞅被积函数。作为一个应用，我们建立了半线性随机 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman 方程的 Schauder 可解性。

items.title: Direct Element-Level Mass Matrix Inversion
items.excerpt: Explicit finite element methods for transient solid dynamics commonly use lumped mass matrices to avoid solving systems of equations for nodal accelerations at each time step. However, diagonal mass matrices may inadequately represent inertia, particularly for higher-order elements and coarse or distorted meshes. This has limited the use of higher-order elements in explicit dynamic analyses. This paper presents a systematic method for directly evaluating the inverse of non-diagonal element-level mass matrices for solid isoparametric elements of arbitrary interpolation order. The method applies to mixed mass matrices defined as linear combinations of lumped and consistent mass matrices, with a weighting parameter controlling the transition between diagonal, consistent, and intermediate formulations. It therefore provides a framework for incorporating non-diagonal mass formulations, including those for quadratic elements, into explicit finite element algorithms. The approach is demonstrated by deriving an explicit inverse formula for the mixed mass matrix of the eight-node hexahedral element. This formula enables efficient element-level
items.title_zh: 直接元素级质量矩阵反演
items.excerpt_zh: 瞬态固体动力学的显式有限元方法通常使用集中质量矩阵来避免求解每个时间步的节点加速度方程组。然而，对角质量矩阵可能不足以表示惯性，特别是对于高阶元素和粗糙或扭曲的网格。这限制了显式动态分析中高阶元素的使用。本文提出了一种直接评估任意插值阶固体等参单元的非对角单元级质量矩阵逆的系统方法。该方法适用于定义为集总质量矩阵和一致质量矩阵的线性组合的混合质量矩阵，其中加权参数控制对角公式、一致公式和中间公式之间的过渡。因此，它提供了一个框架，用于将非对角质量公式（包括二次元的公式）合并到显式有限元算法中。通过推导八节点六面体单元的混合质量矩阵的显式逆公式来演示该方法。该公式可实现高效的元素级

items.title: Forests of Omnitrees: Analysis and Applications to Anisotropic Space--Time Finite Elements
items.excerpt: We prove output-optimal work bounds for omnitree forests, which bisect cells along selected axes. A canonical descriptor characterizes representable partitions independently of split order. Complete one-level cycles, including coarsening, face balance and selected coarse meshes, take sequential work proportional to stored input and output at fixed dimension and key width, with polynomial depth dependence even for unbalanced input. From balanced input, refinement-only balance stays within each request's coordinate slab; this bound is attained. Polynomial trace equations characterize conforming high-order spaces across crossed face partitions. Reconstruction moments bound interpolation errors and capture the logarithmic loss that bilinear nodal interpolation can suffer on balanced meshes. Elements of degree up to four resolve moving heat layers on unstructured 4D space-time and 5D space-time-parameter meshes. Multigrid uses the generated hierarchies.
items.title_zh: 全树森林：各向异性时空有限元的分析与应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了全树森林的输出最优工作范围，它沿着选定的轴将单元一分为二。规范描述符描述了独立于分割顺序的可表示分区。完整的一级循环，包括粗化、面平衡和选定的粗网格，在固定维度和键宽度上采取与存储的输入和输出成比例的顺序工作，即使对于不平衡输入也具有多项式深度依赖性。从平衡输入来看，仅细化平衡保留在每个请求的坐标板内；达到了这个界限。多项式迹方程描述了跨交叉面分区的一致高阶空间。重建矩限制插值误差并捕获双线性节点插值在平衡网格上可能遭受的对数损失。最多四度的元素可解析非结构化 4D 时空和 5D 时空参数网格上的移动热层。多重网格使用生成的层次结构。

items.title: Beyond the error horizon: averaged quantile Kaczmarz methods for corrupted and noisy linear systems
items.excerpt: Linear systems and least-squares problems can contain measurement errors of different scales: a few measurements may be highly unreliable, while small noise affects every measurement. Residual-based iterative filtering can remove the influence of sparse corruption, but its accuracy is limited by a noise-dependent error horizon. We study how averaging and relaxation reduce this horizon in averaged quantile randomized Kaczmarz (AQRK), which filters equations by residual quantiles and averages a batch of single-row updates. Filtering, however, introduces an update bias that averaging alone cannot remove. We show that re-querying the accepted equations can remove this bias, and when the corruption is sparse enough relative to the conditioning of the matrix and large enough relative to the noise, we prove that AQRK with re-queried residuals reduces the horizon as averaging does without the corruption: its error decays to a horizon proportional to $\sqrt{\alpha/s}$, where $\alpha$ is the stepsize and $s$ the update batch size. Further, decreasing stepsizes or increasing batches gives convergence to the solution of the clean system. Numerica
items.title_zh: 超越误差范围：针对损坏和噪声线性系统的平均分位数 Kaczmarz 方法
items.excerpt_zh: 线性系统和最小二乘问题可能包含不同规模的测量误差：一些测量可能非常不可靠，而小噪声会影响每个测量。基于残差的迭代滤波可以消除稀疏损坏的影响，但其精度受到噪声相关误差范围的限制。我们研究了平均和松弛如何在平均分位数随机 Kaczmarz (AQRK) 中减少这一范围，该算法通过残差分位数过滤方程并对一批单行更新进行平均。然而，过滤引入了仅靠平均无法消除的更新偏差。我们证明，重新查询接受的方程可以消除这种偏差，并且当损坏相对于矩阵的条件足够稀疏并且相对于噪声足够大时，我们证明具有重新查询残差的 AQRK 会像没有损坏的情况下平均那样减少视野：其误差衰减到与 $\sqrt{\alpha/s}$ 成比例的视野，其中 $\alpha$ 是步长，$s$ 是更新批量大小。此外，减少步长或增加批次可以收敛到清洁系统的解决方案。数值

items.title: Convergence of discrete exterior calculus for the Hodge-Dirac and Hodge-Laplace problems on surfaces
items.excerpt: We prove that discrete exterior calculus converges for the Hodge-Dirac and Hodge-Laplace problems on every closed oriented Riemannian surface. The proof applies the error bounds of a companion paper on finite element exterior calculus. We prove and use that every closed oriented surface, with any metric, carries uniformly regular families of triangulations that are acute with a uniform margin.
items.title_zh: 曲面上 Hodge-Dirac 和 Hodge-Laplace 问题的离散外微积分的收敛性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了霍奇-狄拉克和霍奇-拉普拉斯问题的离散外微积分在每个闭向黎曼曲面上收敛。该证明应用了有限元外微积分配套论文的误差界限。我们证明并使用了每个封闭定向曲面，无论具有任何度量，都具有均匀规则的三角剖分族，这些三角剖分是锐角且边缘均匀的。

items.title: High-Order Regularization for Singular and Nearly Singular Laplace and Stokes Layer Potentials in Two Dimensions
items.excerpt: Layer potentials represent the solutions of many elliptic boundary value problems, but their kernels have the singularity of the fundamental solution, so standard quadrature loses accuracy at targets on or near the boundary. In two dimensions, Gaussian regularization of the logarithmic kernel gives a smooth kernel involving the exponential integral $E_1$, but for the single layer its regularization error is only first order in the smoothing radius $\delta$. We construct modified kernels for two-dimensional Laplace and Stokes single- and double-layer potentials that achieve regularization error $O(\delta^p)$, $p=3,5,7$, uniformly for targets on and near the curve. The resulting method is both high-order accurate and easy to implement: the integrals are evaluated directly by the periodic trapezoidal rule on a single fixed set of boundary nodes for all targets. Choosing $\delta=c h^q$ with $q<1$, where $h$ is the node spacing, keeps the discretization error smaller than the regularization error as $h\to0$, and numerical experiments confirm the predicted $O(h^{pq})$ convergence. Finally, we combine the near-curve evaluation with a fast Po
items.title_zh: 二维奇异和近似奇异拉普拉斯和斯托克斯层势的高阶正则化
items.excerpt_zh: 层势代表许多椭圆边值问题的解，但它们的核具有基本解的奇点，因此标准求积在边界上或边界附近的目标上会失去精度。在二维中，对数核的高斯正则化给出了涉及指数积分 $E_1$ 的平滑核，但对于单层，其正则化误差仅为平滑半径 $\delta$ 中的一阶。我们为二维拉普拉斯和斯托克斯单层和双层势构建了修改后的内核，以实现正则化误差 $O(\delta^p)$，$p=3,5,7$，对于曲线上和曲线附近的目标一致。由此产生的方法既高阶准确又易于实现：积分是通过所有目标的一组固定边界节点上的周期梯形规则直接评估的。选择 $\delta=c h^q$ 且 $q<1$，其中 $h$ 是节点间距，使离散化误差小于正则化误差 $h\to0$，并且数值实验证实了预测的 $O(h^{pq})$ 收敛。最后，我们将近曲线评估与快速 Po 结合起来

items.title: A nonlinear multigrid method for the preconditioned lattice Boltzmann equation
items.excerpt: This work developed a preconditioned lattice Boltzmann equation (PLBE) smoother for the residual-driven full approximation scheme (FAS) multigrid to accelerate steady-state LBE calculations. To overcome the deterioration of LBE smoothing at low viscosity, we used a two- relaxation-time (TRT) collision model together with characteristic-velocity and kinetic precondition- ing to keep the relaxation frequency for the even-order moments within a favorable range, while independently selecting the relaxation frequency for the odd-order moments to reduce their local amplification factor. We further investigated F-, W-, and hybrid V/W-cycles to address residual stagnation observed with V-cycles at high Reynolds numbers. The 2D lid-driven cavity flow was used as a test case. At Re = 5000, TRT-PLBE-FAS achieves an approximately 27-fold speedup over single-grid TRT-PLBE. At Re = 20000 on a 20482 grid, the hybrid V/W-cycle reduces solution time by 14% compared with the W-cycle.
items.title_zh: 预条件格子Boltzmann方程的非线性多重网格方法
items.excerpt_zh: 这项工作为残差驱动的完全逼近方案 (FAS) 多重网格开发了一种预条件格子玻尔兹曼方程 (PLBE) 平滑器，以加速稳态 LBE 计算。为了克服低粘度下LBE平滑的恶化问题，我们使用了两次弛豫时间（TRT）碰撞模型以及特征速度和动力学预处理，将偶阶矩的弛豫频率保持在有利的范围内，同时独立选择奇数阶矩的弛豫频率以降低其局部放大系数。我们进一步研究了 F 循环、W 循环和混合 V/W 循环，以解决在高雷诺数下 V 循环观察到的残余停滞问题。二维盖驱动腔流用作测试用例。在 Re = 5000 时，TRT-PLBE-FAS 比单网格 TRT-PLBE 实现约 27 倍的加速。在 20482 网格上 Re = 20000 时，与 W 循环相比，混合 V/W 循环将求解时间缩短了 14%。

items.title: Finite volume neural networks for singularly perturbed boundary value problems
items.excerpt: We develop a singular-layer enhanced Finite Volume Neural Network (sl-FVNN) methodology for solving singularly perturbed boundary value problems. The proposed framework combines flux-conserving finite volume residuals with analytically derived boundary layer correctors, enabling stable and efficient approximation of sharp boundary variations induced by small perturbation parameters. Numerical experiments over a broad range of small perturbation parameters ($10^{-4}$ to $10^{-12}$), demonstrate that the sl-FVNN yields uniformly accurate predicted solutions and significantly improved convergence behavior compared to conventional FVNN methods. Further comparisons with sl-PINNs from (Gie, Hong, Jung, Appl. Anal. 2024) show that our sl-FVNNs attain comparable accuracy for reaction--diffusion and Burgers equations, while achieving significantly improved convergence for convection-dominated nonlinear problems. These results highlight the effectiveness of incorporating asymptotic layer structures into finite volume based neural networks, offering a practical and scalable framework for multiscale PDE learning in stiff regimes.
items.title_zh: 用于奇异扰动边值问题的有限体积神经网络
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了一种单层增强有限体积神经网络（sl-FVNN）方法来解决奇异扰动边界值问题。所提出的框架将通量守恒的有限体积残差与分析得出的边界层校正器相结合，能够稳定且有效地近似由小扰动参数引起的急剧边界变化。在广泛的小扰动参数（$10^{-4}$ 到 $10^{-12}$）上进行的数值实验表明，与传统的 FVNN 方法相比，sl-FVNN 可以产生一致准确的预测解，并显着改善收敛行为。与 (Gie, Hong, Jung, Appl. Anal. 2024) 中的 sl-PINN 的进一步比较表明，我们的 sl-FVNN 在反应扩散和 Burgers 方程方面达到了相当的精度，同时在对流主导的非线性问题上实现了显着改进的收敛性。这些结果凸显了将渐近层结构纳入基于有限体积的神经网络的有效性，为刚性状态下的多尺度 PDE 学习提供了实用且可扩展的框架。

items.title: Residual-driven lattice Boltzmann equation. Part I: framework and nonlinear solution methods
items.excerpt: We developed a residual-driven framework of the lattice Boltzmann equation (LBE) to integrate general nonlinear iterative methods. The nonlinear residual is constructed directly from the complete LBE collision-streaming update, allowing general nonlinear solvers to be integrated without modifying the original LBE algorithmic structure, i.e., the kernel consisting of collision-streaming, boundary conditions, and various forcing and interaction effects. Sophisticated techniques, such as weighted fixed-point iteration, full approximation scheme (FAS) multigrid, and Jacobian-free Newton-Krylov methods are integrated into the LBE via this framework, and preconditioned LBE is further incorporated as a nonlinear smoother to demonstrate solver composability. Numerical tests validate that FAS and Newton methods do converge to the same discrete steady fixed-point obtained with the primitive LBE iteration. For the 2D lid-driven cavity flow, the FAS scheme reduces the measured solution time by a factor of approximately 44 at Re = 1000 and more than 224 at Re = 5000. Accurate results are also obtained for the steady flows past a cylinder at Re = 2
items.title_zh: 残差驱动的格子玻尔兹曼方程。第一部分：框架和非线性求解方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了格子玻尔兹曼方程 (LBE) 的残差驱动框架来集成通用非线性迭代方法。非线性残差直接从完整的LBE碰撞流更新构建，允许集成通用非线性求解器，而无需修改原始LBE算法结构，即由碰撞流、边界条件以及各种力和相互作用效应组成的内核。通过该框架将加权定点迭代、完全逼近方案 (FAS) 多重网格和无 Jacobian Newton-Krylov 方法等复杂技术集成到 LBE 中，并且将预处理的 LBE 进一步合并为非线性平滑器，以演示求解器的可组合性。数值测试验证了 FAS 和牛顿方法确实收敛到通过原始 LBE 迭代获得的相同离散稳定定点。对于 2D 盖驱动腔流，FAS 方案将测量求解时间在 Re = 1000 时减少了约 44 倍，在 Re = 5000 时减少了 224 倍以上。对于在 Re = 2 时流过圆柱体的稳定流也获得了准确的结果

items.title: Hilbert's Tenth problem and NP-completeness of Boolean Syllogistic with unordered cartesian product
items.excerpt: We relate the decidability problem for BS with unordered cartesian product with Hilbert's Tenth problem and prove that BS with unordered cartesian product is NP-complete.
items.title_zh: 希尔伯特第十个问题和具有无序笛卡尔积的布尔三段论的 NP 完备性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将带有无序笛卡尔积的BS的可判定性问题与希尔伯特第十问题联系起来，并证明带有无序笛卡尔积的BS是NP完全的。

items.title: Cohomological VC-density: Bounds and Applications
items.excerpt: The concept of Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) density is pivotal across various mathematical fields, including discrete geometry, probability theory and model theory. In this paper, we introduce a topological generalization of VC-density. Let $Y$ be a topological space and $\mathcal{X}$ a family of closed subspaces of $Y$. For each $p \geq 0$, we define a number, $\mathrm{vcd}^{p}_{\mathcal{X}}$, which we refer to as the degree $p$ VC-density of the family $\mathcal{X}$. The classical notion of VC-density within this topological framework can be recovered by setting $p=0$. Our definition of degree $p$ VC-density extends to higher orders as well. For $p \geq 0$, $q \geq 1$, we define the degree $p$, order $q$ VC density $\mathrm{vcd}^{p,q}_{\mathcal{X}}$ of $\mathcal{X}$, which recovers Shelah's notion of higher order VC-density for $q$-dependent families when $p=0$. Our definition introduces a completely new notion when $p > 0$. items.title_zh: 上同调 VC 密度：界限和应用
items.excerpt_zh: Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) 密度的概念在各个数学领域都至关重要，包括离散几何、概率论和模型论。在本文中，我们介绍了 VC 密度的拓扑推广。设$Y$为拓扑空间，$\mathcal{X}$为$Y$的闭子空间族。对于每个$p \geq 0$，我们定义一个数字$\mathrm{vcd}^{p}_{\mathcal{X}}$，我们将其称为$\mathcal{X}$族的$p$ VC密度。通过设置 $p=0$ 可以恢复该拓扑框架内 VC 密度的经典概念。我们对$p$ VC密度的定义也扩展到更高的阶次。对于$p \geq 0$、$q \geq 1$，我们定义$\mathcal{X}$的度$p$、阶$q$ VC密度$\mathrm{vcd}^{p,q}_{\mathcal{X}}$，这恢复了当$p=0$时$q$依赖族的Shelah的高阶VC密度概念。当 $p > 0$ 时，我们的定义引入了一个全新的概念。当族 $\mathcal{X}$ 在具有某些基础拓扑的结构中可定义时（例如

items.title: On $(\Sigma^2_1)^{uB}$ Absoluteness Between V and HOD
items.excerpt: We put together Woodin's $\Sigma^2_1$ basis theorem of AD$^+$ and Vop\v{e}nka's theorem to conclude the following: If there is a proper class of Woodin cardinals, then every $(\Sigma^2_1)^{\mbox{uB}}$ statement that is true in $V$ is true in $\mbox{HOD}$. Moreover, this is true even if we allow a parameter $C \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ such that $C$ and its complement have scales that are $\mbox{OD}$ and universally Baire. We also investigate whether $(\Sigma^2_1)^{\mbox{uB}}$ statements are upwards absolute from $\mbox{HOD}$ to $V$ under large cardinal hypotheses, observing that this is true if $\mbox{HOD}$ has a proper class of Woodin cardinals. Finally, we discuss $(\forall^{\mathbb{R}})\, (\Sigma^2_1)^{\mbox{uB}}$ absoluteness and conclude that this much absoluteness between $\mbox{HOD}$ and $V$ cannot be implied by any large cardinal axiom consistent with the axiom ``$V =$ Ultimate $L$''.
items.title_zh: 关于V和HOD之间的$(\Sigma^2_1)^{uB}$绝对性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将 AD$^+$ 的 Woodin 的 $\Sigma^2_1$ 基本定理和 Vop\v{e}nka 定理放在一起得出以下结论：如果存在 Woodin 基数的真类，则每个在 $V$ 中为真的 $(\Sigma^2_1)^{\mbox{uB}}$ 陈述在 $\mbox{HOD}$ 中也为真。此外，即使我们允许参数 $C \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ 使得 $C$ 及其补码的尺度为 $\mbox{OD}$ 且普遍为 Baire，情况也是如此。我们还研究了在大基数假设下 $(\Sigma^2_1)^{\mbox{uB}}$ 陈述是否是从 $\mbox{HOD}$ 到 $V$ 向上绝对的，观察到如果 $\mbox{HOD}$ 具有适当的伍丁基数类，则这是正确的。最后，我们讨论 $(\forall^{\mathbb{R}})\, (\Sigma^2_1)^{\mbox{uB}}$ 绝对性，并得出结论，$\mbox{HOD}$ 和 $V$ 之间的绝对性不能用任何与公理“$V =$ Ultimate $L$”一致的大基数公理来暗示。

items.title: A Dubnov-Ivanov-Nagata-Higman Theorem for NIP nilrings
items.excerpt: We prove that NIP nilrings of bounded nilexponent are nilpotent. We also deduce that NIP $\omega$-categorical $n$-Engel Lie algebras of characteristic $p>n$ are nilpotent, yielding a case of the Lie algebra analogous of Wilson conjecture for $\omega$-categorical groups.
items.authors: Christian d'Elb\'ee, Yanis Davoust, Jules Tindzogho Ntsiri
items.title_zh: NIP尼尔环的Dubnov-Ivanov-Nagata-Higman定理
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明有界 niexponent 的 NIP nirings 是幂零的。我们还推导出特征 $p>n$ 的 NIP $\omega$-分类 $n$-Engel 李代数是幂零的，产生类似于 $\omega$-分类群的威尔逊猜想的李代数的情况。

items.title: On non-isomorphic universal sofic groups
items.excerpt: We show that there are $2^{\aleph_0}$ non-isomorphic universal sofic groups. This proves a conjecture of Simon Thomas.
items.title_zh: 关于非同构通用 sofic 群
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明存在 $2^{\aleph_0}$ 个非同构通用 sofic 群。这证明了西蒙·托马斯的猜想。

items.title: Maximality of the Do\v{s}en-Petri\'{c} Boolean Category
items.excerpt: We prove that the zero-identity Boolean category of Do\v{s}en and Petri\'c, freely generated by a nonempty set of propositional variables, is maximal. Every congruence preserved by the operations on morphisms and by uniform formula substitution either is equality or identifies every pair of parallel morphisms. This disproves their conjecture that the category is not maximal. We give two proofs that use Boolean Coherence and uniform formula substitution to derive equality of the product projections from an identification of distinct parallel morphisms. We also give a Lean formalization of these proofs and their dependencies. It includes Boolean Coherence and the correspondence between substitution on tagged occurrence sets and substitution on finite ordinals.
items.title_zh: Do\v{s}en-Petri\'{c} 布尔范畴的极大性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明由一组非空命题变量自由生成的 Do\v{s}en 和 Petri\'c 的零同一性布尔范畴是最大的。态射运算和统一公式替换所保留的每个同余要么是相等的，要么标识每对平行态射。这反驳了他们关于范畴不是极大的猜想。我们给出了两个证明，使用布尔相干性和统一公式替换，从不同平行态射的识别中推导出乘积投影的相等性。我们还对这些证明及其依赖关系进行了精益形式化。它包括布尔一致性以及标记出现集的替换和有限序数的替换之间的对应关系。

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Controllability Can Reduce Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
items.excerpt: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents. One risk is that models could deliberately shape their reasoning to make it opaque to monitors. We stress-test this risk through persona-control training: supervised fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning traces rewritten in the voices of diverse personas. This induces a broader ability to control CoT, even though training contains no monitor-evasion examples. In covert side-task evaluations, traces in which a gpt-oss-20b model organism completes the hidden side task contain less monitorable evidence than the base model's. Averaged across evaluations and CoT lengths, weighted by side-task-success counts, the CoT monitorability metric g-mean$^2$ falls from 0.94 for the base model to 0.68 for the model organism without a hiding instruction, and to 0.22 when explicitly instructed to hide. In intervention evaluations, explicit hiding often drives monitorability near zero. The effect extends to a Kimi-K2.6 model organism in agentic environments, though hidden objectives requiring extended reasoning or longer
items.authors: Zheng-Xin Yong, Benjamin Arnav, Miles Wang, Tomek Korbak, Olivia Watkins
items.title_zh: 思想链可控性会降低思想链可监控性
items.excerpt_zh: 思想链 (CoT) 监控是一种很有前景的工具，可用于检测人工智能代理中的隐藏目标、脱任务行为和其他故障。一个风险是模型可能会故意塑造他们的推理，使其对监视器来说不透明。我们通过角色控制训练对这种风险进行压力测试：对用不同角色的声音重写的数学推理轨迹进行监督微调。即使训练不包含监控规避示例，这也会带来更广泛的控制 CoT 的能力。在隐蔽副任务评估中，gpt-oss-20b 模型生物体完成隐藏副任务的痕迹包含的可监控证据少于基本模型的证据。对评估和 CoT 长度进行平均，并按副任务成功计数进行加权，CoT 可监控性指标 g-mean$^2$ 从基础模型的 0.94 下降到没有隐藏指令的模型生物体的 0.68，并在明确指示隐藏时下降到 0.22。在干预评估中，显式隐藏通常会使可监控性接近于零。该效果延伸到代理环境中的 Kimi-K2.6 模型生物体，尽管隐藏的目标需要扩展推理或更长时间

items.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
items.excerpt: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. We ask whether a model can rewrite its own weights to make itself better, and find that it can, by its own reasoning, with no gradients and no training; we call this self-rewriting. Given its weights, graded answers and the ability to run itself, a 27B model diagnoses its failure and edits the weights behind it. It surpasses itself: its own edit makes it 6.6 points more accurate on 490 problems it never saw, in a test fixed in advance, and another session's edit also makes it significantly better. It keeps getting better: it submits an edit only when its own tests support it, each edit replacing the last, and over its first eight such sessions its accuracy only rises. Unlike test-time scaling, the gain persists in its weights and adds no cost per answer; unlike training, it needs no pre- or post-training infrastructure, only an open model and hours on one GPU. items.authors: Jiajun Fan, Neil He, Changyi Yang, Andy Mao, Xi Zhu, Chaoran Cheng, Kaiqu Liang, Shuaike Shen, Zetian Li, Ruihan Guo, Ge Liu
items.title_zh: 语言模型可以重写自己的权重
items.excerpt_zh: 语言模型训练一次，冻结并部署：再次改进一个模型需要另一次训练，一旦任务结束，推理时的提示、支架或额外计算就会消失。前沿模型已被证明可以编辑一个小得多的模型的权重。我们询问一个模型是否可以重写自己的权重以使自己变得更好，并发现它可以通过自己的推理，无需梯度，无需训练；我们称之为自重写。考虑到其权重、分级答案和自行运行的能力，27B 模型会诊断其故障并编辑其背后的权重。它超越了自己：在预先修复的测试中，它自己的编辑使其在 490 个从未见过的问题上准确度提高了 6.6 分，而另一个会话的编辑也使其明显更好。它不断变得更好：只有当它自己的测试支持它时，它才会提交编辑，每次编辑都会替换最后一次，并且在前八次这样的会话中，它的准确性只会上升。与测试时间缩放不同，增益持续存在于其权重中，并且不会增加每个答案的成本；与训练不同，它不需要训练前或训练后的基础设施，只需要一个开放模型和一个 GPU 上的时间。它修复了d

items.title: Conserved Verdicts, Drifting Commitments: Identifying Harmful Overthinking
items.excerpt: A reasoning model that has reached a correct answer can lose it by continuing to think. Deciding whether to stop means comparing two probabilities at the same point of a chain: that the answer the model would give if stopped now is correct (its commitment), and that the answer it will finish with is correct (its verdict). We show that the verdict alone, which is what final-correctness probes estimate, cannot make this comparison. As a forecast of a fixed outcome it has no predictable drift, whether continuing helps or hurts. The commitment-verdict gap equals the expected remaining change in answer quality and the accuracy gained by stopping. A second identity splits any accuracy-versus-budget curve into answer change within chains and change in which chains are still running. We measure both on MATH-500. At all 379 points where DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B holds a correct answer, selected without regard to how its chain ends, continuing loses 3.6 points on average (95% CI [2.2, 5.2]), and the loss concentrates in a few problems. In six reasoning models from three families, on MATH-500 and OlympiadBench and with budgets up to 16,384
items.authors: Jianghong Zhou, Hao Rong, Chen Lin
items.title_zh: 保守的判决，漂移的承诺：识别有害的过度思考
items.excerpt_zh: 已经得出正确答案的推理模型可能会因为继续思考而失去正确答案。决定是否停止意味着比较链上同一点的两个概率：如果现在停止，模型给出的答案是正确的（其承诺），并且它将完成的答案是正确的（其结论）。我们表明，仅靠最终正确性探测器估计的判决无法进行这种比较。作为对固定结果的预测，它没有可预测的漂移，无论持续是有利还是有害。承诺与结论的差距等于答案质量的预期剩余变化和通过停止获得的准确性。第二个恒等式将任何准确性与预算曲线分成链内的答案变化和仍在运行的链的变化。我们在 MATH-500 上对两者进行测量。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 拥有正确答案的所有 379 个点中，选择时不考虑其链如何结束，持续平均损失 3.6 个点（95% CI [2.2, 5.2]），并且损失集中在几个问题上。来自三个系列的六个推理模型，在 MATH-500 和 OlympiadBench 上，预算高达 16,384

items.title: From Sorry to QED: Refining LLM Math Proofs via Angelic Execution
items.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) can now generate Lean proof scripts that capture the high-level structure of many mathematical arguments. However, these scripts frequently fail on complex theorems: a single missing side condition or misapplied lemma can cause the prover to abort early and discard an otherwise viable proof outline. This paper presents MathEye, a framework that converts imperfect LLM-generated proof scripts into fully verified Lean proofs by combining symbolic reasoning with minimal human interaction. At the core of MathEye is angelic proof checking, an optimistic execution model that replaces failing proof fragments with placeholders while preserving the overall structure of the argument. This optimistic check produces an angelic proof that isolates the exact proof obligations that the LLM fails to discharge. Because these unresolved obligations are often logically interdependent, asking a mathematician to address every placeholder directly is inefficient. To minimize human effort, MathEye performs residual analysis over a proof dependence graph that captures symbol-level data flow in the angelic proof. By formulating obl
items.authors: Yanju Chen, Hanzhi Liu, Ruizhe Qian, Jiaming Shan, Xu Yang, Yufei Ding, Osbert Bastani, Yu Feng
items.title_zh: 从抱歉到 QED：通过 Angelic Execution 完善 LLM 数学证明
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 现在可以生成精益证明脚本，捕获许多数学论证的高级结构。然而，这些脚本经常在复杂的定理上失败：单个缺失的附加条件或误用的引理可能会导致证明者提前中止并放弃其他可行的证明大纲。本文介绍了 MathEye，这是一个框架，通过将符号推理与最少的人类交互相结合，将不完美的 LLM 生成的证明脚本转换为经过充分验证的精益证明。 MathEye 的核心是天使证明检查，这是一种乐观的执行模型，用占位符替换失败的证明片段，同时保留论证的整体结构。这种乐观的检查产生了天使般的证明，隔离了法学硕士未能履行的确切证明义务。由于这些未解决的义务在逻辑上通常是相互依赖的，因此要求数学家直接解决每个占位符的效率很低。为了最大限度地减少人力，MathEye 对证明依赖图执行残差分析，捕获天使证明中的符号级数据流。通过制定obl

items.title: MCTS Is Counting the Wrong Thing: Learning Exploration Counts for LLM Reasoning
items.excerpt: Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) has powered landmark successes in reinforcement learning, yet its gains in LLM reasoning can remain modest despite substantial search effort. We identify an overlooked bottleneck: what MCTS counts. Standard UCT assigns independent visit counts to textual branches, allowing different formulations of the same reasoning strategy to repeatedly receive exploration bonuses. Our theoretical analysis shows that this count fragmentation can impair exploration efficiency, as quantified by increased cumulative regret. To address this problem, we introduce Learned Pseudo-Count MCTS (LPC-MCTS), which changes only the exploration statistic in UCT. A lightweight Coin-Flipping Network head on the policy's hidden representations estimates representation coverage, enabling related branches to share exploration evidence. Across 5 mathematical-reasoning and 7 search benchmarks, LPC-MCTS consistently outperforms strong MCTS baselines. Holding each LPC-MCTS-trained policy fixed, replacing standard MCTS counts at inference improves average mean@16 accuracy across 5 mathematical benchmarks by 3.79 percentage points on Qwen2.5-7
items.authors: Xuan Zhang, Zhijian Zhou, Zicheng Hu, Yan Feng, Hongyan Hao, Yuan Qi, Chao Qu
items.title_zh: MCTS 计算错误：学习探索对 LLM 推理很重要
items.excerpt_zh: 蒙特卡罗树搜索（MCTS）在强化学习领域取得了里程碑式的成功，但尽管付出了巨大的搜索努力，它在法学硕士推理方面的进展仍然有限。我们发现了一个被忽视的瓶颈：MCTS 的重要性。标准 UCT 将独立的访问计数分配给文本分支，允许同一推理策略的不同表述重复获得探索奖励。我们的理论分析表明，这种计数碎片会损害探索效率，这可以通过累积遗憾的增加来量化。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了学习伪计数MCTS（LPC-MCTS），它仅改变UCT中的探索统计量。策略隐藏表示的轻量级硬币翻转网络负责估计表示覆盖范围，使相关分支能够共享探索证据。在 5 个数学推理和 7 个搜索基准中，LPC-MCTS 始终优于强大的 MCTS 基准。固定每个 LPC-MCTS 训练的策略，在推理时替换标准 MCTS 计数，在 Qwen2.5-7 上将 5 个数学基准的平均 Mean@16 准确度提高了 3.79 个百分点

items.title: Symbolic Abstraction Refinement
items.excerpt: Autonomous systems choose actions whose outcomes are uncertain and are subject to time constraints. Probabilistic timed automata (PTAs) model exactly this, and verifying one answers a question about the system's decision-making: the maximum probability of reaching a goal, or the minimum probability of reaching a hazard, that a controller can guarantee. Verification normally works over symbolic states, each pairing a discrete location with a region of clock values, and its difficulty is that the best behavior generally varies within such a region. The PRISM verifier's most capable PTA method responds by splitting regions until each is uniform, rebuilding the transitions that reach them and propagating the split backward through the state graph of a stochastic game, a cascade of graph reconstruction that partitions regions the property never depends on. We present SYMAR, which instead makes the value function symbolic: each symbolic state carries a function from sub-regions of its clock region to probability bounds, so refinement is the appearance of new sub-regions in that function, and previously generated states are never split nor t
items.authors: Daniel Bryce (Smart Information Flow Technologies, LLC), Robert P. Goldman (Smart Information Flow Technologies, LLC), David J. Musliner (Smart Information Flow Technologies, LLC), Jeremy Gottlieb (Smart Information Flow Technologies, LLC), John Skovbekk (Smart Information Flow Technologies, LLC)
items.title_zh: 符号抽象细化
items.excerpt_zh: 自治系统选择的行动的结果是不确定的并且受到时间限制。概率定时自动机 (PTA) 正是对此进行建模，并验证一个关于系统决策的问题的答案：控制器可以保证达到目标的最大概率，或达到危险的最小概率。验证通常在符号状态上进行，每个符号状态将一个离散位置与一个时钟值区域配对，其困难在于最佳行为通常在该区域内变化。 PRISM 验证器最强大的 PTA 方法通过分割区域直到每个区域一致、重建到达它们的转换并通过随机博弈的状态图向后传播分割来响应，这是一个级联的图重建，用于划分属性从不依赖的区域。我们提出了 SYMAR，它使价值函数符号化：每个符号状态都承载从其时钟区域的子区域到概率边界的函数，因此细化是该函数中新子区域的出现，并且先前生成的状态永远不会分裂也不会发生变化。

items.title: EvoSkill-S1: Evolving Reusable Skills with Genetic-Inspired Operators
items.excerpt: Reusable skills allow language-model agents to accumulate and reuse problem-solving experience. However, most existing methods improve a skill bank only indirectly through rollout-driven accumulation and heuristic reflection, often resulting in shallow and weakly controlled updates. We present EvoSkill-S1, an RL-driven framework that instead treats reusable skills themselves as the direct objects of evolution. Given hard-negative failures, EvoSkill-S1 selects parent skills and transforms them into candidate child skills through five genetic-inspired operators: revision, cross-revision, mutation, dual-reflection, and crossover. Downstream task rewards train the skill evolver to generate more effective child skills, while evaluator-guided write-back selectively retains beneficial updates. Complementary Skill Bank Fusion consolidates operator-specific banks to exploit their distinct recovery patterns, while a Procedural Skill Interface supports transfer to unseen problems. Across all reported math and code benchmarks, EvoSkill-S1 improves the corresponding initialized skill banks under both Qwen and GPT-family solvers, with relative gain
items.authors: Yujun Wang, Jiqiang Li, Yinuo Lu, Jinhe Bi, Aniri, Wenxuan Ye, Boliang Liu, Sikuan Yan, Shuning Wang, Xuebing Zhou, S{\"o}ren Pirk, Hinrich Sch{\"u}tze, Yunpu Ma
items.title_zh: EvoSkill-S1：利用受遗传启发的操作员发展可重用技能
items.excerpt_zh: 可重用的技能允许语言模型代理积累和重用解决问题的经验。然而，大多数现有方法只是通过推出驱动的积累和启发式反思来间接改进技能库，通常会导致浅层和弱控制的更新。我们提出了 EvoSkill-S1，这是一个 RL 驱动的框架，它将可重用技能本身视为进化的直接对象。考虑到硬阴性失败，EvoSkill-S1 选择父技能，并通过五个受遗传启发的运算符将其转换为候选子技能：修订、交叉修订、突变、双重反射和交叉。下游任务奖励训练技能发展者产生更有效的儿童技能，而评估者引导的回写选择性地保留有益的更新。补充技能库融合整合了运营商特定的银行，以利用其独特的恢复模式，而程序技能界面则支持转移到未见的问题。在所有报告的数学和代码基准中，EvoSkill-S1 改进了 Qwen 和 GPT 系列求解器下相应的初始化技能库，并具有相对增益

items.title: A Full-Ledger Counterfactual Audit of Adaptive Reasoning
items.excerpt: Adaptive reasoning must decide whether to answer now or spend more compute. Predicting that the current answer is wrong does not establish whether further reasoning will improve it. We introduce the Full-Ledger Counterfactual Value Audit (FLCVA), which compares an immediate answer with four fixed-length continuations from the same frozen prefix under one answer procedure and accounts for the cost of every signal used by a policy. On GSM8K and MATH-500, a random 256-token continuation recovers a wrong answer in 26.6% of Qwen3-8B cases and 18.9% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B cases, while damaging a correct answer in 1.4% and 1.9%. Correctness labels from independently sampled continuations predict a separate continuation's outcome in both primary models. In offline replay, using these labels to allocate compute improves performance on DeepSeek; the Qwen3 gain remains inconclusive. Under full cost accounting, the tested lightweight, myopic controllers mainly recognize current errors and add little continuation-specific value beyond that shortcut. A Llama-8B replication and action/cost ablations examine the robustness of these findings
items.authors: Xiaopeng Chu, Wenzheng Kong, Wei Liu, Wenyi Zhang
items.title_zh: 自适应推理的全账本反事实审计
items.excerpt_zh: 自适应推理必须决定是立即回答还是花费更多计算。预测当前答案是错误的并不能确定进一步的推理是否会改善它。我们引入了全账本反事实价值审计（FLCVA），它将立即答案与一个答案程序下来自同一冻结前缀的四个固定长度延续进行比较，并考虑策略使用的每个信号的成本。在 GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上，随机 256 个令牌延续在 26.6% 的 Qwen3-8B 案例和 18.9% 的 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 案例中恢复了错误答案，同时损坏了 1.4% 和 1.9% 的正确答案。来自独立采样延续的正确性标签预测两个主要模型中单独延续的结果。在离线重放中，使用这些标签来分配计算可以提高 DeepSeek 的性能； Qwen3 的增益仍不确定。在完全成本核算下，经过测试的轻量级、短视控制器主要识别当前错误，并且除了该捷径之外几乎没有增加特定于延续的价值。 Llama-8B 复制和行动/成本消融检验了这些发现的稳健性

items.title: Regularized Score Centering
items.excerpt: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. items.authors: Hao Bai, Chenlu Ye, Xuanchang Zhang, Aviral Kumar, Tong Zhang
items.title_zh: 正则化分数居中
items.excerpt_zh: 异步强化学习提高了训练吞吐量，但来自陈旧策略的数据以及训练和推理之间的数值不匹配可能会破坏学习的稳定性。为了稳定离策略学习，分数中心（SC）消除了奖励基线对预期更新的影响。我们的梯度诊断显示，SC 的极端梯度比重要性采样 (IS) 的梯度要小，但当学习者远离生成数据的行为策略时，SC 仍然会失败。为了限制这种策略不匹配，我们引入了正则化分数中心（RSC），它添加了反向 Kullback-Leibler（KL）惩罚，以鼓励学习者的下一个令牌分布保持接近行为策略的下一个令牌分布。 RSC 在使用或不使用截断重要性采样 (TIS) 的情况下均可工作，该采样限制了令牌重要性权重。我们的理论分析支持这种方法，表明 KL 正则化提高了收敛保证。我们评估数学推理和代理任务的密集和混合专家模型，包括在线购物、工具使用、游戏和完全异步软件工程。 RSC 与 TIS 实质

items.title: The Hidden Cost of MoE Diffusion Decoding: Profiling and Fixing the Sampler
items.excerpt: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Unlike autoregressive decoding, where sampling touches one position's logits per committed token, diffusion decoding processes S times as many logit entries per output token, where S is the number of denoising steps. We show this pipeline is largely redundant or fusable and remove it in two lossless tiers: a bit-exact tier whose output is byte-identical to the reference decoder, and an accuracy-parity tier using a fused single-pass entropy kernel and Gumbel-max sampling. Combined with a W4A16 expert kernel, the full stack reaches 2.4-2.7 times end-to-end speedup over bf16 at unchanged benchmark accuracy on GSM8K, HumanEval,
items.title_zh: MoE 扩散解码的隐藏成本：分析和修复采样器
items.excerpt_zh: 掩码扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 通过迭代地对整个标记画布进行去噪来进行解码，因此每次前向传递都会在整个画布上逐个词汇的 logits 张量上运行每个标记采样和停止管道。我们在带宽限制边缘加速器 (NVIDIA GB10) 上对 26B 参数扩散专家混合模型的单用户解码进行了分析，并报告了一个很容易被忽略的结果：在权重量化之后，这个 Logits 管道（而不是专家 GEMM）是解码时间的最大消耗者。与自回归解码不同，自回归解码中采样涉及每个提交令牌的一个位置的 logit，扩散解码处理每个输出令牌的 S 倍 logit 条目，其中 S 是去噪步骤的数量。我们证明这个管道很大程度上是冗余的或可融合的，并在两个无损层中删除它：一个比特精确层，其输出与参考解码器的字节相同，以及一个使用融合单通道熵内核和 Gumbel-max 采样的精度奇偶校验层。与 W4A16 专家内核相结合，整个堆栈在 GSM8K、HumanEval、

items.title: A Temporal Algebraic Framework for Data Stream Evaluation Under Delayed Labels and Distribution Shifts
items.excerpt: In data streams, labels often arrive late or only for some instances, class prevalence drifts, and rare classes vanish from short windows. Standard evaluation then confuses a degraded decision boundary with a change in prevalence, and is biased when labels are delayed or selected by the model. We extend an algebraic framework that obtains pooled (micro) and per-class (macro) measures from one confusion matrix to streams, weighting the counts in time by exponential fading or a sliding window; the update costs O(m^2) per step, whatever the stream length, and each pooled measure stays a weighted combination of the per-class ones. Delayed and selective feedback enter as an observation mask: until its label arrives, an instance is counted with the model's calibrated class probabilities, and the bias of this interim estimate is driven by their calibration error. Audited conventions report no value for a class without verified instances. We separate prior shift from concept drift by monitoring prior-free coordinates (recall and specificity) and attribute a change in a measure to the two sources with a first-order Jacobian decomposition.
