items.authors: Ronaldo C. Prati, Elaine Ribeiro de Faria
items.title_zh: 延迟标签和分布变化下数据流评估的时态代数框架
items.excerpt_zh: 在数据流中，标签通常会延迟到达或仅在某些情况下到达，类流行度漂移，并且稀有类会从短窗口中消失。然后，标准评估将退化的决策边界与患病率的变化混淆，并且当模型延迟或选择标签时，标准评估会产生偏差。我们扩展了一个代数框架，该框架获得从一个混淆矩阵到流的池化（微观）和每类（宏观）测量，通过指数衰落或滑动窗口及时对计数进行加权；无论流长度如何，每步的更新成本为 O(m^2)，并且每个池化度量保持每类度量的加权组合。延迟和选择性反馈作为观察掩模输入：在其标签到达之前，将使用模型的校准类概率对实例进行计数，并且此临时估计的偏差由其校准误差驱动。经过审计的约定报告没有经过验证的实例的类没有任何价值。我们通过监控先验自由坐标（召回率和特异性）将先验偏移与概念漂移分开，并使用一阶雅可比分解将度量的变化归因于两个源。昂斯

items.title: Physics-informed neural networks for spacecraft trajectory optimization with exact boundary conditions
items.excerpt: We use neural networks to optimize trajectories by modeling the position as a function of time and minimizing the thrust with respect to the network parameters. This corresponds to an unsupervised training procedure in which physical laws are incorporated directly into the optimization objective. In standard physics-informed neural networks, initial and terminal states are enforced through additional weighted loss terms, resulting in a multi-objective optimization problem that is highly sensitive to the choice of loss weights and can lead to poor convergence and reduced accuracy. To address this challenge, we construct a simple transformation, exploiting the mathematical structure of trajectory optimization problems, to enforce boundary conditions exactly a-priori. This transformation can be interpreted as a reparameterization of the solution space that embeds the boundary conditions directly into the function. This converts the original constrained optimization problem into an unconstrained one over admissible trajectories. I.e. the transformation eliminates the boundary condition penalty terms and reduces the problem to a single-obj
items.authors: Samuel Sch\"onherr, G\"unther Waxenegger-Wilfing, Sascha Ranftl
items.title_zh: 用于具有精确边界条件的航天器轨迹优化的物理信息神经网络
items.excerpt_zh: 我们使用神经网络通过将位置建模为时间函数并最小化网络参数的推力来优化轨迹。这对应于无监督训练过程，其中物理定律直接纳入优化目标。在标准的基于物理的神经网络中，初始状态和最终状态是通过附加的加权损失项强制执行的，从而导致多目标优化问题，该问题对损失权重的选择高度敏感，并可能导致收敛性差和精度降低。为了应对这一挑战，我们构建了一个简单的变换，利用轨迹优化问题的数学结构，精确地先验地强制执行边界条件。这种转换可以解释为解空间的重新参数化，将边界条件直接嵌入到函数中。这将原始的约束优化问题转换为可接受轨迹上的无约束优化问题。 IE。该变换消除了边界条件惩罚项并将问题简化为单个对象

items.title: A Log-Timescale Perturbation Bound for Selective State Space Models at Every Sequence Length
items.excerpt: Mamba models deployed on streaming data, such as limit order book updates, run far past the sequence lengths they were trained on. A guarantee on how much a small change of input can move the hidden state therefore has to hold at every length. The closest existing bound we know of measures the change of the timescale additively, and it grows linearly with the sequence length unless the timescale is bounded away from zero. In this paper, we measure the change on a log scale instead. The key observation is that the decay factor of each step then moves by at most a fixed fraction of that step's input weight, so the per-step errors cannot pile up. Using this, we prove that two runs of a selective-scan cell from a common start stay within a bound that holds at every length, shrinks to zero with the size of the change and needs no lower bound on the timescale. We give a construction showing that, for small changes, this bound is within a factor of about 2 of the best possible, and we extend it to the update used in Mamba's released code when the timescale is bounded above. We then evaluate block-level bounds built from the theorem on two sm
items.title_zh: 每个序列长度的选择性状态空间模型的对数时标扰动界
items.excerpt_zh: 部署在流数据（例如限价订单簿更新）上的 Mamba 模型的运行远远超过了它们训练时的序列长度。因此，必须保证输入的微小变化可以使隐藏状态移动多少。我们知道的最接近的现有界限测量时间尺度的加法变化，并且它随着序列长度线性增长，除非时间尺度远离零。在本文中，我们用对数尺度来衡量变化。关键的观察结果是，每个步骤的衰减因子最多移动该步骤输入权重的固定分数，因此每个步骤的误差不会堆积。利用这一点，我们证明了选择性扫描单元从共同开始的两次运行都保持在每个长度都保持的范围内，随着变化的大小缩小到零，并且不需要时间尺度的下限。我们给出的结构表明，对于小的更改，此界限在最佳可能值的大约 2 倍之内，并且当时间尺度在上述界限内时，我们将其扩展到 Mamba 发布的代码中使用的更新。然后，我们评估根据两个 sm 上的定理构建的块级边界

items.title: BernBRS: Certified Backward Reachability for Deep Bernstein Neural Networks
items.excerpt: Ensuring the safety of complex neural network systems requires mathematically rigorous verification. While backward reachability analysis is a critical tool for identifying safe initial states, computing tight, formal bounds remains notoriously difficult to scale. Recent advancements have demonstrated that DeepBern-Nets neural networks utilizing Bernstein polynomial activation functions possess advantageous mathematical properties that enable exceptionally fast and tight forward reachability analysis. Building upon this efficiency, this paper introduces BernBRS, a highly accurate and scalable framework for the backward reachability analysis of DeepBern-Nets. BernBRS simultaneously computes certified inner and outer approximations of the Backward Reachable Set (BRS). Rather than relying on single convex bounding, our method intelligently refines a cover of the input space by analyzing activation patterns, splitting the input domain precisely where an exact decomposition of the relaxation gap predicts the most significant reduction in error. This targeted refinement enables high levels of scalability to highly complex and massive archit
items.title_zh: BernBRS：深度 Bernstein 神经网络的向后可达性认证
items.excerpt_zh: 确保复杂神经网络系统的安全需要严格的数学验证。虽然向后可达性分析是识别安全初始状态的关键工具，但计算严格的形式边界仍然难以扩展。最近的进展表明，利用 Bernstein 多项式激活函数的 DeepBern-Nets 神经网络具有有利的数学特性，可以实现异常快速和严格的前向可达性分析。基于这种效率，本文引入了 BernBRS，这是一种用于 DeepBern-Nets 后向可达性分析的高度准确且可扩展的框架。 BernBRS 同时计算后向可达集 (BRS) 的经过认证的内部和外部近似值。我们的方法不是依赖于单个凸边界，而是通过分析激活模式智能地细化输入空间的覆盖，精确地分割输入域，其中松弛间隙的精确分解预测误差最显着的减少。这种有针对性的改进可以为高度复杂和大规模的架构提供高水平的可扩展性

items.title: TempQuant: Learning Adaptive Temperatures for Quantized Language Models
items.excerpt: Large language models are increasingly deployed at low precision, yet quantization can degrade their performance. We study how quantization interacts with decoding settings such as the sampling temperature and top-p by examining how it distorts the model's next-token probabilities. Measuring entropy during generation across deployed temperatures, we find that quantization warms the model on average, and that temperature matters much more for the performance of a quantized model than for its full-precision counterpart. Because quantization and temperature both shape the next-token distribution, we investigate how much the sampling settings can undo what quantization changes, through our method TempQuant, which learns the quantized model's temperature and top-p to bring its next-token probabilities closer to the full-precision model's. We learn these settings at two granularities. The first is a single global setting per requested temperature, which finds nearly the same temperatures that tuning on labeled answers would, without any labels. Model cards typically recommend sampling a quantized model with the same settings as its full-pre
items.authors: Mukund Athmaram, Liang Ma, Manoj Rao
items.title_zh: TempQuant：学习量化语言模型的自适应温度
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地以低精度部署，但量化会降低其性能。我们通过检查量化如何扭曲模型的下一个令牌概率来研究量化如何与采样温度和 top-p 等解码设置相互作用。在跨部署温度的生成过程中测量熵，我们发现量化平均使模型变暖，并且温度对于量化模型的性能比对于全精度模型的性能更重要。由于量化和温度都会影响下一个令牌分布，因此我们通过 TempQuant 方法研究采样设置可以在多大程度上撤销量化变化，该方法学习量化模型的温度和 top-p，使其下一个令牌概率更接近全精度模型。我们以两种粒度学习这些设置。第一个是每个请求温度的单个全局设置，它找到与调整标记答案几乎相同的温度，没有任何标签。模型卡通常建议使用与其全预置相同的设置对量化模型进行采样

items.title: ReMaRL: Learning to Unmask and Remask in Frozen Diffusion Language Models
items.excerpt: Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, and the order in which tokens are unmasked affects final-answer accuracy. Several methods learn unmasking policies from task rewards, but these policies cannot remask earlier predictions. Remasking lets the model correct those predictions using newly generated context. Heuristic rules guide both unmasking and remasking, while supervised remaskers learn to detect token errors. Neither approach directly optimizes these decisions for final-answer correctness. To address this gap, we introduce ReMaRL (Remasking with Reinforcement Learning), a lightweight policy that learns which tokens to unmask, retain, or remask. We train this roughly 0.3M-parameter policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) from final-answer rewards while keeping the diffusion model frozen. With LLaDA-8B-Instruct, ReMaRL achieves the highest scores among the compared unmasking and remasking policies within the tested inference budgets of 4-32 model calls on math and 8-16 calls on code.
items.authors: Egor Shibaev, Danila Biktimirov, Ivan Klimov, Artem Makoian, Viacheslav Meshchaninov, Dmitry Vetrov
items.title_zh: ReMaRL：学习在冻结扩散语言模型中揭露和重新掩盖
items.excerpt_zh: 屏蔽扩散语言模型并行生成标记，并且标记被揭开的顺序影响最终答案的准确性。有几种方法可以从任务奖励中学习揭露策略，但这些策略无法重新掩盖早期的预测。重新屏蔽让模型使用新生成的上下文来纠正这些预测。启发式规则指导取消屏蔽和重新屏蔽，而受监督的重新屏蔽器则学习检测令牌错误。这两种方法都没有直接优化这些决策以确保最终答案的正确性。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了 ReMaRL（通过强化学习进行重新屏蔽），这是一种轻量级策略，可以学习要取消屏蔽、保留或重新屏蔽哪些令牌。我们通过最终答案奖励的组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 来训练这个大约 0.3M 参数的策略，同时保持扩散模型冻结。借助 LLaDA-8B-Instruct，ReMaRL 在 4-32 次数学模型调用和 8-16 次代码调用的测试推理预算内，在比较的解密和重新屏蔽策略中获得了最高分。

items.title: Limite 1B - Violetto: Technical Report
items.excerpt: We present Limite 1B - Violetto, a one-billion-parameter model designed for high-throughput mathematical reasoning. Limite is trained from scratch on 237 billion tokens from a carefully curated, mathematics-centric corpus and supports context lengths of up to 131k tokens. Its architecture and training recipe were developed together to maximize reasoning capability while keeping training and inference costs low. Post-training combines knowledge distillation, targeted supervised fine-tuning, and RLVR on a curated curriculum. Limite achieves 94.01% on AIME 2026 and 74.25% on BeyondAIME, placing it among models many times its size on our evaluation suite. The model is deliberately only lightly instruction-tuned: it is intended primarily as a single-turn mathematical solver and as a fast, parallel component of larger systems, rather than as a general-purpose assistant. We release the model, its base and value checkpoints, and an optimized serving implementation under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.authors: Mario Prignano, Gabriele Cirillo, Alessio Morosini, Luca Cerovaz, Alessandro Bartolocci, Emanuele Rodol\`a, Giulio Starace, Francesco Pappone
items.title_zh: Limite 1B - Violetto：技术报告
items.excerpt_zh: 我们推出了 Limite 1B - Violetto，这是一个专为高通量数学推理而设计的十亿参数模型。 Limite 使用来自精心策划的、以数学为中心的语料库中的 2370 亿个标记从头开始进行训练，并支持高达 131k 个标记的上下文长度。其架构和训练方法是一起开发的，以最大限度地提高推理能力，同时保持较低的训练和推理成本。后期培训将知识提炼、有针对性的监督微调和 RLVR 结合在精心策划的课程中。 Limite 在 AIME 2026 上取得了 94.01% 的成绩，在 BeyondAIME 上取得了 74.25% 的成绩，在我们的评估套件中跻身于其规模数倍的模型之列。该模型故意只进行了轻微的指令调整：它的主要目的是作为单轮数学求解器和大型系统的快速并行组件，而不是作为通用助手。我们在 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布了模型、其基础和值检查点以及优化的服务实现。

items.title: Clustering in pure-attention hardmax transformers and its role in sentiment analysis
items.excerpt: Transformers are extremely successful machine learning models whose mathematical properties remain poorly understood. Here, we rigorously characterize the behavior of transformers with hardmax self-attention and normalization sublayers as the number of layers tends to infinity. By viewing such transformers as discrete-time dynamical systems describing the evolution of points in a Euclidean space, and thanks to a geometric interpretation of the self-attention mechanism based on hyperplane separation, we show that the transformer inputs asymptotically converge to a clustered equilibrium determined by special points called \textit{leaders}. We then leverage this theoretical understanding to solve sentiment analysis problems from language processing using a fully interpretable transformer model, which effectively captures `context' by clustering meaningless words around leader words carrying the most meaning. Finally, we outline remaining challenges to bridge the gap between the mathematical analysis of transformers and their real-life implementation.
items.authors: Albert Alcalde, Giovanni Fantuzzi, Enrique Zuazua
items.title_zh: 纯注意力 Hardmax 变换器中的聚类及其在情感分析中的作用
items.excerpt_zh: Transformer 是非常成功的机器学习模型，但其数学特性仍然知之甚少。在这里，当层数趋于无穷大时，我们严格地表征具有 Hardmax 自注意力和归一化子层的 Transformer 的行为。通过将此类 Transformer 视为描述欧几里德空间中点演化的离散时间动态系统，并借助基于超平面分离的自注意力机制的几何解释，我们表明 Transformer 输入渐近收敛到由称为 \textit{leaders} 的特殊点确定的集群平衡。然后，我们利用这种理论理解，使用完全可解释的转换器模型来解决语言处理中的情感分析问题，该模型通过将无意义的单词聚集在最有意义的引导词周围，有效地捕获“上下文”。最后，我们概述了弥合变压器数学分析与其现实生活实施之间差距的剩余挑战。

items.title: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
items.excerpt: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for human-AI interaction usually trains the agent against a single large language model (LLM) that simulates the user. We show that agents trained this way can systematically fail to generalize, and we trace the failure to simulator collapse: the simulator LLM is mode-collapsed, and a policy trained against it learns narrow strategies that exploit the simulator's mode behavior; these strategies transfer poorly to unseen simulators and to real users. We formalize the collapse and propose two solutions. Verbalized Sampling, applied at inference time, samples each simulator reply from a verbalized response distribution. Co-Training, applied during training similar to self-play, co-evolves the simulator as the policy, so the policy cannot exploit the mode behavior. A population variant samples the simulator for each rollout from a pool of recent checkpoints. We validate both solutions on three benchmarks: Persuasion for Good, tau^2-bench, and CooperBench. Verbalized Sampling improves held-out success by up to 9% over single-simulator RL, and Co-Training pushes gains further to 14%; the human s
items.authors: Simon Yu, Nicholas Tomlin, Marwa Abdulhai, Ximing Lu, Derek Chong, Abe Hou, Dilara Soylu, Sergey Levine, Christopher D. Manning, Weiyan Shi
items.title_zh: 一个冻结的模拟器是不够的：多智能体强化学习中的模拟器崩溃
items.excerpt_zh: 用于人机交互的多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 通常会针对模拟用户的单个大型语言模型 (LLM) 来训练智能体。我们表明，以这种方式训练的智能体可能会系统性地无法泛化，并且我们将失败追溯到模拟器崩溃：模拟器 LLM 是模式崩溃的，针对它训练的策略会学习利用模拟器模式行为的狭隘策略；这些策略很难转移到看不见的模拟器和真实用户中。我们将崩溃正式化并提出了两种解决方案。言语采样，在推理时应用，从言语响应分布中对每个模拟器回复进行采样。协同训练（Co-Training），在训练过程中应用，类似于自我游戏，将模拟器作为策略共同进化，因此策略无法利用模式行为。每次推出时，群体变体都会从最近检查点池中对模拟器进行采样。我们在三个基准上验证了这两种解决方案：Persuasion for Good、tau^2-bench 和 CooperBench。与单模拟器 RL 相比，语言化采样将保留成功率提高了 9%，而协同训练将收益进一步提升至 14%；人类的

items.title: Relative computability and definability for nonregular oracles
items.excerpt: Classically, a set is computable from an oracle if both the set and its complement are computably enumerable (c.e.) relative to that oracle. We construct a countable nonstandard model of true arithmetic with sets A and X such that both A and its complement are c.e. relative to X, yet A is not pointwise Turing reducible to X. The Turing functionals used here are single-valued at every oracle. For regular oracles, we prove that the classical equivalence holds over ISigma_1. Two further phenomena, each known from earlier work, are realized with the same oracle X that witnesses our main separation. Strong and pointwise Turing reducibility differ for this X, and some Delta_1^X set is not X-c.e.
items.authors: Yong Liu, Cheng Peng, Mengzhou Sun
items.title_zh: 非正则预言的相对可计算性和可定义性
items.excerpt_zh: 传统上，如果一个集合及其补集相对于该预言机是可计算可枚举的（c.e），则该集合是可从该预言机计算的。我们用集合 A 和 X 构建了一个可数非标准算术模型，使得 A 及其补集都是 c.e.相对于 X，但 A 不能逐点图灵简化为 X。这里使用的图灵泛函在每个预言机上都是单值的。对于常规预言机，我们证明经典等价在 ISigma_1 上成立。两个进一步的现象，每一个都从早期的工作中已知，是通过见证我们主要分离的同一个预言机 X 实现的。该 X 的强图灵可约性和逐点图灵可约性不同，并且某些 Delta_1^X 集不是 X-c.e.。

items.title: Boxes in Infinite Words: Complexity, Automata, and Point Modules
items.excerpt: Motivated by the geometry of point modules over monomial algebras, we introduce a box-counting function associated to a right-infinite word over a finite alphabet. An extendable box is a family of finite words obtained by choosing letters independently at each position, subject to the condition that all choices admit a common infinite right continuation in the associated subshift. We prove several results for these functions for words of linearly bounded complexity. For $k$-automatic words, we show using techniques from first-order logic that the total box-counting function is $k$-regular. Finally, we apply our results to prove eventual affine growth of the number of positive-dimensional irreducible components in finite projections of point-module spaces associated to semiprime monomial algebras of at most quadratic growth.
items.title_zh: 无限单词中的盒子：复杂性、自动机和点模块
items.excerpt_zh: 受单项代数上点模几何的启发，我们引入了与有限字母表上的右无限单词相关的盒计数函数。可扩展框是通过在每个位置独立选择字母而获得的有限单词族，前提是所有选择在相关子移位中都允许公共无限右延续。我们证明了这些函数对于线性有界复杂度的单词的几个结果。对于 $k$-自动单词，我们使用一阶逻辑技术证明总盒计数函数是 $k$-常规的。最后，我们应用我们的结果来证明与最多二次增长的半素单项代数相关的点模空间的有限投影中正维不可约分量的数量的最终仿射增长。

items.title: Learn then Bet: Learning Interpretable Rules for Reliable Agent Intervention
items.excerpt: Autonomous agents now run for hundreds of steps with little or no human supervision. In practice, practitioners use runtime monitors such as turn limits and keyword filters to decide when a run should be stopped, upgraded, or assisted. However, these heuristics may stop runs that would otherwise succeed or allow failing runs to continue. To address this limitation, we introduce LeBet (Learn then Bet), a statistical learning framework that derives its learning objective from sufficient conditions for valid and powerful intervention. In particular, LeBet learns an interpretable OR-of-AND monitor and accumulates evidence through a fixed betting statistic, intervening when the evidence reaches a prescribed threshold. Under finite within-class exchangeability and leave-one-out stability, we derive finite-sample guarantees for false-positive control (validity) and detection power conditional on the training data, using the same trajectories for learning and calibration without assuming independent and identically distributed trajectories. items.title: When Cooperation Must Change: Semantic Strategy Unlearning in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) supports coordinated decision-making in distributed Web services, multi-robot control, and collaborative games through learned coordination conventions. When deployment requirements change, a previously useful convention may become obsolete or unsafe. For example, revised cache-sharing permissions in Web content delivery may require caches to abandon a learned division of storage and serving roles while maintaining efficient delivery. Teams must therefore remove the specified convention while preserving useful cooperation. This is challenging because the same relational pattern can be reproduced by different agents across different histories. Runtime shielding leaves the underlying coordination preference intact and can impair task progress, while existing reinforcement unlearning and trajectory-deletion methods do not directly target role-invariant conventions. items.title: Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
items.excerpt: Fast charging of lithium-ion batteries is a multi-objective control problem that requires reducing charging time and sustaining high energy throughput while suppressing accelerated degradation and safety-critical electrochemical reactions. Conventional protocols are easy to implement but have limited ability to adapt to variations in battery chemistry, operating conditions, and aging state. Model-based optimization and conventional data-driven control often require accurate models, costly iterative search, or task-specific policies. We develop a large language model (LLM)-empowered intelligent agent for adaptive battery fast-charging control. In this closed-loop framework, the agent interprets structured battery states, generates executable charging actions, observes the resulting battery response, and continuously adjusts subsequent decisions. We construct a large-scale simulation corpus with PyBaMM across five battery chemistries and 11 parameter sets and convert the resulting state-action-response trajectories into structured process data for agent training. items.title: ARCHER: From Rationale Imitation to Executable Reasoning in Small Language Models
items.excerpt: Small language models are attractive for local, low-cost, and privacy-sensitive deployment, but they remain unreliable on mathematical reasoning tasks that require decomposition, exact computation, tool use, and verification. We introduce \textbf{ARCHER}: \textbf{A}ction-trace \textbf{R}einforcement for \textbf{C}alculator-grounded \textbf{H}ierarchical \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{R}easoning, a two-stage framework for training small language models (SLMs) to produce executable and auditable reasoning trajectories. In the first stage, ARCHER compiles free-form chain-of-thought rationales into typed action traces containing reasoning steps, calculator calls, deterministic runtime observations, verification actions, and final answers. This shifts the supervision target from imitating explanatory text to learning a tool-grounded reasoning policy. In the second stage, ARCHER refines this policy through asymmetric hierarchical reinforcement learning, using grouped and conditionally gated trajectory rewards for answer correctness, tool grounding, process discipline, and trace alignment. items.excerpt_zh: 小语言模型对于本地、低成本和隐私敏感的部署很有吸引力，但它们在需要分解、精确计算、工具使用和验证的数学推理任务上仍然不可靠。我们引入 \textbf{ARCHER}：\textbf{A}action-trace \textbf{R} 增强 \textbf{C} 计算器为基础的 \textbf{H}ierarchical \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{R}easoning，一个两阶段框架，用于训练小语言模型（SLM）以产生可执行和可审计的推理轨迹。 In the first stage, ARCHER compiles free-form chain-of-thought rationales into typed action traces containing reasoning steps, calculator calls, deterministic runtime observations, verification actions, and final answers.这将监督目标从模仿解释性文本转变为学习基于工具的推理策略。 In the second stage, ARCHER refines this policy through asymmetric hierarchical reinforcement learning, using grouped and conditionally gated trajectory rewards for answer correctness, tool grounding, process discipline, and trace alignment. ARCHER 在五个标准 sub-10B 主干网中进行了改进
items.title_zh: ARCHER：从基本原理模仿到小语言模型中的可执行推理

items.title: Binarization as an Attack Surface in Weightless Neural Networks
items.excerpt: Weightless Neural Networks (WNNs) are lightweight classifiers that binarize their inputs and learn by storing binary patterns in lookup memories, which makes them attractive for resource-constrained tasks such as intrusion detection. Because a small perturbation that crosses no binarization threshold leaves the binary input unchanged, WNNs may appear naturally robust to adversarial examples; a perturbation that does cross a threshold, however, can still change the prediction. We study this tension in WiSARD, the canonical RAM-based WNN, and in two variants that replace its memories with Bloom filters, Bloom WiSARD and BTHOWeN. A continuous perturbation reaches these classifiers only by crossing an encoding threshold, changing at least one binary tuple, and redirecting a memory query; we formalize this mechanism with a threshold-crossing bound and a response-margin certificate for standard Boolean WiSARD. Controlled MNIST experiments compare linear and data-driven thermometer encodings under model-agnostic sensitivity probes, a score-based Simulated Annealing attack, and surrogate-transfer attacks. items.authors: Lucas Senos Coutinho, Matheus Vargas, Pedro Teixeira, Heudson Tosta Mirandola, Ori Rottenstreich, Priscila Machado Vieira Lima, Leandro Santiago, Daniel Sadoc Menasche
items.title_zh: 二值化作为失重神经网络中的攻击面
items.excerpt_zh: 失重神经网络 (WNN) 是轻量级分类器，可对输入进行二值化，并通过在查找存储器中存储二进制模式来进行学习，这使得它们对于入侵检测等资源受限的任务很有吸引力。由于不跨越任何二值化阈值的小扰动会使二进制输入保持不变，因此 WNN 可能对对抗性示例表现出天然的鲁棒性； a perturbation that does cross a threshold, however, can still change the prediction.我们在 WiSARD（基于 RAM 的规范 WNN）以及用 Bloom 过滤器替换其内存的两个变体（Bloom WiSARD 和 BTHOWeN）中研究了这种张力。连续扰动仅通过跨越编码阈值、更改至少一个二进制元组以及重定向内存查询来到达这些分类器； we formalize this mechanism with a threshold-crossing bound and a response-margin certificate for standard Boolean WiSARD.受控 MNIST 实验比较了模型不可知敏感性探针、基于分数的模拟退火攻击和代理转移攻击下的线性和数据驱动的温度计编码。 ke 时仅更改编码

items.title: Landau's problems through ratios of $L$-functions
items.excerpt: Very recently, Lee announced a proof of the Twin Prime Conjecture assuming the Ratios Conjecture for the Riemann zeta function. We obtain conditional asymptotic formulas with power-saving errors for each of Landau's four prime problems. In the function field setting, using Sawin's estimates for factorization functions in squarefree progressions and a discriminant cohomology argument, we obtain unconditional Goldbach and prime-pair asymptotics over sufficiently large fixed odd fields, including prime fields. Similar results may be possible for other problems in analytic number theory.
items.authors: Haozhe Gou, Victor Y. Wang, Max Wenqiang Xu
items.title_zh: 通过 $L$ 函数的比率来解决朗道问题
items.excerpt_zh: 最近，Lee 宣布了孪生素数猜想的证明，假设黎曼 zeta 函数的比率猜想。对于朗道的四个素数问题，我们都获得了带有节能误差的条件渐近公式。在函数域设置中，使用 Sawin 对无平方级数中因式分解函数的估计和判别上同调论证，我们在足够大的固定奇数域（包括素数域）上获得无条件哥德巴赫和素数对渐近。对于解析数论中的其他问题也可能得到类似的结果。

items.title: Irreducible Projective Polynomials
items.excerpt: Suppose $q=p^{s_1}$ and $\sigma=p^{s_2}$ for a prime $p$ and $s_1,s_2\in\mathbb{N}.$ In this paper, we characterize for which values of $p, d, s_1, s_2, \ell$ there exists an irreducible polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_q$ of the form \begin{align*} x^\frac{\sigma^d-1}{\ell}+\sum_{j=0}^{d-1}a_j x^\frac{\sigma^j-1}{\ell} \end{align*} for fixed $d,\ell\in\mathbb{N}$ where $\ell\mid (\sigma-1).$ In particular, we enumerate irreducible polynomials of this form.
items.title_zh: 不可约射影多项式
items.excerpt_zh: 假设 $q=p^{s_1}$ 和 $\sigma=p^{s_2}$ 为素数 $p$ 和 $s_1,s_2\in\mathbb{N}.$ 在本文中，我们描述了 $p, d, s_1, s_2, \ell$ 的值在 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上存在形式为 \begin{align*} 的不可约多项式x^\frac{\sigma^d-1}{\ell}+\sum_{j=0}^{d-1}a_j x^\frac{\sigma^j-1}{\ell} \end{align*} 对于固定的 $d,\ell\in\mathbb{N}$ 其中 $\ell\mid (\sigma-1).$ 特别是，我们枚举这种形式的不可约多项式。

items.title: On p-adic modularity of abelian threefolds with imaginary multiplication and rational p-isogeny
items.excerpt: We prove $p$-adic modularity of a certain class of abelian threefolds over $\mathbf{Q}$ (with imaginary multiplication and rational $p$-isogeny), including the Jacobians of some genus 3 curves known as Picard curves. More precisely, we study a deformation problem for residual 3-dimensional totally reducible Galois pseudorepresentations over an imaginary quadratic field which are ordinary at primes over $p$ and conjugate self-dual. We show that under certain conditions the universal pseudodeformation ring in any weight (including the non-classical low weight corresponding to an abelian threefold) is isomorphic to a specialization of the ordinary Hida Hecke algebra on $U(2,1)$. The conditions that we assume are essentially class group conditions as well as weak regularity of the Hecke algebras in sufficiently high classical weights.
items.title_zh: 具有虚乘和有理p同源性的阿贝尔三重的p进模性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了 $\mathbf{Q}$ 上某类阿贝尔三重的 $p$-adic 模性（具有虚数乘法和有理 $p$-同源性），包括一些称为皮卡德曲线的属 3 曲线的雅可比行列式。更准确地说，我们研究了虚二次域上剩余 3 维完全可约伽罗瓦伪表示的变形问题，该二次域在 $p$ 上的素数处是普通的并且是共轭自对偶的。我们证明，在某些条件下，任何权重（包括对应于阿贝尔三重的非经典低权重）的通用伪变形环与普通 Hida Hecke 代数在 $U(2,1)$ 上的特化是同构的。我们假设的条件本质上是类群条件以及足够高的经典权重下赫克代数的弱正则性。

items.title: The first-order theory of the ring of integers of any abelian extension of $\Q$ is undecidable
items.excerpt: We show that any ring of totally real abelian integers has a JR-number and therefore the first-order theory of every ring of totally real abelian integers is undecidable. It then follows that the first-order theory of the ring of integers of any abelian extension of $\Q$ is undecidable and that there is one formula without parameters defining $\Z$ in any such ring. The main arithmetic input is a recent paper of Bajpai, Das, Kedlaya, and Mello proving that the houses of cyclotomic integers form a well-ordered subset of $\R$.
items.authors: Barry Mazur, Karl Rubin, Alexandra Shlapentokh
items.title_zh: $\Q$ 的任何阿贝尔扩展的整数环的一阶理论是不可判定的
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明任何全实阿贝尔整数环都有一个 JR 数，因此每个全实阿贝尔整数环的一阶理论是不可判定的。由此可见，$\Q$ 的任何阿贝尔扩展的整数环的一阶理论都是不可判定的，并且存在一个没有参数在任何此类环中定义 $\Z$ 的公式。主要算术输入是 Bajpai、Das、Kedlaya 和 Mello 最近发表的一篇论文，证明分圆整数的房子形成 $\R$ 的良序子集。

items.title: An ancient diophantine problem of Brahmagupta
items.excerpt: In the seventh century CE, Brahmagupta gave a parametric solution to the problem of finding two numbers $x$ and $y$ such that $x+y, x-y$ and $xy+1$ are all squares. We describe a method for generating infinitely many rational parametric solutions of the problem and another method for generating parametric solutions of the problem in terms of univariate polynomials with integer coefficients. The complete solution of the problem still remains elusive.
items.title_zh: 婆罗门笈多的古代丢番图问题
items.excerpt_zh: 在公元七世纪，Brahmagupta 给出了一个参数解决方案，解决了寻找两个数字 $x$ 和 $y$ 使得 $x+y、x-y$ 和 $xy+1$ 都是正方形的问题。我们描述了一种生成问题的无限多个有理参数解的方法，以及另一种根据具有整数系数的单变量多项式生成问题的参数解的方法。问题的彻底解决仍然难以实现。

items.title: Two-Sided large oscillations of the argument of the Riemann zeta function and its iterates
items.excerpt: Assuming the Riemann hypothesis, we establish lower bounds for large oscillations of the iterated argument functions \(S_n(t)\) of the Riemann zeta function. As a corollary, we prove that, for every fixed integer \(n \geq 0\), \[S_n(t)=\Omega_{\pm}\Big(\frac{(\log t)^{1/2}(\log_3 t)^{1/2}}{(\log_2 t)^{n+1/2}} \Big).\] For even \(n\), this recovers two results of Chirre and Mahatab in 2021. For odd \(n\), our result strengthens theirs by establishing the missing direction of oscillation with the same order of magnitude.
items.title_zh: 黎曼zeta函数及其迭代参数的两侧大振荡
items.excerpt_zh: 假设黎曼假设，我们为黎曼 zeta 函数的迭代参数函数 \(S_n(t)\) 的大振荡建立下界。作为推论，我们证明，对于每个固定整数 \(n \geq 0\)，\[S_n(t)=\Omega_{\pm}\Big(\frac{(\log t)^{1/2}(\log_3 t)^{1/2}}{(\log_2 t)^{n+1/2}} \Big)。\] 对于偶数 \(n\)，这会恢复 Chirre 和 的两个结果Mahatab 于 2021 年。对于奇数 \(n\)，我们的结果通过建立具有相同数量级的缺失振荡方向来加强他们的结果。

items.title: An Explicit Version of Serre's Open Image Theorem for Galois Number Fields
items.excerpt: In 1971, Serre showed that the mod $p$ Galois representation associated to a non-CM elliptic curve over a number field is surjective for all but finitely many primes $p$. That is, there exists a constant $c(E,K)$, for $E$ a non-CM elliptic curve over a number field $K$, such that $\rho_{E,p}:\mathrm{Gal}(\overline{K}/K)\to \mathrm{Aut}(E[p])$ is surjective for all primes $p>c(E,K)$. We give a bound for this constant using an effective version of the Faltings isogeny theorem for specific number fields. We show that, for $K=\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{D})$ with $|D|<50$ and $K$ a formally real number field, given a non-CM elliptic curve $E$ over $K$ we have $c(E,K)\le 2C_1(K)\log N_{K/\mathbb Q}\operatorname{rad}\left( 2\mathcal O_K\mathfrak N_{E}\right )+2 C_2(K)$, where $\mathfrak N_E$ denotes the conductor ideal of $E$, and the constants $C_1(K)$ and $C_2(K)$ can be described explicitly. We also show that for primes greater than this bound, the image cannot be contained in the normalizer of a non-split Cartan subgroup. This works for any Galois number field. Our proof assumes the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH).
items.authors: Clifford J Rodrigues, Debargha Banerjee, Krishna Kishore, Sunil Kumar Mallick
items.title_zh: 伽罗瓦数域塞尔开像定理的显式版本
items.excerpt_zh: 1971 年，Serre 证明，与数域上的非 CM 椭圆曲线相关的 mod $p$ 伽罗瓦表示对于除了有限多个素数 $p$ 之外的所有素数都是满射的。也就是说，存在一个常数$c(E,K)$，对于$E$，在数域$K$上有一条非CM椭圆曲线，使得$\rho_{E,p}:\mathrm{Gal}(\overline{K}/K)\to \mathrm{Aut}(E[p])$对于所有素数$p>c(E,K)$是满射。我们使用特定数域的法尔廷斯同源定理的有效版本给出了该常数的界限。我们证明，对于 $K=\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{D})$ 且 $|D|<50$ 且 $K$ 为形式实数域，给定 $K$ 上的非 CM 椭圆曲线 $E$，我们有 $c(E,K)\le 2C_1(K)\log N_{K/\mathbb Q}\operatorname{rad}\left( 2\mathcal O_K\mathfrak N_{E}\right )+2 C_2(K)$，其中$\mathfrak N_E$表示$E$的理想导体，常数$C_1(K)$和$C_2(K)$可以明确描述。我们还表明，对于大于此界限的素数，图像不能包含在非分裂嘉当子群的归一化器中。这适用于任何伽罗瓦数域。我们的证明假设采用广义黎曼假设（GRH）。

items.title: On the number of elite primes
items.excerpt: A prime $p$ is elite if all sufficiently large Fermat numbers $F_n=2^{2^n}+1$ are quadratic nonresidues modulo $p$. Let $E(x)$ be the number of elite primes up to $x$. The best published bounds are $E(x)\ll x/(\log x)^{3/2}$ unconditionally and $E(x)\ll x^{5/6}$ under the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH), both due to Just. Just and Pollack remarked, without a written proof, that sorting primes by the exact power of $2$ dividing $p-1$ should give $x/(\log x)^{2-\varepsilon}$ and $x^{3/4+\varepsilon}$. We give complete proofs of slightly sharper statements: $E(x)\le(16+o(1))x\log\log x/(\log x)^2$ unconditionally, and $E(x)\ll x^{3/4}(\log x)^{1/2}$ under GRH. We also recall, with short proofs, known facts about the period of $(F_n\bmod p)$ that go back to Aigner: every elite prime $p$ satisfies the defining condition from the index $v_2(\operatorname{ord}_p 2)$ onwards, and the period is even unless $p\in\{3,5\}$. Finally, we show under GRH that, when the moduli involved are at most $x^{1/3}$, the set of primes bounded by the sieve argument has size $\asymp x\log\log x/(\log x)^2$.
