items.excerpt_zh: 如果所有足够大的费马数 $F_n=2^{2^n}+1$ 都是模 $p$ 的二次非留数，则素数 $p$ 是精英数。令 $E(x)$ 为直到 $x$ 的精英素数的数量。最好的已发布边界是无条件 $E(x)\ll x/(\log x)^{3/2}$ 和广义黎曼假设 (GRH) 下的 $E(x)\ll x^{5/6}$，两者均归因于 Just。 Just 和 Pollack 指出，在没有书面证明的情况下，按照 $2$ 除 $p-1$ 的精确幂对素数进行排序应该得到 $x/(\log x)^{2-\varepsilon}$ 和 $x^{3/4+\varepsilon}$。我们给出了稍微尖锐的陈述的完整证明：无条件$E(x)\le(16+o(1))x\log\log x/(\log x)^2$，以及GRH下的$E(x)\ll x^{3/4}(\log x)^{1/2}$。我们还通过简短的证明回忆起关于 $(F_n\bmod p)$ 周期的已知事实，这些事实可以追溯到 Aigner：每个精英素数 $p$ 都满足从索引 $v_2(\operatorname{ord}_p 2)$ 开始的定义条件，并且周期是偶数，除非 $p\in\{3,5\}$。最后，我们在 GRH 下证明，当涉及的模数最多为 $x^{1/3}$ 时，由筛参数限制的素数集的大小为 $\asymp x\log\log x/(\log x)^2$。这表明剩余因子 $\log\log

items.title: Delaunay Combinatorics of the Moduli and Teichm\"uller Space of Closed Genus-Two Riemann Surfaces
items.excerpt: Every closed Riemann surface of genus two is hyperelliptic, so it is determined by six branch points on the sphere, which become cone points of angle pi in the quotient orbifold metric. The Delaunay decomposition of these cone points, dual to the Voronoi diagram of the Weierstrass points, gives a trivalent graph with eight vertices, twelve edges and six faces. We classify these graphs. When the dual triangulation is simple there are exactly two types, dual to the octahedron and to a stacked triangulation, with orientation-preserving automorphism groups of orders 24 and 2, and we determine the Whitehead-move (diagonal-flip) orbit connecting them. Allowing bigons, the orbit closes at exactly twenty types. Iterated edge contraction from the two simple types gives a seven-level hierarchy of 2, 6, 22, 32, 22, 5 and 1 types, ending at two vertices joined by six parallel edges; closing under both contraction and expansion gives all 280 maps on the sphere with six vertices and no vertex of degree one. The rank of the linear cone-angle system of each type equals the real dimension 6 of the Teichm\"uller space. We realize both simple types by e
items.title_zh: 闭亏格-两个黎曼曲面的模和Teichm\"uller空间的Delaunay组合
items.excerpt_zh: 每一个属二闭黎曼曲面都是超椭圆的，因此它由球面上的六个分支点确定，这些分支点成为商轨道度量中角度为 pi 的圆锥点。这些锥点的 Delaunay 分解与 Weierstrass 点的 Voronoi 图对偶，给出了具有八个顶点、十二条边和六个面的三价图。我们对这些图进行分类。当对偶三角剖分很简单时，恰好有两种类型，对偶八面体和堆叠三角剖分，具有 24 阶和 2 阶的保向自同构群，并且我们确定连接它们的怀特海移动（对角翻转）轨道。如果允许大佬，轨道恰好在二十种类型处闭合。两个简单类型的迭代边收缩给出了 2、6、22、32、22、5 和 1 类型的七级层次结构，以由六个平行边连接的两个顶点结束；在收缩和膨胀下闭合给出了球体上的所有 280 个贴图，其中有 6 个顶点，但没有 1 阶顶点。每种类型的线性锥角系统的秩等于 Teichm\"uller 空间的实维数 6。我们通过 e 实现这两种简单类型

items.title: The cop number of the flower snarks, and the generalized Petersen graphs with cop number two
items.excerpt: We study two questions of Morris, Runte and Skelton (Australas. J. Combin. 83 (2022)) on the game of Cops and Robbers. First, we show that the flower snark $J_n$ has cop number $3$ for every $n\geq 5$, and that $J_3$ has cop number $2$. The upper bound comes from a three-cop strategy, which we call the rolling wall. It works on every connected graph whose vertices can be arranged in a cycle of columns, each dominated by a single vertex. Because only one cop moves on each turn, the same strategy also shows that the lazy cop number of $J_n$ is $3$ for $n\geq 5$. Second, we prove the conjecture of Morris, Runte and Skelton that the only generalized Petersen graphs with cop number $2$ are $\mathrm{GP}(n,1)$ and the four graphs $\mathrm{GP}(6,2)$, $\mathrm{GP}(8,2)$, $\mathrm{GP}(9,3)$ and $\mathrm{GP}(12,3)$. The new ingredient is an explicit robber strategy showing that two cops do not suffice on $\mathrm{GP}(3k,k)$ and $\mathrm{GP}(4k,k)$ for $k\geq 4$. The theorem on flower snarks and all of the new lower bounds have been formally verified in the Lean 4 proof assistant.
items.title_zh: 花蛇的警察编号，以及警察编号为 2 的广义 Petersen 图
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了 Morris、Runte 和 Skelton (Australas. J. Combin. 83 (2022)) 关于警察和强盗游戏的两个问题。首先，我们证明花蛇 $J_n$ 对于每 $n\geq 5$ 都有警察号码 $3$，并且 $J_3$ 有警察号码 $2$。上限来自三警察策略，我们称之为滚动墙。它适用于每个顶点可以排列在列循环中的连通图，每个列由一个顶点主导。因为每回合只有一名警察移动，所以相同的策略还表明，对于 $n\geq 5$，$J_n$ 的惰性警察编号为 $3$。其次，我们证明了 Morris、Runte 和 Skelton 的猜想，即警察编号为 $2$ 的唯一广义 Petersen 图是 $\mathrm{GP}(n,1)$ 以及四个图 $\mathrm{GP}(6,2)$、$\mathrm{GP}(8,2)$、$\mathrm{GP}(9,3)$ 和 $\mathrm{GP}(12,3)$。新的成分是一个明确的强盗策略，表明两个警察不足以解决 $\mathrm{GP}(3k,k)$ 和 $\mathrm{GP}(4k,k)$ 的 $k\geq 4$ 问题。关于花蛇的定理和所有新的下界已在 Lean 4 证明助手中得到正式验证。

items.title: The Walsh spectrum of the Dobbertin APN function
items.excerpt: APN functions yield the best resistance to differential attacks when used as a building block of a block cipher. APN functions induced by monomials over finite fields have received particular interest both for their simplicity and their unique properties. A key property of APN functions is their linearity, which has been determined for all known APN monomials outside of the Dobbertin APN monomials. In this paper, we close this gap and determine the complete Walsh spectrum and in particular the linearity of the Dobbertin APN monomial, answering a problem that has been open for more than 20 years. Using known connections, our result also yields the asymptotically largest Sidon sets in elementary abelian $2$-groups constructed so far as well as binary linear codes of minimum distance $5$ that are almost optimal.
items.title_zh: Dobbertin APN 函数的沃尔什谱
items.excerpt_zh: 当 APN 函数用作分组密码的构建块时，可以最好地抵抗差分攻击。由有限域上的单项式导出的 APN 函数因其简单性和独特的性质而受到特别关注。 APN 函数的一个关键属性是其线性度，该属性已针对 Dobbertin APN 单项式之外的所有已知 APN 单项式确定。在本文中，我们缩小了这一差距，确定了完整的 Walsh 谱，特别是 Dobbertin APN 单项式的线性度，回答了 20 多年来一直悬而未决的问题。使用已知的连接，我们的结果还产生了迄今为止构造的基本阿贝尔 $2$ 群中渐近最大的 Sidon 集以及几乎最优的最小距离 $5$ 的二进制线性码。

items.title: Proper implies improper for the chromatic symmetric function
items.excerpt: Stanley's question of whether the chromatic symmetric function distinguishes trees has been unanswered for over thirty years. It has now been checked for trees with at most 29 vertices, and for several classes of trees. There is the perception that answering the question might be easier for the class of ``proper'' trees, i.e. trees where every vertex is either a leaf or adjacent to a leaf. In this paper, we show that an affirmative answer for a subclass of proper trees, which we call ``$k$-weighted'', is equivalent to an affirmative answer for all trees. In addition, we show that in the class of $k$-weighted trees, the coefficients carry redundant information. In fact we give a closed formula for obtaining the redundant coefficients from other coefficients.
items.title_zh: 对于色对称函数来说，适当意味着不适当
items.excerpt_zh: 斯坦利关于色对称函数是否能区分树木的问题三十多年来一直没有答案。现在已经检查了最多具有 29 个顶点的树以及多个树类。有人认为，对于“适当的”树类（即每个顶点都是叶子或与叶子相邻的树）来说，回答这个问题可能更容易。在本文中，我们表明，对真树子类（我们称之为“$k$加权”）的肯定答案相当于对所有树的肯定答案。此外，我们还表明，在 $k$ 加权树的类别中，系数携带冗余信息。事实上，我们给出了一个从其他系数中获取冗余系数的封闭公式。

items.title: On stretched Kostka polynomials
items.excerpt: Stretched Kostka polynomials are defined by $f_{\lambda,\mu}(N) := K_{N\lambda,N\mu}$, where $K_{\lambda,\mu}$ denotes the corresponding Kostka number. In 2004, King-Tollu-Toumazet conjectured that, for every integer $k$, there are only finitely many polynomials $f_{\lambda,\mu}(N)$ such that $f_{\lambda,\mu}(1)=k$. For $k=3$, KTT also conjectured that there are exactly two such polynomials. We prove both conjectures via Ehrhart theory, by counting lattice points in families of rational polytopes with a fixed set of normals.
items.authors: Alexey Garber, Igor Pak, Zachary Slonim
items.title_zh: 关于拉伸 Kostka 多项式
items.excerpt_zh: 拉伸 Kostka 多项式由 $f_{\lambda,\mu}(N) := K_{N\lambda,N\mu}$ 定义，其中 $K_{\lambda,\mu}$ 表示相应的 Kostka 数。 2004 年，King-Tollu-Toumazet 推测，对于每个整数 $k$，只有有限多个多项式 $f_{\lambda,\mu}(N)$ 使得 $f_{\lambda,\mu}(1)=k$。对于$k=3$，KTT还推测这样的多项式正好有两个。我们通过埃尔哈特理论证明了这两个猜想，通过计算具有一组固定法线的有理多面体族中的格点。

items.title: Rank Functions of Flag Matroids with Applications to Order-Neutral Submodular Valuations
items.excerpt: We provide a rank function axiomatization for flag matroids and show that it is cryptomorphic to the definition of flag matroids as a sequence of matroid quotients. Afterwards, we present some applications of flag matroid rank functions by providing solutions to selected problems. In particular, we discuss connections between flag matroids and submodular valuations in computational economics by showing that rank functions of flag matroids of length $k$ are precisely the same as $\{0, 1, \dots, k\}$-order-neutral submodular valuations. We then prove that $v:2^E\to \mathbb{R}$ is an order-neutral submodular valuation if and only if $v$ can be written as $v(X) = b|X| + \sum_{i=1}^l c_ir_{N_i}(X), \quad b \in \mathbb{R}, c_i > 0$, where $N_{i+1}$ is a quotient of $N_i$. Doing so allows us to prove that every order-neutral submodular valuation is a gross-substitute valuation and that not every order-neutral submodular valuation is a Rado valuation. Furthermore, we prove that if $|E|\geq 3$, then a set $A$ is a Sidon set if and only if all $A$-submodular valuations are order-neutral, if and only if all $A$-submodular valuations are gross-su
items.title_zh: 标志矩阵的排序函数及其在阶中性子模估值中的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为标志拟阵提供了一个等级函数公理化，并表明它对于将标志拟阵定义为拟阵商序列是隐形的。之后，我们通过提供选定问题的解决方案来展示标志拟阵排名函数的一些应用。特别是，我们通过证明长度为 $k$ 的标志拟阵的秩函数与 $\{0, 1, \dots, k\}$ 阶中性子模估值完全相同，讨论了计算经济学中标志拟阵和子模估值之间的联系。然后我们证明 $v:2^E\to \mathbb{R}$ 是一个顺序中性子模估值当且仅当 $v$ 可以写成 $v(X) = b|X| + \sum_{i=1}^l c_ir_{N_i}(X), \quad b \in \mathbb{R}, c_i > 0$，其中 $N_{i+1}$ 是 $N_i$ 的商。这样做可以让我们证明每个订单中性子模块估值都是总替代估值，并且并非每个订单中性子模块估值都是 Rado 估值。此外，我们证明，如果 $|E|\geq 3$，则当且仅当所有 $A$-子模估值都是顺序中性时，集合 $A$ 是 Sidon 集，当且仅当所有 $A$-子模估值都是总苏

items.title: Intervals in affine Bruhat order
items.excerpt: Let $(W,S)$ be an irreducible affine Coxeter system. We study Bruhat intervals in $W$ via the well-known characterization of Bruhat order in terms of galleries. We start by using folded galleries to formulate an analogous order on the coweight lattice, which we call Iwahori order. This allows us to reduce the description of certain Bruhat intervals to that of the corresponding Iwahori intervals. We next give closed-form descriptions of all Iwahori intervals, using the quantum Bruhat graph (QBG). More precisely, we show that lower Iwahori intervals saturate pseudo-Weyl polytopes (that is, certain intersections of negative cones), and upper Iwahori intervals saturate certain unions of positive cones, with the cone points given by explicit formulae involving paths in the QBG. We then describe arbitrary Bruhat intervals by partitioning them into their core, a large region which is (in most cases) completely determined by an Iwahori interval, and their crust, the complementary boundary region. We conclude by proving that, under a super-regularity assumption, the crust is covered by certain locally-defined tesselating shapes. All statements
items.authors: Elizabeth Mili\'cevi\'c, Petra Schwer, Anne Thomas
items.title_zh: 仿射 Bruhat 阶的间隔
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $(W,S)$ 为不可约仿射 Coxeter 系统。我们通过画廊方面众所周知的 Bruhat 阶特征来研究 $W$ 中的 Bruhat 区间。我们首先使用折叠画廊在权重格上制定类似的顺序，我们称之为 Iwahori 顺序。这使我们能够将某些 Bruhat 间隔的描述减少到相应的 Iwahori 间隔的描述。接下来，我们使用量子 Bruhat 图（QBG）给出所有 Iwahori 区间的封闭形式描述。更准确地说，我们表明较低的 Iwahori 区间使伪 Weyl 多胞体（即负锥体的某些交点）饱和，而较高的 Iwahori 区间使正锥体的某些并集饱和，其中锥点由涉及 QBG 中路径的显式公式给出。然后，我们通过将任意 Bruhat 区间划分为核心（在大多数情况下）完全由 Iwahori 区间决定的大区域）及其地壳（互补边界区域）来描述任意 Bruhat 区间。我们的结论是，在超规则假设下，地壳被某些局部定义的镶嵌形状覆盖。所有声明

items.title: The length of the longest path in random acyclic orientations of a complete multipartite graph
items.excerpt: We study the distribution of the length of the longest path in a uniformly random acyclic orientation of a complete multipartite graph. We derive an explicit analytic expression for the probability generating function of the longest path length, and, for an arbitrary fixed number of parts of equal size, we apply analytic combinatorics in several variables to obtain asymptotics (as the part size tends toward infinity) for its mean longest path length.
items.authors: Aiden Corcoran, Erik Lundberg, Elisabeth Rodriguez
items.title_zh: 完整多部分图的随机非循环方向上的最长路径的长度
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究完整多部分图的均匀随机非循环方向上最长路径的长度分布。我们推导出最长路径长度的概率生成函数的显式解析表达式，并且对于任意固定数量的相同大小的零件，我们在多个变量中应用解析组合以获得其平均最长路径长度的渐近（因为零件尺寸趋于无穷大）。

items.title: Odd-degree cycles and rationality of Peskine sixfolds of discriminant 24
items.excerpt: Benedetti and Faenzi conjectured that, for a general trivector $\sigma\in\mathcal D^{1,6,10}$, the Peskine sixfold $X_1^\sigma$ is rational if the Brauer class $\beta$ on the associated K3 surface vanishes. We prove this implication for every $\sigma$ in a nonempty Zariski open subset $U\subset\mathcal D^{1,6,10}$. When $\beta=0$, we construct a line on the generic fiber of the Peskine fibration after a cubic field extension and use odd-degree descent to obtain a line over the original function field. We extend criteria for rationality to smooth complete intersections of an arbitrary number of quadrics under suitable hypotheses. Finally, we describe the derived category of the generic fiber of the Peskine fibration in terms of a twisted nodal curve of arithmetic genus two.
items.title_zh: 判别式 24 的 Peskine 六倍奇数循环和合理性
items.excerpt_zh: Benedetti 和 Faenzi 推测，对于一般三向量 $\sigma\in\mathcal D^{1,6,10}$，如果关联 K3 表面上的布劳尔类 $\beta$ 消失，佩斯金六重 $X_1^\sigma$ 是有理数。我们为非空 Zariski 开子集 $U\subset\mathcal D^{1,6,10}$ 中的每个 $\sigma$ 证明了这一含义。当$\beta=0$时，我们在三次场延伸后在Peskine纤维的通用纤维上构造一条线，并使用奇数次下降在原始函数场上获得一条线。我们扩展了合理性标准，以在适当的假设下平滑任意数量的二次曲面的完全交集。最后，我们用算术属二的扭曲节点曲线来描述 Peskine 纤维的通用纤维的派生类别。

items.title: Rigidity for Families of Abelian Varieties over $\mathcal{M}_{g,n}$
items.excerpt: We provide a new proof of Farb's theorem on the global rigidity of the period map $\mathcal{M}_{g,n} \to \mathcal{A}_g$. We extend this classification to essentially include the period map for $\mathcal{M}_{2,n}$. We also provide a classification of holomorphic maps $\mathcal{M}_g \to \mathcal{A}_{h}$ for $h \leq 2g-1$. The only nonconstant maps in this range are given by taking the Jacobian of a curve and attaching a fixed Abelian variety. In addition to the group theory of the mapping class group, we make extensive use of the theory of variations of Hodge structures and the birational geometry on $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_2$.
items.title_zh: $\mathcal{M}_{g,n}$ 上阿贝尔变种族的刚性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提供了关于周期映射 $\mathcal{M}_{g,n} \to \mathcal{A}_g$ 的全局刚性的 Farb 定理的新证明。我们扩展这个分类，本质上包括 $\mathcal{M}_{2,n}$ 的周期图。我们还提供了 $h \leq 2g-1$ 的全纯映射 $\mathcal{M}_g \to \mathcal{A}_{h}$ 的分类。该范围内唯一的非常数映射是通过采用曲线的雅可比行列式并附加固定的阿贝尔变体来给出的。除了映射类群的群论之外，我们还广泛使用了Hodge结构的变分理论和$\overline{\mathcal{M}}_2$上的双有理几何。

items.title: Decompositions of the diagonal of complete intersections in products of projective spaces
items.excerpt: We study rationality of very general complete intersections in products of projective spaces. By constructing specific reference varieties and apply specialization method in the form of relative torsion orders, we extend the quintic constructions by Hotchkiss and the quartic constructions by B\"ohning, Graf von Bothmer, Pirutka and Zhang to very general complete intersections in products in every characteristic. In particular, we prove that very general quartic hypersurfaces of positive dimension admit no decomposition of the diagonal in every characteristic.
items.title_zh: 射影空间乘积中完全交集对角线的分解
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究射影空间乘积中非常一般的完全交集的合理性。通过构造特定参考簇并应用相对挠阶形式的特殊化方法，我们将Hotchkiss的五次构造和B\"ohning、Graf von Bothmer、Pirutka和Zhang的四次构造扩展到每个特征中乘积的非常一般的完全交集。特别是，我们证明了非常一般的正维四次超曲面在每个特征中都不允许对角线分解。

items.title: Stabilizing Parabolic Vector Bundles
items.excerpt: For an irreducible parabolic flat vector bundle of rank $r < 2\sqrt{g}$ on a genus $g$ curve, we prove that an analytically general isomonodromic deformation is stable. This refines Landesman-Litt's semistability result for bundles of rank $< 2\sqrt{g+1}$. The proof applies the non-generically globally generated (non-GGG) lemma to establish infinitesimal obstructions to extending destabilizing subbundles of semistable bundles.
items.title_zh: 稳定抛物线向量束
items.excerpt_zh: 对于亏格 $g$ 曲线上秩为 $r < 2\sqrt{g}$ 的不可约抛物线平面向量丛，我们证明解析上的一般等单向变形是稳定的。这改进了秩 $< 2\sqrt{g+1}$ 束的 Landesman-Litt 半稳定性结果。该证明应用非一般全局生成（非 GGG）引理来建立无限小的障碍来扩展半稳定丛的不稳定子丛。

items.title: Motivic Borel-Moore Homology is Borel-Moore Motivic Homology
items.excerpt: This paper studies the higher Chow groups of arbitrary finite type separated schemes using motivic homotopy theory, serving as a Borel-Moore counterpart to the $\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant motivic cohomology of Bachmann-Elmanto-Morrow. We construct a filtration on the G-theory spectrum of a finite type separated scheme $X$, inducing an Atiyah-Hirzebruch style spectral sequence whose associated graded pieces are a complex computing the higher Chow groups of $X$. We prove that this complex is representable in the stable motivic homotopy category, and is a module over the $\mathbb{A}^1$-motivic complex, giving rise to an action of $\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant motivic cohomology on the Bloch-Levine cycle complex. This generalizes some results of Bloch and Levine relating higher Chow groups and motivic cohomology to the case of schemes over an arbitrary base, and which need not be smooth or equidimensional.
items.excerpt_zh: 本文使用动机同伦理论研究任意有限类型分离格式的高级 Chow 群，作为 Bachmann-Elmanto-Morrow 的 $\mathbb{A}^1$-不变动机上同调的 Borel-Moore 对应物。我们在有限类型分离方案 $X$ 的 G 理论谱上构建了一个过滤，引入了 Atiyah-Hirzebruch 风格的谱序列，其相关的分级片段是计算 $X$ 的更高 Chow 群的复数。我们证明该复形在稳定的动机同伦范畴中是可表示的，并且是 $\mathbb{A}^1$-动机复形上的一个模，从而在布洛赫-莱文循环复形上产生 $\mathbb{A}^1$-不变动机上同调的作用。这概括了 Bloch 和 Levine 将更高 Chow 群和动机上同调与任意基上的方案的情况联系起来的一些结果，并且不需要是光滑的或等维的。
items.title_zh: 动机 Borel-Moore 同调 是 Borel-Moore 动机同调

items.title: Horrocks-Mumford sheaves on toric varieties
items.excerpt: Previous work of the authors introduced the class of Horrocks-Mumford sheaves over normal algebraic k-varieties, the most prominent example being the classical Horrocks-Mumford bundle on projective four-space. For a smooth semiprojective toric variety, we derive an explicit description of these sheaves in terms of finitely generated graded modules over the Cox ring which we use for an algorithmic treatment. In particular, we discuss some explicit examples, their indecomposability and local freeness.
items.authors: Klaus Altmann, Andreas Hochenegger, Frederik Witt
items.excerpt_zh: 作者之前的工作介绍了普通代数 k 簇上的 Horrocks-Mumford 滑轮类，最突出的例子是射影四空间上的经典 Horrocks-Mumford 丛。对于平滑的半射影复曲面变体，我们根据 Cox 环上有限生成的分级模块得出这些滑轮的明确描述，我们将其用于算法处理。特别是，我们讨论了一些明确的例子，它们的不可分解性和局部自由性。
items.title_zh: Horrocks-Mumford 滑轮对复曲面品种的影响

items.title: Powers of projective lines inside full flag varieties
items.excerpt: Up to now, symplectic foliations of Poisson varieties have been primarily studied from a set theoretic perspective by describing their symplectic leaves individually as orbit closures. In the direction of obtaining algebro-geometric characterizations, for the standard Poisson structure $\pi$ on the full flag variety $G/B_+$ of a complex semisimple algebraic group $G$, we prove that the irreducible components of the reduced part of the 0-degeneracy locus of $(G/B_+, \pi)$ are precisely the inclusion-maximal $T$-stable complete Poisson submanifolds of $(G/B_+, \pi)$ that are isomorphic to powers of $\mathbb{P}^1$. This characterization is based on a theorem that explicitly classifies the closed Richardson varieties of $G/B_+$ isomorphic to $(\mathbb{P}^1)^d$. In turn, this theorem is based on a general theorem for arbitrary $T$-stable subvarieties of full flag varieties $G/B_+$ isomorphic to $(\mathbb{P}^1)^d$.
items.title_zh: 全旗品种内射影线的幂
items.excerpt_zh: 迄今为止，泊松簇的辛叶化主要是从一套理论角度进行研究，将其辛叶单独描述为轨道闭合。在获得代数几何表征的方向上，对于复半单代数群$G$的全旗簇$G/B_+$上的标准泊松结构$\pi$，我们证明$(G/B_+, \pi)$的0-简并轨迹的约化部分的不可约分量正是以下的包含最大$T$稳定完全泊松子流形$(G/B_+, \pi)$ 同构于 $\mathbb{P}^1$ 的幂。此表征基于一个定理，该定理明确地将 $G/B_+$ 的封闭理查森簇同构于 $(\mathbb{P}^1)^d$。反过来，该定理基于全旗品种 $G/B_+$ 的任意 $T$ 稳定子品种与 $(\mathbb{P}^1)^d$ 同构的一般定理。

items.title: Counting real meromorphic differentials on $\mathbb{CP}^1$
items.excerpt: The counting problem for meromorphic differentials on $\mathbb{CP}^1$ with fixed orders of zeros and poles and vanishing residues at some specific poles, up to the action of $\mathrm{PGL}_2(\mathbb{C})$ and the multiplication by a nonzero constant, was completely solved before by several authors. In all the cases when there are finitely many such meromorphic differentials, an explicit formula for their number was found and also, in the case of residueless meromorphic differentials with two zeros, a link to the WDVV equations and the KP hierarchy was established. We consider a real analog of these counting problems by requiring that a meromorphic differential is preserved by a real structure on $\mathbb{CP}^1$. Our real counting problems admit refinements, obtained for example by specifying the orders of poles and zeros that are fixed by the antiholomorphic involution. We obtain explicit formulas for all our real counting problems and also, in the case of real meromorphic differentials with two complex conjugate zeros and residueless poles, establish a link to the open WDVV equations and the system of equations for the wave function of
items.title_zh: 计算 $\mathbb{CP}^1$ 上的真实亚态差异
items.excerpt_zh: $\mathbb{CP}^1$ 上的亚纯微分的计数问题，具有固定的零和极点顺序以及某些特定极点的消失残差，直到 $\mathrm{PGL}_2(\mathbb{C})$ 的作用以及与非零常数的乘法，之前已被几位作者完全解决。在存在有限多个此类亚纯微分的所有情况下，找到了其数量的显式公式，并且在具有两个零的无余数亚纯微分的情况下，建立了与 WDVV 方程和 KP 层次结构的链接。我们通过要求 $\mathbb{CP}^1$ 上的真实结构保留亚纯微分来考虑这些计数问题的真实模拟。我们的实际计数问题允许改进，例如通过指定由反全纯对合固定的极点和零点的阶数来获得。我们获得了所有实计数问题的显式公式，并且在具有两个复共轭零点和无余极点的实亚纯微分的情况下，建立了与开放式 WDVV 方程和波函数方程组的链接

items.title: Construction and discrete approximation of the renormalized fractional parabolic Anderson model
items.excerpt: For a directed polymer in a discrete fractional Gaussian environment, we identify the scaling limit of its partition field with the renormalized Stratonovich solution of the one-dimensional parabolic Anderson model with fractional noise and flat initial condition. The underlying walk is simple and symmetric, and the temporal and spatial Hurst indices satisfy $H_0>\frac12$, $\frac12\le H_1<1$ and $2H_0+H_1<2$. After an explicit deterministic normalization, the interpolated partition field converges in law in $C_{\rm loc}([0,\infty)\times\R)$, with convergence of all finite moments of its supremum norm on compacts. We construct the limiting field directly by smoothing the noise in the equation and subtracting the corresponding stationary counterterm. The classical solutions converge in $L^p(\Omega;C(\mathcal K))$ for every $1\le p<\infty$ and every compact space-time rectangle $\mathcal K$, including those that meet the initial line $t=0$. For $2H_0+H_1>\frac53$, the limit agrees with the solution that Chen, Ouyang, Tindel and the author constructed using regularity structures. The construction also covers the new range $\frac32<2H_0+H_
items.title_zh: 重正化分数抛物线安德森模型的构建和离散逼近
items.excerpt_zh: 对于离散分数高斯环境中的定向聚合物，我们通过具有分数噪声和平坦初始条件的一维抛物线安德森模型的重正化 Stratonovich 解来确定其分配场的缩放极限。底层行走简单且对称，时空 Hurst 指数满足 $H_0>\frac12$、$\frac12\le H_1<1$ 和 $2H_0+H_1<2$。经过明确的确定性归一化后，插值划分场在 $C_{\rm loc}([0,\infty)\times\R)$ 中收敛，其最高范数的所有有限矩都收敛于紧致上。我们通过平滑方程中的噪声并减去相应的平稳反项来直接构造极限场。对于每个 $1\le p<\infty$ 和每个紧凑时空矩形 $\mathcal K$，经典解收敛于 $L^p(\Omega;C(\mathcal K))$，包括那些满足初始线 $t=0$ 的解。对于 $2H_0+H_1>\frac53$，极限与 Chen、Ouyang、Tindel 和作者使用正则结构构造的解一致。该结构还涵盖了新的范围 $\frac32<2H_0+H_

items.title: Weak and Strong Moments of Log-Concave Measures
items.excerpt: Let $X\in\mathbb{R}^d$ be a log-concave random vector, and let $N$ be a seminorm on $\mathbb{R}^d$. For $p\ge 1$, we show that $\|N(X)\|_p$ is at most $\mathbb{E} N(X)+C s_p$, where $s_p$ is the supremum of $\|u(X)\|_p$ over all linear functionals $u$ satisfying $|u(x)|\le N(x)$ for every $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$. A choice for $C$ is $2+5e/2$. This bound implies Lata{\l}a's conjecture on weak and strong moments.
items.title_zh: 对数凹测度的弱矩和强矩
items.excerpt_zh: 令$X\in\mathbb{R}^d$ 为对数凹随机向量，并令$N$ 为$\mathbb{R}^d$ 上的半范数。对于 $p\ge 1$，我们证明 $\|N(X)\|_p$ 至多是 $\mathbb{E} N(X)+C s_p$，其中 $s_p$ 是 $\|u(X)\|_p$ 在所有满足 $|u(x)|\le N(x)$ 的线性泛函 $u$ 上的上界，对于每个 $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$。 $C$ 的选择是 $2+5e/2$。这个界限暗示了 Lata{\l}a 对弱矩和强矩的猜想。

items.title: Slow and rapid mixing in $\mathbb{Z}_2$ hyperlattice gauge theory
items.excerpt: The Ising model under Glauber dynamics on the torus is known to exhibit a phase transition in its mixing time. The mixing is exponentially slow when $\beta >\beta_c$ and logarithmically fast when $\beta <\beta_c$. In this paper, we generalize the slow-mixing result to $\mathbb{Z}_2$ hyperlattice gauge theory when $\beta$ is large enough. This is a higher-dimensional analogue of the Ising model, with spins on $k$-cells. Specifically, on the torus of any dimension $m \ge k+2$, we prove explicit exponential lower bounds on the mixing time of Glauber dynamics when $\beta$ is sufficiently large. More precisely, we prove that the result holds for a broader class of dynamics, allowing more than one $k$-cell to change its value at each step of the algorithm. Finally, we show that there are distinct slow and rapid mixing regimes, as for sufficiently small $\beta$ the Dobrushin condition is satisfied for Glauber dynamics under the heat-bath rule, which implies logarithmic mixing.
items.title_zh: $\mathbb{Z}_2$超晶格规范理论中的缓慢和快速混合
items.excerpt_zh: 众所周知，圆环上格劳伯动力学下的伊辛模型在其混合时间内表现出相变。当 $\beta >\beta_c$ 时，混合呈指数慢，当 $\beta <\beta_c$ 时，混合呈对数快。在本文中，当$\beta$足够大时，我们将慢混合结果推广到$\mathbb{Z}_2$超晶格规范理论。这是伊辛模型的高维模拟，在 $k$ 个单元上自旋。具体来说，在任何维度 $m \ge k+2$ 的环面上，当 $\beta$ 足够大时，我们证明了格劳伯动力学混合时间的显式指数下界。更准确地说，我们证明该结果适用于更广泛的动力学类别，允许多个 $k$ 单元在算法的每一步改变其值。最后，我们表明存在明显的慢速和快速混合机制，对于足够小的 $\beta$，在热浴规则下满足格劳伯动力学的 Dobrushin 条件，这意味着对数混合。

items.title: The Contact Process with Temporary Immunity on $\mathbb{Z}$
items.excerpt: We develop a regeneration scheme for the one-dimensional contact process with temporary immunity, also known as the spatial SIRS process, a non-attractive interacting particle system. The key ingredient is a one-sided space-time shielding mechanism, constructed from infinite infection paths of an auxiliary process. These paths separate the evolution of the infection front from the configuration and graphical history left behind, allowing us to construct regeneration times without relying on attractiveness. The same shielding mechanism also provides coupling arguments for processes started from different initial configurations. Using this approach, we establish a law of large numbers and a functional central limit theorem for the right edge, existence and uniqueness of an invariant law for the process seen from the edge, and complete convergence. We also prove survival from every nonempty finite infected set for sufficiently large immunity-loss rates and derive an explicit extinction criterion.
items.authors: Thomas Mountford, Rafael Santos, C\'elio Terra, Maria Eul\'alia Vares
items.title_zh: $\mathbb{Z}$ 上具有临时免疫的接触过程
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了一种具有临时免疫性的一维接触过程的再生方案，也称为空间 SIRS 过程，一种无吸引力的相互作用粒子系统。其关键要素是一种单方面的时空屏蔽机制，由辅助进程的无限感染路径构建而成。这些路径将感染前沿的演变与留下的配置和图形历史分开，使我们能够在不依赖吸引力的情况下构建再生时间。相同的屏蔽机制还为从不同初始配置启动的进程提供耦合参数。利用这种方法，我们建立了右边缘的大数定律和泛函中心极限定理，从边缘看过程的不变律的存在性和唯一性，以及完全收敛。我们还证明了每个非空有限感染集在足够大的免疫损失率下的存活率，并得出了明确的灭绝标准。

items.title: Strong Well-Posedness for One-Dimensional Quantile-Dependent SDEs with H\"older-Continuous Diffusion
items.excerpt: We establish strong well-posedness for one-dimensional stochastic differential equations whose drift and diffusion coefficients depend on a prescribed quantile of the solution's marginal law. The diffusion coefficient is uniformly non-degenerate and H\"older continuous in space. The drift is the sum of a non-increasing H\"older-continuous component and a globally Lipschitz component of at most linear growth. Both components are Lipschitz continuous in the quantile variable. The main obstacles are the limited spatial regularity of the diffusion and the quantitative control of quantiles in terms of the $L^1$-distance between densities. We freeze the quantile path and combine uniform H\"older estimates for the resulting densities with a cancellation argument for the second-order diffusion perturbation. This yields an $L^1$-stability estimate for the frozen density flows and, together with uniform tail bounds and positive lower density bounds, a Volterra-type estimate for the frozen quantile map. An exponentially weighted supremum norm makes this map a strict contraction on $[0,T]$, giving a unique self-consistent quantile path and hence
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为一维随机微分方程建立了强适定性，其漂移和扩散系数取决于解的边际定律的规定分位数。扩散系数在空间中一致非简并且 H\"older 连续。漂移是非增加 H\"older 连续分量和至多线性增长的全局 Lipschitz 分量之和。两个分量在分位数变量中都是 Lipschitz 连续的。主要障碍是扩散的有限空间规律性以及根据密度之间的 $L^1$ 距离进行分位数的定量控制。我们冻结分位数路径，并将所得密度的统一 H\"older 估计与二阶扩散扰动的取消参数相结合。这产生了冻结密度流的 $L^1$ 稳定性估计，并与统一的尾部边界和正下密度边界一起，为冻结分位数图提供了 Volterra 型估计。指数加权的上范数使该图成为 $[0,T]$ 上的严格收缩，从而给出了独特的自洽分位数路径，因此
items.title_zh: 具有H\"旧连续扩散的一维分位数相关SDE的强适定性

items.title: DLR variational principle for the one-dimensional log-gas and another proof of existence of Sine-beta
items.excerpt: We show that every stationary solution of the Dobrushin--Lanford--Ruelle (DLR) equations for the one-dimensional log-gas with a quantitative control on its number variance minimizes the free energy functional. This yields a DLR variational principle for this continuous long-range system. Moreover, we show that any limit point of the finite-volume log-gases is stationary and satisfies this condition. This allows us to give a new, physical proof of the existence of a microscopic limit for the Gaussian Beta Ensembles, known as the Sine-beta point process.
items.title_zh: 一维对数气体的 DLR 变分原理和 Sine-beta 存在的另一个证明
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，一维对数气体的 Dobrushin--Lanford--Ruelle (DLR) 方程的每个平稳解（对其数量方差进行定量控制）都会使自由能泛函最小化。这就产生了这个连续远程系统的 DLR 变分原理。此外，我们证明了有限体积对数气体的任何极限点都是平稳的并且满足这个条件。这使我们能够为高斯 Beta 系综（称为正弦 Beta 点过程）存在微观极限提供新的物理证明。

items.title: Singular Birth-Death model
items.excerpt: We introduce and study a one-dimensional singular birth-death model constructed from It\^o's Brownian excursion measure. In this model, particles are born at the origin at infinite rate, evolve as Brownian excursions away from the origin, and are killed upon returning to the origin. Although the number of particles alive at any fixed deterministic time is almost surely finite, we prove that the set of exceptional times at which infinitely many particles are alive is almost surely dense and has Hausdorff dimension $1/2$. We further investigate the spatial structure of the particle system at such exceptional times. In particular, we identify the critical near-origin profile of the infinite particle cloud, which is governed by a scale of order $\log\log(1/|x|)^{-1}$ as $x\downarrow0$. Finally, we establish laws of large numbers and central limit theorems for two natural observables of the system: the $\alpha$-power sum of the positions of all alive particles and the top particle position.
items.title_zh: 单一生死模型
items.excerpt_zh: 我们引入并研究了根据 It\^o 的布朗偏移测度构建的一维奇异生灭模型。在这个模型中，粒子以无限的速率在原点产生，随着布朗运动远离原点而演化，并在返回原点时被杀死。尽管在任何固定确定性时间存活的粒子数量几乎肯定是有限的，但我们证明了无限多个粒子存活的异常时间集合几乎肯定是稠密的，并且具有豪斯多夫维度 $1/2$。我们进一步研究了这种特殊时期粒子系统的空间结构。特别是，我们确定了无限粒子云的临界近原点轮廓，该轮廓由 $\log\log(1/|x|)^{-1}$ 阶尺度控制，即 $x\downarrow0$。最后，我们为系统的两个自然可观测量建立大数定律和中心极限定理：所有存活粒子位置的 $\alpha$ 幂和以及顶部粒子位置。

items.title: Local limit theorem for branching processes with immigration
items.excerpt: Let $\{Y_{n}, n\geq 0\}$ be a critical branching process with immigration. Under the minimal moment restrictions, namely, assuming finite variance for the number of particles of the offspring and finite mean for the number of immigrating particles, we obtain a local limit theorem for the process $\{Y_{n}\}$.
items.authors: Sadillo Sharipov, Alexander Tarasov, Vitali Wachtel
items.title_zh: 移民分支过程的局部极限定理
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\{Y_{n}, n\geq 0\}$ 为移民的关键分支过程。在最小矩限制下，即假设子代粒子数的方差有限，迁移粒子数的均值有限，我们得到过程$\{Y_{n}\}$的局部极限定理。

items.title: Two-Sided Projection-Based Model Reduction of Parametric Generalized Algebraic Riccati Equations via Grassmann-Manifold Optimization
items.excerpt: Parametric generalized algebraic Riccati equations arise in many-query problems in optimal control, state estimation, and filtering, where repeated full-order solutions may become computationally prohibitive for large-scale systems. In this paper, within a projection-based model reduction framework, we propose a two-sided projection approach that constructs reduced bases by minimizing the aggregate relative two-sided projection error of Riccati solution snapshots. Under suitable dissipativity assumptions, the resulting Galerkin-projected PGARE admits a unique symmetric positive semidefinite stabilizing solution. For error assessment, we employ an existing residual-based a posteriori error estimator for the full-order Riccati residual. A projection-based error decomposition developed in this work provides the theoretical motivation for the proposed basis construction. To accommodate clustered solution manifolds, we extend the framework to localized model reduction by combining parameter-space proximity and solution-space correlation for clustering, with classifier-based online basis selection. Numerical experiments on parameterized hea
items.authors: Xuelian Wen, Qiuqi Li, Juan Zhang
items.excerpt_zh: 参数广义代数 Riccati 方程出现在最优控制、状态估计和滤波中的多查询问题中，其中重复的全阶解对于大规模系统来说可能在计算上难以实现。在本文中，在基于投影的模型缩减框架内，我们提出了一种两侧投影方法，该方法通过最小化 Riccati 解快照的相对两侧投影总误差来构造缩减基数。在适当的耗散性假设下，所得的伽辽金投影 PGARE 具有独特的对称正半定稳定解。对于误差评估，我们采用现有的基于残差的后验误差估计器来进行全阶 Riccati 残差。这项工作中开发的基于投影的误差分解为所提出的基础构建提供了理论动力。为了适应聚类的解流形，我们通过将聚类的参数空间邻近性和解空间相关性与基于分类器的在线基础选择相结合，将框架扩展到局部模型简化。参数化热数值实验
items.title_zh: 通过格拉斯曼流形优化对参数化广义代数 Riccati 方程进行基于两侧投影的模型简化

items.title: Global Lanczos with stochastic error correction for trace estimation of matrix functions
items.excerpt: We propose a new method for computing the trace of a matrix function $f(A)$, where $A$ is a large, sparse, symmetric matrix. Our approach combines a deterministic global Lanczos approximation with a stochastic correction of its error. Starting the global Lanczos process with the identity matrix yields a direct approximation of the trace through a small tridiagonal matrix. The resulting basis matrices are polynomials in $A$, allowing the process to be implemented using sparse matrix-matrix multiplications when low-degree polynomials in $A$ have moderate fill-in. However, increased fill-in may limit the number of iterations that can be performed efficiently. To address this limitation, we derive an exact representation of the global Lanczos error as the trace of a matrix function and apply a stochastic estimator to the remainder. Even a moderately accurate estimate can substantially improve the accuracy, combining the deterministic method with the rapid initial convergence of stochastic trace estimators. We discuss error bounds and variance reduction, and present numerical experiments that compare the resulting method with existing ones
items.authors: Michele Rinelli, Igor Simunec, Robbe Vermeiren
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一种计算矩阵函数 $f(A)$ 迹的新方法，其中 $A$ 是一个大的稀疏对称矩阵。我们的方法将确定性全局 Lanczos 近似与其误差的随机校正相结合。使用单位矩阵启动全局 Lanczos 过程会通过一个小的三对角矩阵产生轨迹的直接近似。生成的基矩阵是 $A$ 中的多项式，当 $A$ 中的低次多项式具有适度的填充时，允许使用稀疏矩阵-矩阵乘法来实现该过程。然而，增加填充可能会限制可以有效执行的迭代次数。为了解决这个限制，我们将全局 Lanczos 误差精确表示为矩阵函数的迹，并对余数应用随机估计器。通过将确定性方法与随机迹估计器的快速初始收敛相结合，即使是中等准确的估计也可以显着提高准确性。我们讨论误差范围和方差减少，并提出数值实验，将所得方法与现有方法进行比较
items.title_zh: 具有随机误差校正的全局 Lanczos，用于矩阵函数的迹估计

items.title: Spectral Conditioning of Weighted Multivariate Vandermonde Operators via Radial Beurling--Selberg Approximation
items.excerpt: We establish explicit eigenvalue bounds for Gram matrices of weighted multivariate Vandermonde operators with separated nodes on a torus. The squared magnitudes of the weights are samples of a nonnegative radial spectral energy density whose profile has bounded variation, finite energy, and finite weighted variation cost; compact support is not required. The estimate holds in every dimension and depends on the periodic Euclidean separation and the weighted variation integral. For compactly supported profiles, our analysis combines a signed layer decomposition with the ball approximants of Holt and Vaaler; the noncompactly supported case follows by truncation. Combining the resulting radial envelopes with a bandlimited sampling identity based on Poisson summation yields the spectral bounds by eliminating off-diagonal interactions and nonzero diagonal aliases. The result covers nonmonotone profiles and discontinuous radial low-pass filters, and it is complemented by a global elementary upper bound on the Holt--Vaaler cost that exhibits two radial regimes.
items.authors: Joseph Gabet, Maxime Ferreira Da Costa, Kiryung Lee
items.title_zh: 通过径向 Beurling-Selberg 近似对加权多元 Vandermonde 算子进行谱调节
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为加权多元 Vandermonde 算子的 Gram 矩阵建立显式特征值界，该算子在环面上具有分离的节点。权重的平方大小是非负径向谱能量密度的样本，其轮廓具有有界变化、有限能量和有限加权变化成本；不需要紧凑的支撑。该估计在每个维度上都成立，并且取决于周期性欧几里德分离和加权变异积分。对于紧支撑轮廓，我们的分析将带符号层分解与 Holt 和 Vaaler 的球近似相结合；非紧支持的情况随后是截断。将所得的径向包络与基于泊松求和的带限采样恒等式相结合，通过消除非对角线相互作用和非零对角线别名来产生频谱边界。结果涵盖非单调分布和不连续径向低通滤波器，并由显示两个径向状态的 Holt-Vaaler 成本的全局基本上限进行补充。

items.title: NeRI: Neural Residual Iteration for Elliptic Operator Equations and Variational Inequalities
items.excerpt: In this work, we propose a so-called {\it Neural Residual Iteration} (NeRI), a weak-form neural-network framework for solving a class of elliptic operator equations and variational inequalities, including nonlinear and nonsymmetric problems that may not admit a global energy functional. The key idea is to construct, at each iteration, a state-dependent linear functional whose derivative with respect to the trial function recovers the current weak residual. A single gradient step is then performed on the residual, yielding a residual-driven neural update without requiring a global energy functional or an additional test network. From a function-space perspective, NeRI can be interpreted as a neural-tangent-kernel-preconditioned realization of classical residual iterations, thereby bridging classical iterative solvers and neural-network optimization. We further extend NeRI to elliptic variational inequalities (VIs) through penalized and constraint-preserving formulations. For wide two-layer networks under gradient flow, we prove finite-time lazy-training estimates and derive an $H^1$-error decomposition relative to the exact weak soluti
items.title_zh: NeRI：椭圆算子方程和变分不等式的神经残差迭代
items.excerpt_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种所谓的神经残差迭代（NeRI），这是一种弱形式的神经网络框架，用于求解一类椭圆算子方程和变分不等式，包括可能不允许全局能量泛函的非线性和非对称问题。关键思想是在每次迭代时构造一个状态相关的线性函数，其相对于试验函数的导数恢复当前的弱残差。然后对残差执行单个梯度步骤，产生残差驱动的神经更新，而不需要全局能量函数或额外的测试网络。从函数空间的角度来看，NeRI 可以解释为经典残差迭代的神经切线核预处理实现，从而桥接经典迭代求解器和神经网络优化。我们通过惩罚和约束保持公式进一步将 NeRI 扩展到椭圆变分不等式（VI）。对于梯度流下的宽两层网络，我们证明了有限时间惰性训练估计，并导出相对于精确弱解的 $H^1$ 误差分解

items.title: Delay Closure of Observable Dynamics for the Heat Equation
items.excerpt: We study finite-delay representations of point observables, which are solution values at selected spatial locations, for spatially discretized heat equations. We show that the observables satisfy closed dynamical systems whose evolution depends only on their own history, without requiring solution values elsewhere in the domain. Using semigroup properties, we analyze low-rank approximate closures that can use substantially fewer delay terms than the exact representation. We consider two computational approaches: direct least-squares fitting of delay coefficients from observable trajectories and shift-invert Krylov approximation of the semigroup using preconditioned linear solves. Numerical experiments for constant- and variable-coefficient heat equations in one, two, and three dimensions illustrate the effects of memory length and sensor information on prediction. The results are consistent with the theoretical analysis.
items.authors: Xiaoting Han, Dongbin Xiu, Ludmil T. Zikatanov
items.title_zh: 热方程可观测动力学的延迟收敛
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究点可观测量的有限延迟表示，这些点可观测量是空间离散热方程在选定空间位置的解值。我们证明，可观测量满足封闭动力系统，其演化仅取决于它们自己的历史，而不需要域中其他地方的解值。使用半群属性，我们分析了低秩近似闭包，它可以使用比精确表示少得多的延迟项。我们考虑两种计​​算方法：来自可观察轨迹的延迟系数的直接最小二乘拟合和使用预条件线性求解的半群的移位反转 Krylov 近似。一维、二维和三维的常系数和变系数热方程的数值实验说明了存储器长度和传感器信息对预测的影响。结果与理论分析一致。

items.title: Pole rigidity in root-optimal rational approximation of the exponential on infinite sectors
items.excerpt: The optimal root convergence factor for uniform rational approximation of the exponential on an infinite sector is classical. We prove that, for every fixed infinite sector of opening less than $\pi$, the normalized pole-counting measures of any reduced root-optimal sequence, after scaling the poles by degree, converge weakly to a uniquely determined probability measure supported on a compact analytic arc outside the sector. For the half-line, the corresponding pole law was previously announced by Stahl and Schmelzer; our new result covers sectors of positive opening. The proof rules out boundary pole accumulation and controls an exponentially small Hermite residual through reflection and noncancellation, without assuming interpolation or orthogonality. We explicitly construct the equilibrium measure and its supporting arc in terms of a zero of a Ferrers function, and relate this parameterization to the Gonchar--Rakhmanov theta equation. We also obtain a degree-independent comparison for simultaneous approximation of finitely many $\varphi$-functions with a common denominator. Numerical pole distributions support the theoretical law.
items.title_zh: 无限扇区上指数的根最优有理逼近中的极刚度
items.excerpt_zh: 无限扇区上指数的一致有理逼近的最佳根收敛因子是经典的。我们证明，对于每个开度小于 $\pi$ 的固定无限扇区，任何简化根最优序列的归一化极点计数度量在按度缩放极点后，会弱地收敛到扇区外部紧凑分析弧所支持的唯一确定的概率度量。对于半线，相应的极点定律之前由斯塔尔和施梅尔泽公布；我们的新结果涵盖了积极开放的领域。该证明排除了边界极点累积，并通过反射和非抵消控制指数级小的 Hermite 残差，无需假设插值或正交性。我们根据 Ferrers 函数的零点明确构造均衡测度及其支撑弧，并将该参数化与 Gonchar-Rakhmanov theta 方程相关联。我们还获得了具有公分母的有限多个$\varphi$函数的同时逼近的与度无关的比较。数值极点分布支持理论定律。

items.title: Martingale and signed diffusive optimal transport: geodesics and gradient flows
items.excerpt: In signed diffusive transport, a path of probability densities $\rho_t$ on the circle and a momentum $m_t$ satisfy $\partial_t\rho=\partial_{xx}m$, and the cost of the path is the action $\int_0^1\int m^2/(2\rho)\,dx\,dt$. The diffusivity $m/\rho$ is an unknown of this variational problem and can take either sign. On the real line, the constraint $m\ge0$ gives the martingale Benamou-Brenier problem of Huesmann and Trevisan. We study geodesics and minimizing movements, which discretize gradient flows. For signed geodesics, we prove the $\Gamma$-convergence of the time-discrete problems for all probability endpoints, and of the fully discrete Fourier-grid problems as the space and time meshes tend to zero independently, without a positive lower bound on the densities. For a modified Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) scheme on the torus, we prove convergence along subsequences to a weak solution of a fourth-order equation, the Derrida-Lebowitz-Speer-Spohn equation for the entropy in dimension one, under the assumption that the densities of the scheme stay above a positive constant on every finite time interval. In dimension one, the normali
items.authors: Aymeric Baradat, Jean-David Benamou, Fran\c{c}ois-Xavier Vialard
items.title_zh: Martingale 和带符号扩散最优传输：测地线和梯度流
items.excerpt_zh: 在有符号扩散传输中，圆上概率密度 $\rho_t$ 和动量 $m_t$ 的路径满足 $\partial_t\rho=\partial_{xx}m$，路径的成本是动作 $\int_0^1\int m^2/(2\rho)\,dx\,dt$。扩散率 $m/\rho$ 是该变分问题的未知数，可以采用任一符号。在实线上，约束 $m\ge0$ 给出了 Huesmann 和 Trevisan 的鞅 Benamou-Brenier 问题。我们研究测地线和最小化运动，从而离散梯度流。对于有符号测地线，我们证明了所有概率端点的时间离散问题的 $\Gamma$ 收敛性，以及当空间和时间网格独立趋于零时完全离散傅里叶网格问题的 $\Gamma$ 收敛性，而密度没有正下界。对于环面上改进的 Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) 格式，我们证明了沿着四阶方程（一维熵的 Derrida-Lebowitz-Speer-Spohn 方程）的弱解的子序列的收敛性，假设该格式的密度在每个有限时间间隔上保持在正常数之上。在第一维中，法线

items.title: Spectral Gaps and Low-Energy Modes in Anisotropic High-Contrast PDEs
items.excerpt: We study the low-energy spectrum of high-contrast partial differential equations with strongly anisotropic inclusions. The inclusion stiffness and mass are scaled by a contrast parameter \(\eta\), while a small material eigenvalue \(\epsilon\) controls anisotropy. Stable extensions of local kernel fields give eigenvalue upper bounds proportional to the inverse contrast, uniformly in anisotropy. Additional low-energy modes arise from fields whose nonzero differential images lie in weak material directions. Each fixed family of compatible weak fields yields additional eigenvalue upper bounds of order $\epsilon+ \eta^{-1}$, provided a stable extension exists. Under discrete stability assumptions, we obtain corresponding finite element bounds for the weak modes represented by the mesh. For separable scalar diffusion, we prove norm-resolvent convergence to independent background Dirichlet and inclusion Neumann operators as contrast tends to infinity with anisotropy fixed. Numerical experiments for four PDE models illustrate weak modes and mesh-dependent spectral transitions, and scalar diffusion experiments also test spectral decoupling an
items.authors: Yajun Wang, Eric T. Chung, Lijian Jiang
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究具有强各向异性夹杂物的高对比度偏微分方程的低能谱。夹杂物刚度和质量通过对比参数 \(\eta\) 进行缩放，而小的材料特征值 \(\epsilon\) 控制各向异性。局部核场的稳定扩展给出了与反对比度成正比的特征值上限，各向异性一致。其他低能模式由非零微分图像位于弱材料方向的场产生。如果存在稳定的扩展，每个固定的兼容弱场族都会产生 $\epsilon+ \eta^{-1}$ 阶的附加特征值上限。在离散稳定性假设下，我们获得了网格表示的弱模式的相应有限元边界。对于可分离标量扩散，我们证明了独立背景狄利克雷和包含诺依曼算子的范数分辨收敛性，因为在各向异性固定的情况下对比度趋于无穷大。四个偏微分方程模型的数值实验说明了弱模式和依赖于网格的光谱跃迁，标量扩散实验还测试了光谱解耦和
items.title_zh: 各向异性高对比度偏微分方程中的谱间隙和低能量模式

items.title: Relational Semantics and Completeness for Onto-Epistemic Logic
items.excerpt: This paper investigates a relational semantics for onto-epistemic logic with two semi-negations. The frames carry two pairs of quasi-orders and two commuting involutions. Some frames have nondistributive lattices of stable sets. The four- and nine-valued entailments are recovered as joint entailment on two particular finite frames. Sound and complete binary consequence calculi are given for both component entailments and for joint entailment. The joint Lindenbaum algebra embeds subdirectly into the product of its two component quotients. This embedding shows that joint derivability is the intersection of the two component derivability relations. The finite model property is proved using Dedekind-MacNeille completion and a filter-ideal representation of the resulting lattice. All three entailments are decidable by interleaving the search for a derivation with the search for a finite countermodel.
items.excerpt_zh: 本文研究了具有两个半否定的本体认知逻辑的关系语义。这些框架带有两对准阶和两个通勤对合。一些框架具有稳定集的非分配格。四值和九值蕴涵被恢复为两个特定有限框架上的联合蕴涵。对于分量蕴涵和联合蕴涵都给出了健全且完整的二元结果演算。联合 Lindenbaum 代数直接嵌入到其两个分量商的乘积中。这种嵌入表明联合可导性是两个分量可导性关系的交集。使用 Dedekind-MacNeille 完成和所得晶格的过滤理想表示来证明有限模型属性。通过将对推导的搜索与对有限反模型的搜索交织在一起，所有三个蕴涵都是可判定的。
items.title_zh: 关系语义和本体认知逻辑的完整性

items.title: A note on distributive lattices with a commutative generalized implication
items.excerpt: We study distributive lattices with an ideal-valued generalized implication satisfying a commutativity identity. This class extends commutative weak Heyting algebras by allowing implication values to be non-principal ideals. We characterize its intersection with several known classes of gi-lattices, study gi-deductive systems and their relationship with gi-filters and gi-congruences, and extend the relational characterization of commutativity to this setting. The resulting correspondence yields a Priestley-style duality by restricting the established duality for gi-lattices.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究具有满足交换律恒等式的理想值广义蕴涵的分配格。此类通过允许蕴含值为非主理想来扩展交换弱 Heyting 代数。我们描述了它与几个已知类别的 gi 格的交集，研究 gi 演绎系统及其与 gi 过滤器和 gi 同余的关系，并将交换性的关系表征扩展到此设置。通过限制 gi 格的既定对偶性，由此产生的对应关系产生了普里斯特利式的对偶性。
items.title_zh: 关于具有交换广义蕴涵的分配格的注记

items.title: Chang's Omitting Types Theorem in Lukasiewicz Logic
items.excerpt: We prove Chang-style omitting types theorems for standard first-order Lukasiewicz logic. Starting from a prescribed model $M$, we obtain an extension that omits higher-complexity types while preserving lower-level types already realized in $M$. If $T$ is a $\Pi_{n+2}$-theory, every model of $T$ has an exact extension that preserves its realized $\Sigma_{n+1}$-types and omits every $\Sigma_{n+2}$-type not generated by a $\Sigma_{n+1}$-type. An iterated construction also omits infinity-universal types, whose unbounded quantifier complexity cannot eventually be generated by the corresponding lower-complexity fragments of a single type. The main tool is a refinement of Robinson's infinite forcing sensitive to the quantifier complexity of formulas.
items.title_zh: Lukasiewicz 逻辑中的 Chang 省略类型定理
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了标准一阶 Lukasiewicz 逻辑的 Chang 式省略类型定理。从规定的模型 $M$ 开始，我们获得了一个扩展，该扩展省略了较高复杂性的类型，同时保留了 $M$ 中已实现的较低级别的类型。如果$T$是一个$\Pi_{n+2}$-理论，则$T$的每个模型都有一个精确的扩展，保留其实现的$\Sigma_{n+1}$-类型，并省略不是由$\Sigma_{n+1}$-类型生成的每个$\Sigma_{n+2}$-类型。迭代构造还省略了无限通用类型，其无限量词复杂性最终不能由单一类型的相应较低复杂性片段生成。主要工具是罗宾逊对公式量词复杂性敏感的无限强迫的改进。

items.title: Determinateness in a classical theory of nonclassical truth
items.excerpt: Recent theories that take determinateness as primitive are either nonclassical theories of nonclassical truth, like Field's INT, or classical theories of classical truth, like Fujimoto and Halbach's CD and CD^+. This paper develops a third option: a classical theory of nonclassical truth. The theory, KFDcs, extends the Kripke-Feferman theory KFcs with a primitive determinateness predicate. Unlike CD^+, KFDcs keeps the iteration of truth unrestricted and gives up its completeness. With or without a consistency axiom, KFD is proof-theoretically equivalent to the theory \widehat{ID}_2 of twice iterated fixed points, with ordinal {\varphi}({\varphi}({\varepsilon}_0, 0)0), thus stronger than CD^+. It is also shown that replacing full induction with internal induction yields ordinal {\varphi}({\varphi}({\omega}, 0)0), and restricting internal induction to total formulae yields {\varphi}({\varepsilon_0},0), the ordinal of KF.
items.title_zh: 非经典真理的经典理论的确定性
items.excerpt_zh: 最近以确定性为原语的理论要么是非经典真理的非经典理论，如菲尔德的 INT，要么是经典真理的经典理论，如藤本和哈尔巴赫的 CD 和 CD^+。本文提出了第三种选择：非经典真理的经典理论。 KFDcs 理论通过原始确定性谓词扩展了 Kripke-Feferman 理论 KFcs。与 CD^+ 不同，KFDcs 保持真理的迭代不受限制并放弃其完整性。无论有或没有一致性公理，KFD 在理论上证明等价于两次迭代不动点的理论 \widehat{ID}_2，具有序数 {\varphi}({\varphi}({\varepsilon}_0, 0)0)，因此比 CD^+ 更强。还表明，用内部归纳法代替完全归纳法会产生序数 {\varphi}({\varphi}({\omega}, 0)0)，并且将内部归纳法限制为总公式会产生 {\varphi}({\varepsilon_0},0)，即 KF 的序数。

items.title: The Contingent HOD Dichotomy
items.excerpt: The axiom V = HOD, referring to the class of hereditarily ordinal-definable sets, is contingently contingent by forcing---it holds contingently in the generic multiverse of some models of set theory but not others. Thus we introduce and investigate the \emph{contingent HOD dichotomy}, according to which either (1) the set-theoretic universe V is close to HOD by forcing---HOD is a ground, V = HOD is forceable, the universe is ordinal-definable from a set parameter $V=\text{HOD}_b$, the blurry HOD hierarchy collapses to kappa-HOD for some cardinal kappa, and furthermore these features are invariant by forcing and hold throughout the generic multiverse; or (2) the universe V is far from HOD by forcing in all those respects, so $V\neq\text{HOD}$, but also HOD is not a ground, V = HOD is not forceable, the set-theoretic universe is not ordinal-definable from a set, the universe is not kappa-HOD for any kappa, and these features hold invariantly throughout the generic multiverse. We investigate the nature of the dichotomy in connection with large cardinals, with set-theoretic geology, with the iterated $\text{HOD}^\alpha$ classes, and with
items.title_zh: 偶然 HOD 二分法
items.excerpt_zh: 公理 V = HOD，指的是一类可遗传序数定义的集合，是通过强制而偶然发生的——它在某些集合论模型的泛型多元宇宙中偶然成立，但在其他模型中则不然。因此，我们引入并研究了\emph{偶然HOD二分法}，根据该二分法，（1）集合论宇宙V通过强制接近HOD——HOD是一个基础，V = HOD是可强制的，宇宙是可以从集合参数$V=\text{HOD}_b$有序定义的，对于某些基数kappa，模糊的HOD层次结构折叠到kappa-HOD，此外，这些特征是通过在整个通用多元宇宙中强制和保持而保持不变； （2）宇宙 V 通过在所有这些方面的强制而远离 HOD，所以 $V\neq\text{HOD}$，而且 HOD 不是一个基点，V = HOD 不是可强制的，集合论宇宙不是从集合中序数定义的，宇宙对于任何 kappa 都不是 kappa-HOD，并且这些特征在整个通用多元宇宙中保持不变。我们研究了与大基数、集合论地质学、迭代 $\text{HOD}^\alpha$ 类以及与

items.title: A simplified temporal logic completeness proof
items.excerpt: A temporal logic discussed in the author's book "Logics of Time and Computation" is given a simpler proof of semantic completeness, eliminating some flaws in the original.
items.title_zh: 简化的时态逻辑完整性证明
items.excerpt_zh: 作者在《时间与计算的逻辑》一书中讨论的一个时序逻辑给出了更简单的语义完整性证明，消除了原文中的一些缺陷。

items.title: Borel $(2n+1)$-coloring for bounded degree function graphs
items.excerpt: Let $G=(X,E)$ be a Borel graph generated by $n$-many bounded-to-one Borel functions. We show that $G$ admits a Borel proper $(2n+1)$-coloring, which answers a problem of Kechris, Solecki and Todor\v{c}evi\'{c}.
items.title_zh: Borel $(2n+1)$-有界度函数图的着色
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $G=(X,E)$ 为由 $n$ 个有界到一的 Borel 函数生成的 Borel 图。我们证明 $G$ 承认 Borel 适当的 $(2n+1)$-着色，这回答了 Kechris、Solecki 和 Todor\v{c}evi\'{c} 的问题。

items.title: Strong Standard Completeness of a Hypersequent Calculus for Cyclic Involutive Residuated Lattices
items.excerpt: We present a hypersequent calculus $H_R$ for cyclic involutive residuated lattices and prove strong standard completeness for arbitrary theories in a fixed countable propositional language. Standard models are chains on $[0,1]$; neither commutativity nor equality of the monoid unit and the dualizing constant is assumed. The chain semantics is the class $K_R$ defined by unit cyclicity and all ordered finite-history conditions. Every countable member of $K_R$ embeds into a standard chain preserving the entire signature. The construction combines central-support reconstruction, gap insertion and relative contraction. A relative comparison construction supplies the required chain countermodels. We also prove admissibility of the unrestricted density rule for theoremhood and effective elimination from finite proofs without additional assumption leaves. Elimination uses terminating enumeration of density-free proofs; ordinary Cut is retained, and no complexity bound is claimed. Further constructions give bounded standard embeddings for nontrivial countable chains of involutive uninorm logic and pseudo-uninorm logic with weak commutativity.
items.title_zh: 循环对合剩余格的超序微积分的强标准完备性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了循环对合剩余格的超序微积分 $H_R$ ，并证明了固定可数命题语言中任意理论的强标准完备性。标准模型是 $[0,1]$ 上的链；幺半群单位和对偶常数的交换性和相等性均不被假定。链语义是由单位循环和所有有序有限历史条件定义的类 $K_R$。 $K_R$ 的每个可数成员都嵌入到保留整个签名的标准链中。该结构结合了中心支撑重建、间隙插入和相对收缩。相对比较结构提供了所需的链反模型。我们还证明了定理的无限制密度规则的可接受性以及在没有额外假设条件的情况下从有限证明中有效消除。消除使用无密度证明的终止枚举；保留普通剪切，并且不要求复杂性限制。进一步的构造为具有弱交换性的内卷一致逻辑和伪一致逻辑的非平凡可数链提供有界标准嵌入。

items.title: Instructor-designed AI improves learning in a randomized trial across 19 universities
items.excerpt: Universities are alarmed by recent evidence that artificial intelligence (AI) can undermine learning, with students prescribed generic chatbots or centrally designed AI tools performing worse. In a pre-registered randomized controlled trial across 7,200 students at 19 universities over three semesters, we tested whether AI designed by frontline instructors can improve learning. We encouraged instructors to design AI solutions they believed would best help their students. Drawing on their unique knowledge of their classes and students, the instructors created a wide array of innovations. We show that these instructor-designed AI innovations improved student learning, measured by AI-proof assessments (proctored, in-person examinations). We found no change in student engagement, measured by course activity records, or satisfaction, measured by course evaluations. Our findings demonstrate that AI can improve student learning when its adoption is frontline-driven, with instructors empowered to design and refine AI solutions for their own classrooms.
