items.title_zh: 教师设计的人工智能在 19 所大学的随机试验中改善了学习
items.excerpt_zh: 最近的证据表明，人工智能 (AI) 会破坏学习，学生使用的通用聊天机器人或集中设计的人工智能工具表现更差，大学对此感到震惊。在一项针对 19 所大学的 7,200 名学生进行的为期三个学期的预注册随机对照试验中，我们测试了一线教师设计的人工智能是否可以改善学习。我们鼓励教师设计他们认为最能帮助学生的人工智能解决方案。教师们利用对班级和学生的独特知识，创造了一系列广泛的创新。我们证明，这些由教师设计的人工智能创新改善了学生的学习，通过人工智能验证的评估（监考的现场考试）来衡量。我们发现通过课程活动记录衡量的学生参与度或通过课程评估衡量的满意度没有变化。我们的研究结果表明，当人工智能的采用是由一线驱动的，并且教师有权为自己的课堂设计和完善人工智能解决方案时，人工智能可以改善学生的学习。

items.title: Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another
items.excerpt: Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a clear criterion for what makes a conjecture worth pursuing. We present a method for conjecture generation that builds on the observation that mathematical theorems build on one another: new theorems can modify the setting or hypotheses of earlier theorems, strengthen their conclusions, or extend their scope. We encode these relationships in a new kind of graph, the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), which we instantiate as an online search method for LLM agents. An agent builds a TEG in two steps: (1) identifying relevant theorems from papers found by following citations backward and forward from a seed paper; and (2) comparing those theorems to record how one builds on another. LLM judges and an expert mathematician preferred TEG-generated conjectures over those from an unconstrained baseline. LLM judges favored TEG conjectures for significance, ambition, and insight, and favored baseline conjectures for plausibility. A
items.authors: Hita Kambhamettu, Daniel Krashen, Lyle Ungar
items.title_zh: 通过编码定理如何相互构建来指导人工智能代理生成猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 最近，法学硕士在数学研究领域不断成为头条新闻并取得进展。这项工作的大部分重点是证明现有的开放猜想。决定证明什么更加困难，研究也较少，因为缺乏明确的标准来判断猜想是否值得追求。我们提出了一种猜想生成方法，该方法建立在数学定理相互构建的观察之上：新定理可以修改早期定理的设置或假设，加强其结论，或扩展其范围。我们将这些关系编码在一种新的图表中，即定理演化图（TEG），我们将其实例化为 LLM 代理的在线搜索方法。智能体通过两个步骤构建 TEG：（1）从种子论文中前后引用找到的论文中识别相关定理； (2) 比较这些定理以记录一个定理如何建立在另一个定理的基础上。法学硕士评委和一位数学专家更喜欢 TEG 生成的猜想，而不是来自无约束基线的猜想。 LLM 法官因重要性、野心和洞察力而青睐 TEG 猜想，并因合理性而青睐基线猜想。一个

items.title: Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
items.excerpt: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language reflection methods often struggle to locate critical errors precisely, while outcome verification typically checks only whether the available candidate answers satisfy the problem conditions and can therefore overlook necessary branches. To address these limitations, we propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) for mathematical self-correction. AGPV decomposes the current solution into an ordered sequence of key claims, verifies them individually while invoking a shared mathematical toolbox when needed, and stops upon detecting the first error. A summarization agent converts the failure evidence into a diagnosis that guides a correction agent to re-derive the subsequent solution from that point; AGPV then adapts the next verification iteration to the revised solution. AGPV also verifies solution completeness. We further prove that AGPV guarantees solution correctness and co
items.authors: Rui Zou, Mengqi Wei, Xin Zhao, Ji-Rong Wen
items.title_zh: 用于数学自校正的代理引导过程验证
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型在数学推理方面取得了实质性进展，但在复杂的多步骤推理中，任何步骤的错误都可能沿着不正确的路径传播，并且得到的解决方案可能会省略必要的分支。现有的自然语言反射方法通常难以精确定位关键错误，而结果验证通常仅检查可用的候选答案是否满足问题条件，因此可能会忽略必要的分支。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了用于数学自校正的代理引导过程验证（AGPV）。 AGPV 将当前解决方案分解为关键声明的有序序列，在需要时调用共享数学工具箱时单独验证它们，并在检测到第一个错误时停止。总结代理将失败证据转换为诊断，指导纠正代理从该点重新导出后续解决方案；然后 AGPV 使下一次验证迭代适应修改后的解决方案。 AGPV 还验证解决方案的完整性。我们进一步证明AGPV保证了解的正确性并保证了AGPV的正确性。

items.title: STaSBO: LLM-Guided Strategy Planning and Configuration Selection for Bayesian Optimization
items.excerpt: Bayesian optimization (BO) enables sample-efficient search for expensive black-box problems, but its performance depends strongly on surrogate-acquisition configurations whose suitability varies across problems and optimization states. We take a significant step toward LLM-driven strategic management of BO with STaSBO, a task-agnostic meta-controller that plans search behavior and jointly selects surrogate-acquisition configurations, while numerical BO retains responsibility for probabilistic modeling and candidate generation. STaSBO comprises two coordinated stages: strategy planning and strategy-guided configuration selection. A structured memory system connects prior plans, configuration selections, and candidate behaviors to optimization states, allowing the controller to revise its trajectory summary and behavioral plans during planning. To navigate the large joint configuration space, the selection stage shortlists configurations using surrogate fit evidence. Prospective BO-action diagnostics then expose the candidate behaviors, supporting final joint selection against the behavioral plans. Across 12 synthetic mathematical and 1
items.title_zh: STaSBO：法学硕士指导的贝叶斯优化策略规划和配置选择
items.excerpt_zh: 贝叶斯优化 (BO) 能够对昂贵的黑盒问题进行样本有效搜索，但其性能在很大程度上取决于代理获取配置，其适用性因问题和优化状态而异。我们通过 STaSBO 向 LLM 驱动的 BO 战略管理迈出了重要一步，STaSBO 是一个与任务无关的元控制器，可以规划搜索行为并联合选择代理获取配置，而数值 BO 保留概率建模和候选生成的责任。 STaSBO 包括两个协调阶段：策略规划和策略引导的配置选择。结构化存储系统将先前的计划、配置选择和候选行为连接到优化状态，允许控制器在规划期间修改其轨迹摘要和行为计划。为了导航大型关节配置空间，选择阶段使用替代拟合证据来筛选配置。然后，前瞻性 BO 行动诊断会暴露候选行为，支持针对行为计划的最终联合选择。跨越 12 个综合数学和 1

items.title: Auditable Authorization for LLM Agents: Empirical Evidence Across Model, Harness, and Workflow Layers
items.excerpt: Human approval provides effective control only if rejected work stops and authorized work completes. We formalize refusal safety and bounded authorization completeness, and audit three execution boundaries: the model selects a call, the harness schedules and resumes it, and the workflow routes the decision to a protected effect. Paired decisions, exact traces, and native business-state witnesses support experiments with three models, five prompt arms, four runtime approval designs, two additional framework replays, and 100 public workflow sources. The paired model panel leaves seven of 300 approvals unfinished despite zero denied effects; parallel confirmation loses an approved branch in three tasks per model, restoration omits 336/672 CrewAI approvals, and four of 59 comparable n8n workflows execute after Reject. Comparing intent, generated calls, dispatch, and native effects identifies the first observable divergence and its repair target. This yields a practical audit contract that makes both refusal safety and authorization completeness independently verifiable, converting human approval from a procedural formality into an enforce
items.authors: Bangjie Deng, Xiaoxuan Lu, Wenjun Chen, Chengge Wen, Yulin Wang, Jiayue Meng, Yao Yu, Liying Liang, Weijia Han, Ziwei Hong, Zidong Yu
items.excerpt_zh: 仅当被拒绝的工作停止且授权的工作完成时，人工审批才能提供有效的控制。我们形式化拒绝安全性和有界授权完整性，并审核三个执行边界：模型选择调用、线束安排并恢复调用，以及工作流将决策路由到受保护的效果。配对决策、精确跟踪和本机业务状态见证支持使用三个模型、五个提示臂、四个运行时批准设计、两个附加框架重播和 100 个公共工作流源的实验。尽管拒绝效果为零，但配对模型小组在 300 项批准中仍有 7 项未完成；并行确认在每个模型的三个任务中丢失了一个已批准的分支，恢复忽略了 336/672 个 CrewAI 批准，并且 59 个类似的 n8n 工作流程中的 4 个在拒绝后执行。比较意图、生成的调用、调度和本机效果，确定第一个可观察到的分歧及其修复目标。这产生了一个实用的审计合同，使拒绝安全性和授权完整性都可以独立验证，将人类批准从程序形式转变为强制执行
items.title_zh: LLM 代理的可审计授权：跨模型、框架和工作流程层的经验证据

items.title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
items.excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $\tau^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $\tau^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. Retaining the top 95% of positions raises $\tau^2$ accuracy from 11.5% to 29.9% with a source-learning trade-off.
items.authors: Deyang Kong, Zhaoyi Li, Sijian Ren, Yuan Wei, Ying Wei, Defu Lian, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
items.excerpt_zh: 策略蒸馏（OPD）将专门的能力转移给语言模型代理，但其对交互的跨域影响仍不清楚。我们研究 OPD 如何重塑数学、ALFWorld 和 $\tau^2$-bench 之间的 ReAct 交互模式，重点关注推理、行动和观察获取。一般推理监督将数学工具尝试从 70.4% 减少到 14.4%，同时将准确性从 16.7% 提高到 38.0%；代码解释器监督改善了家庭操作和零售查询。相比之下，ALFWorld 监督将 $\tau^2$-bench 准确率从 41.5% 降低到 6.6%，并伴随着违反用户信息依赖性的频繁工具调用。为了仅使用源域训练轨迹来解决负迁移问题，我们探索了在特定域强化学习之前和之后由教师偏好变化引导的选择性 OPD。通过源学习权衡，保留前 95% 的位置将 $\tau^2$ 准确率从 11.5% 提高到 29.9%。
items.title_zh: 代理的政策蒸馏隐式地重塑了法学硕士的反应模式

items.title: Program Distillation: Transferring LLM Capability from System 2 to System 0
items.excerpt: Recent studies leverage large language models (LLMs) to construct executable programs through environment interaction, feedback analysis, and code revision. However, prior work has mainly treated LLMs as optimizers, overlooking their ability to transfer knowledge across system levels. We propose Program Distillation (PD), a framework that formalizes the transfer of abilities from System 2 to System 0. During learning, the LLM provides task knowledge and draft strategies; at deployment, a student program executes the resulting policy. We show that this approach can improve performance while reducing inference time. We introduce PDBench, a benchmark comprising 27 discrete- and continuous-control tasks with fixed initial policies, and PDMetaHarness, a model-harness-independent meta-system for monitoring and guiding the learning process. The strongest model achieves a normalized mean score of 0.728, surpassing PPO (0.656) and Jev-like decision models (0.239), while running exclusively on CPUs and reducing inference costs. Our analysis shows that performance is largely driven by the first breakthrough during learning, and structural modifi
items.authors: Pujun Zheng, Wanying Ren, Guoxiu He
items.title_zh: 程序蒸馏：将 LLM 能力从系统 2 转移到系统 0
items.excerpt_zh: 最近的研究利用大型语言模型（LLM）通过环境交互、反馈分析和代码修订来构建可执行程序。然而，之前的工作主要将法学硕士视为优化器，忽视了他们跨系统级别转移知识的能力。我们提出了程序蒸馏（PD），一个将能力从系统2到系统0的转移正式化的框架。在学习过程中，法学硕士提供任务知识和起草策略；在部署时，学生程序执行生成的策略。我们证明这种方法可以提高性能，同时减少推理时间。我们引入了 PDBench，一个包含 27 个具有固定初始策略的离散和连续控制任务的基准测试，以及 PDMetaHarness，一个用于监控和指导学习过程的独立于模型线束的元系统。最强模型的归一化平均得分为 0.728，超过了 PPO（0.656）和类似 Jev 的决策模型（0.239），同时仅在 CPU 上运行并降低了推理成本。我们的分析表明，表现在很大程度上是由学习过程中的第一次突破和结构调整所驱动的。

items.title: Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. To restore path selection, candidate pruning, and optimal stopping as genuine policy decisions, we propose RISE (Interactive Structured Environment), which transitions structured reinforcement learning from static subgraphs to full-scale interactive databases along two coupled axe
items.authors: Peng Yu, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang, Ying Wen
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型代理推理的交互式结构化环境扩展
items.excerpt_zh: 通过环境交互进行强化学习是训练后范例的基石，用于将大型语言模型发展为能够进行多轮工具使用和探索的自主代理。由于环境定义了策略观察的内容以及如何验证操作，因此其结构直接限制了代理可以获得的功能。然而，现有的结构化和检索环境依赖于上游预过滤——围绕黄金答案提取紧凑的子图或在政策生效之前检索固定的段落。我们表明，这种预过滤引入了一个基本的测量混淆：因为每个问题的子图都包含了真实路径，它们将候选空间压缩了几个数量级，并通过局部拓扑泄漏了答案位置，从而允许问题盲度启发式地呈现远远高于偶然性的黄金答案。为了将路径选择、候选剪枝和最优停止恢复为真正的策略决策，我们提出了 RISE（交互式结构化环境），它将结构化强化学习从静态子图转变为沿两个耦合轴的全面交互式数据库

items.title: Rethinking Offline On-Policy Distillation: From Scalar Advantages to Distributional Supervision
items.excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities through token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories, but repeatedly evaluating fresh rollouts with the teacher is computationally expensive. Offline methods such as Lightning OPD reduce this cost by caching recorded tokens' teacher log-probabilities on fixed reference rollouts. By extending the idea to a multi-turn agentic search setup, we find that it consistently underperforms the SFT starting point trained by the same teacher. We empirically observe greater teacher--reference mismatch than in mathematical reasoning and post-training distributional flattening, and theoretically show that scalar advantage supervision on fixed rollouts admits solutions with flattened output distributions under suitable conditions. Motivated by these findings, we propose Distributional On-Policy Distillation (DistOPD), a simple yet effective offline OPD method that retains candidate-token probabilities from both reference and teacher at selected positions and aggregates the remaining parts into a residual token. On agentic search, DistOPD achieves performance comparable to online OP
items.authors: Qi Sun, Siyue Zhang, Tingyu Song, Yilun Zhao, Chen Zhao
items.title_zh: 重新思考离线同策蒸馏：从标量优势到分布式监管
items.excerpt_zh: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）通过对学生生成的轨迹进行代币级反馈来转移教师的能力，但与教师一起反复评估新的部署在计算上是昂贵的。 Lightning OPD 等离线方法通过在固定参考推出时缓存记录代币的教师对数概率来降低成本。通过将这个想法扩展到多轮代理搜索设置，我们发现它始终不如同一位老师训练的 SFT 起点。我们凭经验观察到比数学推理和训练后分布平坦化更大的教师参考失配，并且从理论上表明，固定推出的标量优势监督在适当的条件下允许具有平坦输出分布的解决方案。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了分布式在策略蒸馏（DistOPD），这是一种简单而有效的离线 OPD 方法，它保留了选定位置的参考和教师的候选令牌概率，并将剩余部分聚合成剩余令牌。在代理搜索上，DistOPD 的性能可与在线 OP 相媲美

items.title: SART: Sign-Absolute Reformulation Theory for Binary Variable Reduction in Neural Network Verification
items.excerpt: Complete formal verification of neural networks is crucial for their deployment in safety-critical domains. A key bottleneck stems from encoding complexity: traditional methods assign one binary variable per unstable ReLU neuron. We propose the Sign-Absolute Reformulation Theory (SART), which fundamentally breaks the conventional one-to-one mapping between unstable neurons and binary variables by establishing formal reducibility criteria. This allows for finer-grained modeling, where each unstable neuron corresponds on average to fewer than one binary variable, thereby reducing verification complexity at its source. Based on SART, we derive a theoretical lower bound on the number of binary variables required for complete verification and, under the assumption that $P \neq NP$, prove that variables in the final layer can be compressed by 50\%, while the number of variables in intermediate layers cannot be further reduced. To overcome the apparent ``last-layer-only'' limitation, we recast verification as a sequential process and, crucially, show that the gain lifts to the entire network: LayerABS, a SART-based progressive tightening ver
items.authors: Jin Xu, Miaomiao Zhang, Bowen Du
items.title_zh: SART：神经网络验证中二元变量约简的符号绝对重构理论
items.excerpt_zh: 神经网络的完整形式验证对于其在安全关键领域的部署至关重要。一个关键瓶颈源于编码复杂性：传统方法为每个不稳定的 ReLU 神经元分配一个二元变量。我们提出了符号绝对重构理论（SART），该理论通过建立形式化的可约性标准，从根本上打破了不稳定神经元和二元变量之间传统的一对一映射。这允许进行更细粒度的建模，其中每个不稳定神经元平均对应于少于一个二进制变量，从而降低了源头的验证复杂性。基于SART，我们推导出完整验证所需的二元变量数量的理论下界，并在$P \neq NP$的假设下，证明最后一层的变量可以压缩50\%，而中间层的变量数量无法进一步减少。为了克服明显的“仅最后一层”限制，我们将验证重新定义为一个顺序过程，最重要的是，表明增益提升到整个网络：LayerABS，一种基于 SART 的渐进紧缩版本

items.title: Can a Vision-Language Model Tune Clustering In Context?
items.excerpt: Clustering is a widely used unsupervised learning method, but selecting an appropriate algorithm and set of hyperparameters for a specific dataset can require many possible configurations and evaluations. In this work, we investigate whether a Vision-Language Model can instead visually evaluate clustering results and use those decisions to then tune an explicit clustering algorithm. We study this through three progressive experiments using Qwen3.5-27B and five controlled synthetic clustering scenarios. First, we test whether the VLM can distinguish the best clustering result from a pair of plots. Second, we test whether it can assign numerical scores to those plots where a higher score represents a better result. Finally, we use these judgments within an agentic loop in which the VLM scores a k-means clustering and proposes updated hyperparameters that may result in better clustering. Our exploratory results show that the VLM performs well when clear cluster structure is present, while struggling on more ambiguous and noisy settings. In the full agentic experiment, the VLM produces clustering configurations with silhouette scores rela
items.authors: Javith Ranatunga, Paimon Goulart, Evangelos E. Papalexakis
items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型可以在上下文中调整聚类吗？
items.excerpt_zh: 聚类是一种广泛使用的无监督学习方法，但为特定数据集选择合适的算法和超参数集可能需要许多可能的配置和评估。在这项工作中，我们研究视觉语言模型是否可以直观地评估聚类结果，并使用这些决策来调整显式聚类算法。我们通过使用 Qwen3.5-27B 的三个渐进实验和五个受控合成聚类场景来研究这一点。首先，我们测试 VLM 是否能够从一对图中区分出最佳聚类结果。其次，我们测试它是否可以为那些分数越高表示结果越好的图分配数字分数。最后，我们在代理循环中使用这些判断，其中 VLM 对 k 均值聚类进行评分，并提出可能导致更好聚类的更新超参数。我们的探索性结果表明，当存在清晰的簇结构时，VLM 表现良好，而在更模糊和嘈杂的设置中则表现不佳。在完整的代理实验中，VLM 生成轮廓分数相关的聚类配置

items.title: Simplify, Agree, Distill: Label-Free Self-Distillation with Stepping Stones
items.excerpt: Can a language model teach itself to reason without labels? On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the model as its own teacher, but strengthens that teacher with a ground-truth solution. The natural label-free substitute, voting over the model's attempts, fails precisely on hard problems: attempts disagree, and their most common answer is often wrong. We propose STONE, a label-free alternative that moves agreement to easier related problems. The model writes these stepping stones, keeps those it solves consistently, and shows the teacher their worked solutions, with final answers removed; the student sees only the original problem. No step reads a label, and inference needs no extra context or model calls. Across five math benchmarks, the proposed method achieves the highest average accuracy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode. Without thinking mode, it gains 13.2 and 22.7 points, 2.5 and 2.7 times the gains of OPSD with ground-truth solutions.
items.authors: Dingyang Chen, Jinfeng Xiao, Zhenyu Zhang, William Hu, Ziyu Wang, Yang Liu, Shirley Zhang, Yuan Ling, Xinyang Shen, Qi Zhang, Peijie Qiu
items.title_zh: 简化、一致、蒸馏：无标签自蒸馏的垫脚石
items.excerpt_zh: 语言模型可以在没有标签的情况下自学推理吗？按策略自蒸馏 (OPSD) 使用模型作为自己的老师，但通过地面实况解决方案来加强该老师。自然的无标签替代品，对模型的尝试进行投票，在难题上恰恰失败了：尝试不一致，而且他们最常见的答案往往是错误的。我们提出了 STONE，这是一种无标签的替代方案，可以就更简单的相关问题达成一致。该模型编写这些垫脚石，保持其解决的一致，并向教师展示他们的解决方案，并删除最终答案；学生只能看到原来的问题。没有步骤读取标签，推理不需要额外的上下文或模型调用。在五个数学基准中，所提出的方法在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的思维模式中实现了最高的平均准确度。在没有思维模式的情况下，它获得了 13.2 和 22.7 分，是使用 ground-truth 解决方案的 OPSD 收益的 2.5 和 2.7 倍。

items.title: Revealing the Biases of Large Language Models By Inferring Prior Distributions
items.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been known to exhibit a wide range of social biases including name-nationality associations, occupation-gender associations and racial stereotypes. Existing approaches to evaluating these biases typically involve measuring surface-level behavior where a model is fed a dataset of prompts and its outputs are scored relative to ground-truth answers. Inspired by prior elicitation in cognitive science, we propose a different perspective that reconstructs latent bias as a prior underlying the model's behavior. We formulate the problem as a Bayesian inverse problem where, given prompt-response observations on a bias benchmark dataset, we infer a low-dimensional latent distribution that summarizes the model's stereotyping tendencies. This paper develops the mathematical foundation, a practical reconstruction algorithm, and experiments using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) benchmark to infer the prior distributions of LLMs over responses in ambiguous social contexts.
items.authors: Joshua Ryo Cheng, Thomas L. Griffiths, Jake C. Snell
items.title_zh: 通过推断先验分布揭示大型语言模型的偏差
items.excerpt_zh: 众所周知，大型语言模型（LLM）表现出广泛的社会偏见，包括姓名与国籍关联、职业与性别关联和种族刻板印象。评估这些偏差的现有方法通常涉及测量表面行为，其中向模型提供提示数据集，并相对于真实答案对其输出进行评分。受认知科学先验启发的启发，我们提出了一种不同的观点，将潜在偏见重建为模型行为的先验。我们将该问题表述为贝叶斯逆问题，其中，根据对偏差基准数据集的即时响应观察，我们推断出一个低维潜在分布，该分布总结了模型的刻板印象倾向。本文开发了数学基础、实用的重建算法，并使用 QA 偏差基准 (BBQ) 基准进行实验，以推断法学硕士在模糊社会背景下的响应的先验分布。

items.title: Understanding the Role of Reasoning Data in Pretraining
items.excerpt: Reasoning data expose models to multi-step reasoning, but reasoning traces may cover only a subset of the available facts. How should pretraining balance atomic facts with reasoning traces? We study this question by constructing a setting in which every fact provides an atomic training signal, while only a subset appears in reasoning supervision, enabling us to measure generalization to transitions observed atomically but never used in training traces. For a linear transformer, we derive the weight assigned to atomic training signals that minimizes held-transition squared error and show that its leading-order optimum increases with reasoning-chain length and decreases with the fraction of facts held out from reasoning traces. These trends persist in a full transformer layer with an MLP, softmax attention, and cross-entropy loss. We further validate the role of reasoning complexity and data coverage in two natural-language settings: controlled multi-hop reasoning and mathematical pretraining. Together, our results provide a principled view of how reasoning-chain structure and data coverage should shape the allocation of training data d
items.authors: Jianhao Huang, Allan Zhang, Ali Payani, Baharan Mirzasoleiman
items.title_zh: 了解推理数据在预训练中的作用
items.excerpt_zh: 推理数据将模型暴露给多步骤推理，但推理轨迹可能仅覆盖可用事实的子集。预训练应该如何平衡原子事实和推理痕迹？我们通过构建一个设置来研究这个问题，其中每个事实都提供原子训练信号，而只有一个子集出现在推理监督中，使我们能够测量对原子观察到的但从未在训练跟踪中使用的转换的泛化。对于线性变换器，我们推导了分配给原子训练信号的权重，该权重最小化了保持转换平方误差，并表明其主阶最优值随着推理链长度的增加而增加，并随着推理轨迹中保留的事实分数的增加而减少。这些趋势在具有 MLP、softmax 注意力和交叉熵损失的完整 Transformer 层中持续存在。我们进一步验证了推理复杂性和数据覆盖在两种自然语言设置中的作用：受控多跳推理和数学预训练。总之，我们的结果提供了推理链结构和数据覆盖如何影响训练数据分配的原则性观点。

items.title: DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators
items.excerpt: DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.
items.excerpt_zh: DFlash 根据目标模型的隐藏特征训练并行草稿模型。受到 DFlare 之前引入目标隐藏状态的每层组合的启发，我们测试了这些状态的上下文相关权重是否有助于提高块扩散推测器的接受长度。我们训练了块大小为 16 的 Qwen 3 的 DFlash 基线，以及计算每层门以影响投影前隐藏特征大小的动态模型。虽然动态模型和 DFlash 基线之间的平均接受长度没有显着差异，但我们注意到动态模型在数学背景下擅长绘图。在对来自 MetaMathQA 和 Orca-Math 数据集的 700 个提示的评估中，平均接受长度提高了 5%。我们还发现，在推测解码的情况下，同一数据集的子集的吞吐量提高了 4.1%。
items.title_zh: DynaDFlash：块扩散投机者的动态特征投影

items.title: Gradient-Based Co-Design of Systems and Reinforcement Learning Policies with Differentiable Simulators
items.excerpt: Co-design is the problem of jointly optimizing the design of a system and the policy that operates it. Neither can be chosen independently: a system design is only as good as the policy trained for it, and the optimal policy changes with the design. When that policy is learned by reinforcement learning (RL), evaluating a candidate design requires a full policy training run, and the design is usually optimized by black-box search such as Bayesian optimization (BO) or evolution strategies (ES). These methods scale poorly with the design dimension and ignore the differentiable structure of modern simulators and, in particular, the sensitivity of the optimal policy with respect to the design. We instead derive a gradient-based co-design method, where the design gradient decomposes into a direct effect of changing the design at a fixed policy and an indirect effect through the design-dependent optimal policy. The indirect effect requires the sensitivity of the converged policy to the design, which we obtain by applying the implicit function theorem to the stationarity condition of the policy gradient. Based on this sensitivity, we develop
items.authors: Akhil S. Anand, Xun Shen, Marc Peter Deisenroth, Sebastien Gros
items.title_zh: 基于梯度的系统和强化学习策略与可微分模拟器的协同设计
items.excerpt_zh: 协同设计是共同优化系统设计及其运行策略的问题。两者都不能独立选择：系统设计的好坏取决于为其训练的策略，而最优策略会随着设计而变化。当通过强化学习 (RL) 学习该策略时，评估候选设计需要完整的策略训练运行，并且设计通常通过黑盒搜索进行优化，例如贝叶斯优化 (BO) 或进化策略 (ES)。这些方法在设计维度上的扩展性很差，并且忽略了现代模拟器的可微分结构，特别是最优策略对设计的敏感性。相反，我们推导出基于梯度的协同设计方法，其中设计梯度分解为以固定策略改变设计的直接效应和通过依赖设计的最优策略产生的间接效应。间接效应需要收敛策略对设计的敏感性，这是我们通过将隐函数定理应用于策略梯度的平稳条件来获得的。基于这种敏感性，我们开发

items.title: "I Am Not a Kiddo!": Quantifying Epistemic Infantilization in Large Language Models via Multi-Metric Bias Analysis
items.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tutoring and professional knowledge retrieval, yet safety evaluations still focus mainly on overt harms such as toxicity while overlooking benevolent failure modes. We study epistemic infantilization, defined as an identity-conditioned reduction in technical depth that appears when disability disclosure precedes an expert-level query. To measure this effect, we construct a counterfactual dataset of matched question-answer pairs and compare model responses across three settings: no identity context, disability disclosed in prior conversational context, and disability disclosed via a short query prefix. We introduce two composite metrics, the Infantilization Bias Index (IBI) and the Epistemic Accessibility Response Score (EARS), which capture retention of mathematical and formal content, domain terminology, reasoning coverage, and tone signals such as simplification markers and unsolicited offers to adjust the level. items.title_zh: “我不是孩子！”：通过多度量偏差分析量化大型语言模型中的认知婴儿化
items.excerpt_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于辅导和专业知识检索，但安全性评估仍然主要关注毒性等明显危害，而忽视了善意的失败模式。我们研究认知婴儿化，定义为在专家级询问之前披露残疾信息时出现的以身份为条件的技术深度降低。为了衡量这种效果，我们构建了一个匹配问答对的反事实数据集，并比较三种设置下的模型响应：无身份上下文、在先前对话上下文中披露的残疾以及通过简短查询前缀披露的残疾。我们引入了两个复合指标，即婴儿化偏差指数（IBI）和认知可访问性响应分数（EARS），它们捕获数学和形式内容的保留、领域术语、推理覆盖率以及语气信号，例如简化标记和主动提供的调整水平。在五个开放权重模型家庭中，我们发现一致的证据表明，残疾披露通过用更高层次的形式取代正式解释来减少认知获取

items.title: Theoretical Foundations of Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh)
items.excerpt: This paper presents the theoretical foundations and a comprehensive formal system for Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh). We begin by establishing six foundational principles that distinguish computational Fiqh from conventional natural language processing and general theological formalization. items.title_zh: 计算伊斯兰法学的理论基础（Fiqh）
items.excerpt_zh: 本文介绍了计算伊斯兰法学（Fiqh）的理论基础和全面的形式体系。我们首先建立六个基本原则，将计算法学与传统自然语言处理和一般神学形式化区分开来。这些原则将伊斯兰法理学定义为一门以经验为基础的事实运作的规范演绎科学，需要双重归纳演绎方法，并需要专门为伊斯兰教法设计的逻辑基础，而不是采用现有的形式主义。基于这些原则，我们构建了一个三层分层计算语言，$\mathcal{F} = D \circ A \circ G$，包括：（1）一个阿拉伯语形态/语法基础引擎，将完全发声的古典阿拉伯语转换为独立于语言的基础动作结构（GAS）； (2) 阿拉伯具体化行动演算 (ARAC)，将这些结构规范化为规范逻辑表示； (3)一个无功能的Horn-clause数据记录引擎，用于可执行的法律推论。此外，我们引入了一种桥接方法（Alg

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Clinical Decision Support in Gait Analysis: A Proof-of-Concept
items.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate significant potential for clinical decision support but lack specialized biomechanical knowledge required for accurate gait analysis interpretation. We developed and evaluated a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework to enhance LLM-generated clinical explanations for ankle fracture rehabilitation using ground reaction force data. Using the GaitRec dataset (503 subjects: 211 healthy, 292 ankle fracture patients), we implemented a five-stage pipeline integrating: (1) machine learning classification (91.3\% accuracy); (2) Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for explainable feature identification; (3) RAG knowledge base from peer-reviewed biomechanics literature; (4) GPT-5 explanation generation with and without retrieval augmentation; and (5) double-blind evaluation by experienced physical therapists across five clinical criteria. RAG augmentation produced statistically significant improvements in Clini-cal Benefit (mean difference=0.60, p=0.047, {\delta}=0.49) and Completeness (mean difference=0.70, p=0.049, {\delta}=0.49), both demonstrating large effect sizes. items.title_zh: 步态分析中临床决策支持的检索增强生成：概念验证
items.excerpt_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）显示出临床决策支持的巨大潜力，但缺乏准确步态分析解释所需的专业生物力学知识。我们开发并评估了检索增强生成（RAG）框架，以利用地面反作用力数据增强法学硕士生成的踝关节骨折康复临床解释。使用 GaitRec 数据集（503 名受试者：211 名健康人，292 名踝关节骨折患者），我们实现了一个五阶段的流程，集成了：（1）机器学习分类（准确率 91.3%）； (2) 逐层相关性传播，用于可解释的特征识别； (3)来自同行评审的生物力学文献的RAG知识库； (4) 有和没有检索增强的 GPT-5 解释生成； (5) 由经验丰富的物理治疗师根据五项临床标准进行双盲评估。 RAG 增强在临床效益（平均差=0.60，p=0.047，δ=0.49）和完整性（平均差=0.70，p=0.049，δ=0.49）方面产生了统计上显着的改善，两者都表现出很大的效应量。基线 GPT-5 实现强劲

items.title: Which Mathematical Context Supports Target-Aligned Conjecture Generation? A Paired Ablation Study
items.excerpt: Generating mathematical conjectures from natural-language context is challenging because theorem-relevant information is distributed across multiple forms of mathematical context, including definitions, objects, assumptions, and constructions. We study which of these contextual signals help a model recover the specific claim supported by the surrounding setup, using 61 main theorems from 12 papers across four mathematical domains. For each theorem, we redact the result and represent the remaining setup using six context components. A paired ablation design compares full context, six leave-one-out conditions, and six single-component conditions, yielding 793 generated conjectures. Context components were largely complementary: removing one component usually had little effect, whereas retaining only one substantially reduced expected-theorem alignment. Local Mathematical Objects provided the strongest standalone signal, while Structural Constraints and Conditions produced the largest alignment decrease when removed. items.title_zh: 哪种数学背景支持目标对齐猜想生成？配对消融研究
items.excerpt_zh: 从自然语言上下文中生成数学猜想具有挑战性，因为与定理相关的信息分布在多种形式的数学上下文中，包括定义、对象、假设和构造。我们使用来自四个数学领域 12 篇论文的 61 个主要定理，研究哪些上下文信号有助于模型恢复周围设置支持的特定主张。对于每个定理，我们编辑结果并使用六个上下文组件表示剩余的设置。配对消融设计比较了完整的上下文、六个留一条件和六个单成分条件，产生了 793 个猜想。上下文组件在很大程度上是互补的：删除一个组件通常效果不大，而只保留一个大大减少的预期定理对齐。局部数学对象提供了最强的独立信号，而结构约束和条件在移除后产生最大的对齐下降。这些发现表明，目标一致的猜想的生成取决于结合识别相关信息的信息。

items.title: Skill Transfer: Adapting Agent Skills from Strong to Weak Agents
items.excerpt: Agent skills are modular bundles of instructions, code, and resources that an agent loads on demand, increasingly authored and validated on frontier models and shared as an open standard. The same skill behaves differently across models: a strong model turns it into a large performance gain, while a weak model realizes little of that gain and sometimes does worse than with no skill at all. Cost and resource constraints, however, often restrict real deployments to exactly these weaker agents. We hypothesize that the strong model silently supplies procedural steps the skill leaves implicit, which the weak model omits, and formalize closing this gap as \emph{Skill Transfer}: holding the skill's capability ceiling and the model's parameters fixed, we adapt the skill so a specific weak agent can execute it well. Our method abstracts strong and weak trajectories into typed execution structures, localizes their structural divergence with a graph edit distance (GED), and repairs the skill through an iterative diagnoser-patcher loop. items.authors: Yifan Lan, Hanyu Wang, Lu Lin, Jinghui Chen
items.excerpt_zh: 代理技能是代理按需加载的指令、代码和资源的模块化捆绑包，越来越多地在前沿模型上编写和验证，并作为开放标准共享。相同的技能在不同模型中的表现有所不同：强大的模型会将其转化为巨大的性能增益，而弱模型则几乎无法实现这种增益，有时甚至比完全没有技能还要糟糕。然而，成本和资源限制通常将实际部署限制在这些较弱的代理上。我们假设强模型默默地提供了技能隐含的程序步骤，而弱模型省略了这些步骤，并将缩小这一差距的形式化为 \emph{技能转移}：保持技能的能力上限和模型的参数固定，我们调整技能，以便特定的弱智能体可以很好地执行它。我们的方法将强轨迹和弱轨迹抽象为类型化的执行结构，用图形编辑距离（GED）定位它们的结构分歧，并通过迭代诊断器-修补程序循环修复技能。在三个基准和两个模型系列中，技能转移比未经修改的技能标志提高了通过率
items.title_zh: 技能转移：将代理技能从强代理调整为弱代理

items.title: FlashREINFORCE: Critic-Free Single-Rollout Asynchronous RL for Agentic Language Models
items.excerpt: Asynchronous reinforcement learning suits long-horizon agents with irregular rollout times, but group-relative updates require repeated rollouts of each prompt. However, group-based sampling limits prompt coverage at a fixed rollout budget and introduces group synchronization barriers. One rollout per prompt avoids these constraints but removes the variance-reducing group baseline, making updates noisier and more prone to instability on stale, variable-length trajectories. We present FlashREINFORCE, a critic-free, one-pass framework built on One-Batch REINFORCE, a Sequence Trust Region, and Sample-Mean Optimization. These components preserve prompt coverage and signed feedback while controlling policy drift and length-amplified negative updates. In our experiments, FlashREINFORCE remains stable through 6,000 updates on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B at a policy lag of approximately four updates. On Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, it reaches 38.0 mean accuracy across five benchmarks, outperforming the reported GRPO baseline by 1.7 percentage points with half the rollouts (256k versus 512k). Python-tool experiments extend to the 30B MoE model Qwen3-3
items.authors: Jian Hu, Yifan Zhang, Hao Zhang, Binfeng Xu, Shaokun Zhang, Hongqing Peng, Zhiding Yu, Pavlo Molchanov, Jan Kautz, Yi Dong
items.excerpt_zh: 异步强化学习适合具有不规则推出时间的长视野代理，但与组相关的更新需要重复推出每个提示。然而，基于组的采样限制了固定部署预算的即时覆盖范围，并引入了组同步障碍。每个提示一次的推出可以避免这些限制，但会删除减少方差的组基线，从而使更新变得更加嘈杂，并且在陈旧的、可变长度的轨迹上更容易不稳定。我们推出了 FlashREINFORCE，这是一种基于 One-Batch REINFORCE、序列信任区域和样本均值优化构建的无批评的一次性框架。这些组件保留及时报道和签名反馈，同时控制政策漂移和长度放大的负面更新。在我们的实验中，FlashREINFORCE 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 上的 6,000 次更新中保持稳定，策略滞后约为 4 次更新。在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 上，它在五个基准测试中达到了 38.0 的平均准确度，在一半的部署中（256k 与 512k）比报告的 GRPO 基线高出 1.7 个百分点。 Python 工具实验扩展到 30B MoE 模型 Qwen3-3
items.title_zh: FlashREINFORCE：用于代理语言模型的无批评的单推出异步强化学习

items.title: Non-Deterministic Finite Automata for Telugu Letters and Visualizations for Metrical Poetry
items.excerpt: Syllabic weight is central to Telugu metrical poetry. Syllabically, every letter (aksharam token) is either light (laghuvu) or heavy (guruvu). Poets classify it using a set of pre-defined rules. This paper formalizes aksharam token, the atomic unit of syllabic classification, as a non-deterministic finite automaton (NFA) with the regular expression$\colon$ $(A_h+A_d+A_p)(\epsilon+V_s)+A_m+H^+G(\epsilon+H+V_s+V_v)$, where $\epsilon$ denotes a null string, $A$ denotes a vowel (achchu), comprising hrasvam ($A_h$), deergham ($A_d$), plutham ($A_p$), and miscellaneous ($A_m$), $H$ a pure consonant (pollu\_hallu), $G$ a vowel diacritic (gunintha\_chihnam), $V_s$ the sunna (anusvara), and $V_v$ the visarga, the latter two being nasal and aspirated sounds respectively. We then present automata diagrams and regular expressions for (i) a necessary condition satisfied by every light letter, and (ii) a sufficient condition for a letter to be heavy. Finally, we propose graphical visualizations for the 9 Telugu poem types.
items.authors: Boddu Sri Pavan, Chandrasheker Thummanagoti, Appana Mohan Naga Phani Kumar, Boddu Swathi Sree
items.title_zh: 泰卢固字母的非确定性有限自动机和格律诗歌的可视化
items.excerpt_zh: 音节重量是泰卢固格律诗歌的核心。从音节上看，每个字母（aksharam token）要么是轻的（laghuvu），要么是重的（guruvu）。诗人使用一组预定义的规则对其进行分类。本文将音节分类的原子单元 aksharam token 形式化为一个非确定性有限自动机 (NFA)，其正则表达式 $\colon$ $(A_h+A_d+A_p)(\epsilon+V_s)+A_m+H^+G(\epsilon+H+V_s+V_v)$，其中 $\epsilon$ 表示空字符串，$A$ 表示元音 (achchu)，包括 hrasvam ($A_h$)、deergham ($A_d$)、plutham ($A_p$) 和杂项 ($A_m$)、$H$ 纯辅音 (pollu\_hallu)、$G$ 元音变音符号 (gunintha\_chihnam)、$V_s$ 苏纳 (anusvara) 和 $V_v$ Visarga，后两者分别是鼻音和送气音。然后，我们给出自动机图和正则表达式（i）每个轻字母满足的必要条件，以及（ii）一个字母重的充分条件。最后，我们提出了 9 种泰卢固语诗歌类型的图形可视化。

items.title: Isolating Perception for Multi-View Planning under Occlusion-Induced Partial Observability
items.excerpt: Vision-language models (VLMs) are beginning to saturate visual planning benchmarks, yet they fail to resolve depth ambiguity and degrade sharply with problem size under occlusion-induced partial observability (PO). We introduce BW-PO based on the Blocksworld domain, a controlled benchmark that reduces existing VLM planners and formalizers to near-zero performance, and propose VLM-as-perceiver, a paradigm that narrows the VLM's role to local perception while delegating cross-view evidence reconciliation and plan generation to external solvers. Across model-specific challenging subsets of BW-PO, this raises plan success from 1% to 97% for Gemma-4-31B, 0% to 95% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 3% to 84% for Gemini-3.1-Pro. Isolating perception in this way separates two bottlenecks that are otherwise entangled: reconciliation under depth ambiguity, and completeness of visual extraction under scene density.
items.authors: Kevin Nguyen, Ceyhun Efe Kayan, Feng Liu, Li Zhang
items.title_zh: 遮挡引起的部分可观测性下多视​​图规划的隔离感知
items.excerpt_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）开始饱和视觉规划基准，但它们无法解决深度模糊性，并且在遮挡引起的部分可观察性（PO）下随着问题规模的大小而急剧退化。我们引入了基于 Blocksworld 域的 BW-PO，这是一种受控基准，可将现有的 VLM 规划器和形式化器的性能降低到接近于零的性能，并提出了 VLM-as-perceiver，这是一种将 VLM 的角色缩小到局部感知的范式，同时将跨视图证据协调和计划生成委托给外部求解器。在 BW-PO 的特定于模型的挑战性子集中，这将 Gemma-4-31B 的计划成功率从 1% 提高到 97%，将 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 的计划成功率从 0% 提高到 95%，将 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的计划成功率从 3% 提高到 84%。以这种方式隔离感知可以分离两个相互纠缠的瓶颈：深度模糊下的协调，以及场景密度下视觉提取的完整性。

items.title: Commuting pairs in lattices of reductive Lie algebras
items.excerpt: We count ordered commuting pairs in a full lattice \(\Lambda\) in a reductive Lie algebra \(\g\) over \(\Q\). For a fixed convex body \(B\) containing the origin in its interior, the count in \(HB\) is \(C_{\Lambda,B}H^{\dim\g+\dim Z(\g)}\) with a power-saving error. The leading term comes from pairs whose projections to each simple ideal are linearly dependent over its centroid. Their slopes index an absolutely convergent sum of section volumes for \(C_{\Lambda,B}\). Subtracting the contribution of dependent pairs from the finite-field Fourier sums gives cancellation at generic dependent frequencies. For independent frequencies, we bound the dimension of the locus where the corresponding hyperplane contains an irreducible component of a nonzero bracket fibre. For \(n\ge3\), the number of ordered commuting pairs in \(M_n(\Z)\) with entries of absolute value at most \(H\) is \[ \frac{2(n+3)\zeta(n^2-2)}{(n+1)\zeta(n^2-1)} (2\lfloor H\rfloor+1)^{n^2+1} +O_n\!\left(H^{n^2+1-1/(n+1)}\right), \] confirming the exponent \(n^2+1\) predicted by Browning, Sawin and Wang~\cite{BSW}.
items.authors: Caihua Luo, Xu Song, Yilin Zeng
items.title_zh: 还原李代数格中的交换对
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在 \(\Q\) 上的还原李代数 \(\g\) 中计算完整格子 \(\Lambda\) 中的有序通勤对。对于内部包含原点的固定凸体\(B\)，\(HB\)中的计数为\(C_{\Lambda,B}H^{\dim\g+\dim Z(\g)}\)，存在节能误差。主导项来自对每个简单理想的投影与其质心线性相关的对。它们的斜率索引了 \(C_{\Lambda,B}\) 截面体积的绝对收敛总和。从有限场傅立叶和中减去相关对的贡献可以得到一般相关频率处的抵消。对于独立频率，我们限制了轨迹的维数，其中相应的超平面包含非零括号纤维的不可约分量。对于\(n\ge3\)，\(M_n(\Z)\)中绝对值最多为\(H\)的有序通勤对的数量为\[ \frac{2(n+3)\zeta(n^2-2)}{(n+1)\zeta(n^2-1)} (2\lfloor H\rfloor+1)^{n^2+1} +O_n\!\left(H^{n^2+1-1/(n+1)}\right), \] 证实了 Browning、Sawin 和 Wang~\cite{BSW} 预测的指数 \(n^2+1\)。

items.title: Semistable 1-Motives: Monodromy, Explicit Periods, and Local Duality
items.excerpt: Let $K/\mathbf Q_p$ be unramified, with $p>2$. For a $1$-motive with constant lattice, split torus, and good abelian quotient, we compute the semistable extension complex from toric valuations and formal-group logarithms. A canonical monodromy boundary exists for every semistable representation; it detects splitting over crystalline periods and the increase in monodromy rank. For the stated $1$-motives, this boundary and the unramified quotient recover the restricted local Tate pairing, with exponential radicals. Nonsplit elliptic examples, Raynaud uniformization, and a height-one positive-period bound explain the geometric range. For toric motives we construct actual periods, convergent Robba bases, and integral action matrices. A toric basis family has perfect projective/trace-zero matrix duality, including its exact integral defect. An explicit residue-zero solution operator constructs every dual Herr class. Applied componentwise, the same operator gives relative full dual lifts for general constant-lattice $1$-motives once their coefficient sequence is specified. Finally, finite-base coefficient traces realize division-tower Iwasa
items.title_zh: 半稳定 1-动机：单性、显式周期和局部二元性
items.excerpt_zh: 令$K/\mathbf Q_p$ 是无分支的，其中$p>2$。对于具有恒定晶格、分裂环面和良好阿贝尔商的 $1$ 动机，我们根据环面估值和形式群对数计算半稳定扩张复形。每个半稳定表示都存在规范单峰边界；它检测结晶周期的分裂和单一性等级的增加。对于所述的 1$ 动机，该边界和未分枝的商恢复了具有指数根式的受限局部 Tate 配对。非分裂椭圆的例子、雷诺均匀化和高度一正周期界限解释了几何范围。对于环面动机，我们构造实际周期、收敛罗巴基和积分作用矩阵。复曲面基族具有完美的射影/迹零矩阵对偶性，包括其精确的积分缺陷。显式残差零解算子构造每个对偶 Herr 类。按组件应用，一旦指定了系数序列，相同的算子就会为一般恒定格子 $1$ 动机提供相对完整的双提升。最后，有限基系数迹实现除法塔岩佐

items.title: Refined random matrix conjectures for zeros of $p$-adic $L$-functions
items.excerpt: We make and test the conjecture that for $p$-adic $L$-functions associated to quadratic Dirichlet characters and their Teichm\"uller twists, all local statistics of zeros in the unit disk match those of $p$-adic random matrix eigenvalues. This generalizes the case of the number of zeros in the unit disk previously conjectured by Ellenberg-Jain-Venkatesh, which was well-supported by numerics, as well as the case of the discriminant, where their numerics were more ambiguous. Using recent random matrix results on local statistics of eigenvalues, we make the random matrix prediction explicit for many statistics, analogous to local densities and pair-correlations in the complex setting. To test these, we compute data on $p$-adic $L$-functions for characters of conductor up to $10^7$, and for certain statistics in windows above $10^{10}$. We find good agreement with the new random matrix predictions for these statistics, as well as for the discriminant.
items.authors: Heiko Knospe, Jiahe Shen, Roger Van Peski
items.title_zh: $p$-adic $L$-函数零点的改进随机矩阵猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 我们做出并测试了这样的猜想：对于与二次狄利克雷特征及其 Teichm\"uller 扭曲相关的 $p$-adic $L$-函数，单位圆盘中所有零点的局部统计都与 $p$-adic 随机矩阵特征值的统计数据相匹配。这概括了 Ellenberg-Jain-Venkatesh 之前推测的单位圆盘中零点数量的情况，该猜想得到了数值的良好支持，以及使用最近的特征值局部统计随机矩阵结果，我们对许多统计数据进行明确的随机矩阵预测，类似于复杂设置中的局部密度和配对相关性，为了测试这些，我们计算 $p$-adic $L$ 函数上的数据，用于高达 $10^7$ 的导体特征，并且对于高于 $10^{10}$ 的窗口中的某些统计数据，我们发现与这些统计数据以及判别式的新随机矩阵预测。

items.title: Rational lines on pairs of quadrics and cubic hypersurfaces
items.excerpt: We study rational lines on smooth intersections of two quadrics and on smooth cubic hypersurfaces over number fields. For an intersection of two quadrics in $n$ variables, we prove the Hasse principle and weak approximation for the variety of lines when $n\geq 11$, and more generally for the variety of $r$-planes when $n\geq 3r+8$. In this range an $r$-plane exists over the ground field if and only if one exists over every real completion. For the variety of lines, we also prove the Hasse principle and weak approximation when $n\geq 8$, conditional on the finiteness of certain Tate-Shafarevich groups. For a smooth cubic hypersurface in $n$ variables, we prove that a line exists over the ground field when $n\geq 23$.
items.authors: Tim Browning, Stephanie Chan, Nick Rome
items.title_zh: 二次曲面和三次超曲面对上的有理线
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究两个二次曲面的平滑交点和数域上的平滑三次超曲面上的有理线。对于 $n$ 变量中两个二次曲线的交集，我们证明了当 $n\geq 11$ 时各种直线的哈斯原理和弱近似，更一般地证明了当 $n\geq 3r+8$ 时各种 $r$ 平面的哈斯原理和弱近似。在此范围内，当且仅当每个实际完成的区域都存在一个 $r$ 平面时，地面场上才存在 $r$ 平面。对于线的多样性，我们还证明了当 $n\geq 8$ 时的哈斯原理和弱近似，条件是某些 Tate-Shafarevich 群的有限性。对于 $n$ 变量中的光滑立方超曲面，我们证明当 $n\geq 23$ 时，地面场上存在一条线。

items.title: Extreme central $L$-values of almost prime quadratic twists of elliptic curves II
items.excerpt: We prove lower bounds for central $L$-values of quadratic twists of an elliptic curve by discriminants with at most five prime factors. Under the rank-zero Birch--Swinnerton-Dyer formula, these bounds give large Tate--Shafarevich groups.
items.title_zh: 椭圆曲线 II 的几乎素数二次扭曲的极端中心 $L$ 值
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过最多五个素因子的判别式证明了椭圆曲线二次扭曲的中心 $L$ 值的下界。根据零阶 Birch--Swinnerton-Dyer 公式，这些界限给出了大的 Tate--Shafarevich 群。

items.title: Non-vanishing of central $\rm GL_3$ L-values in the level aspect
items.excerpt: We study non-vanishing of central standard $L$-values of spherical cuspidal $\mathrm{GL}_3$ newforms of prime level. A logarithmic M\"obius mollifier with finite inverse Euler factors, combined with a conjugate term from the functional equation, gives a non-vanishing harmonic proportion of at least $1/2-\varepsilon$ for every $\varepsilon>0$ and all sufficiently large prime levels. The required mixed moment is evaluated by an asymmetric approximate functional equation.
items.title_zh: 水平方面的中心 $\rm GL_3$ L 值不消失
items.excerpt_zh: We study non-vanishing of central standard $L$-values of spherical cuspidal $\mathrm{GL}_3$ newforms of prime level.具有有限逆欧拉因子的对数 M\"obius 缓和器与函数方程中的共轭项相结合，对于每个 $\varepsilon>0$ 和所有足够大的素数水平给出至少 $1/2-\varepsilon$ 的非零调和比例。所需的混合矩通过不对称近似函数方程进行评估。

items.title: Log-concavity of rank and crank statistics for integer partitions
items.excerpt: Let $M(m,n)$ and $N(m,n)$ denote the numbers of partitions of $n$ with crank $m$ and rank $m$, respectively. Ji and Zang [Adv. Math. 2021] conjectured that $M(m,n)$ is log-concave in $m$ for $n\ge72$ and $|m|\le n-72$, and that $N(m,n)$ is log-concave in $m$ for $n\ge73$ and $|m|\le n-73$. In this paper, we prove these two conjectures.
items.title_zh: 整数分区的秩和曲柄统计的对数凹性
items.excerpt_zh: Let $M(m,n)$ and $N(m,n)$ denote the numbers of partitions of $n$ with crank $m$ and rank $m$, respectively. Ji and Zang [Adv.数学。 2021] 推测对于 $n\ge72$ 和 $|m|\le n-72$，$M(m,n)$ 在 $m$ 中是对数凹的，对于 $n\ge73$ 和 $|m|\le n-73$，$N(m,n)$ 在 $m$ 中是对数凹的。 In this paper, we prove these two conjectures.

items.title: Automatic $n$-dimensional recurrences over finite $p$-groups with negative predecessor coordinates
items.excerpt: We study $n$-dimensional recurrences on $\mathbb{N}^n$ over finite $p$-groups. The rules are ordered products of group endomorphisms, with a $p$-automatic additional sequence and compatible $p$-automatic boundary data. For finite, nonempty, lexicographically positive predecessor sets, we prove automaticity whenever at most one coordinate contains entries of both signs. This covers all such systems for $n=1$ and $n=2$. For $n\ge3$, lexicographic positivity alone is insufficient: a fixed three-dimensional recurrence with a single nonzero boundary value is nonautomatic in base $p$ for every prime $p$. For nonnegative predecessors, we give a direct automaton construction and explicit state bounds in the abelian case. Negative coordinates are treated using algebraic power-series division, lifting modulo prime powers, central subgroups and boundary-preserving coordinate changes. A two-parameter family with a specified rule and a single boundary seed admits an exact automaticity criterion modulo prime powers. We also give nonabelian examples and finite computational certificates, including a proof of a previously proposed formula counting no
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究有限 $p$ 组上 $\mathbb{N}^n$ 的 $n$ 维递归。这些规则是群自同态的有序产物，具有 $p$-自动附加序列和兼容的 $p$-自动边界数据。对于有限的、非空的、字典顺序为正的前驱集，只要最多一个坐标包含两个符号的条目，我们就证明自动性。这涵盖了 $n=1$ 和 $n=2$ 的所有此类系统。对于 $n\ge3$，单独的字典正性是不够的：对于每个素数 $p$，具有单个非零边界值的固定三维递归在基数 $p$ 中是非自动的。对于非负前驱，我们给出了阿贝尔情况下的直接自动机构造和显式状态边界。使用代数幂级数除法、提升模素幂、中心子群和边界保持坐标变化来处理负坐标。具有指定规则和单个边界种子的二参数族承认模素数幂的精确自动性准则。我们还给出了非阿贝尔例子和有限计算证书，包括先前提出的公式的证明
items.title_zh: 具有负前驱坐标的有限 $p$ 组上的自动 $n$ 维递归

items.title: Positive Dual Certificates for Real Separated Subset Sums: Chamber Optimality of the Conway-Guy and Bohman Sets, and Exact Values up to Eight
items.excerpt: Let $f_R(n)$ be the least possible largest element of a set of $n$ positive reals whose $2^n$ subset sums are pairwise at least 1 apart, and let $f_Z(n) \ge f_R(n)$ be the corresponding integer quantity of the Erd\H{o}s distinct subset sums problem. Fixing the signs of all signed relations $\varepsilon\cdot x$, $\varepsilon \in \{-1,0,1\}^n$, decomposes the real problem into polyhedral chambers, on each of which it is a linear program. We prove that for every $n$ the Conway-Guy set is the unique optimum of its chamber. The proof is an explicit positive dual certificate consisting of $n$ signed relations that are tight at the Conway-Guy set and unit lower triangular in gap coordinates; the relations are described by blocks of consecutive coordinates together with the positions $n - k(k+1)/2$, and tightness reduces to an identity of the Conway-Guy sequence proved by induction. We then show, by a branch-and-bound over chambers in which every leaf carries an exact rational certificate, that $f_R(n) = f_Z(n)$ for all $n \le 8$; in particular $f_R(7) = 44$ and $f_R(8) = 84$. We then prove the same for both of Bohman's families, which first
items.title_zh: 实数分离子集和的正对偶证明：Conway-Guy 和 Bohman 集的室最优性，以及高达 8 的精确值
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $f_R(n)$ 为一组 $n$ 正实数的最小可能最大元素，其 $2^n$ 子集和至少成对为 1，并令 $f_Z(n) \ge f_R(n)$ 为 Erd\H{o}s 不同子集和问题的相应整数数量。固定所有符号关系 $\varepsilon\cdot x$, $\varepsilon \in \{-1,0,1\}^n$ 的符号，将实际问题分解为多面体室，每个多面体室上都是一个线性程序。我们证明，对于每 $n$，Conway-Guy 集都是其腔室的唯一最佳值。证明是一个显式正对偶证明，由 $n$ 签名关系组成，这些关系在 Conway-Guy 集和间隙坐标中的单位下三角上紧密；关系由连续坐标块和位置 $n - k(k+1)/2$ 来描述，紧密性简化为通过归纳证明的 Conway-Guy 序列的同一性。然后，我们通过室上的分支定界（其中每片叶子都带有精确的理性证明）来证明，对于所有 $n \le 8$， $f_R(n) = f_Z(n)$ ； in particular $f_R(7) = 44$ and $f_R(8) = 84$.然后我们证明博曼的两个家庭也是如此，首先

items.title: A $19/5$ lower bound for the four-dimensional Erd\H{o}s box problem
items.excerpt: For every power $q\ge2$ of~$2$, we construct a box-free subset of $[q^5]^4$ with $q^{19}$ points, improving the lower-bound exponent in the four-dimensional Erd\H{o}s box problem from $15/4$ to $19/5$. In fact, $[q^5]^4$ partitions into $q$ isomorphic box-free sets. The proof uses a finite-field rectangle lemma and orthogonality in a four-dimensional bilinear space. We also deduce a uniform bound $f_4(n)\ge2^{-19/20}n^{19/5}$ and a lower bound for grid-coloring numbers.
items.title_zh: 四维 Erd\H{o}s 框问题的 $19/5$ 下界
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 $q\ge2$ ~$2$ 的每一次幂，我们用 $q^{19}$ 点构建 $[q^5]^4$ 的无框子集，将四维 Erd\H{o}s 框问题中的下界指数从 $15/4$ 提高到 $19/5$。事实上，$[q^5]^4$ 划分为 $q$ 同构无盒集。该证明使用四维双线性空间中的有限域矩形引理和正交性。我们还推导了统一界限 $f_4(n)\ge2^{-19/20}n^{19/5}$ 和网格着色数字的下限。

items.title: $A_1^{(1)}$-Grounded partitions at levels $1$ and $2$, Part II: affine crystal structure
items.excerpt: Grounded partitions are coloured partitions with difference conditions, introduced by Dousse and Konan, that are in bijection with the paths of the Kyoto path model of Kang, Kashiwara, Misra, Miwa, Nakashima and Nakayashiki. We describe the affine crystal structure on the grounded partitions arising from the level $1$ and level $2$ perfect crystals of type $A_1^{(1)}$. At level $1$, grounded partitions are naturally identified with $2$-restricted partitions, and the affine crystal structure is given by Kleshchev's modular branching rule for symmetric groups in characteristic $2$. At level $2$, we give explicit bracketing rules which make grounded partitions into affine crystal graphs of highest weights $2\Lambda_0$, $\Lambda_0+\Lambda_1$, and $2\Lambda_1$. We prove this by constructing explicit graph isomorphisms with the asymptotic model of Ariki and Mathas, whose vertices are Kleshchev multipartitions arising from Ariki-Koike algebras. Finally, we erase the $0$-arrows, which leaves the crystal graphs of the restrictions to the Levi subalgebra, and decompose them into finite strings. This decomposition gives new $q$-series identities
items.title_zh: $A_1^{(1)}$-$1$ 和 $2$ 层的接地分区，第二部分：仿射晶体结构
items.excerpt_zh: 接地分区是 ​​Dousse 和 Konan 提出的具有不同条件的彩色分区，与 Kang、Kashiwara、Misra、Miwa、Nakashima 和 Nakayashiki 的京都路径模型的路径呈双射。我们描述了由 $1$ 级和 $2$ 级完美晶体 $A_1​​^{(1)}$ 产生的接地分区上的仿射晶体结构。在 $1$ 级，接地分区自然地与 $2$ 限制分区相同，并且仿射晶体结构由特征 $2$ 中对称群的 Kleshchev 模分支规则给出。在 $2$ 级别，我们给出了明确的括号规则，将接地分区划分为最高权重 $2\Lambda_0$、$\Lambda_0+\Lambda_1$ 和 $2\Lambda_1$ 的仿射晶体图。我们通过用 Ariki 和 Mathas 的渐近模型构造显式图同构来证明这一点，其顶点是由 Ariki-Koike 代数产生的 Kleshchev 多重划分。最后，我们删除 $0$ 箭头，留下列维子代数限制的晶体图，并将它们分解为有限串。这种分解给出了新的$q$系列恒等式

items.title: Dimension bounds for higher Bruhat orders
items.excerpt: We study the Dushnik-Miller dimension of higher Bruhat orders. For the inclusion order $B_{\mathrm{inc}}(n,k)$, with $k$ fixed, we prove that the order of dimension growth is $n^k$, by exhibiting standard examples for the lower bound and explicit systems of coordinates for the upper bound. A recent Tur\'an-system construction of Gao, Kuang, Pikhurko and Wang gives an upper coefficient within a factor smaller than $4$ of the lower coefficient. For the genuine higher Bruhat order $B(n,k)$, we construct for every fixed $k\ge3$ a standard example of order $n^{2k+1}$. We leave it open whether a polynomial upper bound on this dimension exists.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了更高 Bruhat 阶的 Dushnik-Miller 维数。对于包含顺序 $B_{\mathrm{inc}}(n,k)$，在 $k$ 固定的情况下，我们通过展示下界的标准示例和上限的显式坐标系来证明维度增长的顺序为 $n^k$。最近由 Gau、Kuang、Pikhurko 和 Wang 构建的图尔安系统给出了一个上系数，其系数小于下系数的 4 美元。对于真正的高阶 Bruhat 阶 $B(n,k)$，我们为每个固定的 $k\ge3$ 构造阶 $n^{2k+1}$ 的标准示例。我们对这个维度上是否存在多项式上限保持开放态度。
items.title_zh: 高 Bruhat 阶的尺寸界限

items.title: Isolation of $k$-cliques in uniform hypergraphs
items.excerpt: A copy of a hypergraph $F$ is called an $F$-copy. For any integers $k$ and $r$ with $2 \leq r \leq k$, let $K_k^r$ denote the complete $r$-uniform hypergraph whose vertex set is $[k] = \{1, 2, \dots, k\}$ (that is, the edges of $K_k^r$ are the $r$-element subsets of $[k]$). Given an $r$-uniform $m$-edge hypergraph $H$, the $K_k^r$-isolation number of $H$, denoted by $\iota(H, K_k^r)$, is the size of a smallest subset $D$ of the vertex set of $H$ such that the closed neighbourhood $N[D]$ of $D$ intersects the vertex sets of the $K_k^r$-copies contained by $H$ (equivalently, $H-N[D]$ contains no $K_k^r$-copy). We prove that if $H$ is connected and not a $K_k^r$-copy, then $$\iota(H, K^r_k) \le \left \lfloor \frac{(r-1)m + 1}{(r-1)(\binom{k}{r}+1) + 1} \right \rfloor.$$ The bound is best possible. This is a solution to a problem of Li, Zhang and Ye. We also provide an alternative proof for $r < k$. Both proofs introduce new ideas for establishing bounds on isolation parameters.
items.excerpt_zh: 超图 $F$ 的副本称为 $F$ 副本。对于任意整数 $k$ 和 $r$ 且 $2 \leq r \leq k$，设 $K_k^r$ 表示完整的 $r$-均匀超图，其顶点集为 $[k] = \{1, 2, \dots, k\}$（也就是说，$K_k^r$ 的边是 $[k]$ 的 $r$ 元素子集）。给定 $r$-均匀 $m$-边超图 $H$，$H$ 的 $K_k^r$-隔离数，用 $\iota(H, K_k^r)$ 表示，是 $H$ 顶点集的最小子集 $D$ 的大小，使得 $D$ 的闭邻域 $N[D]$ 与 $H$ 包含的 $K_k^r$-副本的顶点集相交（等效地，$H-N[D]$ 不包含 $K_k^r$ 副本）。我们证明，如果 $H$ 是连通的且不是 $K_k^r$ 副本，则 $$\iota(H, K^r_k) \le \left \lfloor \frac{(r-1)m + 1}{(r-1)(\binom{k}{r}+1) + 1} \right \rfloor。$$ 边界是最好的可能。这是解决李、张、叶的一个问题。我们还提供了 $r < k$ 的替代证明。这两个证明都引入了建立隔离参数界限的新想法。
items.title_zh: 均匀超图中 $k$ 派系的隔离

items.title: New Congruences for Simultaneously $l$-Regular and $t$-Distinct Partition in $k$-Colors
items.excerpt: Let $RD_{\ell,t}^k(n)$ enumerates the number of $k$-colored simultaneously $l$-regular and $t$-distinct partitions. In this article, we establish some new infinite families of congruences modulo prime $p$, $p\geq5$ and modulo powers of 5 for $RD_{\ell,t}^k(n)$. For instance, for each $n\geq0$, $0\leq\alpha\leq{2k-2}$ and $k\geq1$, \begin{align*} \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}RD_{(5^{2k-1},5^{2k-1})}^2\big(5^{2k+\alpha-1}n+\frac{9\cdot5^{2k+\alpha-1}-2\cdot5^{2k-1}+1}{12}\big)q^n\equiv& 0\pmod{5^{k+\left[\frac{\alpha}{2}\right]}} \end{align*}
items.authors: Anjelin Mariya Johnson, S. N. Fathima
items.title_zh: 以 $k$ 颜色同时进行 $l$-常规分区和 $t$-不同分区的新同余
items.excerpt_zh: 令$RD_{\ell,t}^k(n)$ 枚举同时$l$-常规分区和$t$-不同分区的$k$-颜色的数量。在本文中，我们为 $RD_{\ell,t}^k(n)$ 建立了一些新的模素数 $p$、$p\geq5$ 和 5 的模幂的无限同余族。例如，对于每个 $n\geq0$、$0\leq\alpha\leq{2k-2}$ 和 $k\geq1$，\begin{align*} \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}RD_{(5^{2k-1},5^{2k-1})}^2\big(5^{2k+\alpha-1}n+\frac{9\cdot5^{2k+\alpha-1}-2\cdot5^{2k-1}+1}{12}\big)q^n\equiv& 0\pmod{5^{k+\left[\frac{\alpha}{2}\right]}} \end{align*}

items.title: Sasakian Hodge Numbers of Calabi-Yau Links
items.excerpt: The link of an isolated weighted homogeneous hypersurface singularity whose degree equals the sum of its weights is a Sasakian manifold that admits a contact Calabi-Yau structure, and its Sasakian Hodge numbers are dimensions of graded pieces of the Milnor algebra of the defining polynomial. In earlier work these numbers were computed with Gr\"obner bases for the $7$-dimensional links of $7549$ of the $7555$ weighted Calabi-Yau threefold links, and two conjectures were raised from the data. The first asserts that polynomials with the same weights have Milnor algebras whose relevant graded pieces have equal dimensions; the second asserts that the Sasakian Hodge number $h^{2,1}_S$ of the link is bounded above by the Hodge number $h^{2,1}$ of the base Calabi-Yau threefold. Both conjectures are proved here. The first holds for every polynomial with an isolated singularity, because its partial derivatives form a regular sequence; an independent derivation of the Sasakian Hodge numbers by sheaf cohomology on the leaf-space orbifold is also given. For the second, the stringy Hodge numbers of the Calabi-Yau orbifold are shown to bound the mid
items.authors: Edward Hirst, Henrique N. S\'a Earp, Tom\'as S. R. Silva
items.title_zh: Calabi-Yau 链路的 Sasakian Hodge 数
items.excerpt_zh: 孤立加权齐次超曲面奇点的度等于其权重之和的链接是一个 Sasakian 流形，它允许接触 Calabi-Yau 结构，并且其 Sasakian Hodge 数是定义多项式的 Milnor 代数的分级部分的维数。在早期的工作中，这些数字是用 Gr\"obner 基针对 $7555$ 加权 Calabi-Yau 三重链接的 $7549$ 的 $7$ 维链接进行计算的，并从数据中提出了两个猜想。第一个断言具有相同权重的多项式具有 Milnor 代数，其相关分级部分具有相同的维数；第二个断言 Sasakian Hodge 数 $h^{2,1}_S$上面的链接由基本 Calabi-Yau 的 Hodge 数 $h^{2,1}$ 所限制，这里证明了第一个猜想对于每个具有孤立奇点的多项式都成立，因为它的偏导数形成了正则序列；对于第二个猜想，还给出了 Calabi-Yau 的弦 Hodge 数通过叶空间上同调的独立推导。显示轨道折叠以限制中间

items.title: A new tautological relation on $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{2,14}$ in cohomology
items.excerpt: We construct a relation $\mathsf{Q}$ in the cohomological tautological ring $\mathsf{RH}^*(\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{2,14})$ which lies outside the space of $3$-spin relations. $\mathsf{Q}$ is a simple linear combination of pure boundary strata classes of codimension 9 supported on the divisor $\Delta_0 \subset \overline{\mathcal{M}}_{2,14}$ of irreducible nodal curves, and transforms according to the irreducible representation of $\Sigma_{14}$ associated to the partition $(2^7)$. The result shows that the set of $3$-spin relations cannot be complete in cohomology. Motivic conjectures relating algebraic cycles to special values of $L$-functions suggest that $\mathsf{Q}$ is nonzero in Chow. More precisely, we prove that the Chow nonvanishing of $\mathsf{Q}$ follows from a conjecture of Harder concerning the failure of the Manin--Drinfeld principle in genus 2. We prove that $\mathsf{Q}$ vanishes in cohomology by pairing with generators of the tautological ring. items.title: Vector bundles on spin K\"ahler surfaces and the multi-spinor Seiberg-Witten equations
items.excerpt: We compute new lower bounds on the second Chern class of a vector bundle $\mathscr{E}$ on a spin K\"ahler surface $X$ that satisfies $c_1(\mathscr{E}) = 0$ and $H^2(\text{End}_0\mathscr{E}) = 0.$ When $X$ is a regular elliptic surface and $\mathscr{E}$ has rank 2, our bound is sharp. Our technique is to use Furuta's finite-dimensional approximation on the multi-spinor Seiberg-Witten equations, together with their algebro-geometric interpretation by the second named author. We also use these techniques to prove an existence theorem for singular Fueter sections and multi-spinor Seiberg-Witten solutions that holds for every Riemannian metric on a large class of 4-manifolds.
items.title_zh: 自旋K\"ahler曲面上的向量丛和多旋量Seiberg-Witten方程
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在自旋 K\"ahler 曲面 $X$ 上计算矢量丛 $\mathscr{E}$ 的第二陈类的新下界，满足 $c_1(\mathscr{E}) = 0$ 和 $H^2(\text{End}_0\mathscr{E}) = 0。$当 $X$ 是正则椭圆曲面且 $\mathscr{E}$ 的秩为 2 时，我们的我们的技术是使用 Furuta 对多旋量 Seiberg-Witten 方程的有限维近似，以及第二位作者的代数几何解释。我们还使用这些技术来证明奇异 Fueter 截面和多旋量 Seiberg-Witten 解的存在定理，该定理适用于一大类 4 流形上的每个黎曼度量。

items.title: Global generation of coinvariant vector bundles on $\overline{\mathrm{M}}_{0,n}$
items.excerpt: Using fusion closed-ness and strong generation properties, we identify collections of modules over vertex operator algebras (VOAs) whose induced vector bundles of coinvariants on the moduli space $\overline{\mathrm M}_{0,n}$ of stable $n$-pointed curves of genus zero are globally generated. These results specialize to \cite{Fak12} for affine VOAs at positive integer levels, and of \cite{DG23} for strongly rational VOAs that are generated in degree 1. To illustrate the results, and to show that fusion-closedness is essential, we give numerous examples, including Lattice VOAs, Simple Current Extensions of Affine VOAs, and various tensor products.
items.title_zh: $\overline{\mathrm{M}}_{0,n}$ 上全局生成共变向量束
items.excerpt_zh: 利用融合封闭性和强生成特性，我们识别了顶点算子代数（VOA）上的模块集合，其在模空间 $\overline{\mathrm M}_{0,n}$ 稳定的 $n$ 指向零亏格曲线上的共变体的诱导向量丛是全局生成的。这些结果专门针对正整数级别的仿射 VOA 的 \cite{Fak12} 以及针对 1 阶生成的强有理 VOA 的 \cite{DG23} 。为了说明结果并表明融合封闭性至关重要，我们给出了许多示例，包括格子 VOA、仿射 VOA 的简单电流扩展以及各种张量积。

items.title: Exceptional sequences of line bundles on $\mathrm{Fl}(1,\ell;\ell+1)$
items.excerpt: Let $X_\ell=\mathrm{Fl}(1,\ell;\ell+1)\subset\mathbb{P}^\ell\times(\mathbb{P}^\ell)^\vee$ be the incidence variety of points and hyperplanes in $\mathbb{P}^\ell$. We prove that for every $\ell\ge 3$, every exceptional sequence of line bundles on $X_\ell$ of maximal length $\ell(\ell+1)=\operatorname{rk} K_0(X_\ell)$ is full. Together with the case $\ell=2$, due to Altmann, Hochenegger and Witt, this shows that for all $\ell\ge2$ an exceptional sequence of line bundles on $X_\ell$ is full if and only if it has maximal length. The proof translates exceptionality into a combinatorial condition on lattice points of $\operatorname{Pic}(X_\ell)\cong\mathbb{Z}^2$ and reduces fullness to sequences containing a non-orthogonal descent. A capacity count for admissibly ordered subsets rules out all but one family of descents; for that family we classify the possible configurations and verify generation using Euler sequences and Koszul complexes.
items.title_zh: $\mathrm{Fl}(1,\ell;\ell+1)$ 上的线束异常序列
items.excerpt_zh: 设$X_\ell=\mathrm{Fl}(1,\ell;\ell+1)\subset\mathbb{P}^\ell\times(\mathbb{P}^\ell)^\vee$为$\mathbb{P}^\ell$中点和超平面的重合变化。我们证明，对于每个 $\ell\ge 3$，$X_\ell$ 上最大长度 $\ell(\ell+1)=\operatorname{rk} K_0(X_\ell)$ 上的每个特殊线束序列都是满的。与 $\ell=2$ 的情况一起，由于 Altmann、Hochenegger 和 Witt，这表明对于所有 $\ell\ge2$，$X_\ell$ 上的特殊线束序列是满的，当且仅当它具有最大长度时。该证明将例外性转化为 $\operatorname{Pic}(X_\ell)\cong\mathbb{Z}^2$ 格点上的组合条件，并将丰满度降低为包含非正交下降的序列。对可接受的有序子集的容量计数排除了除一个血统家族之外的所有血统；对于该族，我们对可能的配置进行分类，并使用欧拉序列和科祖尔复合体验证生成。

items.title: Inequalities for intersection numbers from Hodge-Riemann relations
items.excerpt: We derived inequalities for intersection numbers of nef classes inside algebras satisfying the K\"ahler package, using Hodge-Riemann relations up to degree two. As an application, we construct certain strictly Lorentzian polynomials and show that they cannot be realized as the volume polynomial of nef classes inside such an algebra.
items.title_zh: 霍奇-黎曼关系中的交集数不等式
items.excerpt_zh: 我们使用二阶霍奇-黎曼关系导出了满足 K\"ahler 包的代数内的 nef 类的交数不等式。作为应用，我们构造了某些严格的洛伦兹多项式，并表明它们不能实现为此类代数内的 nef 类的体积多项式。

items.title: A Helly theorem for the Bruhat-Tits building
items.excerpt: Let $K$ be a discretely valued field with valuation ring $\mathcal{O}$. We show that a finite family of $\mathcal{O}$-lattices in $K^m$ is adapted to a common basis if any subfamily of at most $m+1$ $\mathcal{O}$-lattices is. In other words, in the Bruhat-Tits building of $\operatorname{GL}(m)$, a finite family of simplices lies in a common apartment if and only if any subfamily of at most $m+1$ simplices does. The proof uses a version of Radon's theorem for $\mathcal{O}$-lattices. We also give an alternative proof using truncated modules.
items.authors: Rudrendra Kashyap, Kiumars Kaveh, Christopher Manon, Boris Tsvelikhovskiy
items.title_zh: Bruhat-Tits 大楼的 Helly 定理
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $K$ 为具有评估环 $\mathcal{O}$ 的离散值字段。我们证明，如果最多 $m+1$ $\mathcal{O}$-格子的任何子族满足，则 $K^m$ 中的 $\mathcal{O}$-格子的有限族适应于公共基础。换句话说，在 $\operatorname{GL}(m)$ 的 Bruhat-Tits 大楼中，当且仅当最多 $m+1$ 个单纯形的任何子族存在时，有限族单纯形位于公共公寓中。该证明使用 $\mathcal{O}$-格的 Radon 定理的一个版本。我们还提供了使用截断模块的替代证明。

items.title: Projective surfaces with infinite fundamental group and trivial profinite completion
items.excerpt: For every nontrivial finite abelian group \(A\) of odd order, we construct a smooth complex projective surface with infinite topological fundamental group and trivial \'{e}tale fundamental group. The isomorphism types of its finite subgroups are precisely those of the subgroups of \(A\). The surface is Kobayashi hyperbolic and has Stein universal cover.
items.title_zh: 具有无限基本群和平凡有限完成的射影曲面
items.excerpt_zh: 对于奇数阶的每个非平凡有限阿贝尔群\(A\)，我们构造一个具有无限拓扑基本群和平凡基本群的光滑复射影面。其有限子群的同构类型正是\(A\)子群的同构类型。表面为小林双曲线，并有斯坦因万能盖。

items.title: Annihilation versus anchoring of a topologically charged pair on a perforated two-dimensional surface
items.excerpt: Two independent random walks of opposite topological charge move on the discrete torus $(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^2$, which contains $k$ well-separated holes. The walks annihilate when they come within a core distance of each other, and each walk is anchored when it first touches a hole. We prove that the probability of annihilation before anchoring converges to $w_0/(w_0+\sum_j w_j)$, where the weights are explicit and depend only logarithmically on the sizes of the core and of the holes; for point-like core and holes, the limit is $1/(1+k)$. We then prove a fate theorem: the pair either terminates or ends as two opposite charges anchored on two different holes, with probability $(k-1)/(k+1)$ in the point-like case, and the hosting pair $\{j,l\}$ is chosen with probability proportional to $w_jw_l$. The proof combines an abstract competition lemma for rare sets in reversible Markov chains with sharp two-dimensional Green's function estimates.
items.title_zh: 穿孔二维表面上拓扑带电对的湮灭与锚定
items.excerpt_zh: 相反拓扑电荷的两个独立随机游走在离散圆环 $(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^2$ 上移动，其中包含 $k$ 个分隔良好的孔。当这些步道彼此进入核心距离时就会消失，并且当每个步道第一次接触到一个洞时就会被锚定。我们证明锚定前湮灭的概率收敛于 $w_0/(w_0+\sum_j w_j)$，其中权重是明确的并且仅与核心和孔的大小成对数关系；对于点状核心和孔，限制为 $1/(1+k)$。然后我们证明一个命运定理：该对要么终止，要么以锚定在两个不同孔上的两个相反电荷结束，在点状情况下概率为 $(k-1)/(k+1)$，并且选择托管对 $\{j,l\}$ 的概率与 $w_jw_l$ 成比例。该证明将可逆马尔可夫链中稀有集合的抽象竞争引理与尖锐的二维格林函数估计结合起来。

items.title: Finite speed Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac processes and their applications in generative modeling
items.excerpt: We study the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac (OU-K) process, where instead of a Brownian motion, a finite-speed Kac process defines the driving process. The OU-K process can be analyzed through a rescaled, time-inhomogeneous Kac process, characterized by a switching rate from the Kac part, and a convergence rate from the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) part. The law of this inhomogeneous Kac process describes the solution of a wave equation, the Euler-Poisson-Darboux (EPD) equation. For Kac switching rates being multiples of the OU convergence rate, we can explicitly derive this EPD solution via the sum of (the derivative of) two Legendre polynomials, restricted between two Dirac points representing the wave fronts. Using the framework of piecewise-deterministic Markov processes (PDMP), we describe the conditional velocity fields of the OU-K process via our polynomial-law-formula. This allows us to apply the OU-K process in a generative flow model. Since the OU-K velocity fields prove to be bounded by the finite Kac speed, the usual time truncations of diffusion models become unnecessary. We demonstrate advantages over diffusion and flow matching mode
items.authors: Richard Duong, Janis Auffenberg, Gabriele Steidl
items.title_zh: 有限速度 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac 过程及其在生成建模中的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac (OU-K) 过程，其中有限速度 Kac 过程定义了驱动过程，而不是布朗运动。 OU-K 过程可以通过重新调整的、时间不均匀的 Kac 过程进行分析，其特征在于 Kac 部分的切换速率和 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) 部分的收敛速率。这种非齐次 Kac 过程的定律描述了波动方程（Euler-Poisson-Darboux (EPD) 方程）的解。对于 Kac 切换速率是 OU 收敛速率的倍数，我们可以通过限制在表示波前的两个狄拉克点之间的两个勒让德多项式（的导数）之和明确导出此 EPD 解。使用分段确定性马尔可夫过程 (PDMP) 的框架，我们通过多项式定律公式描述 OU-K 过程的条件速度场。这使我们能够在生成流模型中应用 OU-K 过程。由于 OU-K 速度场被证明受到有限 Kac 速度的限制，因此扩散模型的通常时间截断变得不必要。我们展示了相对于扩散和流量匹配模式的优势

items.title: The elephant random walk with proportionally growing recent memory
items.excerpt: In this work, we study an elephant random walk with recent restricted memory, where at step $n$ the elephant remembers only the last $m_n=\max\{\lfloor cn\rfloor,1\}$ steps for $c\in(0,1)$. We show that the random walk undergoes a phase transition at the critical point $p_c=(3+\sqrt{1-c})/4$, which depends on the memory proportion $c$. For $0 <1$, $S_n/n^{\rho}$ converges almost surely and in $L^2$ to a random variable for some constant $\rho\in (1/2, 1)$. This phase transition differs from that of the classical elephant random walk and its remote-memory counterpart, both of which have the same fixed critical point $3/4$.
items.title_zh: 大象随机游走，近期记忆按比例增长
items.excerpt_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了最近记忆受限的大象随机游走，其中在步骤 $n$ 时，大象只记得 $c\in(0,1)$ 的最后 $m_n=\max\{\lfloor cn\rfloor,1\}$ 步骤。我们证明随机游走在关键点 $p_c=(3+\sqrt{1-c})/4$ 处经历相变，这取决于内存比例 $c$。对于 $0 <1$，$S_n/n^{\rho}$ 几乎肯定会收敛，并且在 $L^2$ 中收敛到某个常数 $\rho\in (1/2, 1)$ 的随机变量。这种相变不同于经典的大象随机游走及其远程记忆对应物的相变，两者都有相同的固定临界点 $3/4$。

items.title: Cubic local observability of Gaussian-blind sources in thermal $\phi^4_2$ fields
items.excerpt: We study external sources that are invisible to a spatially local observation in a massive Gaussian thermal field on a circle. A quadratic-reference calibration removes the first-order thermal mass-shift signal. For the resulting quartic model we prove a cutoff-independent, source-uniform $C^1$ expansion of local Wick cubic means. Its leading operator has the time-integrated cube of the thermal covariance as its kernel. A positive bilateral Laplace representation proves injectivity on the entire external source space, while analyticity gives exponential singular-value upper bounds. The expansion yields local Araki relative-entropy lower bounds on every fixed finite-dimensional source space, and a uniform separation theorem at every prescribed Sobolev resolution. Under an additional interval-length condition, a reflection-positivity identity yields an explicit, nonoptimal double-logarithmic conditional stability bound for this specific thermal kernel. Continuum probability estimates and the integrability assumptions of the Feynman--Kac--Nelson construction are verified in Section~3.
items.title_zh: 热 $\phi^4_2$ 场中高斯盲源的三次局部可观测性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究在圆形的巨大高斯热场中进行空间局部观测时不可见的外部源。二次参考校准消除了一阶热质量转移信号。对于所得的四次模型，我们证明了局部 Wick 三次均值的与截止无关、源均匀的 $C^1$ 展开。其主导算子以热协方差的时间积分立方为核。正双边拉普拉斯表示证明了整个外部源空间上的单射性，而解析性给出了指数奇异值上限。展开在每个固定的有限维源空间上产生局部 Araki 相对熵下界，并在每个规定的 Sobolev 分辨率上产生均匀分离定理。在附加的区间长度条件下，反射正恒等式产生了针对该特定热核的显式非最优双对数条件稳定性界限。 Feynman--Kac--Nelson 构造的连续概率估计和可积性假设在第~3 节中得到验证。

items.title: Domains of attraction of quasi-stationary distributions for an absorbed random walk
items.excerpt: We study a continuous-time random walk on the positive integers, killed at zero, where the downward rate $a$ and upward rate $b$ satisfy $a>b>0$. Its quasi-stationary distributions form a one-parameter family. We show that if the initial distribution $(m_n)_{n\geq 1}$ is strictly positive and satisfies $m_{n+1}/m_n\to r$, where $(b/a)^{1/2}<1$, then its conditional distribution given survival converges in total variation to the corresponding nonminimal quasi-stationary distribution. We obtain asymptotic equivalents for the joint probabilities of position and survival, and for the survival probability itself. We also give a moment condition under which the minimal quasi-stationary distribution is selected. Finally, we construct an initial distribution whose successive-term ratios do not converge but whose conditional distribution nevertheless converges to a nonminimal quasi-stationary distribution. Thus the ratio condition is sufficient but not necessary.
items.title_zh: 吸收随机游走的准平稳分布的吸引力域
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究正整数上的连续时间随机游走，杀死为零，其中向下速率 $a$ 和向上速率 $b$ 满足 $a>b>0$。其准平稳分布形成一个单参数族。我们证明，如果初始分布 $(m_n)_{n\geq 1}$ 严格为正，并且满足 $m_{n+1}/m_n\to r$，其中 $(b/a)^{1/2}<1$，则给定生存率的条件分布在全变分中收敛于相应的非最小准平稳分布。我们获得了位置和生存的联合概率以及生存概率本身的渐近等价。我们还给出了选择最小准平稳分布的矩条件。最后，我们构造一个初始分布，其连续项比率不收敛，但其条件分布仍然收敛于非最小准平稳分布。因此，比率条件是充分但不是必要的。

items.title: A Cut Finite Element Method with Boundary Value Correction for Robin, Neumann and Interface Conditions
items.excerpt: We extend the cut finite element method with boundary value correction of Burman, Hansbo and Larson [Math.\ Comp.\ 87 (2018) 633--657] to Robin and Neumann conditions and to interface problems with imperfect bonding. The formulation retains a piecewise affine boundary for all integration, while using the exact geometry only at boundary quadrature points. The correction uses Taylor expansions of the solution and its gradient along the discrete normal, with the exact normal used to evaluate the transported flux. At an interface, a further correction to the normal flux jump accounts for the difference between these two normals. Under the stated trace and Poincar\'e bounds, the corrected form is an $O(h^{1/2})$ perturbation of a symmetric form, whose matrix can therefore be used as a preconditioner. For a fixed finite Robin coefficient, we obtain the energy error bound $C_\beta(h^p+\delta_h^{m+1})$, whereas the bound uniform in the Robin coefficient is $C(h^p+h^{-1/2}\delta_h^{m+1})$, provided the Poincar\'e constant is uniform. With $\delta_h=O(h^2)$, the sufficient Taylor orders are therefore $2m+2\ge p$ and $2m+\frac32\ge p$, respectiv
items.authors: Erik Burman, Peter Hansbo, Mats G. Larson
items.title_zh: 罗宾、诺依曼和界面条件的边界值修正割有限元法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将 Burman、Hansbo 和 Larson [Math.\ Comp.\ 87 (2018) 633--657] 的边界值修正的切割有限元方法扩展到 Robin 和 Neumann 条件以及不完美粘合的界面问题。该公式为所有积分保留分段仿射边界，同时仅在边界正交点处使用精确的几何形状。校正使用解的泰勒展开及其沿离散法线的梯度，并使用精确法线来评估传输通量。在界面处，对法线通量跳跃的进一步修正说明了这两个法线之间的差异。在规定的迹和庞加莱边界下，校正形式是对称形式的 $O(h^{1/2})$ 扰动，因此其矩阵可以用作预条件子。对于固定的有限 Robin 系数，我们获得能量误差界限 $C_\beta(h^p+\delta_h^{m+1})$，而 Robin 系数的界限均匀性为 $C(h^p+h^{-1/2}\delta_h^{m+1})$，前提是庞加莱常数是均匀的。对于 $\delta_h=O(h^2)$，足够的泰勒阶数因此分别为 $2m+2\ge p$ 和 $2m+\frac32\ge p$

items.title: Gusto: a toolkit for compatible finite element dynamical cores
items.excerpt: Gusto is a tool for rapid prototyping of new algorithms based on compatible finite element methods for discretising the fluid equations in the dynamical core of weather and climate models. In this context, the development of new algorithms typically follows a path that involves testing on a hierarchy of simpler equation sets sharing important features of the mathematical structure of the equation set solved by the dynamical core. Gusto provides compatible finite element spatial discretisations of the hierarchy of equation sets, along with a range of timestepping schemes. The code is modular so that different spatial and temporal discretisations can be combined and the same schemes can be applied to any of the equation sets. This facilitates fair comparison of the schemes and makes the extension of any algorithmic developments to the more complex equation sets more straightforward. In this paper we present Gusto to the community by describing the algorithms implemented in Gusto and showcasing their performance through a variety of test problems commonly used in numerical weather prediction.
items.authors: Jemma Shipton, Thomas M. Bendall, Colin J. Cotter, David M. Acreman, Timothy C. Andrews, Jack Betteridge, Alex Brown, Thomas H. Gibson, Nell Hartney, David A. Ham, Joshua Hope-Collins, Jeremy A. Pike, Connor J. Ward, Dan Witt
items.title_zh: Gusto：兼容有限元动力核心的工具包
items.excerpt_zh: Gusto 是一种基于兼容的有限元方法快速构建新算法原型的工具，用于离散天气和气候模型动力学核心中的流体方程。在这种情况下，新算法的开发通常遵循一条路径，涉及对更简单的方程组的层次结构进行测试，这些方程组共享由动力核心求解的方程组的数学结构的重要特征。 Gusto 提供了方程组层次结构的兼容有限元空间离散化，以及一系列时间步进方案。该代码是模块化的，因此可以组合不同的空间和时间离散化，并且可以将相同的方案应用于任何方程组。这有利于方案的公平比较，并使任何算法开发扩展到更复杂的方程组更加直接。在本文中，我们通过描述 Gusto 中实现的算法并向社区展示 Gusto，并通过数值天气预报中常用的各种测试问题展示其性能。

items.title: A Unified Framework for First- and Second-Order Energy-Stable Parametric Finite Element Methods for Planar Willmore Flow
items.excerpt: The construction of structure-preserving schemes for planar Willmore flow that are second-order accurate in time and avoid large coupled nonlinear solves remains challenging. In this work, we develop a unified framework for first- and second-order fully discrete energy-stable parametric finite element schemes for planar Willmore flow with a length-penalization term. The framework is based on a new equivalent reformulation involving a global auxiliary variable. The main novelty lies in the second-order construction, which combines midpoint curvature quantities weighted by elementwise arc-length Jacobian ratios with a compatible discrete tangent to obtain exact discrete chain rules for the bending energy and curve length. A further contribution is to show that both schemes satisfy discrete modified energy dissipation laws that yield the same type of a priori bounds on the discrete solution as the original energy law. They also retain Barrett--Garcke--N{\"u}rnberg tangential motion to promote favorable mesh distribution. items.title_zh: 平面威尔莫尔流一阶和二阶能量稳定参数有限元方法的统一框架
items.excerpt_zh: 构建时间上二阶精确并避免大耦合非线性求解的平面威尔莫尔流结构保持方案仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们为具有长度惩罚项的平面威尔莫尔流的一阶和二阶完全离散能量稳定参数有限元方案开发了一个统一的框架。该框架基于涉及全局辅助变量的新的等效重新表述。主要新颖之处在于二阶结构，它将由元素弧长雅可比比加权的中点曲率量与兼容的离散正切相结合，以获得弯曲能量和曲线长度的精确离散链规则。进一步的贡献是表明这两种方案都满足离散修正能量耗散定律，这些定律在离散解上产生与原始能量定律相同类型的先验界限。他们还保留了 Barrett--Garcke--N{\"u}rnberg 切向运动以促进有利的网格分布。每个阶段都减少为具有完全相同的系数矩阵的两个线性求解和一个标量非线性求解。我们

items.title: Convergence analysis of physics-informed neural networks for subdiffusion
items.excerpt: Physics-informed neural networks have emerged as mesh-free solvers for partial differential equations, yet their rigorous convergence theory for time-fractional problems remains limited. We present a convergence analysis of PINNs for linear subdiffusion equations and for the associated backward problem of recovering the initial data from terminal observations. To address the nonlocality and weakly singular kernels of fractional derivatives, we introduce a discretization-based PINN framework built on some popular time-stepping schemes satisfying discrete maximal regularity, including backward Euler, BDF2, L1, and fractional CN schemes. This approach avoids the exact evaluation of fractional derivatives at training points while preserving the stability structure needed for convergence analysis. For the forward problem, we prove that, under the natural fractional maximal-regularity condition $u\in W^{\alpha,p}(0,T;L^2(\Omega))\cap L^p(0,T;H^2(\Omega)\cap H_0^1(\Omega))$, the piecewise linear temporal reconstructions of PINN-loss minimizers converge to the exact solution.
