items.authors: Bangti Jin, Qiqi Rao, Zhi Zhou
items.title_zh: 次扩散的物理信息神经网络的收敛性分析
items.excerpt_zh: 基于物理的神经网络已成为偏微分方程的无网格求解器，但其针对时间分数问题的严格收敛理论仍然有限。我们针对线性次扩散方程以及从终端观测中恢复初始数据的相关后向问题提出了 PINN 的收敛分析。为了解决分数导数的非定域性和弱奇异核问题，我们引入了一种基于离散化的 PINN 框架，该框架建立在一些满足离散最大正则性的流行时间步进方案上，包括后向 Euler、BDF2、L1 和分数 CN 方案。这种方法避免了在训练点对分数阶导数的精确评估，同时保留了收敛分析所需的稳定性结构。对于前向问题，我们证明，在自然分数最大正则性条件 $u\in W^{\alpha,p}(0,T;L^2(\Omega))\cap L^p(0,T;H^2(\Omega)\cap H_0^1(\Omega))$ 下，PINN 损失最小化器的分段线性时间重建收敛于精确解。该结果避免了 e 上的高阶正则性假设

items.title: Effectively nuclear C*-algebras
items.excerpt: We study the computable content of nuclearity for $C^*$-algebras. We show that nuclearity effectivizes automatically: a presentation of a $C^*$-algebra is effectively nuclear, in the sense that the completely positive approximations witnessing nuclearity can be computed uniformly from the data they approximate, if and only if it is a computable presentation of a nuclear $C^*$-algebra, and likewise for the effectivization of the Choi--Effros form of nuclearity. The main tool is an effective version of the Arveson extension theorem: we prove that the $n$-th matrix numerical range of a tuple from a computable presentation is computably compact, uniformly in all of its data, and deduce an algorithm which converts an approximately attainable tuple of matrices into a computable unital completely positive map attaining it. A byproduct is that the computable states of any computable presentation of a unital $C^*$-algebra are weak$^*$-dense in its state space. items.title: Weak Generators in Stable Module Categories
items.excerpt: The aim of this note is to show that the existence of weak generators in the stable module category of a ring, or equivalently, of $p$-indigent modules in the terminology of Holston et al., depends on the underlying model of set theory.
items.title_zh: 稳定模块类别中的弱生成器
items.excerpt_zh: 本文的目的是表明，环的稳定模类别中弱生成元的存在，或者等效地，用 Holston 等人的术语来说，$p$-indigent 模的存在，取决于集合论的基础模型。

items.title: Direction or Magnitude? Learning Scalars over Task-Calibrated Directions
items.excerpt: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) aims to preserve adaptation quality while reducing training costs. We propose SCALAR, which achieves performance comparable to LoRA with substantially fewer trainable parameters, lower peak training memory, and higher throughput. SCALAR constructs a fixed input basis from task activations and assigns a random output dictionary to each input direction. Fine-tuning learns only layer-specific scalar coefficients, reducing gradient and optimizer-state storage. Grouped computation aggregates output atoms before applying the adapter to token activations, while dictionary sharing across compatible layers reduces fixed-basis storage. Experiments on commonsense reasoning, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge evaluation after instruction tuning demonstrate effective adaptation at small trainable budgets. On commonsense reasoning, SCALAR achieves accuracy comparable to LoRA with about 4% of its trainable parameters. items.title: Quantum Graph Neural Networks: Architectures, Trainability, and Applications
items.excerpt: Quantum graph neural networks (QGNNs) apply parametrized quantum circuits to graph-structured data, with the aim of overcoming limits of classical graph neural networks in scalability, expressivity, and long-range information flow. Since the first Hamiltonian-based model in 2019, the field has produced many architectures, applications, and claims, but the evidence behind them has not been assessed systematically. This survey introduces a unified formalism that describes every QGNN as an encoder, a graph-conditioned circuit, observables, and an optional classical head, together with a circuit-level condition for permutation equivariance and a resource model for comparing costs. We organize the literature into five architecture families (convolutional, equivariant, message-passing and recurrent, Hamiltonian, and hybrid) and compare them by qubit cost, symmetry, scalability, and evidence. items.title: On the Limits of Sufficient Explanations
items.excerpt: We formally characterize the conditions under which sufficient explanations exist for classifiers on structured data such as graphs and strings. We focus on post-hoc explainers that select parts of the input as sufficient explanations. An explanation is sufficient if the selected part alone ensures the predicted label. Sufficient explanations have been widely adopted across data modalities, including graphs, strings, and images. However, a unified formal analysis of sufficient explanations remains missing. We bridge this gap with four main contributions: (i) We define a general explanation formalism consisting of an instance space, a classifier, and a select relation. items.title_zh: 论充分解释的限度

items.title: Small Is Not Dead: Distance-Aware Cluster Revival for e-means
items.excerpt: e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) is a recent mini-batch k-means algorithm, now part of the FAISS library, that reaches the error of Lloyd's algorithm about an order of magnitude faster on large embedding datasets. Every five mini-batches, it removes every cluster whose running point count falls below a tenth of the average and reuses its centre to split a large cluster. In the authors' ablation, removing this mechanism, called dead-cluster revival, raises the error more than removing any other component added to the moving-average update. The rule, however, considers only cluster size: it cannot distinguish a cluster that is small because it is redundant from one that covers a rare, isolated group of points, and on data with such groups it repeatedly removes centres whose removal is costly. We add a second condition, based on the distance between centres: a small cluster is removed only if its centre is close to another centre, relative to a running estimate of the mean squared error. items.title: ParetoM$^3$: Learning on the Pareto Set under Preference Guidance via Min-Max-Min Optimization
items.excerpt: Learning across multiple inherently conflicting objectives requires selecting desirable trade-offs from the Pareto set. In this work, we study preference-guided multi-objective optimization, where a predefined preference function is minimized over the weak Pareto set of multiple nonconvex objectives. Leveraging a merit function that vanishes on the weak Pareto set, we propose a penalty-based min-max-min formulation, termed the M$^3$ problem, which unifies preference optimization and the enforcement of weak Pareto optimality in a single objective. We further develop ParetoM$^3$, a single-loop first-order algorithm for computing stationary solutions of the resulting M$^3$ problem. Under a local Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz assumption, we prove that ParetoM$^3$ finds an $\epsilon$-stationary point of the M$^3$ problem that is also approximately weakly Pareto optimal for the original multi-objective problem when the penalty parameter is sufficiently large, with explicit non-asymptotic convergence rates. We also show that this stationarity notion recovers existing optimality criteria, including approximate preference stationarity and approximate Ka

items.title: Uncertainty-Aware Continual Learning for 2D XRD Interpretation Using Simulated and Experimental Data
items.excerpt: Autonomous experimentation systems require characterization models that can interpret heterogeneous measurements and maintain predictive performance as data accumulate. Developing such models involves addressing domain mismatch between data sources, overconfident predictions on unfamiliar inputs, and catastrophic forgetting during sequential updates. In this work, we present a proof-of-concept framework for uncertainty-aware continual interpretation of two-dimensional X-ray diffraction (XRD) data. The framework integrates established components: maximum mean discrepancy-based domain adaptation to reduce simulation-to-experiment discrepancies, a convolutional neural network with a spectral-normalized neural Gaussian process (CNN--SNGP) for predictive uncertainty estimation, and replay with knowledge distillation for sequential model updating. We evaluate the framework using simulated and previously-collected experimental data for crystal structure classification of single-phase body-centered cubic, face-centered cubic, and hexagonal close-packed patterns. Data are organized into predefined sequential blocks to assess adaptation and r
items.authors: Zihan Wang, Hyun Sang Park, Ali Rachidi, David Elbert, Todd C. Hufnagel, Wei Chen
items.excerpt_zh: 自主实验系统需要能够解释异构测量并在数据积累时保持预测性能的表征模型。开发此类模型涉及解决数据源之间的领域不匹配、对不熟悉的输入的过度自信预测以及顺序更新期间的灾难性遗忘。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个概念验证框架，用于二维 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 数据的不确定性感知连续解释。该框架集成了已建立的组件：基于最大平均差异的域适应，以减少模拟与实验的差异，具有用于预测不确定性估计的谱归一化神经高斯过程（CNN--SNGP）的卷积神经网络，以及用于顺序模型更新的知识蒸馏重放。我们使用模拟和先前收集的实验数据来评估该框架，用于单相体心立方、面心立方和六方密堆积图案的晶体结构分类。 Data are organized into predefined sequential blocks to assess adaptation and r

items.title: Contrastive local learning in large nonlinear analog circuits
items.excerpt: Machine learning in physical hardware promises to reduce training cost by colocating computation, memory and adaptation within device physics. Contrastive local learning networks (CLLNs) offer a compelling route: an electrical circuit relaxes to equilibrium in free and weakly clamped states, and each adaptive element updates from local voltage contrasts rather than backpropagated error signals. Yet whether nonlinear transistor implementations can scale beyond proof-of-concept circuits, and what design principles control that scaling, have remained unknown. Here we show that nonlinear analog circuits trained by contrastive local rules can learn larger machine-learning tasks and remain robust under hardware nonidealities. Using device-level circuit simulations, we systematically explore initialization, operating regime, loss-dependent clamping and training parameters, and scale CLLNs beyond ten thousand adaptive edges. The same local rule trains classifiers that reach the accuracy regime of conventional digital methods on Ionosphere and handwritten-digit benchmarks, and a network that autoregressively generates language over a 122-tok
items.authors: Pragyan Pandey, Peter Wu, Deema Alyahya, Eric Y. Ma
items.title_zh: 大型非线性模拟电路中的对比局部学习
items.excerpt_zh: 物理硬件中的机器学习有望通过在设备物理中并置计算、内存和适应来降低训练成本。对比局部学习网络（CLLN）提供了一条引人注目的途径：电路在自由和弱钳位状态下松弛至平衡，并且每个自适应元件根据局部电压对比而不是反向传播的误差信号进行更新。然而，非线性晶体管的实现是否可以扩展到概念验证电路之外，以及什么设计原则控制这种扩展，仍然未知。在这里，我们表明，通过对比局部规则训练的非线性模拟电路可以学习更大的机器学习任务，并在硬件非理想情况下保持鲁棒性。使用器件级电路仿真，我们系统地探索初始化、操作机制、损耗相关钳位和训练参数，并将 CLLN 扩展到超过一万个自适应边缘。相同的本地规则训练分类器，使其在电离层和手写数字基准上达到传统数字方法的准确度，以及在 122-tok 上自回归生成语言的网络

items.title: See Every Block Once: Variance-Reduced Post-Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
items.excerpt: Policy gradient methods are widely used to align large language model outputs with human preferences, but the log-likelihoods they require cannot be directly computed in Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). MDLM post-training therefore relies on a surrogate objective based on the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), and recent work estimates a blockwise variant of this objective via Monte Carlo methods to support blockwise generation. However, existing estimation schemes randomly sample the block index, so they may evaluate the same block more than once and leave some blocks unevaluated. This introduces variance arising from block selection into the estimates. In this work, we propose a full-block estimator that evaluates every block exactly once and averages the results. We theoretically show that the proposed estimator remains unbiased while eliminating the between-group variance arising from block selection, thereby achieving lower variance than the baseline for the same sample size. In experiments on five benchmarks spanning mathematics, planning, and coding, our method achieves the highest accuracy on four benchmarks and outperforms
items.authors: Yunzhen He, Hiroaki Yamagiwa, Hidetoshi Shimodaira
items.title_zh: 查看每个块一次：掩蔽扩散语言模型的方差减少后训练
items.excerpt_zh: 策略梯度方法广泛用于使大型语言模型输出与人类偏好保持一致，但它们所需的对数似然不能在掩蔽扩散语言模型（MDLM）中直接计算。因此，MDLM 训练后依赖于基于证据下界 (ELBO) 的替代目标，最近的工作通过蒙特卡洛方法估计该目标的分块变体以支持分块生成。然而，现有的估计方案对块索引进行随机采样，因此它们可能多次评估同一块，而使某些块未被评估。这将块选择产生的方差引入到估计中。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个全块估计器，它对每个块进行一次评估并对结果进行平均。我们从理论上表明，所提出的估计量保持无偏，同时消除了由于块选择而产生的组间方差，从而在相同样本量的情况下实现了比基线更低的方差。在涉及数学、规划和编码的五个基准的实验中，我们的方法在四个基准上实现了最高的准确度，并且表现优于其他基准

items.title: Folding Language Models into Themselves
items.excerpt: Knowledge distillation usually trains a compact student from scratch, which needs a large amount of data even though the teacher's weights already encode most of what the student has to learn. In this work, we explore building the student directly from the teacher's weights. We propose Concertina, which folds every group of N adjacent teacher layers into one shared block that is executed N times. Each loop step carries a low-rank correction initialized from the layer it replaces, and a per-token gate mixes these corrections, to let every token recover the behavior of the original layers from a single shared block. We further design a distillation data recipe that balances general, mathematical, academic and targeted multiple-choice data, to recover all capabilities of the teacher together rather than one at the expense of another. On Qwen3-4B, a 2.27B Concertina model distilled on 22B tokens retains about 90% of the teacher on commonsense and mathematical reasoning and 84% on average across eight benchmarks. items.authors: Ziyang Zhang, Yubin Jing, Yuyao Li, Haofan Wang, Yichen Gong
items.title_zh: 将语言模型折叠起来
items.excerpt_zh: 知识蒸馏通常从头开始训练紧凑的学生，即使教师的权重已经编码了学生必须学习的大部分内容，这也需要大量数据。在这项工作中，我们探索直接根据教师的权重构建学生。我们提出了 Concertina，它将每组 N 个相邻的教师层折叠成一个执行 N 次的共享块。每个循环步骤都带有从其替换的层初始化的低秩校正，并且每个令牌门混合这些校正，以使每个令牌从单个共享块恢复原始层的行为。我们进一步设计了一种蒸馏数据配方，平衡一般、数学、学术和有针对性的多项选择数据，以恢复教师的所有能力，而不是以牺牲另一种能力为代价。在 Qwen3-4B 上，在 22B 代币上提取的 2.27B 手风琴模型在常识和数学推理方面保留了约 90% 的知识，在八个基准测试中平均保留了 84%。它的性能优于相同大小的密集和层共享基线以及经过一千多次训练的 Qwen3-1.7B

items.title: Beyond Gold Standards: Epistemic Ensemble of LLM Judges for Formal Mathematical Reasoning
items.excerpt: Statement autoformalization plays a crucial role in formal mathematical reasoning by enabling the automatic translation of natural language statements into formal languages. While recent advances using large language models (LLMs) have shown promising capabilities in autoformalization, methods for automatically evaluating autoformalization remain underexplored. LLM-as-a-judge presents a promising approach for automating such evaluation, however, existing methods typically employ coarse-grained and generic evaluation criteria, which limit their effectiveness for advanced formal mathematical reasoning, where quality hinges on nuanced, multi-granular dimensions. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this gap by introducing a systematic, automatic method to evaluate autoformalization tasks. The proposed method is based on an epistemically and formally grounded ensemble (EFG) of LLM judges, defined on criteria encompassing logical preservation (LP), mathematical consistency (MC), formal quality (FQ), and formal validity (FV), resulting in a transparent assessment that accounts for different contributing factors. items.authors: Lan Zhang, Marco Valentino, Jordan Meadows, Andr\'e Freitas
items.title_zh: 超越黄金标准：法学硕士正式数学推理法官的认知集合

items.title: BBOWP-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Black-Box Optimization Word Problems
items.excerpt: Formulating an optimization problem strongly affects final solution quality, yet good formulations usually require substantial expertise. Recent studies have explored automatically deriving optimization problems from natural-language descriptions, but existing benchmarks focus on settings where objectives and constraints can be written explicitly as mathematical expressions. Many practically important problems are naturally treated as black-box optimization (BBO) problems, in which only objective values are observable, and the functional form is unavailable. In BBO, search space design (as part of problem formulation) and optimization algorithm selection are crucial for problem-solving. Automating these processes with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging. We introduce Black-Box Optimization Word Problems (BBOWP), a novel problem setting in which a system must infer both a search space and an optimization algorithm from a natural-language description of a black-box optimization task. To support research on this setting, we establish the BBOWP Benchmark Suite (BBOWP-Bench), a dataset and evaluation framework for BBOWP. E

items.title: Inject a Turn, Not a Token: Learning Where to Redirect LLM Reasoning for Self-Correction
items.excerpt: Large language models struggle to reliably identify and correct errors in their own reasoning. Unlike prior training-based approaches that fine-tune an LLM to generate revisions or feedback, we learn where to intervene in failed rollouts and determine how to redirect them. To choose where to intervene, we train a 130K-parameter MLP head on a frozen encoder using only final-answer correctness. For redirection, we find that under a fixed generation budget, the tested inline injections fail to reliably redirect reasoning, whereas presenting the same instruction in a new user turn changes the model's course. The resulting correction framework, UPTURN (User-Prompt TURN injection at a learned position), requires no LLM fine-tuning: it retains a selected prefix, injects an instruction as a new user turn, and regenerates the suffix. Across four reasoners and six math benchmarks, UPTURN improves average accuracy in every setting over a 32-rollout baseline. It outperforms self-correction and reflection-token injection baselines under matched correction budgets, transfers across reasoners and to GPQA-Diamond without retraining, and complemen
items.authors: Jiwon Jeon, Myungsik Cho, Jeonghye Kim, Youngchul Sung
items.title_zh: 注入转向，而不是代币：学习如何重定向 LLM 推理以进行自我纠正
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型很难可靠地识别和纠正自身推理中的错误。与之前基于培训的方法对法学硕士进行微调以生成修订或反馈不同，我们学习在何处干预失败的推出并确定如何重新引导它们。为了选择干预位置，我们仅使用最终答案正确性在冻结编码器上训练 130K 参数 MLP 头。对于重定向，我们发现在固定的生成预算下，测试的内联注入无法可靠地重定向推理，而在新用户轮流中呈现相同的指令会改变模型的过程。由此产生的校正框架 UPTURN（在学习位置进行用户提示 TURN 注入）不需要 LLM 微调：它保留选定的前缀，在新的用户回合中注入指令，并重新生成后缀。通过 4 个推理器和 6 个数学基准，UPTURN 在 32 次推出的基线上提高了每种设置的平均准确度。它在匹配的校正预算下优于自我校正和反射令牌注入基线，无需重新训练即可跨推理器传输并传输到 GPQA-Diamond，并且补充

items.title: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
items.excerpt: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains unresolved. Adding a language reward did not ensure use of the requested script. Passage answering and script compliance therefore need direct evaluation, even when other benchmark scores improve.
items.authors: Sutanshu Saksena Raj, Daksh Maan, Avinash Benki, Parijat Chatterjee, Pasunuti Prasanjith, Purusharth Malik
items.title_zh: 强化学习后印度任务的增益和回归
items.excerpt_zh: 我们使用 GRPO 在四种环境中运行强化学习 (RL)，从覆盖英语和八种印度语言的监督微调 30B-A3B 专家混合模型开始。我们在一项评估活动中通过 34 个基准比较了强化学习前后的模型。 MATH 提高了 36.07 点，大多数印度基准也有所提高。然而，由于英语答案从 8.7% 上升至 91.7%，XQuAD-Indic F1 下降了 19.32 分； IndicQA 下降 8.64，而 English XQuAD F1 上升 11.71。来自相同监督初始化的第二次 RL 运行添加了印度语环境以及语言和重复奖励。与发布的模型相比，它提高了段落回答和指令遵循基准，同时保留了数学性能。但它在推理和编码基准方面失去了优势。几种训练选择同时发生变化，因此我们无法孤立任何一项奖励条件的影响。脚本合规性仍未解决。添加语言奖励并不能确保所请求的脚本的使用。因此，即使其他基准分数有所提高，段落回答和脚本合规性也需要直接评估。

items.title: From Reading Code to Reading Spec: A Verified Layer for LLM-Driven Codebase Maintenance
items.excerpt: The rapid growth of LLM-generated code increases software complexity and the maintenance burden on engineers. While LLMs offer a potential automated alternative, this structural complexity hinders their ability to manage codebases directly. We introduce the Provable Representation Of Original Functionality (PROOF), which manages codebases indirectly via structured specifications. To enable full-lifecycle codebase management strictly through these specifications, PROOF abstracts codebase topology into a hierarchical natural-language representation. To establish absolute trust, the system proves semantic equivalence by reconstructing source code exclusively from this specification. This verified foundation drives maintenance requests, executing code modifications while synchronously updating itself to prevent semantic drift. Experiments on real-world repositories confirm the effectiveness of these specifications.
items.authors: Xinhao Zhang, Jingjie Lu, Kunpeng Liu, Fei Xie
items.title_zh: 从阅读代码到阅读规范：LLM 驱动的代码库维护的验证层
items.excerpt_zh: LLM 生成的代码的快速增长增加了软件复杂性和工程师的维护负担。虽然法学硕士提供了潜在的自动化替代方案，但这种结构复杂性阻碍了他们直接管理代码库的能力。我们引入了原始功能的可证明表示（PROOF），它通过结构化规范间接管理代码库。为了严格通过这些规范实现全生命周期代码库管理，PROOF 将代码库拓扑抽象为分层自然语言表示。为了建立绝对信任，系统通过专门根据该规范重构源代码来证明语义等效性。这个经过验证的基础驱动维护请求，执行代码修改，同时同步更新自身以防止语义漂移。对现实世界存储库的实验证实了这些规范的有效性。

items.title: How Much Is Left Matters: False Positives and False Negatives in Partial-Prompt Contamination Tests
items.excerpt: Partial-prompt completion, where a model receives the first part of a benchmark problem and is checked for whether it reproduces the rest, is a widely used test for benchmark contamination. We audit this test on seven open-weight models using MATH-500 and recent AIME 2025/2026 problems, which serve as true negatives. Memorization flags depend strongly on how much text remains: for every model, problems with at most 8 leftover words are flagged several times more often than problems with at least 25 (31.5% vs. 5.5% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), and half to three-quarters of all ROUGE-based flags come from short leftovers. On true negatives, a ROUGE-L >= 0.75 threshold flags up to 6.7% of problems at a 60% prefix, and at an 80% prefix even exact match flags 8.6% (pooled over models; 6.2% on AIME 2026, which postdates every model), against 0% at 40-60%. The test also misses contamination upstream: models distilled from Qwen2.5-Math, whose base is heavily flagged in prior work, show almost no model-specific recall. Calibrating each model against models from other families removes most flags while isolating a consistent Qwen2.5-speci
items.title_zh: 剩下多少很重要：部分即时污染测试中的假阳性和假阴性
items.excerpt_zh: Partial-prompt completion, where a model receives the first part of a benchmark problem and is checked for whether it reproduces the rest, is a widely used test for benchmark contamination.我们使用 MATH-500 和最近的 AIME 2025/2026 问题对七个开放权重模型进行了测试，这些模型作为真负数。 Memorization flags depend strongly on how much text remains: for every model, problems with at most 8 leftover words are flagged several times more often than problems with at least 25 (31.5% vs. 5.5% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), and half to three-quarters of all ROUGE-based flags come from short leftovers. On true negatives, a ROUGE-L >= 0.75 threshold flags up to 6.7% of problems at a 60% prefix, and at an 80% prefix even exact match flags 8.6% (pooled over models; 6.2% on AIME 2026, which postdates every model), against 0% at 40-60%. The test also misses contamination upstream: models distilled from Qwen2.5-Math, whose base is heavily flagged in prior work, show almost no model-specific recall.根据其他系列的模型校准每个模型会删除大多数标志，同时隔离一致的 Qwen2.5 规范

items.title: Cover times of random recursive trees and linear preferential attachment trees
items.excerpt: We study the cover times of uniform random recursive trees and linear preferential attachment trees, including the negative-parameter models corresponding to random $d$-ary increasing trees. We prove explicit limits in probability and expectation when the cover times are rescaled by $n (\log n)^2$. In particular, for the uniform random recursive tree the cover time is close to $e n (\log n)^2$ with high probability.
items.authors: Omer Angel , Christina Goldschmidt , Peleg Michaeli
items.title_zh: 随机递归树和线性优先附着树的覆盖次数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究均匀随机递归树和线性优先附着树的覆盖时间，包括与随机$d$元递增树相对应的负参数模型。当覆盖时间按 $n (\log n)^2$ 重新调整时，我们证明了概率和期望的明确限制。特别是，对于均匀随机递归树，覆盖时间很有可能接近 $e n (\log n)^2$。

items.title: The speed of convergence for propagation of chaos in the mean-field Ising model
items.excerpt: We derive sharp relative-entropy asymptotics for increasing propagation of chaos in the Curie--Weiss model at zero external field. For every fixed inverse temperature $0<\beta<1$, the relative entropy of a $k$-spin marginal with respect to the symmetric product measure is $$ \frac{\beta^2}{4(1-\beta)^2}\frac{k(k-1)}{N^2}+o\left(\frac{k^2}{N^2}\right),\qquad k=o(N). $$ At the critical inverse temperature $\beta=1$, the rate changes to $\alpha_{\mathrm c}^2 k(k-1)/(4N)+o(k^2/N)$ in the regime $k=o(\sqrt N)$, where $\alpha_{\mathrm c}$ is the second moment of the limiting quartic law of the rescaled magnetization. We also obtain asymptotics for sequences $\beta_N\uparrow1$ that interpolate between these two regimes. Crucially, the proof reveals that the pair correlations determine the leading correction to the likelihood ratio, providing precise control of both the chi-square divergence and relative entropy.
items.authors: Jonas Jalowy , Matthias Löwe , Sara Terveer
items.title_zh: 平均场伊辛模型中混沌传播的收敛速度
items.excerpt_zh: 我们推导了尖锐的相对熵渐近论，以增加零外场下居里-韦斯模型中混沌的传播。对于每个固定逆温度 $0<\beta<1$，$k$-自旋边际相对于对称乘积测度的相对熵为 $$ \frac{\beta^2}{4(1-\beta)^2}\frac{k(k-1)}{N^2}+o\left(\frac{k^2}{N^2}\right),\qquad k=o(N)。 $$在临界逆温度$\beta=1$处，在$k=o(\sqrt N)$范围内，速率变化为$\alpha_{\mathrm c}^2 k(k-1)/(4N)+o(k^2/N)$，其中$\alpha_{\mathrm c}$是重新调整磁化强度的极限四次定律的二阶矩。我们还获得了在这两种状态之间插值的序列 $\beta_N\uparrow1$ 的渐近。至关重要的是，证明表明配对相关性决定了似然比的主要修正，从而提供了对卡方散度和相对熵的精确控制。

items.title: Ergodicity without monotonicity: patch-positive spin systems
items.excerpt: Monotonicity is the standard tool for proving that an interacting particle system is ergodic. What can replace it when the system is not monotone and its invariant measure is unknown? The simplest such systems are kinetically constrained models such as FA-1f and East exposed to noise. In these models vacancies enable updates, so adding vacancies should help the system forget its initial state. We prove this for a broad class of spin systems, which we call patch-positive. If vacancies are created spontaneously at a uniformly positive rate, the system converges to the same equilibrium from a large class of initial states, and from every initial state if the threshold density is at most $\tfrac12$ or the interactions are oriented. In particular, the East model with noise is ergodic at every density, and we obtain new cases of the positive-rates conjecture. The key idea is to compare the dual processes of the system with and without the added deaths.
items.title_zh: 没有单调性的遍历性：补丁正自旋系统
items.excerpt_zh: 单调性是证明相互作用的粒子系统遍历的标准工具。当系统不是单调且其不变测度未知时，什么可以替代它？最简单的此类系统是动力学约束模型，例如暴露于噪声的 FA-1f 和 East。在这些模型中，空缺可以进行更新，因此添加空缺应该有助于系统忘记其初始状态。我们在一大类自旋系统中证明了这一点，我们称之为补丁正向的。如果空位以一致的正速率自发产生，则系统从一大类初始状态收敛到相同的平衡，并且如果阈值密度最多为 $\tfrac12$ 或相互作用是定向的，则从每个初始状态收敛到相同的平衡。特别是，带有噪声的 East 模型在每个密度下都是遍历的，并且我们获得了正率猜想的新案例。关键思想是比较系统的双进程有和没有增加死亡的情况。

items.title: High-order IMEX local discontinuous Galerkin methods with sparse grids for high-dimensional nonlinear parabolic PDEs
items.excerpt: In this work, we develop a high-order IMEX-LDG scheme on sparse grids for solving nonlinear parabolic PDEs in moderate to high dimensions. The method combines the advantages of LDG methods for convection--diffusion problems, IMEX-RK time integrators for stiff systems, and sparse-grid techniques to mitigate the curse of dimensionality. The resulting scheme is fully parallelized in MPI, is robust, efficient, and scalable, making it suitable for a wide range of applications involving high-dimensional nonlinear parabolic PDEs.
items.authors: Joel P. Villarino , Manuel J. Castro , J. A. García-Rodríguez , J. G. López-Salas
items.title_zh: 高维非线性抛物线偏微分方程的稀疏网格高阶 IMEX 局部不连续 Galerkin 方法
items.excerpt_zh: 在这项工作中，我们在稀疏网格上开发了一种高阶 IMEX-LDG 方案，用于求解中高维的非线性抛物线偏微分方程。该方法结合了用于对流扩散问题的 LDG 方法、用于刚性系统的 IMEX-RK 时间积分器以及用于减轻维数灾难的稀疏网格技术的优点。所得方案在 MPI 中完全并行化，具有鲁棒性、高效性和可扩展性，使其适用于涉及高维非线性抛物线偏微分方程的广泛应用。

items.title: A Realizability-Based Kinetic-Fluid Domain Decomposition Method for Single-Temperature Gas Mixtures
items.excerpt: This paper introduces a domain-adaptive numerical method for multi-species kinetic models that relax toward a single-temperature and single-velocity hydrodynamic limit. To this end, we derive moment realizability matrices for this regime. In this way the ideas of Levermore, Morokoff, and Nadiga are extended to non-equilibrium mixtures in which inter-species and intra-species collisions occur at comparable rates, so that all species relax to a common velocity and a common temperature. The realizability conditions are used as an indicator to divide the computational domain, at each time step, into macroscopic and kinetic regions. In the kinetic regions, where the continuum description fails (e.g., across strong shocks, non-equilibrium interfaces, or kinetic boundary layers), the method solves the multi-species kinetic equations. Close to local thermodynamic equilibrium, the Euler equations of the mixture are solved instead. Confining the kinetic computations to the non-equilibrium regions reduces the simulation time, while the results remain close to those of the full kinetic solver. The method is discretized on Cartesian grids with hig
items.authors: Domenico Caparello , Lorenzo Pareschi , Thomas Rey
items.title_zh: 基于可实现性的单温气体混合物动流体域分解方法
items.excerpt_zh: 本文介绍了一种适用于多物种动力学模型的域自适应数值方法，该方法可以放松到单温度和单速度流体动力学极限。为此，我们推导出该机制的矩可实现矩阵。通过这种方式，Levermore、Morokoff 和 Nadiga 的想法被扩展到非平衡混合物，其中物种间和物种内碰撞以相当的速率发生，以便所有物种松弛到共同的速度和共同的温度。可实现性条件用作将每个时间步的计算域划分为宏观区域和动力学区域的指标。在连续统描述失败的动力学区域（例如，跨越强冲击、非平衡界面或动力学边界层），该方法求解多物种动力学方程。在接近局部热力学平衡时，求解混合物的欧拉方程。将动力学计算限制在非平衡区域可以减少模拟时间，同时结果仍然接近完整动力学求解器的结果。该方法在笛卡尔网格上进行离散化

items.title: A narrow band method for non-causal discretizations of anisotropic eikonal equations, with adaptive width, sub-and super-solution construction, and quasi-linear complexity
items.excerpt: We describe a narrow band method for numerically solving anisotropic eikonal equations, and more generally static first order Hamilton-Jacobi equations with possibly non-convex Hamiltonians, discretized using standard schemes (semi-Lagrangian, upwind-differences, Lax-Friedrichs). The causality property is not needed, in contrast with the fast marching method. The proposed approach simultaneously builds a numerical sub-solution u and super-solution u to the problem, and adapts the width of the narrow band based on their comparison. We prove that (1 + $\epsilon$)u $\ge$ u at termination, where $\epsilon$ > 0 is any given tolerance parameter, and that the worst case complexity is O(N | ln $\epsilon$| ln(N/$\epsilon$)), where N denotes the number of discretization points, and the underlying constant is explicit in terms of those associated with the scheme properties. Numerical experiments illustrate our results.
items.authors: Jean-Marie Mirebeau (CNRS, CB), Yanis Mouheb (CB, CEA/DAM)
items.title_zh: 一种用于各向异性征函方程非因果离散化的窄带方法，具有自适应宽度、子解和超解构造以及拟线性复杂度
items.excerpt_zh: 我们描述了一种窄带方法，用于数值求解各向异性随函方程，以及更一般的静态一阶 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程，可能具有非凸哈密顿量，使用标准方案（半拉格朗日、迎风差分、Lax-Friedrichs）进行离散化。与快速推进方法相比，不需要因果关系属性。所提出的方法同时构建问题的数值子解 u 和超级解 u，并根据它们的比较来调整窄带的宽度。我们证明终止时 (1 + $\epsilon$)u $\ge$ u ，其中 $\epsilon$ > 0 是任何给定的容差参数，并且最坏情况复杂度为 O(N | ln $\epsilon$| ln(N/$\epsilon$))，其中 N 表示离散化点的数量，并且基础常数在与方案属性相关的方面是显式的。数值实验说明了我们的结果。

items.title: Compatible by Construction: Bottom-Up Nonlinear Model Reduction without Interface Bases
items.excerpt: Nonlinear manifolds can provide compact representations of solutions to partial differential equations (PDEs), but generating training data and learning these representations on large domains remain costly. We present a bottom-up framework that reuses local nonlinear representations learned on a small training domain to solve larger PDE systems. A shared nonlinear decoder represents the full set of degrees of freedom owned by each subdomain, without separate interior and interface models. Each global degree of freedom has a unique owner, and local residuals directly use decoded state values from the corresponding neighboring subdomains. The resulting discrete state is single-valued by construction, eliminating the need for independent interface copies and additional interface compatibility constraints. Physical coupling is retained through the original time-discrete PDE residual. With the decoder held fixed, the subdomain-specific reduced coordinates are determined jointly by minimizing this residual, and the Gauss--Newton system is assembled from local contributions. Experiments on parameterized viscous Burgers and incompressible Nav
items.title_zh: 结构兼容：自下而上的非线性模型简化，无需接口基础
items.excerpt_zh: 非线性流形可以提供偏微分方程 (PDE) 解的紧凑表示，但生成训练数据并在大域上学习这些表示仍然成本高昂。我们提出了一个自下而上的框架，该框架重用在小型训练域上学习的局部非线性表示来求解更大的偏微分方程系统。共享非线性解码器代表每个子域拥有的全套自由度，没有单独的内部和界面模型。每个全局自由度都有一个唯一的所有者，局部残差直接使用来自相应相邻子域的解码状态值。由此产生的离散状态在构造上是单值的，从而消除了对独立接口副本和额外接口兼容性约束的需要。通过原始时间离散 PDE 残差保留物理耦合。在解码器保持固定的情况下，通过最小化该残差来联合确定子域特定的简化坐标，并且高斯-牛顿系统由局部贡献组装而成。参数化粘性 Burgers 和不可压缩 Nav 的实验

items.title: Self-Interpretations and Kraj\'ı{č}ek-Theories
items.excerpt: We study self-interpretations of theories and their connection to Kraj\'{\i}\v{c}ek-theories. Our two main results are the following. Firstly, if the self-interpretations of a theory form a group in the category ${\sf INT}_3$ of theories and interpretations, then the theory is a Kraj\'{\i}\v{c}ek-theory. Secondly, a sequential theory is a Kraj\'{\i}\v{c}ek-theory iff all its self-interpretations are initial. Here initiality of the interpretation $K$ means roughly that its internal interpretations of the weak theory ${\sf S}^1_2$ are initial in all interpretations of ${\sf S}^1_2$.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究理论的自我解释及其与 Kraj\'{\i}\v{c}ek 理论的联系。我们的两个主要结果如下。首先，如果一个理论的自我解释形成理论和解释类别${\sf INT}_3$中的一个组，那么该理论是一个Kraj\'{\i}\v{c}ek理论。其次，序贯理论是一个 Kraj\'{\i}\v{c}ek 理论，当且仅当它所有的自我解释都是初始的。这里解释$K$的初始性大致意味着它对弱理论${\sf S}^1_2$的内部解释在${\sf S}^1_2$的所有解释中都是初始的。
items.title_zh: 自我解释和克拉吉克理论

items.title: Arithmetical and set-theoretic semantics of the logic of problems and propositions
items.excerpt: Kolmogorov interpreted intuitionistic logic as a calculus of problems and later remarked that a complete treatment should deal with problems and propositions together. Melikhov's logic HC is such a joint two-sorted system: it combines classical propositions with intuitionistic problems by means of two modalities, the problem !A (``find a proof of the proposition A'') and the proposition phi (``the problem phi has a solution''). We give the language of HC a formal semantics in which the modalities are read literally: solutions of !A are proofs of A in a fixed formal theory, ?phi states that phi has a solution, and the connectives on problems are interpreted as in Kleene realizability. Three variants are studied: the arithmetical semantics I (provability in PA), its external version E (truth in the standard model), and the set-theoretic semantics B over ZF, where problem variables are ``black boxes'' and a quantifier Pi over them is available. Validity is defined as the existence of a computable uniform solution. We determine which schemes are valid, build calculi HCI, HCE, HCB sound with respect to the three semantics, and derive Lob's
items.title_zh: 问题和命题逻辑的算术和集合论语义
items.excerpt_zh: 柯尔莫哥洛夫将直觉逻辑解释为问题的演算，后来指出，完整的治疗应该同时处理问题和命题。梅利霍夫的逻辑 HC 就是这样一个联合二分类系统：它通过两种模态将经典命题与直觉问题结合起来，即问题 !A（“找到命题 A 的证明”）和命题 phi（“问题 phi 有解”）。我们赋予 HC 语言一种形式语义，其中的模态按字面意思解读：!A 的解是 A 在固定形式理论中的证明，?phi 表明 phi 有一个解，问题上的连接词被解释为 Kleene 可实现性。研究了三种变体：算术语义 I（PA 中的可证明性）、其外部版本 E（标准模型中的真理）以及 ZF 上的集合论语义 B，其中问题变量是“黑匣子”，并且可以使用它们上的量词 Pi。有效性被定义为存在可计算的统一解。我们确定哪些方案是有效的，根据三种语义构建 HCI、HCE、HCB 声音演算，并导出 Lob

items.title: Higher derived limits, Kurepa families and Chang's Conjecture
items.excerpt: We investigate the interplay between homological algebra and combinatorial set theory, specifically focusing on the (non)vanishing of higher derived limits of certain inverse systems of abelian groups, denoted $\mathbf C_{[\kappa]^\lambda}$, indexed by the ordered sets $([\kappa]^{\lambda},\subseteq)$, where $\lambda < \kappa$ are infinite cardinals. Our first main result is a general structural theorem which provides a generalisation of Goblot's theorem to the setting of locally small directed sets. We then present the first systematic study of generalised cofinal Kurepa families. We establish their existence in the constructible universe $L$ and under specific cardinal arithmetic hypotheses. Then, we apply our structural result to show that $\mathrm{lim}^{n+2} \mathbf{C}_{[\kappa]^{\aleph_n}} = 0$ in environments where the appropriate cofinal Kurepa families exist. In contrast, we explore conditions that force these derived limits to be nonzero. items.authors: Dianthe Basak , Matteo Casarosa , Chris Lambie-Hanson , Pedro Marun , Boban Velickovic , Alessandro Vignati
items.title_zh: 更高的导出极限、Kurepa 族和张猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究同调代数和组合集合论之间的相互作用，特别关注某些阿贝尔群逆系统的更高导出极限的（不）消失，表示为 $\mathbf C_{[\kappa]^\lambda}$，由有序集 $([\kappa]^{\lambda},\subseteq)$ 索引，其中 $\lambda < \kappa$ 是无限基数。我们的第一个主要结果是一个一般结构定理，它将 Goblot 定理推广到局部小有向集的设置。然后，我们提出了对广义共尾库雷帕家族的第一个系统研究。我们在可构造宇宙 $L$ 和特定的基数算术假设下确定它们的存在。然后，我们应用我们的结构结果来表明，在存在适当的共尾 Kurepa 族的环境中，$\mathrm{lim}^{n+2} \mathbf{C}_{[\kappa]^{\aleph_n}} = 0$。相反，我们探索迫使这些导出的限制非零的条件。特别是，我们证明了 Chang 猜想 (CC) 的某些实例，以及合适的 $\diamondsuit$ 序列的存在，意味着 $\mathrm{lim}^{n+2} \mathbf{C}_{[\kapp

items.title: HOL in HOL: mechanized soundness, completeness and consistency, with and without infinity
items.excerpt: What can a logic certify about a copy of itself? For Church's simple theory of types, formalized as a deep embedding in Isabelle/HOL with Henkin semantics and a natural-deduction calculus, the answer has two tiers. On the first tier, plain Isabelle/HOL certifies the logic without an axiom of infinity, by a standard model with one individual. On the second tier, the logic with a Dedekind-style axiom of infinity is certified only in Isabelle/HOL extended by a large enough set-theoretic universe. Both tiers appear in Harrison's self-verification of HOL Light. What the present formalization adds is Henkin completeness, and with it a semantics that matches the calculus exactly, compactness and model existence on the first tier, and the boundary between the tiers. Comparing two ways of adding infinity to the object logic shows where the boundary lies. One is an infinite domain of individuals, expressed by the first-order sentences "there are at least $n$ individuals", each of which has a finite model; the other is the Dedekind axiom, a single sentence with no finite model, and there the first tier ends. In the calculus the axiom is strictly
items.authors: Christoph Benzmüller (Otto-Friedrich-Universität Bamberg and Freie Universität Berlin), Daniel Kirchner (Otto-Friedrich-Universität Bamberg)
items.title_zh: HOL in HOL：机械化的健全性、完整性和一致性，有或没有无穷大
items.excerpt_zh: 逻辑可以证明其自身的副本是什么？对于 Church 的简单类型理论，形式化为具有 Henkin 语义和自然演绎演算的 Isabelle/HOL 的深度嵌入，答案有两层。在第一层，简单的 Isabelle/HOL 通过一个个体的标准模型来证明没有无穷大公理的逻辑。在第二层，具有戴德金式无穷大公理的逻辑仅在由足够大的集合论宇宙扩展的 Isabelle/HOL 中得到证明。这两层都出现在哈里森对 HOL Light 的自我验证中。目前的形式化增加的是亨金完备性，以及与微积分精确匹配的语义、第一层的紧凑性和模型存在性以及各层之间的边界。比较向对象逻辑添加无穷大的两种方法可以显示边界所在。一个是个体的无限域，用一阶句子“至少有$n$个个体”来表示，每个个体都有一个有限模型；另一个是戴德金公理，没有有限模型的单个句子，第一层到此结束。在微积分中，公理严格是

items.title: A large ultrafilter number at $\aleph_ω$
items.excerpt: Gitik constructed a model where $\aleph_\omega$ is strong limit, $2^{\aleph_\omega}=\aleph_{\omega+2}$ and every strongly uniform ultrafilter on $\aleph_\omega$ has character $\aleph_{\omega+2}$. We show that in fact every uniform ultrafilter on $\aleph_\omega$ has character $\aleph_{\omega+2}$ in that model.
items.excerpt_zh: Gitik 构建了一个模型，其中 $\aleph_\omega$ 为强极限，$2^{\aleph_\omega}=\aleph_{\omega+2}$ 并且 $\aleph_\omega$ 上的每个强均匀超滤器都有字符 $\aleph_{\omega+2}$。我们证明，实际上 $\aleph_\omega$ 上的每个均匀超滤器在该模型中都具有字符 $\aleph_{\omega+2}$。
items.title_zh: $\aleph_ω$ 处有大量超滤器

items.title: Forcing global $Π^2_n$ uniformization with or without projective determinacy
items.excerpt: We construct a set-forcing extension of $L$ which has the same reals as $L$ and satisfies the $\Pi^2_n$-uniformization property for every $n\geq1$. Assuming $\omega$ Woodin cardinals and a measurable cardinal above them, we also obtain a forcing extension of $L(\mathbb R)^{M_\omega}$ which has the same reals and satisfies projective determinacy together with the $\Pi^2_n$-uniformization property for every $n\geq1$.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们构造 $L$ 的集合强制扩展，它与 $L$ 具有相同的实数，并且满足每个 $n\geq1$ 的 $\Pi^2_n$ 统一属性。假设 $\omega$ Woodin 基数和其上方的可测基数，我们还获得 $L(\mathbb R)^{M_\omega}$ 的强制扩展，它具有相同的实数，并满足每个 $n\geq1$ 的投影确定性以及 $\Pi^2_n$ 均匀化属性。

items.title: Lower bounds on ranks of universal quadratic forms through geometry-of-numbers
items.excerpt: We obtain lower bounds for the ranks of universal forms over totally real cubic fields using techniques from geometry-of-numbers and the parametrisation of cubic rings by binary cubics due to Delone--Faddeev. Additionally, our methods give lower bounds for totally real primitive fields of any degree with codifferent generated by a totally positive element.

items.excerpt: As LLM models generate proofs at an exponential rate, many question the value of a PhD. items.title: Why Correct Answers Are Not Enough
items.excerpt: “Imagine that an AI system proposes a plan for distributing public services among several districts. Under the model’s assumptions and requirements, no other permitted plan costs less overall. A formal proof of this result has been checked by software. But residents in some districts object: they would have to wait far too long for service under the plan. […]”
items.title_zh: 为什么正确答案还不够
items.excerpt_zh: “想象一下，人工智能系统提出了一个在多个地区之间分配公共服务的计划。根据该模型的假设和要求，没有其他允许的计划总体成本更低。这一结果的正式证明已经通过软件进行了检查。但一些地区的居民表示反对：他们将不得不等待太长时间才能获得该计划下的服务。[...]”

items.title: How do we know that they are not cheating?
items.excerpt: If the agents are grown to be ambitious and want to finish a task at all costs, how can we be sure that the lengthy and confusing proofs that they are producing and verifying are not suffering some kind of hacking, like in the HuggingFace incident?
items.title_zh: 我们怎么知道他们没有作弊？
items.excerpt_zh: 如果代理人变得雄心勃勃，想要不惜一切代价完成任务，我们如何确定他们正在制作和验证的冗长且令人困惑的证据不会遭受某种黑客攻击，就像 HuggingFace 事件一样？

items.title: Human skepticism and formal verification
items.excerpt: I believe mathematical claims that are verified in Lean, but this is also basically an appeal to authority. From the perspective of methodological skepticism, I do not know that the results claimed by OpenAI are true until I have studied them and personally convinced myself that they are true.
items.title_zh: 人类怀疑论和形式验证
items.excerpt_zh: 我相信在精益中得到验证的数学主张，但这基本上也是对权威的诉求。从方法论怀疑论的角度来看，我不知道 OpenAI 声称的结果是否真实，直到我研究了它们并亲自说服自己它们是真实的。

items.title: A vision of the future of mathematics
items.excerpt: Mathematics has been struck by an asteroid. I don't mean the nefarious action of a powerful corporation, but rather the empirical fact that AI systems are capable of superhuman mathematical ability. How this fact was revealed is not important; under different circumstances it may have been revealed sooner or later, or more gently, but ultimately the fact remains the same. We need to face it.
items.title_zh: 数学未来的愿景
items.excerpt_zh: 数学被小行星撞击了。我指的并不是一家强大公司的邪恶行为，而是人工智能系统具有超人数学能力的经验事实。这个事实如何被揭露并不重要；重要的是。在不同的情况下，它可能会迟早、或更温和地被揭露，但最终事实是一样的。我们需要面对它。

items.title: Positivist and Humanist Mathematics: A Case for Schism
items.excerpt: If we do not split the discipline in two, one half of the discipline will inevitably dominate the other, and we will all be worse off for it. After all of the great crises of mathematics in which it survived as a whole, we now find ourselves in an entirely unprecedented situation. We either schism or die.
items.title_zh: 实证主义和人文主义数学：分裂的一个案例
items.excerpt_zh: 如果我们不把学科一分为二，一半的学科将不可避免地支配另一半，我们都会因此而变得更糟。在经历了数学作为一个整体幸存下来的所有重大危机之后，我们现在发现自己处于一个完全前所未有的境地。我们要么分裂，要么死亡。

A new vision of mathematical research.

items.title: Euler's 1747 conjecture on sums of two integers with all prime factors congruent to 1 modulo 4
items.excerpt: Proved · Additive number theory · with OpenAI Codex (model version not stated) · significance 22/100. In modern terms: can every positive integer n\equiv 2\pmod 4 be written as n=a+b with a,b positive integers all of whose prime factors are congruent to 1 modulo 4 (the integer 1 is allowed)? items.title_zh: 欧拉 1747 年关于所有质因数均等于 1 模 4 的两个整数之和的猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 已证明 · 加法数论 · 使用 OpenAI Codex（模型版本未说明） · 重要性 22/100。在 1747 年 5 月 6 日写给哥德巴赫的信中，欧拉提出，每个 4m+2 形式的数都是两个 4x+1 形式的数之和，这两个数都没有 4p-1 形式的约数。用现代术语来说：每个正整数 n\equiv 2\pmod 4 可以写成 n=a+b ，其中 a,b 都是正整数，其所有质因数都与 1 模 4 全等（允许整数 1）？欧拉认为这是通向四平方定理的可能途径。 Dietmann 和 Elsholtz (2019) 证明了这一点足够大

items.title: Rohrbach's conjecture on thin h-bases of finite groups
items.excerpt: Proved · Finite group theory; thin bases and product decompositions · with ChatGPT (version not stated) · significance 28/100. Let G be a finite group and h\ge2. A subset A\subseteq G is an h-basis if A^h=G, that is, every element of G is a product of h elements of A. Counting gives |A|\ge|G|^{1/h} for every h-basis. Rohrbach asked in 1937 whether this is sharp up to a constant: for every fixed h, is there a constant c_h, independent of G, such that every finite group G has an h-basis A with |A|\le c_h|G|^{1/h}?

items.excerpt: Proved · Markov chain mixing, random graphs · with GPT-5.6 Sol; GPT-6.1 Sol · significance 24/100. Let G\sim G(n,d/n) be a sparse Erdős-Rényi random graph with fixed average degree d. items.title: The van der Put-Singer conjecture: the inverse problem in difference Galois theory over C(x)
items.excerpt: Proved · Difference Galois theory; inverse problem · with ChatGPT 6 with the MechMath Agent Team (MMAT) · significance 25/100. Let C be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero and K=C(x) with the shift \sigma(x)=x+1. Every linear difference system \sigma Y=AY with A\in\mathrm{GL}_n(K) has a Picard-Vessiot (difference Galois) group, a linear algebraic group over C. Van der Put and Singer proved that such a group G always has a cyclic component group G/G^\circ, and conjectured the converse: does every linear algebraic group G for which G/G^\circ is cyclic occur as a difference Galois group over C(x)?

items.title: Smale's mean value constant: is it exactly 4?
items.excerpt: Proved · Complex analysis · with Claude; ChatGPT (versions not stated) · significance 45/100. For a complex polynomial p of degree d\ge 2 with p(0)=0 and p'(0)\ne 0, let S(p)=\min_{p'(c)=0}|p(c)/(c\,p'(0))|, and let K(d) be the supremum of S(p) over all such p of degree d. Smale (1981) proved K(d)\le 4 for every d and asked whether 4 can be replaced by 1; that was disproved in 2026. What is the exact value of Smale's mean value constant K^*=\sup_{d\ge2}K(d)? Jatar and Ng (2026) list whether K^*=4 as open.

items.title: The k-Clique Hypothesis

items.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
items.excerpt: AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. PDD Kit helps ensure the code is doing what the developer intended by creating formal specifications and testing against them. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification, proves AI-generated code meets it for every input, and uses tests where proofs aren't practical. Developers review intent, not every line. The post Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit appeared first on Microsoft Research .

items.title: A generalization of the Dirichlet approximation theorem for affine actions on the real line
items.excerpt: We study quantitative density of orbits of the free semigroup $\Gamma$ generated by two maps of $(0,\infty)$. For the M\"obius pair $x\mapsto 1/x$, $x\mapsto x+1$ we show that every orbit is $O(n^{-1})$-dense in $[0,\infty)$, that every irrational number $u$ is approached at a rate governed by the continued fraction of $u$ (at least $n^{-2}$, exponential when $u$ has bounded partial quotients, and $\exp(-cn/\log n)$ for almost every $u$), and that for rational $u$ and rational starting points the rate $n^{-1}$ is optimal. For the affine pair $T_0(x)=x/a$, $T_1(x)=bx+1$ with $a,b>1$, which was studied by Bergelson, Misiurewicz and Senti, we prove that for every $x>0$ and $u\ge 0$ there are infinitely many $\gamma\in\Gamma$ with \[ |\gamma(x)-u|1, \] where $|\gamma|$ is the word length of $\gamma$ and $C$ is independent of $\gamma$. This exponential rate holds whether or not $\log_a b$ is rational, and the exponential order cannot be improved for almost every $u$. We also give a corrected version of the Kronecker-type estimate $|\gamma(x)-u|<(u+1)(t^{1/|\gamma|}-1)$. Finally, we discuss the approximation of real numbers by ratios of pri
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究由 $(0,\infty)$ 的两个映射生成的自由半群 $\Gamma$ 轨道的定量密度。对于 M\"obius 对 $x\mapsto 1/x$, $x\mapsto x+1$，我们证明每个轨道在 $[0,\infty)$ 中都是 $O(n^{-1})$ 密集，每个无理数 $u$ 都以由 $u$ 的连分数控制的速率逼近（至少 $n^{-2}$，当 $u$ 具有有界部分商时为指数，并且$\exp(-cn/\log n)$ 对于几乎每个 $u$)，对于有理 $u$ 和有理起点，速率 $n^{-1}$ 是最优的。对于仿射对 $T_0(x)=x/a$、$T_1(x)=bx+1$ 和 $a,b>1$，我们证明对于每个 $x>0$ 和 $u\ge。 0$ 有无数个 $\gamma\in\Gamma$ 与 \[ |\gamma(x)-u|1, \] ，其中 $|\gamma|$ 是 $\gamma$ 的字长，并且 $C$ 与 $\gamma$ 无关。无论 $\log_a b$ 是否有理，该指数率都成立，并且几乎每个 $u$ 的指数阶数都无法改进。 $|\gamma(x)-u|<(u+1)(t^{1/|\gamma|}-1)$ 最后，我们讨论 pri 比率对实数的近似。

items.title: Classification of torsion of elliptic curves over sextic fields
items.excerpt: We determine all the groups that appear as the torsion group of an elliptic curve over a number field of degree $6$. Apart from the $44$ groups that occur infinitely often, which were determined by Derickx and Sutherland, exactly four groups occur: $\mathbb{Z}/25\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathbb{Z}/37\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathbb{Z}/4\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}/12\mathbb{Z}$ and $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}/24\mathbb{Z}$. The first three were known to occur, while the group $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}/24\mathbb{Z}$ is new. We also show that, up to isomorphism, each of the groups $\mathbb{Z}/37\mathbb{Z}$ and $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}/24\mathbb{Z}$ is the torsion group of a single elliptic curve over a single sextic field. The methods build on those developed by Derickx and Najman for quartic fields and by the author for quintic fields. Among the new ingredients are a formal immersion criterion at the prime $2$ which uses the Cartier operator, and arguments with several diamond operators and with cuspidal divisor classes on quotients of modular curves.
items.title_zh: 六次域上椭圆曲线的挠率分类
items.excerpt_zh: 我们确定在 $6$ 度数域上显示为椭圆曲线扭转群的所有群。除了由 Derickx 和 Sutherland 确定的无限频繁出现的 $44$ 组之外，恰好出现了四个组： $\mathbb{Z}/25\mathbb{Z}$、$\mathbb{Z}/37\mathbb{Z}$、$\mathbb{Z}/4\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}/12\mathbb{Z}$ 和$\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}/24\mathbb{Z}$。前三个已知发生过，而 $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}/24\mathbb{Z}$ 组是新的。我们还证明，直到同构，每个群 $\mathbb{Z}/37\mathbb{Z}$ 和 $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}/24\mathbb{Z}$ 都是单个椭圆曲线在单个六角域上的挠群。这些方法建立在 Derickx 和 Najman 为四次域开发的方法以及作者为五次域开发的方法的基础上。新的成分包括在素数 $2$ 处使用 Cartier 运算符的正式浸入标准，以及与多个钻石运算符和模曲线商上的尖除数类的争论。

items.title: Some instances of modularity for residually reducible representations in the mixed case
items.excerpt: Let $F$ be a totally real field, abelian over $\Q$, in which an odd prime $p$ splits completely, and let $\rho:G_F\to\GL_2(\overline\Q_p)$ be an odd irreducible representation which is de Rham with distinct Hodge--Tate weights at the places above $p$ and whose residual representation is reducible. We consider the \emph{mixed} case of the Fontaine--Mazur conjecture, in which $\rho$ is reducible at some places above $p$ and irreducible at the others. This case is not covered by the work of Pan and Zhang. We prove some instances of modularity in this situation. Our main result is that $\rho$ is modular if it is non-split at every place above $p$ where it is reducible, by combining Zhang's pro-modularity theorem with a classicality criterion based on Emerton's ordinary parts. Together with a theorem of Zhao on local indecomposability, this gives the modularity of the $\lambda$-adic representations attached to abelian varieties of $\GL_2$-type in the mixed case, and, using a result of Snowden, of potentially modular representations of parallel weight two under a mild additional condition. It also gives the modularity of representations who
items.title_zh: 混合情况下剩余可约表示的模块化的一些实例
items.excerpt_zh: 令$F$是一个完全实数域，在$\Q$上进行交换，其中一个奇质数$p$完全分裂，并令$\rho:G_F\to\GL_2(\overline\Q_p)$是一个奇数不可约表示，它是de Rham，在$p$之上的位置具有不同的Hodge--Tate权重，并且其残差表示是可约的。我们考虑 Fontaine-Mazur 猜想的 \emph{mixed} 情况，其中 $\rho$ 在 $p$ 之上的某些地方可约，而在其他地方不可约。潘和张的工作并未涉及此案。我们在这种情况下证明了一些模块化的例子。我们的主要结果是，通过将张的亲模块化定理与基于艾默顿普通部分的经典性标准相结合，如果 $\rho$ 在 $p$ 之上的每个可约处都不可分割，则 $\rho$ 是模块化的。与局部不可分解性的赵定理一起，这给出了混合情况下附加到 $\GL_2$-类型的阿贝尔变体的 $\lambda$-adic 表示的模块化，并且使用斯诺登的结果，给出了在温和附加条件下平行权重二的潜在模块化表示。它还给出了表示的模块化

items.title: Ramanujan-type congruences for the smallest parts function
items.excerpt: In a famous paper of Andrews, he defined and studied the smallest parts function $\operatorname{spt}(n)$. He showed that it satisfies the three Ramanujan-type congruences: \[ \operatorname{spt}(5n+4)\equiv0\pmod5,\qquad \operatorname{spt}(7n+5)\equiv0\pmod7,\qquad \operatorname{spt}(13n+6)\equiv0\pmod{13}. \] In a recent preprint, the author showed that these are the only "canonical'' congruences. Here, we complete the classification of Ramanujan-type congruences for $\operatorname{spt}$, showing that if $\operatorname{spt}(\ell n+b)\equiv0\pmod\ell$ for all $n\geq0$, where $\ell\geq5$ is prime, then $(\ell,b)\in\{(5,4),(7,5),(13,6)\}.$ That is, Andrews' congruences are the only Ramanujan-type congruences for $\operatorname{spt}(n)$. These results have been verified in Lean by AxiomProver.
items.title_zh: 最小部分函数的拉马努金型同余
items.excerpt_zh: 在安德鲁斯的一篇著名论文中，他定义并研究了最小零件函数$\operatorname{spt}(n)$。他证明它满足三个拉马努金型同余：\[ \operatorname{spt}(5n+4)\equiv0\pmod5,\qquad \operatorname{spt}(7n+5)\equiv0\pmod7,\qquad \operatorname{spt}(13n+6)\equiv0\pmod{13}。 \] 在最近的预印本中，作者表明这些是唯一的“规范”同余。在这里，我们完成了 $\operatorname{spt}$ 的拉马努金型同余分类，表明如果 $\operatorname{spt}(\ell n+b)\equiv0\pmod\ell$ 对于所有 $n\geq0$，其中 $\ell\geq5$ 是素数，那么$(\ell,b)\in\{(5,4),(7,5),(13,6)\}.$ 也就是说，Andrews 同余是 $\operatorname{spt}(n)$ 的唯一拉马努金型同余。这些结果已在 Lean 中由 AxiomProver 验证。

items.title: Rational points on loxodromic K3 surfaces and complex dynamics
items.excerpt: We establish an analogue of the Hilbert irreducibility theorem for all K3 surfaces over number fields that admit an automorphism of positive entropy. Our method draws ingredients from both algebraic geometry and complex dynamics.
items.authors: Dami\'an Gvirtz-Chen, Zhizhong Huang, Zhuchao Ji, Junyi Xie
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为所有承认正熵自同构的数域上的 K3 曲面建立了希尔伯特不可约定理的类似物。我们的方法从代数几何和复杂动力学中汲取成分。

items.title: On integers $n$ relatively prime to $\lfloor \alpha n^2\rfloor$
items.excerpt: For $\alpha\in\mathbb{R}$ and $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $S_{\alpha,k}(x):=\#\{n\in\mathbb N:n\le x,\ \gcd(n,\lfloor\alpha n^k\rfloor)=1\}$. Roth conjectured, and Watson proved, that $S_{\alpha,1}(x)\sim 6x/\pi^2$ for every irrational $\alpha$. Whether the same asymptotic holds for every fixed $k\ge2$ is a special case of a question of Bergelson and Richter, and was asked explicitly by Champagne. We answer this for $k=2$, with no Diophantine condition on $\alpha$: for every irrational $\alpha$, $S_{\alpha,2}(x)\sim x/\zeta(2)$ as $x\to\infty$. More precisely, for every fixed $A>0$ we obtain an error term $O_A(x/(\log q(x))^A)$, where $q(x)$ is the largest continued-fraction convergent denominator of $\alpha$ not exceeding $x$. The proof sieves $S_{\alpha,2}(x)$ over divisors, splitting at the parameter $R=q(x)^{1/8}$. items.title_zh: 关于整数 $n$ 与 $\lfloor \alpha n^2\rfloor$ 互质
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 $\alpha\in\mathbb{R}$ 和 $k\in\mathbb{N}$，设 $S_{\alpha,k}(x):=\#\{n\in\mathbb N:n\le x,\ \gcd(n,\lfloor\alpha n^k\rfloor)=1\}$。罗斯推测，沃森证明，对于每个无理 $\alpha$，$S_{\alpha,1}(x)\sim 6x/\pi^2$。对于每个固定的 $k\ge2$ 是否同样的渐近成立是 Bergelson 和 Richter 问题的特例，Champagne 明确地提出了这一问题。我们的答案是 $k=2$，$\alpha$ 上没有丢番图条件：对于每个无理 $\alpha$，$S_{\alpha,2}(x)\sim x/\zeta(2)$ 为 $x\to\infty$。更准确地说，对于每个固定的$A>0$，我们获得一个误差项$O_A(x/(\log q(x))^A)$，其中$q(x)$是$\alpha$不超过$x$的最大连分数收敛分母。证明通过除数筛选 $S_{\alpha,2}(x)$，在参数 $R=q(x)^{1/8}$ 处分裂。大于 $R$ 的除数通过将条件 $d\mid\gcd(n,\lfloor\alpha n^2\rfloor)$ 简化为 M\"obius 算术级数求和，并应用 Zhan 统一估计来计算在短时间间隔内由 $\mu(n)$ 扭曲的指数和；至多 $R$ 的除数通过 Erd\H{o}s-Tur\'an 不等式处理

items.title: The smallest-parts function and elliptic curves
items.excerpt: Recently, Ono established a new connection between partition congruences and the arithmetic of elliptic curves by expressing the partition function $p(n)$ as a CM trace on the modular curve $X_0(6)$. This approach yields new proofs of Ramanujan-type congruences for the partition function modulo powers of $5$, $7$, and $11$, revealing how the geometry of supersingular elliptic curves and the arithmetic of oriented optimal embeddings govern these congruence properties. Motivated by Ono's work, we develop an analogous passage from CM traces to congruences modulo $5$, $7$, and $13$ for the for Andrews's smallest-parts partition function $spt(n)$, employing the established theta-lift and modular-trace methods suited to this setting. With $P$ the Bruinier--Ono weight-zero weak Maass function and $f$ an explicit weakly holomorphic modular function on $\Gamma_0(6)$, the Ahlgren--Andersen formula expresses $spt(n)$ as one twelfth of the discriminant $1-24n$ CM trace of $f-P$. We explain the theta-lift normalization, the contribution of the two orientations, and the harmonic-Maass-form uniqueness argument. Following Garvan's work, we construct

items.title: Finding Integer Roots of Polynomials in Nearly Optimal Time
items.excerpt: Let $f\in\mathbb Z[x]$ be a polynomial of degree $n$ with integer coefficients of absolute value less than $2^b$. Using Pan's approximate factorization theorem, we give a deterministic algorithm that finds all distinct integer roots of $f$ in $\widetilde O(nb)$ bit operations. This matches the bit size of the input up to logarithmic factors and does not require $f$ to be square-free. Since we were unable to verify parts of the running time analysis of Pan's theorem, we also give a self-contained deterministic algorithm with running time $\widetilde O(nb+\min(n,b)^3b^2)$, which is $\widetilde O(nb)$ whenever $b\leq n^{1/4}$. This answers a question of Harvey and Hittmeir (2022), who asked whether integer roots can be found deterministically in quasilinear time, conditionally on Pan's theorem, and unconditionally for $b\leq n^{1/4}$. The fastest previous deterministic algorithm, due to Nir, takes $\widetilde O(n^{3/2}b)$ bit operations and works only for square-free polynomials. Instead of $p$-adic lifting, we combine approximate complex root finding with exact polynomial evaluation. We first approximate the complex roots of the polynom
items.title_zh: 在近乎最佳的时间内求多项式的整数根
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $f\in\mathbb Z[x]$ 为 $n$ 次多项式，其整数系数的绝对值小于 $2^b$。使用 Pan 近似因式分解定理，我们给出了一个确定性算法，该算法可以在 $\widetilde O(nb)$ 位运算中找到 $f$ 的所有不同整数根。这将输入的位大小与对数因子相匹配，并且不需要 $f$ 是无平方的。由于我们无法验证潘氏定理的部分运行时间分析，我们还给出了一个独立的确定性算法，运行时间为$\widetilde O(nb+\min(n,b)^3b^2)$，每当$b\leq n^{1/4}$时，$\widetilde O(nb)$。这回答了 Harvey 和 Hittmeir (2022) 的问题，他们询问是否可以在拟线性时间、有条件地根据潘氏定理、无条件地找到 $b\leq n^{1/4}$ 的整数根。由于 Nir，先前最快的确定性算法需要 $\widetilde O(n^{3/2}b)$ 位运算，并且仅适用于无平方多项式。我们不是将$p$-adic 提升结合起来，而是将近似复数求根与精确的多项式求值结合起来。我们首先近似多项式的复数根

items.title: On Gallai $d$-colored circulants
items.excerpt: A $d$-graph is a complete graph whose edges are colored with colors from $[d]$. It is Gallai if it contains no triangle whose three edges have distinct colors. We prove that every Gallai $d$-circulant is an iterated lexicographic product of circulants using at most two colors. The proof uses the compatibility of the known canonical modular decomposition with the cyclic action. For $d$-graphs avoiding both a rainbow triangle $\Delta$ and the two-colored four-vertex graph $\Pi$ whose chromatic components are paths, we give a more explicit classification. Color-preserving vertex transitivity is equivalent to circular symmetry and to a reduced positional game tree whose branching numbers and labels depend only on depth. The edge colors in the given cyclic labeling are determined by a chain of divisors of the order. This description yields a complete isomorphism invariant and a linear-time recognition procedure in the difference-word representation. The characterization of CIS $d$-circulants reduces to CIS two-colored factors. Finally, we extend the numerical CIS criterion to $d$-graphs whose chromatic components are vertex-transitive.
items.title_zh: 加莱 $d$ 彩色循环
items.excerpt_zh: $d$-图是一个完整的图，其边缘使用 $[d]$ 中的颜色进行着色。如果它不包含三个边具有不同颜色的三角形，则它是加莱。我们证明每个 Gallai $d$-循环都是使用至多两种颜色的循环的迭代词典积。该证明使用已知的规范模分解与循环动作的兼容性。对于避免彩虹三角形 $\Delta$ 和彩色分量为路径的双色四顶点图 $\Pi$ 的 $d$ 图，我们给出了更明确的分类。保留颜色的顶点传递性相当于圆形对称性和简化的位置博弈树，其分支数量和标签仅取决于深度。给定循环标记中的边缘颜色由阶数的除数链确定。该描述在差异词表示中产生完整的同构不变量和线性时间识别过程。 CIS $d$-循环的表征简化为 CIS 双色因子。最后，我们将数值 CIS 准则扩展到颜色分量是顶点传递的 $d$ 图。

items.title: Circular flows and bisections of random regular graphs
items.excerpt: Jaeger conjectured that, for every positive integer $p$, every $4p$-edge-connected graph admits an orientation with congruent indegree and outdegree modulo $2p+1$. We prove a stronger probabilistic counterpart: a uniformly random simple $(4p+1)$-regular graph has a strongly connected orientation with all outdegrees in $\{p,3p+1\}$ with probability tending to one as its even order grows. More generally, for every fixed odd $d\ge9$, there is $\varepsilon_d>0$ such that its circular flow number is less than $2+4/(d-1)-\varepsilon_d$ with probability tending to one. We give explicit margins at the small degrees and prove the bound $91/33$ at degree seven, answering a fixed-upper-bound question of Li and Li. Gaps below $3$ at degree five and below $8/3$ at degree seven remain open. A uniform estimate for dense bisections also gives short intervals above the Li--Li maximum-bisection lower bound. Finally, we prove the one-unit bisection-gap conjecture of Greenhill, Isaev and Lewis: at every fixed degree $d\ge3$, the typical minimum parameter for orientations with outdegrees in $\{p,d-p\}$ exceeds the threshold forced by the maximum bisection
items.excerpt_zh: Jaeger 推测，对于每个正整数 $p$，每个 $4p$ 边连接图都承认具有全等入度和出度模 $2p+1$ 的方向。我们证明了一个更强的概率对应物：一个均匀随机的简单 $(4p+1)$-正则图与 $\{p,3p+1\}$ 中的所有出度具有强连通方向，随着偶数阶的增长，概率趋向于 1。更一般地，对于每个固定奇数$d\ge9$，存在$\varepsilon_d>0$，使得其循环流数小于$2+4/(d-1)-\varepsilon_d$，概率趋于1。我们在小度数处给出显式裕度，并证明七度数的界限为 $91/33$，回答了 Li 和 Li 的固定上限问题。五级时的缺口低于 3 美元，七级时的缺口仍低于 8/3 美元。密集二分的统一估计也给出了高于 Li--Li 最大二分下界的短间隔。最后，我们证明了 Greenhill、Isaev 和 Lewis 的单位二等分间隙猜想：在每个固定度数 $d\ge3$ 上，出度为 $\{p,d-p\}$ 的方向的典型最小参数超过了最大二等分所强制的阈值
items.title_zh: 随机正则图的循环流和二等分

items.title: The Iterated Local Transitivity Model for oriented graphs
items.excerpt: Transitivity in social and other complex networks describes the tendency for two nodes with a common neighbor to become adjacent. We propose a new model for complex networks based on transitivity, called the Iterated Local Transitivity Model for Oriented Graphs (ILTO). The model generalizes the Iterated Local Model for Tournaments (ILMT). As in ILMT, oriented graphs are generated iteratively by cloning nodes and their adjacencies, with arcs between clones oriented either as the corresponding arcs between their parents or in the reverse direction. This process produces dense oriented graphs and, under suitable conditions, graphs with high connectivity and small diameter. We analyze the universality properties of ILTO, showing that, for generating sequences with infinite support, the base oriented graph determines which oriented graphs appear as induced subgraphs, unlike in ILMT. We study motifs in ILTO and show that when the base graph is a tournament and the generating sequence has infinite support, the model generates quasirandom tournament sequences. Finally, we study domination numbers, the cop number, and the dichromatic number. W
items.authors: Anthony Bonato, MacKenzie Carr, Ketan Chaudhary, Trent G. Marbach, Teddy Mishura
items.title_zh: 有向图的迭代局部传递模型
items.excerpt_zh: 社交网络和其他复杂网络中的传递性描述了具有共同邻居的两个节点变得相邻的趋势。我们提出了一种基于传递性的复杂网络的新模型，称为有向图迭代局部传递性模型（ILTO）。该模型概括了锦标赛迭代局部模型 (ILMT)。与 ILMT 一样，定向图是通过克隆节点及其邻接迭代生成的，克隆之间的弧要么与其父节点之间的相应弧相同，要么相反。该过程产生密集的定向图，并且在适当的条件下，产生具有高连通性和小直径的图。我们分析了 ILTO 的普适性，结果表明，为了生成具有无限支持的序列，基本定向图决定了哪些定向图显示为诱导子图，这与 ILMT 不同。我们研究了 ILTO 中的主题，并表明当基本图是锦标赛并且生成序列具有无限支持时，该模型会生成准随机锦标赛序列。最后，我们研究支配数、警察数和二色数。瓦

items.title: On the lower- and upper bounds of three-colored anti-Ramsey numbers
items.excerpt: In this paper we study a relatively new Ramsey type graph parameter introduced by my Bachelor's thesis supervisor N\'ora Alm\'asi, and her Master's thesis supervisor Maria Axenovich. The parameter $\xi(G)$ denotes the largest natural number $n$, such that there is a red-blue-green edge coloring of $K_n$, such that in the edge coloring all copies of $G$ represent all three colors. After a brief recap on Ramsey numbers, we precisely define $\xi(G)$, and take a look at its relations to the Ramsey numbers. In the third chapter we establish lower bounds on $\xi(G)$, in the cases $G=K_5$ and $G=K_6$, namely $\xi(K_5)\ge 19$ and $\xi(K_6)\ge 31$.
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了我的学士论文导师 N\'ora Alm\'asi 和她的硕士论文导师 Maria Axenovich 介绍的一个相对较新的 Ramsey 类型图参数。参数$\xi(G)$表示最大自然数$n$，这样就有$K_n$的红蓝绿边缘着色，这样在边缘着色中$G$的所有副本都代表所有三种颜色。在简要回顾拉姆齐数之后，我们精确定义$\xi(G)$，并看看它与拉姆齐数的关系。在第三章中，我们在$G=K_5$和$G=K_6$的情况下建立$\xi(G)$的下界，即$\xi(K_5)\ge 19$和$\xi(K_6)\ge 31$。
items.title_zh: 关于三色反拉姆齐数的下界和上限

items.title: Lemmas and Conjectures in Spectral Graph Theory
items.excerpt: The corpus of Elie Duhamel and Tristan Cazenave~\cite{dc} contains $305{,}755$ automatically generated conjectures relating spectral and metric invariants of connected graphs. A pipeline generated with Claude Code (numerical refutation, proof by the SMT solver \textsf{z3} from a library of lemmas, discovery of new lemmas, formalisation in \lean~4/Mathlib) refuted $162{,}964$ conjectures and proved $117{,}390$ without any unproved hypothesis, of which $79{,}505$ are verified end to end in \lean{} for every connected graph. This document collects, with proofs written for mathematicians, the most interesting lemmas that were discovered and proved, the ten most useful lemmas, the ten hardest theorems, simpler proofs of known results (Bollob\'as--Erd\H{o}s, Yang--Lu), and the unrefuted conjectures that we find most interesting. All the proofs are gathered in an archive
items.title_zh: 谱图论中的引理和猜想
items.excerpt_zh: Elie Duhamel 和 Tristan Cazenave~\cite{dc} 的语料库包含 $305{,}755$ 自动生成的与连通图的谱和度量不变量相关的猜想。使用 Claude Code 生成的管道（数值反驳、来自引理库的 SMT 解算器 \textsf{z3} 的证明、新引理的发现、\lean~4/Mathlib 中的形式化）反驳了 $162{,}964$ 猜想，并在没有任何未经证实的假设的情况下证明了 $117{,}390$，其中 $79{,}505$ 被端到端验证每个连通图的\lean{}。本文档收集了为数学家编写的证明，发现和证明的最有趣的引理、十个最有用的引理、十个最难的定理、已知结果的简单证明（Bollob\'as--Erd\H{o}s、Yang--Lu）以及我们认为最有趣的未经驳斥的猜想。所有证据都收集在档案中

items.title: Well-Covered Powers: Cartesian Products and Cayley Graphs
items.excerpt: We study graphs whose powers are well-covered, with an emphasis on Cartesian products and Cayley graphs. We first establish necessary conditions and sufficient criteria for Cartesian products, provide examples showing that a factor need not be well-covered and that two noncomplete factors can have the well-covered powers property, and classify several structured product families. In particular, we construct graphs satisfying the well-covered powers property for arbitrarily large diameters. We then show that the Cartesian square of a connected abelian Cayley graph is well-covered exactly when the graph is complete. We classify the well-covered-power graphs among connected circulant graphs of degree at most four. For Cartesian products of any number of complete graphs, we also prove that the recursive alphabet-size inequalities in the final conjecture are sufficient for all powers to be well-covered, prove partial converses for arbitrarily many factors, and give explicit obstructions for every binary prefix followed by one complete factor.
items.authors: Haobo Ma, Thanh Vu, Wenlin Zhang
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究幂函数被广泛涵盖的图，重点是笛卡尔积和凯莱图。我们首先建立笛卡尔积的必要条件和充分准则，举例说明一个因子不需要被很好覆盖，两个非完全因子可以具有很好覆盖的幂性质，并对几个结构化产品族进行分类。特别是，我们构建了满足任意大直径的良好覆盖幂属性的图。然后我们证明，当图完整时，连通的交换凯莱图的笛卡尔平方被完全覆盖。我们将覆盖良好的幂图分类为最多四次的连通循环图。对于任意数量的完全图的笛卡尔积，我们还证明最终猜想中的递归字母大小不等式足以很好地覆盖所有幂，证明任意多个因子的部分逆，并为每个二元前缀后跟一个完整因子给出显式障碍。
items.title_zh: 涵盖广泛的幂：笛卡尔积和凯莱图

items.title: Automatic partition identities
items.excerpt: We encode certain sets of partitions by regular languages of boundary words, so that their generating functions become rational series in the quantum plane $RU=qUR$. An equality between two partition counts is certified by writing the difference of their series as $(1-U)a+b(1-R)$, with $a,b$ converging $q$-adically. We show that $a,b$ may be chosen as solutions of finite holonomic systems of $q$-difference equations computed from the automata, and describe finite certificates of their convergence, together with bounded searches for such certificates; the searches need not succeed, but a false identity is always detected. As an application, we prove the three-row, level-two case of Primc's conjecture, which equates counts of coloured partitions subject to local multiplicity conditions with counts of coloured partitions whose parts lie in prescribed residue classes modulo eight.
items.title_zh: 自动分区身份
items.excerpt_zh: 我们用边界词的常规语言对某些分区集进行编码，使得它们的生成函数成为量子平面$RU=qUR$中的有理级数。两个分区计数之间的相等性通过将它们的级数之差写为 $(1-U)a+b(1-R)$ 来证明，其中 $a,b$ 收敛于 $q$-adically。我们证明 $a,b$ 可以被选择作为由自动机计算的 $q$ 差分方程的有限完整系统的解，并描述它们收敛的有限证书，以及对此类证书的有界搜索；搜索不一定会成功，但总会检测到虚假身份。作为一个应用，我们证明了 Primc 猜想的三行二级情况，该猜想将受局部重数条件影响的彩色分区的计数等同于其部分位于模 8 的规定残差类中的彩色分区的计数。

items.title: Short permutation pattern waves: The complete length-five classification
items.excerpt: For a permutation pi in Sk, a pi-wave is an increasing sequence of integers whose consecutive gaps have relative order pi. Let g(pi, n) be the maximum cardinality of a pi-wave-free subset of [n], and let P(pi, r) be the least integer N such that every r-coloring of [N] contains a monochromatic pi-wave. We determine the asymptotic orders of both functions for every permutation of length at most five. Existing upper bounds and weak-wave constructions provide sharp bounds for all but eight length-five patterns in S_5. For these eight exceptional alternating patterns, we establish g(pi, n) = Theta((log n)squared) and P(pi, r) = Theta(r(log r)squared).
items.authors: Lihong Qiu, Minglei Mao, Yaping Mao
items.title_zh: 短排列模式波：完整的长度五分类
items.excerpt_zh: 对于 Sk 中的排列 pi，pi 波是一个递增的整数序列，其连续间隙具有相对阶数 pi。令 g(pi, n) 为 [n] 的无 pi 波子集的最大基数，并令 P(pi, r) 为最小整数 N，使得 [N] 的每个 r 着色都包含单色 pi 波。我们确定两个函数对于每个长度最多为五的排列的渐近阶。现有的上限和弱波结构为 S_5 中除八个长度为 5 的模式之外的所有模式提供了锐界。对于这八种特殊的交替模式，我们建立 g(pi, n) = Theta((log n)squared) 和 P(pi, r) = Theta(r(log r)squared)。

items.title: Seshadri constants of singular loci of line arrangements with at most twelve lines
items.excerpt: Let ${\mathcal L}$ be an arrangement of $d$ lines in the complex projective plane and let $Z={\operatorname{Sing}}({\mathcal L})$. A question of Pokora asks whether the multipoint Seshadri constant of ${\mathcal O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(1)$ at $Z$ is always computed by a line of the arrangement containing the largest number of points of $Z$. We prove that the answer is affirmative for every arrangement of at most twelve lines. The proof uses a B\'ezout-type covering criterion, elementary restrictions on the intersection lattice, and a detailed analysis of the two extremal combinatorial types that can occur for twelve lines. One type is the Hesse arrangement; it is handled using a net of quartics through its twelve double points. The other type would yield a uniquely determined incidence structure on thirteen lines. We show that this incidence structure is not realizable over any field.
items.authors: Marcin Dumnicki, {\L}ucja Farnik, Krishna Hanumanthu, Brian Harbourne, Piotr Pokora, Joaquim Ro\'e, Halszka Tutaj-Gasi\'nska
items.excerpt_zh: 令${\mathcal L}$ 为复射影平面中$d$ 线的排列，并令$Z={\operatorname{Sing}}({\mathcal L})$。 Pokora 的一个问题询问 ${\mathcal O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(1)$ 在 $Z$ 处的多点 Seshadri 常数是否总是由包含 $Z$ 最多点数的排列线来计算。我们证明，对于最多十二行的每种排列，答案都是肯定的。该证明使用了 B\'ezout 型覆盖准则、相交格的基本限制，以及对 12 条线可能出现的两种极值组合类型的详细分析。一种是黑塞排列；它是通过其十二个双点使用四次网来处理的。另一种类型将在十三行上产生唯一确定的关联结构。我们证明这种关联结构在任何领域都是不可实现的。
items.title_zh: 最多十二行的行排列的奇异位点的 Seshadri 常数

items.title: Min-plus Bruhat decomposition
items.excerpt: We study min-plus Bruhat cells $B_{trop}^{(n)} \odot p\odot B_{trop}^{(n)}$, where $B_{trop}^{(n)}$ denotes the set of all upper-triangular matrices over $\RR \cup \{\infty\}$, and $p$ is a permutation. It is proved that $\dim (B_{trop}^{(n)} \odot p \odot B_{trop}^{(n)})= \frac{n(n+1)}{2} + l(p)$, where $l(p)$ is the length of $p$ in Coxeter generators. Also we provide an explicit description of the cell $B_{trop}^{(n)}(\RR) \odot p_0\odot B_{trop}^{(n)}(\RR)$ (up to a subset of dimension less than $n^2$) for the highest in Bruhat order permutation $p_0$. Finally, it is shown that for a tropically non-singular matrix $A$ for at most one permutation $p_A$ it can hold $A\in B_{trop}^{(n)}\odot p_A\odot B_{trop}^{(n)}$.
items.title_zh: 最小加布鲁哈特分解
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究 min-plus Bruhat 单元 $B_{trop}^{(n)} \odot p\odot B_{trop}^{(n)}$，其中 $B_{trop}^{(n)}$ 表示 $\RR \cup \{\infty\}$ 上所有上三角矩阵的集合，$p$ 是一个排列。证明$\dim (B_{trop}^{(n)} \odot p \odot B_{trop}^{(n)})= \frac{n(n+1)}{2} + l(p)$，其中$l(p​​)$是Coxeter生成器中$p$的长度。此外，我们还为 Bruhat 阶排列 $p_0$ 中最高的单元格 $B_{trop}^{(n)}(\RR) \odot p_0\odot B_{trop}^{(n)}(\RR)$ （最多小于 $n^2$ 的维度子集）提供了明确的描述。最后，证明对于热带非奇异矩阵 $A$，最多有一个排列 $p_A$，它可以容纳 $A\in B_{trop}^{(n)}\odot p_A\odot B_{trop}^{(n)}$。

items.title: D-equivalence conjecture for hyperk\"ahler varieties of generalized Kummer type
items.excerpt: We show that birationally equivalent hyperk\"ahler varieties of generalized Kummer type are derived equivalent, confirming the D-equivalence conjecture in this case. Combined with recent results of other authors, this settles the conjecture for all known deformation types of hyperk\"ahler varieties. The kernel is built from an equivariant Fourier-Mukai kernel on the sum-zero loci of powers of an abelian surface. We deform it along diagonal twistor paths, using the hyperholomorphic endomorphism algebra. Comparing wall hyperplanes gives a common twisted derived category for two adjacent birational models, and a finite sequence of wall crossings then gives the equivalence.
items.authors: Will Donovan, Chengxi Wang, Nantao Zhang
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了广义 Kummer 型的双有理等价 hyperk\"ahler 簇是导出等价的，证实了本例中的 D 等价猜想。结合其他作者最近的结果，这解决了所有已知的 hyperk\"ahler 簇变形类型的猜想。该核是根据阿贝尔曲面幂的零和轨迹上的等变 Fourier-Mukai 核构建的。我们使用超全纯自同态代数沿对角扭量路径对其进行变形。比较壁超平面给出了两个相邻双有理模型的共同扭曲派生类别，然后壁交叉的有限序列给出了等价性。
items.title_zh: 广义Kummer型hyperk\"ahler簇的D-等价猜想

items.title: Global vector fields and the automorphism group of regular semisimple Hessenberg varieties
items.excerpt: For a connected regular semisimple Hessenberg variety other than the full flag variety, we prove that the identity component of its automorphism group is an algebraic torus. The argument uses equivariant local coordinates and weight-homogeneous coefficient functions of vector fields.
items.authors: Mikiya Masuda, Takashi Sato, Haozhi Zeng
items.title_zh: 正则半单Hessenberg簇的全局向量场和自同构群
items.excerpt_zh: 对于全旗簇以外的连通正则半单 Hessenberg 簇，我们证明其自同构群的恒等分量是代数环面。该论证使用向量场的等变局部坐标和权重齐次系数函数。

items.title: Admissible extremal rays and the anticanonical minimal model program
items.excerpt: We develop an anticanonical minimal model program for projective $\mathbb{Q}$-factorial klt pairs $(X,\Delta)$ such that $-(K_{X}+\Delta)$ is pseudoeffective. We first prove the cone and contraction theorems for potentially klt triples and establish the existence of flips for such triples. Using these results, we introduce the notion of admissible extremal rays and show that $(K_{X}+\Delta)$-positive admissible extremal rays are precisely the rays that are to be contracted by $-(K_{X}+\Delta)$-MMP. The elementary MMP steps associated to such admissible rays preserve klt singularities. For potentially klt pairs $(X,\Delta)$ with $\mathbb{Q}$-divisors $\Delta$, we prove that every $(K_{X}+\Delta)$-positive extremal ray is admissible and obtain a cone theorem for the $(K_{X}+\Delta)$-positive part of the Mori cone. Assuming termination of the anticanonical minimal model program, we establish a dichotomy: potentially klt pairs admit anticanonical minimal models, whereas non-potentially klt pairs admit non-admissible models.
items.authors: Sung Rak Choi, Sungwook Jang, Dae-Won Lee
items.title_zh: 容许极值射线和反规范最小模型程序
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为投影 $\mathbb{Q}$-阶乘 klt 对 $(X,\Delta)$ 开发了一个反规范最小模型程序，使得 $-(K_{X}+\Delta)$ 是伪有效的。我们首先证明潜在 klt 三元组的圆锥定理和收缩定理，并建立此类三元组翻转的存在性。利用这些结果，我们引入了容许极值射线的概念，并表明 $(K_{X}+\Delta)$-正容许极值射线正是 $-(K_{X}+\Delta)$-MMP 收缩的射线。与此类允许光线相关的基本 MMP 步骤保留了 klt 奇点。对于潜在的 klt 对 $(X,\Delta)$ 与 $\mathbb{Q}$-约数 $\Delta$，我们证明每个 $(K_{X}+\Delta)$-正极值射线是可接受的，并获得 Mori 锥的 $(K_{X}+\Delta)$-正部分的锥定理。假设反规范最小模型程序终止，我们建立二分法：潜在的 klt 对承认反规范最小模型，而非潜在的 klt 对承认不可接受的模型。

items.title: A Bubble Compactification of KSBA Moduli Space of Surfaces of General Type
items.excerpt: We construct a bubble-tree enhancement of the KSBA moduli space of surfaces of general type using index-one-cover Deligne--Mumford stacks. The construction is inspired by bubbling phenomena for K\"ahler--Einstein metrics. Non-klt semi-log-canonical singularities are replaced by admissible simple-normal-crossing configurations: the cusp and degenerate-cusp components are rational, while the simple-elliptic case also contains elliptic ruled components. A key feature is that the construction avoids lci covers. We construct the moduli stack of polarized bubble-tree index-one-cover Deligne-Mumford stacks. The stack is in general not separated, and we construct its underlying separated algebraic space. We also construct the moduli stack of bubble-tree index-one-cover Deligne-Mumford stacks with labeled sections that record algebraic bubbling centers and compare it with the pointed metric bubble tree. The labeled sections determine a numerical class whose stability proves the separatedness of the moduli stack. We establish a perfect obstruction theory and a virtual fundamental class on the bubble-tree moduli stacks. This provides a novel and
