items.title: Conjecture B for $X_{10}$ and its genus-two mirror
items.excerpt: We prove Conjecture B of Akhtar--Coates--Corti--Heuberger--Kasprzyk--Oneto--Petracci--Prince--Tveiten unconditionally for the normalized family of maximally mutable Laurent polynomials with prescribed $T$-binomial edge coefficients associated with the degree-10 orbifold del Pezzo hypersurface $X_{10}\subset\mathbb{P}(1,2,3,5)$. An explicit $S$-extended quantum-period calculation determines the affine mirror map $\lambda=a-346$ and proves that the regularized quantum period equals the classical period as a formal power series throughout the family.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们无条件地证明了 Akhtar--Coates--Corti--Heuberger--Kasprzyk--Oneto--Petracci--Prince--Tveiten 的猜想 B，用于最大可变洛朗多项式的归一化族，其规定的 $T$-二项式边缘系数与 10 次 Orbifold del Pezzo 超曲面相关$X_{10}\subset\mathbb{P}(1,2,3,5)$。显式的$S$扩展量子周期计算确定了仿射镜像映射$\lambda=a-346$，并证明正则化量子周期等于经典周期，作为整个系列的形式幂级数。
items.title_zh: $X_{10}$ 及其属二镜像的猜想 B

items.title: Canonical Projectivization of Algebraic Varieties in Characteristic Zero
items.excerpt: We construct a canonical projectivization of every smooth proper algebraic variety $X$ in characteristic zero. Once a principalization procedure is fixed, the construction gives a finite sequence of blowups in smooth centers with smooth projective endpoint, natural under semilinear isomorphisms and preserving the quasi-projective core, the intersection of all maximal quasi-projective open subsets. At each stage we select finitely many ideals near the generic points of the image in $X$ of the boundary of a maximal quasi-projective open. Principalizing their product strictly lowers the dimension of that image. The selection is defined intrinsically, without a polarization or a chosen projective modification; a Hilbert scheme argument proves its finiteness. Naturality embeds the automorphism group in that of a smooth projective variety of the same dimension. We then extend the construction to smooth proper integral algebraic spaces, obtaining canonical projectivizations of all compact connected Moishezon manifolds.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们构造特征零中每个光滑真代数簇 $X$ 的规范投影。一旦主化过程被固定，该构造就会在具有平滑射影端点的平滑中心给出有限的放大序列，在半线性同构下自然并保留拟射影核心，即所有最大拟射影开子集的交集。在每个阶段，我们在最大准射影开边界的 $X$ 中的图像通用点附近选择有限多个理想。将他们的产品原则化严格降低了该形象的维度。选择是本质上定义的，没有极化或选择的投影修改；希尔伯特方案论证证明了其有限性。自然性将自同构群嵌入到相同维度的平滑射影簇中。然后，我们将构造扩展到平滑真积分代数空间，获得所有紧连通 Moishezon 流形的规范投影。
items.title_zh: 特征零代数簇的正则投影化

items.title: Bayesian Filters via the Stochastic Category
items.excerpt: We extend the categorical treatment of Bayesian filters to models with feedback, whose transitions and observations may depend on the past observations. We work in the stochastic category, whose objects are measurable spaces and whose morphisms are Markov kernels, which we refer to as stochastic morphisms. We systematically parameterize stochastic morphisms by a measurable space, and develop the calculus of conditioning in a notation intuitively compatible with classical probability theory, requiring neither string diagrams nor densities. A stochastic morphism into a product space is regarded as a parameterized family of joint laws, and its conditional law is again a stochastic morphism, so that the rules of conditioning become equalities of stochastic morphisms. We define the Bayesian inverse with respect to a parameterized prior and prove Bayesian coherence. A model with feedback is then a model whose parameter space grows with the observations, and we derive the Bayesian filter, prediction and smoothing for such models, with standard Borel hidden states and countably generated observation spaces. items.excerpt_zh: 我们将贝叶斯过滤器的分类处理扩展到具有反馈的模型，其转换和观察可能取决于过去的观察。我们研究的是随机范畴，其对象是可测空间，其态射是马尔可夫核，我们将其称为随机态射。我们通过可测量的空间系统地参数化随机态射，并以与经典概率论直观兼容的符号开发条件微积分，既不需要弦图也不需要密度。乘积空间中的随机态射被视为参数化的联合律族，其条件律又是随机态射，因此条件规则成为随机态射等式。我们根据参数化先验定义贝叶斯逆并证明贝叶斯一致性。带反馈的模型是参数空间随着观测值而增长的模型，我们推导了此类模型的贝叶斯滤波器、预测和平滑，具有标准的 Borel 隐藏状态和可数生成的观测空间。仿射高斯随机莫普

items.title: R\'enyi mixing bounds for kinetic samplers via $L^2$ hypocoercivity
items.excerpt: We study convergence in R\'enyi divergence of order two for underdamped Langevin dynamics, the bouncy particle sampler, and the Zigzag sampler, for a target $e^{-U}$ on $\mathbb R^d$ that satisfies a logarithmic Sobolev inequality, with $\nabla^2U$ bounded below by a possibly negative constant and, for the Zigzag sampler, also bounded above. For initial laws whose R\'enyi divergence from equilibrium is at most $R$, we show that it decays exponentially, at a rate that depends on $R$. With the friction or refreshment rate chosen according to $R$, the time needed to reach a fixed accuracy in total variation or in R\'enyi divergence is of order $\sqrt{R\log R}$ at fixed dimension and target parameters, improving the linear dependence obtained by directly converting exponential $L^2$ decay. The key idea is to use the logarithmic Sobolev inequality for the position target in place of the usual spatial spectral-gap estimate in the $L^2$ hypocoercivity argument. items.title: Markovian Lifts and Multifactor Approximations for Weighted Sub-fractional Brownian Motion
items.excerpt: We construct a Hilbert-space Markovian lift of weighted sub-fractional Brownian motion for $0 <2$, including the logarithmic case $b=1$. A Laplace factorization represents the process as the boundary value of a forward curve. In the weighted Sobolev space with derivative weight $r^\gamma/(1+r)^2$, $0<\gamma<1$, right translation is strongly continuous and the noise operator is Hilbert--Schmidt if and only if $b+\gamma>1$. The state norm bounds the total variation of initial curves on compact intervals. For locally bounded deterministic temporal weights, this bound allows the driven scalar equation to be restarted from every lifted state. Under spatial Lipschitz assumptions, with additional time and derivative regularity in the Young case, the solution and forward curve form a time-inhomogeneous Markov process with $C_b$-Feller transitions; both coefficients may have linear growth. Discretization of the Laplace variable gives independent Ornstein--Uhlenbeck factors coupled to the original process through the same Gaussian noise. items.title_zh: 加权次分数布朗运动的马尔可夫提升和多因子近似

items.title: The Arc Threshold of the Two-Row Ising Torus: Exact Factorization, an Algebraic Critical Coupling, Uniformity in the Circumference, and the Rate of Convergence
items.excerpt: The Lee-Yang circle theorem places every zero of a ferromagnetic Ising partition polynomial on the unit circle. The arc condition, that every zero lie in the closed left half-plane, turns the circle theorem into a product formula for the characteristic function of the occupation count and makes it usable for local limit theorems. For the two-row periodic Ising torus we give the exact reflection factorization of the row transfer matrix, reduce the crossing at zeta = i to a real cubic, and identify the critical coupling a_c* = 0.8637850566870... as the unique root in (0,1) of an explicit octic. We prove that every a > a_c* satisfies the arc condition simultaneously for all circumferences, that no smaller coupling does, and that the finite thresholds approach a_c* at the rate C/n^2 with an explicit algebraic constant C. The factorization and the 2x2 threshold are formalized in Lean 4 against Mathlib; the zeta = i reduction, uniformity and rate are analysis-level.
items.title_zh: 两行 Ising 环面的弧阈值：精确因式分解、代数临界耦合、周长均匀性和收敛率
items.excerpt_zh: 李杨圆定理将铁磁伊辛分区多项式的每个零都放在单位圆上。每个零都位于闭左半平面内的圆弧条件将圆定理转化为占据数特征函数的乘积公式，并使其可用于局部极限定理。对于两行周期伊辛环面，我们给出行传输矩阵的精确反射因式分解，将 zeta = i 处的交叉减少到实数三次，并将临界耦合 a_c* = 0.8637850566870... 确定为显式八次晶 (0,1) 中的唯一根。我们证明，对于所有圆周，每个 a > a_c* 同时满足弧条件，没有更小的耦合可以满足，并且有限阈值以显式代数常数 C 的速率 C/n^2 逼近 a_c*。因子分解和 2x2 阈值在 Lean 4 中针对 Mathlib 进行形式化； zeta = i 减少、均匀性和速率是分析级别的。

items.title: Almost sure exponential stability of multi-dimensional stochastic systems driven by a symmetric $\alpha$-stable process
items.excerpt: This article investigates the stability of a class of multidimensional stochastic systems driven by a symmetric $\alpha$-stable process with $1<\alpha<2$. These driving processes have infinite second moments, which prevents the direct application of standard second-moment methods and may lead to divergent jump integrals in the generators of quadratic Lyapunov functions. We establish criteria for $p$th-moment exponential stability and almost sure exponential stability. A numerical example illustrates the theoretical results.
items.authors: Xuekang Zhang, Hongjian Liu, Guangjun Shen
items.title_zh: 由对称 $\alpha$ 稳定过程驱动的多维随机系统几乎肯定指数稳定性
items.excerpt_zh: 本文研究了由 $1<\alpha<2$ 的对称 $\alpha$ 稳定过程驱动的一类多维随机系统的稳定性。这些驱动过程具有无限的二阶矩，这妨碍了标准二阶矩方法的直接应用，并且可能导致二次李雅普诺夫函数的生成器中的跳跃积分发散。我们建立了 $p$th 矩指数稳定性和几乎肯定指数稳定性的标准。数值例子说明了理论结果。

items.title: Optimal no-feedback card guessing after a fixed number of riffle shuffles
items.excerpt: An ordered deck of $n$ cards is subjected to $k$ independent Gilbert--Shannon--Reeds riffle shuffles. A player then guesses each card without feedback, with repeated guesses allowed. For every fixed $k\ge1$, we prove that, once $n$ is sufficiently large, an optimal guess at position $i$ in the top half of the deck is $\lfloor i/2^k\rfloor+1$; the bottom-half strategy is obtained by reflection. We also show that the optimal expected number of correct guesses is $2\sqrt{n/((2^k-1)\pi)}+O_k(1)$. Our starting point is the result of our earlier work that the label at each position is distributed as an equally weighted mixture of $2^k$ components, each a shifted sum of two independent binomial random variables (a Poisson-binomial distribution). The proof of the optimal strategy combines three ingredients: a uniform concentration estimate that separates the mixture components, exact binomial inequalities that control the gaps between competing peaks, and a coefficient comparison that resolves modal ties. The expected-score asymptotic is proved independently of the strategy, using only the peak heights of the mixture components.
items.title_zh: 固定次数的洗牌后最佳无反馈猜牌
items.excerpt_zh: 一副有序的 $n$ 牌将接受 $k$ 独立的 Gilbert-Shannon-Reeds riffle 洗牌。然后，玩家在没有反馈的情况下猜测每张牌，并允许重复猜测。对于每个固定的$k\ge1$，我们证明，一旦$n$足够大，甲板上半部分位置$i$的最佳猜测是$\lfloor i/2^k\rfloor+1$；下半部策略是通过反射得到的。我们还表明，正确猜测的最佳预期数量是 $2\sqrt{n/((2^k-1)\pi)}+O_k(1)$。我们的出发点是我们早期工作的结果，即每个位置的标签作为 $2^k$ 分量的等权混合分布，每个分量都是两个独立二项式随机变量的移位和（泊松二项式分布）。最佳策略的证明结合了三个要素：分离混合物成分的统一浓度估计、控制竞争峰之间间隙的精确二项式不等式以及解决模态关系的系数比较。仅使用混合成分的峰值高度即可独立于策略证明预期分数渐近。

items.title: Almost sure exponential stabilization of linear stochastic systems driven by a general $\alpha$-stable process via discrete-time state feedback
items.excerpt: Given an unstable linear scalar differential equation $dx(t)=\theta x(t)dt$, $\theta>0$, we show that it can be almost surely exponentially stabilized by a discrete-time feedback control driven by a general $\alpha$-stable process. More precisely, consider the stochastically controlled system $dx(t)=\theta x(t)dt+bx(\lfloor t/\tau\rfloor\tau)dZ(t)$, where $Z(t)$ is a general $\alpha$-stable process with $\alpha\in(1,2)$, and $\lfloor t/\tau\rfloor$ denotes the integer part of $t/\tau$. Unlike the extensively studied driven Brownian-driven case, the $\alpha$-stable process has no finite second moment, so high-order moment methods are no longer applicable. By using fractional moments, characteristic functions, and moment inequalities for $\alpha$-stable stochastic integrals, we prove that the stochastically controlled system is almost surely exponentially stable provided that the inequality $|b\sigma|^\alpha\left(1-\beta\operatorname{sgn}(b)\tan^2\frac{\pi\alpha}{2}\right)>(\theta+b\mu) \frac{-1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\cos\frac{\alpha\pi}{2}}$ holds, and that $\tau>0$ is sufficiently small.
items.excerpt_zh: 给定一个不稳定的线性标量微分方程 $dx(t)=\theta x(t)dt$, $\theta>0$，我们表明它几乎可以肯定通过由一般 $\alpha$ 稳定过程驱动的离散时间反馈控制实现指数稳定。更准确地说，考虑随机控制系统 $dx(t)=\theta x(t)dt+bx(\lfloor t/\tau\rfloor\tau)dZ(t)$，其中 $Z(t)$ 是一般 $\alpha$ 稳定过程，$\alpha\in(1,2)$，$\lfloor t/\tau\rfloor$ 表示整数部分$t/\tau$。与广泛研究的驱动布朗驱动情况不同，$\alpha$-稳定过程没有有限二阶矩，因此高阶矩方法不再适用。通过使用 $\alpha$-稳定随机积分的分数矩、特征函数和矩不等式，我们证明随机控制系统几乎肯定是指数稳定的，只要不等式 $|b\sigma|^\alpha\left(1-\beta\operatorname{sgn}(b)\tan^2\frac{\pi\alpha}{2}\right)>(\theta+b\mu) \frac{-1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\cos\frac{\alpha\pi}{2}}$ 成立，并且 $\tau>0$ 足够小。
items.title_zh: 由一般 $\alpha$ 稳定过程通过离散时间状态反馈驱动的线性随机系统几乎肯定指数稳定

items.title: RH-Conditional Positivity in a Theta-Kernel Langevin Model
items.excerpt: A classical Brownian-bridge representation of Riemann's xi function defines an even, rapidly confining probability density and a reversible Langevin model. Our principal physical observable is the transient variance after a quadratic-potential quench; we also analyze a tilted bridge-range response and a sixth-order cumulant gap. For a specified passive harmonic trap with bounded delayed residual feedback, we derive a non-vacuous finite-time variance-increase bound under explicit calibration and sampling assumptions. An elementary global curvature estimate and de Bruijn's strip-contraction theorem give a direct proof of a strict susceptibility bound for every nonnegative quadratic tilt, without assuming the Riemann hypothesis. The inequality itself is a classical GHS consequence, valid more generally for every real quadratic tilt. Reversibility then gives explicit finite-time response and deterministic-control action bounds (not thermodynamic energy). items.excerpt_zh: 黎曼 xi 函数的经典布朗桥表示定义了均匀、快速限制的概率密度和可逆朗之万模型。我们主要的物理可观测值是二次电位失超后的瞬态方差；我们还分析了倾斜桥范围响应和六阶累积量间隙。对于具有有界延迟残差反馈的指定无源谐波陷阱，我们在显式校准和采样假设下推导出非空有限时间方差增加界。基本全局曲率估计和 de Bruijn 条带收缩定理直接证明了每个非负二次倾斜的严格磁化率界限，而无需假设黎曼假设。不等式本身是一个经典的 GHS 结果，对于每一个实二次倾斜更普遍有效。然后，可逆性给出了明确的有限时间响应和确定性控制动作界限（不是热力学能量）。相同的曲率估计在向外二次淬火后给出单调方差松弛，具有指数赤字界限。在未变形密度下，所有交替零场

items.title: Factorized approximate inverse preconditioners in the tensor train format
items.excerpt: We present a preconditioning pipeline that accelerates Tensor Train (TT) linear solvers for symmetric positive-definite problems. Extending the Factorized Sparse Approximate Inverse framework to tensor networks, we construct a preconditioner as the product of a TT operator and its transpose. This formulation is positive semidefinite for any bond dimension and truncation, and definite whenever the factor is non-singular, satisfying the mathematical requirements of the Conjugate Gradient method. We detail the construction of this preconditioner and its integration into Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG)-like linear solvers. Performance evaluations show consistent iteration reductions for anisotropic diffusion and Poisson problems across various configurations, leading to net speedups of up to 25% in ill-conditioned settings of time stepping schemes that can reuse the approximate inverses. These benchmarks were performed with the open-source Julia library DifferenTT.jl, which we also introduce in this work to provide out-of-the-box access to these preconditioned pipelines.
items.authors: Pau Torrente Badia, Daniel P\'erez Garc\'ia, Artur Garcia-Saez, Stefano Carignano
items.title_zh: 张量序列格式的因式分解近似逆预处理器
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一种预处理管道，可以加速对称正定问题的张量训练 (TT) 线性求解器。将因式分解稀疏近似逆框架扩展到张量网络，我们构建了一个预处理器作为 TT 算子及其转置的乘积。该公式对于任何键维数和截断都是正半定的，只要因子是非奇异的，该公式就是定的，满足共轭梯度法的数学要求。我们详细介绍了该预处理器的构造及其与密度矩阵重整化群 (DMRG) 类线性求解器的集成。性能评估显示，各种配置下的各向异性扩散和泊松问题的迭代减少一致，导致在可以重用近似逆的时间步长方案的病态设置中净加速高达 25%。这些基准测试是使用开源 Julia 库 DifferenTT.jl 执行的，我们也在这项工作中引入了该库，以提供对这些预处理管道的开箱即用访问。

items.title: Weighted Randomized Kaczmarz for Sparsely Corrupted Linear Systems
items.excerpt: In this paper, we introduce a generalized weighted randomized Kaczmarz framework to approximate solutions to overdetermined linear systems whose measurements are perturbed by sparse, additive corruptions. The proposed framework samples equations with probabilities proportional to a user-defined weighting function of their corresponding residual magnitudes. Our work focuses on weighting functions that will reduce the influence of potentially corrupted equations, and provides analyses for a general class of non-increasing weighting functions. We derive one-step expected squared error bounds that separate progress on uncorrupted equations from the contribution of corrupted equations, and provide sufficient conditions for geometric convergence under one specific family of weighting functions -- threshold weighting. We also investigate adaptive exponential weights scaled by the median or median absolute deviation of residual magnitudes, requiring no prior knowledge of the corruption fraction or magnitudes. items.authors: Jessie Chen, Ziyu Cheng, Yunhui He, Alona Kryshchenko, Jocelyn T. Chi, Anna Ma, Jamie Haddock
items.title_zh: 稀疏损坏线性系统的加权随机 Kaczmarz
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们引入了一种广义加权随机 Kaczmarz 框架来近似解决超定线性系统，该系统的测量受到稀疏、加性损坏的干扰。所提出的框架对方程进行采样，其概率与用户定义的相应残差幅度的加权函数成正比。我们的工作重点是加权函数，该函数将减少潜在损坏方程的影响，并为一般类别的非递增加权函数提供分析。我们推导了一步期望平方误差界限，将未损坏方程的进展与损坏方程的贡献分开，并为一种特定的加权函数族（阈值加权）下的几何收敛提供了充分的条件。我们还研究了按残差幅度的中值或中值绝对偏差缩放的自适应指数权重，无需事先了解腐败分数或幅度。最后，我们考虑一系列逆残差加权函数。数值实验证明了这种概括的好处

items.title: A probabilistic score estimation using the Bismut--Elworthy--Li formula
items.excerpt: Score-learning methods generally lack pointwise supervision, which affects the training accuracy, particularly in regions where SDE trajectories are rare. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel method called \emph{BEL anchors}, which uses Monte Carlo score estimates at user-selected space-time query points. By combining a Feynman--Kac representation of the Fokker--Planck equation with the Bismut--Elworthy--Li formula, our estimator requires neither closed-form transition densities, spatial discretization, nor derivatives of the initial density. We derive its asymptotic variance and use the anchors as sparse supervised targets for existing score-learning objectives. Experiments show that BEL anchors improve implicit score matching in poorly sampled regions, prevent score-PINN collapse, and enable accurate sample regeneration in several numerical examples.
items.authors: Jiatong Sun, Long Nguyen, Ning Jiang, Weiqi Chu, Yao Li
items.title_zh: 使用 Bismut--Elworthy--Li 公式进行概率分数估计
items.excerpt_zh: 分数学习方法通​​常缺乏逐点监督，这会影响训练准确性，特别是在 SDE 轨迹很少的区域。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了一种名为 \emph{BELanchors} 的新颖方法，该方法在用户选择的时空查询点处使用蒙特卡洛分数估计。通过将 Fokker-Planck 方程的 Feynman-Kac 表示与 Bismut-Elworthy-Li 公式相结合，我们的估计器既不需要封闭形式的过渡密度、空间离散化，也不需要初始密度的导数。我们推导出其渐近方差，并使用锚作为现有分数学习目标的稀疏监督目标。实验表明，BEL 锚点改进了采样质量较差区域的隐式得分匹配，防止得分-PINN 崩溃，并在多个数值示例中实现了准确的样本重新生成。

items.title: Initial-Trace Insufficiency and Entropy-Accounting Separation in Finite-Volume Coarse Graining
items.excerpt: Coarse finite-volume information does not automatically define an exact pathwise closure for the restricted evolution of a fine-grid realization. We study two one-step information boundaries that are distinct from recursive predictive memory. First, we show that parent averages together with complete initial parent-interface trace pairs are sufficient for one forward-Euler finite-volume transition with a deterministic two-state numerical flux, but they do not generally determine a completed second-order strong-stability-preserving Runge-Kutta, equivalently Heun, transition. An explicit scalar upwind collision shows that hidden interior data can affect later stage traces and hence the completed parent update, even when initial traces and parent averages agree. Second, we show that exact conservative one-step closure is not the same as entropy-accounting closure. items.title_zh: 有限体积粗粒化中的初始痕量不足和熵核算分离

items.title: Fixed-grid schemes for fractional moving-boundary problems
items.excerpt: The Landau transformation xi = x/s(t) is the usual way to hold a moving boundary in place. It fails for fractional time derivatives because they have no chain rule: the transformed operator gains a nonlocal integral with a closed form only for self-similar fronts. We develop a sharp-interface finite-difference scheme for the conservation-consistent memory-flux fractional Stefan problem on a fixed grid, storing the memory limit h(x) = s^-1(x) as the time each node melts. The front is advanced using an integrated energy balance, with the singular source timed to the sub-step crossing instant. Against a known self-similar solution, the front constant is accurate to 0.02 to 0.11%, whereas competing formulations differ by 17 to 27% at alpha = 0.6. A remaining positivity violation follows from dt/t0 ~ s0^(1 - 2/alpha) and disappears on a front-locked time grid. We also derive two exact solutions with non-power-law fronts: a source-dominated solution and a Mittag-Leffler traveling wave, and verify the scheme against both. items.title: Adaptive data-driven reduced-order models for reciprocal MIMO port-Hamiltonian dynamical systems
items.excerpt: Port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems provide a general framework for modeling a broad class of physical dynamical systems, including systems with dissipation. Constructing accurate and robust data-driven reduced-order models for general pH systems is challenging. In this work, we focus on an important subclass of pH systems satisfying reciprocity, a property arising naturally in a variety of models. Rather than seeking to preserve the full pH structure, we exploit the additional symmetry provided by reciprocity to develop an efficient data-driven reduced-order modeling approach. We show that every minimal realization of a reciprocal system is self-adjoint with respect to a generally indefinite inner product and can, up to a similarity transformation preserving the pH structure, be represented in a Krein space with a signature inner product. This observation motivates a Galerkin projection onto a tangential rational Krylov subspace with respect to the corresponding indefinite inner product. items.title_zh: 互易 MIMO 端口哈密尔顿动力系统的自适应数据驱动降阶模型
items.excerpt_zh: 哈密​​尔顿港 (pH) 系统为模拟各种物理动力系统（包括耗散系统）提供了通用框架。为一般 pH 系统构建准确且稳健的数据驱动降阶模型具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们重点关注满足互易性的 pH 系统的一个重要子类，这是各种模型中自然出现的属性。我们不是寻求保留完整的 pH 结构，而是利用互易性提供的额外对称性来开发有效的数据驱动的降阶建模方法。我们证明，互易系统的每个最小实现对于一般不定的内积都是自伴的，并且可以在保持 pH 结构的相似变换之前，在带有签名内积的 Kerin 空间中表示。这一观察激发了相对于相应的不定内积到切向有理 Krylov 子空间的伽辽金投影。尽管最终的投影涉及全阶状态解和未知的内积，但我们表明其减少的质量和刚度矩阵

items.title: Convergence analysis of TriCG and TriMR for symmetric quasi-definite linear systems
items.excerpt: TriCG and TriMR are two short-recurrence iterative methods introduced by Montoison and Orban [SIAM J.\ Sci.\ Comput., 43 (2021), pp.\ A2502--A2525] for solving symmetric quasi-definite linear systems. Extensive numerical experiments have demonstrated the efficiency of these two methods, but a systematic convergence analysis is still lacking. In this paper, we derive convergence bounds for the TriCG error norm and the TriMR residual norm. Numerical experiments support the theoretical results.
items.title_zh: 对称拟定线性系统TriCG和TriMR的收敛性分析
items.excerpt_zh: TriCG 和 TriMR 是 Montoison 和 Orban [SIAM J.\ Sci.\ Comput., 43 (2021), pp.\ A2502--A2525] 提出的两种用于求解对称拟定线性系统的短递归迭代方法。大量的数值实验证明了这两种方法的有效性，但仍缺乏系统的收敛性分析。在本文中，我们推导了 TriCG 误差范数和 TriMR 残差范数的收敛界。数值实验支持了理论结果。

items.title: A hybrid TT/QTT discontinuous Galerkin method with fixed-matrix upwinding for three-dimensional transient multigroup neutron transport
items.excerpt: We develop a hybrid tensor-train/quantized tensor-train (TT/QTT) upwind discontinuous Galerkin method for three-dimensional transient multigroup neutron transport. The central contribution is a fixed-matrix upwind construction: two spatial DG matrices serve all directions and energy groups, with signed and absolute direction-cosine factors preserving Kronecker structure. For homogeneous materials on uniform Cartesian grids, operator rank bounds are independent of mesh size, group count and direction count at fixed scattering order. We derive a conditional global step-defect bound and enforce group-integrated balance of the compressed system. Crank-Nicolson tests show second-order convergence on a separable manufactured solution whose finest final state occupies 13 kB instead of 35 TB, a compression factor of $2.7\times10^9$. A modified rank-adaptive basis-update and Galerkin integrator (TT-BUG) advances passive and active bursts with approximately half a billion unknowns. items.title: CARD: A Proof-Carrying Certificate-to-Action Interface for Relative-Measurement Graphs
items.excerpt: Geometric certificates make mathematical claims about specified estimator objects, while robotic action requires a physical transform, a service decision, and timely proof support. We present CARD, a proof-carrying interface that keeps these objects distinct and records how they combine. Its lifted-fiber formulation separates semantic motion from witness repair and characterizes when projected and proof-carrying costs coincide. Its actionability result gives an exact useful-service law: uniform sampling without replacement produces a hypergeometric yield, while sampling from the eligible population gives one useful service per request under the observed live-confirmation condition. The primary study contains 404 Full16 cases from 20 sorties of an AA15-X500 airborne survey system. All 404 checker-confirmed optimizer points are reference-discrepant, with median rotation and translation discrepancies of 1.9891 degrees and 21.6322 m. The paired causal-navigation transforms are reference-consistent in all 404 cases, with medians of 0.0036566 degrees and 0.0104519 m. items.title_zh: CARD：用于相对测量图的带有证明的证书到操作接口
items.excerpt_zh: 几何证书对指定的估计器对象做出数学声明，而机器人动作需要物理变换、服务决策和及时的证明支持。我们提出了 CARD，这是一个携带证据的接口，可以使这些对象保持独特并记录它们如何组合。其提升纤维公式将语义运动与证人修复分开，并描述预计成本和证明成本何时重合。其可操作性结果给出了精确的有用服务定律：无放回的均匀采样产生超几何产量，而从合格人群中采样在观察到的实时确认条件下为每个请求提供一项有用服务。主要研究包含 AA15-X500 机载测量系统 20 架次的 404 个 Full16 案例。所有 404 个经检查器确认的优化器点均存在参考差异，中位旋转和平移差异为 1.9891 度和 21.6322 m。成对的因果导航变换在所有 404 个案例中都是参考一致的，中位数为 0.0036566 度和 0.0104519 米。在五个匹配的请求预算中，hy 之间的最大差异

items.title: Counterexample-driven autonomous research with application to excess radiated energy in a Z-pinch
items.excerpt: Recent breakthroughs in artificial-intelligence-assisted mathematics show that open-ended machine search can outperform human mathematicians, yet transferring this paradigm to physics requires refactoring the research workflow. We introduce Simjecture, an open-source framework in which language-model agents pursue human-defined physical conjectures. The framework tackles two central challenges in this transfer: first, because physics is empirical and no model is final, it structures inquiry around counterexample-driven falsification and prospective hypothesis repair; second, because physical theories must interact with the real world, it uses computational physics as an executable testbed while separating the qualification of numerical instruments from scientific claim review so solvers and diagnostics can be adapted within a recorded investigation. We apply the framework in an 82.6 h investigation to tackle the long-standing problem of radiated energy exceeding the imploding-shell kinetic energy in a Z-pinch. items.title_zh: 反例驱动的自主研究及其在 Z 箍缩中过量辐射能量的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 人工智能辅助数学的最新突破表明，开放式机器搜索可以超越人类数学家，但将这种范式转移到物理学需要重构研究工作流程。我们介绍 Simjecture，这是一个开源框架，其中语言模型代理可以追求人类定义的物理猜想。该框架解决了这种转移中的两个核心挑战：首先，因为物理学是经验性的，没有模型是最终的，所以它围绕反例驱动的证伪和前瞻性假设修复进行探究；其次，由于物理理论必须与现实世界相互作用，因此它使用计算物理学作为可执行的测试平台，同时将数值仪器的资格与科学声明审查分开，以便可以在记录的调查中调整求解器和诊断。我们在 82.6 小时的研究中应用该框架，以解决 Z 箍缩中辐射能超过内爆壳动能的长期存在的问题。研究揭示了能量转换、保留和释放时间的竞争效应。更强的相干螺旋定义

items.title: Low-Rank Hierarchical Merging for Efficient Long-to-Short Reasoning
items.excerpt: Long-to-Short (L2S) model merging seeks to combine the strong reasoning capability of long chain-of-thought models with the concise style of base models, but existing methods that rely on linear interpolation and first-order activation statistics fail to capture how the loss landscape responds to parameter displacement, leading to degraded accuracy on hard tasks. We propose Low-Rank Hierarchical Merging (LHM), a training-free framework that replaces heuristic statistics with lightweight second-order curvature information. LHM consists of three components: (1) a low-rank Hessian approximation that efficiently estimates per-layer Hessian traces via Hutchinson's estimator on random inputs, eliminating the need for task-specific data; (2) a Layer Second-Order Sensitivity (LSOS) index that combines Hessian trace with task-vector norm to quantify per-layer fusion difficulty; and (3) a Dual-Constraint Coefficient Mapping (DCCM) that converts LSOS scores into layer-adaptive merge coefficients while jointly satisfying a fusion-error bound and a global length-reduction target. Experiments across six mathematical benchmarks on 1.5B and 7B models
items.authors: Zeqiu Yu, Xuesheng Zhang, Wenxiao Zhao, Shixiao Wang
items.title_zh: 用于高效长到短推理的低秩分层合并
items.excerpt_zh: 长到短（L2S）模型合并旨在将长思想链模型的强大推理能力与基础模型的简洁风格结合起来，但依赖线性插值和一阶激活统计的现有方法无法捕获损失景观如何响应参数位移，导致困难任务的准确性下降。我们提出了低阶分层合并（LHM），这是一种免训练框架，用轻量级二阶曲率信息取代启发式统计。 LHM 由三个组成部分组成：(1) 低阶 Hessian 近似，通过 Hutchinson 随机输入估计器有效估计每层 Hessian 轨迹，从而无需特定于任务的数据； (2) 层二阶灵敏度 (LSOS) 指数，将 Hessian 迹与任务向量范数相结合，以量化每层融合难度； (3) 双约束系数映射 (DCCM)，将 LSOS 分数转换为层自适应合并系数，同时共同满足融合误差界限和全局长度缩减目标。在 1.5B 和 7B 模型上进行的六个数学基准实验

items.title: AlgoPilot: Cross-Paradigm Reasoning in Language Models via Strategy Selection and Guidance
items.excerpt: Real-world problems span diverse domains, including program synthesis, symbolic reasoning, planning, and optimization, and often require fundamentally different solution paradigms. A central challenge for LLM-based reasoning is twofold: identifying an appropriate problem-solving approach and formulating it correctly. In this paper, we propose AlgoPilot, a cross-paradigm reasoning framework that enables adaptive selection of the solving approaches and structured problem formulation prior to execution. The AlgoPilot framework contains three components: 1) a SteerLM, trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), that adaptively selects the solving strategy (paradigm and modes) based on input problems, 2) the corresponding expert GuideLM, trained via SFT, that generates structured formulation guidance tailored to the selected strategy, and 3) an ExecutionLM that generates solutions conditioned on both the selected strategy and its formulation. items.excerpt_zh: 现实世界的问题跨越不同的领域，包括程序综合、符号推理、规划和优化，并且通常需要根本不同的解决方案范例。基于法学硕士的推理的核心挑战是双重的：确定适当的问题解决方法并正确地制定它。在本文中，我们提出了 AlgoPilot，这是一个跨范式推理框架，可以在执行之前自适应选择解决方法和结构化问题表述。 AlgoPilot 框架包含三个组件：1) SteerLM，通过监督微调 (SFT) 和强化学习 (RL) 进行训练，根据输入问题自适应地选择解决策略（范例和模式）；2) 相应的专家 GuideLM，通过 SFT 训练，生成针对所选策略的结构化公式指导；3) ExecutionLM，根据所选策略及其公式生成解决方案。与依赖固定推理模板的基于提示的方法不同，我们的方法学习根据输入自适应地选择和构建问题解决策略

items.title: Clocks all the way down: does sequence-processing AI need endogenous temporal structure?
items.excerpt: Mainstream sequence-processing AI is temporally reactive: each update is driven by input and learned state transitions, rather than by an independently evolving internal temporal reference. Biological brains, by contrast, continuously generate rhythmic activity that structures perception, memory, and cognition, and this rhythmicity reaches all the way to behavior. We ask whether this difference is merely implementational or genuinely computational. Four lines of evidence suggest that endogenous temporal structure supports putative functions that input-driven architectures may not readily replicate: 1) phase-dependent routing of information, 2) delay-structured combinatorial representation, 3) cross-frequency multiplexing of items, and 4) oscillation-gated offline consolidation. A proof-of-concept delay-ablation test dissociates representational capacity from memory retrieval. In recurrent and spatial spiking networks with fixed synaptic weights and connectivity, shuffling delays preserves part of the capacity but substantially impairs the sequence retrieval. The relative contrast is more pronounced for spatial networks and longer prop
items.authors: Meysam Hashemi, Alireza Valizadeh, Viktor Jirsa
items.excerpt_zh: 主流序列处理人工智能是时间反应性的：每次更新都是由输入和学习的状态转换驱动的，而不是由独立演变的内部时间参考驱动的。相比之下，生物大脑不断产生节奏活动，构建感知、记忆和认知，这种节奏一直延伸到行为。我们要问的是，这种差异仅仅是实现上的还是真正计算上的。四行证据表明，内生时间结构支持输入驱动架构可能不易复制的假定功能：1）相位相关的信息路由，2）延迟结构组合表示，3）项目的跨频复用，以及4）振荡门控离线整合。概念验证延迟消融测试将表征能力与记忆检索分离。在具有固定突触权重和连接性的循环和空间尖峰网络中，改组延迟保留了部分容量，但严重损害了序列检索。对于空间网络和较长的支撑，相对对比更为明显
items.title_zh: 时钟一路走低：序列处理人工智能是否需要内源时间结构？

items.title: Toward User-Centered Agentic Recommendation: When Does Platform Competition Benefit Users?
items.excerpt: Conventional recommender systems operate within platform-specific catalogs, limiting access to potentially valuable resources across platforms. We propose user-centered agentic recommendation, a paradigm in which user agents compare recommendations from competing platform agents, and formalize their interaction as a repeated game. Platforms strategically modify descriptions without changing intrinsic item value, while each user agent assesses platform credibility using feedback from consumed items only. Our analysis shows that expanded resource access need not improve user welfare: strategic misrepresentation and limited verification can offset the benefits of platform competition. We quantify when platform credibility assessment allows users to benefit from broader access despite strategic exaggeration. Our analysis identifies resource and reporting conditions that guarantee higher average welfare than the original platform with an interaction budget linear in platform count. items.excerpt_zh: 传统的推荐系统在特定于平台的目录中运行，限制了跨平台对潜在有价值资源的访问。我们提出了以用户为中心的代理推荐，这是一种范式，其中用户代理比较来自竞争平台代理的推荐，并将它们的交互形式化为重复游戏。平台在不改变物品内在价值的情况下策略性地修改描述，而每个用户代理仅使用消费物品的反馈来评估平台可信度。我们的分析表明，扩大资源访问并不需要改善用户福利：战略性失实陈述和有限的验证可能会抵消平台竞争的好处。我们量化平台可信度评估何时允许用户从更广泛的访问中受益，尽管战略上有所夸大。我们的分析确定了资源和报告条件，这些资源和报告条件保证了比原始平台更高的平均福利，并且互动预算与平台数量呈线性关系。对合成市场和亚马逊市场的实验表明，可信度评估可以提高有限范围的效用，而其收益取决于市场规模
items.title_zh: 迈向以用户为中心的代理推荐：平台竞争何时让用户受益？

items.title: Exact Optimality Certification of QPLIB 2096 through Complete Set Partitioning

items.title: ATC: Agent Trajectory Control for Role-Contract Enforcement in Black-Box Multi-Agent Systems
items.excerpt: Multi-agent LLM systems assign different responsibilities to different agents: one plans, another retrieves evidence, another verifies, another executes. This division of labor is only meaningful if each agent stays within the functions it is authorized to perform. Over many turns, however, an agent can produce a locally reasonable message that exercises authority belonging to another role: a verifier that begins planning, a retriever that asserts unsupported conclusions, an executor that changes state no one approved. We formalize this as role drift, a turn-level breach of an agent's role contract. We introduce Agent Trajectory Control (ATC), which makes each role's authority explicit as a contract and enforces it at the point where a message would enter the shared conversation. ATC scores a proposed output for out-of-role deviation, leakage into the functions of other roles, impermissible speech acts, and logical contract breaches, then computes a leakage-regularized target that constrains regeneration; the revised message is re-checked before admission. items.title_zh: ATC：黑盒多智能体系统中角色契约执行的智能体轨迹控制

items.title: Four Extensions of the Universal Law of Robustness: Log-Concave Covariates, Heterogeneous Mixtures, Vector-Valued Predictors, and Markovian Data
items.excerpt: Bubeck and Sellke's universal law of robustness says that fitting $n$ noisy samples below the noise level with a class of $p$ real parameters forces a Lipschitz constant of order $\sqrt{nd/p}$, when the covariate distribution on $\mathbb{R}^d$ is isoperimetric: smooth interpolation costs a factor $d$ of overparametrization. Its hypotheses are Gaussian-type concentration, a homogeneous covariate law, scalar outputs, and independent samples; we relax each one. Exponential concentration suffices, at the unchanged rate and absolute constant and at the price of a capacity burn-in, some form of which we show is necessary; this gives the law for normalized log-concave covariates, with a $\log d$ loss from the current KLS bound. For heterogeneous mixtures the worst component constant is replaced by the weighted average of the component constants, under a typicality condition on the mixture composition. items.title: Language Models Can Benefit from Domain-Specific Inductive Biases
items.excerpt: Language models are typically trained with a single choice of architecture on diverse domains and data sources. Modern transformers have been extensively refined for such general-purpose learning, but are they equally effective across different subsets of the pretraining data? We investigate this question by training small language models from scratch on representative subsets of pretraining data such as web text, code, and mathematics. We introduce variants of transformers in which standard activation functions are replaced with learned splines tuned on specific datasets, providing a simple way to modify their inductive biases. Using a mix-and-match of architectures and datasets, we evaluate cross-domain transfer, i.e. how well does an architecture tuned for one domain perform on data from another? We find that the tuned transformer variants improve training efficiency or generalization on all seven of our tested datasets, but the gains are often domain-specific. items.title_zh: 语言模型可以受益于特定领域的归纳偏差

items.title: Dr. No: Feature Steering for Abstention in Vision-Language Models
items.excerpt: Large foundation models often answer even when the available visual or textual evidence is insufficient to support a reliable conclusion. Dr. No is evaluated on LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B across multimodal abstention benchmarks, including UNK-VQA and MM-UPD, and additionally benchmarked on language reasoning tasks using Qwen3.5-2B on AbstentionBench subsets. items.title: ExaTune: Exhaustive Hyperparameter Landscape Exploration at Scale
items.excerpt: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) returns a single optimal configuration, systematically discarding the explored performance landscape that encodes how results depend on configuration choices. Fitness landscape analysis comprises a robust collection of methods from evolutionary computation offering ruggedness indices, autocorrelation functions, and fitness-distance correlation that have never been applied to machine learning hyperparameter spaces at scale, given that fine-grained ground-truth enumeration data has not existed. items.excerpt: Prior-data fitted networks are typically trained using synthetic data generated by a single, manually constructed generator. items.title: ScaleTraj: Scale-Decomposed Human Trajectory Generation
items.excerpt: Individual-level trajectories are essential for applications that rely on user-level mobility behavior. Existing mobility-generation approaches face a fundamental tension between individual-level and population-level statistical fidelity: top-down models reproduce aggregate mobility statistics but struggle to guarantee realistic individual trajectories, while bottom-up generators synthesize individual trajectories yet often fail to preserve key population-level mobility regularities after aggregation. items.title: When Strong Reasoners Join the Pool: Small Union Premiums and Costly Runaway Generations in LLM Routing
items.excerpt: Routing benchmarks often judge a router against a hindsight oracle that counts a query as solved whenever any model's recorded answer is correct, but under stochastic decoding that oracle mixes two different objects: the clairvoyant ceiling of committing to one model per query and the premium of calling several models and keeping any correct answer. A companion study measured this premium at 3.5 percentage points (pp) for 11 small open models on MATH-500; how large it is once current reasoning models enter the pool was unknown. We measure it with a fixed-protocol, pre-committed generation on a single NVIDIA B300: all 500 MATH-500 problems, 30 seeded samples per problem, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and NVIDIA's Nemotron Nano 9B v2 and Nemotron Super 49B v1.5 (a NAS derivative of the same 70B) under vendor sampling, a 65,536-token cap, a pinned Math-Verify scorer, and an append-only attempt ledger, for 45,000 scored responses. The two reasoning models both reach 96.1% accuracy against 76.2% for the 70B baseline. items.title: Where Did the Update Go? Certifying Declared Change Envelopes for Model Updates
items.excerpt: Deployed language models are updated continually, and regulators increasingly accept changes that were declared in advance. Showing that an update changed behavior only where it was declared to is a different statistical problem from bounding how much it changed: a useful update is meant to change some decisions, so global disagreement and regression bounds cannot certify it. We formalize the problem with declared change envelopes. Before training, the developer commits to a region of inputs, and every decision that changes outside it counts as leakage. Leakage compares two models, so it can be certified from unlabeled traffic with anytime-valid tests whose sample cost we bound from above and below, and per-update certificates compose into a bound on lifetime drift outside all declared scopes. We measure leakage for LoRA and full fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, and knowledge editing on models from 1.5B to 72B parameters. Narrow updates leak widely: domain and policy LoRA updates keep only about 7-36% of the decisions they change inside the declared scope. Across 256 trained variants, leakage tracks the up
items.excerpt_zh: 已部署的语言模型不断更新，监管机构越来越多地接受提前宣布的更改。显示更新仅在声明的地方改变行为与限制其改变量是不同的统计问题：有用的更新意味着改变一些决策，因此全局分歧和回归界限无法证明它。我们通过声明的变更范围将问题正式化。在训练之前，开发人员会承诺一个输入区域，并且在该区域之外更改的每个决策都被视为泄漏。 Leakage 比较了两个模型，因此可以通过随时有效的测试从未标记的流量中进行认证，我们从上方和下方限制了样本成本，并且每次更新证书构成了所有声明范围之外的生命周期漂移的界限。我们测量 LoRA 的泄漏以及对 1.5B 至 72B 参数模型的全面微调、偏好优化、强化学习和知识编辑。狭窄的更新会广泛泄漏：域和策略 LoRA 更新仅保留其在声明范围内更改的决策的约 7-36%。在 256 个经过训练的变体中，泄漏跟踪了
items.title_zh: 更新去哪儿了？验证模型更新的已声明变更范围

items.title: Evaluation Contracts and Evaluation Leverage: Sliced-Gap Readings in Structured Prediction Can Move Without Model Change
items.excerpt: NLP evaluation reports routinely cite sliced performance differences, most prominently the intra-inter gap in document-level relation extraction, as capability evidence. We show that such gap readings are joint properties of models and evaluation contracts: scoring function, gold version, threshold, output format, and prompt language. With predictions frozen, a method ordering reverses under a gold-standard exchange (+0.0363, CI excluding zero; tie-level after), movement localizing where gold re-partitions: renames are gauge transformations (Delta=0; re-annotation +0.862). We formalize this as an evaluation leverage account centered on the rank-flip condition. Constructively, the audited evaluation reading (AER) is a contract-marginalized, tie-declared, seed-prescribed, gate-filtered procedure whose tie declarations cover every contract-induced flip on the declared WMT19 grids (14/14; held-out 73% vs. union-of-ties 89%), matching the best single metric contract at epsilon=0.10 equivalence. Evidence spans DocRE, HacRED, a UD probe, and released gold revisions; an alternative-reference-set replication extends it beyond our testbeds. Fai
items.authors: Hao Lu, Weixing Zhu, Ruiyang Li
items.title_zh: 评估契约和评估杠杆：结构化预测中的切片间隙读数可以在不改变模型的情况下移动
items.excerpt_zh: NLP 评估报告通常会引用切片性能差异（最突出的是文档级关系提取中的内部差距）作为能力证据。我们证明，这种差距读数是模型和评估合约的联合属性：评分函数、黄金版本、阈值、输出格式和提示语言。随着预测的冻结，方法排序在金本位交换下反转（+0.0363，CI 排除零；之后为平局级别），移动本地化黄金重新分区：重命名是规范转换（Delta = 0；重新注释+0.862）。我们将其形式化为以排名翻转条件为中心的评估杠杆账户。从建设性的角度来看，审计评估读数（AER）是一个合约边缘化、平局声明、种子规定、门过滤程序，其平局声明涵盖了声明的 WMT19 网格上的每个合约引发的翻转（14/14；保留 73% 与平局联合 89%），匹配 epsilon=0.10 等价的最佳单一度量合约。证据涵盖 DocRE、HacRED、UD 探针，并发布了黄金修订版；替代参考集复制将其扩展到我们的测试平台之外。辉

items.title: ReSI-Math: Exploring Recoverable Capability Frontiers for Efficient Reasoning Improvement
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective approach for improving mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, a fundamental question remains: when a model fails to solve a problem, does it truly lack the underlying capability? In this work, we reveal that direct failure does not necessarily imply inability. Some reasoning failures can be recovered by exploring the model's own trajectories, exposing a recoverable capability frontier: a policy-dependent region where solutions are not reliably generated through direct decoding but can be elicited through trajectory-level search. Based on this observation, we introduce ReSI-Math, a framework that explores recoverable capability frontiers and converts recovered capabilities into data-efficient RLVR supervision. ReSI-Math uses Self-Judge-guided evolutionary search to identify recoverable failures under a fixed policy and adaptively selects frontier problems for sequential RLVR as the policy evolves. items.authors: Yao Cui, Zhen Yang, Yuandong Wang, Yangfu Zhu, Tianyu Wo, Zhenzhou Shao
items.title_zh: ReSI-Math：探索可恢复的能力前沿以提高高效推理能力
items.excerpt_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为改进大型语言模型中数学推理的有效方法。然而，一个基本问题仍然存在：当一个模型无法解决问题时，它是否真的缺乏底层能力？在这项工作中，我们揭示了直接失败并不一定意味着无能。一些推理失败可以通过探索模型自身的轨迹来恢复，暴露可恢复的能力边界：一个策略相关的区域，其中解决方案不能通过直接解码可靠地生成，但可以通过轨迹级搜索得出。基于这一观察，我们引入了 ReSI-Math，这是一个探索可恢复能力边界并将恢复能力转换为数据高效的 RLVR 监督的框架。 ReSI-Math 使用自我判断引导的演化搜索来识别固定策略下的可恢复故障，并随着策略的演化自适应地选择顺序 RLVR 的前沿问题。在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，正确与不正确的轨迹交叉从 621 次尝试中产生了 272 个验证者确认的正确后代（43.8%）。三秒后

items.title: Shuffled OPSD: When Semantic Consistency Hurts On-Policy Self-Distillation?
items.excerpt: Knowledge distillation improves a student model's reasoning ability through supervision from a teacher. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the same model as both teacher and student under different contexts: the student generates reasoning trajectories from the question alone, while the teacher additionally receives a complete worked example and provides token-level supervision along those trajectories. Because the problem statement is shared, its content and ordering shape both student generation and teacher feedback. Preserving its semantic structure therefore seems natural, but does it always improve learning? We introduce Shuffled OPSD, which shuffles the words of the shared problem statement while keeping the teacher-only worked example intact. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3 model scales, the method improves mean accuracy over both an intact-target control and Standard OPSD under matched training configurations. The largest gain over Standard OPSD is 3.52 percentage points on Qwen3-1.7B. Further controls show that preserving larger word blocks offers no advantage over word-level shuffling at t
items.title_zh: 重新洗牌的 OPSD：语义一致性何时会损害按策略自我蒸馏？
items.excerpt_zh: 知识蒸馏通过老师的监督提高学生模型的推理能力。在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）在不同的环境下使用与教师和学生相同的模型：学生仅根据问题生成推理轨迹，而教师另外收到一个完整的工作示例，并沿着这些轨迹提供令牌级监督。由于问题陈述是共享的，因此其内容和顺序会影响学生的生成和教师的反馈。因此，保留其语义结构似乎很自然，但它总是能改善学习吗？我们引入了 Shuffled OPSD，它会打乱共享问题陈述的文字，同时保持教师专用示例的完整。在三个数学推理基准和三个 Qwen3 模型尺度上，该方法在匹配的训练配置下提高了完整目标控制和标准 OPSD 的平均精度。 Qwen3-1.7B 相对于标准 OPSD 的最大增益为 3.52 个百分点。进一步的控制表明，保留较大的字块并没有比 t 处的字级混洗更有优势。

items.title: ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals
items.excerpt: Looped transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared set of transformer layers, offering a parameter-efficient way to scale computation. However, standard residual connections aggregate information across recurrent depth into a single stream, providing limited control over which intermediate representations from preceding layers should be reused. In this paper, we introduce ARLoop, a looped transformer architecture based on attention residuals, where the input of each layer is selectively aggregated through attention over model depth. Distinct from standard transformers, we find that looped transformers do not require access to the full residual history: sliding-window depth attention matches or outperforms full-history attention at larger recurrent depths. Across controlled experiments with multiple parameter scales (140M and 370M) and recurrent depths (R = 1 to 5), ARLoop consistently outperforms prior residual designs for looped transformers. items.authors: Yuekun Yao, Yupei Du, Dawei Zhu, Huan Sun
items.title_zh: ARLoop：具有注意力残差的全开放预训练环形变压器
items.excerpt_zh: 循环变压器通过重复应用一组共享的变压器层来增加有效深度，提供一种参数有效的方法来扩展计算。然而，标准残差连接将循环深度的信息聚合到单个流中，从而对应重用前几层的中间表示提供有限的控制。在本文中，我们介绍了 ARLoop，一种基于注意力残差的循环变压器架构，其中每层的输入通过模型深度上的注意力有选择地聚合。与标准 Transformer 不同，我们发现循环 Transformer 不需要访问完整的残差历史：滑动窗口深度注意力在较大的循环深度上匹配或优于全历史注意力。在具有多个参数尺度（140M 和 370M）和循环深度（R = 1 到 5）的受控实验中，ARLoop 始终优于环形变压器的先前残差设计。更重要的是，我们在现实的 LLM 预训练方案下进一步将 ARLoop 参数扩展到 0.6B 和 1.2B，证明增益转移到现实的 pretr

items.title: Beyond Accuracy: What Language-Subspace Interventions Capture, Remove, and Improve
items.excerpt: Language-subspace interventions aim to improve multilingual reasoning by suppressing language-related components in mid-layer activations. Using MATH and MGSM across four open-weight LLMs, we ask three questions: do estimated language subspaces capture translation-associated variation? Does projecting them out remove language information? And do they improve accuracy without compromising response language? For the first question, we build subspaces using the existing Mean-SVD construction and our DiffPCA. Both capture substantial translation-associated variation and show similar patterns across model depth. For the second, we project out each subspace and train linear probes to classify language from the projected activations. The probes still identify language almost perfectly, showing that neither subspace exhaustively captures language information. For the third, we evaluate several intervention configurations on Qwen2.5-7B, by varying subspace creation methods and intervention operators. items.authors: Shaanil Punglia, Dadhichi Telwadkar, Vaibhav Rathore, Siddharth Sureka, Neha Bhargava
items.title_zh: 超越准确性：语言子空间干预捕获、删除和改进哪些内容
items.excerpt_zh: 语言子空间干预旨在通过抑制中间层激活中与语言相关的成分来改善多语言推理。在四个开放权重法学硕士中使用 MATH 和 MGSM，我们提出三个问题：估计的语言子空间是否捕获与翻译相关的变异？将它们投影出来会删除语言信息吗？它们是否可以在不影响响应语言的情况下提高准确性？对于第一个问题，我们使用现有的 Mean-SVD 构造和 DiffPCA 构建子空间。两者都捕获了大量与翻译相关的变化，并在模型深度上显示出相似的模式。对于第二个，我们投影出每个子空间并训练线性探针以根据投影的激活对语言进行分类。探测器仍然几乎完美地识别语言，这表明两个子空间都没有详尽地捕获语言信息。对于第三个，我们通过不同的子空间创建方法和干预算子来评估 Qwen2.5-7B 上的几种干预配置。我们发现，最能提高 MGSM 准确性的干预措施会牺牲反应语言的保真度，只有一种干预措施可以改善联合

items.title: Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
items.excerpt: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. items.authors: Ariana M. Villegas-Suarez, Guido Freire, Sohan Venkatesh, Bartosz Cywi\'nski
items.excerpt_zh: 针对狭窄领域内的有害数据（例如糟糕的医疗建议）微调大型语言模型 (LLM) 可能会使其出现广泛的偏差。这种风险的现实程度尚不清楚，因为在实践中模型很少根据明显有害的数据进行微调。在这项工作中，我们表明，对模型认为是错误的但没有有害内容的数据进行微调也可能导致广泛的偏差。在数学、琐事、烹饪和体育方面，模型越强烈地不相信它所训练的答案，它就会变得越不协调。在数学中，随着训练答案变得更加错误，错位答案从 4% 上升到 60% 以上，而一般能力几乎没有损失。经过微调后，模型给出了错误的答案，但其多项选择概率仍然更倾向于正确的答案，这表明错位来自于这种内部不一致。然后，我们研究一个更现实的环境，其中更新单个事实，如知识编辑或持续学习。同样的关系成立，并且模型在对错误事实进行训练后仍然相信真实事实越多，它就越错位。
items.title_zh: 明知错误：对法学硕士进行违背自己信念的培训可能会导致偏差

items.title: Suppressing Misaligned Behaviors in Language Models, Durably
items.excerpt: Undesired model behaviors can emerge or re-emerge at any stage of training. Once observed, how effectively can we suppress them? To study this question, we first construct two model organisms--language models deliberately trained to exhibit a specific misalignment--that differ in what triggers the behavior. The narrow-trigger organism misbehaves only when the prompt contains a specific cue: it cheats on multiple-choice questions by following a planted hint that points to a wrong answer, and behaves normally otherwise. The broad-trigger organism has no such cue: after fine-tuning on insecure code, it gives harmful responses across a wide range of open-ended prompts. We then formalize post-hoc behavioral suppression and evaluate methods along three criteria: immediate suppression of the target behavior, durability under further training, and preservation of general capability. We compare standard methods--SFT, GRPO, and gradient-ascent unlearning--along these dimensions. Building on prior work on alignment shallowness, we hypothesize that more durable suppression requires the ability to recover from a wider range of misalignment states.
items.authors: Luxi He, Pengcheng Jiang, Jifan Zhang, Jiawei Han, Danqi Chen
items.title_zh: 持久抑制语言模型中的失调行为
items.excerpt_zh: 不需要的模型行为可能在训练的任何阶段出现或重新出现。一旦观察到，我们如何有效地抑制它们？为了研究这个问题，我们首先构建了两种模型生物体——经过刻意训练以表现出特定失调的语言模型——它们在触发行为的因素上有所不同。只有当提示包含特定提示时，窄触发有机体才会行为不当：它通过遵循指向错误答案的植入提示来在多项选择题中作弊，否则行为正常。广泛触发的有机体没有这样的提示：在对不安全的代码进行微调后，它会在各种开放式提示中给出有害的响应。然后，我们将事后行为抑制形式化，并根据三个标准评估方法：立即抑制目标行为、进一步训练下的持久性以及一般能力的保留。我们沿着这些维度比较标准方法——SFT、GRPO 和梯度上升遗忘。基于先前关于对准浅度的工作，我们假设更持久的抑制需要能够从更广泛的未对准状态中恢复。

items.title: Computational Phenomenology of Borderline Personality Disorder: A Comparative Evaluation of LLM-Simulated Expert Personas and Human Clinical Experts
items.excerpt: Building on a human-led thematic analysis of clinical life-story interviews (> 150,000 words) with inpatients with Borderline Personality Disorder, this study examines the capacity of large language models (OpenAI's GPT, Google's Gemini, and Anthropic's Claude) to support qualitative clinical analysis. The models' interpretative potential was evaluated using a mixed-methods approach. Study A involved blinded and non-blinded judges in phenomenology and clinical psychology. The experts assessed the validity of AI-generated content using semantic congruence, Jaccard coefficients, and multidimensional validity ratings, including credibility, coherence, the substantiveness of results, and grounding in qualitative data. In Study B, neural methods were used to embed human- and model-generated theme descriptions in a multidimensional vector space. This approach provided an objectified computational measure of the difference between human and model semantics and linguistic style. items.authors: Marcin Moskalewicz, Anna Sterna, Karolina Dro\.zd\.z, Kacper Dudzic, Marek Pokropski, Paula Flores
items.title_zh: 边缘性人格障碍的计算现象学：法学硕士模拟专家角色和人类临床专家的比较评估
items.excerpt_zh: 这项研究以人类主导的对边缘性人格障碍住院患者的临床生活故事访谈（> 150,000 字）进行主题分析为基础，考察了大型语言模型（OpenAI 的 GPT、Google 的 Gemini 和 Anthropic 的 Claude）支持定性临床分析的能力。使用混合方法评估模型的解释潜力。研究A涉及现象学和临床心理学方面的盲法和非盲法法官。专家们使用语义一致性、杰卡德系数和多维有效性评级来评估人工智能生成内容的有效性，包括可信度、连贯性、结果的实质性和定性数据的基础。在研究 B 中，使用神经方法将人类和模型生成的主题描述嵌入到多维向量空间中。这种方法提供了人类和模型语义和语言风格之间差异的客观化计算测量。在研究 C 中，进行了补充性非专家评估（N=115），以检验主题冗长对人类作者和反面观点的影响。

items.title: Equational theories of min-plus semirings
items.excerpt: We study the equational theory and subvarieties of the variety $\mathcal V$ generated by $(\mathbb N_0,\min,+)$. We prove that a subvariety of $\mathcal V$ is proper if and only if it is locally finite, equivalently, if and only if it satisfies a power-stabilization identity. Every finite member generates a hereditarily finitely based variety with a finite subvariety lattice. In contrast, the periodic subvarieties defined by $x^m=x^{m+1}$ are nonfinitely based for $m\geq2$. We construct a strictly descending chain of nonfinitely based subvarieties and three varieties generated by explicit reduced products, each with a decidable equational theory. The smallest is a limit variety: it is nonfinitely based, and every proper subvariety has an absolute finite identity basis. The subvariety lattice of $\mathcal V$ has cardinality continuum. In fact, the interval between the first reduced-product variety and the subvariety defined by $x^2=x^3$ already has this cardinality, and all its members are nonfinitely based. We also give a hereditarily finitely based example with an infinite subvariety lattice. The constructions use finite convex model
items.title_zh: 最小加半环方程论
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究 $(\mathbb N_0,\min,+)$ 生成的 $\mathcal V$ 变体的方程理论和子变体。我们证明 $\mathcal V$ 的子变体当且仅当它是局部有限的时才是正确的，等效地，当且仅当它满足功率稳定恒等式时。每个有限成员都会生成一个具有有限子品种格的遗传有限品种。相反，$x^m=x^{m+1}$ 定义的周期性子品种非无限地基于 $m\geq2$。我们构造了一个严格下降的非有限基子品种和由显式约简乘积生成的三个品种，每个品种都有一个可判定的方程理论。最小的是极限品种：它是非有限基础的，并且每个真子品种都有绝对有限的同一基础。 $\mathcal V$ 的子类型格具有基数连续统。事实上，第一个缩减产品品种和 $x^2=x^3$ 定义的子品种之间的区间已经具有此基数，并且其所有成员都是非有限基的。我们还给出了一个具有无限子品种格的遗传有限示例。该结构使用有限凸模型

items.title: Friedman--Stanley cofinality without Borel completeness
items.excerpt: Friedman and Stanley asked whether an invariant Borel class of countable structures must be Borel complete whenever every countable level of their hierarchy reduces to it. We construct a counterexample in one fixed countable language. The structural counterexample and its principal supporting results have been formalized in Lean~4 and it is available on github.
items.title_zh: 没有 Borel 完备性的 Friedman--Stanley 共尾性
items.excerpt_zh: 弗里德曼和斯坦利询问，每当其层次结构的每个可数级别都归结为可数结构的不变 Borel 类时，是否一定是 Borel 完备的。我们用一种固定的可数语言构造一个反例。结构反例及其主要支持结果已在 Lean~4 中形式化，并可在 github 上获取。

items.title: A Side Condition Principle With Applications
items.excerpt: We introduce a combinatorial principle $\textsf{SC}(\kappa)$, for any regular cardinal $\kappa \ge \omega_2$, which asserts the existence of a family $\mathcal{Y} \subseteq [H(\kappa)]^\omega$ of elementary substructures of $H(\kappa)$ which is closed under finite intersections and satisfies that for stationarily many $N \in \mathcal{Y}$, if $M \in \mathcal{Y}$ and $M \cap \omega_1 < N \cap \omega_1$, then $M \cap N \cap \kappa \in N$. We explore the idea of defining forcings with side conditions consisting of finite subsets of such a family $\mathcal{Y}$. If $\textsf{SC}(\omega_2)$ holds, then there exists a thin stationary subset of $[\omega_2]^\omega$, and consequently $\textsf{SC}(\omega_2)$ is independent of ZFC. Assuming that $\mu$ is a Mahlo cardinal, the L\'{e}vy collapse $\mathrm{Col}(\omega,<\mu)$ forces that $\textsf{SC}(\kappa)$ holds for all regular cardinals $\kappa \ge \omega_2$. Local instances of $\textsf{SC}$ can be forced using matrices of models or derived as consequences of square principles. We apply the principle $\textsf{SC}$ to define two kinds of forcings: a streamlined version of a strongly proper collapse,
items.excerpt_zh: 我们引入组合原理 $\textsf{SC}(\kappa)$，对于任何正则基数 $\kappa \ge \omega_2$，它断言 $H(\kappa)$ 的基本子结构族 $\mathcal{Y} \subseteq [H(\kappa)]^\omega$ 的存在，该族在有限交集下闭合，并满足平稳多个 $N \in \mathcal{Y}$，如果 $M \in \mathcal{Y}$ 且 $M \cap \omega_1 < N \cap \omega_1$，则 $M \cap N \cap \kappa \in N$。我们探索用由这样一个族 $\mathcal{Y}$ 的有限子集组成的附加条件来定义强迫的想法。如果 $\textsf{SC}(\omega_2)$ 成立，则存在 $[\omega_2]^\omega$ 的薄平稳子集，因此 $\textsf{SC}(\omega_2)$ 独立于 ZFC。假设 $\mu$ 是 Mahlo 基数，则 L\'{e}vy 折叠 $\mathrm{Col}(\omega,<\mu)$ 强制 $\textsf{SC}(\kappa)$ 对所有常规基数 $\kappa \ge \omega_2$ 成立。 $\textsf{SC}$ 的局部实例可以使用模型矩阵强制或作为平方原理的结果导出。我们应用 $\textsf{SC}$ 原则来定义两种强制：强适当崩溃的简化版本，
items.title_zh: 附带条件原理及其应用

items.title: Iterating logarithms and well-foundedness
items.excerpt: We prove that there is no sequence $\{ X_n \}_{n\in\omega}$ such that for all $n$, there is an injection from $\mathcal{P}(X_{n+1})$ to $X_n$ under a restricted set of axioms that conforms to the "working mathematician's" intuition (excluding Choice, Replacement, and Foundation). We also show such a sequence cannot be defined using a formula either. More precisely, it is inconsistent with Zermelo set theory minus Infinity to have a formula $\Phi(\cdot,\cdot)$ such that for each $n\in\omega$ there are $X$ and $Y$ with $\Phi(n,X)$, $\Phi(n+1,Y)$, and $\mathcal{P}(Y)$ being injectable into $X$. We finally show that the theorem fails if we allow infinitely many definitions, one for each term of the sequence, by using Hamkins, Linetsky, and Reitz's pointwise definable extensions of countable models of ZFC.
items.authors: Gervasio Figueroa, Joel Kuperman, Pedro S\'anchez Terraf
items.title_zh: 迭代对数和有根据性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明不存在序列$\{ X_n \}_{n\in\omega}$，使得对于所有$n$，在一组符合“工作数学家”直觉的受限公理下存在从$\mathcal{P}(X_{n+1})$到$X_n$的注入（不包括选择、替换和基础）。我们还表明这样的序列也不能使用公式来定义。更准确地说，有一个公式 $\Phi(\cdot,\cdot)$ 使得对于每个 $n\in\omega$ 都有 $X$ 和 $Y$，其中 $\Phi(n,X)$、$\Phi(n+1,Y)$ 和 $\mathcal{P}(Y)$ 可注入到 $X$ 中，这与 Zermelo 集合论减去无穷大是不一致​​的。最后，我们通过使用 Hamkins、Linetsky 和 ​​Reitz 的 ZFC 可数模型的逐点可定义扩展，证明如果我们允许无限多个定义（序列的每一项都有一个定义），则该定理将失败。

items.title: Large cardinals, small violations of choice
items.excerpt: We study the relationship between large cardinals and Blass' Small Violation of Choice ($\mathsf{SVC}$), which states that the Axiom of Choice holds in a set-generic extension of the universe. Our main theorem is that in the presence of a supercompact cardinal, either the Axiom of Choice fails significantly, or else $\mathsf{SVC}$ holds in $L(\mathcal P(\mathrm{Ord}))$. We show that a supercompact is not strong enough to reflect $\mathsf{SVC}$, while an extendible cardinal is. If we assume Usuba's Lo\'s Property holds for the supercompact, then we can outright derive $\mathsf{SVC}$ in the universe.
items.authors: Hope Duncan, Gabriel Goldberg, Asaf Karagila
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究大基数和 Blass 的小违反选择 ($\mathsf{SVC}$) 之间的关系，该违反选择公理指出选择公理在宇宙的集合泛型扩展中成立。我们的主要定理是，在存在超紧基数的情况下，要么选择公理显着失效，要么 $\mathsf{SVC}$ 在 $L(\mathcal P(\mathrm{Ord}))$ 中成立。我们表明，超紧凑的强度不足以反映 $\mathsf{SVC}$，而可扩展的基数则足够。如果我们假设 Usuba 的 Lo 性质对于超紧来说成立，那么我们可以直接导出宇宙中的 $\mathsf{SVC}$ 。
items.title_zh: 大基数，小违规选择

items.title: The P-Ideal Dichotomy and the Failure of Two-Cardinal Square Principles
items.excerpt: We prove that the $\mathrm{P}$-ideal dichotomy implies the negation of the square principle $\square(\lambda, \omega)$ for every regular cardinal $\lambda\geq\omega_2$.
items.title_zh: P-理想二分法和二基数平方原理的失败
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明 $\mathrm{P}$ 理想二分法意味着对于每个正则基数 $\lambda\geq\omega_2$ 都否定平方原理 $\square(\lambda, \omega)$。

items.title: Geometric classification of imaginaries in pseudofinite fields
items.excerpt: In [Pil07], Pillay showed that every imaginary in a proper pair of algebraically closed fields is interalgebraic with an imaginary of a certain algebraic form. In this paper, we establish an analogue for lovely pairs of pseudofinite fields. After naming countably many constants, we prove that every imaginary in lovely pairs of pseudofinite fields is interalgebraic with an imaginary of the same algebraic form as [Pil07] in the corresponding pairs of finite extensions of pseudofinite fields.
items.title_zh: 伪有限域中虚数的几何分类
items.excerpt_zh: 在 [Pil07] 中，Pillay 证明了一对真代数闭域中的每个虚数都是具有某种代数形式的虚数的代数。在本文中，我们为可爱的伪有限域对建立了一个类比。在命名了可数个常数之后，我们证明可爱的伪有限域对中的每个虚数都是代数的，其代数形式与相应的伪有限域有限扩展对中的[Pil07]相同。

items.title: Hereditarily Lindel\"of and hereditarily separable subspaces of function spaces
items.excerpt: A space is ESLC if it contains neither an $S$-space nor an $L$-space, and NFS is the class of spaces containing no free sequences of length $\omega_1$. We prove that under $\mathrm{MA}(\omega_1)$, if all finite powers of $X$ belong to NFS, then $C_p(X)^\omega$ is ESLC; thus, for subspaces of $C_p(X)$, hereditary Lindel\"ofness, hereditary separability and countable spread coincide. This is derived from a dual form of a theorem of Todor\v{c}evi\'c. A Lindel\"of $\Sigma$-space belongs to NFS if and only if its compact subspaces have countable tightness. Hence $C_p(X)$ contains no $L$-spaces if $X$ is a Lindel\"of $\Sigma$-space of countable tightness and $\mathrm{MA}(\omega_1)$ holds, or if $X$ is any Lindel\"of $\Sigma$-space and PFA holds. Under $\mathrm{MA}(\omega_1)$, all iterated function spaces of Corson compact spaces are ESLC, and in ZFC the space $C_p(X,\{0,1\})$ is ESLC for every zero-dimensional Corson compact space $X$.
items.excerpt_zh: 如果一个空间既不包含 $S$ 空间也不包含 $L$ 空间，则该空间是 ESLC，并且 NFS 是不包含长度为 $\omega_1$ 的自由序列的空间类。我们证明在$\mathrm{MA}(\omega_1)$下，如果$X$的所有有限幂都属于NFS，则$C_p(X)^\omega$是ESLC；因此，对于 $C_p(X)$ 子空间，遗传 Lindel 性、遗传可分性和可数分布是一致的。这是从 Todor\v{c}evi\'c 定理的对偶形式导出的。$\Sigma$ 空间的 Lindel 空间属于 NFS 当且仅当其紧致子空间具有可数紧度。因此，如果 $X$ 是可数紧性的 $\Sigma$ 空间的 Lindel 且 $\mathrm{MA}(\omega_1)$ 成立，或者如果 $X$ 是 $\Sigma$ 空间的任何 Lindel 且 PFA 成立，则 $C_p(X)$ 不包含 $L$ 空间。在 $\mathrm{MA}(\omega_1)$ 下，Corson 紧致空间的所有迭代函数空间都是 ESLC，而在 ZFC 中，对于每个零维 Corson 紧致空间 $X$，空间 $C_p(X,\{0,1\})$ 都是 ESLC。

items.title: Keeping Mathematical Conferences Human
items.excerpt: As AI makes it increasingly easy to produce polished mathematical papers, slides, and explanations, conferences may have an opportunity to become more interactive and more human. I suggest experimenting with conversational talk formats, where chairs and audiences can ask questions throughout, encouraging discussion, clarification, and a deeper shared understanding of mathematics.
items.title_zh: 保持数学会议人性化
items.excerpt_zh: 随着人工智能使制作精美的数学论文、幻灯片和解释变得越来越容易，会议可能有机会变得更具互动性和更加人性化。我建议尝试对话式演讲形式，主席和观众可以自始至终提出问题，鼓励讨论、澄清和对数学更深入的共同理解。

items.title: Slow Maths
items.excerpt: For a long time, I had the ideal job. As a teacher, I passed on not just mathematics, but also the taste for critical thinking, for confrontation, and the joy of discovery.
items.title_zh: 慢速数学

items.title: Bermond's lobster conjecture for lobsters of maximum degree three
items.excerpt: Proved · Graph theory, graceful labelings of trees · with GPT-6 Astra (discovery), Codex (formalization) · significance 15/100. Bermond (1979) conjectured that every lobster is graceful. A lobster is a finite tree in which every vertex lies within distance two of a single path. A tree on n vertices is graceful if its vertices can be labelled with the distinct integers 0,1,\dots,n-1 so that the n-1 edge differences |f(u)-f(v)| are exactly 1,2,\dots,n-1. Is every lobster graceful?
items.title_zh: 最大三级龙虾的伯蒙德龙虾猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 已证明 · 图论、树木的优雅标签 · 使用 GPT-6 Astra（发现）、Codex（形式化） · 重要性 15/100。 Bermond (1979) 推测每只龙虾都是优雅的。龙虾是一棵有限树，其中每个顶点都位于单个路径的距离 2 内。如果一个有 n 个顶点的树的顶点可以用不同的整数 0,1,\dots,n-1 来标记，那么 n-1 个边差 |f(u)-f(v)| 就是优雅的。正好是 1,2,\dots,n-1。每只龙虾都是优雅的吗？

items.title: Cuspidal sheaves on the stack of L-parameters
items.excerpt: We introduce the notion of cuspidal coherent sheaves on the moduli stack of local L-parameters. We give a complete classification and relate them to Lusztig's cuspidal local systems (or character sheaves). Under the categorical local Langlands conjecture, these sheaves are expected to correspond to supercuspidal representations supported at basic points. We also construct semiorthogonal decompositions of the category of coherent sheaves on the moduli stack of L-parameters that conjecturally match the semiorthogonal decompositions of sheaves on $\mathrm{Bun}_G$ coming from the stratification by the Kottwitz set and Bernstein decomposition of representation categories.
items.title_zh: L 参数堆栈上的尖滑轮
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在局部 L 参数的模堆栈上引入了尖头相干滑轮的概念。我们给出了完整的分类，并将它们与 Lusztig 的尖头局部系统（或字符滑轮）联系起来。根据绝对局部朗兰兹猜想，这些滑轮预计对应于基本点支持的超尖峰表示。我们还在 L 参数模堆栈上构造相干滑轮类别的半正交分解，推测与来自 Kottwitz 集分层和表示类别的 Bernstein 分解的 $\mathrm{Bun}_G$ 上滑轮的半正交分解相匹配。

items.title: Porosity in Diophantine approximation
