items.title: On the Distribution of Prime Squares and Its Applications
items.excerpt: We prove that, for every \(A>0\), all but \(O_A(X(\log X)^{-A})\) integers \(n<X\) satisfying \(n\equiv11\pmod{24}\) admit a representation \[ n=a^2+b^2+p^2, \] where \(p\) and \(a^2+b^2+1\) are prime and \((a,b)=1\). For ergodic averages along prime squares, we prove a universal divergence result for integrable functions, while establishing almost-everywhere convergence for near-integrable functions. We also quantify how the bounds used to establish convergence behave as one approaches integrability. Moreover, we prove endpoint improving and sparse bounds for the corresponding discrete averages, with an explicit Orlicz loss.
items.title_zh: 论素数平方的分布及其应用
items.excerpt_zh: We prove that, for every \(A>0\), all but \(O_A(X(\log X)^{-A})\) integers \(n<X\) satisfying \(n\equiv11\pmod{24}\) admit a representation \[ n=a^2+b^2+p^2, \] where \(p\) and \(a^2+b^2+1\) are prime and \((a,b)=1\).对于沿素数平方的遍历平均值，我们证明了可积函数的通用散度结果，同时为近可积函数建立了几乎处处收敛。我们还量化了当人们接近可积性时，用于建立收敛的界限如何表现。此外，我们还证明了相应离散平均值的端点改进和稀疏边界，并具有显式 Orlicz 损失。

items.title: A power-saving asymptotic for a M\"obius-weighted GCD quadratic form
items.excerpt: For the M\"obius-weighted quadratic form $T(N)=\sum_{m,n\leq N}\mu(m)\mu(n)(m,n)^2/(mn)$, we prove that $T(N)=cN+O_{\varepsilon}(N^{2/3+\varepsilon})$ for every $\varepsilon>0$, where $c>0$ is given by an absolutely convergent series of finite M\"obius sums multiplied by a convergent Euler product. The proof combines the classical Jordan-totient decomposition of the GCD kernel with a mean-value estimate that is uniform in a coprimality parameter. Grouping the resulting squares according to $\lfloor N/d\rfloor$ gives the error term and a nonnegative series for $c$.
items.title_zh: M\"obius加权GCD二次型的节能渐进式
items.excerpt_zh: For the M\"obius-weighted quadratic form $T(N)=\sum_{m,n\leq N}\mu(m)\mu(n)(m,n)^2/(mn)$, we prove that $T(N)=cN+O_{\varepsilon}(N^{2/3+\varepsilon})$ for every $\varepsilon>0$, where $c>0$ is given by an absolutely有限 M\"obius 和乘以收敛欧拉积的收敛级数。 The proof combines the classical Jordan-totient decomposition of the GCD kernel with a mean-value estimate that is uniform in a coprimality parameter.根据 $\lfloor N/d\rfloor$ 对结果平方进行分组，给出误差项和 $c$ 的非负级数。

items.title: The distribution of $\alpha\pi$ modulo one in $\Fq(T)$: beyond Matom\"aki's exponent
items.excerpt: Let $\alpha$ be an element of $\Fq((1/T))$ which is not in $\Fq(T)$. We ask how small $\nrm{\alpha\pi}$ can be made when $\pi$ runs over irreducible polynomials, and write $\theta(\alpha)$ for the largest exponent $\theta$ such that $\nrm{\alpha\pi}<|\pi|^{-\theta}$ has infinitely many solutions. The analogue of Matom\"aki's exponent, $\theta(\alpha)\ge\frac13$, was proved by Baier and the author, and it is the natural limit of the Riemann Hypothesis. In this paper we go beyond it. For odd characteristic $p$ and $q$ large in terms of $p$ and $\theta$, we prove that $\theta(\alpha)\ge\theta$ for every $\alpha$ and every $\theta<\sqrt2-1=0.414\ldots$, and for every $\theta<\frac12$ when $\alpha$ has bounded partial quotients. The main tools are an exact count of points in affine subspaces of $\Fq[T]$, a splitting of these subspaces into long arithmetic progressions, and the results of Sawin and Shusterman on the M\"obius function along such progressions.
items.title_zh: $\alpha\pi$ 在 $\Fq(T)$ 中模一的分布：超出 Matom\"aki 的指数
items.excerpt_zh: 设$\alpha$为$\Fq((1/T))$中不在$\Fq(T)$中的元素。 We ask how small $\nrm{\alpha\pi}$ can be made when $\pi$ runs over irreducible polynomials, and write $\theta(\alpha)$ for the largest exponent $\theta$ such that $\nrm{\alpha\pi}<|\pi|^{-\theta}$ has infinitely many solutions. Matom\"aki 指数 $\theta(\alpha)\ge\frac13$ 的类比已被 Baier 和作者证明，它是黎曼猜想的自然极限。本文我们超越它。对于 $p$ 和 $\theta$ 而言较大的奇数特征 $p$ 和 $q$，我们证明 $\theta(\alpha)\ge\theta$ 对于每个 $\alpha$ 和每个 $\theta<\sqrt2-1=0.414\ldots$, and for every $\theta<\frac12$ when $\alpha$ has bounded partial quotients. The main tools are an exact count of points in affine subspaces of $\Fq[T]$, a splitting of these subspaces into long arithmetic progressions, and the results of Sawin and Shusterman on the M\"obius function along such progressions.

items.title: Cyclotomic polynomials with trinomial irreducible factors over finite fields
items.excerpt: We classify the pairs $(q,n)$, where $q$ is a prime power, $n>1$, and $\gcd(n,q)=1$, for which every irreducible factor of $\Phi_n(x)$ over $\F_q$ has exactly three nonzero terms. The positive support exponents of these factors have a common greatest common divisor, which gives a unique reduction by a power substitution. The reduced degree is two in odd characteristic and belongs to $\{2,3,4\}$ in characteristic two; the cubic and quartic cases arise by scalar substitution from the layers of orders $7$ and $15$. This yields necessary and sufficient arithmetic conditions on $(q,n)$ and explicit factorizations. Among the classified families, precisely those arising from quartic bases have a divisor layer containing an irreducible factor with more than three terms.
items.title_zh: 有限域上具有三项不可约因子的分圆多项式
items.excerpt_zh: 我们对$(q,n)$对进行分类，其中$q$是素数幂，$n>1$，并且$\gcd(n,q)=1$，$\Phi_n(x)$在$\F_q$上的每个不可约因子都恰好有三个非零项。这些因素的正支持指数有一个共同的最大公约数，它通过幂替换给出了独特的减少。奇数特征中减少的程度为二，属于特征二中的$\{2,3,4\}$；三次和四次情况是通过 $7$ 和 $15$ 阶数层的标量替换产生的。这产生了 $(q,n)$ 和显式因式分解的必要且充分的算术条件。在分类族中，正是那些由四次基产生的族具有除数层，其中包含超过三项的不可约因子。

items.title: On Certain Congruences for Partition $k$-Tuples with $5$-Cores
items.excerpt: Let $A_{t,k}(n)$ denote the number of partition $k$-tuples of $n$ with $t$-cores. Using fifth-order modular equations and the Atkin $U_5$-operator, we prove the congruences $A_{5,125i+21}(25n+r)\equiv 0 \pmod{5^3}$ for $r\in\{9,14,19,24\}$, $A_{5,125i+41}(25n+r)\equiv 0 \pmod{5^3}$ for $r\in\{19,24\}$, and $A_{5,125i+111}(125n+r)\equiv 0 \pmod{5^4}$ for $r\in\{39,64,89,114\}$, which were stated by Tang \cite{tang2025iterative}.
items.title_zh: 关于分区 $k$-元组与 $5$-核心的某些同余
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $A_{t,k}(n)$ 表示具有 $t$ 个核心的 $n$ 的分区 $k$ 元组的数量。 Using fifth-order modular equations and the Atkin $U_5$-operator, we prove the congruences $A_{5,125i+21}(25n+r)\equiv 0 \pmod{5^3}$ for $r\in\{9,14,19,24\}$, $A_{5,125i+41}(25n+r)\equiv 0 $r\in\{19,24\}$ 的 \pmod{5^3}$ 和 $A_{5,125i+111}(125n+r)\equiv 0 \pmod{5^4}$ 对于 $r\in\{39,64,89,114\}$，由 Tang \cite{tang2025iterative} 陈述。

items.title: Partition statistics and universal mixed mock modular forms
items.excerpt: In this note, we construct combinatorial statistics in terms of partitions, overpartitions, and two-color partitions and relate the corresponding generating functions to the universal mock theta functions. Our framework primarily builds on two $q$-series identities of Fine.
items.title_zh: 分区统计和通用混合模拟模块化形式
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们根据分区、过度分区和双色分区构建组合统计，并将相应的生成函数与通用模拟 theta 函数相关联。 Our framework primarily builds on two $q$-series identities of Fine.

items.title: Graphs with three distinct distance eigenvalues, one of which is zero
items.excerpt: Koolen, Hayat and Iqbal asked for the connected graphs whose distance matrix has exactly three distinct eigenvalues, the middle one being $0$. The examples they gave, namely the Johnson graphs, the Hamming graphs and the halved cubes, are distance-regular. In this note, we show that the distance spectrum of such a graph is $\{\rho,0,-c\}$ with integers $c\ge2$ and $c\mid\rho$. For $c=2$ the graphs are exactly the cocktail party graphs, and for $c=3$ they are exactly the Cartesian product $K_3\,\square\,K_3$ of two triangles, the Petersen graph and its complement. We also show that such a graph need not be transmission-regular: Seidel switching the lattice graph $K_6\,\square\,K_6$ with respect to a line and the triangular graph $T(11)$ with respect to a maximal clique of size $10$ gives graphs on $36$ and $55$ vertices with distance spectra $\{54,0^{(26)},(-6)^{(9)}\}$ and $\{81,0^{(45)},(-9)^{(9)}\}$. Among the graphs of diameter $2$ obtained by switching a strongly regular graph with smallest eigenvalue $-2$ with respect to one part of an equitable partition, these two are the only ones that have exactly three distance eigenvalues a
items.title_zh: 具有三个不同距离特征值的图，其中一个为零
items.excerpt_zh: Koolen, Hayat and Iqbal asked for the connected graphs whose distance matrix has exactly three distinct eigenvalues, the middle one being $0$. The examples they gave, namely the Johnson graphs, the Hamming graphs and the halved cubes, are distance-regular. In this note, we show that the distance spectrum of such a graph is $\{\rho,0,-c\}$ with integers $c\ge2$ and $c\mid\rho$.对于 $c=2$，这些图正是鸡尾酒会图，而对于 $c=3$，它们恰好是两个三角形的笛卡尔积 $K_3\,\square\,K_3$、彼得森图及其补集。我们还表明，这样的图不必是传输正则的：Seidel 相对于一条线切换晶格图 $K_6\,\square\,K_6$ 以及相对于大小 $10$ 的最大团切换三角图 $T(11)$ 给出在 $36$ 和 $55$ 顶点上的图，其距离谱为 $\{54,0^{(26)},(-6)^{(9)}\}$ 和$\{81,0^{(45)},(-9)^{(9)}\}$。在通过相对于公平划分的一部分切换具有最小特征值 $-2$ 的强正则图而获得的直径为 $2$ 的图中，这两个是唯一具有恰好三个距离特征值 a 的图。

items.title: Hopf Algebra of Graphs for Operator Splitting Methods
items.excerpt: Motivated by combinatorial identities arising in the study of operator splitting methods and their description in terms of bipartite rooted trees, we establish a connection between operator splitting methods and the theory of combinatorial Hopf algebras. We show that the inclusion-exclusion expansion of the elementary weight of a rooted tree over its rooted subforests can be interpreted as the antipode of Schmitt's Hopf algebra of graphs. This interpretation recovers known identities for operator splitting and partitioned Runge-Kutta methods from general properties of the antipode. We further show that adjoint operator splitting methods can be described algebraically through the antipode and the canonical involution of the original method. The resulting framework also yields new combinatorial identities and connects the analysis of geometric numerical integrators with the theory of incidence Hopf algebras.
items.title_zh: 算子分裂方法图的 Hopf 代数
items.excerpt_zh: 受算子分裂方法及其用二分根树描述的研究中出现的组合恒等式的启发，我们在算子分裂方法和组合 Hopf 代数理论之间建立了联系。我们证明，有根树的基本权重在其有根子森林上的包含-排除扩展可以解释为图的施密特霍普夫代数的对映体。这种解释从对映体的一般属性中恢复算子分裂和分区龙格-库塔方法的已知身份。我们进一步表明，伴随算子分裂方法可以通过对映点和原始方法的规范对合进行代数描述。由此产生的框架还产生了新的组合恒等式，并将几何数值积分器的分析与关联 Hopf 代数理论联系起来。

items.title: The sum of sizes of nontrivial cross-intersecting families
items.excerpt: Families $\mathcal A_1,\ldots,\mathcal A_m\subseteq\binom{[n]}k$ are cross-intersecting if every member of one family meets every member of each other family. A family is nontrivial if its members have no common element. For $n>2k$ and $m\ge3$, we determine the maximum sum of the sizes of $m$ nonempty, nontrivial cross-intersecting families. We prove the sharp bound \[ \sum_{i=1}^{m}|\mathcal A_i| \le \max\bigl\{m\,h(n,k,1),\ g(n,k)+3(m-1)\bigr\}, \] where \[ h(n,k,1)=\binom{n-1}{k-1}-\binom{n-k-1}{k-1}+1 \] and \[ g(n,k)=\binom nk-2\binom{n-k}k -\binom{n-k-1}{k-1}+\binom{n-2k+1}k. \] We also characterize all equality cases. Two types of extremal configurations arise: copies of a maximum nontrivial intersecting family, and copies of a specific three-member nontrivial intersecting family together with its full cross-intersecting companion. The proof applies a known restricted lexicographic comparison to obtain the weighted bound for shifted families, and uses local generator reductions for critically shifted families. These reductions exploit shiftedness after removing the common core of a section, while preserving nontriviality and th
items.title_zh: 非平凡交叉族的大小总和
items.excerpt_zh: 如果一个族的每个成员都与其他族的每个成员相遇，则族 $\mathcal A_1,\ldots,\mathcal A_m\subseteq\binom{[n]}k$ 是交叉相交的。如果一个家庭的成员没有共同元素，那么这个家庭就是不平凡的。对于 $n>2k$ 和 $m\ge3$，我们确定 $m$ 个非空、非平凡交叉族的大小的最大总和。我们证明锐界 \[ \sum_{i=1}^{m}|\mathcal A_i| \le \max\bigl\{m\,h(n,k,1),\ g(n,k)+3(m-1)\bigr\}, \] 其中 \[ h(n,k,1)=\binom{n-1}{k-1}-\binom{n-k-1}{k-1}+1 \] 和 \[ g(n,k)=\binom nk-2\binom{n-k}k -\binom{n-k-1}{k-1}+\binom{n-2k+1}k。 \] 我们还描述了所有平等案例的特征。出现两种类型的极值配置：最大非平凡相交族的副本，以及特定三成员非平凡相交族及其完全交叉相交族的副本。该证明应用已知的受限词典比较来获得移位族的加权界限，并对关键移位族使用局部生成器约简。这些减少利用了删除部分的共同核心后的转移性，同时保留了非平凡性和真实性。

items.title: Large Maximal Intersecting Families with Covering Number Three
items.excerpt: Let $n>2k$ and $k\ge4$. The largest size of an intersecting family of $k$-subsets of $[n]$ with covering number at least three is \[ g_1(n,k)=\binom{n-1}{k-1}-3\binom{n-k-1}{k-1}+\binom{n-k-2}{k-1}+\binom{n-2k}{k-1}+3, \] attained by a unique family up to isomorphism. We prove that every other maximal intersecting family $\mathcal F$ with covering number three satisfies \[ |\mathcal F|\le M(n,k)=\max\{q(n,k),g_2(n,k)\}, \] where \begin{align*} q(n,k)&=\binom{n-1}{k-1}-3\binom{n-k-1}{k-1}+\binom{n-k-3}{k-1}+\binom{n-2k+1}{k-1}+3,\\ g_2(n,k)&=g_1(n,k)-\binom{n-k-3}{k-3}+1. \end{align*} This bound is attained for every $n>2k$ and $k\ge4$, so $M(n,k)$ is the second largest distinct size. For $k=4$, $g_1(n,4)=13n-69$ and $M(n,4)=12n-61$. For $k\ge5$, we have $M(n,k)=q(n,k)$ when $2k<n\le3k-2$ and $M(n,k)=g_2(n,k)$ when $n\ge3k-2$; the two terms coincide only at $n=3k-2$. We also classify all families attaining $M(n,k)$ that admit a critically shifted labeling, including additional nonisomorphic families at $n=2k+1$. The proof combines local replacements with an inverse-shift estimate and gives a new proof of the known maximum and its uniqu
items.title_zh: 覆盖数为 3 的大型最大相交族
items.excerpt_zh: Let $n>2k$ and $k\ge4$. $[n]$ 的 $k$-子集的相交族的最大尺寸为 \[ g_1(n,k)=\binom{n-1}{k-1}-3\binom{n-k-1}{k-1}+\binom{n-k-2}{k-1}+\binom{n-2k}{k-1}+3, \] 通过同构的唯一族获得。我们证明每个其他最大相交族 $\mathcal F$ 覆盖数字 3 满足 \[ |\mathcal F|\le M(n,k)=\max\{q(n,k),g_2(n,k)\}, \] 其中 \begin{align*} q(n,k)&=\binom{n-1}{k-1}-3\binom{n-k-1}{k-1}+\binom{n-k-3}{k-1}+\binom{n-2k+1}{k-1}+3,\\ g_2(n,k)&=g_1(n,k)-\binom{n-k-3}{k-3}+1。 \end{align*} 每个 $n>2k$ 和 $k\ge4$ 都会达到此界限，因此 $M(n,k)$ 是第二大的不同大小。对于 $k=4$，$g_1(n,4)=13n-69$ 和 $M(n,4)=12n-61$。对于$k\ge5$，当$2k<n\le3k-2$时，我们有$M(n,k)=q(n,k)$；当$n\ge3k-2$时，我们有$M(n,k)=g_2(n,k)$； the two terms coincide only at $n=3k-2$.我们还对所有达到 $M(n,k)$ 且承认关键转移标签的家族进行分类，包括 $n=2k+1$ 处的其他非同构家族。该证明将局部替换与逆移估计相结合，并给出了已知最大值及其唯一的新证明。

items.title: The Dilate Rollercoaster
items.excerpt: Given a finite subset $A\subseteq\mathbb{Z}$ and a multiset of non-zero integers $\Lambda=\{\lambda_1, \ldots, \lambda_k\}$, the dilate sum \[\Lambda\cdot A:=\lambda_1\cdot A+\lambda_2\cdot A+\cdots+\lambda_k\cdot A =\{\lambda_1a_1+\cdots+\lambda_ka_k: a_1, \ldots, a_k\in A\}.\] For a non-zero real number $r$, say that $\Lambda_2$ $r$-dominates $\Lambda_1$ if we can partition some of the elements of $\Lambda_2$ into blocks summing to the elements of $r\cdot\Lambda_1$. Then for all finite subsets $A\subseteq\mathbb{Z}$, $\Lambda_2\cdot A$ contains a translate of $r\cdot(\Lambda_1\cdot A)$, and hence $|\Lambda_1\cdot A|\le|\Lambda_2\cdot A|$ for all $A$. In a recent paper, Kravitz (arXiv:2606.27087) proves the converse: if $\Lambda_2$ does not $r$-dominate $\Lambda_1$ for any $r$, then there exists a finite set $A$ satisfying $|\Lambda_1\cdot A|>|\Lambda_2\cdot A|$. For example, $\{2, 3, 5, 7\}$ does not contain two disjoint subsets with a sum ratio of 7, and so there exists a finite $A\subseteq\mathbb{Z}$ for which $|A+7\cdot A|>|2\cdot A+3\cdot A+5\cdot A+7\cdot A|$. We extend Kravitz's method to apply it to multiple inequalities and
items.title_zh: 扩张过山车
items.excerpt_zh: 给定有限子集 $A\subseteq\mathbb{Z}$ 和非零整数多重集 $\Lambda=\{\lambda_1, \ldots, \lambda_k\}$，膨胀和 \[\Lambda\cdot A:=\lambda_1\cdot A+\lambda_2\cdot A+\cdots+\lambda_k\cdot A =\{\lambda_1a_1+\cdots+\lambda_ka_k: a_1, \ldots, a_k\in A\}.\] 对于非零实数 $r$，如果我们可以将 $\Lambda_2$ 的一些元素划分为与 $r\cdot\Lambda_1$ 的元素相加的块，则称 $\Lambda_2$ $r$-支配 $\Lambda_1$。那么对于所有有限子集 $A\subseteq\mathbb{Z}$，$\Lambda_2\cdot A$ 包含 $r\cdot(\Lambda_1\cdot A)$ 的翻译，因此 $|\Lambda_1\cdot A|\le|\Lambda_2\cdot A|$ 对于所有 $A$ 都是如此。在最近的一篇论文中，Kravitz (arXiv:2606.27087) 证明了相反的情况：如果对于任何 $r$，$\Lambda_2$ 不以 $r$ 支配 $\Lambda_1$，则存在满足 $|\Lambda_1\cdot A|>|\Lambda_2\cdot A|$ 的有限集 $A$。例如，$\{2, 3, 5, 7\}$ 不包含总和为 7 的两个不相交子集，因此存在有限 $A\subseteq\mathbb{Z}$，其中 $|A+7\cdot A|>|2\cdot A+3\cdot A+5\cdot A+7\cdot A|$。我们扩展了克拉维茨的方法，将其应用于多重不等式，

items.title: Quasi-polynomial valuations of lattice polytopes
items.excerpt: We prove that for any valuation $\varphi$ of lattice polytopes in ${\mathbb R}^m$, which is quasi-polynomial with respect to ${\mathbb Z}^m$-translations, and any lattice polytope $P$, the function $\varphi(nP)$ is quasi-polynomial in $n$.
items.title_zh: 晶格多面体的拟多项式估值
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，对于 ${\mathbb R}^m$ 中格子多面体的任何估值 $\varphi$（相对于 ${\mathbb Z}^m$ 平移而言是拟多项式），以及任何格子多面体 $P$，函数 $\varphi(nP)$ 是 $n$ 中的拟多项式。

items.title: Excedances and Deficiencies of Integer Partitions
items.excerpt: The notion of a fixed point, applied by Blecher and Knopfmacher to integer partitions, can be considered as a permutation statistic. Here we apply two related permutation statistics, excedance and deficiency, to integer partitions. Using analytic and combinatorial techniques, we establish several generating functions and make connections to partition concepts including Dyson's crank statistic, overpartitions, and the Rogers--Ramanujan partitions.
items.title_zh: 整数分区的超出和不足
items.excerpt_zh: Blecher 和 Knopfmacher 将不动点的概念应用于整数分区，可以将其视为排列统计量。在这里，我们将两个相关的排列统计量（超出和不足）应用于整数分区。使用分析和组合技术，我们建立了几个生成函数并与分区概念建立了联系，包括戴森曲柄统计、过度分区和 Rogers-Ramanujan 分区。

items.title: Two-point concentration for graph classes admitting sparse vertex deletion
items.excerpt: For fixed $p\in(0,1)$, we prove that the maximum number of vertices in an induced subgraph of $G(n,p)$ from a given class is concentrated on two consecutive integers, unifying and extending several earlier results. We require that the class contain arbitrarily large graphs and that every sufficiently large $k$-vertex member have a vertex of degree $o(k)$ whose deletion leaves a graph in the same class. This condition holds for empty graphs, trees, forests, planar graphs, graphs of bounded maximum degree, degeneracy or treewidth, graphs excluding a fixed complete bipartite subgraph (including graphs containing no cycle of length four), and many other graph classes.
items.title_zh: 允许稀疏顶点删除的图类的两点集中
items.excerpt_zh: 对于固定的 $p\in(0,1)$，我们证明给定类的 $G(n,p)$ 的导出子图中的最大顶点数集中在两个连续的整数上，统一并扩展了几个早期的结果。我们要求该类包含任意大的图，并且每个足够大的 $k$ 顶点成员都有一个度数为 $o(k)$ 的顶点，删除该顶点会在同一类中留下一个图。此条件适用于空图、树、森林、平面图、有界最大度图、简并性或树宽、不包括固定完全二分子图的图（包括不包含长度为 4 的循环的图）以及许多其他图类。

items.title: On potential density of rational points on hyperkahler varieties
items.excerpt: In this paper, we prove that the rational points on hyperk\"ahler varieties in each of the four known deformation families admitting a rational Lagrangian fibration are potentially dense. Furthermore, we give several applications and construct examples of hyperk\"ahler varieties beyond these families satisfying the potential density property. Our approach is first to prove that rational points on hyperk\"ahler varieties admitting two rational Lagrangian fibrations with distinct associated isotropic rays are potentially dense. We then construct a projective Shafarevich--Tate twist admitting two such fibrations, together with a dominant rational map from the twist to the original variety.
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们证明了承认有理拉格朗日纤维的四个已知变形族中每个超k“ahler簇的有理点都是潜在稠密的。此外，我们给出了一些应用并构造了超出这些满足潜在密度性质的族的hyperk“ahler簇的例子。我们的方法首先证明超k\“ahler簇上允许两个有理拉格朗日纤维与不同相关各向同性射线的有理点可能是稠密的。然后我们构造一个允许两个这样的纤维的射影Shafarevich-Tate扭曲，以及从扭曲到原始簇的主导理性图。
items.title_zh: 关于超卡勒簇上有理点的潜在密度

items.title: Stable compatibility for model categories
items.excerpt: By introducing the notion of stable compatibility, we provide a framework in the model category theory which addresses the existence of a stable model structure on the category of modules over a monad. Exact version of such monads have been studied in the setting of triangulated categories, separately as separable monads a la Balmer in tensor triangular geometry and non-separable monads a la Dell'Ambrogio and Sanders in stable homotopy theory. By introducing stable compatibility, we explore their properties together and produce a non-separable monad in Algebraic geometry and more.
items.title_zh: 模型类别稳定兼容
items.excerpt_zh: 通过引入稳定兼容性的概念，我们提供了模型范畴理论的一个框架，该框架解决了单子上模块类别的稳定模型结构的存在问题。这种单子的精确版本已经在三角范畴的设置中进行了研究，分别作为张量三角几何中的巴尔默的可分离单子和稳定同伦理论中的戴尔安布罗吉奥和桑德斯的不可分离单子。 By introducing stable compatibility, we explore their properties together and produce a non-separable monad in Algebraic geometry and more.

items.title: Regions of totally real arrangements of rational curves
items.excerpt: We prove a plane-curve analogue of Zaslavsky's theorem for arrangements of real rational curves for which every complex singularity with more than one local branch is real and all of its branches are real. If at least one component has odd degree, the number of real regions equals the total rational Betti number of the complexified complement. We also give a formula for bounded affine regions which records the number of branches at infinity and the connected components of the real affine curve. Oriented regions generate the middle Borel--Moore homology over $\mathbb{Q}$, and they generate it over $\mathbb{Z}$ when the component degrees are coprime. The relations are described by the circles in the real normalization and, in an affine chart, by winding functions. These results imply equality of combinatorial rank and real combinatorial rank in the framework of Brown--Dupont and Sturmfels--Telen. Examples include singular rational cubics, arrangements of conics, Chebyshev curves, and the plane model of the $27$ lines on a split cubic surface.
items.title_zh: 有理曲线完全实数排列的区域
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了扎斯拉夫斯基定理的平面曲线类似物，用于实有理曲线的排列，其中每个具有多个局部分支的复奇点都是真实的，并且其所有分支都是真实的。如果至少一个分量具有奇数度，则实数区域的数量等于复数补集的总有理贝蒂数。我们还给出了有界仿射区域的公式，该公式记录了无穷远分支的数量以及真实仿射曲线的连通分量。定向区域在 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上生成中间 Borel--Moore 同源性，并且当分量度互质时，它们在 $\mathbb{Z}$ 上生成它。这些关系在实归一化中由圆圈描述，在仿射图中则由缠绕函数描述。这些结果意味着在Brown-Dupont 和Sturmfels-Telen 框架下组合秩与真实组合秩相等。示例包括奇异有理三次曲线、二次曲线排列、切比雪夫曲线以及分割三次曲面上 27$ 线的平面模型。

items.title: From MHV Gravity Amplitudes and Hodges map to Pentad Varieties
items.excerpt: We study some geometric aspects behind the Hodges matrix appearing in the context of scattering amplitudes for the $\mathcal N=8$ supergravity. Through a vector bundle construction, we show that the Hodges matrix gives rise to a canonical rational map from the two-step flag variety to symmetric matrices, called the $\textit{Hodges map}$. This construction allows to define the amplitude geometrically: its vanishing locus is a divisor - the $\textit{MHV gravity divisor}$. Inspired by the Hodges map, we introduce the notion of Hadamard ratio of two varieties. In the case relevant to gravity, this is the ratio of two Grassmannians, which we call the $\textit{pentad variety}$, connecting it to the pentad constraint from algebraic statistics. Moreover, we show that the pentad variety is closely related to the combinatorial algebraic geometry of Martin's affine slope variety, and the phirotopes of Below, Krummeck, and Richter-Gebert.
items.authors: Joris Koefler, Emanuele Ventura, Hongmiao Yu
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了 $\mathcal N=8$ 超重力散射幅度背景下出现的霍奇斯矩阵背后的一些几何方面。通过向量丛构造，我们表明霍奇斯矩阵产生了从两步标志变体到对称矩阵的规范有理映射，称为 $\textit{Hodges 映射}$。这种结构允许以几何方式定义振幅：它的消失轨迹是一个除数 - $\textit{MHV 重力除数}$。受霍奇斯图的启发，我们引入了两个簇的哈达玛比的概念。在与引力相关的情况下，这是两个格拉斯曼量的比率，我们称之为 $\textit{pentadvariation}$，将其与代数统计中的五元约束联系起来。此外，我们表明五元簇与马丁仿射斜率簇的组合代数几何以及Below、Krummeck 和Richter-Gebert 的phirotope 密切相关。
items.title_zh: 从 MHV 重力振幅和 Hodges 地图到 Pentad Varieties

items.title: Galois Actions on Energy-Harmonic Functions
items.excerpt: We study the action of $\text{Gal}(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}/\mathbb{Q})$ on the solutions to the discrete Dirichlet problem for a graph with fixed edge energies. We establish transitivity of the Galois action outside a thin set in the parameter space and demonstrate that the exceptional thin set may be Zariski dense, so the conclusion cannot in general be replaced by one that holds on a Zariski-open set. Identifying the parameter locus where the Galois action is transitive constrains the possibilities for linking combinatorial and arithmetic properties of the discrete energy-harmonic Laplace equations and other systems of the same form.
items.title_zh: 能量调和函数的伽罗瓦作用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究 $\text{Gal}(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}/\mathbb{Q})$ 对具有固定边能量的图的离散狄利克雷问题的解的作用。我们在参数空间中的薄集之外建立了伽罗瓦作用的传递性，并证明了特殊的薄集可能是扎里斯基稠密的，因此结论通常不能被扎里斯基开集上成立的结论所取代。识别伽罗瓦作用传递性的参数轨迹限制了将离散能量调和拉普拉斯方程和相同形式的其他系统的组合和算术性质联系起来的可能性。

items.title: On motivic multiplicativity of cyclic covers
items.excerpt: Let $Y$ be a smooth projective complex variety of dimension $n$ with trivial Chow groups, and let $f: X\rightarrow Y$ be a cyclic cover of degree $d$ branched over a smooth ample divisor $D\in |dL|$. We show that a naturally constructed Chow--K\"unneth decomposition of $X$ is $m$-fold $mn$-multiplicative for each integer $m\geq2$ and that its stable motivic multiplicativity defect satisfies $\mathfrak{sd}(X)\leq 2dn$. If, in addition, each positive-codimension cycle class on $Y$ is supported on $D$, then a double cover admits motivic $0$-multiplicativity. As a further application, we show that any smooth Gushel--Mukai sixfold admits motivic 0-multiplicativity. Moreover, we establish the sharp modified-diagonal property for all smooth double EPW sextics, confirming a conjecture of O'Grady for these varieties.
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $Y$ 为具有平凡 Chow 群的维度 $n$ 的平滑射影复变体，并令 $f: X\rightarrow Y$ 为在平滑充足除数 $D\in |dL|$ 上分支的度 $d$ 的循环覆盖。我们证明，$X$ 的自然构造的 Chow--K\"unneth 分解对于每个整数 $m\geq2$ 是 $m$-倍 $mn$-乘法，并且其稳定动机乘性缺陷满足 $\mathfrak{sd}(X)\leq 2dn$。此外，如果 $Y$ 上的每个正余维循环类在 $D$ 上得到支持，则双重覆盖承认动机作为进一步的应用，我们证明任何光滑的 Gushel--Mukai 六倍都承认动机 0-乘法性。此外，我们为所有光滑的双 EPW 六角形建立了尖锐的修改对角线性质，证实了 O'Grady 对这些簇的猜想。
items.title_zh: 关于循环覆盖的动机多重性

items.title: Secant dimensions and bilinear decomposition widths for finite Heisenberg groups
items.excerpt: Let $G=UT_3(\F_q)$ be the finite Heisenberg group. We study the image closures and secant varieties of a family of equivariant bilinear maps between representations induced from central characters. Evaluation at a basepoint identifies the ambient space with $M_{q^2}(\C)$. A single channel is represented by $A^T\operatorname{diag}(d)B$, with $A$ and $B$ in prescribed twisted-convolution algebras. We prove that its affine image closure has dimension $3q^2-2$ for every central-character pair and that its affine second-secant closure has the expected dimension for every prime power $q$. For $q\ge3$, the proof constructs two differential images with zero intersection. We also prove a subgroup-lifting theorem for channel parameterizations on finite abelian groups with bicharacter coefficients: a parameter point with differential rank $r(3|H|-2)$ on a subgroup $H$ extends by zero to a parameter point with differential rank $r(3|K|-2)$ on the ambient group $K$, provided that every parameter vector is nonzero. Exact Jacobian certificates determine all secant dimensions for $q=2,3,4,5$, with generic widths $2,4,6,9$. The lifting theorem yields
items.authors: Nguyen Bich Van, Nguyen Trung Kien
items.excerpt_zh: 设 $G=UT_3(\F_q)$ 为有限海森堡群。我们研究了由中心人物导出的表示之间的等变双线性映射族的图像闭包和割线变体。基点处的评估用 $M_{q^2}(\C)$ 标识环境空间。单个通道由 $A^T\operatorname{diag}(d)B$ 表示，其中 $A$ 和 $B$ 采用规定的扭曲卷积代数。我们证明，对于每个中心字符对，其仿射图像闭包的维度为 $3q^2-2$，并且其仿射二割线闭包对于每个素数幂 $q$ 具有预期的维度。对于 $q\ge3$，证明构造了两个具有零交集的差分图像。我们还证明了具有双字符系数的有限阿贝尔群上通道参数化的子群提升定理：子群 $H$ 上具有差分秩 $r(3|H|-2)$ 的参数点以零延伸到环境组 $K$ 上具有差分秩 $r(3|K|-2)$ 的参数点，前提是每个参数向量均非零。精确雅克比证书确定 $q=2,3,4,5$ 的所有割线尺寸，通用宽度为 $2,4,6,9$。 The lifting theorem yields
items.title_zh: 有限海森堡群的割线维数和双线性分解宽度

items.title: Seshadri functions on surfaces
items.excerpt: We study the Seshadri function on the ample cone of a smooth complex projective surface at a fixed point. At a submaximal class, we show that the function is differentiable if and only if there is a unique Seshadri curve. At a maximal class $L$, differentiability is equivalent to every curve $C$ computing the Seshadri constant satisfying $\frac{[C]}{{\rm mult}_x C}=\frac{[L]}{\sqrt{L^{2}}}$. We also prove that the non-differentiability locus is nowhere dense. For the blow-up of $\mathbb P^{2}$ at $r\ge 9$ very general points, assuming the $(-1)$-curves conjecture for the blow-up at $r+1$ very general points, we construct a non-empty open subset of the ample cone on which the Seshadri function at a very general point equals $\sqrt{L^{2}}$. Consequently, this function is not piecewise linear. Under the assumption of the Strong SHGH conjecture, we obtain a common non-empty open subset on which maximality holds at every point when $r\ge36$.
items.title_zh: 表面上的 Seshadri 函数
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究固定点处光滑复射影曲面的大锥体上的 Seshadri 函数。在次极大类中，我们证明当且仅当存在唯一的 Seshadri 曲线时该函数是可微的。在最大类 $L$ 处，可微性相当于每条曲线 $C$ 计算满足 $\frac{[C]}{{\rm mult}_x C}=\frac{[L]}{\sqrt{L^{2}}}$ 的 Seshadri 常数。我们还证明不可微轨迹并不密集。对于 $\mathbb P^{2}$ 在 $r\ge 9$ 非常一般点处的爆炸，假设 $(-1)$ 曲线猜想在 $r+1$ 非常一般点处爆炸，我们构造一个大锥体的非空开子集，在该子集上，Seshadri 函数在非常一般点处等于 $\sqrt{L^{2}}$。因此，该函数不是分段线性的。在强 SHGH 猜想的假设下，我们得到一个公共的非空开子集，当 $r\ge36$ 时，该子集在每个点上都存在极大值。

items.title: Uniform duplication-divergence random graphs I: Degrees and Local Limits
items.excerpt: We study a growing random graph in which each new vertex chooses a uniformly random parent, joins that parent with probability $r\in(0,1]$, and independently joins each of the parent's current neighbors with probability $p\in(0,1)$. Let $p_c$ be the unique solution of $p_c e^{p_c}=1$. For $0 0$ and $\kappa>0$ solves $p^\kappa+p\kappa=1$. This confirms predictions from physics (Lambiotte, Krapivsky, Bhat and Redner, \textit{Physical Review Letters}, 2016). We further show that for every fixed radius $\ell$ and $p<1$, and infinite with exactly one end for $r=1$. Moreover, for every $0 <1$, both the fixed-vertex degrees and the maximum degree grow on the scale $t^p$, and the vertex of maximum degree is eventually unique and persistent.
items.authors: Partha S. Dey, Neeladri Maitra, Jaya M. Manthripragada, Grigory Terlov
items.title_zh: 均匀重复散度随机图 I：度和局部极限
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究一个不断增长的随机图，其中每个新顶点选择一个均匀随机的父节点，以 $r\in(0,1]$ 的概率连接该父节点，并以 $p\in(0,1)$ 的概率独立连接每个父节点的当前邻居。令 $p_c$ 为 $p_c e^{p_c}=1$ 的唯一解。对于 $0 0$ 和 $\kappa>0$ 求解$p^\kappa+p\kappa=1$。这证实了物理学的预测（Lambiotte, Krapivsky, Bhat and Redner, \textit{Physical Review Letters}, 2016）。我们进一步证明，对于每个固定半径 $\ell$ 和 $p<1$，以及 $r=1$ 的无限一端，此外，对于每个 $0 <1$，固定顶点度数和最大度数都在尺度上增长。 $t^p$，最大度数的顶点最终是唯一且持久的。

items.title: Two moments suffice for Bessel approximation: conditioned differences, contingency tables, and probabilistic divide-and-conquer
items.excerpt: We develop Stein's method, with explicit constants throughout, for the discrete Bessel distribution: the law of a Poisson variable given its difference from an independent Poisson variable. The Bessel family is characterized by a birth-death operator with quadratic death rate $n(n+k)$ and as the exact fixed-point set of a centered quadratic-bias transform, and we prove a dependency expansion of Arratia-Goldstein-Gordon type: two joint moments of a column array control the total-variation distance from the conditioned row sum to a matched Bessel law. Applied to the row-constrained Fisher-Yates ensemble on $2\times c$ contingency tables -- independent Bernoulli or capped-Poisson entries conditioned on the row-sum difference, column sums free -- this yields a limit theorem -- which upgrades to the entire conditioned table at the same two-moment error -- a completely explicit enumeration estimate, and an exact divide-and-conquer sampler with certified acceptance. The entire apparatus -- operator, expansion, enumeration, sampler -- generalizes to $r\times c$ tables, where conditioning on all successive row differences produces a hyper-Bess
items.title_zh: 对于贝塞尔近似来说，两个矩就足够了：条件差异、列联表和概率分而治之
items.excerpt_zh: 我们针对离散贝塞尔分布开发了斯坦因方法，该方法始终具有显式常数：考虑到泊松变量与独立泊松变量的差异，泊松变量的定律。 Bessel 系列的特征是具有二次死亡率 $n(n+k)$ 的生死算子，并且是中心二次偏差变换的精确定点集，我们证明了 Arratia-Goldstein-Gordon 类型的依赖扩展：列数组的两个联合矩控制从条件行和到匹配贝塞尔定律的总变分距离。应用于 $2\times c$ 列联表上的行约束 Fisher-Yates 系综——以行和差为条件的独立伯努利或上限泊松条目，自由列和——这产生了一个极限定理——它在相同的两时刻误差处升级到整个条件表——一个完全显式的枚举估计，以及一个经过认证的验收的精确分而治之采样器。整个装置——运算符、扩展、枚举、采样器——概括为 $r\times c$ 表，其中对所有连续行差异的调节产生了 hyper-Bess

items.title: Stein's method for negative binomial and hyper-negative-binomial laws, with applications
items.excerpt: We develop Stein's method for the negative binomial law and for the hyper-negative-binomial law, the law of the smallest row total of an array of independent geometric variables given the differences of the row totals, with every constant explicit. The main instrument is a comparison of two biasings of the approximated variable, which cancels the rate term exactly at the matched parameter. We provide total variation bounds for sums of independent geometric variables at drifting parameters, for sums of dependent geometric variables (the Arratia-Goldstein-Gordon theorem with geometric summands and the Poisson law as an endpoint), and for Poisson mixtures; the exact conditional law of negative-binomial counts given their differences, with the Bessel law as its Poisson limit; and a dependency expansion for the column direction of a contingency table. A final section verifies every bound numerically, with one script per result.
items.title_zh: 负二项式和超负二项式定律的斯坦因方法及其应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了负二项式定律和超负二项式定律的斯坦因方法，即给定行总计差异的独立几何变量数组的最小行总计的法则，每个常量都是明确的。主要工具是对近似变量的两个偏差进行比较，这精确地消除了匹配参数处的速率项。我们提供了漂移参数下独立几何变量之和、因几何变量之和（以几何被数和泊松定律为端点的 Arratia-Goldstein-Gordon 定理）以及泊松混合的总变分界； the exact conditional law of negative-binomial counts given their differences, with the Bessel law as its Poisson limit; and a dependency expansion for the column direction of a contingency table. A final section verifies every bound numerically, with one script per result.

items.title: Exact Asymptotics for the Harmonic Descent Chain and Extended Convergence Bounds for Recursive Statistics
items.excerpt: We give an exact asymptotic expansion of the occupation probabilities $a(n,k)$ of the harmonic descent chain, introduced by D. Aldous, as $n\rightarrow\infty$ with $k\in\mathrm{o}(\sqrt{n})$. In addition, we extend the recent results of Brandenberger et al. by giving a bound on the rate of convergence of sequences defined recursively by $x_n = \frac{1}{H_{n-1}}\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}\frac{x_i}{n-i}$ for more general initial conditions. This result enables the application of an existing central limit theorem, also by Brandenberger et al., to statistics of the critical beta-splitting tree which satisfy our more general initial conditions.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了由 D. Aldous 引入的调和下降链的占据概率 $a(n,k)$ 的精确渐近展开，为 $n\rightarrow\infty$ 和 $k\in\mathrm{o}(\sqrt{n})$。此外，我们扩展了 Brandenberger 等人的最新结果。对于更一般的初始条件，给出由 $x_n = \frac{1}{H_{n-1}}\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}\frac{x_i}{n-i}$ 递归定义的序列收敛速度的界限。这一结果使得布兰登伯格等人能够将现有的中心极限定理应用于满足我们更一般的初始条件的临界β分裂树的统计。
items.title_zh: 谐波下降链的精确渐近和递归统计的扩展收敛界

items.title: Stability, discretization, and optimality of continuous-time causal optimal transport
items.excerpt: We prove stability of continuous-time causal and bicausal optimal transport problems when both marginals converge in adapted Wasserstein distance along common vanishing time shifts. The marginal laws, filtrations, and costs may all vary, while the limit remains the original causal or bicausal transport problem. This allows for time discretization and the approximation of transport problems between non-degenerate scalar fractional stochastic differential equations by their Wong--Zakai schemes. We further establish sufficient conditions so that the synchronous coupling is optimal for the bicausal transport problem between scalar fractional stochastic differential equations under continuous, nonnegative submodular costs of polynomial growth. This result covers all Hurst parameters \(H\in(0,1)\) up to an additional order-preserving commutator condition on the corresponding coefficients for the rough regime \(H\in(0,1/2)\).
items.title_zh: 连续时间因果最优传输的稳定性、离散化和最优性
items.excerpt_zh: 当两个边际沿共同消失时间平移以适应的 Wasserstein 距离收敛时，我们证明了连续时间因果和双因果最优传输问题的稳定性。边际法则、过滤和成本都可能有所不同，而限制仍然是原始的因果或双因运输问题。这允许通过 Wong-Zakai 方案实现时间离散化和非简并标量分数阶随机微分方程之间的传输问题的近似。我们进一步建立充分的条件，使得同步耦合对于多项式增长的连续、非负子模成本下标量分数阶随机微分方程之间的双因果传输问题是最优的。该结果涵盖了所有 Hurst 参数 \(H\in(0,1)\)，直至粗略状态 \(H\in(0,1/2)\) 的相应系数上的附加保序换向器条件。

items.title: Absorption Probabilities for Brownian Convex Hulls in Arbitrary Dimension
items.excerpt: For every dimension $d\ge1$, we determine the probability that a prescribed point in $\mathbb R^d$ belongs to the convex hull over $[0,1]$ of a standard Brownian motion starting at the origin or of a Brownian bridge from $0$ to $0$. We obtain explicit one-dimensional integral formulas involving only standard special functions. For example, in dimension three the Brownian-motion absorption probability $p_3^B(r)$ for a prescribed point at distance $r>0$ from the origin is \[ p_3^B(r) =\frac{r}{\sqrt2\,\pi^{3/2}} \int_0^\infty \left(\frac{\pi}{2\sqrt{1+v^2}}-1\right) \mathrm{e}^{-r^2(1+v^2)/4} (K_1-K_0)\!\left(\frac{r^2(1+v^2)}4\right)\,\mathrm{d} v, \] where $K_\nu$ denotes the modified Bessel function of the second kind. For each fixed dimension $d\ge1$ and each prescribed nonzero point in $\mathbb R^d$, we derive precise asymptotics of the non-absorption probabilities for the convex hulls of Brownian motion on $[0,T]$ and a Brownian bridge from $0$ to $0$ over the same interval, as $T\to\infty$. The corresponding probabilities are asymptotic to explicit positive constants times $T^{-1/2}(\log T)^{d-1}$ and $T^{-1}(\log T)^{d-1}$, resp
items.title_zh: 任意维数布朗凸包的吸收概率
items.excerpt_zh: 对于每个维度 $d\ge1$，我们确定 $\mathbb R^d$ 中的指定点属于从原点开始的标准布朗运动或从 $0$ 到 $0$ 的布朗桥 $[0,1]$ 上的凸包的概率。 We obtain explicit one-dimensional integral formulas involving only standard special functions.例如，在第三维中，距原点距离 $r>0$ 处的指定点的布朗运动吸收概率 $p_3^B(r)$ 为 \[ p_3^B(r) =\frac{r}{\sqrt2\,\pi^{3/2}} \int_0^\infty \left(\frac{\pi}{2\sqrt{1+v^2}}-1\right) \mathrm{e}^{-r^2(1+v^2)/4} (K_1-K_0)\!\left(\frac{r^2(1+v^2)}4\right)\,\mathrm{d} v, \] 其中 $K_\nu$ 表示第二类修正贝塞尔函数。对于每个固定维度 $d\ge1$ 和 $\mathbb R^d$ 中的每个指定非零点，我们推导出 $[0,T]$ 上布朗运动凸包的非吸收概率的精确渐近，以及同一区间内从 $0$ 到 $0$ 的布朗桥，如 $T\to\infty$。 The corresponding probabilities are asymptotic to explicit positive constants times $T^{-1/2}(\log T)^{d-1}$ and $T^{-1}(\log T)^{d-1}$, resp

items.title: Universality of Large-Scale Geometry For Critical Random-Cluster Models
items.excerpt: The understanding of the behaviour of critical lattice models in two dimensions has made immense progress in the past couple of decades, with conformal invariance as its conjectured end goal. We consider here the critical random-cluster model (or FK-percolation) on a large class of graphs --- namely bi-periodic isoradial graphs --- with cluster-weight~$q \in [1,4]$. Following up on the establishment of rotational invariance at criticality in \cite{Rotation}, we prove that the large scale behaviour of these models is asymptotically the same on all such graphs. These include the critical homogeneous models on the square, triangular and hexagonal lattices.
items.title_zh: 关键随机簇模型的大尺度几何的普遍性
items.excerpt_zh: 在过去的几十年里，对二维临界晶格模型行为的理解取得了巨大进展，共形不变性是其推测的最终目标。 We consider here the critical random-cluster model (or FK-percolation) on a large class of graphs --- namely bi-periodic isoradial graphs --- with cluster-weight~$q \in [1,4]$.继在 \cite{Rotation} 中建立临界点旋转不变性之后，我们证明这些模型的大规模行为在所有此类图上是渐近相同的。其中包括方形、三角形和六角形晶格的临界齐次模型。

items.title: On the asymptotic distribution of the largest eigenvalue of unbalanced complex Jacobi ensembles
items.excerpt: Let $\mathbf{A} \sim \mathbb{C}\mathcal{W}_p(I,m)$ and $\mathbf{B} \sim \mathbb{C}\mathcal{W}_p(I,n)$ be two independent complex Wishart random matrices. In this work, we investigate the asymptotic distribution of the largest eigenvalue $\theta_{\max}$ of the random matrix $\mathbf{J} = (\mathbf{A}+\mathbf{B})^{-1}\mathbf{B}$. The high-dimensional regime is potentially unbalanced in the sense that, as $p \to \infty$, $m$ may grow faster than $p$, whereas $n$ grows proportionally to $p$. The asymptotic behavior of $\theta_{\max}$ is characterized by means of a Riemann-Hilbert (RH) problem for Jacobi polynomials with modified Jacobi weights. We establish the type 2 Tracy--Widom asymptotic distribution of $\theta_{\max}$. This provides an alternative, RH-based proof of the corresponding result of Johnstone [Ann. Statist. 36 (2008), 2638-2716] in the balanced regime, and establishes a conjecture of Jiang [Probab. Theory Relat. Fields 144 (2009), 221-246] in the unbalanced regime. In addition, we obtain an explicit correction of order $p^{-2/3}$ to the Tracy--Widom approximation, with a remainder of order $\mathcal{O}(p^{-1})$, and show ex

items.title: Loss of Monotonicity in the Vector Play Model and Consequences for Newton-Type Solvers
items.excerpt: The vector play model (VPM) replaces the implicit minimization of the energy-based hysteresis model (EBM) by an explicit update. Its tangent contains the product of the Hessians of two unrelated potentials and is unsymmetric. Hence, the VPM has no co-energy density at frozen memory, and the skew part makes $\boldsymbol{H}\mapsto\boldsymbol{B}$ lose monotonicity in a band just outside the pinning circle, into which small time steps drive the sliding states. In composite models, the determinant of the tangent can change sign, which explains published failures of the local inversion $\boldsymbol{B}\mapsto\boldsymbol{H}$, and where it is negative, $\boldsymbol{H}\mapsto\boldsymbol{B}$ is not injective. In the scalar potential formulation, the exact tangent keeps a descent guarantee, whereas symmetric surrogates of the tangent, such as the symmetrized tangent or Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno (BFGS) updates, lose it and become ascent directions where the skew part dominates, as computations of TEAM Problem 32 confirm. It is therefore recommended to use solvers with an unsymmetric tangent.
items.authors: Dominik Cibicki, Klaus Roppert, Manfred Kaltenbacher
items.title_zh: 矢量游戏模型中的单调性损失以及牛顿型求解器的后果
items.excerpt_zh: 矢量播放模型 (VPM) 通过显式更新取代了基于能量的磁滞模型 (EBM) 的隐式最小化。它的正切包含两个不相关势的 Hessian 乘积，并且是不对称的。因此，VPM 在冻结内存下没有共能密度，并且偏斜部分使得 $\boldsymbol{H}\mapsto\boldsymbol{B}$ 在钉扎圆之外的带中失去单调性，其中小时间步长驱动滑动状态。在复合模型中，切线的行列式可以改变符号，这解释了已发布的局部反演 $\boldsymbol{B}\mapsto\boldsymbol{H}$ 的失败，并且当它为负时， $\boldsymbol{H}\mapsto\boldsymbol{B}$ 不是单射的。在标量势公式中，精确的切线保持下降保证，而切线的对称代理（例如对称切线或 Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno (BFGS) 更新）会丢失它并成为倾斜部分占主导地位的上升方向，正如 TEAM Problem 32 的计算所证实的那样。因此，建议使用具有不对称切线的求解器。

items.title: A Hierarchical direct solver for Lippmann-Schwinger equations based on boundary traces
items.excerpt: A high-order hierarchical direct solver for variable-media scattering in two dimensions is presented. Standard discretizations for these problems produce dense linear systems that are commonly solved iteratively, requiring a new global solve for each incident field. The method proposed here instead constructs a reusable scattering operator for the inhomogeneous medium, based on a hierarchical subdivision of the computational domain. First, high-accuracy leaf scattering operators are built from discretized local integral equations. Up the hierarchy, neighboring boxes are merged to build the scattering operators for successively larger boxes. A key feature of the method is that each scattering operator is represented as a map of incoming traces to outgoing traces. Consequently, volume unknowns appear only in the leaf computations; all higher levels of the hierarchy operate entirely on boundary traces. The hierarchical solver is presented first at the continuum level and discretized only afterward using high-order local volume quadrature, polynomial trace representations, and boundary integral techniques. items.title_zh: 基于边界迹的李普曼-施温格方程的分层直接求解器
items.excerpt_zh: 提出了一种用于二维可变介质散射的高阶分层直接求解器。这些问题的标准离散化会产生密集的线性系统，通常需要迭代求解，需要对每个事件场进行新的全局求解。这里提出的方法基于计算域的分层细分，为非均匀介质构造了一个可重用的散射算子。首先，高精度叶子散射算子是根据离散局部积分方程构建的。在层次结构中，相邻的框被合并，为连续更大的框构建散射算子。该方法的一个关键特征是每个散射算子都表示为传入轨迹到传出轨迹的映射。因此，体积未知数仅出现在叶计算中；层次结构的所有较高级别完全在边界轨迹上运行。分层求解器首先在连续体级别上呈现，然后才使用高阶局部体积求积、多项式迹表示和边界积分技术进行离散化。 For a discretization involving $

items.title: A comparison of parallel iterative methods for ILU triangular solves
items.excerpt: Exact triangular solves parallelise poorly, limited by the size and number of the level sets, so on GPUs the factors from incomplete LU (ILU) factorisations are often solved approximately with parallel iterative methods. We compare four such methods: a Jacobi method, an Incomplete Sparse Approximate Inverse (ISAI), GMRES polynomials, and AIRG, a reduction multigrid built on GMRES polynomials, for which we introduce a parallel coarse/fine splitting that bounds the diagonal dominance ratio of the fine-fine block. We test them with ILU(0) and ILU(1) factors of canonical PDE problems and 91 SuiteSparse/Matrix Market matrices, the latter on a single GPU. AIRG is the most robust on the PDE factors, with nearly flat iteration counts under refinement and no per-problem tuning, but has the largest setup and memory costs. GMRES polynomials are more robust than the Jacobi method at a similar cost. As the inner solve of an ILU preconditioner with tuned inner iteration counts, ISAI gives the largest median speedups over a hipSPARSE exact triangular solve (4.5$\times$ and 6.8$\times$ for ILU(0) and ILU(1)), though this was dominated by smaller prob
items.title_zh: ILU 三角求解的并行迭代方法的比较
items.excerpt_zh: 由于水平集的大小和数量的限制，精确三角求解的并行性很差，因此在 GPU 上，不完全 LU (ILU) 分解的因子通常通过并行迭代方法来近似求解。我们比较了四种这样的方法：雅可比方法、不完全稀疏近似逆 (ISAI)、GMRES 多项式和 AIRG（一种基于 GMRES 多项式构建的归约多重网格），为此我们引入了并行粗/细分割，该分割限制了细细块的对角优势比。 We test them with ILU(0) and ILU(1) factors of canonical PDE problems and 91 SuiteSparse/Matrix Market matrices, the latter on a single GPU. AIRG 在 PDE 因子上是最稳健的，在细化下迭代次数几乎持平，并且无需针对每个问题进行调整，但具有最大的设置和内存成本。 GMRES polynomials are more robust than the Jacobi method at a similar cost.作为具有调整的内部迭代计数的 ILU 预处理器的内部求解，ISAI 提供了比 hipSPARSE 精确三角求解最大的中值加速（ILU(0) 和 ILU(1) 为 4.5$\times$ 和 6.8$\times$），尽管这是由较小的概率主导的

items.title: Unconditional optimal convergence of a relaxation Crank-Nicolson difference scheme for 2D space-fractional NLS
items.excerpt: In this paper, we develop a linearly implicit relaxation Crank-Nicolson difference scheme for the two-dimensional space-fractional nonlinear Schr\"odinger (SFNS) equation, where the fractional Laplacian is approximated by a simple fractional central difference scheme. The proposed scheme is uniquely solvable and conserves discrete mass for general real-valued nonlinear coefficients, and a modified discrete energy in the cubic case. By introducing a modified error system employing a cut-off technique, we establish the optimal-order error estimates without mesh-ratio restriction. Specifically, the primary variable achieves second-order temporal and spatial convergence in the discrete $H_h^{\alpha/2}$-norm, and the relaxation variable satisfies the same convergence in the discrete $L^2$-norm. Some numerical experiments confirm the relevant theoretical results.
items.title_zh: 二维空间分数 NLS 松弛 Crank-Nicolson 差分格式的无条件最优收敛
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们为二维空间分数非线性薛定格（SFNS）方程开发了一种线性隐式松弛克兰克-尼科尔森差分格式，其中分数拉普拉斯算子由简单的分数中心差分格式近似。该格式是唯一可解的，并且保留了一般实值非线性系数的离散质量，以及三次情况下的修正离散能量。通过引入采用截断技术的修正误差系统，我们建立了具体来说，主变量在离散$H_h^{\alpha/2}$-范数下实现二阶时间和空间收敛，并且松弛变量在离散$L^2$-范数下满足相同的收敛性。一些数值实验证实了相关的理论结果。

items.title: Parameter Bounds and Inverse Approximation for Linearized ReLU$^k$ Networks on the Sphere
items.excerpt: We study direct and inverse approximation for linearized shallow ReLU$^k$ networks on $\mathbb S^d$ with quasi-uniform hidden parameters. For $0<\alpha<\frac{d+2k+1}{2d}$, under the coefficient growth condition $\bigl(n\sum_{j=1}^na_{j,n}^2\bigr)^{\frac{1}{2}}\leq n^\alpha M$, we prove that approximation at the order $n^{-\frac{d+2k+1}{2d}+\alpha}$ is equivalent to membership in the parity-compatible Besov space $\mathcal B_{2,\infty,*}^{\frac{d+2k+1}{2}-\alpha d}(\mathbb S^d)$. Mere convergence under the same coefficient budget does not imply this regularity. For unconstrained approximation along a nested parameter sequence, a single ridge function gives a counterexample when $\alpha<\frac{1}{2}$, whereas for $\alpha>\frac{1}{2}$ the endpoint Besov inverse conclusion follows from a Bernstein inequality under antipodal quasi-uniformity. The inverse conclusion is also recovered when the prescribed rate holds for two quasi-uniform parameter sequences whose union is antipodally separated.

items.title: A posteriori error estimates for a finite volume approximation of a local sensing Keller-Segel model
items.excerpt: A local sensing Keller-Segel model, in which cells adjust their motility to the local chemoattractant rather than its gradient, and a semi-implicit finite volume scheme for its numerical approximation are studied. Computable a posteriori bounds for the approximation error measured in terms of the $L^\infty(0, T; H^{-1}(\Omega))$ and $L^2(0, T; L^2(\Omega))$ norms of the cell density are derived based on a new stability estimate and suitable reconstructions of the flux and the flux potential of the numerical solution. Optimal scaling of the estimates is numerically demonstrated in 1D and 2D experiments. Moreover, an adaptive mesh refinement method steered by the estimator is proposed for the 1D case, and its efficiency is numerically verified.
items.title_zh: 局部感知 Keller-Segel 模型的有限体积近似的后验误差估计
items.excerpt_zh: 研究了局部传感 Keller-Segel 模型，其中细胞根据局部化学引诱剂而不是其梯度调整其运动性，并研究了其数值近似的半隐式有限体积方案。根据细胞密度的 $L^\infty(0, T; H^{-1}(\Omega))$ 和 $L^2(0, T; L^2(\Omega))$ 范数测量的近似误差的可计算后验界限是基于新的稳定性估计以及数值解的通量和通量势的适当重建而导出的。估计的最佳缩放比例在一维和二维实验中以数字方式得到证明。此外，针对一维情况提出了一种由估计器引导的自适应网格细化方法，并通过数值验证了其效率。

items.title: Flux vector splittings and semi-implicit finite volume schemes for an isentropic two-phase flow model
items.excerpt: We present two new semi-implicit finite volume schemes for the 1D hyperbolic and thermodynamically compatible (HTC) isentropic two-phase flow model of Romenski et al., written in terms of mixture density, volume fraction, partial gas density, mixture momentum and the relative phase velocity. In gas-liquid mixtures, the sound speed of the weakly compressible liquid is much larger than the gas sound speed and flow velocity, so the time step of fully explicit discretizations is dictated by liquid acoustic waves, even when the interest lies in the dynamics of the gas. To overcome this difficulty, the model's flux is split at the continuous level into an explicit subsystem (gas dynamics) and an implicit subsystem (liquid acoustic waves), leading to a nonlinear system for liquid pressure solved with the Newton method. In the first splitting the entire liquid phase is treated implicitly, while in the second the liquid convective terms are moved to the explicit subsystem, so only liquid acoustic waves are treated implicitly and nested Picard iterations are avoided. items.authors: Michael Dumbser, Gabriella Puppo, Alessandra Spilimbergo, Tommaso Tenna
items.title_zh: 等熵两相流模型的通量矢量分裂和半隐式有限体积方案
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为 Romenski 等人的一维双曲和热力学兼容 (HTC) 等熵两相流模型提出了两种新的半隐式有限体积方案，用混合物密度、体积分数、部分气体密度、混合物动量和相对相速度来编写。在气液混合物中，弱可压缩液体的声速远大于气体声速和流速，因此完全显式离散化的时间步长由液体声波决定，即使兴趣在于气体动力学。为了克服这一困难，模型的通量在连续水平上分为显式子系统（气体动力学）和隐式子系统（液体声波），从而形成用牛顿法求解的液体压力非线性系统。在第一次分裂中，整个液相被隐式处理，而在第二次分裂中，液体对流项被移至显式子系统，因此仅隐式处理液体声波，并避免嵌套皮卡德迭代。因此，两种方案的时间步长仅受流速和

items.title: A Second-Order Stochastic Dynamic Mode Decomposition by Richardson Extrapolation
items.excerpt: Stochastic dynamic mode decomposition (SDMD) approximates the Koopman semigroup of an It\^o diffusion by a Galerkin generator matrix on a dictionary of observables, computed from samples of the invariant law and evaluations of the generator, and advances observables with a first-order stochastic Taylor step (SDMD-1). The second-order Taylor step (SDMD-2) also needs the matrix of second generator actions, hence a dictionary with four derivatives, evaluations of a fourth-order differential operator at every sample, and a third matrix. We show that the Richardson extrapolation of two SDMD-1 half steps (SDMD-R) is second-order accurate with the data, the matrices, and the regularity of SDMD-1. One error bound covers exact and empirical Galerkin matrices. It consists of the Galerkin error of the dictionary, which is common to all schemes, a time-stepping term, and a data term of order $m^{-1/2}$ in the sample size $m$. The time-stepping term is $O(\dt^2)$ for SDMD-R and $O(\Theta_N\dt+\dt^2)$ for SDMD-2, where $\Theta_N$ is the norm of the second-order Galerkin residual $\Proj_N\cA(I-\Proj_N)\cA|_{\cV_N}$. The first-order term is attained
items.title_zh: 基于理查森外推法的二阶随机动力模态分解

items.title: Coinduction in Grounded Arithmetic
items.excerpt: A grounded arithmetic counts a sentence as true only when a terminating process establishes it; a sentence no such process settles has no value. Such a logic can state that an event happens, but not that it never happens under unbounded choice. This paper extends such a logic so that it can. The base is Reflective Grounded Arithmetic (RGA) with Inductive Grounded Arithmetic (IGA)'s least-fixed-point reading and ground induction. It adds a separate greatest-fixed-point former $\nu$ with Park's coinduction rule, proves that one former cannot carry both ground induction and coinduction, and adds a dichotomy rule: the classical disjunction between a least-fixed-point atom and the greatest-fixed-point atom of its dual, under a derivable premise that the body's leaves are decided. The systems are sound for an explicit model reading every $\nu$-body at its greatest fixed point, hence consistent; they agree with the least model wherever it has a value and prove sentences it leaves without one. items.title: Polyteam logics for quantum contextuality
items.excerpt: We introduce logics of dependence and independence over polyteams (that is, databases with multiple relation schemes), in a similar way as in arXiv:1704.02158v3 [cs.LO]. On this basis, we develop a logical framework in which we can express (in formulas) relevant properties about the statistics of a repeated quantum experiment. In this framework, we formalize Bell's theorem, and the Kochen-Specker theorem as failure of logical entailments, as it was suggested in arXiv:2107.10817v3 [math.LO]. The key feature of polyteam logics in action here is their power to express both local and global properties, with respect to the set of possible measurements. The point of this is at least twofold. Firstly, as in arXiv:1102.0264v7 [quant-ph], it gives a high-level (information-theoretic) understanding of these physical phenomena, that is not intrinsic to the physical objects involved. Secondly, since logical entailment is often (partially) axiomatizable, this framework incites us to tackle the question of contextuality computationally. items.excerpt_zh: 我们以与 arXiv:1704.02158v3 [cs.LO] 类似的方式引入了多组（即具有多种关系方案的数据库）的依赖和独立逻辑。在此基础上，我们开发了一个逻辑框架，在其中我们可以（用公式）表达有关重复量子实验的统计数据的相关属性。在这个框架中，我们将贝尔定理和科亨-斯佩克定理形式化为逻辑蕴涵失败，正如 arXiv:2107.10817v3 [math.LO] 中所建议的那样。此处使用的多组逻辑的关键特征是它们能够针对可能的测量集表达局部和全局属性。 The point of this is at least twofold.首先，如 arXiv:1102.0264v7 [quant-ph] 中所示，它给出了对这些物理现象的高级（信息论）理解，这不是所涉及的物理对象所固有的。其次，由于逻辑蕴涵通常（部分）可公理化，因此该框架促使我们通过计算来解决上下文性问题。 We also define semiring-weighted polyteams along with logics on them, and use them to recover the probabilistic v

items.title: Well begun is half done: the computation of Eulerian paths
items.excerpt: We characterize the uniform computational strength of finding one-way Eulerian paths in countable graphs. For both directed and undirected graphs, this problem is Weihrauch-equivalent to $\mathsf{lim}\times\mathsf{C}_{\mathbb{N}}'$, where $\mathsf{C}_{\mathbb{N}}'$ is the jump of closed choice on the natural numbers. This refines the proof-theoretical strength of the existence of an Eulerian path given by the reverse mathematics framework. The $\mathsf{C}_{\mathbb{N}}'$ component comes entirely from the difficulty of choosing a starting vertex: with a valid start prescribed, the problem is equivalent to $\mathsf{lim}$. We also study the problem $\mathsf{OrientEP}$ of orienting an undirected graph while preserving the existence of a one-way Eulerian path. We prove $\mathsf{lim}_2<_{\mathrm{W}}\mathsf{OrientEP}<_{\mathrm{W}}\mathsf{C}_{2}'\sqcap\mathsf{Sort}_2$ and $\mathsf{OrientEP}\not\le_{\mathrm{W}}\mathsf{C}_{\mathbb{N}}$.
items.title_zh: 好的开始就成功了一半：欧拉路径的计算
items.excerpt_zh: 我们描述了在可数图中寻找单向欧拉路径的统一计算强度。 For both directed and undirected graphs, this problem is Weihrauch-equivalent to $\mathsf{lim}\times\mathsf{C}_{\mathbb{N}}'$, where $\mathsf{C}_{\mathbb{N}}'$ is the jump of closed choice on the natural numbers.这完善了逆向数学框架给出的欧拉路径存在性的证明理论强度。 The $\mathsf{C}_{\mathbb{N}}'$ component comes entirely from the difficulty of choosing a starting vertex: with a valid start prescribed, the problem is equivalent to $\mathsf{lim}$.我们还研究了在保持单向欧拉路径存在的同时对无向图进行定向的问题 $\mathsf{OrientEP}$。我们证明 $\mathsf{lim}_2<_{\mathrm{W}}\mathsf{OrientEP}<_{\mathrm{W}}\mathsf{C}_{2}'\sqcap\mathsf{Sort}_2$ 和$\mathsf{OrientEP}\not\le_{\mathrm{W}}\mathsf{C}_{\mathbb{N}}$。

items.title: Modular proof analysis and cut elimination for the Reflection Calculi $\mathsf{RC}_1$ and $\mathsf{QRC}_1$
items.excerpt: The reflection calculus with one modality is denoted by $\mathsf{RC}_1$ and its quantified generalization is known as $\mathsf{QRC}_1$. These decidable calculi are of interest since they generate the strictly positive fragments of the (quantified) provability logic for theories like Peano Arithmetic and Heyting Arithmetic. We introduce analytic cut-free calculi ${\mathrm{GRC1}}$ and ${\mathrm{GQRC1}}$ for $\mathsf{RC}_1$ and $\mathsf{QRC}_1$ respectively. The new calculi derive sequents of the form $A\Longrightarrow B$ with $A,B$ strictly positive formulas. In particular, the new calculi do not use (multi)sets nor nested sequents. For both ${\mathrm{GRC1}}$ and ${\mathrm{GQRC1}}$ it is shown that the cut-rule is admissible. As a consequence, it is proven that the calculi are deductively equivalent to $\mathsf{RC}_1$ and $\mathsf{QRC}_1$ respectively. The cutfree systems are used to prove uniform interpolation for the two reflection calculi. In addition, ${\mathrm{GRC1}}$ is used to give a syntactic proof of Dashkov's Theorem to the extent that $\mathsf{RC}_1$ is the strictly positive fragment of the provability logic ${\mathsf{GL}}$.

items.title: Some variants of function domination
items.excerpt: We investigate whether classical recursion-theoretic notions defined by function domination remain unchanged when success is required only on sets of prescribed asymptotic density. We establish robustness for many such notions and uncover unexpected connections between familiar degree properties by comparing upper and lower density. In contrast, pdomination, as defined by Chong, Hoi, Stephan and Turetsky, is not robust under density weakenings. We also answer a question of Kjos-Hanssen and Nies by characterizing superhighness as domination with a threshold boundedly limit recursive in the oracle. As an application, we introduce supermaximal sets, a strengthening of maximality whose degrees are exactly the superhigh r.e. degrees.

items.title: Order-Invariant CFO Contains Local-Order-Invariant FO
items.excerpt: Order-invariant cluster first-order logic (CFO) and local-order-invariant first-order logic are two fragments of order-invariant first-order logic, both motivated by the study of invariant logics on classes of bounded degree. Our main result is that order-invariant CFO contains local-order-invariant FO on arbitrary classes of finite structures, settling the conjecture of Ghasemi and Grange that order-invariant CFO contains plain FO. By combining this with a collapse result of Ghasemi and Grange, we obtain the equivalence of FO, local-order-invariant FO, and order-invariant CFO on classes of finite colored graphs of bounded degree. The proof makes use of Gaifman normal form, which allows our translation from local-order-invariant FO to order-invariant CFO to be effective. Combined with the fixed-parameter tractability of model-checking for order-invariant CFO on bounded-degree colored graph classes, this shows that model-checking for local-order-invariant FO on bounded-degree colored graph classes is fixed-parameter tractable. items.title: $\mathsf{RCA}_0$ Proves the Collapse of the Intersection Principles Hierarchy
items.excerpt: This paper shows that the pairwise intersection principle ($2\mathrm{IP}$) implies, over $\mathsf{RCA}_0$, the existence of a Cohen $1$-generic real relative to every given set. Together with the known implications, this yields the equivalence over $\mathsf{RCA}_0$ of the finite intersection principle (FIP), $2\mathrm{IP}$, and $1$-GEN. In fact, FIP is equivalent to $n\mathrm{IP}$ for every fixed $n\geq 2$. These results give affirmative answers to Questions~1 and~2 of Cholak, Downey, and Igusa, and to Question~9.10.26 of Dzhafarov and Mummert. The proof uses cumulative, nested supports satisfying a finite Helly property and a decoding argument based on a least selected label. Neither $\Sigma^0_2$ induction nor $\Sigma^0_2$ bounding is required.

items.title: Early Stopping in Large Reasoning Models: A Survey and Empirical Audit of Efficiency and Reliability
items.excerpt: Large reasoning models can improve accuracy by generating longer reasoning traces, but some of this computation may be unnecessary. Early-stopping methods aim to stop once enough reasoning is available to answer. Evaluating these methods requires accounting for the cost of deciding when to stop and the reliability of the resulting answer. We evaluate different methods across five reasoning models on mathematical and scientific reasoning, code generation, and factuality tasks by using a shared rollout replay protocol. We introduce Target-Integrated Token Efficiency (TITE) to measure efficiency relative to the oracle across accuracy targets. We also examine correctness at later exit positions, transfer across models and tasks, post-stop reasoning continuation, and retained justification quality. In our experiments, correctness can decrease at later positions beyond what the fitted decoding-noise model predicts. Reliability checks also reveal continued reasoning after forced termination and weaker supporting reasoning in some correct early-stopping outputs. The implementation can be found in https://github.com/hung20gg/audit-early-stoppi

items.title: Automated Theorem Generation in First-Order Logic by Construction from Triangular Standard Contradictions
items.excerpt: Automated theorem generation (ATG) seeks to construct new theorems rather than merely prove given conjectures. Existing approaches typically generate candidate statements that require subsequent proof or formal verification. We propose a constructive framework for ATG in first-order logic based on triangular standard contradictions. The method constructs minimally unsatisfiable clause sets from selected first-order literals, then forms theorems by retaining some clauses as premises and taking the negation of one clause, or a conjunction of clauses, as the conclusion. Minimal unsatisfiability ensures that the remaining premises are satisfiable, avoiding trivial inference by explosion, while unsatisfiability of the full set guarantees the resulting entailment. Theorems are therefore correct by construction, without a separate proof procedure for each instance. Extending the previously developed $\Delta_1$ generator, we introduce seven methods, $\Delta_2$--$\Delta_8$, forming a unified family of eight theorem-generation methods. items.title: Few Trials, Many Metrics: Beta Mixtures for Low-Budget AI Evaluation
items.excerpt: Evaluating a stochastic AI system often requires many repeated samples per instance, especially for metrics defined over long horizons. Recent work has shown that modeling instance-level success probabilities with a Beta distribution recovers Pass@$k$ from far fewer samples than direct estimation. items.excerpt: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have recovered interpretable, causally relevant features in robot foundation models (RFMs) such as $\pi_{0.5}$ (arXiv:2603.19183, arXiv:2603.19233). SAE features on individual instruction tokens are less interpretable than timestep-pooled ones (arXiv:2603.19183), and whether they can redirect a robot's goal remains untested. items.title: One Offset, Two Directions: Baseline Adjustment via Subgroup Offsets
items.excerpt: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) estimates advantages against the within-prompt mean reward, a baseline shared across the group. In practice, rollouts within a prompt are not always homogeneous, differing in their solution strategies and reasoning trajectories, along which they may group into subgroups. items.title: Are Fake Citations a Form of Reward Hacking? A Pre-Registered Study of Post-Training and Citation Cues
items.excerpt: Post-trained language models fabricate citations at high rates. We ask whether that is reward hacking: scoring well on a proxy for scholarship while doing worse on what it stands for. We ran four pre-registered experiments on 900 frozen questions (US federal case law, computationally adjacent scientific literature, and medical literature) across twelve open-weights checkpoints covering four post-training stages of three model families, then refit on fifteen. The clearest result holds the weights fixed and changes only the prompt. Asking for citations raises fabrication sharply in post-trained checkpoints and not in base ones: a 47.8-point interaction on twelve checkpoints (Holm-adjusted p = 2e-34) and 41.5 points on fifteen, in all three domains. A length-matched control separates the citation cue from a demand for a longer answer, so the effect is specific to citations, not verbosity. Post-training also raises fabrication overall, from 4.8% to 56.7%, but our registered prediction that it would rise most where fabrication is most tempting did not hold. items.title: A Compute Center Anyone Can Join: A Peer-to-Peer System for AI Inference
items.excerpt: Today, most people obtain AI inference by buying it from a small number of organizations that run large data centers, while many GPUs owned by individuals and small institutions sit idle for much of the day. Bitcoin showed that strangers can contribute resources under shared rules and receive checkable rewards, but it relies on an asymmetry: proof-of-work is expensive to produce and cheap to verify. Useful inference has no such asymmetry. We propose the Open Inference Market (OIM), which replaces the missing asymmetry with an economic mechanism. A worker delivers a result without knowing whether it will be audited; its unsettled earnings serve as collateral during a challenge window; and confirmed cheating forfeits all of it. We call this principle earnings as collateral. In a simplified model we show three things. The number of audits needed for deterrence is a constant per worker per day, independent of the worker's throughput, so the audited share falls as the network gets busier. items.title: Geometric Morphology Learning: Empowering Foundation Models from Structure to Spacetime Intelligence
items.excerpt: Geometry is the very form that connects space, time, and matter, serving as the fundamental fabric of the physical world, from continuous fields to discrete structures. Despite its importance, deep learning is inherently blind to geometry. Riemannian geometry stands as a well-established mathematical foundation for studying geometry, yet it remains largely incompatible with deep learning architectures. To bridge this gap, we establish a new learning framework--Geometric Morphology Learning--that learns geometric or topological structures, shapes or conformations for representation learning, reasoning and action modeling. Moving beyond early attempts limited to specific geometric priors, this theory centers on modeling the intrinsic geometry of objects and learning from such geometric or topological knowledge. Specifically, we construct a neural bundle, a unified scaffolding linking local and global structures, and formulate differentiable operators, including connection and curvature, thereby enabling the study of geometry with advanced geometric concepts such as holonomy and cohomology. items.title_zh: 几何形态学学习：赋予基础模型从结构到时空智能的能力
items.excerpt_zh: 几何是连接空间、时间和物质的形式，是物理世界的基本结构，从连续场到离散结构。尽管深度学习很重要，但它本质上对几何是盲目的。黎曼几何是研究几何的成熟数学基础，但它在很大程度上与深度学习架构不兼容。为了弥补这一差距，我们建立了一个新的学习框架——几何形态学习——学习几何或拓扑结构、形状或构象，用于表示学习、推理和动作建模。该理论超越了仅限于特定几何先验的早期尝试，集中于对对象的内在几何进行建模并从此类几何或拓扑知识中进行学习。具体来说，我们构建了一个神经束，一个连接局部和全局结构的统一脚手架，并制定了可微算子，包括连接和曲率，从而能够利用完整几何和上同调等先进的几何概念来研究几何。因此，几何形态学习开放

items.title: FB-MOAC: A Reinforcement Learning Algorithm for Forward-Backward Markov Decision Processes
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are effective in solving problems that can be modeled as Markov decision processes (MDPs). These algorithms primarily target forward MDPs whose dynamics evolve over time from an initial state. However, several important problems in different scenarios including stochastic control and network systems exhibit both a forward and a backward dynamics. As a consequence, they cannot be expressed as a standard MDP, thereby calling for a novel theory for RL in this context. Accordingly, this work introduces the concept of Forward-Backward Markov Decision Processes (FB-MDPs) for multi-objective problems, develops a novel theoretical framework to characterize their optimal solutions, and proposes a general forward-backward step-wise template that allows to adapt RL algorithms for FB-MDP problems. A Forward Backward Multi Objective Actor Critic (FB-MOAC) algorithm is introduced accordingly to obtain optimal policies with guaranteed convergence and a competitive rate with respect to standard approaches in RL. FB-MOAC is evaluated on diverse use cases in the context of mathematical finance and mobile resource
items.title_zh: FB-MOAC：一种用于前向-后向马尔可夫决策过程的强化学习算法
items.excerpt_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 算法可以有效解决可建模为马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP) 的问题。这些算法主要针对前向 MDP，其动态从初始状态随时间演变。然而，包括随机控制和网络系统在内的不同场景中的几个重要问题同时表现出前向和后向动态。因此，它们无法表达为标准的 MDP，因此需要一种新的 RL 理论。因此，这项工作引入了多目标问题的前向-后向马尔可夫决策过程 (FB-MDP) 的概念，开发了一种新颖的理论框架来表征其最佳解决方案，并提出了一种通用的前向-后向逐步模板，允许针对 FB-MDP 问题调整 RL 算法。相应地引入了前向后向多目标演员批评家 (FB-MOAC) 算法，以获得相对于 RL 中的标准方法具有保证收敛性和竞争速率的最优策略。 FB-MOAC 在数学金融和移动资源背景下的不同用例上进行评估

items.title: On the Limits of Test-Time Compute for Self-Evaluation
items.excerpt: Self-verification and aggregation have emerged as popular approaches for bridging the gap between pass@1 and pass@N. However, increasing the number of candidates does not consistently narrow the gap between final-answer accuracy and pass@N. To understand this limitation, we use ranking error to measure how reliably models distinguish their correct generations from incorrect ones. We show that ranking error admits a bias-variance decomposition, with both components shaped by algorithmic design choices and inference compute. Across our experiments, additional compute reduces variance, while bias initially decreases before approaching a plateau. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Scorpio, a simple and general method that jointly scores randomly grouped candidates. Across math, code, and puzzle benchmarks, Scorpio improves verification, tree search, and aggregation. For verification, Scorpio improves accuracy over the strongest baseline by up to 7 percentage points while matching or exceeding that baseline's peak accuracy with 17-42% lower inference cost. items.authors: Anirudh Buvanesh, Khaled Rouissi, Sujin Yun, Johan Obando-Ceron, Morgane M Moss, Samuel Lavoie, Michael Noukhovitch, Laurent Charlin, Aaron Courville
items.title_zh: 论自评测试时计算的局限性
items.excerpt_zh: 自我验证和聚合已成为弥合 pass@1 和 pass@N 之间差距的流行方法。然而，增加考生数量并不能始终缩小最终答案准确性与 pass@N 之间的差距。为了理解这一限制，我们使用排名误差来衡量模型如何可靠地区分正确的世代和错误的世代。我们表明，排名误差允许偏差-方差分解，这两个分量均由算法设计选择和推理计算决定。在我们的实验中，额外的计算减少了方差，而偏差在接近稳定状态之前最初会减少。在此分析的指导下，我们引入了 Scorpio，这是一种简单而通用的方法，可以对随机分组的候选人进行联合评分。在数学、代码和谜题基准方面，Scorpio 改进了验证、树搜索和聚合。为了进行验证，Scorpio 比最强基线的准确度提高了 7 个百分点，同时匹配或超过该基线的峰值准确度，推理成本降低了 17-42%。对于树搜索，使用 Scorpio 对部分解决方案进行评分并选择最终的解决方案

items.title: Beyond Blackwell: Constrained Data Processing Inequalities
items.excerpt: We study the comparison of statistical experiments from a decision-theoretic standpoint, working with Markov transitions as basis-free linear maps on dual spaces. Our starting observation is that the data-processing inequality, that adding noise to an experiment cannot lower its Bayes risk, is the functoriality of fibrewise minimisation over a presheaf of decision rules: the rules available after an experiment form a presheaf, garbling acts on it by precomposition, and a risk functional is a natural transformation from it to the ordered reals. The argument refers to neither probabilities nor expected values, and it survives replacing the decision presheaf by a sub-presheaf of admissible rules. Any constraint imposed on the strategy that a rule induces fairness, unbiasedness, is automatically of this form, and so yields a data-processing inequality with no counterpart in the unconstrained Blackwell theory. Our main result is their quantitative companion. items.excerpt_zh: 我们从决策理论的角度研究统计实验的比较，将马尔可夫转变用作对偶空间上的无基线性映射。我们最初的观察是，数据处理不等式，即向实验添加噪声不能降低其贝叶斯风险，是决策规则预束上纤维最小化的函数性：实验后可用的规则形成预束，通过预组合对其进行混淆，而风险函数是从它到有序实数的自然变换。该论证既不涉及概率，也不涉及期望值，并且用可接受规则的子预集替换决策预集后，它仍然存在。对规则带来公平、公正的策略施加的任何约束都会自动采用这种形式，因此会产生数据处理不平等，而在无约束的布莱克韦尔理论中没有对应物。我们的主要结果是它们的定量伴侣。对于后处理下封闭的约束，我们定义了一个约束缺陷并证明了一个约束随机化定理：一个实验在每个可接受的决策上都支配另一个实验

items.title: From Weeks to Hours: Fast and Principled SFT Data Generation for Reasoning LLMs
items.excerpt: Reasoning-oriented post-training enables large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks via multi-step inference. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on high-quality reasoning traces is a particularly efficient approach, but its effectiveness depends critically on careful data curation. Existing pipelines rely on a costly generate-then-filter paradigm: large pools of long reasoning traces are produced by multiple teacher models and subsequently filtered for difficulty and diversity using additional LLMs, often requiring weeks of computation. In this work, we propose SFTProbe, a fundamentally different approach that bypasses this pipeline by directly predicting the quality of reasoning data. We show that a brief LoRA-based adaptation, combined with evaluating loss on only 5% of each reasoning trace, suffices to estimate both difficulty and diversity. SFTProbe is grounded in a geometric view of post-training, where pretrained LLMs lie in a low-rank, anisotropic loss basin. items.title: Dataset Mismatch Matters in Group Relative Policy Optimization for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards
items.excerpt: Recently, reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is practically very important, where the leading approach is group relative policy optimization (GRPO) that typically faces a trade-off between rollout efficiency and downstream performance. To improve efficiency while preserving performance, existing selective rollout methods mainly exploit only source-side training dynamics to optimize the discrete distribution over source prompts. However, in practice, the source training dataset is rarely identically distributed to the target test dataset. When such a mismatch exists, due to legal or privacy constraints, it is usually not acceptable to share target prompts themselves with the RLVR trainer. Nevertheless, it is still possible for the target data owner to provide limited aggregated feedback from a small held-out target set without revealing target prompts or rollout traces. In this paper, we propose learning-to-reweight rollout (L2RR) that explicitly incorporates target-side performance feedback into GRPO. items.authors: Zhen-Yu Zhang, Jiandong Zhang, Huaxiu Yao, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama
items.excerpt_zh: 最近，可验证奖励（RLVR）的强化学习实际上非常重要，其中领先的方法是群体相对策略优化（GRPO），通常面临推出效率和下游性能之间的权衡。为了在保持性能的同时提高效率，现有的选择性推出方法主要仅利用源端训练动态来优化源提示上的离散分布。然而，在实践中，源训练数据集很少与目标测试数据集相同分布。当存在这种不匹配时，由于法律或隐私限制，与 RLVR 训练者共享目标提示本身通常是不可接受的。尽管如此，目标数据所有者仍然可以从一个小的保留目标集中提供有限的聚合反馈，而无需透露目标提示或推出跟踪。在本文中，我们提出了学习重新加权部署（L2RR），它将目标端性能反馈明确地纳入 GRPO 中。具体来说，L2RR 通过优化双层目标来学习源提示上的离散采样分布

items.title: Learning hidden-state dynamics from unpaired snapshots with lift-project SDEs
items.excerpt: Many systems are observed only through unpaired snapshots, with population samples available at each time point but no correspondence between samples at different times. These snapshots determine the one-time distributions but leave the temporal coupling unspecified, requiring a modeling prior to connect successive times. We propose the lift-project stochastic differential equation (SDE), an autonomous SDE on the observed coordinate and a few hidden coordinates, trained only to match the snapshots. Most existing methods, including time-dependent SDEs, Schr\"odinger bridges and optimal transport, evolve the observed coordinate alone. For a scalar observation, the classical comparison theorem implies that all such models have non-negative lagged covariance, so on data whose lagged covariance turns negative, their error has a computable floor. The lift-project SDE is not bound by this floor. items.title: The Tangled Web They Weave: Exploring Neural Representations with Directed Simplicial Complexes
items.excerpt: Understanding how artificial neural networks (ANNs) represent and combine features internally is a central challenge in mechanistic interpretability. Existing neural circuit-discovery methods represent neuron interactions as pairwise edges in a graph. But distributed neural representations consist of large groups of neurons that are inherently linked by higher-order causal dependencies: suppressing a subgroup of neurons in concert may shift the activation of other neurons in the feature representation. We propose a method to construct filtered directed simplicial complexes (DSCs) that give a topological representation of such dependencies, built from the activation profiles of an ANN on a given set of inputs. Our approach treats ANNs as structural causal models and uses counterfactual ablations to test for causal links between groups of internal neurons within specific input contexts. As a proof of concept, we apply the approach to a pair of small multilayer perceptron (MLP) architectures in a synthetic two-dimensional quadrant classification task.
