items.title: Jet-QSparse: Accelerating Agentic LLM Inference with 4-Bit Sparse Attention
items.excerpt: Long-horizon reasoning and agentic workloads strain KV-cache capacity and decode attention throughput. We present Jet-QSparse, a training-free method that combines compact NVFP4 cache storage with native FP4 query-key computation on Blackwell tensor cores. A dense scan scores the full key history and selects 128-token blocks for sparse FP16 value aggregation with FP32 accumulation, preserving higher precision in the output-forming step while enabling contiguous tile loads. Calibrated key centering and at most two BF16 pages per sequence and layer address quantization error; FP8 prefill uses a temporary arena while the persistent cache is packed directly from BF16 activations. Across four hybrid LLMs, a budget of 128 blocks per KV head shows no detected accuracy loss on the evaluated mathematical reasoning, coding, and agentic benchmarks, although some smaller budgets incur losses. With 64 blocks, Qwen3.8-27B achieves a $1.94\times$ end-to-end decode speedup over dense BF16 at 128K context and batch size 16 on one GB300, and the measured Qwen KV pools provide $2.58$-$2.76\times$ BF16's token capacity.
items.authors: Haozhan Tang, Hao Kang, Meng Lu, Yecheng Wu, Zerui Wang, Seokho Han, Haocheng Xi, Shuo Yang, Song Han, Han Cai
items.title_zh: Jet-QSparse：利用 4 位稀疏注意力加速代理 LLM 推理
items.excerpt_zh: 长视野推理和代理工作负载对 KV 缓存容量和解码注意力吞吐量造成压力。我们提出了 Jet-QSparse，这是一种免训练方法，它将紧凑的 NVFP4 缓存存储与 Blackwell 张量核心上的本机 FP4 查询键计算相结合。密集扫描对完整的密钥历史记录进行评分，并选择 128 个令牌块进行稀疏 FP16 值聚合和 FP32 累积，从而在输出形成步骤中保持更高的精度，同时启用连续的切片加载。校准键居中，每个序列最多两个 BF16 页和层地址量化误差； FP8 预填充使用临时区域，而持久缓存则直接从 BF16 激活中打包。在四个混合 LLM 中，每个 KV 头 128 个块的预算显示在评估的数学推理、编码和代理基准上没有检测到准确性损失，尽管一些较小的预算会产生损失。凭借 64 个块，Qwen3.8-27B 在 1 GB300 上以 128K 上下文和批量大小 16 的方式实现了比密集 BF16 1.94\times$ 的端到端解码加速，并且测量的 Qwen KV 池提供 2.58$-$2.76\times$ BF16 的代币容量。

items.title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
items.excerpt: Embedding models underpin virtually every modern AI system, from search engines to recommendation systems. Despite shared mathematical foundations, research on embedding models remains fragmented by modality: the communities develop largely in isolation, seldom exchanging insights. We argue that this fragmentation obscures a deeper convergence. Driven by contrastive learning, Transformer architectures, and a granularity shift, embedding research across modalities is converging toward a common set of principles, even as modality-specific challenges remain underexplored. To reason across this convergence without conflating it, we propose a framework of three progressively harder capabilities: coverage, comparability, and compositionality. Three paths toward unification satisfy these in turn: transformation broadens coverage, alignment enables comparability, and joint embedding, the terminus we advocate, aims at compositionality. This position paper traces the resulting evolution, providing the first unified, cross-cutting treatment of omnimodal embedding research.
items.authors: Ziyin Zhang, Yuyu Guo, Ying Zhang, Siqiao Xue, Zihan Liao, Jin Qin, Wenjie Yang, Siyuan Yang, Shijie Li, Cheng Chen, Hao Wu, Zhaoyang Zhu, Ruipeng Li, Zhaokun Jiang, Lei Lei, Rui Wang, Hang Yu, Rui Wang
items.title_zh: 从碎片到融合：全模态嵌入的调查和路线图
items.excerpt_zh: 嵌入模型几乎支撑着从搜索引擎到推荐系统的所有现代人工智能系统。尽管拥有共同的数学基础，但嵌入模型的研究仍然在形式上支离破碎：社区基本上是孤立发展的，很少交流见解。我们认为这种分裂掩盖了更深层次的融合。在对比学习、Transformer 架构和粒度转变的推动下，跨模态的嵌入研究正在趋向于一套共同的原则，尽管特定模态的挑战仍未得到充分探索。为了在不混淆的情况下推理这种融合，我们提出了一个由三种逐渐困难的功能组成的框架：覆盖范围、可比性和组合性。实现统一的三种路径依次满足这些要求：转换扩大覆盖范围，对齐实现可比性，而联合嵌入（我们提倡的终点）旨在组合性。这篇立场文件追踪了由此产生的演变，为全模态嵌入研究提供了第一个统一的、跨领域的处理。

items.title: Enhancing Language Model Reasoning with Structured Multi-Level Modeling
items.excerpt: Inference-time scaling enhances a model's reasoning by extending its chain-of-thought (CoT). However, existing approaches typically rely on a single policy trained with outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL), which often suffers from long-horizon plan failures where the implicit plan drifts from valid strategies, especially for small LMs with limited capacity. To address this, we propose Multi-Level Reasoning (MLR), which reformulates long-CoT generation as a two-level stochastic process. A high-level planner generates structured step descriptors specifying both the reasoning mode and the semantic subgoal. The low-level executor then produces detailed reasoning conditioned on these descriptors, forming an alternating plan--execute loop. To maintain scalability, we adopt a minimal design where the base model serves as the low-level policy and a lightweight LoRA module implements the high-level policy. For training, we observe that outcome-reward RL provides sparse and delayed feedback for long trajectories (e.g., several thousand tokens), hindering credit assignment. We therefore introduce iterative Step-DPO, a process-level prefer
items.authors: Siheng Xiong, Ali Payani, Faramarz Fekri
items.title_zh: 通过结构化多级建模增强语言模型推理
items.excerpt_zh: 推理时间缩放通过扩展其思想链 (CoT) 来增强模型的推理能力。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于经过结果奖励强化学习 (RL) 训练的单一策略，该策略经常会遭受长期计划失败的困扰，其中隐式计划偏离有效策略，特别是对于容量有限的小型 LM。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了多级推理（MLR），它将长 CoT 生成重新表述为两级随机过程。高级规划器生成结构化步骤描述符，指定推理模式和语义子目标。然后，低级执行器根据这些描述符产生详细的推理，形成交替的计划-执行循环。为了保持可扩展性，我们采用最小化设计，其中基本模型作为低级策略，轻量级 LoRA 模块实现高级策略。对于训练，我们观察到结果奖励强化学习为长轨迹（例如数千个令牌）提供稀疏且延迟的反馈，从而阻碍了信用分配。因此，我们引入迭代 Step-DPO，一种流程级首选方法

items.title: What Breaks and What Comes Back: Capability Damage and Recovery in Depth-Pruned Small Language Models
items.excerpt: Depth pruning removes whole Transformer blocks to make a language model smaller and faster, but the damage is not spread evenly across what the model can do, and a short fine-tuning run, called healing, decides what comes back. We measure this for small models used as agents. Four instruction-tuned models of 1.2-1.7B parameters (Llama-3.2-1B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and OLMo-2-1B) are pruned and healed, and six capabilities are tracked: structured output, function calling, instruction following, mathematical reasoning, safety refusal and knowledge. Three results hold across the families. First, function calling and math collapse in every model (retention 0.00-0.07 of the unpruned score), and the order in which capabilities break agrees closely across the four (Kendall's W = 0.92; 0.62 after correcting for chance floors). Second, which parameters are trained matters as much as which data: fully tuning the last three blocks instead of adding low-rank adapters to all blocks costs up to 0.18 in capped mean retention on three families, and one 300k-token pilot per scope detects this. Third, we test a planner that allocates a 1M-token he
items.authors: Piyush Dhoka, Vedant Pandhare, Varun Inamdar, Aadarsh Pathre, Pavitha Nooji
items.title_zh: 破坏和恢复：深度修剪的小语言模型中的能力损坏和恢复
items.excerpt_zh: 深度修剪删除了整个 Transformer 块，使语言模型更小、更快，但损害并没有均匀地分布在模型可以做的事情上，并且称为修复的短暂微调运行决定了返回的结果。我们针对用作代理的小模型来测量这一点。对 1.2-1.7B 参数的四个指令调整模型（Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、SmolLM2-1.7B 和 OLMo-2-1B）进行修剪和修复，并跟踪六种功能：结构化输出、函数调用、指令跟踪、数学推理、安全拒绝和知识。三个结果在整个家庭中都成立。首先，函数调用和数学在每个模型中都会崩溃（未剪枝分数的保留为 0.00-0.07），并且功能中断的顺序在四个模型中非常一致（Kendall 的 W = 0.92；校正机会层后为 0.62）。其次，训练哪些参数与哪些数据一样重要：完全调整最后三个块，而不是向所有块添加低等级适配器，三个系列的平均保留上限成本高达 0.18，每个范围的一个 300k 代币试点检测到这一点。第三，我们测试一个分配 1M 代币的规划器

items.title: Rethinking LLM Pruning via Test-Time Scaling
items.excerpt: Structured pruning reduces the size of large language models, often at the cost of lower accuracy. Whether this decline reflects diminished reasoning capacity or greater difficulty in sampling correct solutions is less clear. We examine this question across expert, FFN and layer pruning on four mathematical and coding benchmarks, comparing original and pruned models through pass@k at matched sampling budgets. Even after substantial pruning, some models match or exceed the original model's reasoning coverage despite lower pass@1, and solve problems left unsolved in the original samples. Retaining broad coverage, however, does not mean that correct solutions remain easy to obtain. Under severe pruning, diverse generated chain-of-thought (CoT) traces can coexist with increased repetition and less reliable generation. As correct answers become harder to sample, the additional attempts can sharply increase total token use even when individual responses become shorter. This separation between coverage and sampling efficiency also clarifies expert-selection gains, as methods with markedly different pass@1 can solve the same problems at large
items.title_zh: 通过测试时间缩放重新思考 LLM 修剪
items.excerpt_zh: 结构化剪枝可以减小大型语言模型的大小，但通常会以降低准确性为代价。这种下降是否反映了推理能力的下降或采样正确解决方案的难度加大，目前尚不清楚。我们在四个数学和编码基准上通过专家、FFN 和层剪枝来研究这个问题，通过 pass@k 在匹配的采样预算下比较原始模型和剪枝模型。即使经过大量修剪，一些模型尽管 pass@1 较低，但仍然匹配或超过原始模型的推理覆盖率，并解决了原始样本中未解决的问题。然而，保持广泛的覆盖面并不意味着仍然容易获得正确的解决方案。在严格的修剪下，不同的生成的思想链（CoT）痕迹可以与增加的重复和不太可靠的生成共存。随着正确答案变得越来越难以采样，即使单个响应变得更短，额外的尝试也会急剧增加总令牌使用量。覆盖率和采样效率之间的这种分离也阐明了专家选择的收益，因为具有明显不同的 pass@1 的方法可以解决大部分相同的问题

items.title: TopoSteer: Topological Layer Selection for Activation Steering in LLMs
items.excerpt: Activation steering controls large language models at inference time by adding a vector to their internal representations. Most work asks how to build that vector, and far less attention has gone to where to add it, even though steering at a poorly chosen layer can be worse than not steering at all. Prior selectors choose a layer without ever steering the model to test it: they score how separable the target behavior is at that layer, and how consistently the individual examples point along the steering direction. We argue that what matters is not the separability of the two activation clouds, nor the alignment of individual displacements with their mean, but the extent of the cloud of per-example displacements that mean-difference steering averages. We propose a topology-based layer selection method, called TopoSteer, which scores a layer by the total H_0 persistence of its displacement cloud, computed as the length of the cloud's Euclidean minimum spanning tree. We show that the score focuses on the displacement cloud's relative geometry, while class separation affects it only through standardization. We also provide a theoretical e
items.authors: Tuc Nguyen, Marcos Guti\'errez-del-Pozo, Eduardo Paluzo-Hidalgo, Yifan Hu, Adaku Uchendu, Thai Le
items.excerpt_zh: 激活引导通过向其内部表示添加向量来在推理时控制大型语言模型。大多数工作都询问如何构建该向量，而很少关注将其添加到何处，尽管在选择不当的层上进行转向可能比根本不进行转向更糟糕。先前的选择器选择一个层，而无需引导模型来测试它：他们对目标行为在该层的可分离程度以及单个示例沿引导方向指向的一致性进行评分。我们认为，重要的不是两个激活云的可分离性，也不是单个位移与其平均值的对齐，而是均值差转向平均的每个示例位移云的范围。我们提出了一种基于拓扑的层选择方法，称为 TopoSteer，该方法通过其位移云的总 H_0 持久性对层进行评分，计算为云的欧几里德最小生成树的长度。我们表明，分数集中于位移云的相对几何形状，而类分离仅通过标准化影响它。 We also provide a theoretical e
items.title_zh: TopoSteer：法学硕士中激活转向的拓扑层选择

items.title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
items.excerpt: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without verbalizing every intermediate reasoning step. Experiments on agentic math and QA benchmarks show that TAC-CoT improves accuracy by up to 8.8 points while reducing model forward passes by up to 6.8x. Furthermore, analyses show that TAC-CoT improves tool-use quality in both single- and multi-tool settings.
items.authors: Juseon Do, Sangmin Bae, Jeesu Jung, Hwanjun Song
items.title_zh: TAC-CoT：通过交错显式令牌实现工具授权的隐式思维链
items.excerpt_zh: 基于 LLM 的代理系统越来越多地与 CoT 推理相结合，以解决需要准确推理、外部知识和多步骤审议的任务。然而，显式 CoT 会产生大量的生成开销，而隐式 CoT（用紧凑的连续标记取代文本原理）自然不支持代理工具使用所需的显式通信接口。我们提出了 TAC-CoT，一种工具赋能的自适应隐式 CoT 框架，它用紧凑的潜在推理片段取代显式推理轨迹，同时仅保留工具调用、观察和最终答案的文本标记。这种交错的设计可以实现代理工具的使用，而无需用语言描述每个中间推理步骤。代理数学和 QA 基准测试表明，TAC-CoT 将准确性提高了 8.8 分，同时将模型前向传递次数减少了 6.8 倍。此外，分析表明，TAC-CoT 提高了单工具和多工具设置中的工具使用质量。

items.title: Consolidating Reasoning with Test-Time Training
items.excerpt: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires finalizing solutions from reasoning that is distributed across the individual attempts of many agents. However, useful intermediate reasoning can remain unexploited when collaboration is limited to voting on conclusions reached among individual agents, or aggregating long, noisy collections of reasoning trajectories in context. In this work, we propose TTT-Consolidate, a framework that uses multi-agent reasoning trajectories as adaptation data to improve a model's subsequent reasoning. TTT-Consolidate jointly consolidates trajectories into parametric representations through test-time training, then generates a new solution by conditioning on the consolidated information. We meta-learn how to consolidate using bi-level optimization at training time, where an inner loop encodes reasoning trajectories into a lightweight LoRA adapter, and an outer loop learns meta-parameters for the inner loop such that the consolidation is helpful for the model to synthesize a final solution. As no large-scale corpus of diverse reasoning trajectories exists for training aggregation methods, we construct the Op

items.excerpt_zh: 有效的多智能体协作需要通过分布在许多智能体的单独尝试中的推理来最终确定解决方案。然而，当协作仅限于对各个代理之间达成的结论进行投票，或在上下文中聚合长而嘈杂的推理轨迹集合时，有用的中间推理可能仍未被利用。在这项工作中，我们提出了 TTT-Consolidate，一个使用多智能体推理轨迹作为适应数据来改进模型后续推理的框架。 TTT-Consolidate 通过测试时训练将轨迹联合合并为参数表示，然后通过合并信息生成新的解决方案。我们元学习如何在训练时使用双层优化进行整合，其中内循环将推理轨迹编码到轻量级 LoRA 适配器中，外循环学习内循环的元参数，以便整合有助于模型合成最终解决方案。由于不存在用于训练聚合方法的大规模不同推理轨迹的语料库，我们构建了 Op

items.title: FOLLIE: Automated Reasoning over the First Dataset of Sentences with their First-Order Logical Representation for French
items.excerpt: FOLLIE (for First-Order Logic for Language Inference and Entailment for French) connects French sentences, compositional first-order representations and automated natural language inference (NLI). The first French NLI-ready, NL-to-FOL resource, it contains 19,983 inference records and 36,987 non-empty sentence-slot--formula mappings from six heterogeneous NLI sources, retaining French lexical material and source problem structure. Its silver annotations are produced by a neural--symbolic pipeline, with 111 separately identified LLM-assisted additions. The construction combines morphosyntactic analysis, probability-conditioned categorial multitagging, grammatical proof search, discourse representation and first-order semantic construction. Stage-wise experiments show substantial gains in derivation coverage; analyses of conjunction distributions, logical-operator incidence and scope alternation characterise the resulting resource. We then develop an automatic inference engine whose input-conditioned background theories address lexical relations, quantification, quantities, event structure and temporal dependencies. items.title: Free energy of the Hopfield model at every temperature and loading ratio
items.excerpt: Proved · Mathematical statistical mechanics · with GPT 6 Astra, Fable 5.1 · significance 32/100. In the Hopfield model, N spins \sigma\in\{-1,1\}^N interact through M_N independent uniform \pm1 patterns x^1,\ldots,x^{M_N}, with free energy F_N(\beta)=\frac1N\log\int\exp\big(\frac{\beta}{2N}|X_N^\top\sigma|^2\big)\,dP_N(\sigma). In the extensive-storage regime M_N/N\to\alpha\in(0,\infty), Amit, Gutfreund and Sompolinsky derived a replica phase diagram (1985-1987), and rigorous results (Bovier, Gayrard, Picco; Pastur, Shcherbina, Tirozzi; Talagrand) covered only high temperature, small \alpha
items.title_zh: Hopfield 模型在每个温度和负载比下的自由能

items.title: Equality of the Mirković-Vilonen and theta bases (Kamnitzer's conjecture)
items.excerpt: Proved · Geometric representation theory; cluster algebras · with ChatGPT-6-Pro (with Codex; reviewed by Rethlas-OSV) · significance 25/100. Let G be a connected complex semisimple group and N a maximal unipotent subgroup. \mathbb{C}[N] carries the Mirković-Vilonen (MV) basis, from MV cycles in the affine Grassmannian via geometric Satake (Baumann-Kamnitzer-Knutson), and the theta basis of Gross-Hacking-Keel-Kontsevich for its cluster structure. Kamnitzer's ICM 2022 report closes its cluster-algebra section with the conjecture: the MV and theta bases for \mathbb{C}[N] coincide. Do they?

items.title: Morel's purity conjecture for A^1-homotopy sheaves of pure S^1-spectra
items.excerpt: Disproved · Algebraic K-theory, motivic homotopy theory · with GPT-6 Astra; Claude Opus 5.5 · significance 15/100. Let S be a separated noetherian scheme of finite Krull dimension. Call an S^1-spectrum over S pure if it lies in the smallest triangulated subcategory of the stable \mathbb A^1-homotopy category containing the suspension spectra of smooth projective S-schemes and closed under arbitrary coproducts and retracts; call a Nisnevich sheaf on \mathrm{Sm}_S pure if Zariski and Nisnevich cohomology agree and cohomology is insensitive, in a range of degrees, to removing closed subsets of high codimension.
items.title_zh: 纯 S^1 谱的 A^1-同伦滑轮的莫雷尔纯度猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 用 GPT-6 Astra 反驳了·代数 K 理论、动机同伦理论；克劳德作品 5.5 · 重要性 15/100。令 S 为有限克鲁尔维数的分离诺特格式。如果 S^1-谱位于 S 上的纯谱，则它位于稳定 \mathbb A^1-同伦范畴的最小三角子范畴中，该范畴包含平滑射影 S-方案的悬置谱，并且在任意余积下闭合并回缩；如果 Zariski 和 Nisnevich 上同调一致并且上同调在一定程度上对删除高余维的闭子集不敏感，则称 \mathrm{Sm}_S 上的 Nisnevich 束为纯。

items.title: Updates from the AHM: guidelines on doctoral advising
items.excerpt: “We are happy to announce that the Teaching Working Group of the Association for Human Mathematics wrote a set of recommendations on doctoral advising aimed at departments, advisors, and students. The document contains five guidelines centered on prioritizing human-authored writing, avoiding overreliance on AI, confronting the ethical concerns of AI use, and improving the wellbeing of students, as well as concrete proposals on how to implement them. […]”
items.excerpt_zh: “我们很高兴地宣布，人类数学协会的教学工作组针对院系、导师和学生编写了一套关于博士生咨询的建议。该文件包含五项指导方针，重点是优先考虑人类撰写的写作、避免过度依赖人工智能、面对人工智能使用的道德问题、改善学生的福祉，以及如何实施这些建议的具体建议。[…]”
items.title_zh: AHM 的更新：博士生咨询指南

items.title: Comparisons of benchmark equivalence relations
items.excerpt:
We determine all Borel-reducibility comparisons within the family of benchmark equivalence relations in Gao's monograph, enlarged by the universal treeable relation $E_{\infty T}$ and its countable power $E_{\infty T}^\omega$. We prove $E_\infty^\omega\leq_B c_0$, $E_\infty
leq_B\ell_p$ for $2 <\infty$, $\ell_p
leq_B{\equiv_m}$ for $2 <\infty$, $c_0
leq_B{\equiv_m}$, $c_0
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$, and $\equiv_m
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$. Together with the classical result, these give $\ell_p\leq_B{\equiv_m}$ exactly when $p\leq2$. The same methods show that $E_{\infty T}$ is incomparable with every $\ell_p$, $1\leq p<\infty$. The comparisons answer questions recorded in Gao's monograph and Kanovei's monograph. We also prove that unitary equivalence of all bounded linear operators is not Borel reducible to $\equiv_m$, answering a question of Ding and Gao. Equivalently, unitary equivalence of arbitrary representations of $F_\infty$ is strictly more complicated than that of arbitrary representations of $\mathbb Z$, answering a question of Thomas.
items.title_zh: 基准等价关系比较
items.excerpt_zh:
我们确定了高专着中基准等价关系族中的所有 Borel 约简性比较，并通过通用可树关系 $E_{\infty T}$ 及其可数幂 $E_{\infty T}^\omega$ 进行了放大。我们证明$E_\infty^\omega\leq_B c_0$，$E_\infty
leq_B\ell_p$对于$2 <\infty$，$\ell_p
leq_B{\equiv_m}$对于$2 <\infty$，$c_0
leq_B{\equiv_m}$， $c_0
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$ 和 $\equiv_m
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$。与经典结果一起，这些给出的 $\ell_p\leq_B{\equiv_m}$ 恰好等于 $p\leq2$。同样的方法表明$E_{\infty T}$与每个$\ell_p$、$1\leq p<\infty$是不可比的。这些比较回答了高的专着和卡诺维的专着中记录的问题。我们还证明了所有有界线性算子的酉等价性不能将 Borel 简化为 $\equiv_m$，回答了 Ding 和 Gau 的问题。同样，$F_\infty$ 的任意表示的酉等价严格地比 $\mathbb Z$ 的任意表示的酉等价更复杂，这回答了 Thomas 的问题。

items.title: A law of the iterated logarithm for random multiplicative functions on integers with a large prime factor
items.excerpt: Let $f$ be a Rademacher random multiplicative function supported on the squarefree integers. We investigate the almost sure fluctuations of the restricted sum $M^{>}(x)=\sum_{n\le x;~ P(n)>x^{1/2}}f(n)$, where $P(n)$ is the largest prime factor of $n$. With $Q(x)$ being the conditional variance of $M^{>}(x)$ given the values of $f$ at primes not exceeding $x^{1/2}$, we prove that, almost surely, the upper and lower limits of $M^{>}(x)(2Q(x)\log\log Q(x))^{-1/2}$ as $x\to\infty$ are $1$ and $-1$, respectively. Furthermore, it is shown that the almost sure cluster set of the normalized sum is $[-1,1]$.
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $f$ 为无平方整数上支持的 Rademacher 随机乘法函数。我们研究了限制和 $M^{>}(x)=\sum_{n\le x;~ P(n)>x^{1/2}}f(n)$ 的几乎确定的波动，其中 $P(n)$ 是 $n$ 的最大素因子。由于 $Q(x)$ 是 $M^{>}(x)$ 的条件方差，给定质数处的 $f$ 值不超过 $x^{1/2}$，我们几乎可以肯定地证明，$M^{>}(x)(2Q(x)\log\log Q(x))^{-1/2}$ 作为 $x\to\infty$ 的上限和下限分别为 $1$ 和 $-1$。此外，表明归一化和的几乎确定的簇集是$[-1,1]$。
items.title_zh: 具有大质因数的整数上的随机乘法函数的迭代对数定律

items.title: Integral Brauer--Manin Obstruction for Fermat Near Misses
items.excerpt: We study the integral Hasse principle for the affine surfaces given by $x^4+y^4-w^2=m^2$, where $m>1$ is odd and squarefree. We give a criterion to determine if there is an integral Brauer--Manin obstruction, which depends only on simple congruence conditions on the prime factors of $m$ modulo $8$. We use this to show that for $100\%$ of such surfaces there is no integral Brauer--Manin obstruction to the Hasse principle for integral points.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究 $x^4+y^4-w^2=m^2$ 给出的仿射曲面的积分哈斯原理，其中 $m>1$ 是奇数且无平方。我们给出了一个判断是否存在积分布劳尔-马宁障碍的标准，该标准仅取决于 $m$ 模 $8$ 的质因数的简单同余条件。我们用它来表明，对于 $100\%$ 的此类曲面，积分点的哈斯原理不存在积分布劳尔-马宁障碍。
items.title_zh: 积分布劳尔--费马差点的马宁阻碍

items.title: A Local Fourier-Transform Proof of Offen's Spherical Transfer Theorem
items.excerpt: Let $E/F$ be an unramified quadratic extension of non-archimedean local fields of characteristic zero and odd residual characteristic. Offen proved that, on the full spherical space of nondegenerate Hermitian matrices, equality of the Hironaka and Satake transforms implies Jacquet--Ye matching. We give a purely local proof of this theorem. The argument combines Jacquet's compatibility of matching with Fourier transform, the Godement--Jacquet functional equation, and Hironaka's scalar functional equation for Hermitian zeta integrals. The local proof recovers Jacquet's spherical-Hecke fundamental lemma from the unit case.
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $E/F$ 为特征零和奇残差特征的非阿基米德局部场的未分支二次扩展。 Offen 证明，在非简并 Hermitian 矩阵的全球面空间上，Hironaka 和 Satake 变换的等式意味着 Jacquet-Ye 匹配。我们给出这个定理的纯局部证明。该论证结合了 Jacquet 匹配与傅立叶变换的兼容性、Godement-Jacquet 函数方程以及 Hironaka 的 Hermitian zeta 积分标量函数方程。局部证明从单位情况中恢复了 Jacquet 的球形-Hecke 基本引理。
items.title_zh: 奥芬球面传递定理的局部傅立叶变换证明

items.title: Erd\H{o}s--Straus Conjecture: Modular Inversion in Mordell Classes
items.excerpt: We examine modular inversion of strict Grid certificates in a ceiling continued-fraction construction for the Erd\H{o}s--Straus equation. The six Mordell classes modulo $840$ form four inversion orbits. Prime-input pattern frequencies in the pairs $121 \leftrightarrow361 $ and $289 \leftrightarrow 529$ have equal asymptotic limits for every fixed cutoff.
items.title_zh: Erd\H{o}s--斯特劳斯猜想：Mordell 类中的模逆
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了 Erd\H{o}s-Straus 方程的上限连分数构造中严格网格证书的模反演。六个莫德尔级模 $840$ 形成四个反转轨道。 $121 \leftrightarrow361 $ 和 $289 \leftrightarrow 529$ 对中的素数输入模式频率对于每个固定截止值具有相同的渐近限制。

items.title: Clusters of primes revisited
items.excerpt: We revisit the generalized Rayleigh quotient optimization problem related to the Maynard-Tao sieve with the goal of finding a more efficient function basis. We demonstrate that a family based on products of reciprocals, previously used in asymptotic estimates for $H_m = \liminf_{n \to \infty}(p_{n+m}-p_n)$, provides results that are close to the theoretical limits of the sieve across many regimes. In particular, we establish $H_2 \leq 31 \, 140$, $H_3 \leq 2 \, 560 \, 022$, $H_4 \leq 193 \, 672 \, 056$, and $H_5 \leq 13 \, 659 \, 045 \, 840$. We also show that, as $k \to \infty$, the related variational quantity $M_k$, introduced by Maynard, satisfies the lower bound $M_k \geq \log k - 0.273572 + o(1)$.
items.title_zh: 重新审视素数簇
items.excerpt_zh: 我们重新审视与 Maynard-Tao 筛相关的广义瑞利商优化问题，目标是找到更有效的函数基础。我们证明，基于倒数乘积的族（之前用于 $H_m = \liminf_{n \to \infty}(p_{n+m}-p_n)$ 的渐近估计）提供的结果在许多范围内都接近筛子的理论极限。特别是，我们建立 $H_2 \leq 31 \, 140$，$H_3 \leq 2 \, 560 \, 022$，$H_4 \leq 193 \, 672 \, 056$ 和 $H_5 \leq 13 \, 659 \, 045 \, 840$。我们还表明，当 $k \to \infty$ 时，Maynard 引入的相关变分量 $M_k$ 满足下界 $M_k \geq \log k - 0.273572 + o(1)$。

items.title: A spectral theory of zeta functions of function fields
items.excerpt: We study Hilbert spaces constructed from the Weil quadratic form associated with the zeta function of a curve over a finite field, together with self-adjoint extensions of the differentiation operator on these spaces. For a distinguished family of these extensions, we prove that the eigenvalues converge to the ordinates of the zeros of the zeta function and that the corresponding entire spectral functions, after normalization, converge locally uniformly to an infinite product determined by these zeros. These limits occur as the interval parameter approaches a finite endpoint, rather than infinity as in the setting of the Riemann zeta function. We also realize the global Hilbert space through the Rosati trace pairing and show that translation by $\log q$ is unitarily equivalent to multiplication by normalized Frobenius. This provides a geometric model for the analogous analytic constructions associated with the Riemann zeta function.
items.title_zh: 函数场 zeta 函数的谱理论
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究由与有限域上的曲线 zeta 函数相关的 Weil 二次形式构造的希尔伯特空间，以及这些空间上微分算子的自伴随扩展。对于这些扩展的杰出族，我们证明特征值收敛到 zeta 函数零点的纵坐标，并且相应的整个谱函数在归一化后局部均匀地收敛到由这些零点确定的无限乘积。当区间参数接近有限端点时，就会出现这些限制，而不是像黎曼 zeta 函数设置中那样无穷大。我们还通过 Rosati 迹配对实现了全局希尔伯特空间，并证明 $\log q$ 的平移统一等价于归一化 Frobenius 的乘法。这为与黎曼 zeta 函数相关的类似解析结构提供了一个几何模型。

items.title: Weil Operators and Remainders of Anderson Generating Functions over a Punctured Projective Line
items.excerpt: Let $A_\rho$ be the coordinate ring of the projective line over $\Fq$ with a closed point of degree $N$ removed. We give finite formulas for higher Weil operators in a basis of Riemann--Roch spaces, which recover the formulas of Hu--Ou--Yang when $N=1$. We identifythese operators with representatives of the residue Casimir tensors and obtain a determinant formula for the Weil pairing, relative to a chosen determinant realization. For a normalized rank-one Drinfeld module, we compute the remainder of its Anderson generating function modulo any nonconstant $p\in A_\rho$. The formula includes multiple zeros and a zero at the ordinary point at infinity. Its last coefficient is a nonzero scalar multiple of an exponential division value. When $(p)$ is a finite principal prime, a value of the associated special function at one zero of $p$ generates the torsion field after adjoining that zero. We give an explicit $q$-linear formula recovering a torsion generator from this value. We also specialize the evaluation theorem of Gazda--Maurischat and compute the different as the principal ideal $(\partial_xp)$.
items.authors: Chuangqiang Hu, Xiao-Min Huang, Guorui Ma
items.title_zh: 穿刺射影线上的韦尔算子和安德森余数生成函数
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $A_\rho$ 为 $\Fq$ 上的投影线的坐标环，并删除了 $N$ 度的闭点。我们给出了Riemann-Roch空间基上的高Weil算子的有限公式，恢复了$N=1$时Hu--Ou--Yang的公式。我们用残差卡西米尔张量的代表来识别这些算子，并获得相对于所选行列式实现的 Weil 配对的行列式公式。对于归一化的一阶 Drinfeld 模块，我们计算其安德森生成函数对任何非常数 $p\in A_\rho$ 取模的余数。该公式包括多个零和无穷远普通点处的零。它的最后一个系数是指数除法值的非零标量倍数。当 $(p)$ 是有限主素数时，$p$ 的一个零处的相关特殊函数的值在邻接该零后生成挠场。我们给出了一个显式的 $q$-线性公式，从该值恢复扭转发生器。我们还专门研究了 Gazda--Maurischat 的评估定理，并计算不同的主理想 $(\partial_xp)$。

items.title: Positive Values of Inhomogeneous Quadratic Forms of Type (1, 4): The Constant \Gamma_{1,4} = 8
items.excerpt: Let Q be a real indefinite quadratic form of type (1, 4) with determinant D \neq 0. We prove that for every c \in \mathbb{R}^5 there exists x \in \mathbb{Z}^5 such that 0 < Q(x + c) \le (8|D|)^{1/5}, and that the constant 8 is optimal. This establishes a conjecture of Bambah, Dumir and Hans-Gill and, together with earlier work, completes the determination of the sharp constants \Gamma_{r,s} for positive inhomogeneous values of nondegenerate indefinite quadratic forms. The proof combines classical reduction and gap theorems with uniform bounds for circular gaps of quadratic residues. A central step identifies the exceptional parameters in certain resonant reduced families: an explicit ladder of integer witnesses resolves their punctured neighbourhoods, leaving only three rational parameter points, subject to stated coefficient conditions. These are treated by retaining the coupling in a preceding, less reduced form. The remaining covering statements are verified by finite certificates in exact rational arithmetic.
items.title_zh: (1, 4) 型非齐次二次形式的正值：常数 \Gamma_{1,4} = 8
items.excerpt_zh: 令 Q 为 (1, 4) 型实数不定二次形式，行列式 D \neq 0。我们证明对于每个 c \in \mathbb{R}^5 都存在 x \in \mathbb{Z}^5 使得 0 < Q(x + c) \le (8|D|)^{1/5}，并且常数 8 是最优的。这建立了 Bambah、Dumir 和 Hans-Gill 的猜想，并与早期的工作一起，完成了非简并不定二次型正非齐次值的尖锐常数 \Gamma_{r,s} 的确定。该证明将经典归约和间隙定理与二次留数的圆形间隙的统一界限结合起来。一个核心步骤是识别某些共振简化族中的特殊参数：整数见证人的显式阶梯解决了其被刺破的邻域，仅留下三个合理参数点，受规定的系数条件影响。通过将耦合保留在先前的、较少简化的形式中来处理这些问题。其余的覆盖语句通过精确有理算术中的有限证书进行验证。

items.title: A Winner Classification for Rooted Partizan Edge Geography on Heterogeneous Bouquets of Cycles
items.excerpt: We consider an undirected edge-traversal game on a finite bouquet of simple cycles. Each of two players controls a token, both tokens begin at the common root, and the players alternate traversing edges that have not been used by either token. A player with no legal move loses. We prove that the first player wins precisely when the number of cycles of odd edge-length is odd, without assuming equal cycle lengths. The proof uses a simultaneous induction on root and defense configurations, with an exact analysis of the forced race between two opened cycles. We also explain how the classification corresponds to a completed Lean 4 formalization of the underlying game on finite edge sets.
items.title_zh: 异质周期花束上根源游击边缘地理的优胜者分类
items.excerpt_zh: 我们考虑在有限的简单循环束上进行无向边缘遍历游戏。两个玩家中的每一个控制一个令牌，两个令牌都从公共根开始，并且玩家交替遍历两个令牌都没有使用过的边。没有合法动作的玩家就输了。我们证明，当奇数边长的周期数为奇数时，第一个玩家获胜，而不假设周期长度相等。该证明使用对根和防御配置的同时归纳，并对两个开放周期之间的强制竞争进行精确分析。我们还解释了分类如何对应于有限边缘集上基础游戏的完整 Lean 4 形式化。

items.title: Sharp bounds, stability, and arithmetic fluctuations for induced pentagons
items.excerpt: We prove that every graph with $m>0$ edges contains at most $\frac{3}{2\sqrt{2}}(\frac{m}{5})^{5/2}$ induced pentagons. Equality holds precisely for balanced blow-ups of the Clebsch graph, together with isolated vertices. The bound and equality classification extend to arbitrary nonnegative vertex weights and to all graphons, including fractional graphons. Moreover, a deficit of $\varepsilon$ in the normalized ratio can be repaired by $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon}m)$ edge edits on the original vertex set, producing an exactly balanced Clebsch blow-up and isolates. The exponent $1/2$ is optimal. We further separate the linear cost of adjacency errors from the quadratic cost of class imbalance. This yields an arithmetic description of the finite-edge deficit and its explicit second-order term, with a uniform power-saving remainder. For each fixed integer $j$, the exact extremal count at $m=40k^2+j$ is eventually an integer coefficient polynomial in $k$, computable by a finite enumeration; we do not quantify its threshold of validity. The proof combines global variational conditions, an active-density bound, and an exact rational certificate on
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明每个具有 $m>0$ 边的图最多包含 $\frac{3}{2\sqrt{2}}(\frac{m}{5})^{5/2}$ 诱导五边形。等式恰好适用于 Clebsch 图的平衡放大以及孤立的顶点。边界和等式分类扩展到任意非负顶点权重和所有图元，包括分数图元。此外，归一化比率中 $\varepsilon$ 的缺陷可以通过对原始顶点集进行 $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon}m)$ 边缘编辑来修复，从而产生精确平衡的 Clebsch 放大和隔离。指数 $1/2$ 是最佳的。我们进一步将邻接错误的线性成本与类不平衡的二次成本分开。这产生了有限边缘赤字及其显式二阶项的算术描述，以及统一的节能余数。对于每个固定整数$j$，$m=40k^2+j$处的精确极值计数最终是$k$中的整数系数多项式，可通过有限枚举计算；我们不量化其有效性阈值。该证明结合了全局变分条件、活性密度界和精确有理证明
items.title_zh: 诱导五边形的锐界、稳定性和算术涨落

items.title: Four runners that are barely lonely
items.excerpt: For positive integers $v_1,\dots,v_n$ let $\mathrm{ML}(v_1,\dots,v_n)=\max_t\min_i\|v_it\|$, where $\|x\|$ is the distance to the nearest integer. Kravitz asked which values below $1/n$ occur. For $n=4$, Jain and Kravitz showed that the values below $1/4$ are $m/(4m+2)$, $m\ge2$, up to finitely many undetermined exceptions. We settle the four-runner case completely. A primitive quadruple has $\mathrm{ML}<1/4$ if and only if it is, up to order, $\{1,2,3,4k\}$, or $\{x,y,x+y,x+2y\}$ with $\gcd(x,y)=1$ and $y\not\equiv x,2x\pmod 4$, or $\{1,3,4,14\}$. The values below $1/4$ are exactly $m/(4m+2)$ with $m\ge2$, $m\ne3$, so $3/14$ is the only exception, and Conjecture 4.1 of Fan and Sun holds. A density lemma bounds the length of a quadruple on neither critical subtorus by $512$, and an exact search over 800,816,099 quadruples completes the proof. The same method shows that the two-dimensional subtori of $(\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^4$ with loneliness below $2/5$ take exactly the three-runner values in that range, which between $1/3$ and $2/5$ are the fractions $p/q$ with $1\le 2q-5p\le 4$. Hence the accumulation points of the four-runner spec
items.authors: Hyunjun Yi, Karam Gill, Bryan Bu
items.title_zh: 四位并不孤单的跑步者
items.excerpt_zh: 对于正整数 $v_1,\dots,v_n$ 令 $\mathrm{ML}(v_1,\dots,v_n)=\max_t\min_i\|v_it\|$，其中 $\|x\|$ 是到最近整数的距离。 Kravitz 询问哪些值低于 $1/n$。对于 $n=4$，Jain 和 Kravitz 表明低于 $1/4$ 的值是 $m/(4m+2)$、$m\ge2$，最多有有限多个未确定的异常。我们彻底解决了四人案件。原始四元组的 $\mathrm{ML}<1/4$ 当且仅当其在阶上为 $\{1,2,3,4k\}$ 或 $\{x,y,x+y,x+2y\}$ 且 $\gcd(x,y)=1$ 且 $y\not\equiv x,2x\pmod 4$ 或 $\{1,3,4,14\}$ 时。 $1/4$ 以下的值恰好是 $m/(4m+2)$，其中 $m\ge2$、$m\ne3$，因此 $3/14$ 是唯一的例外，Fan 和 Sun 的猜想 4.1 成立。密度引理将两个关键 subtorus 上的四元组的长度限制为 $512$，并且对 800,816,099 个四元组的精确搜索完成了证明。同样的方法表明，孤独度低于 $2/5$ 的 $(\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^4$ 的二维 subtori 恰好采用该范围内的三轮值，其中 $1/3$ 和 $2/5$ 之间是分数 $p/q$ 与 $1\le 2q-5p\le 4$。因此四轮规格的累积点

items.title: Asymptotic stability of clique-saturating edges near Tur\'an thresholds
items.excerpt: Let $f_{p+1}(n,m)$ denote the minimum number of $K_{p+1}$-saturating edges in an $n$-vertex $K_{p+1}$-free graph with $m$ edges. In this paper, we investigate the stability of this parameter near the Tur\'an thresholds, with particular emphasis on the role of the minimum degree. We introduce the refined parameter $f_{p+1,p}(n,m,\delta)$. It is defined for $K_{p+1}$-free graphs on $n$ vertices with $m$ edges, minimum degree $\delta$, and containing at least a copy of $K_p$. For every fixed integer $p\ge3$, we establish a stability result when the number of edges is $\mathrm{ex}(n,K_p)+o(n^2)$, showing that \[ f_{p+1,p} (n,m,\delta)=\left(\frac{(p-2)^2}{2(p-1)^3}+o(1)\right)n^2, \ \text{for }\ m=\mathrm{ex}(n,K_p)+o(n^2), \ \delta\geq \left(\frac{p-2}{p-1}+o(1)\right)n. \] We further obtain a stability theorem in the regime where the number of edges is quadratically smaller than $\operatorname{ex}(n,K_{p+1})$. More precisely, for $0 \leq c< \frac{1}{2p(3p-1)}$, \[ f_{p+1,p} (n,m,\delta)=\left(\frac{1}{2p}+o(1)\right)n^2, \ \text{for }\ m=\operatorname{ex}(n,K_{p+1})-(c+o(1))n^2, \ \delta\geq \left(\frac{p-1}{p}-2c+o(1)\right)n. \]

items.title: The Hibi--Li (2016) conjecture is fully resolved
items.excerpt: Hibi and Li conjectured that the order polytope $\mathcal{O}(P)$ of a finite poset $P$ has at most as many faces of each dimension as its chain polytope $\mathcal{C}(P)$, and that equality in some dimension $k$ with $1\leq k\leq|P|-1$ forces the two polytopes to be unimodularly equivalent. Fourier proved the inequality in a 2026 preprint. Let $X$ be the five-element poset in which an element lies above two incomparable elements and below two other incomparable elements. Building on Fourier's proof, we show that if an $n$-element poset contains $X$ as an induced subposet, then, for every $k$ with $2\leq k\leq n-1$, its chain polytope has at least $\binom{n-3}{k-2}$ more $k$-dimensional faces than its order polytope, and that for every $n\geq5$ some $n$-element poset containing $X$ attains all these bounds at once. Since Hibi and Li showed that $\mathcal{O}(P)$ and $\mathcal{C}(P)$ are unimodularly equivalent exactly when $P$ does not contain $X$, this proves the equality statement for these $k$. items.title: Anti-concentration and Graham's rearrangement problem in finite abelian groups
items.excerpt: Let $S$ be a subset of $n$ elements of a group $G$. An ordering $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ of its elements is valid if the partial sums $x_1,x_1+x_2,\ldots,x_1+\cdots+x_n$ are pairwise distinct. This notion has a long history in combinatorial group theory, dated back to Gordon's works in early 1960. Alspach-Liversidge conjecture asserts that any subset of the nonzero elements of a finite abelian group $G$ has a valid ordering. This generalizes Graham's conjecture, which considers the case when the group $G$ is $\mathbb{F}_p$, the cyclic group of prime order. Graham's conjecture has been solved recently, as a combination of results by Kravitz, Bedert and Kravitz, M\"uyesser and Pokrovskiy, Bedert, Buci\'c, Kravitz, Montgomery, and M\"uyesser, and Pham and Sauermann. Beside this, the only other case where Alspach-Liversidge conjecture has been confirmed is $G=\mathbb{F}_2^k$, thanks to a recent result by Bedert, Buci\'c, Kravitz, Montgomery, and M\"uyesser. We prove the Alspach-Liversidge conjecture in its full generality. Our proof combines ideas from many previous papers. In particular, we will use the probabilistic approach and the absorption

items.title: The Cranston--Li--Su--Wang--Xu (2026) conjecture is true
items.excerpt: Let $A$ be a finite abelian group. A nowhere-zero $A$-flow of a graph gives every edge a direction and a non-zero value in $A$, so that at every vertex the sum of the values on the entering edges equals the sum on the leaving edges. Such a flow can be changed along a cycle: going around the cycle, add a fixed non-zero element of $A$ to the value of every edge that points forward and subtract it from the value of every edge that points backward. The Cranston--Li--Su--Wang--Xu (2026) conjecture states that if $A$ has at least four elements, then in every graph in which all degrees are even, any two nowhere-zero $A$-flows are joined by a chain of such changes through nowhere-zero $A$-flows. It also states that, for every integer $k\ge 4$, the same holds for integer flows whose values are between $1$ and $k-1$ in absolute value, where each change adds a non-zero integer. We prove this conjecture. items.title_zh: Cranston--Li--Su--Wang--Xu (2026)猜想成立

items.title: Foatic Homomesy
items.excerpt: Using a unified method of identifying a telescoping function for each statistic-action pair, we prove conjectures of La Croix and Roby, and of Sheridan-Rossi that various permutation statistics, such as the number of fixed points, are homomesic under Foatic actions: compositions of the Foata bijection and dihedral symmetries of one-line notation. Underlying these results is a family of bijective identities relating permutation statistics across the Foata bijection; one of them --- an unexpected invariance of the number of right-to-left minima under reverse-complement, proved by an explicit bijection --- may be of independent interest. The telescoping functions also turn out to be shared among some Foatic actions, implying that mixing certain actions still yields a constant average on closed walks.
items.title_zh: 泡沫同质性
items.excerpt_zh: 使用一种统一的方法来识别每个统计-动作对的伸缩函数，我们证明了 La Croix 和 Roby 以及 Sheridan-Rossi 的猜想，即各种排列统计量（例如固定点的数量）在 Foatic 动作下是同源的：Foata 双射和单行符号的二面体对称性的组合。这些结果的基础是一系列与 Foata 双射排列统计相关的双射恒等式；其中之一——反向补码下从右到左最小值数量的意外不变性，由显式双射证明——可能具有独立的意义。伸缩函数也被一些 Foatic 动作所共享，这意味着混合某些动作仍然会在封闭行走中产生恒定的平均值。

items.title: Tate and Artin--Tate Motivic Tensor-Triangular Geometry
items.excerpt: We compute the Balmer spectra of geometric Tate and Artin--Tate motives with $\mathbb{F}_p$-coefficients over any field whose characteristic differs from $p$. For Tate motives, we find the bigraded comparison map to be a homeomorphism to the homogeneous spectrum of the motivic cohomology of the base field. For Artin--Tate motives, we describe the spectrum as a gluing of the spectrum of Artin motives computed by Balmer--Gallauer with the punctured Tate spectrum. We determine all specialisations between these pieces and the resulting topology. Under the hypothesis that the spectrum of rational Tate motives is a singleton, we also compute the integral Tate spectrum after inverting the exponential characteristic of the base field. As a consequence of our results, we identify the punctured Tate spectrum as an open subspace of the spectrum of the category of geometric Voevodsky motives, and draw some conclusions concerning the latter. Finally, we include an appendix where we define generalised periodicity in the context of tensor-triangular geometry, and explore its applications in motivic settings.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在特征不同于 $p$ 的任何场上使用 $\mathbb{F}_p$ 系数计算几何 Tate 和 Artin--Tate 动机的巴尔默谱。对于泰特动机，我们发现二级比较图是基场动机上同调的齐次谱的同胚。对于 Artin--Tate 动机，我们将谱描述为 Balmer--Gallauer 计算出的 Artin 动机谱与刺穿的 Tate 谱的粘合。我们确定这些部分和最终拓扑之间的所有专业化。在有理泰特动机谱是单例的假设下，我们还计算了基域指数特征求逆后的积分泰特谱。根据我们的结果，我们将刺穿的泰特谱识别为几何 Voevodsky 动机类别谱的开放子空间，并得出有关后者的一些结论。最后，我们包括一个附录，我们在张量三角形几何的背景下定义广义周期性，并探索其在动机设置中的应用。
items.title_zh: 泰特和阿廷--泰特动机张量-三角形几何

items.title: Integral Hodge structures and atoms of fourfolds
items.excerpt: Following the recent work by OpenAI on the irrationality of very general cubic fourfolds in Hassett divisors, we prove some compatibility of Iritani's blow-up formula with the classical blow-up decomposition of integral Hodge structures. As a consequence, we express OpenAI's birational invariant in terms of the theory of atoms developped by Katzarkov--Kontsevich--Pantev--Yu. We also show that, for every smooth complex rational cubic fourfold, the primitive cohomology is isometric as an integral Hodge structure to the twisted middle cohomology of a K3 surface and we prove irrationality of the very general Verra fourfold.
items.excerpt_zh: 继 OpenAI 最近对哈塞特除数中非常一般的三次四重的无理性进行研究之后，我们证明了 Iritani 的爆炸公式与积分 Hodge 结构的经典爆炸分解的某些兼容性。因此，我们用 Katzarkov-Kontsevich-Pantev-Yu 提出的原子理论来表达 OpenAI 的双有理不变量。我们还证明，对于每个光滑复有理三次四重，原上同调作为积分 Hodge 结构与 K3 曲面的扭曲中上同调是等距的，并且我们证明了非常一般的 Verra 四重的非理性。
items.title_zh: 积分 Hodge 结构和四重原子

items.title: Truncated Grassmannians: polytopes, representations, and Cauchy formulas
items.excerpt: The goal of this paper is to develop algebraic and combinatorial techniques for studying the geometric properties of truncated Grassmannians, a class of algebraic varieties obtained via certain projections of classical Grassmannians within their Pl\"ucker embeddings. We introduce a class of cyclic representations of maximal parabolic subalgebras of the general linear Lie algebra, which are proved to serve as duals of the homogeneous components of coordinate rings of truncated Grassmannians. We prove that the characters of these representations are computed via truncated Cauchy formulas and establish a connection with coordinate rings of complete collineations. We also construct monomial bases of these representations in terms of certain generalized chain polytopes and use the RSK correspondence to establish connections with Cauchy-type formulas and with Gelfand--Tsetlin patterns.
items.title_zh: 截断的格拉斯曼函数：多胞形、表示和柯西公式
items.excerpt_zh: 本文的目标是开发代数和组合技术来研究截断格拉斯曼量的几何性质，截断格拉斯曼量是通过经典格拉斯曼量在其 Pl\"ucker 嵌入中的某些投影获得的一类代数簇。我们引入了一类一般线性李代数的最大抛物线子代数的循环表示，它们被证明可以作为截断的坐标环的齐次分量的对偶。我们证明了这些表示的特征是通过截断的柯西公式计算的，并与完全共线的坐标环建立了联系。我们还根据某些广义链多胞形构造了这些表示的单项式基，并使用 RSK 对应关系与柯西型公式和 Gelfand-Tsetlin 模式建立了联系。

items.title: Uniformization of compact K\"ahler Threefolds of Zero Kodaira Dimension
items.excerpt: Given two smooth compact K\"ahler threefolds $X$ and $Y$ whose universal covers are biholomorphic, we show that $\kappa(X) = 0$ if and only if $\kappa(Y) =0$.
items.title_zh: 紧凑型 K\"ahler 三倍零小平维的均匀化
items.excerpt_zh: 给定两个光滑紧凑的 K\"ahler 三重 $X$ 和 $Y$，其通用覆盖是双全纯的，我们证明 $\kappa(X) = 0$ 当且仅当 $\kappa(Y) =0$。

items.title: Hyperelliptic curves on $(1,d)$ abelian surfaces for $d\leq 15$
items.excerpt: Bryan, Oberdieck, Pandharipande and Yin predicted the number of hyperelliptic curves on general abelian surfaces under a transversality condition. Some of the numbers have already been confirmed. In this paper we construct singular hyperelliptic curves on $(1,d)$ polarised abelian surfaces for $d\leq 15$ confirming a few predicted numbers, namely of (geometric) genus $g=d$ and of geometric genus $k+3$ on $(1,2k)$ and $(1,2k+1)$ polarised surfaces. Moreover, we have found that all genus 7 hyperelliptic curves on general $(1,8)$ polarised surfaces are double coverings of curves locally embedded into $(1,4)$ polarised surfaces. More interestingly, there is a unique genus 9 hyperelliptic curve (up to translation) locally embedded into a general $(1,12)$ polarised surface and it is a Klein covering of a curve locally embedded into a $(1,3)$ polarised surface.
items.authors: Pawe{\l} Bor\'owka, Paolo Grossi, Anatoli Shatsila
items.title_zh: $d\leq 15$ 的 $(1,d)$ 阿贝尔曲面上的超椭圆曲线
items.excerpt_zh: Bryan、Oberdieck、Pandharipande 和 Yin 预测了横截条件下一般阿贝尔曲面上的超椭圆曲线的数量。其中一些数字已经得到确认。在本文中，我们在 $(1,d)$ 极化阿贝尔曲面上构造 $d\leq 15$ 的奇异超椭圆曲线，确认了一些预测数字，即 $(1,2k)$ 和 $(1,2k+1)$ 极化曲面上的（几何）亏格 $g=d$ 和几何亏格 $k+3$。此外，我们发现一般$(1,8)$偏振面上的所有属7超椭圆曲线都是局部嵌入到$(1,4)$偏振面上的曲线的双重覆盖。更有趣的是，有一条独特的9型超椭圆曲线（直到平移）局部嵌入到一般的$(1,12)$偏振表面中，并且它是局部嵌入到$(1,3)$偏振表面中的曲线的克莱因覆盖。

items.title: Rational curves of submaximal quantum index
items.excerpt: On a complex toric surface, oriented real rational curves tangent to the toric boundary at real points are distinguished by their value of quantum index. Using variants of usual Welschinger multiplicities, G. Mikhalkin defined enumerative invariants $W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}$ that are provided by a signed count of oriented real rational curves with given quantum index $\kappa$ and fixed tangency points on the boundary of the positive quadrant (the tangency orders being encoded by $\tilde{\Delta}$). We prove that, for most toric surfaces and tangency orders, the invariant $W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}$ is zero in the case of the highest nonmaximal value of $\kappa$. This is done by enumerating tropical curves with Block--G\"ottsche multiplicities. Additionally, we prove that, in many situations, the lower bound, given by the absolute value $|W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}|$ of $W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}$, for the number of oriented real rational curves is not sharp close to the tropical limit in the case of the highest nonmaximal value of $\kappa$.
items.title_zh: 次极大量子指数有理曲线
items.excerpt_zh: 在复杂的复曲面上，在实点处与复曲面边界相切的定向实有理曲线通过其量子指数值来区分。使用通常的韦尔辛格多重性的变体，G. Mikhalkin 定义了枚举不变量 $W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}$，这些不变量由具有给定量子索引 $\kappa$ 和正象限边界上的固定切点的定向实有理曲线的有符号计数提供（切线顺序由 $\tilde{\Delta}$ 编码）。我们证明，对于大多数复曲面和相切阶，在 $\kappa$ 最高非极大值的情况下，不变 $W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}$ 为零。这是通过枚举具有 Block--G\"ottsche 多重性的热带曲线来完成的。此外，我们证明，在许多情况下，由 $W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}$ 的绝对值 $|W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}|$ 给出的下界，对于有向实有理曲线的数量，在最高非最大值的情况下并不急剧接近热带极限。 $\kappa$。

items.title: An atomic approach to Shokurov's conic-bundle conjecture
items.excerpt: In this paper, we apply a weaker version of Hodge atoms to show that a standard conic bundle over a smooth complex projective rational surface $S$ is irrational if $|2K_S+\Delta|\ne\emptyset$, where $\Delta$ is the discriminant divisor. This proves Shokurov's conjecture on rationality of conic bundle threefolds. As an application, we deduce precisely which nodal quartic double solids are rational.
items.authors: Leonardo F. Cavenaghi, Ludmil Katzarkov, Daniel Pomerleano, Zhijia Zhang
items.title_zh: 肖库洛夫圆锥束猜想的原子方法
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们应用霍奇原子的较弱版本来证明，如果 $|2K_S+\Delta|\ne\emptyset$ ，则光滑复射影有理曲面 $S$ 上的标准圆锥丛是无理数，其中 $\Delta$ 是判别除数。这三重证明了肖库洛夫关于圆锥丛合理性的猜想。作为一个应用，我们精确地推导了哪些节点四次双固体是有理数。

items.title: Odd-Degree Rigidity and a Numerical Characterization of Complete Flag Varieties
items.excerpt: Let $F=G/B$ be the complete flag variety of a connected semisimple complex linear algebraic group. We prove that if a smooth Fano variety $X$ has the same dimension and Picard number as $F$, then the existence of a continuous map $X\to F$ of odd topological degree implies $X$ is isomorphic to $F$. In particular, a smooth Fano variety homotopy equivalent to $F$ is isomorphic to $F$. The algebraic input is a numerical characterization of complete flags: a positive-dimensional smooth Fano variety $X$ is a complete flag variety if and only if its pseudoindex $\iota_X$ is at least two and ${\rm ker}({\rm Sym}^2N^1(X)_{\mathbb R}\to N^2(X)_{\mathbb R})$ contains a positive-definite quadratic form. The pseudoindex condition can equivalently be replaced by the divisibility of $-K_X$ by two in ${\rm Pic}(X)$. The key observation is that a single definite quadratic relation excludes surfaces in every fiber of any elementary contraction; standard contraction theorems then yield smooth ${\mathbb P}^1$-fibrations and the characterization of complete flags applies. For the odd-degree theorem, Poincar\'e duality and a mod-two Wu-class argument show
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $F=G/B$ 为连通半单复线性代数群的完全标志簇。我们证明，如果光滑 Fano 簇 $X$ 与 $F$ 具有相同的维数和皮卡德数，则奇拓扑度的连续映射 $X\to F$ 的存在意味着 $X$ 与 $F$ 同构。特别是，等价于 $F$ 的光滑 Fano 簇同伦与 $F$ 同构。代数输入是完全标志的数值表征：正维平滑 Fano 簇 $X$ 是完全标志簇当且仅当其伪索引 $\iota_X$ 至少为 2 并且 ${\rm ker}({\rm Sym}^2N^1(X)_{\mathbb R}\to N^2(X)_{\mathbb R})$ 包含正定二次形式。伪索引条件可以等效地替换为 ${\rm Pic}(X)$ 中 $-K_X$ 能被 2 整除。关键的观察结果是，单个确定的二次关系排除了任何基本收缩的每个纤维中的表面；标准收缩定理然后产生平滑的${\mathbb P}^1$-纤维并且应用完整标志的表征。对于奇次定理，庞加莱对偶性和模二吴级论证表明
items.title_zh: 完整旗帜品种的奇数刚性和数值表征

items.title: Analysis of Triggered Packet Streams: Stochastic Bounds on System Time under General Triggering Delays
items.excerpt: Many emerging communication systems increasingly involve devices that transmit packets in multiple causally dependent stages as part of an internal workflow, rather than waiting for receiver feedback. To analyze such systems, we recently introduced the $\mathrm{M^T/G/1}$ queue, in which primary customers arrive according to an exogenous Poisson process, and each triggers a secondary customer to join the queue after an independent random delay, called the \textit{triggering delay}. Our prior heuristic approximations assume identical exponential service times, and our matrix-analytic framework assumes exponential triggering delays. However, no exact analysis is available when both distributions are general. In this paper, we derive stochastic bounds, in the usual stochastic order, on the system-time distribution of each customer class under general triggering-delay and service-time distributions. The service times within each primary--secondary pair may be generally dependent. Using sample-path coupling and level-crossing arguments, we show that the stationary workload is stochastically sandwiched between those of two classical queues:
items.authors: Mehran Rahnamania, Michel Mandjes, Farid Ashtiani
items.title_zh: 触发数据包流分析：一般触发延迟下系统时间的随机界限
items.excerpt_zh: 许多新兴通信系统越来越多地涉及在多个因果相关阶段传输数据包的设备，作为内部工作流程的一部分，而不是等待接收器反馈。为了分析此类系统，我们最近引入了$\mathrm{M^T/G/1}$队列，其中主要客户根据外生泊松过程到达，并且每个客户在独立的随机延迟（称为\textit{触发延迟}）后触发次要客户加入队列。我们之前的启发式近似假设相同的指数服务时间，并且我们的矩阵分析框架假设指数触发延迟。然而，当两个分布都是一般分布时，无法进行精确分析。在本文中，我们以通常的随机顺序导出了一般触发延迟和服务时间分布下每个客户类别的系统时间分布的随机界限。每个主-辅对内的服务时间通常可以是相关的。使用样本路径耦合和水平交叉参数，我们表明固定工作负载随机地夹在两个经典队列之间：

items.title: Martingale Representation in Counting-Process Filtrations via Poisson Embedding
items.excerpt: We revisit martingale representation for counting processes using the Poisson embedding, deriving the representation in their natural filtration from that of the underlying Poisson random measure. Our approach combines Poisson Malliavin calculus with the Clark-Ocone and Mecke formulas. We first characterize measurability with respect to the counting-process filtration through the structure of the Malliavin derivative. We show that any random variable measurable in the counting-process filtration is invariant with respect to the auxiliary mark on the acceptance region obtained from the Poisson embedding method and vanishes on the rejection region. We then prove that every square-integrable martingale in this smaller filtration consequently admits a unique stochastic integral representation with respect to the compensated counting process: the integrand is explicitly characterized as the conditional expectation of the Malliavin derivative, which identifies as the conditional effect of an additional accepted event on the terminal functional. Additionally, we define the mirroring counting process which counts the rejected events in the Po
items.authors: Caroline Hillairet, Thibaut Mastrolia, Anthony R\'eveillac
items.title_zh: 通过泊松嵌入进行计数过程过滤的 Martingale 表示
items.excerpt_zh: 我们使用泊松嵌入重新审视用于计数过程的鞅表示，从底层泊松随机度量的自然过滤中导出表示。我们的方法将泊松马利亚文微积分与克拉克-奥科内和梅克公式相结合。我们首先通过 Malliavin 导数的结构来表征计数过程过滤的可测量性。我们证明，在计数过程过滤中可测量的任何随机变量相对于通过泊松嵌入方法获得的接受区域上的辅助标记是不变的，并且在拒绝区域上消失。然后，我们证明，在这个较小的过滤中，每个平方可积鞅都允许关于补偿计数过程的唯一随机积分表示：被积函数被明确地描述为 Malliavin 导数的条件期望，它被识别为附加接受事件对终端泛函的条件影响。此外，我们定义了镜像计数过程，用于对 Po 中的拒绝事件进行计数。

items.title: Strong solvability and its failure for critical SDEs
items.excerpt: We revisit the construction of strong solutions to singular SDEs by compactness on Wiener space. For spatially varying diffusion coefficients, assuming sufficiently small form bounds on the drift and diffusion gradient, we use basic energy estimates and an extended compactness criterion for Wiener functionals to construct an approximation-independent stochastic flow of homeomorphisms. Both forward and inverse maps have local Sobolev moment bounds, and the resulting strong solutions are pathwise unique in a class of solutions satisfying a Krylov estimate. We also show that the endpoint critical condition $b\in L^\infty_tL^d_x$, together with $\mathrm{div } b=0$ does not guarantee the existence of a strong solution. For every $d\geq2$, we construct a SDE with a divergence-free drift in this class and an additive Brownian noise, started from the origin, has a weak solution unique in law, but no strong solution. The proof uses logarithmic rescaling to characterize strong solvability by whether the sample measures of an associated stationary diffusion are Dirac masses. Positivity of the top Lyapunov exponent, combined with random SRB theor
items.title_zh: 关键 SDE 的强可解性及其失败
items.excerpt_zh: 我们重新审视通过维纳空间上的紧致性构建奇异 SDE 的强解。对于空间变化的扩散系数，假设漂移和扩散梯度的形式界限足够小，我们使用基本能量估计和维纳泛函的扩展紧性准则来构造同胚的近似独立随机流。正向和逆向映射都具有局部 Sobolev 矩界限，并且所得的强解在满足 Krylov 估计的一类解中是路径唯一的。我们还表明，端点临界条件 $b\in L^\infty_tL^d_x$ 与 $\mathrm{div } b=0$ 一起并不能保证强解的存在。对于每个$d\geq2$，我们构造一个在此类中具有无散漂移和加性布朗噪声的SDE，从原点开始，具有法律上唯一的弱解，但没有强解。该证明使用对数重新缩放来通过相关平稳扩散的样本测量是否是狄拉克质量来表征强可解性。顶部 Lyapunov 指数的正性，与随机 SRB 理论相结合

items.title: Efficient Importance Sampling of Brownian Motion Avoiding Poissonian Obstacles for Long Time
items.excerpt: We design and analyze an efficient importance sampling estimator of the probability that, over a long time horizon, a Brownian particle avoids obstacles of a fixed radius placed according to an independent Poisson random field. Donsker and Varadhan identify the exponential decay rate of this probability as the optimal balance between the volume cleared of obstacles and the spectral cost of confinement, and the confinement results of Sznitman and Povel show that the particle survives by localizing its path in a ball of (roughly) deterministic radius but with a random center. This strategy makes direct Monte Carlo exponentially ineffective over long horizons, and makes a practical yet asymptotically optimal sampler non-trivial to design, since the sampler must track the random region swept out by the path. For every fixed dimension \(d\ge2\) and every fixed obstacle radius, we construct a sequential importance sampler that is unbiased and asymptotically optimal. The full algorithm has finite expected total work at every fixed horizon, and both its expected work and the coefficient of variation grow at most subexponentially with the time
items.authors: Jose Blanchet, Paul Dupuis, Hao Liu
items.title_zh: 布朗运动的高效重要性采样避免长时间的泊松障碍
items.excerpt_zh: 我们设计并分析了一种有效的重要性采样估计器，该估计器的概率是，在很长一段时间内，布朗粒子避开根据独立泊松随机场放置的固定半径的障碍物。 Donsker 和 Varadhan 将这种概率的指数衰减率确定为清除障碍物的体积与限制的光谱成本之间的最佳平衡，而 Sznitman 和 Povel 的限制结果表明，粒子通过将其路径定位在半径（大致）确定但具有随机中心的球中而得以生存。这种策略使得直接蒙特卡洛在长范围内呈指数级无效，并且使得实用且渐近最优的采样器的设计变得非常重要，因为采样器必须跟踪路径扫过的随机区域。对于每个固定维度 \(d\ge2\) 和每个固定障碍物半径，我们构造一个无偏且渐近最优的顺序重要性采样器。完整的算法在每个固定范围内的预期总工作量是有限的，并且其预期工作量和变异系数最多随时间呈次指数增长

items.title: A Model for Fast Mining Blockchains
items.excerpt: We study a Markovian model for a blockchain mining process. In the limit where there is an infinite number of miners, the model satisfies a functional law of large numbers due to Barbour and Luczac (2008), leading to an infinite set of coupled ODEs characterising the blockchain heights. We show that the sequence of solutions to this system converges uniformly, to a limiting profile in an appropriate comoving frame. Utilising asymptotic arguments inspired by Brunet and Derrida (1997), we derive an explicit expression for the position of the travelling front, which exhibits a leading order logarithmic Bramson correction in time. For a finite number of miners, we further derive a correction to the travelling speed which is logarithmic in the number of miners. Finally, by application of a computation due to Ablowitz and Zeppetella (1979), we identify that, for a specific choice of the travelling speed, the Painlev\'e integrable, travelling wave solution of the Fisher-KPP equation with drift accurately matches our limiting profile. Our results are supported by numerical simulations.
items.authors: Rhys Bowden, Cengiz Gazi, Jan de Gier, Peter Taylor
items.title_zh: 快速挖掘区块链的模型
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究区块链挖掘过程的马尔可夫模型。在矿工数量无限的情况下，该模型满足 Barbour 和 Luczac (2008) 提出的大数函数定律，从而产生表征区块链高度的无限耦合 ODE 集合。我们证明了该系统的解序列均匀地收敛到适当的共动框架中的极限轮廓。利用受 Brunet 和 Derrida (1997) 启发的渐近论证，我们推导了行进锋位置的显式表达式，它表现出时间上的前导对数布拉姆森校正。对于有限数量的矿工，我们进一步推导了对移动速度的修正，该修正是矿工数量的对数。最后，通过应用 Ablowitz 和 Zeppetella (1979) 的计算，我们发现，对于特定的行进速度选择，带有漂移的 Fisher-KPP 方程的 Painlev 可积行波解与我们的极限轮廓精确匹配。我们的结果得到了数值模拟的支持。

items.title: Cutoff for random Cayley graphs of finite groups
items.excerpt: We study the random walk on a Cayley graph of a finite group whose generators are chosen independently and uniformly at random. We show that, for every finite group, the walk exhibits cutoff with high probability whenever the number of generators is large compared with the logarithm of the order of the group but small compared with every positive power of it. The cutoff time is the time at which the expected entropy of the walk comes close to its maximum, and in general it depends on the structure of the group. This settles a conjecture of Aldous and Diaconis.
items.title_zh: 有限群随机凯莱图的截止
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究有限群凯莱图上的随机游走，该群的生成器是独立且均匀随机选择的。我们证明，对于每个有限群，当生成器的数量与该群的阶数的对数相比较大但与它的每个正幂相比较小时，游走就会以高概率表现出截止。截止时间是步行的预期熵接近最大值的时间，通常取决于群体的结构。这解决了奥尔德斯和迪亚科尼斯的猜想。

items.title: Strong well-posedness for cyclic catalytic reaction--diffusion SPDEs with mutation and immigration
items.excerpt: We study cyclic catalytic stochastic reaction-diffusion systems with mutation and immigration. The equations have square-root catalytic coefficients and spatially colored noise. Under a condition requiring the cyclic inward drift to dominate the corresponding noise covariance, we establish global strong well-posedness for nonnegative initial states. Our approach combines positivity-preserving approximations, uniform energy estimates, and a concave power entropy that controls the occupation of states near zero. These boundary estimates allow us to derive a Hellinger stability inequality for two synchronized weak variational solutions, yielding pathwise uniqueness directly in this solution class. We then use joint compactness of the approximating solutions and their driving noise, together with martingale identification and the Gyongy-Krylov criterion, to construct a probabilistically strong solution on the prescribed Wiener space.
items.title_zh: 循环催化反应的强适定性--具有突变和迁移的扩散SPDE
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究具有突变和迁移的循环催化随机反应扩散系统。这些方程具有平方根催化系数和空间有色噪声。在要求循环向内漂移主导相应噪声协方差的条件下，我们为非负初始状态建立了全局强适定性。我们的方法结合了保正近似、统一能量估计和控制状态占据接近于零的凹功率熵。这些边界估计使我们能够导出两个同步弱变分解的海林格稳定性不等式，从而直接在该解类中产生路径唯一性。然后，我们使用近似解及其驱动噪声的联合紧性，以及鞅识别和 Gyongy-Krylov 准则，在规定的维纳空间上构建概率强的解。

items.title: Tracy Widom law for sample covariance matrices under quadratic form concentration
items.excerpt: We study sample covariance matrices formed from i.i.d., centered, isotropic random vectors $q_1, \dots, q_N \in \mathbb{R}^M$, whose coordinates are allowed to be dependent. We assume the random vectors satisfy a concentration bound for their quadratic forms $q_i^T A q_i$. Under this assumption, we establish edge universality and obtain the Tracy--Widom law for the largest eigenvalue of the sample covariance matrix after appropriate centering and scaling. In particular, our result removes the unconditionality assumption in existing edge universality results for log-concave ensembles~\cite{BX}, resolving the question that originally motivated our work. The concentration assumption also allows us to extend the result beyond the log-concave class.
items.title_zh: 二次形式浓度下样本协方差矩阵的 Tracy Widom 定律
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究由 i.i.d.、居中、各向同性随机向量 $q_1, \dots, q_N \in \mathbb{R}^M$ 形成的样本协方差矩阵，其坐标允许相互依赖。我们假设随机向量满足其二次形式 $q_i^T A q_i$ 的浓度界限。在此假设下，我们建立边缘普适性，并在适当的居中和缩放后获得样本协方差矩阵最大特征值的Tracy--Widom定律。特别是，我们的结果消除了对数凹系综现有边缘普遍性结果中的无条件假设~\cite{BX}，解决了最初激发我们工作的问题。浓度假设还允许我们将结果扩展到对数凹类之外。

items.title: Adversarial Wronskians: A proof of the Kung--Traub conjecture
items.excerpt: We prove the Kung--Traub conjecture: a deterministic stationary root-finding method without memory, using at most $n$ real scalar function or derivative evaluations per iteration, cannot have local order greater than $2^{n-1}$ on every real analytic function with a simple zero. For $n\geq2$, the bound is attained by the methods of Kung and Traub. The local estimate is required at every sufficiently close starting point, with constants that may depend on the function. Evaluation points and derivative orders may be chosen adaptively, and the rules for choosing them and processing the data are unrestricted. The proof uses a localisation property of polynomial Wronskians to obtain a lower bound at each fixed scale. A diagonal construction then gives one entire function, with derivative bounded above and below on the real line, for which every larger order fails. We also obtain a sharper bound when evaluations are made in prescribed groups, and prove the corresponding result for complex scalar evaluations. The results of this paper are also formally verified in Lean.
items.title_zh: 对抗性朗斯基主义者：Kung-Traub 猜想的证明
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了 Kung--Traub 猜想：一种没有记忆的确定性平稳求根方法，每次迭代最多使用 $n$ 实标量函数或导数评估，在每个具有简单零的实解析函数上不能具有大于 $2^{n-1}$ 的局部阶数。对于 $n\geq2$，通过 Kung 和 Traub 的方法获得界限。在每个足够接近的起点处都需要局部估计，其常数可能取决于函数。评估点和导数阶数可以自适应地选择，并且选择它们和处理数据的规则不受限制。该证明使用多项式 Wronskians 的本地化属性来获得每个固定尺度的下界。然后，对角线构造给出一个完整的函数，其导数在实线上和下界为界，对于该函数，每个较大的订单都会失败。当在规定的组中进行评估时，我们还获得了更清晰的界限，并证明了复杂标量评估的相应结果。这篇论文的结果也在Lean中得到了形式化的验证。

items.title: The nodally bound-preserving finite element method for the transport equation
items.excerpt: Numerical approximations of transport problems, even when stabilised, often violate the bounds respected by the exact solution. Depending on the problem being solved, this can produce non-physical results, such as negative densities or higher-than-unity concentrations. Various bound-preserving numerical methods exist, yet they are usually either conditionally stable or only first-order accurate. In this context, the present work extends the nodally bound-preserving finite element method to the linear transport equation. As a baseline discretisation we use the least-squares finite element method, which is instrumental in achieving unconditional stability for second-order time stepping. It also leads to symmetric algebraic systems, thereby enabling simple, efficient solvers, which we further enhance through Anderson acceleration. Unconditional stability is proved for the backward Euler and Crank--Nicolson discretisations. We also derive error estimates for the fully discrete second-order scheme and provide various numerical examples, including two-phase incompressible flows.
items.authors: Nicol\'as Espinoza-Contreras, Gabriel Barrenechea, Douglas Pacheco
items.title_zh: 输运方程的节点守界有限元法
items.excerpt_zh: 运输问题的数值近似，即使稳定了，也常常违反精确解所遵循的界限。根据要解决的问题，这可能会产生非物理结果，例如负密度或高于单位的浓度。存在各种保界数值方法，但它们通常要么是条件稳定的，要么只是一阶精确的。在这种情况下，目前的工作将节点守界有限元方法扩展到线性输运方程。作为基线离散化，我们使用最小二乘有限元方法，这有助于实现二阶时间步进的无条件稳定性。它还导致了对称代数系统，从而实现了简单、高效的求解器，我们通过安德森加速进一步增强了这一点。证明了向后的欧拉和克兰克-尼科尔森离散化的无条件稳定性。我们还推导了完全离散二阶方案的误差估计，并提供了各种数值示例，包括两相不可压缩流。

items.title: Meshless Latent Dynamics Models for Model Order Reduction of time-dependent Partial Differential Equations
items.excerpt: Latent dynamics learning has emerged as a prominent approach for Model Order Reduction (MOR) of time-dependent, parameterized Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). Traditional autoencoder-based approaches are intrinsically tied to fixed spatial discretizations during both training and inference, motivating the development of meshless methodologies. In this context, conditioning provides a natural mechanism for representing temporal evolution through spatially continuous functions, enabling mesh-agnostic Latent Dynamics Models (LDMs). In this work, we introduce a unified mathematical framework for mesh-agnostic LDMs based on conditioning in Neural Fields (NeFs). Leveraging a taxonomy of conditioning mechanisms (weak, strong, and pure), we formulate meshless LDMs as NeFs conditioned on a latent state. We establish a Universal Approximation Theorem (UAT) for this class of models and analyze their stability by deriving Lipschitz bounds for different conditioning mechanisms. Our analysis reveals an expressivity--stability trade-off, providing insight into why more expressive conditioning, despite its higher representational capacity, can
items.authors: Lorenzo Tomada, Federico Pichi, Gianluigi Rozza
items.excerpt_zh: 潜在动态学习已成为瞬态参数化偏微分方程 (PDE) 模型降阶 (MOR) 的重要方法。传统的基于自动编码器的方法在训练和推理过程中本质上与固定空间离散化相关，从而推动了无网格方法的发展。在这种情况下，调节提供了一种通过空间连续函数表示时间演化的自然机制，从而实现与网格无关的潜在动力学模型（LDM）。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个基于神经场（NeF）调节的网格不可知 LDM 的统一数学框架。利用调节机制的分类（弱、强和纯），我们将无网格 LDM 制定为以潜在状态为条件的 NeF。我们为此类模型建立了通用逼近定理（UAT），并通过推导不同调节机制的 Lipschitz 界限来分析其稳定性。我们的分析揭示了表达性与稳定性的权衡，从而深入了解为什么更具表达性的条件反射尽管具有更高的表征能力，但可以
items.title_zh: 用于时变偏微分方程模型降阶的无网格潜在动力学模型

items.title: Robust edge multiscale space based hybrid Schwarz preconditioner for high-frequency Helmholtz problems
items.excerpt: We develop a novel hybrid Schwarz method, termed the robust edge multiscale space based hybrid Schwarz method (REMs-HS), for the efficient solution of high-frequency Helmholtz problems. The method combines a one-level restricted additive Schwarz preconditioner with impedance transmission conditions (RAS-imp) and an edge multiscale (EMs) coarse solver in a multiplicative way. A key ingredient of our construction is a modified impedance boundary condition (mIBC), which is imposed both on the subdomain problems and on the local problems that generate the EMs coarse space. Compared with the original impedance boundary condition, the mIBC makes the proposed method both stable and inexpensive theoretically. We prove that the resulting REMs-HS preconditioner gives rise to a uniform convergent fixed-point iteration for large wavenumbers. Moreover, the required resolution conditions are substantially relaxed. Only a mild condition on the level parameter $\ell$ of the hierarchical coarse basis $\ell>\frac{1}{2}\log_2 k$ is needed, which is markedly weaker than the conditions in previous analyses. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the
items.authors: Shubin Fu, Shihua Gong, Guanglian Li, Yulei Liao
items.title_zh: 用于高频亥姆霍兹问题的基于鲁棒边缘多尺度空间的混合施瓦茨预处理器
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了一种新颖的混合施瓦茨方法，称为基于鲁棒边缘多尺度空间的混合施瓦茨方法（REMs-HS），用于有效解决高频亥姆霍兹问题。该方法以乘法方式将单级受限加性 Schwarz 预处理器与阻抗传输条件 (RAS-imp) 和边缘多尺度 (EM) 粗求解器相结合。我们构建的一个关键要素是修改后的阻抗边界条件 (mIBC)，它既适用于子域问题，也适用于生成 EM 粗空间的局部问题。与原始阻抗边界条件相比，mIBC 使得该方法在理论上既稳定又廉价。我们证明，由此产生的 REMs-HS 预处理器可以针对大波数产生均匀收敛的定点迭代。此外，所需的解决条件也大大放宽。仅需要对层次粗基 $\ell>\frac{1}{2}\log_2 k$ 的水平参数 $\ell$ 施加温和的条件，这明显弱于之前分析中的条件。大量的数值实验证明了

items.title: A Good-Vorticity Low-Regularity Integrator for the Inviscid Oldroyd--B System with Stress Diffusion
items.excerpt: We establish sharp convergence results for a sequential semi-implicit good-vorticity integrator for the two-dimensional inviscid Oldroyd--B system with stress diffusion on the torus. For exact solutions satisfying $u\in C_tB^{1+\alpha}_{\infty,1}$ and $\tau\in C_tB^\alpha_{\infty,1}\cap L^1_tB^{2+\alpha}_{\infty,1}$, $0\le\alpha\le2$, we prove convergence in the critical norms $B^1_{\infty,1}\times B^0_{\infty,1}$, uniformly over the time nodes on every finite interval where these regularity assumptions hold, including the critical endpoint $\alpha=0$. For $0<\alpha\le2$, we obtain the rate $O(h^{\alpha/2})$ without any additional time H\"older assumption, reaching first order at $\alpha=2$. These algebraic exponents are optimal for this Eulerian scheme over the stated solution classes, as shown by fixed-data lower bounds in the case $a=b=0$ with nonzero velocity mean. For a fixed shear solution at critical regularity, we establish matching logarithmic upper and lower bounds on the numerical error, ruling out every positive algebraic convergence rate.
