items.authors: Xinyu Cheng, Zhaonan Luo, Zhaojie Yang, Cheng Yuan
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为环面应力扩散的二维无粘 Oldroyd--B 系统的顺序半隐式好涡度积分器建立了锐收敛结果。对于满足 $u\in C_tB^{1+\alpha}_{\infty,1}$ 和 $\tau\in C_tB^\alpha_{\infty,1}\cap L^1_tB^{2+\alpha}_{\infty,1}$、$0\le\alpha\le2$ 的精确解，我们证明了临界范数 $B^1_{\infty,1}\times 的收敛性B^0_{\infty,1}$，在这些正则性假设成立的每个有限区间上的时间节点上均匀分布，包括关键端点 $\alpha=0$。对于 $0<\alpha\le2$，我们获得速率 $O(h^{\alpha/2})$，无需任何额外的时间 H\"较早的假设，在 $\alpha=2$ 处达到一阶。这些代数指数对于所述欧拉方案在所述解类上是最优的，如具有非零速度平均值的情况 $a=b=0$ 的固定数据下界所示。对于临界正则的固定剪切解，我们建立匹配的对数上限和下限数值误差的界限，排除每个正代数收敛率我们还证明了时间节点处的一个应力导数的增益是最优的。
items.title_zh: 应力扩散无粘Oldroyd--B系统的良好涡度低规整性积分器

items.title: A well-balanced path-conservative discontinuous Galerkin method with generalized hydrostatic reconstruction for non-conservative balance laws
items.excerpt: We propose a high-order well-balanced path-conservative discontinuous Galerkin method for one-dimensional balance laws with non-conservative products. Generalized hydrostatic reconstruction at cell interfaces couples effective numerical fluxes with Dal Maso-LeFloch-Murat path integrals, while a cellwise reference-equilibrium decomposition cancels projection-induced residuals in the volume discretization. Under explicit assumptions on equilibrium recovery, admissibility, paths, and boundary data, the spatial discretization is path conservative, and prescribed rest and moving equilibria are exactly preserved by both the semi-discrete scheme and its fully discrete SSP-RK approximation. The framework is applied to the two-layer shallow water equations and a blood-flow model with spatially varying vessel properties. Numerical experiments confirm the designed order of accuracy and round-off-level preservation of smooth and discontinuous equilibria, demonstrate accurate resolution of small perturbations, and show that the interface treatment captures shocks and stationary material contacts without visible spurious oscillations.
items.authors: Ruilin Fan, Yinhua Xia, Yan Xu
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一种用于具有非保守乘积的一维平衡律的高阶良好平衡路径保守不连续伽辽金方法。单元界面处的广义流体静力重建将有效数值通量与 Dal Maso-LeFloch-Murat 路径积分耦合起来，而单元参考平衡分解则消除了体积离散化中由投影引起的残差。在平衡恢复、容许性、路径和边界数据的明确假设下，空间离散是路径保守的，并且半离散格式及其全离散 SSP-RK 近似精确地保留了规定的静止和移动平衡。该框架应用于两层浅水方程和具有空间变化血管特性的血流模型。数值实验证实了设计的精度顺序以及平滑和不连续平衡的舍入水平保持，证明了小扰动的精确分辨率，并表明界面处理捕获了冲击和固定材料接触，而没有可见的寄生振荡。
items.title_zh: 非保守平衡律的广义静水力重构的良好平衡路径保守间断伽辽金法

items.title: Numerical methods for nonlinear stochastic differential equations driven by subdiffusion
items.excerpt: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) driven by subdiffusion see great applications in anomalous transport and asset price dynamics. Trusted numerical methods are essential for their application in practice. In this paper, for SDEs driven by subdiffusion with superlinear coefficients, we propose a brand-new explicit numerical method. The sharp convergence rate is proved with new techniques. The potential application of the proposed method in numerically solving a generalized Fokker-Planck equation is also illustrated. Numerical simulations are provided to demonstrate the theoretical results.
items.authors: Qian Guo, Wei Liu, Ruchun Zuo
items.excerpt_zh: 由次扩散驱动的随机微分方程 (SDE) 在异常运输和资产价格动态中有着广泛的应用。值得信赖的数值方法对于其在实践中的应用至关重要。在本文中，对于由超线性系数的次扩散驱动的SDE，我们提出了一种全新的显式数值方法。新技术证明了其急剧的收敛速度。还说明了所提出的方法在数值求解广义福克-普朗克方程中的潜在应用。提供数值模拟来证明理论结果。
items.title_zh: 次扩散驱动的非线性随机微分方程的数值方法

items.title: Scott spectral gaps for trees are bounded
items.excerpt: Given a Borel class of trees, we show that there is a tree in that class whose Scott sentence is not too much more complicated than the definition of the class. In particular, if the class is definable by a $\Pi_\alpha$ sentence, then there is a model of Scott rank at most $\alpha + 2$. This gives another proof-and one that does not require first proving Vaught's conjecture for trees-of the fact that trees are not faithfully Borel complete.
items.title_zh: 树木的斯科特光谱间隙是有限的
items.excerpt_zh: 给定一个 Borel 树类，我们证明该类中有一棵树，其 Scott 句子并不比该类的定义复杂太多。特别是，如果该类可以由 $\Pi_\alpha$ 句子定义，则存在一个斯科特等级至多 $\alpha + 2$ 的模型。这给出了另一个证明——并且不需要首先证明沃特对树的猜想——树不是忠实的波雷尔完备的这一事实。

items.title: On Star operation and some ideals on the Baire space
items.excerpt: We investigate several $\sigma$-ideals on the Baire space $\omega^\omega$ $(\mathbb{Z}^\omega)$, introducing and studying the ideals $\mathcal{G}$ and $\mathcal{SMZ}^+$, alongside the classical ideals of meager sets, strong measure zero sets, the eventually different ideal and infinitely equal ideal We establish structural relationships and proper inclusions among these ideals. Also we compute the cardinal invariants of $\mathcal{M}_-$, proving that they are same as invariants of $\sigma$-ideal of meager sets. We further analyze the operation $^*$ on families of sets, establishing dual relationships such as $\mathcal{ED}^* = \mathcal{IE}$, $\mathcal{IE}^*=\mathcal{ED}$, $\mathcal{M}_-^*=\mathcal{SMZ}^+$ and $\mathcal{H}^* = \mathcal{G}$, and derive separations between ideals under additional set-theoretic assumptions. Finally, we prove a tree dichotomy theorem for the ideal $\mathcal{M}_-$ and we study the associated forcing notion.
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了贝尔空间 $\omega^\omega$ $(\mathbb{Z}^\omega)$ 上的几个 $\sigma$-理想，引入并研究了理想 $\mathcal{G}$ 和 $\mathcal{SMZ}^+$，以及贫集、强测度零集、最终不同理想和无限相等理想的经典理想，我们在这些理想之间建立了结构关系和适当的包含。我们还计算了 $\mathcal{M}_-$ 的基数不变量，证明它们与 $\sigma$-理想贫集的不变量相同。我们进一步分析集合族上的运算 $^*$，建立对偶关系，例如 $\mathcal{ED}^* = \mathcal{IE}$、$\mathcal{IE}^*=\mathcal{ED}$、$\mathcal{M}_-^*=\mathcal{SMZ}^+$ 和 $\mathcal{H}^* = \mathcal{G}$，并推导附加条件下理想值之间的分离集合论假设。最后，我们证明了理想 $\mathcal{M}_-$ 的树二分定理，并研究了相关的强迫概念。
items.title_zh: 论星操作及贝尔空间的一些理想

items.title: On Local Finiteness of Modal K4 Algebras
items.excerpt: We study local finiteness for modal $K4$ algebras via the tunability of their dual general frames. In particular, we provide a sufficient condition for modal $K4$ algebras to be locally finite by identifying a structure which must be present in non-locally finite modal $K4$ algebras. We then show that this condition becomes both necessary and sufficient for $\sigma$-complete modal $K4$ algebras. Next, we translate this condition into a pair of order-theoretic conditions on transitive Kripke frames, providing a classification of local finiteness on their dual modal algebras. We further show that the logic of any class of well-founded transitive relations with no infinite antichains has the finite model property, and conclude that the logic of the class of well-quasi orderings has the finite model property.
items.title_zh: 论模态 K4 代数的局部有限性
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过模态 $K4$ 代数的对偶通用框架的可调性来研究其局部有限性。特别是，我们通过识别非局部有限模态 $K4$ 代数中必须存在的结构，为模态 $K4$ 代数局部有限提供了充分条件。然后我们证明这个条件对于 $\sigma$-完全模态 $K4$ 代数来说既是必要的又是充分的。接下来，我们将此条件转化为传递克里普克框架上的一对序论条件，提供其双模态代数上的局部有限性的分类。我们进一步证明，任何一类没有无限反链的有据可依的传递关系的逻辑都具有有限模型性质，并得出结论，一类良准排序的逻辑具有有限模型性质。

items.title: Circumventing the Computational Hardness of Computational Arbitrage
items.excerpt: AI model marketplaces host providers with heterogeneous costs and capabilities. These differences create an opportunity for computational arbitrage (Olmedo et al., 2026), in which an intermediary purchases inference from a portfolio of models and resells it to users at a profit. Beyond creating profit opportunities for the arbitrageur, computational arbitrage offers financial value to both consumers and providers and could therefore significantly influence AI model markets. While prior work empirically demonstrates the feasibility of computational arbitrage for small model pools, scaling it to large marketplaces requires arbitrage strategies that are both computationally tractable and inexpensive to identify and deploy. In this work, we formalize computational arbitrage as an allocation problem and prove that it is generally NP-hard. However, we show that the optimal allocation can be computed efficiently under a natural diminishing-returns condition on how model performance scales with inference spending. We further develop a sample-efficient method for estimating model performance from limited data, reducing the upfront cost of iden
items.authors: Nastaran Okati, Ricardo Olmedo, Moritz Hardt
items.excerpt_zh: 人工智能模型市场托管着具有异构成本和能力的提供商。这些差异创造了计算套利的机会（Olmedo 等人，2026），其中中介机构从模型组合中购买推理并将其转售给用户以获取利润。除了为套利者创造利润机会之外，计算套利还为消费者和提供商提供财务价值，因此可能对人工智能模型市场产生重大影响。虽然先前的工作凭经验证明了小型模型池计算套利的可行性，但将其扩展到大型市场需要计算上易于处理且识别和部署成本低廉的套利策略。在这项工作中，我们将计算套利形式化为分配问题，并证明它通常是 NP 困难的。然而，我们表明，在模型性能如何随推理支出扩展的自然收益递减条件下，可以有效地计算最优分配。我们进一步开发了一种样本有效的方法，用于根据有限的数据估计模型性能，从而降低 iden 的前期成本
items.title_zh: 规避计算套利的计算难度

items.title: CIRCE Divines LLM Task Complexity from Constraint Structure
items.excerpt: Estimating whether a problem is too complex for a large language model (LLM) before the model attempts it can guide model routing, how to allocate test-time compute, and suggest the need for new tools to aid the agent. While existing estimators rely on the problem text, LLM-annotated task difficulty labels, or signals obtained after a model attempts to solve the problem, such as its hidden states, none explicitly leverage the constraint structure inherent in the problem: the variables to assign and how the constraints over them interact. We introduce CIRCE, which extracts a problem's structure by using a cheap LLM to construct a Constraint Intermediate Representation that deterministically compiles into the constraint graph. Across seven reasoning benchmarks (including SAT, logic, and math) and four LLMs, even a randomly initialized GNN encoder improves predictions of LLM response correctness, reducing negative log-likelihood from 0.465 to 0.423 and increasing AUROC from 0.691 to 0.727 relative to the strongest baseline for each metric.
items.authors: Chenhao Hong, Jiakai Xu, Kaushiki Singh, Yusen Zhang, Eugene Wu
items.title_zh: CIRCE 从约束结构中分析 LLM 任务的复杂性
items.excerpt_zh: 在模型尝试之前估计问题对于大型语言模型 (LLM) 是否过于复杂，可以指导模型路由、如何分配测试时计算，并建议是否需要新工具来帮助代理。虽然现有的估计器依赖于问题文本、LLM 注释的任务难度标签或模型尝试解决问题后获得的信号（例如其隐藏状态），但没有一个估计器明确利用问题固有的约束结构：要分配的变量以及对它们的约束如何相互作用。我们引入了 CIRCE，它通过使用廉价的 LLM 来构建确定性地编译到约束图中的约束中间表示来提取问题的结构。在七个推理基准（包括 SAT、逻辑和数学）和四个 LLM 中，即使是随机初始化的 GNN 编码器也能提高 LLM 响应正确性的预测，相对于每个指标的最强基线，将负对数似然从 0.465 降低到 0.423，并将 AUROC 从 0.691 增加到 0.727。

items.title: Researcher-in-the-Loop Evolutionary Discovery of Entanglement-Assisted Quantum Code Families
items.excerpt: LLM-guided program evolution can produce mathematical constructions, but validity, generality, and reproducibility require distinct evidence. We develop a researcher-in-the-loop discovery pipeline that combines program evolution, exact evaluation, mathematical generalization, certified nonexistence checks, and formal proof checking. We apply it to entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes (EAQECCs). Starting from tasks that did not specify a family formula, evolved programs produced finite qubit constructions whose structure researchers generalized to the family $[[n,1,n-1;n-q-1]]_q$ for prime powers $q\ge3$ at $n\ge2q+1$ and for $q=2$ at odd $n\ge5$. Lean checks the algebraic certificate underlying this family. Together with entanglement lifting, the family closes 54 gaps in archived EAQECC tables. The released evidence includes 115 verified code records, ten nonexistence results with checked DRAT proofs, family implementations, and preserved search programs for exact checks and seeded replay. In a controlled cohort of eight paired generation blocks, validation-selected iterative programs achieve success in 46.1% and 31.6%
items.authors: Jae-Hyun Baek, Byung-Sun Won, Jon-Lark Kim
items.excerpt_zh: 法学硕士指导的程序演化可以产生数学结构，但有效性、通用性和可重复性需要明确的证据。我们开发了一个研究人员在环发现管道，结合了程序演化、精确评估、数学概括、经过认证的不存在检查和形式证明检查。我们将其应用于纠缠辅助量子纠错码（EAQECC）。从没有指定族公式的任务开始，进化程序产生了有限的量子位结构，其结构研究人员将其推广到族$[[n,1,n-1;n-q-1]]_q$，对于$n\ge2q+1$处的质数幂$q\ge3$和奇数$n\ge5$处的$q=2$。精益检查该族的代数证书。与纠缠解除一起，该系列弥补了存档的 EAQECC 表中的 54 个空白。已发布的证据包括 115 个经过验证的代码记录、10 个经过检查的 DRAT 证明的不存在结果、系列实现以及用于精确检查和种子重放的保留搜索程序。在八个配对生成块的受控队列中，验证选择的迭代程序取得了 46.1% 和 31.6% 的成功
items.title_zh: 纠缠辅助量子码族的循环研究员进化发现

items.title: Experts Exhibit Structured Redundancy: Structure-Preserving Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
items.excerpt: Sparse MoE mechanism significantly improves the trade-off between model capacity and inference efficiency. However, practical deployment still requires storing all experts, resulting in substantial memory overhead. We show that expert outputs in MoE layers exhibit structured redundancy. Across different models and task categories, the stable rank and entropy effective rank of expert outputs are consistently far below the nominal number of experts, while expert output distributions also exhibit fewer effective modes. Motivated by these observations, we reformulate expert pruning as a structure-preserving expert subset selection problem and efficiently optimize it via a greedy strategy, rather than only independently scoring and ranking individual experts or exhaustively searching over expert combinations. We propose two expert pruning methods under the unified structure-preserving framework: Projection Energy Expert Pruning (PEEP), which preserves the functional subspace by maximizing weighted projection energy, and Distributional Coverage Expert Pruning (DCEP), which preserves the distributional geometry by minimizing weighted coverag
items.authors: Tian Wang, Yongding Tao, Yihong Dong, Xiaoming Wu, Ying Guo, Ge Li
items.excerpt_zh: 稀疏MoE机制显着改善了模型容量和推理​​效率之间的权衡。然而，实际部署仍然需要存储所有专家，从而导致大量的内存开销。我们证明 MoE 层中的专家输出表现出结构化冗余。在不同的模型和任务类别中，专家输出的稳定排名和熵有效排名始终远低于名义专家数量，而专家输出分布也表现出较少的有效模式。受这些观察的启发，我们将专家剪枝重新表述为保留结构的专家子集选择问题，并通过贪婪策略对其进行有效优化，而不是仅对单个专家进行独立评分和排名或对专家组合进行详尽搜索。我们在统一结构保持框架下提出了两种专家剪枝方法：投影能量专家剪枝（PEEP），通过最大化加权投影能量来保留功能子空间，以及分布覆盖专家剪枝（DCEP），通过最小化加权覆盖来保留分布几何形状
items.title_zh: 专家表现出结构化冗余：混合专家大型语言模型的结构保留专家剪枝

items.title: Online Evidence-Containment Prediction over Text Spans under Distinct Queries
items.excerpt: Evidence-grounded NLP systems often verify nested text regions sequentially, so verifying one region constrains others. We formalize this as Online Evidence-Containment Prediction (OECP): each candidate is predicted before exact verification and queried at most once. Span containment is exactly a triangular 2D product order, making OECP distinct-query online isotonic regression. With multiple admissible targets, worst-case regret is near-linear, $\widetilde{\Theta}(m_{\mathrm{eff}})$, in the effective scale given by endpoint-rank compression; a single fixed target, as in standard QA, admits an explicit polynomial-time learner with optimal $\Theta(\log m_{\mathrm{eff}})$ regret, run on real NQ episodes. On Natural Questions, containment yields a large deductive gain plus a smaller learned gain on unresolved candidates, reproduced across two backbones and DPR hierarchies. Expected Search-space Reduction (ESR) turns these probabilities into decisions, localizing evidence in fewer verifier calls on SciFact, ERASER, and DPR hierarchies; on DPR hierarchies under call budgets it outperforms four recent external selectors and raises fixed-rea
items.title_zh: 不同查询下文本跨度的在线证据包含预测
items.excerpt_zh: 基于证据的 NLP 系统通常会按顺序验证嵌套文本区域，因此验证一个区域会限制其他区域。我们将其形式化为在线证据遏制预测（OECP）：在精确验证之前对每个候选者进行预测，并且最多查询一次。 Span包含正是一个三角形的2D乘积顺序，使得OECP不同查询在线等渗回归。对于多个可接受的目标，最坏情况的后悔是接近线性的，$\widetilde{\Theta}(m_{\mathrm{eff}})$，在端点等级压缩给出的有效范围内；与标准 QA 中一样，单个固定目标承认具有最佳 $\Theta(\log m_{\mathrm{eff}})$ 遗憾的显式多项式时间学习器，在真实 NQ 片段上运行。在自然问题上，遏制会产生较大的演绎增益，加上未解决的候选者的较小学习增益，在两个骨干网和 DPR 层次结构中重现。预期搜索空间缩减 (ESR) 将这些概率转化为决策，将证据定位到较少的验证者调用 SciFact、ERASER 和 DPR 层次结构中；在呼叫预算下的 DPR 层次结构上，它优于最近的四个外部选择器，并提高了固定区域

items.title: Multi-Test Nation Bias Benchmarking of LLMs with Explicit Unbiased Baselines
items.excerpt: While prior work has highlighted that systematic nation-level bias in large language models (LLMs) can pose operational risks for international relations (IR) applications, many existing evaluations still lack a clearly specified unbiased reference (ground truth), limiting fully quantitative and cross-setting measurement. Using an expanded corpus of 722 official UN Security Council (UNSC) records, we measure nation-level bias with five complementary tests, thereby extending prior approaches to cover a broader set of bias expression channels: opinion ranking (WOW), association sorting (AK+-), vote simulation (PVS), opposition attribution (F-Oppose), and framing (Headliner). To enable grounded bias evaluation, we explicitly define an unbiased status for each test; in particular, for WOW and AK+- where ground truth is difficult to specify, we propose an action-based pseudo unbiased status derived from observable voting behavior to construct a quantifiable baseline. Benchmarking 4 LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, Llama 3.3-70B, Mistral-22B-Small, and Qwen3-30B) across the five permanent members of the UNSC, we find a test-agnostic macro-pattern: relati

items.title_zh: 具有明确无偏见基线的法学硕士的多测试国家偏见基准

items.title: Specification-Guided Generation for Large Language Models
items.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) can generate structured outputs, but existing constrained-decoding methods mainly enforce syntax and cannot directly enforce satisfaction of a formal specification. We introduce a neuro-symbolic, specification-guided decoding framework that combines LLM generation with symbolic reasoning. At each step, the framework refines the decoding grammar by filtering out values that cannot be extended to an output satisfying the specification. We present a forward-only variant that guarantees specification satisfaction by construction, and a backtracking variant that revises earlier feasible choices when their downstream consequences leave only values that the LLM itself judges unsuitable. The framework is model-agnostic, requires no retraining, and builds on existing grammar-constrained decoding mechanisms. Experiments on configuration and constraint-solving benchmarks show that the forward-only variant reliably produces specification-compliant outputs while reducing repeated LLM inference compared with rejection sampling and incurring modest symbolic-reasoning overhead. items.title: PrivacyFlow: Privacy in AI Agents through Information Flow Analysis and Consequence-Aware Risk Management
items.excerpt: Autonomous LLM agents executing multi-step workflows over personal data often misalign with user privacy expectations and leak sensitive, out-of-context information. Although Contextual Integrity (CI) formalizes this problem, existing benchmarks and defenses rarely operationalize CI for realistic multi-step task sequences in evolving environments. In this work, we first introduce agentic PrivacyBench, a benchmark of 5873 tasks in 986 task sequences with dynamic environment updates and CI-grounded allow-sets for sensitive information. We also introduce PrivacyFlow, a defense that separates deliberative privacy planning (System 2) from task execution (System 1), treating each sharing decision as a structured risk-management problem. Before execution, PrivacyFlow traces the provenance and purpose of each planned data flow, models recipient background knowledge, and simulates what external actors could infer. This allows us to model the downstream consequences of disclosure, including inference attacks and context-dependent harms. items.title: A Theoretical Framework for Understanding and Building "Any-task inference" Capable Foundation Models
items.excerpt: In this work, we provide a formal framework and mathematical definition for the subset of foundation models focused on enabling the property of "any-task inference" (ATI) (similar to zero-shot inference), rather than those designed for pre-training fine-tuning. items.title: Kernel-based Interpolatory Methods for Context Compression of Attention Mechanisms
items.excerpt: The bottleneck of attention mechanisms, which are the fundamental building block of modern language models, is their quadratic complexity in terms of context size. There has thus been an increasing interest in the compression of the context, also called KV-cache compression. In this article, we consider the problem of compressing the context of attention mechanisms by first formulating it in the Hilbert space associated with its kernel. In this formalism, attention can be represented as the ratio of two linear maps whose interpolant is also the ratio of interpolants, this allows us to consider the interpolation of the linear maps directly. We thus introduce two novel KV-cache compression methods which we call GAIM and Q-DAIM, based on the Generalized Empirical Interpolation Method (GEIM) and the Q-Discrete Empirical Interpolation Method (Q-DEIM), respectively. As the cost of these methods is quadratic in terms of context length, we propose surrogate models based on the Taylor series, the Performer and the Random Fourier Features method which allow the compression to be done in linear time. items.excerpt_zh: 注意力机制是现代语言模型的基本构建模块，其瓶颈在于其上下文大小的二次复杂性。因此，人们对上下文压缩（也称为 KV 缓存压缩）越来越感兴趣。在本文中，我们首先在与其内核相关的希尔伯特空间中表述它，从而考虑压缩注意力机制上下文的问题。在这种形式中，注意力可以表示为两个线性映射的比率，其插值也是插值的比率，这使得我们可以直接考虑线性映射的插值。因此，我们引入了两种新颖的 KV 缓存压缩方法，分别基于广义经验插值法（GEIM）和 Q-离散经验插值法（Q-DEIM），称为 GAIM 和 Q-DAIM。由于这些方法的成本是上下文长度的二次方，因此我们提出了基于泰勒级数、表演者和随机傅立叶特征方法的代理模型，该模型允许在线性时间内完成压缩。最后，我们将这个结果扩展到流i

items.title: Steering Vectors as a Training Signal in LLM Post-Training
items.excerpt: Steering vectors (SVs) are residual-stream directions that shift the behavior of LLMs when added to hidden states at inference time. While prior work has mainly used SVs as post-hoc controls, we ask whether the same directions can also guide parameter updates during post-training. We study this question across supervised learning, including SFT and distillation, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Our framework considers two intervention regimes: a hidden-state hook during teacher-forced supervised training, and an advantage-repair mechanism on wrong rollouts in GRPO. For each regime, we analyze three design axes, which are the steering direction, its placement, and the operation used to combine it with training. In supervised settings, SV injection improves over plain SFT and distillation, with gains scaling with the off-policy gap and reaching up to a $12\%$ improvement when distilling from thinking-mode teachers. items.title: When can Optimally Trained Transformers Achieve Near-Lossless Token Prediction for non-Markovian Data?
items.excerpt: There exists little mathematical theory explaining why Transformer architectures are empirically successful even for non-Markovian data. To this end, this paper studies next-token prediction via stochastic optimal control theoretically trained Transformers for such sources, where we consider either stationary and ergodic non-Markovian sources or those which are hidden Markov models of some finite order (possibly non-stationary). In either case, we first obtain error bounds via finite models with finite window approximations. For stationary ergodic sources, the resulting error is bounded by an entropy gap; for $N$th order Markovian sources, it decays at an exponential rate $\alpha^{\lfloor M/N\rfloor}$, where $M$ is the window length and $\alpha$ is determined by filter stability (and the Dobrushin coefficients of the transition and measurement kernels). We then construct a Transformer of depth $M+1$, one head per layer, realizing the truncated filter, and we optimally train it with stochastic control developed in earlier work, which rigorously returns a near optimal Transformer. items.title: A Positional Realizability Theory of Length Generalization in Single-Head Attention
items.excerpt: Why does length generalization (LG) depend so sharply on the positional encoding (PE)? Relative schemes extrapolate fixed offsets, absolute schemes fix positions, and neither handles growing offsets. We give a realizability theory for a deliberately controlled abstraction, a single positional-only attention head, that derives this well-documented empirical pattern and says precisely where it holds and breaks. Here $\alpha_L$ serves as the computable witness of that taxonomy's derivation, not as a stronger empirical predictor. items.excerpt: Process reward models (PRMs) score reasoning steps, but best-of-N selection also requires a rule that aggregates those scores. We study that rule as a separate evaluation object. Across seven scoring checkpoints and two benchmarks, the stored N=32 outcomes give higher deletion-induced selection instability for product than geometric mean (GM) in all 14 cells. The equal-cell difference is +0.0965; a shared-problem bootstrap, conditional on these checkpoints and frozen pools, gives a 95% interval of [0.0846,0.1086]. A pre-injection-defined sensitivity excludes replacement slots that are either reducer's clean winner and retains 4,459 of 4,622 cell-problem records. The retained difference is +0.0986 [0.0875,0.1098]. items.title: Certifying Retraining Regret through Residual Structure
items.excerpt: We certify a fixed ridge predictor's regret against full-feature retraining over every continuous completion of an interval-valued table. Our main theorem gives verifiable original-row residual conditions for a uniform error bound independent of nuisance-feature scale and rank, with an asymptotically sharp leading constant and quantitative leakage stability. Full-rank constructions separate certification dimension from feature dimension, including examples requiring directions beyond the candidate. Observed-row anchors make the conditions computable, while exact row geometry and global search return valid upper bounds and feasible original-table witnesses. A finite-scale contraction and common-domain moment fallback implement the structural result. Four real-world tasks retain all model features and certify twenty rank-three instances to width $10^{-5}$. Their primary median widths improve over centered moments. Joint residual refinement additionally certifies all twenty new response-independent masks to the same precision within 76.21 seconds. items.title: When Everyone Can Build a Model: Mechanistic Inference in the Age of AI
items.excerpt: Modern deep learning and AI-assisted code generation are lowering the technical barrier to building mathematical models of biological systems that reproduce complex observations. This lets researchers with domain expertise build semi-mechanistic, hybrid models constrained by prior knowledge and augmented with learned structure without extensive training in modelling. However, easier construction does not make interpretation easier: predictive success of such so-called grey-box models does not establish that an inferred mechanism corresponds to the one that generated the data, and the learned component can absorb errors in the mechanistic part. Many biological modelling problems are underdetermined, so several, possibly infinitely many, models may reproduce the same data equally well. This ambiguity enters at two modelling choices: which variables can affect others, and which response function describes the underlying mechanism. For the first choice, causal inference provides a formal framework stating which causal relationships and intervention effects are identifiable from the data and available knowledge. items.excerpt_zh: 现代深度学习和人工智能辅助代码生成正在降低构建重现复杂观察结果的生物系统数学模型的技术障碍。这使得具有领域专业知识的研究人员可以构建受先验知识约束并通过学习结构进行增强的半机械混合模型，而无需进行大量建模培训。然而，更简单的构建并不会使解释更容易：这种所谓的灰盒模型的预测成功并不能证明推断的机制与生成数据的机制相对应，并且学习的组件可以吸收机械部分中的错误。许多生物建模问题是不确定的，因此几个（可能是无限多个）模型可以同样好地再现相同的数据。这种模糊性存在于两个建模选择中：哪些变量可以影响其他变量，以及哪个响应函数描述了潜在的机制。对于第一种选择，因果推理提供了一个正式的框架，说明哪些因果关系和干预效果可以从数据和现有知识中识别出来。对于第二个，合奏

items.title: Adaptive Personalization Under Preference Epistemic Uncertainty
items.excerpt: Human preferences change over time: an established preference may remain valid over time, become uncertain as context shifts, or be explicitly revised. Effective personalization requires conversational AI to adapt its response strategy to evolving preferences rather than relying on passive memory retrieval. We formalize this capability as adaptive personalization under epistemic uncertainty. A human preference study further confirms that people favor state-contingent response strategies as preference uncertainty changes. To evaluate whether language models mirror this adaptation, we create a multilingual benchmark spanning 250 personas, 5 languages, and 25K conversational turns that decouples strategy selection from response execution. Across eight closed- and open-weight models, we uncover a recognition-generation gap: models reliably identify appropriate strategies when selecting among candidate options, but collapse during open-ended generation, suffering a 35-46% drop in strategy calibration. Crucially, this failure is systematic: models default to exploit-first behavior, over-relying on existing preferences regardless of preferen
items.authors: Priyanka Dey, Rajarshi Das, Vikas Bahirwani, Qi Zeng, Julia Kruk, Qi Qi
items.excerpt_zh: 人类偏好会随着时间的推移而变化：既定的偏好可能会随着时间的推移而保持有效，随着环境的变化而变得不确定，或者被明确修改。有效的个性化需要对话式人工智能根据不断变化的偏好调整其响应策略，而不是依赖于被动的记忆检索。我们将这种能力形式化为认知不确定性下的自适应个性化。一项人类偏好研究进一步证实，随着偏好不确定性的变化，人们倾向于选择状态相关的响应策略。为了评估语言模型是否反映了这种适应，我们创建了一个涵盖 250 个角色、5 种语言和 25K 对话轮次的多语言基准，将策略选择与响应执行分离。在八个封闭式和开放式权重模型中，我们发现了一个识别生成差距：模型在选择候选选项时可靠地识别出适当的策略，但在开放式生成过程中崩溃，策略校准下降了 35-46%。至关重要的是，这种失败是系统性的：模型默认为利用优先行为，过度依赖现有偏好，而不管偏好如何
items.title_zh: 偏好认知不确定性下的自适应个性化

items.title: GraphNIAH: A Benchmark for Long-Context Reasoning over Real-World Graphs
items.excerpt: The needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) benchmark was introduced as a test for measuring a model's ability to find small relevant facts within a very large body of input text. However, existing NIAH benchmarks each suffer from one or more of the following limitations: (1) reliance on synthetic data, so their evaluations may not generalize to real-world settings; (2) reuse of previously published datasets, leading to the risk of benchmark contamination; (3) dependence on manual annotation, which requires human effort to create and update data and is prone to future benchmark contamination; and (4) unrealistic simplification of long-context multi-hop reasoning where each next step is trivial given previous steps, while real-world reasoning often requires planning over multiple possible proof paths. To address these limitations, we introduce \Benchmark, a dynamic benchmark built from real citation relationships among scientific papers published after the evaluated models' knowledge cutoff date, which utilizes real-world information while ensuring no benchmark contamination. The fully automated benchmark construction pipeline samples representati
items.excerpt_zh: 大海捞针 (NIAH) 基准测试是为了衡量模型在大量输入文本中查找小的相关事实的能力而引入的。然而，现有的 NIAH 基准都存在以下一个或多个限制：（1）依赖合成数据，因此它们的评估可能无法推广到现实世界的环境； （2）重复使用之前发布的数据集，导致基准污染的风险； （3）依赖人工标注，需要人工创建和更新数据，并且很容易受到未来基准污染的影响； (4) 长上下文多跳推理的不切实际的简化，其中考虑到先前的步骤，每个下一步都是微不足道的，而现实世界的推理通常需要规划多个可能的证明路径。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 \Benchmark，这是一种动态基准，根据评估模型的知识截止日期后发表的科学论文之间的真实引用关系构建，它利用真实世界的信息，同时确保没有基准污染。全自动标杆施工管道样品代表
items.title_zh: GraphNIAH：现实世界图长上下文推理的基准

items.title: Stepwise-Querying: Distilling Reasoning without Access to Teacher Chain-of-Thought
items.excerpt: Reasoning distillation is widely used to transfer the reasoning capabilities of large language models to smaller students through teacher-generated supervision. In the black-box setting, however, teachers may expose only final answers and brief solutions, leaving intermediate calculations and validity conditions unavailable and thus limiting the reasoning supervision available for distillation. We propose Stepwise Querying, which elicits step-specific explanations without requiring access to the teacher's internal chain-of-thought (CoT) traces. Independent queries to the same teacher request intermediate derivations, validity checks, and corrections for individual steps, the assembled solutions are then used for standard supervised fine-tuning. Across two teachers, two students, and four mathematics and code benchmarks, our method achieves the highest score in 14 of 16 comparisons with three baselines. We further introduce Stepwise Explanation Information Gain (SEIG), a diagnostic based on the log-ratio of a frozen student's probabilities of correct step completion under stepwise and global explanations. items.authors: Dicong Yu, Wenhua Wang, Tian Wang
items.title_zh: 逐步查询：在不接触教师思路的情况下提炼推理
items.excerpt_zh: 推理蒸馏被广泛用于通过教师生成的监督将大型语言模型的推理能力转移给较小的学生。然而，在黑盒设置中，教师可能只公开最终答案和简要解决方案，而无法获得中间计算和有效性条件，从而限制了可用于蒸​​馏的推理监督。我们提出逐步查询，它可以引出特定于步骤的解释，而无需访问教师的内部思维链（CoT）痕迹。对同一教师的独立查询要求对各个步骤进行中间推导、有效性检查和修正，然后将组装的解决方案用于标准监督微调。在两名教师、两名学生以及四个数学和代码基准测试中，我们的方法在与三个基准进行的 16 次比较中的 14 次中获得了最高分。我们进一步介绍了逐步解释信息增益（SEIG），这是一种基于冻结学生在逐步和全局解释下正确完成步骤的概率的对数比的诊断。对 GSM8K 的分析表明

items.title: Iterated Integrals as Lexical Fingerprints: Path Signature Embeddings for Lexical Similarity
items.excerpt: While sentence embeddings are primarily designed for semantic generalization, their latent geometry implicitly encodes surface-level lexical properties, a relationship that remains poorly understood. Shallow pooling methods discard word order, while deep Transformer models obscure these lexical alignments behind computational complexity and uninterpretable spaces. We propose constructing sentence embeddings via the path signature of Word2Vec trajectories, leveraging the iterated integrals of rough path theory to create representations that explicitly capture sequential and lexical structure in a geometrically tractable manner. Through extensive ablations spanning Word2Vec dimensions, signature depths, and PCA compression, we correlate embedding distances against five lexical string metrics: Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, word Jaccard, phoneme Levenshtein, and character TF-IDF. We reveal that while average pooling almost entirely fails to capture character-level edit distances, path signatures strongly align with them, with depth 2 signatures optimally balancing character and word-level sensitivities. items.title_zh: 作为词汇指纹的迭代积分：词汇相似性的路径签名嵌入
items.excerpt_zh: 虽然句子嵌入主要是为了语义泛化而设计的，但它们的潜在几何结构隐式地编码了表面层的词汇属性，这种关系仍然知之甚少。浅层池化方法会丢弃词序，而深层 Transformer 模型会掩盖计算复杂性和不可解释空间背后的词汇对齐。我们建议通过 Word2Vec 轨迹的路径签名构建句子嵌入，利用粗糙路径理论的迭代积分来创建以几何易于处理的方式明确捕获顺序和词汇结构的表示。通过跨越 Word2Vec 维度、签名深度和 PCA 压缩的广泛消融，我们将嵌入距离与五个词汇字符串度量相关联：Levenshtein、Jaro-Winkler、单词 Jaccard、音素 Levenshtein 和字符 TF-IDF。我们发现，虽然平均池化几乎完全无法捕获字符级编辑距离，但路径签名与它们密切相关，深度 2 签名可以最佳地平衡字符级和单词级敏感性。此外，我们证明了 c

items.title: Asynchronous Flow Map Language Models
items.excerpt: The order in which tokens are predicted in language modeling has a profound impact on the quality of generated sequences. Autoregressive and masked diffusion models iteratively fill in tokens and can exploit such orderings across generation steps, but how to leverage an ordering for one-step parallel language modeling is unclear. We introduce asynchronous flow map language models (aFMLMs), which incorporate prediction order into one-step modeling by learning the flow maps of asynchronous flows. These flows specify an ordering through a tokenwise time schedule that controls the relative denoising progress of tokens. We formulate a general class of asynchronous flows that admit both prescribed and learned, state-adaptive schedules, show that they define valid flow maps, and develop new methods for their flow map distillation. The resulting models can generate all tokens in a single forward pass by internalizing the ordering encoded in the flow into their hidden computations. On Sudoku solving and code generation for GSM8K math word problems, aFMLM establishes new state-of-the-art one-step performance.
items.authors: Chanhyuk Lee, Wonjung Kim, Patrick Pynadath, Jaehoon Yoo, Satoshi Hayakawa, Ruqi Zhang, Jinwoo Kim, Seunghoon Hong
items.title_zh: 异步流程图语言模型
items.excerpt_zh: 语言建模中预测标记的顺序对生成序列的质量有着深远的影响。自回归和掩码扩散模型迭代地填充标记，并且可以跨生成步骤利用此类排序，但如何利用单步并行语言建模的排序尚不清楚。我们引入了异步流图语言模型（aFMLM），它通过学习异步流的流图将预测顺序合并到一步建模中。这些流程通过控制令牌的相对去噪进度的令牌时间计划来指定排序。我们制定了一类通用的异步流，它允许规定的和学习的、状态自适应的调度，表明它们定义了有效的流图，并为其流图精炼开发了新方法。通过将流中编码的顺序内部化到其隐藏计算中，生成的模型可以在单个前向传递中生成所有令牌。在 GSM8K 数学应用题的数独求解和代码生成方面，aFMLM 建立了新的最先进的一步性能。

items.title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
items.excerpt: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree's depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage over a few bill
items.authors: Leon Lufkin, Cutter Dawes, Alexander Speicher, Kamesh Krishnamurthy, Tom\'as Figliolia, Beren Millidge
items.excerpt_zh: 注意力的二次缩放是限制大型语言模型（LLM）的长上下文能力的基本瓶颈。各种方法试图规避这一点，但它们要么无法匹配注意力的表达能力（例如，滑动窗口或具有固定大小状态的线性注意力变体），要么只能实现恒定因子的加速（例如，索引器本身按二次方缩放的稀疏注意力方法）。在本文中，我们推导了一种基于分层树结构索引器的渐近次二次稀疏注意力方法，我们将其称为 Zyphra 分层注意力（ZHA）。 ZHA 在 KV 缓存上构造一棵递归压缩的键摘要树，未来的查询从上到下遍历该树以检索键的稀疏子集。至关重要的是，通过迭代地增加树的深度，包括路由和最终注意力的总成本在序列长度上呈次线性增长，从而导致注意力的整体次二次（但超线性）缩放。我们证明，ZHA 可以廉价地应用于现有的预训练模型，只需花费几个小时的简短 KL 蒸馏训练阶段
items.title_zh: 使用分层树结构索引器进行次二次注意力

items.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
items.excerpt: Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. To address this challenge, we propose Flide, an efficient and exact inference engine that decouples the logical tree structure of a decision request from its physical execution within a single flattened token stream. Through ForkAttention, Flide navigates request dependencies using GPU-resident indices across both standard attention and recurrent Gated DeltaNet layers, guaranteeing in exact arithmetic that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass. By expressing branch topologies directly in GPU-resident metadata, Flide accommodates diverse request mixtures with a compact set of pre-recorded execution graphs while enabling expanding agent histories to resume from checkpoints saved in earlier passes. Extensive evaluations on public hybrid and
items.authors: Bobo Li, Jiajia Song, Hao Fei, Wynne Hsu, Mong Li Lee
items.excerpt_zh: Jev 等决策模型已成为 LLM 代理系统的一种非常有前途的范例，为快速 System One 执行提供轻量级且可靠的分类推理。然而，现有的面向生成的推理引擎无法有效地支持这些工作负载，遭受严重的前缀重新计算开销或扭曲的输出概率。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 Flide，这是一种高效且精确的推理引擎，它将决策请求的逻辑树结构与其在单个扁平令牌流中的物理执行分离。通过 ForkAttention，Flide 使用 GPU 驻留索引跨标准注意力层和循环门控 DeltaNet 层来导航请求依赖关系，从而在精确的算术中保证每个查询分支的计算结果与隔离的前向传递相同。通过直接在 GPU 驻留元数据中表达分支拓扑，Flide 通过一组紧凑的预先记录的执行图来容纳不同的请求混合，同时允许扩展代理历史记录从早期传递中保存的检查点恢复。对公共混合动力和
items.title_zh: Flide：通过精确的状态分叉加速决策推理

items.title: An Efficient Randomized Hierarchical Tucker Decomposition
items.excerpt: We introduce randomized algorithms for computing the hierarchical Tucker decomposition of high-order tensors. Unlike traditional algorithms performed in a sequential leaves-to-root direction, our algorithms traverse the dimension tree in a root-to-leaves direction, leveraging randomized sequential projections to accelerate the computation of intermediate subspaces. This strategy can reduce the computation time by an order of magnitude relative to prior randomized algorithms using the leaves-to-root direction, while guaranteeing quasi-optimal approximation. Although the theoretical error bound is slightly larger than for leaves-to-root methods, in all our experiments the practical error adheres to the classic bound. Our results highlight the method's potential for scalable tensor decompositions in high-dimensional data analysis.
items.authors: Bram Leys , Karl Meerbergen , Nick Vannieuwenhoven , Mathijs Vivet
items.title_zh: 一种高效的随机分层塔克分解
items.excerpt_zh: 我们引入了用于计算高阶张量的分层塔克分解的随机算法。与按顺序叶到根方向执行的传统算法不同，我们的算法以根到叶方向遍历维度树，利用随机顺序投影来加速中间子空间的计算。相对于之前使用叶到根方向的随机算法，该策略可以将计算时间减少一个数量级，同时保证准最优近似。尽管理论误差范围略大于叶到根方法，但在我们所有的实验中，实际误差都遵循经典范围。我们的结果突出了该方法在高维数据分析中可扩展张量分解的潜力。

items.title: The complexity of tilting
items.excerpt: Many explicit constructions in algebra are not first-order definable in classical finitary logic, but are, however, definable in infinitary logic. The aim of this paper is to show how infinitary logic can be used to lift model-theoretic results in arithmetic to a quantifier-sensitive form. We apply this idea to a deep result of Jahnke and Kartas on the model theory of perfectoid fields. Our main result is that a first-order sentence $\phi$ holds in the tilt $k^{\flat}$ of a perfectoid field $k$ if and only if a certain sentence $\phi^{\natural}$ holds in a non-principal ultrapower of $k$, where $\phi^{\natural}$ does not depend on $k$ and is only slightly more complicated than $\phi$ itself. In particular, tilting preserves the L\'evy hierarchy in a precise sense. To this end, we prove that the Standard Decomposition of a valued field at a constant $t$ is infinitarily interpretable by formulas of rank at most 1.
items.excerpt_zh: 代数中的许多显式构造在经典有限逻辑中不是一阶可定义的，但在无限逻辑中是可定义的。本文的目的是展示如何使用无限逻辑将算术中的模型理论结果提升为量词敏感的形式。我们将这个想法应用到 Jahnke 和 Kartas 关于完美类场模型理论的深刻结果中。我们的主要结果是，当且仅当某个句子 $\phi^{\natural}$ 在 $k$ 的非主超幂中成立时，一阶句子 $\phi$ 在完美域 $k$ 的倾斜 $k^{\flat}$ 中成立，其中 $\phi^{\natural}$ 不依赖于 $k$，并且仅比 $\phi$ 本身稍微复杂一些。特别是，倾斜在精确意义上保留了 L'evy 层次结构。为此，我们证明常量 $t$ 下的赋值字段的标准分解可以通过等级最多为 1 的公式无限地解释。
items.title_zh: 倾斜的复杂性

items.title: Strongly stable fields
items.excerpt: Let $K$ be a field which is strongly stable, that is, stable and strongly dependent. Then $K$ is finite or algebraically closed. This answers a question of Shelah.
items.title_zh: 强稳定场
items.excerpt_zh: 设$K$为强稳定场，即稳定且强依赖的场。那么 $K$ 是有限的或代数封闭的。这回答了谢拉的问题。

items.title: Loose Inductive Set Theories
items.excerpt: We prove that KP, with Full Set Induction, is neither solid nor tight. More generally, every consistent theory obtained from KPC by adding a quantifier bounded set of sentences has a model with a parameter-free definable class surjection from its natural numbers onto its universe. Using such enumerations to define generic extensions by relative interpretations, we show that theories with the stable definable ground property are not tight. Ground definability over MOST and continuum coding over ZFC^{\Pi_3} yield applications to weak inductive set theories with large cardinals and forcing axioms. Finally, solidity for quantifier bounded extensions of MOST with Full Set Induction implies a Ground Axiom formulated using a fixed finite level of genericity; under the same solidity hypothesis, the corresponding extension of full ZFC proves the ordinary Ground Axiom.
items.title_zh: 松散归纳集合论
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过全套感应证明 KP 既不坚固也不紧。更一般地，通过添加量词有界句子集从 KPC 获得的每个一致理论都有一个模型，该模型具有从其自然数到其宇宙的无参数可定义类满射。使用这样的枚举通过相对解释来定义通用扩展，我们表明具有稳定可定义基础属性的理论并不严格。 MOST 上的基本可定义性和 ZFC^{\Pi_3} 上的连续编码产生了对具有大基数和强制公理的弱归纳集理论的应用。最后，具有全集归纳的 MOST 量词有界扩展的可靠性意味着使用固定的有限通用性级别制定的基本公理；在相同的可靠性假设下，完整ZFC的相应扩展证明了普通的Ground Axiom。

items.title: A conjecture on Galois groups and large fields
items.excerpt: Let $p$ be a prime number and let $K$ be a field such that $p$ is prime to the absolute Galois group $\operatorname{Gal}(K)$, in the sense that $p$ does not divide the degree of any finite Galois extension of $K$. We conjecture that $K$ is large in the sense of Pop: any smooth algebraic curve $C$ over $K$ with a $K$-rational point has infinitely many $K$-rational points. This conjecture would have some consequences in mathematical logic. For instance, it would imply the expected classification of stable fields of positive characteristic. We give some weak evidence for this conjecture. Specifically, suppose that $K$ is a perfect field and $\operatorname{Gal}(K)$ is prime to $p$. Then every abelian variety $A$ over $K$ has Zariski dense $K$-rational points, and if $C$ is a smooth curve of genus less than $7-p$ with at least one $K$-rational point, then $C$ has infinitely many $K$-rational points.
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $p$ 为素数，并令 $K$ 为一个域，使得 $p$ 与绝对伽罗瓦群 $\operatorname{Gal}(K)$ 互质，从某种意义上说，$p$ 不能整除 $K$ 的任何有限伽罗瓦扩张的次数。我们推测 $K$ 在 Pop 意义上是大的：任何在 $K$ 上且具有 $K$ 有理点的平滑代数曲线 $C$ 都有无限多个 $K$ 有理点。这个猜想会对数理逻辑产生一些影响。例如，这意味着对具有积极特征的稳定领域的预期分类。我们为这个猜想提供了一些微弱的证据。具体来说，假设 $K$ 是完美域，并且 $\operatorname{Gal}(K)$ 与 $p$ 互质。那么$K$ 上的每个阿贝尔簇 $A$ 都具有 Zariski 稠密 $K$ 有理点，并且如果 $C$ 是一条小于 $7-p$ 的平滑曲线且至少有一个 $K$ 有理点，则 $C$ 具有无穷多个 $K$ 有理点。
items.title_zh: 关于伽罗瓦群和大域的猜想

items.title: Beyond Response Scoring: An AI-aware Cognitive Supervision Framework for Automated Mathematical Short Answer Grading
items.excerpt: Transformer-based language models have achieved remarkable success in automated short answer grading (ASAG). However, current methods in ASAG struggle to comprehend, reason about and evaluate complex mathematical answers involving symbols and formulas. These score-only methods fail to generalize across diverse responses and skill states associated with identical scores. Moreover, they ignore the potential upward bias introduced by generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) usage in assessing students' performance and knowledge mastery. To address these limitations, we propose AICG (AI-aware Cognitive-supervised Grading), a two-branch multi-task framework. The first branch combines RoBERTa-based regression, ordinal, and classification heads for individual-answer grading. The second branch uses an expert-designed Q-matrix to associate responses with assessed skills and jointly predicts G-DINA-derived skill mastery and learning gain. Through the shared encoder, these skill-level targets provide cognitive supervision for answer grading beyond score labels. AICG further uses a Gen-AI detector, trained through supervised contrastive pretrainin

items.title: Collaborative work groups on exposition problems
items.excerpt: Fear of being scooped leads to unpolished preprints intended to claim priority. Could such undesirable flag-planting behavior also arise for expository work on key results? Starting from this premise, this post proposes that collaborative working groups offer a healthier way forward.

items.title: A new system of accreditation
items.excerpt: I propose the following: the main way that a mathematician obtains "credit" for new results should be by writing publications which are at the level of doctoral theses and defending them in front of the mathematical community. The community can then give this publicly available reviews. Hiring committees then look at someone's list of such publications, taking into account the community's comments to judge quality if they so desire, and make hiring decisions based on that.
items.title_zh: 新的认证体系
items.excerpt_zh: 我建议如下：数学家为新成果获得“信誉”的主要方式应该是撰写博士论文级别的出版物，并在数学界面前进行辩护。然后社区可以提供公开的评论。然后，招聘委员会会查看某人的此类出版物清单，并考虑社区的评论来判断质量（如果他们愿意），并据此做出招聘决定。

items.excerpt: Disproved · Ring theory; representation theory of rings · with GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 · significance 40/100. A ring R is right pure semisimple if every right R-module is a direct sum of finitely generated modules. Every ring of finite representation type is both left and right pure semisimple. The pure semisimplicity conjecture asserts the converse from one side: every right pure semisimple ring is of finite representation type, equivalently every right pure semisimple ring is also left pure semisimple. items.title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
items.excerpt: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). It reduces mean correction latency by 64.8% after completion and 44.3% during execution, with 38.1% fewer model calls. In a separate proof-of-concept evaluation over MIMIC, all 13 cohort states execute successfully, while correction trajectories demonstrate selective preservation of unaffected computations and recomputation of changed or dependent nodes. items.title: How Stable Are LLM-Generated Proofs Under Program Refactoring? A Stress Test for Verifiable Code Generation
items.excerpt: Benchmarks for verifiable code generation usually test a proof against one fixed implementation. We ask whether the same proof remains valid after a program refactoring that preserves behavior. We introduce RefactorProof, which derives 458 Lean-certified variants from the 185 VERINA tasks that compile in our pinned environment while holding the specification and evaluated proof fixed byte-for-byte. VERINA supplies reference proofs for 46 tasks, all from its basic split; the primary model-versus-reference comparisons further match on 21-25 short, non-recursive tasks. Structural refactorings expose substantial brittleness across proof sources: task-normalized structural PSR is 4.3% for the supplied references and 13.3-26.8% for the specialized provers. On the matched tasks, specialized prover proofs nevertheless have higher overall unchanged-proof survival than the supplied reference artifacts: +15.6 points for DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B, +18.8 for Goedel-Prover-V2-32B, and +20.3 for Goedel-Prover-V2-8B; all three 95% CIs exclude zero. The ordering persists after excluding universally survived T1 variants, under family-balanced aggregation,
items.title_zh: LLM 生成的证明在程序重构下的稳定性如何？可验证代码生成的压力测试
items.excerpt_zh: 可验证代码生成的基准通常会针对一种固定实现来测试证明。我们询问在保留行为的程序重构之后相同的证明是否仍然有效。我们引入了 RefactorProof，它从 185 个 VERINA 任务中派生出 458 个精益认证的变体，这些任务在我们的固定环境中进行编译，同时保持规范和评估证明逐字节固定。 VERINA 为 46 项任务提供参考证明，全部来自其基本拆分；主要模型与参考的比较进一步匹配 21-25 个简短的非递归任务。结构重构暴露了跨证明源的严重脆弱性：所提供参考的任务标准化结构 PSR 为 4.3%，专门证明者为 13.3-26.8%。在匹配的任务中，专门的证明者证明比提供的参考工件具有更高的总体不变证明生存率：DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 为 +15.6 分，Goedel-Prover-V2-32B 为 +18.8 分，Goedel-Prover-V2-8B 为 +20.3 分；所有三个 95% CI 均排除零。在家族平衡聚合下，排除普遍存活的 T1 变体后，排序仍然存在，

items.title: CASEL: Consequence-Aware Selective Execution for Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
items.excerpt: Tool-using language agents increasingly modify external systems, yet most runtime safeguards allocate scrutiny by generic uncertainty scores or coarse mutation heuristics. We introduce CASEL (Consequence-Aware Selective Execution Layer), a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that combines calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequence, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness to choose, for each proposed tool call, among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, and abstention by minimizing a per-mode cost. We formalize direct execution as selective prediction and state and test the validity conditions of a finite-sample threshold and a trajectory risk ledger. In a controlled simulation over 20 seeds with 120,000 test actions each, in which every method has the same intervention menu and the same compute cost, CASEL reduces harmful-side-effect trajectories from 14.75 percent for an uncertainty-ranked gate to 7.02 percent and mean normalized harm from 0.184 to 0.123. A gate ranked by the product of failure probability and consequence reaches similar harm (5.82 percent, 0.120) but sen
items.authors: Yanyan Zhang, Fei Shen, Ting Yan, Hao Zhang
items.title_zh: CASEL：针对可靠的长视野工具使用代理的后果感知选择性执行
items.excerpt_zh: 使用工具的语言代理越来越多地修改外部系统，但大多数运行时保护措施通过通用不确定性分数或粗略突变启发法来分配审查。我们引入了 CASEL（结果感知选择性执行层），这是一种与模型无关的运行时分配策略，它结合了校准失败概率、状态相关结果、可逆性、模糊性和证据新鲜度，对于每个建议的工具调用，通过最小化每种模式的成本，在直接执行、验证、沙箱、澄清、批准和弃权之间进行选择。我们将直接执行形式化为选择性预测和状态，并测试有限样本阈值和轨迹风险分类账的有效性条件。在对 20 多个种子进行的受控模拟中，每个种子有 120,000 个测试操作，其中每种方法都具有相同的干预菜单和相同的计算成本，CASEL 将有害副作用轨迹从不确定性排序门的 14.75% 减少到 7.02%，平均标准化伤害从 0.184 减少到 0.123。按故障概率和后果的乘积排名的门达到类似的危害（5.82％，0.120），但森

items.title: Learning to Formalize: Bridging Open-Ended Workloads and Fast Decision Models
items.excerpt: Decision models offer fast choices over sup- plied alternatives, while general-purpose large language models interpret open-ended tasks through flexible generation and reasoning at the cost of sequential decoding. Many work- loads expect a generative backend to determine what can be done and therefore provide no well-defined candidate list. We bridge this in- terface gap with a small candidate formalizer trained on offline teacher-generated lists. The formalizer constructs explicit, validated alter- natives from task context, and a frozen deci- sion model selects an entry. A motivating com- parison with official TypeSafe Jev-1.13.0 on 200 CALVIN-D test episodes reports 11% suc- cess with generic motions versus 46.5% with DeepSeek V4 Flash pose candidates. Sepa- rately, a six-arm privileged-state evaluation on 1,011 CALVIN-D validation annotations finds that a locally deployed decision model can achieve at most 52.6% task success rate with the fine-tuned formalizer, compared with 11.8% without it, and the end-to-end latency is kept to 2.09 s, whereas Qwen3.5-27B is 3.67 s with the exact experiment setting.
items.authors: Chengxuan Pei, Ziyao Wang, Teng Mei, Zhe Li
items.title_zh: 学习形式化：连接开放式工作负载和快速决策模型
items.excerpt_zh: 决策模型提供了对所提供替代方案的快速选择，而通用大型语言模型通过灵活的生成和推理来解释开放式任务，但代价是顺序解码。许多工作负载期望生成后端来确定可以做什么，因此没有提供明确定义的候选列表。我们通过在离线教师生成的列表上进行训练的小型候选形式化器来弥补这一接口差距。形式化器根据任务上下文构造明确的、经过验证的替代方案，并且冻结的决策模型选择一个条目。在 200 个 CALVIN-D 测试集上与官方 TypeSafe Jev-1.13.0 进行的令人兴奋的比较显示，通用动作的成功率为 11%，而 DeepSeek V4 Flash 候选姿势的成功率为 46.5%。另外，对 1,011 个 CALVIN-D 验证注释进行的六臂特权状态评估发现，使用微调形式化器，本地部署的决策模型最多可以实现 52.6% 的任务成功率，而没有微调形式化器的任务成功率为 11.8%，并且端到端延迟保持在 2.09 秒，而在精确的实验设置下，Qwen3.5-27B 为 3.67 秒。

items.title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
items.excerpt: Reflective text optimization makes agentic systems better, but the optimization loop is itself a resource-hungry workload whose sequential structure leaves parallel evaluation capacity idle. We extend the open-source GEPA optimizer to propose and evaluate a batch of candidates on each optimization step instead of one candidate at a time. In our sweep on two tasks, most batched runs finished in half the wall-clock time or less, and the fastest in about a quarter to a third. Batched settings also achieved higher held-out test scores, from 68.9% to 72.1% on LiveBench-Math (with $2\times2$) and from 49.0% to 60.0% on HoVer (with $8\times1$). A simple runtime model explains the measured speedups under a finite worker pool, and batched settings also spend their metric-call and dollar budgets more efficiently. We frame the axes along which a reflective optimization step can scale in parallel, a first look at allocating a fixed optimization budget across them.
items.authors: Jialin Zhang, Lakshya A Agrawal, Shangyin Tan, Donghyun Lee, Lutfi Eren Erdogan, Dan Klein, Koushik Sen, Alex Dimakis, Matei Zaharia
items.title_zh: 批处理反射优化循环：并行提案使 GEPA 更快更好
items.excerpt_zh: 反射文本优化使代理系统变得更好，但优化循环本身是一个资源匮乏的工作负载，其顺序结构使并行评估能力闲置。我们扩展了开源 GEPA 优化器，以在每个优化步骤中提出并评估一批候选者，而不是一次一个候选者。在我们对两项任务的扫描中，大多数批处理运行在挂钟时间的一半或更短的时间内完成，最快的运行时间约为四分之一到三分之一。批量设置还获得了更高的保留测试分数，LiveBench-Math 上的分数从 68.9% 提高到 72.1%（$2\times2$），HoVer 上的分数从 49.0% 提高到 60.0%（$8\times1$）。一个简单的运行时模型解释了在有限工作池下测得的加速情况，并且批处理设置还可以更有效地花费其度量调用和美元预算。我们构建了反射优化步骤可以并行扩展的轴，首先考虑在它们之间分配固定的优化预算。

items.title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.
items.authors: Bo Yang, Zishuai Zhang, Weihua Li, Qinnan Zhang, Sijia Wen, Hainan Zhang
items.title_zh: Guided-RLVR：具有可验证奖励的强化学习的引导探索
items.excerpt_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提高大型语言模型（LLM）在数学和编程等任务上的推理能力方面显示出强大的经验收益。然而，最近的研究表明，RLVR 的推出经常会陷入一组狭窄的推理轨迹，从而限制了探索的推理空间。受关键步骤中的思维标记作为 LLM 推理路径中的关键结构元素这一发现的启发，我们提出了 Guided-RLVR，这是一种通过轻量级控制器增强 RLVR 的新颖方法。控制器策略性地将语义上有意义的引导标记注入到采样分布中，鼓励模型从多个推理角度处理问题，从而扩大探索空间。数学推理和代码生成基准的实验表明，Guided-RLVR 始终优于现有的 RLVR 方法，同时产生更多样化的推理轨迹。

items.title: Can LLMs Reliably Grade Olympiad Proofs? A Study of Mathematical Verification with LLMs
items.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress on solving competition-level mathematics, yet their ability to verify natural-language mathematical proofs remains relatively underexplored. This gap is especially pronounced for Olympiad-level proofs, which require meticulous assessment of each claim in a long reasoning chain. Current proof verification thus primarily relies on expert inspection, which is costly to scale. In this paper, we present a systematic study of LLM-based verification in this setting. Specifically, we introduce a human-curated dataset of USAMO 2025 candidate solutions with expert grading, and conduct a broad evaluation of existing LLM verifiers across frontier models. We also propose TROJAN, an iterative self-critique pipeline for generating high-fidelity adversarial proofs at scale. Our comprehensive evaluation covers 20 models spanning seven metrics, two prompt styles, three inference methods, and three prompt templates, showing that state-of-the-art models still leave considerable room for improvement. To narrow this gap, we propose MABGrader, a Multi-Armed Bandit framework that reframes grading as
items.authors: Azim Ospanov, Zijin Feng, Ding Ding, Chengwu Liu, Haoli Bai, Jiacheng Sun, Lifeng Shang, Farzan Farnia
items.title_zh: 法学硕士可以可靠地对奥林匹克校样进行评分吗？法学硕士数学验证研究
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在解决竞赛级数学方面取得了显着进展，但其验证自然语言数学证明的能力仍然相对未得到充分开发。这种差距对于奥林匹克级别的证明尤其明显，这需要对长推理链中的每个主张进行仔细评估。因此，当前的证据验证主要依赖于专家检查，而这对于规模化来说成本高昂。在本文中，我们在此背景下对基于法学硕士的验证进行了系统研究。具体来说，我们引入了由专家评分的 USAMO 2025 候选解决方案的人工数据集，并对跨前沿模型的现有 LLM 验证者进行了广泛的评估。我们还提出了 TROJAN，一种迭代自我批评管道，用于大规模生成高保真对抗性证明。我们的综合评估涵盖了 20 个模型，涵盖七个指标、两种提示样式、三种推理方法和三个提示模板，这表明最先进的模型仍然存在很大的改进空间。为了缩小这一差距，我们提出了 MABGrader，这是一个 Multi-Armed Bandit 框架，它将分级重新定义为

items.title: Dependency Graphs of Mathematical Arguments: Representation, Structural Measurement, and Proof Review
items.excerpt: We propose a source-grounded framework for representing and measuring mathematical arguments with assistance from large language models. It includes numbered and unnumbered statements, equations, assumptions, and constructions, distinguishing source occurrences from contextual states and inference records. Proposed dependencies retain source evidence and review status. A measurement contract fixes manuscript versions, boundaries, granularity, proof choices, and macro anchors. On a selected finite directed acyclic graph, depth is the longest prerequisite-path length, and bulk counts distinct ancestor edges. We give a union recurrence that accounts for shared subarguments and identify reachability conditions preserving depth and the macro skeleton; unrestricted refinement need not preserve depth or bulk. A standardized, versioned prompt protocol separates annotation discovery, deterministic recomputation, and review assistance. Cross-paper links support a research agenda on theorem co-use, rare combinations, and connections between dependency communities. These patterns motivate probabilistic premise suggestions and review of possible o
items.title_zh: 数学论证的依赖图：表示、结构测量和证明审查
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个基于源的框架，用于在大型语言模型的帮助下表示和测量数学论证。它包括编号和未编号的陈述、方程、假设和构造，将源事件与上下文状态和推理记录区分开来。建议的依赖项保留源证据和审查状态。测量合同确定了手稿版本、边界、粒度、证明选择和宏观锚点。在选定的有限有向无环图上，深度是最长的先决路径长度，并且批量计数不同的祖先边缘。我们给出了一个联合递归，它解释了共享子参数并确定了保持深度和宏观骨架的可达性条件；无限制的细化不需要保留深度或体积。标准化的版本化提示协议将注释发现、确定性重新计算和审查协助分开。跨论文链接支持关于定理共同使用、罕见组合以及依赖社区之间的联系的研究议程。这些模式激发了概率前提建议和对可能的情况的审查

items.title: Why and how to transparently disclose AI use in mathematics research
items.excerpt: With the goal of standardising AI disclosures, I argue for the inclusion of maximally transparent AI disclosures in mathematics research. I provide concrete and actionable guiding principles, a taxonomy and a LaTeX package for implementation.
items.title_zh: 为什么以及如何透明地披露人工智能在数学研究中的使用
items.excerpt_zh: 为了标准化人工智能披露的目标，我主张在数学研究中纳入最大程度透明的人工智能披露。我提供了具体且可操作的指导原则、分类法和用于实施的 LaTeX 包。

items.title: Math2038: A Day in the Life of Future Mathematicians
items.excerpt: A short story (8 min read) about one Friday in 2038: AI has become extremely capable at mathematics, yet a professor, a postdoc and a first-year student still find meaning and joy in their craft.
items.title_zh: Math2038：未来数学家生活中的一天
items.excerpt_zh: 一个关于 2038 年某个星期五的短篇故事（阅读 8 分钟）：人工智能在数学方面已经变得非常有能力，但教授、博士后和一年级学生仍然在自己的技艺中找到意义和乐趣。

items.title: Responsibility of Mathematicians in the Age of AI
items.excerpt: “The day mathematics felt different to me was sometime in July. Until the beginning of this year, I had mostly avoided AI, hoping the hype would blow over. Anyway, the models hallucinated too much to be very useful. Then something changed. They got better, very very quickly.” […]
items.title_zh: 人工智能时代数学家的责任
items.excerpt_zh: “七月份的某个时候，我对数学感到不一样。直到今年年初，我基本上都回避人工智能，希望炒作能够平息。无论如何，这些模型产生了太多幻觉，不太有用。然后事情发生了变化。它们变得更好，非常非常快。” […]

items.title: Forcing square with small conditions
items.excerpt: We show that if $\kappa^{<\kappa} = \kappa$, then there is a $\kappa$-strategically closed, $\kappa^+$-c.c. partial order that forces $\square_\kappa$. We discuss consequences for generic large cardinals.
items.title_zh: 小条件下强制平方
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，如果 $\kappa^{<\kappa} = \kappa$，则存在 $\kappa$-策略关闭，$\kappa^+$-c.c。强制 $\square_\kappa$ 的偏序。我们讨论一般大基数的后果。

items.title: Counting Markov triples and simple geodesics
items.excerpt: We give an asymptotic formula for the number of Markov triples with largest entry below $x$. We show that the error term is $o(\log x)$, which improves upon the previous best known results due to McShane and Rivin. We give an explicit error based on classical zero-free regions of the Riemann zeta function, and a sharper estimate under the quasi-Riemann hypothesis. The proof uses the correspondence between Markov triples and simple closed geodesics on the modular punctured torus and a careful analysis of the McShane-Rivin unit ball.
items.title_zh: 计算马尔可夫三元组和简单测地线
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出了最大条目低于 $x$ 的马尔可夫三元组数量的渐近公式。我们证明误差项是 $o(\log x)$，它改进了 McShane 和 Rivin 先前最知名的结果。我们给出了基于黎曼 zeta 函数的经典无零区域的显式误差，以及拟黎曼假设下的更清晰的估计。该证明使用了马尔可夫三元组与模穿孔环面上的简单闭合测地线之间的对应关系以及对 McShane-Rivin 单位球的仔细分析。

items.title: Uniform local models of quasi-unipotent $p$-adic differential equations
items.excerpt: We construct uniform analytic models of quasi-unipotent differential modules over Robba rings. For modules of rank at most $r$ and highest ramification break at most $b$, the inner radius of the model annulus depends only on $r,b$ and the residue characteristic $p$. At each radius, the model admits a basis, possibly depending on the radius, in which the connection matrix is bounded by a constant depending only on $r,b,p$. Both bounds are independent of the coefficient field, and these analytic models require no coefficient extension. A prescribed absolute Frobenius structure extends to such a bounded model with the same radius and connection bound. After a finite coefficient extension, we also realize quasi-constant modules, which carry the finite local monodromy, as differential direct summands of sums of pushforwards of rank-one modules, with uniformly bounded cover degrees and highest breaks of the inducing modules.
items.title_zh: 拟单能$p$-adic微分方程的均匀局部模型
items.excerpt_zh: 我们构建了 Robba 环上准单能微分模的一致解析模型。对于等级最多为 $r$ 且最高分枝断点最多为 $b$ 的模块，模型环的内半径仅取决于 $r,b$ 和残差特征 $p$。在每个半径处，模型承认一个基，可能取决于半径，其中连接矩阵由仅取决于 $r,b,p$ 的常数界定。两个界限都独立于系数场，并且这些解析模型不需要系数扩展。规定的绝对弗罗贝尼乌斯结构扩展到具有相同半径和连接边界的有界模型。经过有限系数扩展后，我们还实现了准常数模块，它具有有限局部单性，作为一级模块的前推和的微分直加数，具有均匀有界的覆盖度和归纳模块的最高中断。

items.title: Hankel determinants for the $(n+2)$-shifted $q$-metallic numbers
items.excerpt: Let $\Phi_n(q)$ denote the $q$-deformation (in the sense of Morier-Genoud & Ovsienko) of the metallic number $\phi_n=\frac{n+\sqrt{n^2+4}}{2}$. This is a power series with integer coefficients. We prove that the Hankel continued fraction of the $(n+2)$-shifted series $\Phi_n^{(n+2)}$ is eventually periodic, and that the corresponding Hankel determinant sequence $\Delta^{(n+2)}$ is $2n(n+1)$-periodic if $n$ is even, $2n(n+1)$-antiperiodic if $n$ is odd, and that it takes only the values $-2,-1,0,1,2$. This confirms part of a former conjecture of ours and complements similar results we obtained for all $\ell$-shifts of $\Phi_n$ with $0\le\ell\le n+1$. In addition, we formulate a new conjecture of quasi-polynomiality for higher shifts $\ell\ge n+3$. The determinant values arise as telescoping products of the partial numerators of the Hankel continued fraction. Most of the technically involved and lengthy verifications are carried out by a symbolic computation program, whose code is publicly available on GitHub for independent verification.
items.title_zh: $(n+2)$ 移动的 $q$ 金属数的 Hankel 行列式
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\Phi_n(q)$ 表示金属数 $\phi_n=\frac{n+\sqrt{n^2+4}}{2}$ 的 $q$ 变形（在 Morier-Genoud 和 Ovsienko 的意义上）。这是具有整数系数的幂级数。我们证明$(n+2)$平移级数$\Phi_n^{(n+2)}$的汉克尔连分式最终是周期的，并且相应的汉克尔行列式序列$\Delta^{(n+2)}$是$2n(n+1)$-周期如果$n$是偶数，$2n(n+1)$-反周期如果$n$是奇数，并且它只需要值$-2,-1,0,1,2$。这证实了我们之前猜想的一部分，并补充了我们对 $\Phi_n$ 与 $0\le\ell\le n+1$ 的所有 $\ell$-shifts 获得的类似结果。此外，我们针对更高的位移 $\ell\ge n+3$ 提出了一个新的拟多项式猜想。行列式值作为汉克尔连分数的部分分子的伸缩乘积而出现。大多数涉及技术且冗长的验证都是通过符号计算程序进行的，其代码在 GitHub 上公开可供独立验证。

items.title: Computations in weight 3 of higher Bloch groups
items.excerpt: We computationally investigate a weight 3 analogue of the relationship between higher Bloch groups, algebraic K-theory, higher regulators, and special values of Dedekind zeta functions. In particular, for F a number field F, we define the pruned Bloch group B _3(F) and compare the covolume of its regulator lattice with zeta_F(3). We define a quantity kappa_3(F), which is conjecturally an integer, that is expected to be closely related to the order of K_4(O_F).
items.authors: Herbert Gangl, Paul E. Gunnells, Dan Yasaki
items.title_zh: 更高 Bloch 群的权重 3 的计算
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过计算研究了高级布洛赫群、代数 K 理论、高级调节器和 Dedekind zeta 函数的特殊值之间关系的权重 3 类似物。特别是，对于 F 数域 F，我们定义剪枝的布洛赫群 B _3(F) 并将其调节晶格的余体积与 zeta_F(3) 进行比较。我们定义一个量 kappa_3(F)，推测它是一个整数，预计与 K_4(O_F) 的阶数密切相关。

items.title: Infinite families and sporadic solutions of the equation $\varphi(n)=c+\alpha\sum_{p\mid n}\varphi(p)$

We determine the parameters $(c,\alpha)$ admitting infinite families of solutions, prove that all remaining solutions are finite in number and arise from an explicit linear mechanism, and compute them exactly in a range of parameters; the finiteness of $\{4,12,30\}$ becomes a special case. items.authors: Hac\`ene Belbachir, Ravi Ranjan, Shubh N. Singh
items.title_zh: 方程的无限族和零星解 $\varphi(n)=c+\alpha\sum_{p\mid n}\varphi(p)$
items.excerpt_zh: Ranjan 和 Singh 证明，对于每个不是奇素数两倍的复合 $n$，$\varphi(n)$ 至少是 $\varphi$ 与 $n$ 素数因数之和的一加上，对于 $n=4,12,30$ 完全相等。 \new{我们研究加权方程$\varphi(n)=c+\alpha\sum_{p\mid n}\varphi(p)$。我们确定允许无限族解的参数$(c,\alpha)$，证明所有剩余的解在数量上是有限的并且由显式线性机制产生，并在参数范围内精确地计算它们； $\{4,12,30\}$ 的有限性成为一种特殊情况。我们还解决了除数函数 $\tau$ 和 $\sigma$ 以及 Jordan totients 的类似方程，并根据素因数之和的已知结果，推导出平均缺陷的完全渐近展开式。} \K{在 $|c|\le10$、$1\le\alpha\le6$ 范围内，复合解集完全确定\V{，并且零星解的数量和大小显示为有界通过 $|c|+\alpha$} 中的多项式。} \B{最后，将素数 $\varphi(p)$ 替换为其迭代 $\varphi^{(k)}(p)$，我们确定所有解

items.title: Retriangular numbers and affine maps between polygonal numbers
items.excerpt: A positive integer $a$ is called \emph{retriangular} if there is a positive integer $b$ such that $aT+b$ is a triangular number whenever $T$ is. We show that the retriangular numbers are exactly the odd squares greater than $1$, and that for each of them $b$ is unique. The proof rests on a rigidity principle: a non-constant affine map carrying the values of one quadratic sequence into the values of another is induced by an affine map of the plane sending the vertex of one parabola to the vertex of the other. We use it to classify all affine maps between sets of polygonal numbers; the $s$-gonal numbers map affinely into the $t$-gonal numbers if and only if $M_t\mid M_s$, where $M_s=2(s-2)/\gcd(s,4)$ defines a bijection from $\{3,4,5,\dots\}$ onto the positive integers. We also treat sparse data, polynomial maps, figurate numbers of higher degree and sums of two triangular numbers, and we study the monoid of affine self-maps of an arbitrary set of integers. For the $s$-gonal numbers this monoid is an arithmetical congruence monoid, and the factorization of self-maps into irreducible ones is unique only for triangular and square numbers.
items.title_zh: 直角三角形数和多边形数之间的仿射映射
items.excerpt_zh: 如果存在正整数 $b$，使得只要 $T$ 为三角数，$aT+b$ 就是三角数，则正整数 $a$ 称为 \emph{retriangular}。我们证明，再三角数正是大于 $1$ 的奇数平方，并且每个 $b$ 都是唯一的。该证明基于刚性原理：将一个二次序列的值传递到另一个二次序列的值中的非恒定仿射图是由将一个抛物线的顶点发送到另一个抛物线的顶点的平面仿射图导出的。我们用它来对多边形数集之间的所有仿射映射进行分类；当且仅当 $M_t\mid M_s$ 时，$s$-gonal 数会亲和地映射到 $t$-gonal 数，其中 $M_s=2(s-2)/\gcd(s,4)$ 定义从 $\{3,4,5,\dots\}$ 到正整数的双射。我们还处理稀疏数据、多项式映射、更高阶的图形数以及两个三角形数的和，并且我们研究任意整数集的仿射自映射的幺半群。对于 $s$-gonal 数，这个幺半群是算术同余幺半群，并且将自映射分解为不可约的幺半群仅对于三角形和平方数是唯一的。

items.title: Pointwise to global good reduction problems
items.excerpt: Given a smooth proper family of varieties over some $p$-adic field, if (sufficiently many of) the closed fibers have good reduction, does the family as a whole have good reduction? This question is asked and positively answered in recent work of Cadoret-Tamagawa for curves in general, and abelian varieties if the base field has absolute ramification at most $p-1$. In this paper we define a general framework for studying this question, yielding new positive answers for families of K3 surfaces and cubic fourfoulds, again with ramification at most $p-1$. Our strategy is to study several extension properties of moduli spaces and how they transfer under various morphisms. Of particular importance are integral canonical models of Shimura varieties, and whether or not their extension properties are preserved under ramified scalar extension. Additionally, building on earlier counterexamples by Raynaud-Ogus-Gabber and Vasiu-Zink, we show that the ramification assumption is optimal for the result of Cadoret-Tamagawa on families of abelian varieties. items.title_zh: 针对全球商品减少问题
items.excerpt_zh: 给定一个在某些 $p$-adic 域上的光滑真值族，如果（足够多的）闭合纤维具有良好的还原性，那么该族作为一个整体是否具有良好的还原性？如果基场的绝对分枝至多为 $p-1$，则在 Cadoret-Tamakawa 最近针对一般曲线和阿贝尔变体的工作中提出了这个问题并得到了积极的回答。在本文中，我们定义了一个研究这个问题的总体框架，为 K3 曲面族和立方四元组提供新的肯定答案，同样具有最多 $p-1$ 的分支。我们的策略是研究模空间的几个可拓性质以及它们在各种态射下如何转移。特别重要的是 Shimura 簇的积分规范模型，以及它们的可拓特性是否在分支标量可拓下得以保留。此外，基于 Raynaud-Ogus-Gabber 和 Vasiu-Zink 的早期反例，我们表明分枝假设对于 Cadoret-Tamakawa 对阿贝尔变种家族的结果是最优的。这反映了这样一个事实：Siegel Shimura 品种的可拓性质不再成立。

items.title: Gross--Prasad conjecture in geometric Langlands
items.excerpt: We prove part of the global Gross--Prasad conjecture for $G = \mathrm{SO}_{n} \times \mathrm{SO}_{n-1}$ and $H = \mathrm{SO}_{n-1}$ in the unramified de Rham geometric Langlands setting proposed by Ben-Zvi--Sakellaridis--Venkatesh.
items.title_zh: 格罗斯--几何朗兰兹中的普拉萨德猜想
items.excerpt_zh: 我们在 Ben-Zvi--Sakellaridis--Venkatesh 提出的未分支 de Rham 几何 Langlands 设置中证明了 $G = \mathrm{SO}_{n} \times \mathrm{SO}_{n-1}$ 和 $H = \mathrm{SO}_{n-1}$ 的全局 Gross--Prasad 猜想的一部分。

items.title: Average eccentricity in k-connected tournaments
items.excerpt: The average eccentricity $\avec(D)$ of a strong digraph $D$ is the mean eccentricity of all vertices in $D$. A tournament $T$ is an orientation of a complete graph. In this paper, we prove that the average eccentricity satisfies $2 \le \avec(T) < \frac{n}{2k} + \frac{11}{2} + \frac{k}{8n}$ for a $k$-connected tournament $T$ of order $n$. We further examine the case for strong tournaments where $k = 1$, and show that $\avec(T) \le \frac{n+11}{2} + \frac{1}{8n}$ for any strong tournament $T$. Moreover, we show that the lower bound $2$ is sharp and that the upper bounds are best possible apart from an additive constant.
items.title_zh: k 连接锦标赛中的平均偏心率
items.excerpt_zh: 强有向图 $D$ 的平均偏心率 $\avec(D)$ 是 $D$ 中所有顶点的平均偏心率。锦标赛 $T$ 是完整图的一个方向。在本文中，我们证明对于 $n$ 阶的 $k$ 连接锦标赛 $T$，平均偏心率满足 $2 \le \avec(T) < \frac{n}{2k} + \frac{11}{2} + \frac{k}{8n}$。我们进一步研究 $k = 1$ 的强锦标赛的情况，并表明对于任何强锦标赛 $T$ 都有 $\avec(T) \le \frac{n+11}{2} + \frac{1}{8n}$。此外，我们表明下限 $2$ 是尖锐的，并且除了加性常数之外，上限是最好的。

items.title: On Hamilton cycles in quasiprimitive graphs of order $2pq$
items.excerpt: Let $p>q>5$ be primes. We determine the socles and corresponding actions of quasiprimitive imprimitive groups of degree $2pq$, all of which are almost simple. Using this classification, we prove that a connected graph of order $2pq$ admitting a quasiprimitive automorphism group contains a Hamilton cycle, except possibly for three specified families of actions with socle $\PSL(2,p)$ or $\PSL(2,q^2)$.
items.title_zh: 论 $2pq$ 阶准原图中的哈密顿循环
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $p>q>5$ 为素数。我们确定$2pq$阶的准原初群的底点和相应的动作，所有这些都几乎是简单的。使用此分类，我们证明承认准原语自同构群的 $2pq$ 阶连通图包含汉密尔顿循环，除了可能具有底 $\PSL(2,p)$ 或 $\PSL(2,q^2)$ 的三个指定的动作族。

items.title: A generalization of pseudocomplementation in semilattices, lattices and posets with 0
items.excerpt: Pseudocomplemented lattices satisfy a lot of nice properties and were studied by a number of algebraists. However, even when a poset P with 0 is not pseudocomplemented, we can assign to every element a of P the set $a^p$ of all maximal elements being orthogonal to a. This assignment $^p$ is a non-trivial operator provided P satisfies the so-called Ascending Chain Condition (ACC). In particular, we investigate this operator when the poset P in question is a semilattice or a lattice. We characterize this operator and describe its properties that turn out to be similar to the corresponding properties of pseudocomplementation. Moreover, we introduce an equivalence relation $\Theta_p$ on P induced by $^p$ similarly as it was done by V. I. Glivenko for distributive pseudocomplemented lattices. Finally, we investigate for which lattices L with 0 satisfying the ACC this equivalence relation turns out to be a congruence and when the quotient lattice $L/\Theta_p$ is complemented respectively modular.
items.title_zh: 半格、格和 0 偏序集中伪补的推广
items.excerpt_zh: 伪补格满足许多良好的性质，并被许多代数学家研究。然而，即使当具有 0 的偏序集 P 不是伪补集时，我们也可以将与 a 正交的所有最大元素的集合 $a^p$ 分配给 P 的每个元素 a。如果 P 满足所谓的升序链条件 (ACC)，则此赋值 $^p$ 是一个不平凡的运算符。特别是，当所讨论的偏序集 P 是半格或格时，我们研究该算子。我们描述了该运算符的特征并描述了其与伪互补的相应属性相似的属性。此外，我们在 P 上引入了由 $^p$ 引发的等价关系 $\Theta_p$，类似于 V. I. Glivenko 对于分配伪补格的做法。最后，我们研究对于哪些具有 0 的格 L 满足 ACC，该等价关系被证明是同余的，以及商格 $L/\Theta_p$ 何时分别模补。

items.title: Existence of uniformly most reliable two-terminal graphs with distance constraints
items.excerpt: A two-terminal graph is a simple graph equipped with two distinguished vertices, called terminals. Let $T_{n,m}$ be the class consisting of all non-isomorphic two-terminal graphs on $n$ vertices and $m$ edges. Let $G$ be any two-terminal graph in $T_{n,m}$, and let $d$ be any positive integer. For every $\rho\in [0,1]$, the \emph{$d$-constrained two-terminal reliability of $G$ at $\rho$}, denoted $R_G^d(\rho)$, is the probability that $G$ has some path of length at most $d$ joining its terminals after each of its edges is independently deleted with probability $\rho$. We say $G$ is a \emph{$d$-uniformly most reliable two-terminal graph} ($d$-UMRTTG) if for each $H$ in $T_{n,m}$ and every $\rho \in [0,1]$ it holds that $R_{G}^d(\rho)\geq R_{H}^{d}(\rho)$. Previous works studied the existence of $d$-UMRTTG in $T_{n,m}$ when $d$ is greater than or equal to $n-1$, or equivalently, when the distance constraint is dropped. In this work, a characterization of all $1$-UMRTTGs and $2$-UMRTTGs is given. Several structural properties of 3-UMRTTGs are established. items.excerpt:

items.title: A new infinite family of covers of complete graphs that admit a half-transitive action of a Suzuki simple group
items.excerpt: We construct a new infinite family of antipodal $2(q-1)$-covers of complete graphs $K_{q^2+1}$ of diameter $3$, where $q=2^{2e+1}\ge 8$, admitting a half-transitive action of the Suzuki simple group $Sz(q)$. We further show that each constructed cover admits an involutory automorphism interchanging the two $Sz(q)$-orbits on arcs, which yields that its full automorphism group is arc-transitive.
items.title_zh: 一个新的无限族完全图覆盖，承认铃木简单群的半传递作用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们构建了一个新的无限族对映体 $2(q-1)$ - 覆盖了直径为 $3$ 的完整图 $K_{q^2+1}$，其中 $q=2^{2e+1}\ge 8$，承认铃木单群 $Sz(q)$ 的半传递作用。我们进一步表明，每个构造的覆盖都承认一个内卷自同构，交换弧上的两个 $Sz(q)$ 轨道，这使得它的完整自同构群是弧传递的。

items.title: Mutation-acyclicity in rank four is decidable but not semialgebraic
items.excerpt: We prove that mutation-acyclicity of quivers on four vertices is decidable. If a four-vertex quiver $Q$ is mutation-acyclic, then some sequence of mutations takes it to an acyclic quiver without any arrow multiplicity exceeding $\operatorname{max}\{\operatorname{ht}(Q),m(Q)\}$, where $\operatorname{ht}(Q)$ is the largest arrow multiplicity of $Q$ and $m(Q)$ is the Markov invariant of Fomin and Neville evaluated on the totally proper wiggle class of $Q$. A search within a computable form of this bound decides mutation-acyclicity of four-vertex quivers with $O(h^{24})$ states for input height $h\ge1$. Together with a theorem of Caldero and Keller, it also decides mutation equivalence of two four-vertex quivers up to relabeling whenever one of them is mutation-acyclic. We conjecture that $\operatorname{ht}(Q)$ alone suffices as the bound, which would reduce the search to $O(h^{6})$ states, and we verify this for all four-vertex quivers of height at most three. items.title: On the diameter and distribution of Sidon sets
items.excerpt: A Sidon set is a set $\mathcal{A}$ of integers with the property that if $0\neq a-b=c-d$ and $a,b,c,d\in\mathcal{A}$, then $(a,b)=(c,d)$. Our main result is an improved and explicit bound on the diameter of a Sidon set: if $\mathcal{A}$ is a Sidon set with $k\ge 1$ elements, then \[\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A}) \ge k^2 \left(\frac{1}{1 + 0.945/\sqrt{k}}-\frac{0.945}{\sqrt k}\right) -1;\] in particular, $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A})\ge k^2-1.89 k^{3/2}$. This implies that if $\mathcal{A}\subseteq[1,N]$ is a Sidon set, then $|\mathcal{A}| \le N^{1/2}+0.945 \, N^{1/4}+0.447$. Our technique also gives an improved bound for the case of large $k$, namely $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal{A}) \ge k^2-1.88607 k^{3/2}$ for $k\ge 483$. A $\gamma$-Golomb ruler is a set $\mathcal{A}$ of integers with the property that there are not $\gamma+1$ distinct pairs $(a_i,b_i)\in\mathcal{A}^2$ with $0\neq a_1-b_1=\cdots=a_{\gamma+1}-b_{\gamma+1}$. Our diameter bounds extend in a natural way to the case of Golomb rulers.
